source_text:
政治与外交
东盟与欧盟最明显的区别之一就在于东盟坚持奉行“互不干涉内政”原则，成员国之间互相尊重彼此采取的政体，同时在对待区域外国家的外交政策方面也不奉行统一的路线方针，但在南海问题上则采取彼此忍让、互不争斗的政策。
target_text: One of the most obvious differences between ASEAN and the EU is ASEAN's adherence to the principle of “non-interference in each other's internal affairs” and mutual respect for each other's polities, as well as the lack of a unified approach to foreign policy vis-à-vis countries outside the region, but the policy of mutual tolerance and non-controversialism in relation to the South China Sea.
title: 东南亚

source_text: 菲律宾、泰国和新加坡从冷战开始至今一直奉行亲近美国的外交路线，美国在三个国家都有驻军。菲律宾在政治上（尤其南海问题上）与中華民國和中华人民共和国之冲突最为尖锐，在杜特尔特上台后争端稍微平缓下来。泰国和新加坡在中华人民共和国停止对外输出革命后与中华人民共和国较少直接冲突，北京奥运会圣火传递活动没有选择经停新加坡，非常耐人寻味。印尼、马来西亚和冷战时期结束后的越南奉行均衡外交政策，不与任何一个大国结盟，也未允许外国在本国常驻军队，但也注意与美国保持友善以对抗中华人民共和国对南海的领土索求。越南常因领土利益问题与中华人民共和国发生冲突。缅甸在冷战时期奉行中立外交政策，与美国、苏联、中华人民共和国保持“等距离”；90年代及21世纪初期与美国关系逐漸交惡，被美国和欧盟长期制裁；2011年实行“民主大选”后逐渐对外开放本国市场，与西方国家的关系迅速改善，同时注意拉近与日本、印度的关系以防止过度依赖中华人民共和国，而被其所控。国小力弱的柬埔寨和老撾夹在中越泰三国之间左支右绌，很难在外交舞台上有所表现。越南、菲律宾和马来西亚对南海岛礁的主权要求有重叠，但彼此之间没有发生过冲突。越南与菲律宾近年来在南海问题上多有合作。
target_text: The Philippines’ political (especially South China Sea) conflict with China’s People’s Republic of China and the People’s Republic of China has been most acute, and the dispute has subsided slightly after Dutelt took office. Thailand and Singapore have pursued a neutral foreign policy during the Cold War, with the US, the Soviet Union, the People’s Republic of China, and with the People’s Republic of China, with less direct conflict with the People’s Republic of China.
title: 东南亚

source_text: 在中華民國大陸時期，中國國籍指中華民國國籍。中華民國政府承認雙重國籍，中華民國國民可以同時擁有中華民國國籍和外國國籍，持有其他護照，方便出國。1949年两岸分治，因两岸政府对全中国主权的主张，造成中华民国国民和中华人民共和国国民身份重叠。香港、澳门居民亦同样拥有完全的中华民国国民身份，归为华侨、無戶籍國民。由于两岸长期分治、1990年代香港和澳门主权移交中华人民共和国的现实，目前的中華民國國民一般指持有中華民國護照的台湾地区（台灣、澎湖、金门和马祖）居民，即通常所说的臺灣人。2013年7月，司法院釋字第710號解釋中，諸位大法官對大陸地區人民的憲法定位各有解釋。實務上，關於公務員報考及投資事務，不適用國民身份，關於安全事故索賠事務，則適用國民身份。
target_text: During China’s mainland period, Chinese nationals were also considered Chinese nationals. China’s government recognized dual citizenship, and Chinese citizens were able to hold Chinese and foreign citizenship at the same time, holding other passports and facilitating their exit. The division of the two sides of the Taiwan Straits in 1949 resulted in the overlapping status of nationals of the Republic of China and the People’s Republic of China as a result of the sovereignty claims of the two sides over the whole of China. Hong Kong and Macao also had the full status of nationals of the Republic of China as Chinese and non-nationals. As a result of the reality of the permanent separation of the two sides, the transfer of sovereignty to the People’s Republic of China in the 1990’s, Hong Kong and Macao in the 1990’s.
title: 中國人

source_text: 到2018年中為止，聯合國總共有193個会员国，包括除梵蒂岡城國以外所有无争议的主權國都是联合国会员国。在聯合國遍布世界的辦事處中，聯合國及其專門機構通過全年舉行定期會議來決定實體和行政議題。聯合國由六大主要機構組成：聯合國大會（主要的審議機構）、安理會（以決定對和平與安全的某些決議）、經濟及社會理事會（以協助促進國際經濟和社會的合作和發展）、秘書處（為聯合國提供所需的研究、資訊和設施）、國際法院（主要的司法機構）以及聯合國託管理事會（當前沒有運作）。其他重要的聯合國機構還有世界衛生組織、世界糧食計畫署和聯合國兒童基金會。聯合國的行政首長是聯合國秘書長。聯合國的經費由會員國分攤和自願捐贈。聯合國現今有六種工作語言，分別為：阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文、西班牙文。
target_text: As of mid-2018, the United Nations has 193 Member States, including all non-controversial major powers, except for Vatican City. In UN offices throughout the world, the United Nations and its specialized agencies decide on practical and administrative issues through regular meetings throughout the year. The United Nations is composed of six major bodies: the United Nations General Assembly (the main deliberative body), the Security Council (by deciding on certain decisions on peace and security), the Economic and Social Council (by helping to promote cooperation and development in the international economy and society), the Secretariat (by providing the United Nations with the research, information and facilities needed), the International Court of Justice (the main judicial body) and the United Nations Office of Management (which did not operate before). Other important UN bodies are the World Health Organization, the World Food Programme and the United Nations Children’s Fund.
title: 联合国

source_text:
背景和建立（1945年—1947年）
在联合国建立的之前一个世纪，为了规制国家之间的冲突，许多国际协约组织和会议被建立起来，例如红十字国际委员会和1899年及1907年海牙公约。在第一次世界大战的惨痛损失之后，巴黎和会宣布建立国际联盟以保证国家间的和谐相处。这一组织解决了一些领土争端，并在一些领域建立国际架构，例如邮政、航空、鸦片控制等，其中一些后来被吸纳进联合国的体系中。然而国际联盟对于殖民地（当时占世界人口的一半）的代表權不够，并且诸如美国、苏联、德国和日本在内的列强参与度亦不足。它無法阻止1931年日本对中国的入侵、纳粹德国的扩张、1935年的第二次意大利埃塞俄比亚战争、1937年的日本侵华战争，以及最终出现的第二次世界大战。
target_text: In the century preceding the establishment of the United Nations (1945-1947), many international treaty organizations and conferences had been established to regulate conflicts between States, such as the International Committee of the Red Cross and the Hague Conventions of 1899 and 1907. In the wake of the tragic losses of the First World War, Paris announced the establishment of an international coalition to ensure harmony among nations. This organization resolved a number of territorial disputes and set up international structures in a number of areas, such as postal, aviation, opium control, and so on, some of which were later absorbed into the United Nations system. But the League of Nations was not sufficiently representative of the colonies, which at that time made up half of the world’s population, and the major powers, such as the United States, the Soviet Union, Germany and Japan, were under-represented.
title: 联合国

source_text: 创立一个新的世界性组织的最初完整构想可以追溯至1939年的美国国务院。美国总统富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福首先使用了“联合国”一词，用于描述同盟国家。1942年1月1日，26国政府签订《聯合國共同宣言》，联合国一词得到首次正式使用。1945年4月25日，聯合國國際組織會議在旧金山召开，50国政府及诸多非政府机构参与并起草《联合国宪章》。1945年10月24日，当时的安理会五大常任理事国（中国、法国、苏联、英国和美国）及多数其他签署国（46国）共同批准宪章，联合国正式宣告成立。
target_text: The original complete idea of creating a new world organization dates back to the United States Department of State in 1939. United States President Franklin Delano Roosevelt first used the term “United Nations” to describe allied countries. On 1 January 1942, 26 Governments signed the United Nations Joint Declaration, which was officially used for the first time. On 25 April 1945, the meeting of the International Organization of the United Nations was held in San Francisco, with 50 Governments and a number of non-governmental agencies participating in and drafting the Charter of the United Nations. On 24 October 1945, the then five permanent members of the Security Council (China, France, the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom and the United States) and most of the other signatories (46) formally ratified the Charter and the United Nations was inaugurated.
title: 联合国

source_text: 1946年1月6日，联合国大会第一次会议（51个国家代表出席）以及安理会在英国伦敦的卫理公会中央礼堂举行。大会选定纽约作为联合国总部，其设施于1952年完工。联合国总部同联合国在日内瓦、维也纳和内罗毕的总部一样，被指定为国际领土。同时，大会还选举挪威外相特吕格韦·赖伊为第一任联合国秘书长。總部完工前，在紐約長島成功湖畔的臨時總部即開始運作，即便後來1971年曾代表中國的中华民国被迫退出，其地位被中华人民共和国取代，以及1991年發生苏联解体，地位被俄罗斯联邦取代。
target_text: On 6 January 1946, the first meeting of the United Nations General Assembly (at which 51 States were represented) and the Security Council were held at the Methodist Central Auditorium in London, United Kingdom. The General Assembly selected New York as the United Nations Headquarters, whose facilities were completed in 1952. The United Nations Headquarters, like the United Nations headquarters in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi, was designated as an international territory. At the same time, the General Assembly elected the first Secretary-General of the United Nations, Norwegian Foreign Minister Trugway Rai.
title: 联合国

source_text: 虽然维持和平是联合国的主要权力和目的，但是美国和苏联之间的对立却时常导致联合国陷入瘫痪的境地，使其只能对冷战之外的冲突进行介入，例外之一是1950年的安理会决议，授权美国领导同盟军抵抗朝鲜对韩国挑衅行动的大规模反击；该决议在苏联代表缺席（因抵制中华人民共和国被排除在联合国外）的情况下通过。。1947年，联合国大会通过决议，同意分治巴勒斯坦地区，建立以色列国。两年之后联合国官员拉尔夫·本奇调停此后造成的冲突。1956年，联合国第一支维和部队建立起来以应对第二次中东战争；然而，对于同时苏联在1956年革命后对匈牙利的入侵却无能为力。
target_text: While peacekeeping is the main authority and purpose of the United Nations, the confrontation between the United States and the Soviet Union has often paralysed the United Nations, allowing it to intervene only in conflicts outside the cold war, with the exception of the 1950 Security Council resolution, which authorized the United States to lead a coalition against North Korea’s massive response to its provocative actions; the resolution was adopted in the absence of representatives of the Soviet Union, who had resisted the exclusion of the People’s Republic of China from the United Nations. In 1947, the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution in which it agreed to partition Palestinian areas and establish the State of Israel.
title: 联合国

source_text: 1960年，联合国部署联合国刚果行动（UNOC）以维持叛乱的加丹加国的秩序，并在1964年将其归于刚果民主共和国治下，这是联合国早年最大规模的军事行动。在前往同叛军首领莫伊兹·冲伯会谈的途中，常被称为是联合国最高效的秘书长的达格·哈马舍尔德在空难中身亡；几个月后他被追授予诺贝尔和平奖。1964年，哈马舍尔德的继任者吴丹部署联合国驻塞浦路斯维和部队，这是联合国历史上持续时间最长的维和任务。
target_text: In 1960, the United Nations deployed the United Nations Operation in the Congo (ONOC) in order to maintain order in the rebel Katanga State and placed it under the authority of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 1964, the largest United Nations military operation in the early years. On his way to talks with the rebel leader, Moez Zeppe, Dag Hammarskjöld, the Secretary-General of the United Nations, often known as the most effective United Nations Secretary-General, died in the air crash; a few months later, he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. In 1964, his successor, U Thant, deployed the United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus, the longest-running peacekeeping mission in the history of the United Nations.
title: 联合国

source_text: 20世纪60年代，随着去殖民化的发展，联合国迎来一批新的独立国家作为其会员；单在1960年就有17个新国家加入联合国，其中有16个来自非洲。1971年10月25日，雖然遭到美国的反对，但在许多第三世界国家的支持下，控制中国大陆的中华人民共和国取代控制台澎金马的中华民国成為安理会的常任理事國，这一投票也被视为是美国在联合国中影响力下降的一大信号。第三世界国家在阿尔及利亚的领导之下建立七十七国集团，这一集团在一段时间内成为联合国中的一股主导力量。1975年，苏联和第三世界国家在美国和以色列的强烈反对之下推动通过决议，宣布锡安主义为种族主义；1991年，在冷战结束之后，这一决议被废止。
target_text: In the 1960s, as a result of decolonization, the United Nations had welcomed as members a new group of independent States; in 1960 alone, 17 new countries had joined the United Nations, 16 of them from Africa. On 25 October 1971, the People’s Republic of China, which controlled China’s mainland, had replaced the Republic of China, with the support of many third world countries, as a permanent member of the Security Council. That vote was also seen as a sign of the declining influence of the United States in the United Nations. The Group of 77, established by the third world countries under the leadership of Algeria, had for some time become a leading force in the United Nations. In 1975, the Soviet Union and the third world countries, with the strong opposition of the United States and Israel, had promoted the adoption of a resolution declaring Zionism racist; in 1991, after the end of the cold war, the resolution had been repealed.
title: 联合国

source_text: 冷战结束后，联合国在维和方面有显著的扩展，在十年内的维和行动数量超过过去四十年。在1988年和2000年间，通过的安理会决议数量翻了超过一倍，维和的预算也增加超过十倍。联合国调停结束萨尔瓦多内战，成功进行纳米比亚的维和任务，并监督了南非种族隔离和柬埔寨红色高棉统治之后的民主选举。1991年，联合国授权美国领导的同盟军事行动，击退伊拉克对科威特的入侵。1971年至1985年担任副秘书长的布莱恩·厄克特后来说这些行动的成功为联合国带来一种“虚假复兴”——在之后，联合国的任务变得更为艰难。
target_text: After the end of the cold war, the United Nations experienced a remarkable expansion in peacekeeping, with the number of peacekeeping operations over the past 40 years in 10 years. Between 1988 and 2000, the number of Security Council resolutions adopted had more than doubled, and the peacekeeping budget had increased more than tenfold. The United Nations had brokered an end to the civil war in El Salvador, successfully conducted a peacekeeping mission in Namibia, and supervised democratic elections following apartheid in South Africa and the Khmer Rouge rule in Cambodia.
title: 联合国

source_text: 联合国宪章原本目的是阻止一个国家对另一个国家的进攻，但在90年代初联合国面临许多同时发生的严重国内危机，包括索马里、海地、莫桑比克和前南斯拉夫。在美国于摩加迪沙之战中损失惨重而撤出之后，联合国在索马里的行动被普遍认为是失败的；而联合国在波黑的行动则因为面对种族清洗显得任务不清和不果决而成为“世界的笑柄”。1994年，联合国卢旺达援助团在安理会无法决断的情况下没能对卢旺达大屠杀进行介入。
target_text: The Charter of the United Nations was intended to prevent one country from attacking another, but in the early 1990s the United Nations faced many serious simultaneous internal crises, including Somalia, Haiti, Mozambique, and the former Yugoslavia. Following the United States’ tragic loss and withdrawal from Mogadishu, the United Nations operation in Somalia was widely recognized as a failure, while the United Nations operation in Bosnia and Herzegovina became “the laughingstock of the world” because of the uncertainty and inaction of its mandate in the face of ethnic cleansing.
title: 联合国

source_text: 在冷战的最后数十年中，联合国受到来自美国和欧洲的批评家的批评，被指管理不善和腐败。1984年，美国总统罗纳德·里根停止对联合国教科文组织的资助，英国和新加坡也紧随其后。1992年至1996年在任的联合国秘书长布特罗斯·布特罗斯-加利对秘书处进行改革，在一定程度上精简了组织的规模。他的继任者科菲·安南（1997年—2006年在任）面对美国撤资的威胁进行进一步的管理改革。
target_text: In the last decades of the Cold War, the United Nations was criticized by critics from the United States and Europe for mismanagement and corruption. In 1984, US President Ronald Reagan stopped funding UNESCO, followed by Britain and Singapore.
title: 联合国

source_text: 20世纪90年代末和21世纪初，联合国授权的国际介入形式多样。联合国在塞拉利昂的任务得到英国皇家海军陆战队的支持，而对阿富汗的入侵则由北约领衔。2003年，在安理会决议未能通过授权的情况下，美国仍然入侵伊拉克，新一轮的对联合国是否有效的争论就此展开。在秘书长潘基文任下，联合国维和行动介入苏丹的达尔富尔冲突和刚果民主共和国的基伍冲突，并派出观察员和化学武器核查人员前往叙利亚内战。2013年，对联合国于2009年在斯里兰卡内战末期的行动的内部审查表明，该组织遭遇“系统性的失败”。在2010年海地地震中，有101名联合国人员殉職，这是联合国历史上最为惨痛的损失。
target_text: At the end of the 1990s and the beginning of the twenty-first century, the United Nations-mandated international engagement took a variety of forms. The United Nations mission in Sierra Leone was supported by the Royal Marine Corps, while the invasion of Afghanistan was led by NATO. In 2003, the United States continued its invasion of Iraq in the absence of a mandate in the Security Council resolution, and a new round of debate began on the effectiveness of the United Nations. Under the leadership of Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, United Nations peacekeeping operations intervened in the conflict in Darfur in the Sudan and the conflict in Kivu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and sent observers and chemical weapons inspectors to the Syrian civil war. In 2013, an internal review of United Nations operations at the end of the civil war in Sri Lanka revealed that the organization had suffered a “systematic failure”.
title: 联合国

source_text: 五大机构中的四个都将总部设于纽约的联合国总部。国际法院的总部位于海牙，而其他专门机构的总部设在联合国驻日内瓦、维也纳和内罗毕的办事处，剩余的联合国实体则分布在全球各地。联合国用于政府间会议和文件的六大语文分别为阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文。根据《联合国特权和豁免公约》，联合国及其机构在其进行运作的国家具有外交豁免权，由此保障联合国对东道国及成员国的公平公正。
target_text: The headquarters of the International Court of Justice is in The Hague, while the headquarters of the other specialized agencies are in the United Nations offices in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi, while the remaining United Nations entities are located worldwide. The six languages used by the United Nations for intergovernmental meetings and documents are Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish, respectively. In accordance with the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the United Nations, the United Nations and its agencies enjoy diplomatic immunity in the countries in which they operate, thereby guaranteeing the fairness and impartiality of the United Nations vis-à-vis the host country and its member States.
title: 联合国

source_text: 联合国大会是联合国的主要合议性团体，包括联合国的所有会员国，每年定期举行会议，但紧急会议亦可以召开。大会由一位主席（由成员国中产生，根据区域进行轮换）和21位副主席主持。第一次会议于1946年1月10日在伦敦西敏卫理公会中央礼堂召开，有51个国家的代表参会。
target_text: The General Assembly of the United Nations, which is the principal collegial body of the United Nations, including all States Members of the United Nations, meets regularly every year, but emergency meetings may also take place. The Assembly is chaired by a President (from among the Member States, rotating on a regional basis) and 21 Vice-Presidents. The first meeting was held on 10 January 1946 at the Westminster Central Auditorium in London, with the participation of representatives of 51 States.
title: 联合国

source_text: 大会对于重要问题的投票需要到场且投票的三分之二多数才能通过。重要问题的例子包括关于和平和安全的建议、主要机构的选举、接纳、暂停和开除会员，以及预算事宜。其他问题则由简单多数决定，每个国家只有一票。除预算事项外，通过的决议对于会员没有约束力。大会可以对联合国范围内的一切事项提出建议，但关于和平和安全的事项则属安全理事会考量。
target_text: The General Assembly needs to be present and a two-thirds majority vote is required for adoption on important issues. Examples of important issues include recommendations on peace and security, elections to principal organs, admission, suspension and dismissal, and budgetary matters. Other matters are decided by a simple majority, with only one vote per country. Resolutions adopted with the exception of budgetary matters are not binding on members. The General Assembly may make recommendations on all matters within the United Nations, but matters relating to peace and security are a matter for the Security Council.
title: 联合国

source_text: 秘书长是联合国的发言人和领导人。根据联合国宪章，这一职位是这一组织的“行政首长”。宪章第九十九条规定秘书长可将“其认为可能威胁国际和平及安全之任何事件”提请安理会注意，特吕格韦·赖伊之后的秘书长将之解读为为这一职位提供了在全球范围推动行动的机会。秘书长一职已经发展成为联合国管理者和会员国间争端及国际问题的调停者两项职责的结合。
target_text: The Secretary-General is the spokesperson and leader of the United Nations. According to the Charter of the United Nations, this post is the “executive head” of the Organization. Article 99 of the Charter provides that the Secretary-General may bring to the attention of the Council “any event which he considers likely to threaten international peace and security” and that the Secretary-General, after Trugway Rai, interprets it as providing an opportunity to move forward on a global scale. The post of Secretary-General has evolved into a combination of responsibilities between United Nations managers and mediators in disputes and international issues between Member States.
title: 联合国

source_text: 国际法院的所在地是海牙的和平宫，与海牙国际法学院（私立国际法研究中心）共享一座建筑。它的主要目的是对国家之间的争端进行裁决。法院开庭审理过战争罪行、非法国家干涉、种族清洗以及其他一些事宜。其他联合国机构可以请求国际法院提供司法建议。
target_text: The Court is located at the Peace Palace in The Hague, where it shares a building with the Hague Academy of International Law (the Private Centre for International Law Studies). Its main purpose is to adjudicate disputes between States. The Court sits on war crimes, illegal State intervention, ethnic cleansing and other matters. Other United Nations bodies may request judicial advice from the Court.
title: 联合国

source_text: 联合国经济及社会理事会（ECOSOC）在推动国际经济和社会合作及发展方面对大会进行协助。经社理事会有54个成员国，由大会选出，任期三年。主席同样选举产生，任期一年，来自经社理事会中中等或较小的成员国。理事会每年7月召开一次会议，会议地点在纽约或是日内瓦。它的主要职责是收集信息、为会员国提供建议，与专门机构进行协调并提供建议。由于协调机构的职责较为宽泛，因此经社理事会时常被批评为不够集中及无关痛痒。
target_text: The Economic and Social Council of the United Nations (ECOSOC) assists the General Assembly in promoting international economic and social cooperation and development. The Council has 54 member States, elected by the General Assembly for a three-year term. The President is also elected for a one-year term from among the middle or smaller members of the Council. The Council meets annually in July, either in New York or Geneva. Its main function is to gather information, advise Member States, coordinate with specialized agencies and make recommendations.
title: 联合国

source_text: 经社理事会的下属机构包括联合国土著问题常设论坛（为联合国机构就原住民问题提供建议）、联合国森林论坛（协调和推广可持续森林管理）、联合国统计委员会（协调各机构间的信息收集）以及可持续发展委员会（协调联合国机构及非政府组织推动可持续发展）。经社理事会同时还为非政府组织提供顾问权，至2004年，已经有超过2,200个组织获得了顾问地位。
target_text: Its subsidiary bodies include the United Nations Permanent Forum on Indigenous Issues (to advise United Nations agencies on indigenous issues), the United Nations Forum on Forests (to coordinate and promote sustainable forest management), the United Nations Statistical Commission (to coordinate inter-agency information-gathering) and the Commission on Sustainable Development (to coordinate the contribution of United Nations agencies and non-governmental organizations to sustainable development).
title: 联合国

source_text: 联合国宪章规定，联合国的主要机构可建立专门机构以履行其职责。最为人所知的机构包括国际原子能机构、粮食及农业组织、联合国儿童基金会、世界银行以及世界卫生组织等。联合国通过这些机构进行大部分的人道主义工作，其中包括大规模疫苗项目（通过WHO）來为全球人类消除疾病，提高全球的健康水平、防止饥荒和营养不良（通过WFP）、改善全球儿童的健康和生活质素（通过UNICEF）、以及保护难民（如联合国难民署）等。
target_text: The Charter of the United Nations provides that the principal organs of the United Nations may establish specialized agencies to fulfil their responsibilities. The most well-known institutions include the International Atomic Energy Agency, the Food and Agriculture Organization, the United Nations Children ' s Fund, the World Bank and the World Health Organization. Through these agencies, the United Nations carries out most of its humanitarian work, including mass vaccine projects (through the World Health Organization) to eradicate disease, improve global health, prevent famine and malnutrition (through the World Food Programme), improve the health and quality of life of children globally (through the United Nations Children ' s Fund) and protect refugees (such as the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees).
title: 联合国

source_text:
办事范围
联合国和联合国系统在各地设有办事處，以联合国办事范围分區，共五大區：非洲地区、美洲地区、亚洲及太平洋地区、欧洲及中亚地区和中东地区：
非洲：在非洲联合国的两个主要活动中心是肯尼亚的内罗毕和埃塞俄比亚的亚的斯亚贝巴。联合国系统的許多單位也设立了区域和国家办事处。
美洲：北美地区的活动中心纽约是联合国总部所在地。在南美地区的活动中心智利圣地亚哥是联合国拉丁美洲和加勒比经济委员会所在。
亚洲和太平洋地区：在亚洲和太平洋地区的活动中心泰国曼谷是联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会所在地。
欧洲和中亚：主要活动中心分别是瑞士日内瓦和奥地利维也纳。兩地都有联合国办事处（日内瓦办事处及维也纳办事处），日內瓦則是欧洲经济委员会（欧洲经委会）所在地。
中东：主要活动中心黎巴嫩贝鲁特是西亚经济社会委员会（西亚经社会）的总部所在地。
target_text: The United Nations and the United Nations system have offices in various locations, with United Nations coverage, in five regions: Africa, the Americas, Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, and the Middle East: Africa: the two main centres of activity of the United Nations in Africa are Nairobi, Kenya, and Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Regional and national offices have also been established in many units of the United Nations system. The Americas: the centre of activities in the North American region is located at United Nations Headquarters. The centre of activities in the South American region is located at the United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean in Santiago, Chile. The centre of activities in the Asia and the Pacific region: Bangkok, Thailand, is hosted by the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific. Europe and Central Asia: the main centres of activities are Geneva, Switzerland, and Vienna, Austria.
title: 联合国

联合国宪章中对会员国做出了规定：此外，联合国大会中还有两个非会员观察员国家：圣座（对梵蒂冈拥有主权）和巴勒斯坦国。库克群岛和纽埃两国皆是同新西兰自由联合的国家，是多个联合国专门机构的正式会员，秘书处承认它们的“完全缔约能力”。
target_text: Following the accession of South Sudan on 14 July 2011, there are currently a total of Member States of the United Nations, including all undisputed independent states other than the Vatican. Member States are provided for in the Charter of the United Nations: In addition, there are two non-member observer States in the United Nations General Assembly: the Saints (Sovereignty over the Vatican) and the State of Palestine. Both Cook Islands and Niue are free association states with New Zealand and are full members of several United Nations specialized agencies whose “full treaty-making capacity” is recognized by the Secretariat.

source_text: 联合国中的七十七国集团是一个发展中国家的松散联合，目标是促进其成员的共同经济利益和提升在联合国中的集体谈判能力。该集团最初由七十七个国家创立，但截至2013年11月其成员国数量已经扩展至133个。1964年6月15日，在联合国贸易和发展会议上发表了《七十七国联合宣言》，正式宣布集团成立。1967年七十七国集团在阿尔及尔召开第一次重要会议，采纳了阿尔及尔宪章并建立了永久的制度基础。
target_text: The Group of 77 at the United Nations, a loosely united group of developing countries with the objective of promoting the common economic interests of its members and enhancing its capacity for collective bargaining in the United Nations, was originally created by seventy-seven countries, but its membership had expanded to 133 by November 2013. On 15 June 1964, the Group was formally proclaimed in the Joint Declaration of 77 at the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development. At its first important meeting, held in Algiers in 1967, the Group adopted the Algiers Charter and established a permanent institutional basis.
title: 联合国

source_text: 联合国宪章第十九条规定：凡拖欠本组织财政款项之会员国，其拖欠数目如等于或超过前两年所应缴纳之数目时，即丧失其在大会投票权。大会如认拖欠原因，确由于该会员国无法控制之情形者，得准许该会员国投票。例如2022年1月初伊朗、委内瑞拉、苏丹及其它5国家就因拖欠聯合國會費暂被取消在联合国大会上的投票资格。
target_text: Article 19 of the Charter of the United Nations provides that a Member of the United Nations which is in arrears in the payment of its financial contributions to the Organization shall have no vote in the General Assembly if the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount of the contributions due from it for the preceding two full years. The Assembly may, if it is satisfied that the failure to pay is due to conditions beyond the control of the Member State, permit that Member to vote.
title: 联合国

source_text:
軍事制裁
冷戰結束之後，聯合國開始在國際安全、維持和平等方面扮演較為積極的角色；近年來維持和平任務（簡稱「維和」）的派遣頻率以及規模不斷突破歷史新高，相關費用也已成為該組織財務支出的最大宗。然而受限於「國家」仍為國際舞臺上最主要行為者的現實環境，聯合國對於強國的行為仍無力約束，一些與強國利益沒有直接相關的事務，也難以動員各國參與落實聯合國的決議。
target_text: After the end of the cold war, the United Nations began to play a more active role in international security and the maintenance of peace; in recent years, the frequency and scale of its peace missions (simplely called "Visions") have broken through history, and the associated costs have become the largest contributor to the organization's financial spending. Yet the country is still the world of the leading players on the international stage, and the United Nations remains unconscionable to the actions of the strong, and there are matters that have no direct bearing on the interests of the strong, and it is difficult to engage the various countries in a United Nations decision.
title: 联合国

source_text:
大會投票權
此外有声音主張改革投票權，原因是目前大會按國家作單位，每個國家擁有一票，變相小國享有否決權，大小國家票值不相等。小國集團（Accountability, Coherence, and Transparency, ACT）則堅持將改革重點放在安理會工作方法上，包括改革維持和平行動、加強問責、透明和一致性，加強國際刑事法院與安理會關系，不對種族清洗罪、戰爭罪和反人類罪使用否決權，以及加強區域組織、制裁機制和預防機制的作用等。
target_text: In addition, there is a voice in favour of reforming voting rights, because the Congress is now a national unit, with each country having one vote, a smaller country having the same right to vote, and a small and small country with an unequal number of votes. The Small National Group (Acountabilty, Court, and Transparency, ACT) has insisted that the reform focus on the working methods of the Council, including reform to maintain peaceful action, accountability, transparency and consistency, strengthening the relationship between the International Criminal Court and the Council, the use of the veto power against ethnic cleansing, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, and strengthening the role of regional organizations, sanctions and pre-emptive mechanisms.

source_text: 阿基米德使用無窮小量的數學分析方式，類似現在的微積分。通过反證法，他甚至可以讓問題的答案達到任意精確度，同時也给出答案所在的范围。這種技術被稱為窮举法，并且他使用这种方法计算出了圆周率的近似值。他做出圆的外接多边型和内接多边型。隨著多邊形的邊數增加，將會越来越接近圓。

source_text: 一般认为，“古巴”一名源自泰诺语“coabana”，意为“肥沃之地”或“好地方”。古巴是加勒比海地區少數以白人為主、混血為輔的國家，同時有少量的华裔，族群組成與美國類似，許多民眾有亲戚居住在美國。然而古巴是美洲唯一的社会主义国家，面临着美国长期的经济封锁，但凭借78.3岁的预期寿命、99.9%的识字率和接近1.8公顷的人均生态足迹，其人类发展指数多年来一直维持在高水平；在2014年，古巴更是首次迈入极高人类发展指数行列。古巴于2006年成为全球唯一符合世界自然基金會可持续发展定义的國家。目前古巴以市场为导向的经济改革已经展开，例如加入世界贸易组织等。联合国粮农组织驻古巴的代表特奥多尔·弗里德里奇指出，古巴是目前拉美唯一完全消除了飢餓的國家。
target_text: However, Cuba is the only socialist country in the Americas that faces a long-standing economic blockade, but with life expectancy of 78.3 years, a 99.9 per cent literacy rate and a per capita ecological footprint close to 1.8 hectares, its human development index has remained high for many years; in 2014, Cuba entered the very high human development index category for the first time. Cuba became the only country in the world that meets the definition of sustainable development of the World Wide Fund for Nature.
title: 古巴

source_text: 古巴政府认为，古巴遵守国际法的基本原则：尊重各国的主权、独立和领土完整，支持民族自决、各国平等，反对干涉别国内政。认为国际合作应在平等基础上互惠互利，坚持和平共处，遵守《联合国宪章》。古巴外交政策的基础是国际主义、反帝国主义和团结第三世界国家。古巴政府谴责任何霸权行为，如使用或威胁使用武力、单方面采取强制措施和一切形式的恐怖主义，包括国家恐怖主义。
target_text: The Government of Cuba believes that Cuba adheres to the fundamental principles of international law: respect for the sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity of States, support for the self-determination of peoples, equality of States and rejection of interference in the internal affairs of other States. It believes that international cooperation should be based on mutual benefit on the basis of equality, adherence to peaceful coexistence and respect for the Charter of the United Nations. Cuba ' s foreign policy is based on internationalism, anti-imperialistism and solidarity with third world countries. The Government of Cuba condemns any act of hegemony, such as the use or threat of use of force, unilateral coercive measures and all forms of terrorism, including State terrorism.
title: 古巴

source_text: 古巴与180个国家有外交关系。在116个国家驻有143个外交代表處，其中有114个大使馆、和2个总领事馆、19个领事馆、4个办事处、4个国际组织代表团。2015年，美國把古巴從「支持恐怖主義的國家」名單中除名。2015年7月1日，美國總統巴拉克·歐巴馬宣布美國與古巴正式恢復外交關係。7月20日零時起，兩國正式恢復邦交，兩國在對方的利益代表處升格為大使館。2016年3月，美國總統巴拉克·歐巴馬訪問古巴。這是繼1928年1月時任美國總統卡爾文·柯立芝訪問古巴之後，美國總統又一次訪問古巴。古巴也是目前唯一与圣座保持外交关系的社会主义国家。
target_text: Cuba has diplomatic relations with 180 countries. There are 143 diplomatic offices in 116 countries, including 114 embassies and 2 consulates general, 19 consulates, 4 offices, and 4 delegations of international organizations. In 2015, the United States removed Cuba from the list of countries that support terrorism. On 1 July 2015, United States President Barack Obama announced that the United States had officially restored diplomatic relations with Cuba.
title: 古巴

source_text: 与于1996年颁布《古巴自由民主团结法》的美国相对，从1992年开始，联合国大会每年都通过要求美国解除对古巴的制裁的决议。巴西总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫表示，加强同古巴在各方面的合作是反对美国封锁古巴的最好方式。古巴政府否认美国租占关塔那摩湾的合法性，因此从1960年以后一直拒绝收取美国的租金，并认为美国归还该地是古美关系正常化的五个基本要求之一。
target_text: In contrast to the United States, which enacted the Cuban Free and Democratic Solidarity Act in 1996, the United Nations General Assembly has adopted annually since 1992 a resolution calling for the lifting of United States sanctions against Cuba. The President of Brazil, Dilma Rousseff, has stated that enhanced cooperation with Cuba in various areas is the best way to oppose the United States embargo against Cuba. The Cuban Government, which denied the legitimacy of the United States rental of Guantánamo Bay, has refused to charge United States rents since 1960 and has considered the return of the Territory to one of the five basic requirements of the normalization of relations between the United States and the United States.
title: 古巴

source_text: 2008年，欧盟与古巴恢复全面关系和双边合作，而美国则以古巴“拒绝走向民主化并尊重人权”为由，继续对其实施贸易禁运。美国总统贝拉克·奥巴马于2009年4月17日表示，将寻求美国与古巴关系新开端，取消了对古巴裔美国人到古旅行和汇款的限制。2014年，古巴与美国达成协议，双方同意通过谈判实现两国外交关系正常化。
target_text: In 2008, the European Union resumed full-fledged relations and bilateral cooperation with Cuba, to which the United States continues to impose a trade embargo on Cuba on the grounds of its “refusal to move towards democratization and respect for human rights.” On 17 April 2009, the President of the United States, Barack Obama, stated that he would seek a new beginning in United States-Cuban relations and lift restrictions on travel and remittances by Cuban Americans to Cuba. In 2014, Cuba and the United States agreed to negotiate normalization of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
title: 古巴

source_text: 在革命中有大批教师移民国外，造成师资紧缺。为此古巴政府在城乡建立起一批师范学校。政府还将巴蒂斯塔统治时期的69座兵营改建成学校。到60年代末教育得到普及。2000年年初，联合国教科文组织在一份报告中赞扬古巴小学生的语言课和数学课成绩在被调查的13个拉美国家中得分最高。2002年年初，古巴政府提出新的教育体制改革计划，要求将每班学生数缩减至15～20名，在各教室配备电视，在各级学校中开设计算机课，并对高中生进行更加直接的专业教育。此外，在两个全国性频道中每天分别播出10小时和12小时的教育节目。在联合国儿童基金会支持下，政府开展了一项全国范围内的早期教育计划，名为“教育你的孩子”，为0—6岁儿童提供基于社区的服务。
target_text: At the beginning of 2000, UNESCO, in a report, commended Cuban pupils for their achievements in language and mathematics, which were among the highest in the 13 Latin American countries surveyed. At the beginning of 2002, the Cuban Government introduced a new programme for the reform of the educational system, which called for the reduction of the number of pupils per class to 15-20, the installation of television in classrooms, computer classes in schools at all levels, and more direct professional education for high school students. In addition, 10 and 12 hours of educational programmes were broadcast on two national channels, respectively. With the support of the United Nations Children's Fund, the Government launched a nationwide early education programme entitled “Education for your children”, which provides community-based services for children aged 0-6.
title: 古巴

source_text: 北大西洋公約組織（，縮寫；，縮寫），簡稱北约组织、北约，是歐洲、北美洲國家为实现防卫合作而建立的国际组织，其成员国拥有大量核武器、常规部队，是西方世界重要的军事同盟。北约为二战后西方阵营在军事上实现战略同盟的标志，亦是馬歇爾計劃在军事領域的延伸、發展，是以美國、英國、法國為首的歐洲防務體系。1949年3月18日，美國、英國、法國針對以蘇聯及東方集團，公開建立北大西洋公約組織，各创始成员国于同年4月4日于美國華盛頓簽署《北大西洋公約》，宣告组织正式成立，而後者於1955年成立華沙條約組織与其抗衡。1990年代華約解散、蘇聯解體後，北約成為聯合國打擊國際性恐怖組織的主力之一和地區性防衛協作的組織。北約的最高決策機構是北約理事會。理事會由成員國國家元首及政府高層、外交部長、國防部長組成。總部設在比利時首都布魯塞爾。最新成員芬蘭於2023年4月4日加入，至此北約總共由跨域歐洲和北美的31個國家組成。
target_text: NATO is an important military alliance in the Western world, and NATO is the symbol of the military alliance of the post-World War II Western camp, and the Marshall Plan’s extension and development in the military domain, led by the United States, the United Kingdom, and the French European Defense Agency. On March 18, 1949, the United States, the United Kingdom, the French, and the United States launched the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NAO) against the Soviet Union and the Eastern countries, the founding members of which signed the North Atlantic Treaty Treaty in Washington on April 4 of the same year, declared the organization formally established, followed by the creation of the Warsaw Treaty Organization in 1955 as a counterweight to it. Following the dissolution of Washington in the 1990’s, Soviet Union, the North was joined by the United States, the United Kingdom, and France against one of the main forces of the Soviet and Eastern blocs, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, the founding members of which signed the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in Washington on April 4 of the same year.
title: 北大西洋公约组织

source_text: 2022年5月12日，芬蘭總統尼尼斯托和總理馬林發表聯合聲明，正式宣布支持芬蘭申請加入北約，盼國家能在幾天內，迅速完成採取這項行動所需的一切流程，在芬蘭宣布將加入北約後，有瑞典消息人士透露，瑞典將在下週提出加入北大西洋公約組織的申請。5月15日，芬蘭宣佈正式加入北約申請。2022年5月16日瑞典首相安德森與最大在野黨溫和聯合黨主席克里斯德森召開共同記者會，展現朝野合作，宣布瑞典政府決定申請加入北約。翌日，瑞典外長林德正式簽署文件，申請瑞典加入北約，並表示將在一至兩日內與芬蘭一同遞交申請。2022年5月18日，芬蘭駐北約大使與瑞典駐北約大使分別在北約布魯塞爾總部，向北約秘書長延斯·斯托尔滕贝格遞交申請書，史托騰伯格表示熱烈歡迎並稱「這是美好的一天，這正是我們安全的關鍵時刻。」2022年6月29日，土耳其总统艾爾段、芬蘭總統尼尼斯托（Sauli Niinisto）及瑞典首相安德森（Magdalena Andersson）在马德里會晤，在北約理事長史托騰伯格（Jens Stoltenberg）見證下，簽署三邊備忘錄，土耳其不再反對芬蘭和瑞典加入北約，土耳其的主要要求，是芬蘭和瑞典不再支持境內的庫德工人黨（PKK），並解除兩國對土耳其的武器禁運，兩國因土耳其2019年軍事入侵敘利亞後，芬蘭和瑞典對土耳其採取武器禁運措施。
target_text: On May 12, 2022, Finnish President Ninisto and Prime Minister Marin issued a joint statement formally declaring their support for Finland’s application to join the North Treaty, hoping that the country would quickly complete all the procedures necessary to take this action within a few days, and after Finland’s announcement that it would join the North Treaty, Swedish sources revealed that Sweden would present its application to join the North Atlantic Treaty Organization next week. On May 15, Finland announced its formal accession to the North Treaty application. On May 16, 2022, the Swedish Prime Minister Andersen and the President of the Greatest Opposition, Christerson, formally announced that the Swedish Government had decided to join the North Treaty in a few days.

source_text: 美国对以色列的坚定支持是反美主义情绪的根源，特别是在穆斯林世界。在美國國內，猶太人具有各方面的影響力，也連帶影響美國的中東政策，因此美国在阿以冲突中的角色往往被看成是不公平并且偏袒以色列。例如，美国对巴勒斯坦哈馬斯恐怖分子袭击以色列平民的事件很快便作出反应，但却常常对以色列军队攻击巴勒斯坦平民的事件视而不见，并拒绝谴责以色列。这个问题在穆斯林世界中引起了极大愤慨以及对美国的反感情绪，因为他们认为美国人是在协助“霸道”的以色列人欺压穆斯林。在阿拉伯世界也有人认为美国之所以帮助以色列是因为美国人根深蒂固的歧视阿拉伯人的想法。此外，美国大力支持一些在中东并不受欢迎，並在国內推行高壓統治的親美独裁政权，例如埃及、阿联酋、沙特阿拉伯和约旦。这与美国支持民主自由的价值背道而馳。2012年9月11日，批評伊斯兰教的电影《穆斯林的无知》播出後，美国驻班加西领事馆遭到来自原利比亚反对派的武装团伙袭击，美国大使克里斯多夫·史蒂文斯及其他三名使馆人员死亡。这是美国外交机构近三十年来遭到的最严重的破坏。
target_text: For example, the United States responded quickly to attacks on Israeli civilians by Palestinian Hamas terrorists, but often ignored the Israeli army’s attacks on Palestinian civilians and refused to condemn Israel. The issue provoked great indignation in the Muslim world, as well as revulsion at the United States because it believed that the Americans were aiding the “oppressive” Israelis to oppress Muslims. In the Arab world, the American Consulate in Benghazi was attacked by armed groups from the former Libyan opposition, as US Ambassador Christopher Stevens and three other US embassies died in recent decades.
title: 反美

source_text: 在美国给予中国贸易最惠国待遇的同时，却对古巴继续实行禁运至2015年，这在有些人看来是十分伪善的且极具复仇意味。1996年的《赫尔姆斯-伯顿法》（Helms-Burton Act，又称《古巴自由与民主声援法》）允许美国公民以及企业控告任何与古巴进行贸易往来的外国人士，以此达到强迫所有国家都对古巴进行禁运的目的。美国的自由派人士将该法视为是对他国主权的践踏以及对世界贸易组织规章的破坏。虽然克林顿总统否决了法案的中心内容，小布什总统却继续执行遭否决部分的条款，该法案的存在引起了部分人的不满。
target_text: While the United States has granted China the most-favoured-nation (MFN) treatment of trade, it continues to impose an embargo on Cuba until 2015, which some consider to be hypocritical and highly vengeful. The Helms-Burton Act of 1996, also known as the Cuban Freedom and Democratic Solidarity Act, allows United States citizens and businesses to sue any alien for trade with Cuba for the purpose of forcing all countries to impose an embargo against Cuba.
title: 反美

source_text: 習近平成為中國領導人後，在處理國際關係上採取更加進取的手段，視美國為中國的頭號敵人，甚至發起「戰狼外交」，中美關係演變成新冷戰，中國反西方情緒也不斷升溫，美國成為中國官方和民間主要的批評對象。2018年，中國和美國之間發生中美貿易戰和因制裁華為而導致的“科技冷戰”，讓中美關係急速惡化。而當香港於2019年6月爆发反對逃犯條例修訂運動後，美國強烈指責香港警察向示威者使用過份武力並讚揚示威者的抗爭運動，使中國政府、中國大陸民間、香港建制派以及其支持者對美國的不滿情緒上升。而在2020年1月21日，美國開始爆發2019冠狀病毒病疫情後，美國因防疫失敗而導致的疫情失控，出現了很多針對於亞裔美國人和海外華人的種族歧視事件，致使中美關係徹底降到“冰點”。2020年2月3日，《華爾街日報》在2019冠狀病毒病疫情期間發表言論“中國是真正的亞洲病夫（）”被中華人民共和國外交部認為是種族歧視言論。而3月18日川普在Twitter上美國指控中國散播疫情，還把COVID-19稱之為“中國病毒”的言論已經引起中國政府和民间的多番不滿。到了2020年5月23日，中國因应香港反對逃犯條例修訂運動而設立《港區國安法》，引起美國等多個與美國為盟友的國家不滿。。
target_text: After becoming China’s leader in 2018, China and the United States took a more progressive approach to international relations, considering that the United States was China’s top enemy, and even “Wolves diplomacy” in June 2019, China’s anti-Western relationship became a new cold war, China’s anti-Western sentiment continued to grow, and the United States became the main critics of China’s official and civil affairs. The Chinese government, China’s mainland, Hong Kong legislatures, and their supporters became less responsive to the United States. On 21 January 2020, the United States began to explode 2019 copies of the virus.
title: 反美

source_text: 1999年4月25日，过万名法轮功学员突然聚集在北京中南海外的府右街和西安门大街上訪，要求结束中国公安机关对法轮功学员正在增强的骚扰，并释放天津被捕的学员。此事令江泽民感到震怒，并怀疑有外部势力暗中施加影响。尽管事情很快得到缓解，法轮功迅速取缔。但另两件事情爆发：以美国为首的北约在科索沃战争中轰炸了南斯拉夫联盟共和国首都贝尔格莱德的中国大使馆（五八事件），以及美国国会指控中国政府窃取美国核机密（李文和案）。五八事件引起了中国反美示威活动，民众指责江泽民对美国过于软弱。然而在中美双方领导人的主动沟通下，中国和美国仍然加速了中国申请加入世界贸易组织的进程。1999年9月22日，胡锦涛当选中共中央军委副主席，成为江泽民最强有力的候选接班人。同年11月，神舟一号发射成功，标志着江泽民于1992年批准的中国载人航天计划获得成功。同年中共中央和中央政府开始大规模的治理腐败活动，包括涉及数百名官员的厦门远华特大走私案；以及江西省人民政府副省长胡长清案，胡长清也成为中华人民共和国改革开放后第一位因贪腐罪名而被法院判处死刑的副省级高官。
target_text: On 25 April 1999, thousands of Falun Gong cadets suddenly gathered in the south-central capital of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia on the Right Street and West Anmen Streets in Beijing, demanding an end to the increasing harassment of Falun Gong cadets by Chinese public security organs and the release of those arrested in Tianjin. The incident shocked Jiang Zemin and suspected external influence. Despite a quick easing of events, Falun Gong was rapidly cut off. But two other incidents broke out: NATO, led by the United States in the war in Kosovo, bombed the Chinese Embassy in Belgrade, the capital of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (the 58th incident), and the United States Congress accused the Chinese government of stealing United States nuclear secrets (Li Wen and the case).
title: 江泽民

source_text: 在世界政治经济稳定的大背景下，江泽民坚持并丰富了市场经济体制。加之其任用的精通经济的朱镕基总理的努力，江泽民执政时期中国基本实现了经济高速发展、政治稳定和国家开放，中国民众的生活水準也有所提高，在此期间中华人民共和国如期实现了香港和澳门的主权交接，并获得了2008年在北京的夏季奥运会、2010年在上海的世界博览会主办权。2001年，中国成功加入世界贸易组织，促使中国吸引大量外资进入，保证了中国经济的繁荣及高速发展；而成为世界工厂后的中国，却不可避免造成了贫富差距扩大和环境污染等问题。
target_text: Jiang Zemin maintained and enriched the market economy in the context of the world’s political and economic stability. In 2001, China joined the World Trade Organization to attract large amounts of foreign investment, ensuring the prosperity and rapid development of China’s economy, while China, after becoming a world factory, inevitably created problems such as widening the gap between rich and poor and environmental pollution.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 外交政策江泽民时期的中国外交政策主要集中在中美关系及中国与周边国家关系。中美外交关系中美关系的核心点集中在台湾问题、两国人权问题、霸权主义与多极国际格局主张。随着9·11恐怖袭击及小布什政权建立，反恐行动也成为中美外交的核心之一。
target_text: China’s foreign policy at the time of Jiang Zemin focused mainly on China’s relations with the US and China’s neighbors. The central focus of China’s foreign relations with the US was the Taiwan issue, the human rights issues of the two countries, hegemonicism, and the multipolar idea of a multipolar international architecture.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 1996年3月23日，中华人民共和国在中华民国第一次总统直选前夕举行军事演习，被解读为试图干预該場总统选举。选举期间美国出动了两組航空母舰舰群到台湾海峡。台海危机解除后，两国关系也逐渐好转，高层交流增加，双边会谈取得进展，双方在人权、核不扩散以及贸易领域舉行双边谈判。1997年江泽民访问美国，该次访问中，双方签署了关于贯彻1985年和平利用核能源合作有关协议等多份协议。1998年6月克林顿总统回访中国。
target_text: On 23 March 1996, the People’s Republic of China held a military exercise on the eve of the first direct election of the President of the Republic of China, which was interpreted as an attempt to interfere in the presidential election. During the election period, the United States launched two air carrier fleets to the Taiwan Strait. After the crisis in the Taiwan Strait, relations between the two countries gradually improved, high-level exchanges increased, bilateral talks progressed, and bilateral negotiations took place between the two sides in the areas of human rights, nuclear non-proliferation and trade. In 1997, Jiang Zemin visited the United States, where he signed agreements on the implementation of the 1985 agreement on cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy. President Clinton returned to China in June 1998.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 9·11恐怖袭击后中美关系的本质有变。中华人民共和国公开强烈支持打击恐怖主义的战争。中国在联合国安理会投票支持安理会第1373号决议，支持美国等联军对阿富汗的军事打击，并在塔利班政权垮台后向阿富汗提供了1.5亿美元的人道救助。9·11之后中美开展了反恐方面的双边对话。之后美国不再将中国看作是最大的潜在威胁，转而注重中东局势以及恐怖主义威胁，美国认识到东亚局势必须保持稳定。
target_text: China voted in favour of Security Council resolution 1373 (2001) and supported the United States and other coalition forces in their military attacks on Afghanistan, and provided US$ 150 million in humanitarian relief to Afghanistan following the fall of the Taliban regime. After 9/11, China engaged in a bilateral dialogue between the US and China on counter-terrorism.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 1991年时任中国共产党中央委员会总书记江泽民分别与苏联共产党中央总书记兼苏联总统戈尔巴乔夫签署《中华人民共和国和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟关于中苏国界东段的协定》及俄罗斯总统叶利钦签署《中俄两国政府间在彼此削减边界地区武装力量和加强军事领域信任问题上的相互谅解备忘录》。1999年12月叶利钦访中时与江泽民签署《关于中俄国界线东西两段的叙述议定书》。2001年7月江泽民再访莫斯科，与俄罗斯总统普京签定《中俄睦邻友好合作条约》，以条约形式肯定两国国界线。中国和俄罗斯之间98%的有争议边界，均是在江泽民在任时签订。2004年中俄两国重新勘定国界，将黑瞎子岛一分为二，其中西部回归中国。
target_text: In December 1999, Jiang Zemin, the Secretary-General of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, signed the Agreement between the People’s Republic of China and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on the Eastern Sector of the Central Border between China and the Soviet Union, and Russian President Yeltsin signed the Memorandum of Understanding between the Governments of China and Russia on the reduction of each other’s armed forces in the border areas and the strengthening of confidence in the military sphere. In December 1999, Yeltsin and Jiang Zemin signed the Description Protocol on the East and East Sectors of the China-Russian Line. In July 2001, Jiang Zemin returned to Moscow and, together with Russian President Putin, signed the Treaty on Good-Neighbourly Relations and Cooperation between China and the Russian Federation, confirming the border between the two countries in the form of a treaty.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 2004年9月30日，程翔在明报以「江泽民要向中国人交待的一件事」为题发文称1999年12月9日江泽民和俄罗斯总统叶利钦签订「关于中俄国界线东西两段的叙述议定书」，单方面放弃对被苏联侵占领土提出要求，以新的『平等条约』来合法化旧的『不平等条约，使中国丧失约344万平方公里土地（不算外蒙古）』。对于这些土地，苏联领导人列宁曾三次（1919年至1923年）发表政府声明要归还中国。程翔故认为江泽民在此问题上不如共产党其他领导人，而且江泽民放弃那么多领土从谈判到最后签署条约的过程从未公开。程翔认为江泽民欠中国人民一个交代，有义务和责任向人民详细交代出卖中国领土的理由。2005年8月，北京国家安全局以间谍罪抓捕了程翔，称其是台湾国家安全局发展的情报人员。
target_text: On 30 September 2004, Jiang Zemin publicly reported that on three occasions (1919-1923), the Soviet leader Lenin had issued a government statement to return China. On 9 December 1999, Jiang Zemin and Russian President Yeltsin signed a “Description Protocol on the East and West segments of the border between China and Russia” and had unilaterally renounced their claim to the territory occupied by the Soviet Union, legitimizing the old ‘inequality treaty’ by means of a new ‘equitable treaty’, thereby depriving China of approximately 3.44 million square kilometres of land (not including Mongolia).
title: 江泽民

source_text: 2017年5月19日，莫斯科「欧亚每日新闻」网报道，俄文媒体纷纷转载题为「中方向塔吉克斯坦提出领土要求」的文章。2016年底，多位中国学者向政府要求重新勘探塔吉克斯坦部份领土，研究其是否自古以來属于中国。俄罗斯汉学家、历史学博士、阿列克谢·马斯洛夫教授日评论：「现在中国的官方及媒体上没有任何对俄罗斯归还被强占领土的正式要求，但是整个社会都没有忘了那些被占领土，整个民族对历史的记忆非常强烈。」自由亚洲电台报导提及一些中文媒体公布江泽民时期「卖国」的历史资料，显示江在没有任何外界压力之下，签协议向邻国「出卖」了大量领土，江同塔吉克斯坦在2002年签订协议，割让邻近帕米尔地区约2萬7000平方公里，使塔方获96.5％的有争议领土，不过在签订条约前，所有争议领土均为塔方宣称主权并实际控制，签订条约后中华人民共和国实际增加至少1,000平方公里的实际控制土地。
target_text: On 19 May 2017, the Moscow “Eurasian Daily News” network reported that the Russian media had published an article entitled “A territorial claim in the direction of Tajikistan.” At the end of 2016, several Chinese scholars had asked the Government to re-profil part of Tajikistan’s territory and to study whether it belonged to China from ancient times. Russian Hanists, Dr. Historics, and Professor Alexei Maslov commented: “There is no official demand on the official and media of China for the return of the occupied territories to Russia, but the entire community has not forgotten the occupied territories and the entire nation has a strong historical memory.” Radio Free Asia reported that some Chinese media published historical information about the “selling country” during the Jiang Zemin period, indicating that the People’s Republic of China actually increased its control of at least 1,000 square kilometres after signing the treaty by signing an agreement with Tajikistan to “sell” a large number of territories to neighbouring countries without any external pressure.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 国务院新闻办公室为对外宣传需要，与曾在中国经商的美国银行家库恩谋划以非官方名义写作并推出《江泽民传》。库恩并非文史类作家，他也不懂汉语，不识中文；中共专门找到资深的中国作家配合此任务，秘密从事「零零一号工程」（即《江泽民传》）的写作。库恩在其撰写的《他改变了中国：江泽民传》称江泽民主政中国期间，中国经济得到頗大发展，人民的生活水平较大的提高，贫困和文盲的比例在其任内也大幅降低，且在国际事务中，中国也受到尊重，中国人在国际上的自信心也得到提高。中国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）的进程取得很大突破，与美国达成中国入世的双边贸易协定，该项协定可认为是江泽民「大国战略」的成功。
target_text: The State Council’s Press Office, in an effort to publicize the needs of the outside world, has planned to write and launch the Jiang Zemin Mission in an unofficial capacity with the United States banker Kuen, who was a businessman in China. Kuan is not a literary and historical writer, nor does he understand Chinese or Chinese; the Chinese Communist Party has found senior Chinese writers to cooperate with the mission and has secretly worked on Project Zero 1 (the Jiang Ze People’s Mission). During his writing of “He changed China: Jiang Zemin legend,” China’s democratic China, China’s economy has grown considerably, its people’s standard of living has improved significantly, its poverty and illiteracy rates have decreased, and China is respected in its international affairs, and China’s international self-confidence has increased. China’s accession to the World Trade Organization (WTO) has made a significant breakthrough in its bilateral trade agreement with the United States on China’s accession to the World Trade Organization (WTO), which could be regarded as the success of Jiang Zemin’s Great Power Strategy.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 学者傅泰林在其专著中宣稱，苏联解体后中国军事和外交资源占优，存在理想的机会要回领土，但九十年代所订立的六項条约及2002年补订的一項条约，均是在争议領土上寻求与中亚国家妥协。明鏡新聞網認爲江泽民此举违反宪法，涉嫌危害国家安全。
target_text: In his op-ed, the scholar Faulerin claimed that China had the best military and diplomatic resources and had the ideal opportunity to return to its territory after the collapse of the Soviet Union, but the six treaties concluded in the 1990s and a treaty supplemented in 2002 sought compromise with the Central Asian countries on the disputed territories. The news network saw Jiang Zemin as unconstitutional and suspected of endangering national security.
title: 江泽民

source_text: 原則上，只有主權國家可以成為聯合國會員國，今日聯合國的193個成員國全部皆是主權獨立的國家。不過，在聯合國初創時，菲律賓、印度這2個創始會員國尚未從他們的殖民母國獨立，白俄罗斯和乌克兰为苏联加盟共和国。而美国在联合国成立之初也争取到了与苏联对等的增加两个席位的权利，却因无法在当时的48个州中选出两个州而搁置此事。如今，美国国务院网站在介绍联合国的创建过程时，依然声称“美国至今仍保留在适当时候增加两个联合国代表席位的权利”。加拿大和澳大利亞則當時仍被視為大英帝國的一部分，仍未完全從英國獨立。
target_text: At the time of the founding of the United Nations, however, two founding member states, the Philippines and India, had not yet become independent from their colonial mother states, Belarus and Ukraine, and the Soviet Union. The United States, which had won two additional seats with the Soviet Union at the time of the founding of the United Nations, had set aside the issue because it had been unable to elect two states in the then 48 states.
title: 聯合國會員國列表

source_text: 联合国还设有联合国大会观察员制度，邀请国际组织、非政府组织、政治实体参与联合国事务。观察员在联合国大会上可以发言，但没有参与会议投票的权利。联合国大会共有65个观察员。当中包含2个观察员国、5个观察员实体、和58个观察员组织。觀察員國被視為擁有主權的政治實體，隨時可以依照自由決斷遞交請願書申請成為聯合國的正式會員國，例如：瑞士聯邦在2002年9月10日成為正式會員國之前的1948年至2002年間，亦是聯合國的常任觀察員國；梵蒂岡城國自1964年4月6日起成为聯合國觀察員國。巴勒斯坦解放組織在1974年11月22日根据聯合國大會的3237號決議得到觀察員席位。在巴勒斯坦解放組織宣稱擁有巴勒斯坦地區的主權之後，1988年12月15日大會依照A/RES/43/177號決議將其名稱改為「巴勒斯坦國」。2012年11月29日，根据联合国大会67/19号决议成为观察员国。許多國際組織、非政府組織，以及諸如歐洲聯盟、馬耳他騎士團等主權地位沒有明確定義的政治實體，皆被聯合國大會邀請成為觀察員。
target_text: The United Nations also has an observer system for the United Nations General Assembly, inviting international organizations, non-governmental organizations, and political entities to participate in its affairs. Observers can speak at the United Nations General Assembly, but they do not have the right to vote. The United Nations General Assembly has 65 observers. These include two observer States, five observer entities, and 58 observer organizations.
title: 聯合國會員國列表

source_text: 联合国不認可科索沃是一个独立的国家。根据联合国安全理事会第1244号决议和关于科索沃政治地位的正在进行的对话，科索沃共和国虽然与半数聯合國会员国建立了外交关系，但不是联合国会员国。它是国际货币基金组织、世界银行、国际奥委会的成员，曾在2015年申请加入联合国教科文组织，但以微弱差距被拒绝。
target_text: According to United Nations Security Council resolution 1244 (1999) and the ongoing dialogue on the political status of Kosovo, the Republic of Kosovo has diplomatic relations with half of the States Members of the United Nations, but it is not a member of the United Nations. It is a member of the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the International Olympic Committee, which applied for membership in UNESCO in 2015, but has been denied a small gap.

source_text: 除了會員外，中華民國同樣也被聯合國拒絕給予「觀察員國」資格（如梵蒂岡、巴勒斯坦國），或「觀察員實體」資格（如馬耳他騎士團）。目前，有12個聯合國成員國和梵蒂岡與中華民國之間有大使級外交關係。依據聯合國網站，無論中、英文版之說明，有關創始會員國頁面，為中華民國(Republic of China)，當前名/繼承國為中華人民共和國(People's Republic of China)。
target_text: In addition to its members, the United Nations has also refused to grant observer status (such as the Vatican, the Palestinian State) or "observer entity" (such as the Marathon). At present, there are 12 United Nations members with diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level between the Vatican and the Chinese. According to the United Nations website, in Chinese and English, the founding member page is the Chinese People's Republic of China (Republic of China), formerly known as the People's Republic of China (People's Republic of China).
title: 聯合國會員國列表

source_text: 前南斯拉夫相关南斯拉夫聯邦人民共和國是联合国的创始会员国，于1945年6月26日签署，1945年10月19日批准《宪章》，在下列国家成立并随后加入联合国后解体：波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那、克羅地亞、斯洛文尼亞、馬其頓共和国、南斯拉夫聯盟共和國。南斯拉夫聯盟共和國与2003年改名为塞爾維亞和黑山，而黑山共和國则于2006年独立，从此塞爾維亞共和國继承塞尔维亚和黑山在联合国的席位和权利。目前存在领土争议的科索沃共和國未被联合国承认，联合国认定其为塞爾維亞的一部分。波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那共和國由大会1992年5月22日A/RES/46/237号决议接纳为联合国会员国。克羅地亞共和國由大会1992年5月22日A/RES/46/238号决议接纳为联合国会员国。斯洛文尼亞共和國由大会1992年5月22日A/RES/46/236号决议接纳为联合国会员国。北馬其頓共和國由大会1993年4月8日A/RES/47/225号决议决定接纳为联合国会员国，在该国国名引起的争端解决之前，国号暂时称为“前南斯拉夫的马其顿共和国”，2019年2月席位名改称“北马其顿”（North Macedonia）。南斯拉夫聯盟共和國由大会2000年11月1日A/RES/55/12号决议接纳为联合国会员国。2003年2月4日，南斯拉夫联盟共和国通过并实行了塞尔维亚和黑山共和国宪法，南斯拉夫联盟共和国正式改国名为“塞爾維亞和黑山”。2006年6月3日，黑山共和國议会通过了独立宣言。
target_text: The former Yugoslav Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia was a founding Member of the United Nations, signed on 26 June 1945, and ratified the Charter on 19 October 1945, following the establishment and subsequent accession to the United Nations of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia, the Republic of Macedonia, the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. The former Yugoslav Federal Republic of Yugoslavia changed its name to Serbia and Montenegro in 2003, while the former Yugoslav Republic of Montenegro became independent in 2006, from which the Republic of Serbia succeeded to Serbia and Montenegro's seat and rights in the United Nations. Kosovo, currently in territorial dispute, was not recognized by the United Nations and was recognized by the United Nations as a part of Serbia. The Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina was admitted to membership of the United Nations by the General Assembly in its resolution A/RES/46/237 of 22 May 1992. The Republic of Croatia was admitted to membership in the United Nations by the Assembly in its resolution A/RES/46/237 of 22 May 1992 and the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia in its resolution A/RES/46/238 of 22 May 1992, by which the Council of the Republic of Slovenia adopted the Declaration of the United States of the Former Yugoslav Republic of Serbia and Montenegro in November 1993.

source_text: 1657 年，丹麦国王弗雷德里克三世看到撕毁布罗姆塞布罗条约的机会，向瑞典宣战，双方卷入了第二次北方战争（1655-1660 年）。不过丹麦军队迅速溃败，瑞典国王查理十世的军队征服日德兰半岛，并指挥瑞典军队横跨结冰的丹麦海峡，占领了富英岛和西兰岛的大部分地区，然后于1658年2月迫使丹麦签署了，这给了瑞典斯堪尼亚、布莱金厄、布胡斯兰、特伦德拉格和博恩霍尔姆岛的控制权。 查理十世很快就后悔没有彻底击灭军力如此孱弱的丹麦，1658年8月，他对丹麦发动了第二次进攻并成功征服了丹麦的大部分岛屿，开始了长达两年的哥本哈根围城战。 丹麦国王积极领导城市防御，召集市民拿起武器，屡次击退瑞典人的进攻。围攻在1660年查理十世古斯塔夫 (Charles X Gustav) 去世后结束，在随后的和平条约中，丹麦设法保持了独立并重新控制了特伦德拉格和博恩霍尔姆。由于国王在战后大受欢迎，弗雷德里克三世以此解散选举君主制，转而支持绝对君主制，这种集权制度在丹麦一直持续到了1848年。
target_text: In 1657, King Frederick III of Denmark saw the opportunity to tear down the Bromsebro Treaty, declared war on Sweden, and was involved in a second war in the North (1655-1660). However, the Danish army was quickly defeated, King Charles X of Sweden conquered the Zhdran Peninsula, and directed the Swedish army across the frozen Danish Channel, taking over most of the island of Fuing and Ceylon, and then forced Denmark to sign in February 1658, which gave Sweden the opportunity to tear down the Treaty of Bromsebro, Bouhusland, Trendrague, and Bohnholm. Charles X quickly regretted the death of Denmark, which was so weak, ended in August 1658, when he launched a second attack on Denmark and successfully conquered most of Denmark’s islands, began a two-year-long war around Copenhagen.
title: 丹麦

source_text: 武装中立联盟于1814年因基尔条约而解散，丹麦君主“不可撤销地永远”放弃了对挪威王国王位的主张，转而寻求当瑞典国王。丹麦保留了对冰岛（直到1944年冰岛独立）、法罗群岛和格陵兰岛这些已由挪威统治数个世纪岛屿的主权。除了北欧殖民地外，丹麦还在1620年至1869年，1658至1850年，1671至1917年间继续统治着丹属印度，和丹属西印度群岛。
target_text: The Armed Neutral Union was dissolved in 1814 by the Kiel Treaty, and the Danish monarch “forever and irrevocably” abandoned his claim to the throne of Norway and sought to be the King of Sweden. Denmark reserved sovereignty over Iceland (until Iceland became independent in 1944), the Faroe Islands and Greenland, islands that had been under Norwegian rule for centuries. In addition to the Nordic colonies, Denmark ruled between 1620-1869, 1658-1850, 1671-1917, and the Danish West Indies.
title: 丹麦

source_text:
丹德互不侵犯条约和“威瑟堡行动”
1939年丹麦与纳粹德国签署了为期10年的互不侵犯条约，但德国于1940年4月9日以一个名为“威瑟堡行动”的演习为名义入侵丹麦，丹麦政府知道两国军事力量的悬殊差距，于是进攻开始后仅仅四个小时就宣布投降，是二战当中遭受入侵国家抵抗时间最短的，但丹麦也因此避免了不必要之伤亡和损失，使得丹麦在战后得以更快复苏。1943年之前，丹麦一直与德国进行经济合作。随着纳粹德国在东线战场显出颓势，丹麦政府拒绝进一步合作并自沉了大部分船只，还将许多军官送往中立的瑞典。进行了一次救援行动，设法将数千名收到纳粹政权迫害的犹太人及其家人疏散到了瑞典的安全地带。一些丹麦人通过加入或自愿进入与德国纳粹并肩作战。冰岛被美军占领后与丹麦断绝关系，于1944年成为一个独立的共和国；德国于1945年5月投降，丹麦获得解放。战后反殖民思想兴起，丹麦开始对属地进行权力下放，1948年，法罗群岛获得自治权。1949年，丹麦成为北约创始成员国。
target_text: While Denmark signed a 10-year non-aggression treaty with Nazi Germany in 1939, Germany invaded Denmark on 9 April 1940 under the name of an exercise called “Operation Weissburg”, the Danish Government, aware of the disparity between the military forces of the two countries, announced its surrender only four hours after the start of the offensive, the shortest time of resistance from the invading countries during World War II, but Denmark avoided unnecessary casualties and losses, allowing Denmark to recover faster after the war.

source_text: 丹麦在北欧具有相当大的影响力，在国际事务中属于中等强国。近年来，格陵兰和法罗群岛在渔业、捕鲸和地缘政治等外交政策问题上也获得了发言权。 丹麦的外交政策很大程度上受到其欧盟 (EU) 成员国身份的影响：丹麦本土与格陵兰（1986年退出）于1973年加入了欧盟的前身欧洲经济共同体 (EEC)。丹麦曾七次担任欧盟理事会主席国，最近一次是自2012年的1月至6月。第二次世界大战后，丹麦结束了其长达两百年的中立政策。1949年丹麦成为北大西洋公约组织(NATO)的创始国之一，由于其地理位置优越，位于波罗的海与北海交汇处，因此至今它的成员身份仍然非常受欢迎。
target_text: In recent years, Greenland and the Faroe Islands have also gained a say in foreign policy issues such as fisheries, whaling, and geopolitics. Denmark’s foreign policy has been largely influenced by its European Union (EU) membership: Denmark’s mainland and Greenland (with its withdrawal in 1986) joined the European Union’s predecessor, the European Economic Community (EEC), in 1973.
title: 丹麦

source_text: 作为发展援助委员会（DAC）成员，丹麦长期以来一直是世界上发展援助占国民总收入比例最大的国家之一。2015年，丹麦将其国民总收入 (GNI) 的0.85%用于对外援助，是实现联合国长期目标（对外援助占到国民总收入0.7%）仅有的六个发达国家之一。该国参与的双边和多边援助，通常由外交部管理。在丹麦政府开展对外援助，特别是双边援助时，主要是以的名义。
target_text: As a member of the Development Assistance Committee (DAC), Denmark has long been one of the countries in the world with the largest share of gross national income (GNI) in development assistance. In 2015, Denmark allocated 0.85% of its gross national income (GNI) to foreign aid, one of only six developed countries to achieve the long-term United Nations target of 0.7% of gross national income (GNI).

行政
總統是政府首腦，處理各種國政，包括內政、經濟、國防、外交、國家安全等，也任命各個內閣人事，需經過參議院同意與建議。總統為了處理外交及國安事務並制定相關政策，設立国家安全委员会，並成為其主席，副總統、国务卿、国防部长是法定正式成員。總統同時兼任三軍統帥，統率陸、海、空軍。
target_text: The executive president is the head of the government, dealing with all kinds of government, including internal affairs, the economy, national defence, foreign affairs, national security, etc., and appointing cabinets with the consent and advice of the Senate. In order to deal with foreign and state security matters and develop related policies, the president has set up the National Security Council and is its chairman, and the vice president, the secretary of state, the minister of defence, is a full-fledged member.
title: 美国总统

source_text:
外交
总统是负责处理对外关系的主要官员。他任命驻外大使、公使和领事（须经参议院认可），接见外国大使及公务人员。总统有权与外国缔结条约，但须经参议院2/3多数票的批准；而总统与外国签订的一切行政协定，却不需经参议院的同意。所以，总统往往以签定行政协定来代替缔结条约。
target_text: The President is the principal official responsible for foreign relations. He appoints ambassadors, ministers and consuls abroad (subject to Senate approval) to meet with foreign ambassadors and public officials. The President has the right to conclude treaties with foreign countries, subject to a two-thirds majority vote in the Senate, while all administrative agreements between the President and foreign countries do not require Senate approval.

source_text: 朝鮮於立國後，就從蘇聯和中華人民共和國以廉價購入能源。因此，在1940年代至1980年代間，其能源供應較為穩定。然而，隨著蘇聯的經濟不景氣，蘇聯要求朝鲜以正價購入燃料，令後者的能源提供開始不穩。朝鲜国内水电的装机容量占总电力装机的比例已经超过了60%，然而，现在的国际形势对朝鲜来说并不有利，联合国和美国对朝鲜施行的制裁和经济封锁，使得朝鲜国内的环保设备进口——包括用于可再生能源建设的设备进口，都变得十分困难。
target_text: As a result, its energy supply was stable between the 1940’s and 1980’s. However, in the wake of the Soviet economic downturn, the Soviet Union demanded that North Korea buy fuel at a positive price, making the supply of energy to its successors unstable. The domestic capacity of electricity and water has already exceeded 60% of the total power supply, but the current international situation is not favourable for North Korea, and the sanctions and economic blockade imposed by the United Nations and the United States on North Korea have made it very difficult for North Korea to import environmental equipment, including for the construction of renewable energy sources.

source_text: 朝鮮於1975年5月，成为“七十七国集团”正式成员国，同年8月正式加入不结盟运动。1991年9月17日同韓國一起加入了聯合國。2000年7月，加入东盟地区论坛（ARF）。与163个国家（含欧盟）建立了外交关系。朝鮮自建國後即與蘇聯和中華人民共和國建交，並維持著緊密的關係。蘇聯解體後也跟俄羅斯保持一定聯繫，另外1961年簽訂的中朝友好合作互助条约框架下，朝鮮是中國的唯一軍事盟友。
target_text: In May 1975, Korea became a full member of the “G77” and joined the Non-Aligned Movement in August of the same year. It joined the United Nations with Korea on September 17, 1991. In July 2000, it joined the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF). It established diplomatic relations with 163 countries, including the European Union.
title: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国

source_text: 現時，朝鲜共與165國保持外交關係，並有24個國家在首都平壤設有大使館。歐洲只有法國與愛沙尼亞與朝鲜从未建立外交關係。目前全球只有馬來西亞的公民可免簽證到朝鮮旅游30天，。从2017年3月5日起，由于金正男遇刺事件，馬來西亞政府基于安全考量，宣布取消朝鮮公民的免簽證待遇，并且禁止馬來西亞公民前往朝鲜。2018年，马来西亚首相马哈迪·莫哈末對於2018年朝美首脑会晤表示歡迎，並表示世界不應對金正恩懷疑並應學習他對於和平的期盼，在東京的一個記者會上， 馬哈迪希望朝美首次峰會能取得好結果，並表示馬來西亞重開北韓駐當地大使館，改善因金正男遇刺事件而低落的兩國關係。2021年3月19日，因马来西亚批准美国对一名朝鲜男子的引渡申请，朝鲜宣布与马来西亚断绝外交关系。
target_text: Since March 5, 2017, as a result of the assassination of Kim Jong-man, the Malaysian government has announced, based on security considerations, the cancellation of the visa-free status of Korean citizens and the prohibition of Malaysian citizens from travelling to the capital, Pyongyang. source_text: 雄心勃勃的培根，很希望得到谋取功名利禄的終南捷径。他十二歲入讀剑桥大学三一學院，攻讀神學、形而上学，同時学習邏輯、數学、天文学、希臘文和拉丁文。他对当时大学的教育体制和主宰学术研究的亚里士多德哲学体系十分反感，1576年从剑桥大学毕业，他与英国驻法国大使一道，前往巴黎，他在那儿担任英国驻法使馆的外交事务秘书，并在巴黎学习统计学和外交。1579年因父病逝辞职回英国。1593年，他当选为下议院议员。1617年，詹姆斯一世赴蘇格蘭期間，出任掌玺大臣（Lord Keeper，或謂臨時攝政 Temporary Regent），1618年，他担任詹姆斯一世手下的大法官（Lord Chancellor），并被授予维鲁拉姆男爵的称号，1621年晋爵为圣阿尔本子爵。
target_text: He was repulsive of the university’s educational system and Aristotle’s philosophy, which dominated academic research. He graduated from Cambridge University in 1576, went to Paris with the British Ambassador to France, where he was the Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the British Embassy in Law and studied statistics and diplomacy. He resigned to the United Kingdom in 1579 because of his father’s death. In 1593, he was elected a member of the House of Commons. In 1617, James I went to Scotland, and became Minister of State (Lor Keeper, or so-called Temple Regent), and in 1618, he was a Grand Judge of James I. He was named Lord Chancellor, and was awarded the title of Lord Wierlum.

source_text: 越南社會主義共和國（, , ），通稱越南（），是位於东南亚的中南半島東端的社会主义国家，北邻中华人民共和国，西接柬埔寨和老挝，拥有超過9,600万人口，位居世界第15名。越南的首都是河内市，最大城市是胡志明市。越南政治上採一黨專政，執政黨越南共產黨是目前越南境内唯一的合法政党。越南是汉字文化圈诸国之一，同时也是東南亞國家聯盟、世界贸易组织、亚洲太平洋经济合作组织、法语圈国际组织成員及未来11国之一。
target_text: Viet Nam ' s Socialist Republic (, ), commonly known as Viet Nam (), is one of the socialist countries at the eastern end of the central and southern islands of South-East Asia, bordering the People ' s Republic of China in the north, bordering Cambodia and Laos in the west, with more than 96 million people and ranked 15th place in the world. Viet Nam ' s capital is Hanoi City, with Ho Chi Minh City as its largest city.
title: 越南

source_text: 1977年，越南加入联合国。越南统一后，仍面临着经济落后的问题。1986年越共领导层决定实施革新开放，从单一的计划经济，开放为市场经济，并发展多元化商品经济，此后经济形势开始好转，2022年越南GDP总量超菲律宾、马来西亚，在东盟国家中仅次于印尼，泰国，新加坡。冷战结束后，越南經濟快速发展，并逐渐摆脱外交困境，1995年加入东盟，1998年加入亚太經合會，2007年加入世界貿易組織。但越南仍在贫富差距和医疗卫生方面面临着诸多问题，亦有西方国家批评越南的人权状况，与邻国的领土争端问题亦再次显现。
target_text: Viet Nam joined the United Nations in 1977. After Viet Nam’s reunification, it continued to face economic backwardness. In 1986, Viet Nam’s leadership decided to innovate and open up from a single planned economy, to an open market economy, and to develop a diversified commodity economy, the economic situation began to improve, with Viet Nam’s total GDP exceeding that of the Philippines, Malaysia in 2022, followed only by Indonesia, Thailand, and Singapore among the ASEAN countries.
title: 越南

source_text: 朝韩问题：朝鲜民主主义人民共和国于1990年代，自1992年中国与韩国建交后，在外交上向越南表示亲近，虽然越南跟中国一样在1990年代建立起社会主义市场经济，但与中国在南中国海诸多岛屿有主权争议與衝突可能。其后两国虽然保持外交关系，但相当冷淡。1996年以后两国经贸关系几乎为零，直到21世纪初两国领导才恢复互访，2007年10月越共中央总书记农德孟受朝鲜劳动党总书记金正日邀请访朝，金正日亲自接送农德孟，规格颇高。1998年，韓國總統金大中訪越期間，對越南戰爭中大韓民國國軍跟随美国出兵越南表示遺憾，2001年8月，越南社会主义共和国主席陳德良訪韓期間，金大中亦官方性的表明謝罪的態度，「我們參加了不幸的戰爭，並與本意相違的給越南國民增加了苦痛，對此深表歉意、撫慰亡者」。2004年韓國總統盧武鉉訪越期間表示「韓國國民心有虧欠。很希望看到越南成功」。2004年10月10日下午，韓国總統盧武鉉與越南政府總理潘文凯、越共中央總書記农德孟相繼進行關於促進經濟合作、加强两國關係的會談。盧武鉉總統與潘文凯總理在該日簽署能源、信息通信等方面的合作協議。之後，盧武鉉總統訪問越南共产党中央辦公廳並會見侬德孟總書記，雙方表示將在朝鲜半岛和平與國家間合作方面增進合作關係。
target_text: In the 1990’s, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea expressed diplomatic proximity to Viet Nam after China’s establishment of a relationship with South Korea in 1992, despite the fact that Viet Nam, like China, established a socialist market economy in the 1990’s, had a sovereignty dispute and potential conflict with China’s many islands in the South China Sea. The two countries, while maintaining diplomatic relations, were rather distant.
title: 越南

source_text: 越南和馬來西亞之間有一條海上邊界，橫跨泰國灣、南中國海；雙方卻在南沙群島提出重疊的主權聲張。兩國已在對方的首都設立大使館——越南在吉隆坡設立大使館，馬來西亞則在河內市設立大使館，並於胡志明市設領事馆。史書記載，自18世紀以來，就有一小群越南人到訪現今屬於馬來西亞的屬邦／蘇丹國。2000年後到馬來西亞定居的越南人人數眾多，其中包括客工、郵購新娘和學生，總數約為10萬人；越南也成為少數馬來西亞人的落腳點，這群人當中以商人居多，主要分布在河內市和胡志明市。
target_text: There is a maritime boundary between Viet Nam and Malaysia, spanning the Gulf of Thailand and the South China Sea, while both sides have raised overlapping claims of sovereignty in the South Sha Islands. The two countries have established embassies in each other's capitals — Viet Nam's embassy in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia's embassy in Hanoi, and the consulate in Ho Chi Minh City. The history book reports that since the 18th century, a small group of Vietnamese have come to visit the state/Sudan of Malaysia today.

source_text: 歐盟目前是歐洲地區規模較大的區域性經濟合作的國際組織。成員國已將部分國家主權交給組織（主要是经济方面，如貨幣、金融政策、內部市場、外貿，亦包括外交政策，歐盟各國的外交政策受歐盟委員會約束），加上歐盟委員會（行政權）連同具政治影響力的歐盟理事會、歐洲議會（立法權）和歐洲法院（司法權），令歐盟越來越像聯邦制國家。雖然歐盟還不是真正的國家，歐盟本身也無權行使各成員國的主權，但里斯本條約第一條第八項（款）允許歐盟簽訂歐洲人權公約成為歐洲委員會的成員國。
target_text: The European Union is currently an international organization with more regional economic cooperation in the European region. The member states have handed over some national ownership to organizations (mainly economic, e.g. currency, financial policy, internal market, foreign trade, including foreign policy. The European Union ' s foreign policy is governed by the Council of the European Union, and the Council of the European Union (executive power), together with its politically influential Council, the Council of Europe (legislative power) and the European Court of Justice (judgment), has made the European Union more and more like a federal state. Although the European Union is not a real country, the European Union itself has no right to exercise the sovereignty of member states, but article VIII of the Lisbon Treaty allows the European Union to sign the European Union Human Rights Convention as a member of the European Commission.
title: 欧洲联盟

source_text: 1950年5月9日，法国外交部长罗伯特·舒曼公布“舒曼计划”，建议将法国、德国的煤钢生产置于一个高级联营机构的管制之下，其他欧洲国家也可参加。1951年4月18日，西德、荷蘭、比利時、盧森堡、法国、意大利六国签署《巴黎条约》，决定成立歐洲煤鋼共同體，合作推動煤與鋼鐵的生產銷售。1952年7月23日，该条约生效，歐洲煤鋼共同體正式成立。
target_text: On 9 May 1950, the French Minister for Foreign Affairs, Robert Schumann, announced the “Shurman Plan” suggesting that the production of coal and steel in France and Germany be placed under the control of a high-level consortium, with the participation of other European countries as well. On 18 April 1951, the six countries of West Germany, Holland, Belgium, Luxembourg, France and Italy signed the Paris Pact, which decided to establish a European coal and steel community and to cooperate in promoting the sale of coal and steel. On 23 July 1952, the Treaty entered into force and the European coal and steel community was formally established.
title: 欧洲联盟

source_text: 1957年3月25日，六國在羅馬簽署《羅馬條約》。1958年1月1日，该条约生效，正式成立歐洲經濟共同體和歐洲原子能共同體，旨在創造共同市場，取消會員國間的關稅，促進會員國間勞力、商品、資金、服務的自由流通。1965年4月8日，六國簽訂《布魯塞爾條約》，决定将煤钢共同体、原子能共同体和经济共同体所属机构加以合并，统称为“欧洲各共同体”。1967年7月1日，该条约生效，“欧洲各共同体”正式成立。
target_text: On 25 March 1957, the six countries signed the Rome Treaty in Rome. On 1 January 1958, the Treaty entered into force, formally establishing the European Economic Community and the European Atomic Energy Community, with the aim of creating a common market, eliminating taxes on membership and promoting the free flow of labour, goods, capital and services among members of the Council. On 8 April 1965, the six countries signed the Brussels Treaty, by which they decided to merge the institutions belonging to the Coal Steel Community, the Atomic Energy Community and the Economic Community, collectively known as the “Communities of Europe.” On 1 July 1967, the Treaty entered into force and the “Communities of Europe” came into force.
title: 欧洲联盟

source_text: 西德於1955年5月8日加入北约，相對的，由蘇聯扶植、 德国统一社会党主政的東德（德意志民主共和國）則加入了-{zh-hans:华沙条约组织; zh-hant:華沙公約組織;}-，使得東西德間的交界成為兩大對壘陣營的最前線，冷战的焦点。1957年，根据《萨尔条约》，原被法国托管的萨尔保护领加入德意志联邦共和国，成为萨尔州。

source_text:
瀾滄江是湄公河上游中國境內河段的名稱，主幹流總長度為2139公里；
「瀾滄」一詞或來源於老撾的瀾滄王國，流經青海、西藏和雲南三省，這裡的民族多數信仰上座部佛教與藏傳佛教；
扎曲在西藏自治區的昌都與昂曲匯合後始稱「瀾滄江」，流經昌都、察雅、左貢和芒康縣，幹流總長度465公里，在德欽縣下鹽井流入雲南；
在云南省西北境內與金沙江、怒江形成世界上罕见的「江水並流而不交汇」的奇特自然地理景观「三江並流」。其间澜沧江与金沙江最短直线距离为66公里，澜沧江与怒江的最短直线距离不到19公里。2003年7月2日，联合国教科文组织第27届世界遗产大会一致决定，将「三江並流」自然景观列入联合国教科文组织的《世界遗产名录》；
南阿河河口至南腊河河口31公里为中国与缅甸界河。
target_text: (c) On 2 July 2003, the 27th United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) World Heritage Conference decided to include the three rivers in the world's natural landscape, known as the triads.
title: 湄公河

source_text: 湄公河三角洲土地肥沃，在近代稱為南圻，古時曾經被占城國和真臘國反覆爭奪，最終被越南佔領。1862年6月5日，越南代表在西贡签署《同法国和西班牙的友好条约》（第一次西贡条约）。根据条约，越南割让位於湄公河三角洲的邊和省（Biên Hòa；今同奈省）、嘉定省 （Gia Định）、定祥省 （Định Tường）和昆仑岛给法国。1867年，法國再奪得昭篤 （Châu Đốc）、河仙 （Hà Tiên） 和永隆 （Vĩnh Long） 三省，并將以上六省稱為交趾支那（Cochinchine），首府是西貢，亦即是現時越南南部的重要城市胡志明市。
target_text: On 5 June 1862, the representative of Viet Nam signed the Treaty of Friendship with France and Spain (the First Treaty of Saigon). According to the treaty, Viet Nam ceded to the border and provinces of the Mekong Delta (Biên Hòa; now the same province, Gia Xinzhenh, the province of Dynasty () and the island of Kunen () was given to France. In 1867, France retrenched the provinces of Chiâu, Hà Tiang, and Yonglong (Vonh Long) and called the six provinces " Cochinchinchine " , the capital of which is the city of Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam at this time.
title: 湄公河

source_text: 1951年印度表达了建造法拉卡堰的意愿，因此而与邻国东巴基斯坦（如今的孟加拉国）产生了。拦河堰于1975年建成，最初目的是从恒河水流量分配 1,100 m3/s 给帕吉勒提河-胡格利河，以恢复的通航能力。在最干旱的时期，恒河水流量约为1400-1600 m3/s ，也就是说此时流往东巴基斯坦的河水只剩下280-420 m3/s。 东巴基斯坦对此表示不满，该争端持续了很长时间，直到1996年印度与孟加拉国签署了一项为期30年的条约。该条约十分复杂，简而言之，条约规定当恒河水流量小于2,000 m3/s时，印度与孟加拉国将各自配得50%水源，具体方式是每方在10天周期里交替获取1,000 m3/s的河水流量。然而，条约签署后仅一年，法拉卡堰的水位达到了历史最低水平，无法完成条约中规定的水源分配措施。1997年，流入孟加拉国的恒河水流量最低仅有180 m3/s。虽然在随后几年里，旱季水流量恢复到了正常水平，但双方也在探讨其它方案来解决这个问题。其中一个方案是在孟加拉国首都达卡西部的庞沙乌帕齐拉再建一个拦河堰，这个新的拦河堰可以帮助孟加拉国更好的利用分配到的恒河水资源。
target_text: In the most arid period, the river flows were estimated at 1400-1600 m3/s, i.e., only 280-420 m3/s of the river that flowed to East Pakistan at that time. The dispute continued for a long time until India signed a 30-year treaty with Bangladesh in 1996. In short, the treaty provided that, when the river flows were less than 2,000 m3/s, India and Bangladesh would each have 50% of the water to recover. However, only one year after the signing of the treaty, Falaka’s water level reached its lowest historical level and did not complete the water distribution measures set out in the treaty.

source_text: 澳大利亚所处之大陆在远古时期即有人类居住生活，但其直至17世纪的大航海时代才被发现从而与外部人类社会接轨，18世纪末期始成为英国殖民及囚犯流放的地点，后因发现珍贵矿藏而成为移民、投资兴业的热点。受益于地理位置较为孤立的特点，澳洲自被殖民以来几未受到国际战争波及，内部也鲜有战乱、冲突的发生，仅北部城市達爾文曾受到第二次世界大战的战事影响。但在兩次世界大戰及朝鲜战争等战役期间，均有澳洲籍士兵遠赴歐洲、朝鲜半岛等主要戰場支援聯合王國、联合国等國家及组织的軍事行動。在自身资源禀赋、欧洲成熟的近现代工农业文明植入和英国带来的良好商業法規共同组成的良性发展环境下，自19世纪中后期始，澳大利亚逐步被建设发展成为了自由民主程度、社会經濟发展程度與国民生活质素均属世界前列的发达国家。然而澳洲大陆上的原住民却因此在一些方面深受其害（包括“失窃的一代”等事件），事后澳大利亚聯邦政府曾为此致歉，并逐渐努力改善和保障原住民的生存发展条件和各项权益，情况至今已大有改观。澳大利亚的独立运动与进程始自1901年，原有的六塊英属殖民地（即現在的州份）组成了澳大利亚联邦，从此澳洲开始逐渐脱离英国并独立行使作为国家的主权，直至1986年通过法令完全脱离英国正式成为独立国家。

source_text: 澳洲政府在其2004年的外交白皮書中表示：其基本外交的政策是重視澳洲與美國之間的關係，并且藉助經貿互動促進與亞太地區國家的關係，即強化美澳同盟的前提下與亞太地區國家发展。近幾十年來，某程度上，澳洲政府一直在致力於推進全球貿易的自由化發展，這亦直接或間接導致了凱恩斯集團和亞太經合組織的形成。澳洲是經濟合作與發展組織以及世界貿易組織創始會員國之一，並與美國簽署了，此外澳洲亦與。截止到2010年，澳洲政府與日本政府持續進行關於自由貿易和雙邊互信等一系列親密合作夥伴的談判，并且簽訂了多個雙邊自由貿易協議。澳洲在政治，經濟以及軍事上的親密盟友包括北約諸國和日本。
target_text: In its 2004 diplomatic white paper, the Australian government stated that its basic diplomacy policy is to focus on relations between Australia and the United States, and to promote relations with the countries of the Asia-Pacific region by facilitating trade exchanges with them, i.e. strengthening the United States Alliance and developing with the countries of the Asia-Pacific region. source_text: 随着中国进行改革开放，对外交流不断增加，领导人外访和接待外宾的次数也越来越多，在杨尚昆的任期届满后，当时的中共中央总书记、中央军委主席江泽民接任国家主席一职，从此共产党的最高领导人兼任国家主席以获得國家元首的身份开始制度化，现任中共中央总书记习近平在胡锦涛卸任国家主席后也承继这“三位一体”的惯例。国家主席职务让最高领导人有了代表国家的身份，在国际上进行元首外交、国事访问和出席国际会议等国事活动。
target_text: With China's reforms and opening up of foreign exchanges, and the increasing number of visits by leaders and receptions of foreign guests, the then Central Secretary-General of the Communist Party and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Jiang Zemin, took over the post of President of the country after the expiry of his term of office.
