1956年11月5日，苏联向三国发送外交照会和最后通牒：如果不停止侵略行为，無法保證巴黎與倫敦的安全，可能使用「火箭武器」（暗示為核武）。 蘇聯并从以色列撤回了苏联大使，并向美国提议联合军事行动阻止其继续侵略。
美苏两国的介入动机各不相同：其一，美国希望能够拉拢一批刚刚从英法等老牌殖民国家统治底下独立出来的亚非拉第三世界国家，避免他们倒向苏联社会主义阵营，其二，英法的军事行动事先并没有通知美国和其他北约盟友，英法没有履行自己的责任，因此美国认为自己没有责任帮助英法，其三，英法的行为是旧时殖民主义野心的体现。其四，三国的侵略行为，给了苏联势力进入这一地区的借口，苏联之前的势力非常微弱；而苏联则能通过插手苏伊士运河危机淡化国际社会对其出兵匈牙利的关注。
target_text: On 5 November 1956, the Soviet Union sent three countries diplomatic notes and an ultimatum: Paris and London could not be guaranteed security without the cessation of the aggression, using “rocket weapons” (implicitly nuclear weapons). The Soviet Union withdrew its Soviet ambassador from Israel and proposed joint military action to the United States to prevent its continued aggression. The two countries had different motives for their intervention: first, the United States hoped to be able to bring together a group of third-world Asian and African countries that had just emerged from the former colonial powers, such as the British and the French, to avoid falling back to the Soviet socialist camps, second, that the British and French military operations had failed to notify the United States and other NATO allies of their responsibilities in advance, and that the United States believed that it had no responsibility to help English and French, whose actions were a manifestation of old colonial ambitions.
title: 第二次中东战争

source_text: 这次政变对印尼政局的影响包括：印尼在外交上由倾向苏联变成倾向美国，在冷战时，印尼军方因此得到美国的支持。大批华人被杀，以及逃往國外。由于两国间的双重国籍协定被印尼单方面撕毁，令不少印尼华人的国籍身份，至今仍有含混不清之处。而在当地幸存的华人，在1970年代被迫归化印尼国籍，放弃原有中文姓氏，在多方面受到种族歧视至今。而华人每年最盛大的节日農曆新年要偷偷摸摸的庆祝。但在华裔穆斯林学者瓦希德当选总统，以及梅加瓦蒂总统、苏西洛总统努力下，情况渐有改善。1960年代大量印尼华人回到中国大陆、香港和台湾，中国大陆启动了历史上最大规模的撤侨活动。中华人民共和国时任副总理兼外交部长陈毅公开宣布准备从印尼接侨60万。到1967年10月30日中国大陸同印尼断绝外交关系为止，中国大陸共接侨9万多人。从1960年到1967年，共有20万人回國，使用了邮轮飞机等手段，在东南沿海各地开设了大量的华侨农场，其中很多印尼华侨是中国大陸羽毛球的杰出运动员教练员，比如王文教，侯加昌、汤仙虎。台灣在1960年亦有派遣船隻撤回華僑。印尼在政变后，被蘇哈托独裁统治多年，因缺乏民主和言论自由，当地吏治亦因此长期败坏，得不到合理解决，至今仍有后遗症。蘇哈托掌權後，改善印尼與馬來西亞的外交關係，印尼對東南亞地區的影響力增加。
target_text: The impact of the coup on Indonesia’s political scene included the following: Indonesia’s diplomatic orientation towards the Soviet Union became a trend toward the United States, and the Indonesian military was supported by the United States during the Cold War. The Chinese who survived the coup d’état in the 1970’s, forced to naturalize Indonesian nationality and renounce their original Chinese surnames, have been subjected to racial discrimination in many ways.

source_text: 1921年唐努圖瓦人民共和國的独立及1944年圖瓦人民共和國加入蘇聯均未獲得该地区原本主权所属国家中華民國的承認。1945年，中華民國與蘇聯簽署《中蘇友好同盟條約》，維持外蒙古現狀，但当时有观点认为唐努乌梁海已脱离外蒙古，因此仍隶属于中国。1948年5月，中華民國駐蘇聯大使傅秉常照會蘇聯外交部聲明唐努烏梁海係中華民國領土。1949年，中華民國宣布廢止《中蘇友好同盟條約》，不再承认外蒙古的独立，但由于中華民國政府因内战失败迁至台湾，外蒙古问题已不再是其关注的核心利益。1961年10月27日，蒙古人民共和国加入聯合國，时任常任理事国的中华民国受蘇聯以外交抵制为要脅而并未加以反对，默认外蒙古的主權國家地位。而对于唐努烏梁海，冷戰結束後，中華民國外交部表示為推動与俄罗斯的雙邊關係，尊重國際社會的共識，認同图瓦共和国為俄國境內下屬聯邦主體之一。中华民国外交部網站上的俄罗斯地圖也包含图瓦。

On 27 October 1961, the People’s Republic of Mongolia joined the United States, while the Republic of China, which was a permanent member of the Soviet Union, did not oppose the Soviet Union’s diplomatic boycott as the land of the People’s Republic of China. In 1949, the People’s Republic of China announced that the Treaty on the Alliance of Friendship between China and the Soviet Union no longer recognized the independence of Mongolia.

source_text: 阿联酋采用聯邦制。阿聯酋最高委員會由七個酋長国的酋长组成，選舉产生總統、副總統、總理、內閣和議會來管理國家。有40名從各個部落來的成員組成聯邦國家議會複審被提議的法案。阿聯酋有一個聯邦法庭系統，5個酋長國參加（杜拜和拉斯海瑪除外）。所有酋長部落還有自己的世俗和伊斯蘭教的法律，用於民事、刑事和高等法院。联邦最高委员会从委员会成员中选出联邦总统和副总统，任期5年，沒有連任限制。总统兼任武装部队总司令。歷任總統由阿布扎比酋長國酋長出任，副總統兼總理則由迪拜酋長國酋長出任。除外交和国防相对统一外，各酋长国拥有相当的独立性和自主权。联邦经费基本上由阿布扎比和迪拜两个酋长国承担。
target_text: The Supreme Council of the United Arab Emirates, composed of seven chieftains from the Emirates, elected a president, vice president, prime minister, cabinet and council to govern the country. The Supreme Council elects the president and vice president of the Federation from among its members for a five-year term, with no re-election restrictions.

source_text: 高級專員是英聯邦成員國之間交換的最高外交使節。高級專員最早是大英帝國時代英国本土和各殖民地或自治領之間的聯絡官，有些還兼任行政長官。後來隨著這些領土紛紛獨立成為英聯邦成員國，有必要在成員國之間互派外交使節。一般國家之間的最高外交使節是代表國家主權的大使，由本國元首派出，由對方元首接納。但是獨立伊始的英聯邦成員國都共戴同一君主（英國君主），因此邏輯上英國君主不能接納自己派給自己的大使，所以英聯邦國家之間沿用了高級專員作為最高外交使節。現在一部分英聯邦成員國的元首並不是英國君主查爾斯三世，但所有英聯邦國家之間仍舊維持高級專員制度。

source_text: 联合国事务局在2004年3月给日本政府的信函中表明，“联合国事务局遵守使用日本海单独标记的惯例的立场是非常明确的，指定（东海/日本海）两个地名违背联合国的惯例，侵害了联合国的中立性质。”这说明联合国认定“日本海”是该海域的唯一正式名称。日本海单独标记原则是国际水文组织或世界地图和教科书等长期以来一直遵守的。
target_text: In a letter addressed to the Government of Japan in March 2004, the United Nations Bureau stated that “the position of the United Nations Bureau of Management to adhere to the practice of using separate markings of the Japanese Sea is very clear, and the designation of two geographical names (East China/Japan Sea) is contrary to United Nations practice and infringes upon the neutrality of the United Nations.” This indicates that the United Nations has identified the Sea of Japan as the only official name for the sea. The principle of separate marking of the Japanese Sea has long been observed, for example, by the International Hydrographic Organization or the World Map and Textbooks.

source_text: 1977年，第三次联合国地名标准化会议通过了决议III/20号（UNCSGN），题为“超出单一主权范围的地理特征之命名”，与IHO技术决议案A.4.2.6一起规定，不论韩国和日本同不同意，这一政策都适用于日本海。在1992年第六届UNCSGN上，韩国政府第一次参与UNCSGN，要求北朝鲜代表同意通过协商来确定海的名字。日本代表说，日本海的名称已经被世界公认，任何做出的变化将会导致地名的混淆。会议建议各方共同努力，在会议外的时间解决这个问题。
target_text: In 1977, the Third United Nations Conference on the Standardization of Geographical Names adopted resolution III/20 (UNCSGN), entitled “The naming of geographical features beyond a single sovereignty”, which, together with IHO technical resolution A.4.2.6, stipulates that this policy applies to the Sea of Japan regardless of the consent of the Republic of Korea and Japan. At the Sixth United Nations Conference on the Standardization of Geographical Names, held in 1992, the Korean Government participated for the first time in UNCSGN, asking North Korean representatives to agree to determine the name of the Sea through consultations. The representative of Japan said that the name of the Sea of Japan was universally recognized and any changes made would lead to confusion of geographical names. The Conference recommended that all parties work together to resolve the issue at a time outside the Conference.
title: 日本海命名爭議

北京条约之后，中国的开国已成定局。自此正式沦为半殖民地。而以同治中兴为界，列强与中国的关系稳定了下来，继而改变了对太平天国的中立政策。法国对越南的侵略也更加放开手脚。

source_text: 根据1844年《中美望厦条约》第34条规定“所有贸易及海面各款恐不无稍有变通之处，应候十二年后，两国派员公平酌办”。根据《虎门条约》中的一体均沾，英、法、美三國在1854年和1856年兩次提出修約要求，俄國也趁机谋求利益；但四國的修約要求並沒有得到清政府的允許，当时英、法正与俄国进行克里米亚战争，无暇东顾中国，“修约”问题也就暂时地搁置起来。
target_text: According to article 34 of the Treaty of China and the United States of America of 1844, “All trade and the sea are subject to minor variations, and the two countries are expected to make a fair decision after 12 years.” According to the Tiger Gate Treaty, the British, French and United States made two requests to amend the Treaty in 1854 and 1856, and Russia took advantage of the opportunity to pursue its interests; however, the four countries' requirements for a revision of the Treaty did not meet with the permission of the Qing Government, when Britain and France were engaged in a Crimea war with Russia, leaving China alone.

source_text: 第一次鸦片战争后，广东民间反抗活动时有发生，《南京条约》規定英国官員可以住在城邑，由於当时两广总督耆英不遵守条约，令英国人七年来无法進入广州城。后来1849年履新的广东巡抚兼五口通商大臣叶名琛更对民间反抗活动采取默认态度，对一切外国的申诉置诸不理。加之新上任的皇帝咸丰极度反外。發生於1856年10月的亞羅號事件，以及1856年的马神甫事件（即广西西林教案），成為英、法聯合出兵中國的導火線。

source_text: 另一方面，法国籍神父馬賴于1856年2月29日因违禁深入內地傳教，被广西西林代理知县张鸣凤所捕杀，法國方面極為不滿，要求清廷賠償道歉，但為葉名琛拒絕。法國波拿巴王朝於是聯合維多利亞時代的英国出兵清朝。法皇拿破崙三世任命葛罗男爵为特命全权专使，率领一支法国远征军开赴中国，令其远东印度支那舰队司令里戈·德热努依里海军少将率舰队配合葛罗的行动。英法欲聯合美國，但美國僅以外交支持。而俄國外交代表以东正教团监护身份早先混入北京，后来則以调停人面目出现，藉機漁利。

source_text: 1858年4月，英法軍艦載有2600多人抵達大沽口（天津市濱海新區）。5月20日聯軍以6艘砲艇掩護陸戰隊近千人向砲台側面登陸，清軍發砲反擊，殺傷近百聯軍士兵。直隸總督譚廷襄卻棄守逃亡，砲台守軍孤立無援，清軍約300多人戰死，南北砲台陸續被聯軍攻佔。5月26日聯軍沿河到達天津城。。在英、法、美、俄公使的要求下，清朝于5月28日派大学士桂良、吏部尚书花沙纳为钦差大臣，赶赴天津议和。谈判期间，美、俄公使扮演“调停者”的角色，抢在英、法之前，與清廷分别于6月13日和6月18日签订了《中俄天津条约》和《中美天津条约》。在中俄《天津条约》签订以前半个月，黑龙江将军奕山在沙俄武力威胁下，与东西伯利亚总督穆拉维约夫签订了《中俄瑷珲条约》。6月26日和6月27日，清朝与英法两国分别签订了《中英天津条约》和《中法天津条约》。条约的主要内容是：公使常驻北京；增开牛庄、登州、台湾、淡水、潮州、琼州、汉口、九江、南京、镇江为通商口岸；扩大领事裁判权；对英赔款四百万两，对法赔款二百万两；修改税则等等。条约规定第二年在北京換約。条约签定后联军于1858年7月陆续南撤。經過第一次大沽口戰役後，僧格林沁奉命加強防務，修復戰後的砲台。

source_text: 韩国总统通过由15－30人组成的国务会议行使行政权，总统担任韩国国务会议议长，国务总理担任国务会议副议长。韩国总统的主要职能包括：作为国家元首负责接见外国使节，颁发嘉奖令、授勋和实施大赦，维护國家統一，民族独立，领土完整，国家连续性和维护宪法，作为最高行政长官，负责推行国会通过的各项法律，并全權领导国务会议、各类咨询机构、行政部门，并有权任命包括国务总理、各部會在内的官员，領導國家安全保障會議，作为大韓民國國軍最高统帅，拥有包括宣战权在内的广泛军事政策制定权，作为国家最高外交官、外交政策决策者，有权任命和派遣外交使节，与外国簽订条约、作为主要政策、法律的制定者，可以向国会提出立法议案，并亲自或以书面形式向國會議員说明自己的观点。总统任命的国务总理需由国会批准。韩国总统无权解散國會，但国会可以通过弹劾程序限制总统。要彈劾總統，先要有韓國國會議員提出彈劾動議，並必須要有過半數國會議員贊成。投票必須於動議提出後的24小時之後，至72小時以前，以不記名投票方式。若投票時間超過則作無效論。若投票結果顯示，有超過三分之二國會議員投贊成票，彈劾議案就通過。一旦彈劾議案通過，總統的職能會被暫時凍結，並由總理代總統職務。之後彈劾議案會交由憲法法院審理。

source_text: 英国使团虽未完成打开中国门户、开拓中国市场的任务，但他们在华逗留期间，收集了大量政治、经济、军事情报，为其发动第一次鸦片战争埋下了伏笔。嘉庆十五年，设热河都统府。1860年9月，英法联军攻占北京，咸丰帝仓皇从圆明园出走，逃往承德。在避暑山庄，咸丰屈服于列强的军事压力，先后批准了《中英北京条约》、《中法北京条约》和《中俄北京条约》。1861年8月22日，咸丰帝駕崩於避暑山庄烟波致爽殿，咸丰死後，11月2日，慈安、慈禧与奕䜣一起以突然袭击的方式，迅速铲除了肃顺等顧命八大臣一伙势力，因此年系农历辛酉年，故史称“辛酉政变”，又因原擬年號為「祺祥」，又稱「祺祥之變」。事變後，由慈安、太后共同執政，是為兩宮聽政。

source_text: 在第二次世界大战期间，列支敦士登在保持中立的同时也是少数几个不承认慕尼黑协定以及第三帝国占领捷克斯洛伐克的欧洲国家之一，并且在二战中始终承认捷克斯洛伐克流亡政府为合法政府，其位于战区的家族财产被带到列支敦士登（以及伦敦）妥善保管。在战争快要结束时，捷克斯洛伐克和波兰夺取了在其认为是德国领土的地区，而剥夺了列支敦士登王朝在波希米亚、摩拉维亚和西里西亚世袭的全部土地及所有权，而直到1938年德奥合并之前列支敦士登亲王还一直居住在维也纳。列支敦士登被剥夺的主权（属于国际法庭中现代法律争议的部分）包括超过1600平方公里的农田及森林，以及许多其家族所拥有的城堡和宫殿。列支敦士登亲王现在依然对这些土地提出主权要求，要求捷克和斯洛伐克归还所占领土。也因此争议，列支敦士登公民在冷战期间被禁止进入捷克斯洛伐克社会主义共和国。捷克斯洛伐克解体为捷克共和国和斯洛伐克共和国后，列支敦士登和它们之间依然互不承认。但最终列支敦士登分别于2009年7月13日和12月9日与捷克和斯洛伐克建立了外交关系。
target_text: At the end of the Second World War, Liechtenstein, while remaining neutral, was one of the few European countries that did not recognize the Munich Agreement and the occupation of Czechoslovakia by the Third Reich, and in the Second World War it was always recognized that the Czechoslovak exile government was a legitimate government, and that its family property located in the war zone was taken to Liechtenstein (as well as London). At the end of the war, Czechoslovakia and Poland took over the areas they considered German territory and deprived the Liechtenstein dynasty of all land and title to the heritage of Bohemia, Moravia and Silesia, while Liechtenstein citizens were still residing in Vienna until 1938, when the Doo merger took place. The part of the sovereignty that Liechtenstein was deprived of (which was part of the modern legal dispute in the International Tribunal) included more than 1,600 square kilometres of agricultural land and forests, as well as castles and palaces owned by many of its families.
title: 列支敦斯登

source_text: 由於長期以來一直作為瑞士的盟国，列支敦士登也自然承襲瑞士国际洗钱运动中心的地位。1924年列支敦斯登與瑞士之間簽訂有双边共同貨幣與關稅條約。根據條約，除了貨物能在兩國之間的國界自由流通外，瑞士法郎也成為列支敦斯登的官方貨幣。但是除了上述幾個事項之外，并没有条约规定列支敦斯登在其他重要的政治、经济或政府決策上必须事先获得瑞士的同意，这也使得列支敦士登直到今日仍能在经济上保有独立性。1993年時瑞士拒絕加入歐洲貨幣聯盟，由於列支敦斯登在外交事务方面早已委任瑞士代執行，本身並無單獨與他國簽訂協約的能力，該國連帶地也成為西歐國家裡面少數仍流通非歐元貨幣的國家。
target_text: According to the agreement, the Swiss franc is the official currency of Liechtenstein, apart from the free circulation of goods between the two countries. But, apart from the foregoing, there is no treaty requiring Liechtenstein’s prior consent to other important political, economic, or government decisions, which would enable Liechtenstein to remain economically independent until today. In 1993, Switzerland refused to join the European Monetary Union, since Liechtenstein had already appointed Switzerland to operate in foreign affairs, without having the sole capacity to conclude agreements with other countries.

列支敦士登奉行中立政策，由于运作成本太高因此在1868年解除武裝後就沒有再恢復過軍備，现在是世上少数完全没有军队的国家之一（詳見沒有軍隊的國家一覽）。一种流传的说法和美国中央情报局的《世界概况》描述曾经声称，列支敦士登的防务由瑞士负责，但事实上瑞士与列支敦士登之间并没有签订军事防务条约。而根据列支敦士登官方网站上关于两国双边关系的描述中也没有提到任何相关的防务条约。《世界概况》现也已更改。
target_text: It is one of the few countries in the world that has no army at all (see details of countries without military forces) because of the high operating costs Liechtenstein pursues a policy of neutrality. A well-known statement and the United States Central Intelligence Agency's World Fact Sheet describe a claim that the defence of Liechtenstein is the responsibility of Switzerland, but in fact there is no military defense treaty between Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
title: 列支敦斯登

source_text: 根据国际公法，内陆国家在临海邻国拥有过境权，即其人员、运输工具和货物擁有不受阻挠地通过邻国领土的权利。内陆国家利用国际性江河通往海洋的情况则需要取决于该国境内是否具备可以通航的国际性河流。1919年，《凡尔赛和约》规定捷克斯洛伐克可以自由利用易北河航道和汉堡港口。奥地利和匈牙利则通过国际性条约获准使用多瑙河航道进行江海航运。此外，根据1986年《联合国船舶登记条件公约》，每个国家，不论是沿海国或内陆国，均有权使悬挂其国旗的船舶在公海上行驶。
target_text: In accordance with public international law, landlocked countries have the right of transit in neighbouring countries, i.e. the right to unimpeded passage of persons, means of transport and goods through the territory of neighbouring countries. The access of landlocked countries to the sea by international rivers depends on the availability of international rivers within the country. In 1919, the Versailles Treaty provided for free access by Czechoslovakia to the sea lanes of the Elbe and the port of Hamburg. Austria and Hungary, through international treaties, are authorized to use the Danube sea lanes. Moreover, under the 1986 United Nations Convention on Conditions for the Registration of Ships, each State, whether coastal or landlocked, has the right to allow vessels flying its flag to travel on the high seas.
title: 內陸國家

正方形与无理数
公元前五世纪时，毕达哥拉斯学派最早证明了正方形的对角线长度与边长长度的比例：，是无法表示为两个自然数的公比的。平面镶嵌
用同一种多边形不重疊地将平面“铺满”，称为平面的正镶嵌图。正方形是能够组成平面的正镶嵌图的三种正多边形之一（另外两种分别是正三角形和正六边形）。
target_text: In the fifth century BC, the Pythagoras school first proved the ratio between the length of the rectangular rectangle and the length of the edge: it cannot be expressed as a square of two natural numbers. The square is embedded in a single polygon that “fills” the plane with the same polygon, which is known as the square's orthopaedic map. The square is one of three orthopaedics (the other two are rectangular and hexagonal) that make up the square.
title: 正方形

source_text: 臺北經濟文化代表處（，TECRO），或稱臺北經濟文化辦事處，簡稱臺灣代表處、臺北代表處或臺北辦事處，是中華民國外交部在非邦交國所設立的驻外機構，具有實質大使館之功能，實際上在駐在國行使大使館或領事館的權責，其人員在駐在國享有部分外交禮遇。
target_text: The Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECRO), or the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office, is known as the Taiwan Representative Office, the Taipei Representative Office or the Taipei Office. It is the diplomatic presence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China in a non-State border country, with the function of a genuine embassy, and is in fact operating in the country in the exercise of the authority of embassies or consulates, and its members enjoy some diplomatic courtesy in the country.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 设置此类代表机构，通常是中華民國政府與原邦交國因北京的一個中國政策失去邦交后采取的權宜措施。早期代表机构名称不一，亦可能由外交部之外的中華民國政府部门设置，如經濟部设置的遠東貿易服務中心、行政院新聞局駐外機構等。中華民國外交部设置的這些代表机构，本國稱之為「駐（某國）代表處」或「駐（某地）辦事處」，但在駐在國另有名稱。中華民國通過此類代表機構，和駐在國保持政治、經濟貿易、文化等關係與交流。
target_text: These institutions, which the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs has set up, are known as “a representative’s office” or “a representative’s office” in China, but they are also known as “a resident’s office” in China. China, through such institutions, maintains political, economic, cultural and other relations and exchanges in the country.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 在无邦交的駐在國，中華民國外交部積極爭取以「中華民國」或「臺灣」為名，设立外交代表機構。但受限于這些國家与中華人民共和國的外交关系，基於中华人民共和国的「一個中國政策」，駐在國不與中華民國建立正式邦交，但轉以此權宜方式維持雙邊關係；又因代表處不能以中華民國國號冠名，因而轉用具有指標意義的地名——「臺北」冠名。2020年8月，中華民國外交部在中华人民共和国无邦交的索馬利蘭设立台灣駐索馬利蘭共和國代表處。
target_text: In China, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs actively struggled to establish diplomatic representation in the name of “China” or “Taiwan.” However, diplomatic relations between these countries and the People’s Republic of China are limited by the “one-China policy” of the People’s Republic of China, which does not establish official relations with China, but instead maintains bilateral relations in an ad hoc manner; and, since the Office of the Representative is unable to use the name of the People’s Republic of China as the country’s crown, the name “Taibei” has been replaced by the name “Tai Nam.” In August 2020, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China set up the Republic of Taiwan and the Republic of Somalia in Somaliland, the country’s borderless territory of the People’s Republic of China.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 2002年2月25日，中華民國外交部表示，考慮為駐外機構改一個更有“連續性”的名稱，以“台灣”代替目前使用的“台北”。中華民國外交部發言人張小月指，台灣民意調查顯示，70%的被採訪者讚成用“台灣”代替“台北”，作為駐外機構名稱。2018年11月，中華民國外交部國際傳播司議建議駐外機構臉書粉專名稱以“Taiwan”和所在地點命名。如「駐洛杉磯臺北經濟文化辦事處」（英文：Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles），更名为「Taiwan in Los Angeles」。
target_text: On February 25, 2002, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it was considering changing the name of the foreign agency to a more “continuing” and replacing the currently used term “Taiwan” with “Taiwan.” According to the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Taiwan Public Opinion Survey, 70% of the respondents preferred the term “Taiwan” to “Taibei” as the name of the foreign agency. In November 2018, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China and China recommended that the foreign agency’s Facebook book be named “Taiwan” and its location.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 在中华人民共和国政治习惯中，「臺灣」相比「臺北」有台独含义。在中华人民共和国邦交国的中华民国外交代表机构使用「臺灣」一名，被中华人民共和国政府方面视为制造“一中一台”。2021年11月设立駐立陶宛台灣代表處之前，曾在中华人民共和国的邦交国，设立臺灣駐巴林王國商務代表團、駐玻利維亞臺灣商務辦事處、臺灣駐利比亞商務代表處等机构，但後來都改名或裁撤。而在中美新冷战的背景下，中华人民共和国外交部发言人赵立坚在2021年9月例行记者会表示，美国政府不得将駐美國臺北經濟文化代表處更名为“台湾代表处”。
target_text: In the political tradition of the People's Republic of China, the term “Taiwan” is more than “Taibei.” The use of the term “Taiwan” in the diplomatic representations of the States of the People's Republic of China is regarded by the Government of the People's Republic of China as a “one Taiwan” creation. Prior to the establishment of the Republic of Lithuania's representation office in Taiwan in November 2021, it was established in the State border of the People's Republic of China that the United States Government should not change its name to “Taiwan Representative Office” in the Economic and Cultural Office of the Kingdom of Bahrain. In the context of the New Cold War between China and the United States, the spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, Zhao Jian, stated in September 2021 that the United States Government should not rename the post “Taiwan Representative Office” in the Economic and Cultural Office of the United States in Taipei.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 臺北經濟文化代表處的功能是發展實質的對等互利關係，「促進中華民國與外國間經貿、投資、文化、科技等交流合作及民間之瞭解與互助」，在駐在國實質代表中華民國的利益。臺北代表處雖然不稱為大使館，但經由中華民國外交部官方授權，可行使大使館等正式外交機構的部分職責，如发展双边关系、负责侨务、核發中華民國護照及簽證等。
target_text: Its functions are to develop a genuinely reciprocal relationship of mutual benefit, “promoting exchanges of trade, investment, culture, technology, etc. between the Chinese and foreign countries, and understanding and mutual assistance between the Chinese and Chinese peoples” and to represent China’s interests in the country’s territory. Although it is not known as an embassy, it is officially authorized by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs to exercise some of the responsibilities of official diplomatic bodies, such as embassies, such as developing bilateral relations, dealing with overseas affairs, issuing China’s passports and issuing visas.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 在一般情況下，臺北代表處享有治外法權保障，駐節國家所提供的領事保護機制相近，部分國家則給與臺北代表處人員等同正式外交使節或國際組織人員的身份，享有外交特權或外交豁免權的待遇，例如：美國、日本、紐西蘭、瑞士、沙烏地阿拉伯等。其他國家也在臺灣設立類似的代表機構，如美國在臺協會臺北辦事處、加拿大駐台北貿易辦事處等。
target_text: In general, the Taipei representation enjoys extra-territorial guarantees, the diplomatic protection mechanisms offered by visiting countries are similar, and some countries grant official diplomatic envoys or members of international organizations the same status as their counterparts in Taipei, such as the United States, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, Saudi Arabia, etc.. Other countries have similar representation structures in Taiwan, such as the United States North Office in Taiwan, Canada's North Trade Office, etc.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text: 中華民國外交部將「代表處」的地位定位為大使館，「辦事處」則同於領事館。為配合組織改造，依立法院於2012年1月20日通過、經總統公布的《駐外機構組織通則》，規範外交部和其他中央部會駐外機構組織編制，並自9月1日開始將駐外人員之行政職稱統一以正式官銜訂定，駐外機構（大使館與代表處）之館長均稱大使，解決原先大使館、總領事館、代表處、辦事處人員職稱複雜、容易混淆的問題。
target_text: The Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs has defined the status of the Office of the Representative as an embassy, and the Office of the Attorney-General as a consulate. As part of the restructuring of the organization, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and other central ministries, in accordance with the General Principles for the Organization of Foreign Institutions, adopted by the Legislative Assembly on 20 January 2012 and published by the President, have been working in foreign organizations, and since September 1 has been establishing an official post for the administration of foreign personnel, and the head of the foreign agency (Ambassadors and Representatives) has called the ambassador a solution to the complex and confusing problems of the former embassy, head of office, representative office and staff.
title: 臺北經濟文化代表處

source_text:
加拿大駐台北貿易辦事處（、），是加拿大政府在台灣設立的代表機構，具有實質大使館的功能。歷史
加拿大政府與中華民國政府於1970年10月13日斷交後，無法在中華民國設置大使館或領事館。因此，在台灣代表加拿大的機構被稱做「貿易辦事處」，是以此來避免敏感的外交用語。
target_text: The Canadian Trade Office in Taipei (and) is a representative agency of the Canadian government in Taiwan, with a physical embassy function. The Government of Canada and the Chinese government were unable to set up embassies or consulates in China after their closure on October 13, 1970.
title: 加拿大駐台北貿易辦事處

source_text:
特点
1987年6月12日至26日，在奥地利维也纳召开了由138个国家和地区的3000名代表参加的“麻醉品滥用和非法贩运问题”部长级会议。 这次会议通过了《管制麻醉品滥用今后活动的综合性多学科纲要》，向各国政府和有关国际组织提出了在今后的禁毒活动中开展综合治理的建议，并提出了“爱生命，不吸毒”的口号。同时，为了进一步引起各国、各地区对毒品问题的重视，号召全世界人民共同抵御毒品的侵袭，与毒品犯罪活动作坚决的斗争，也为了纪念这次意义重大的国际禁毒会议，大会结束时，与会代表一致建议，将每年的6月26日定为“国际禁毒日”。这项建议被联合国采纳。同年召开的第42届联合国大会通过决议，正式确定每年的6月26日为“反麻醉品的滥用和非法贩运国际日”。
target_text: At the conclusion of the Ministerial Conference on Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, held in Vienna, Austria, from 12 to 26 June 1987, with the participation of 3,000 representatives from 138 countries and regions, the Conference adopted the Comprehensive Multidisciplinary Outline of Future Activities in Drug Abuse Control, which made recommendations to Governments and relevant international organizations for integrated management of future drug control activities and proposed the slogan “Love for life, non-drug use.” At the same time, and in order to further draw the attention of States and regions to the drug problem, called upon the peoples of the world to work together against drug abuse, to combat drug-related crime, and to commemorate the significant international drug conference, the Conference unanimously recommended that 26 June of each year be designated “International Day against Drug Abuse”. This proposal was adopted by the United Nations. At its forty-second session, held in the same year, the General Assembly formally established 26 June of each year as the International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking.
title: 禁止药物滥用和非法贩运国际日

source_text:
近代政体理论
启蒙运动之后，政体理论上划时代的建树人物是法国思想家让·布丹。他根据掌握国家主权的人数多寡，将政体分为君主政体、贵族政体和民主政体。他认为法国的君主政体是最好的政体，把君主政体按照君主行使权力的方式分为王朝君主制（或者称作正宗的君主制）、领主君主制和暴君制。这种划分的意义在于将世俗政治权威置于了神法和自然法的规范下，认为只有这样，人民才能真正享有财产和自由，并且自愿服从主权者的权威。
target_text: In the wake of the Enlightenment Movement, the defining figure of the polity theory was the French thinker Jean Boudan, who divided the polity into monarchy, nobility, and democracy according to the number of people in control of national sovereignty. In his view, France’s monarchy was the best form of government, dividing the monarchy into monarchy (or real monarchy), monarchy and tyrantism in the manner in which it was exercised by the monarchy. This division meant that secular political authority was placed under the norms of the divine and natural law, and considered that only then could the people truly enjoy property and freedom and comply voluntarily with the authority of the sovereign.
title: 政体

source_text: 此后，托马斯·霍布斯才完全摆脱了伦理、道德和宗教的约束，以社会契约为基础，按照主权的归属将政体分为一人掌握主权的君主政体、议会式的贵族政体以及全体臣民大会掌权的民主政体。霍布斯放弃了对理想政体的探讨，认为人性的自私不可能让统治者放弃私利而只谋求公共利益，只有私人利益与公共利益统一的地方，公共利益才会被增进。他认为这只-{}-有绝对君主制才能够实现。
target_text: Since then, Thomas Hobbs has been completely free of ethical, moral, and religious constraints, based on a social contract, dividing the form of government into a sovereign monarchy, a parliamentary system of nobility, and a democracy in which all subjects are in power, in accordance with the attribution of sovereignty. Hobbs has abandoned the discussion of the ideal system of government, believing that human selfishness cannot allow rulers to abandon their private interests and only pursue public interests, which he believes can only be achieved if private interests are reconciled with those of the public.
title: 政体

source_text: 殖民地，旧称植民地，是指由宗主国统治，没有政治、经济、军事和外交方面的独立权力，完全受宗主国控制的非宗主國本土地区。广义的殖民地还包括：虽然拥有行政机关、军队等国家机构，但经济、军事、外交等一方或多方被别国控制的「半殖民地国家」、卫星国和保护国，還有委任统治地、托管地，以及殖民主义国家在这些地区设置的“属地”、“海外领地”(英国)、“海外省”(法国)、“附属地”(德国)等諸多不同名稱的各種非本土行政區。联合国定义的“非自治领土”为前殖民地的遗存。
target_text: Colonies, formerly known as colonies, are native territories of non-dominant States which are under the domination of the Crown, which have no independent political, economic, military or diplomatic powers, and which are entirely under the control of the Crown. In the broad sense, colonies include “semi-colonial States” of which one or more parties, such as the economy, the military or the diplomatic, are controlled by another State, as well as satellite States and protectors, and also mandate territories, trust lands, and various non-native regions of which colonial countries have established “territorial territories”, “Overseas territories” (United Kingdom), “Overseas provinces” (France), “subsidiary lands” (Germany), etc. The United Nations defines “self-governing territories” as the legacy of former colonies.
title: 殖民地

source_text: 英屬香港以及葡屬澳門英屬香港及葡屬澳門：1842年《南京条约》把香港島割讓為英国殖民地，其後1860年《北京条约》再割讓九龍及1898年《展拓香港界址專條》租借新界99年，塑造了今日香港大致範圍。澳門則在1557年開始被葡萄牙人向明朝租借，及在1887年與清朝簽訂《中葡和好通商條約》成為殖民地。然而，1971年中华人民共和国透過聯合國大會2758號決議取代中華民國在聯合國的席位代表權後，翌年即1972年向聯合國非殖民化委員會提出將香港及澳門於准許民族自決及獨立的殖民地或屬地名單上撤消，理據是「殖民地是遭受外國統治管轄而喪失主權的國家……香港及澳門本身並非主權國家，而是英國和葡萄牙所佔領的中國領土，是帝國主義國家強加於中國的一系列不平等條約的結果，中华人民共和国不承認這些不平等條約，聯合國並沒有權討論這些問題。」而議案在大會上獲得通過。此舉的結果是使香港及澳門人民喪失自決的權力，無法依據聯合國非殖化的努力及早自治，自此港澳被移出联合国擬准許民族自決及獨立的“非自治领土”名单。
target_text: British Hong Kong and Portuguese Hong Kong and Portuguese Macau: The 1842 Treaty of Nanjing ceded Hong Kong into a British colony, followed by the Beijing Treaty of 1860, which rented the New Territories for a further 99 years, and the 1898 Hong Kong Boundaries Act, which shaped today’s Hong Kong. Macau was removed in 1557 by Portuguese tenants from the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and in 1887 by the signing of the Treaty of Trade and Trade between the People’s Republic of China and the Democratic People’s Republic of China. However, in 1971, the People’s Republic of China replaced China with the United Kingdom’s powers of representation in the United States by resolution 2758 of the United Nations General Assembly, and in 1972, the United Kingdom and Portugal proposed to the United Nations Commission on Decolonization that Hong Kong and Macau should be self-deposited and an exclusive colony of the United States, and that the island’s efforts to remove the sovereignty of the People’s People’s Republic of China and the United Kingdom’s sovereignty from the United Kingdom’s sovereignty and the United States of China’s status as an unequal power.

source_text: 根據2017年公布的部分英國外交部的解密文件顯示，在二戰後非殖民化浪潮中，英國政府曾探討讓香港成為自治領的可能，例如楊慕琦計劃，但受到中國大陸內政不穩的因素影響，而且中華人民共和國國務院總理周恩來亦多次向英國政府警告「讓香港自治會視作為不友善的表現」。英國外交部曾在1952年批准第22任香港總督葛量洪較為溫和的改革方案，但行政立法兩局的官守官員突然反對任何改革，時殖民地大臣列堤頓（Oliver Lyttelton）在同年表示任何重大改革都不恰當。1958年上任的港督柏立基認為，推動任何改革都會挑釁中國大陸。致令英國政府在香港統治至1997年6月30日，期間只作民生事務改革而無以在香港推動民主。
target_text: According to a declassified document issued in 2017 by the British Foreign Ministry, in the post-World War II wave of decolonization, the British government explored the possibility of making Hong Kong self-governing, such as the Yang Murgyi plan, but was affected by the instability in China’s internal affairs, and the Chinese People’s Republic and the State Secretary of State, Zhou En, repeatedly warned the British government “to make Hong Kong self-governing as an unfriendly gesture.” In 1952, the British Foreign Ministry approved Hong Kong’s 22nd Hong Kong Governor-General Gondya’s reform programme, but the officials of the two branches of executive legislation suddenly opposed any reform, while the colonial minister, Oliver Lytelton, said that any major reform would be inappropriate.

source_text:
现存的殖民地和海外自治领地
联合国成立后，去殖民化进程加快，大多数殖民地完成去殖民，但英法等国依然有大量前殖民地以“海外领地”形式存在。《联合国宪章》第十一章将非自治领土定义为“其人民尚未臻自治之充分程度者”。大会在1946年12月14日第66(I)号决议中列出了适用《宪章》第十一章的72个领土名单。1963年，给予殖民地国家和人民独立宣言执行情况特别委员会（又称“非殖民化特别委员会”或“24国委员会”）核准了适用《宣言》的领土初步名单（A/5446/Rev.1，附件一）。如今，24国委员会的议程上保留了下列17个非自治领土。负有或承担管理这些领土责任的会员国称为管理国。这些地区的人民享有自决权。
target_text: In 1963, the Special Committee on the Situation with regard to the Implementation of the Declaration on the Granting of Independence to Colonial Countries and Peoples (also known as the “Special Committee on Decolonization” or the “Committee of 24”) approved a preliminary list of Territories to which the Declaration applied (A/5446/Rev.1, annex I). Today, in Chapter XI of the Charter of the United Nations, Non-Self-Governing Territories are defined as “those whose peoples have not yet attained a full measure of self-government.” In its resolution 66 (I) of 14 December 1946, the General Assembly listed 72 Territories to which Chapter XI of the Charter applies. source_text:
绝对王权
他一天工作八小時以上，以無比的熱誠與精神治理國家，很快就成為全歐洲最優秀的英明君王，創立有史以來無與倫比的絕對君主制。藉由天才宣教士雅克-貝尼涅·博須埃主教（又譯博旭哀，）積極宣傳君權神授與絕對君主制，以及路易自身的努力，他徹底馴服法國貴族與教會主教，並重用有非凡才幹的中產階級（布爾喬亞），為他打理分工越趨精細的國家事務，當中最優秀的人才是财政大臣柯尔贝（見後述）；而能幹的皮埃爾·塞吉埃（1588-1672年）則是負責外交與法院事務，對法國早期的外交成就貢獻卓著。
target_text: He worked eight hours a day or more to govern the country with the greatest passion and spirit, and quickly became Europe’s finest and wiser King, with an unprecedented absolute monarchy. The best man in the world was the Minister of Finance, Colbe, by proclaiming to him by a talented priest, Bishop Jacques-Berninire Boshoe. The best man was Pierre Ségié (1588-1672), who was responsible for diplomacy and the courts, and for the country’s early diplomatic achievements.
title: 路易十四

source_text: 荷蘭執政威廉三世在1688年的光榮革命後，當上英國國王，並使英國在1689年加入奧格斯堡同盟，升高大同盟戰爭的等級。這是路易十四繼1685年迫害結盟宗之後的另一次外交大挫敗（原本英國在1670年後外交上一直相當於法國的附庸），從此路易面對英-荷-奧的三強聯盟，注定他最後統一全歐野心消亡的命運。
target_text: After the glorious revolution of 1688, the Dutch government, William III, became the King of England, and in 1689 the United Kingdom joined the Oggsburg coalition, raising the level of the Great Alliance War. This was another major diplomatic setback after Louis’s persecution of his allies in 1685 (formerly the United Kingdom’s diplomatic arm of France since 1670), and since then Louis was faced with the three powers of the In-Ho-O coalition, which was destined for his ultimate demise as an all-European ambition.

source_text: 因为北卡罗来纳级战列舰只能防御14英寸炮，显得攻强守弱，于是南达科他级战列舰诞生了。南达科他级战列舰的设计排水量、火力与北卡罗莱纳级相同，重点加强防护力，因此尽可能的减轻一些不必要的重量重点优化装甲防护。由于排水量受华盛顿海军条约限制及试用了一些未经全面测试的革新性新技术而使该级舰并不是十分成功，而且没有安装空调，但仍被公认为攻防比较平衡的、最优秀的条约型战列舰。该级保持与北卡罗来纳级相同的最大舰宽，缩小水线长度，动力舱室更加紧凑，造成航速略为降低，转弯半径较北卡罗莱纳级稍大；采用单烟囱，增加侧舷装甲带倾斜角度以及甲板装甲厚度，防护水平得到了明显的提高；采用球鼻型舰艏以降低舰体阻力，并增大了主机功率。该级舰于1938年5月批准建造，同级四艘：南达科他号(BB57)、印第安纳号(BB58)、马萨诸塞号(BB59)、阿拉巴马号(BB60)，均于1942年间服役。由于长宽比小，所以南达科他级战列舰（1941）是美国唯一一级长宽比保持在6.5以下新式战列舰。
target_text: Since the North Carolina Class warship was only defence-resistant by 14 inches of artillery and appeared weak, the South Dakota class battleship was born. The South Dakota class battleship was designed as well as the North Carolina class with the same number of drains, firepower, and a greater emphasis on protection, thereby reducing some of the unnecessary weights as much as possible to optimize armoured protection. As a result of drainage restrictions imposed by the Washington Naval Treaty and the trial of new and innovative technologies that were not fully tested, the class was not successful and was not equipped with air conditioners, but the level of protection was significantly increased by the fact that it was recognized as the best treaty-type warship to strike a more balanced battle against the South Dakota class.

Although the President has the name of the head of the General Assembly, he is actually in charge of presiding over the proceedings of the Assembly; the Secretary-General is at the heart of the actual United Nations Organization, and he can make a major international impact through the negotiation of national views, the organization of concrete work to achieve the decisions of the General Assembly.
title: 联合国大会

source_text: 近几年，大会例行全体会议虽然只计划在三个月的时间内举行，但由于事务繁杂，会期往往延长至下一次会议召开前不久。按照联合国议事规则，例行安排的会议通常从“9月第三周的周二开始，从第一周开始计算，第一周至少包含一个工作日”。按照惯例，大会召开3个月后，在12月初，最后两次常会将暂停至1月份才继续举行，并一直延续到下一个会期开始之前。聯大通常在每年十二月底的聖誕節假期前，即完成其主要議程。
target_text: In recent years, the regular plenary meetings of the General Assembly, although scheduled for only three months, have often been extended, owing to the complexity of the matter, to a short time before the next meeting. In accordance with the rules of procedure of the United Nations, routine meetings normally begin “on Tuesday, the third week of September, beginning with the first week, and include at least one working day.” In early December, three months after the Assembly's session, the last two regular sessions will be suspended until January and continue until the next session begins.
title: 联合国大会

source_text: 根据1878年俄土戰爭後的《柏林條約》，奥匈帝国被授權占领並管理奥斯曼波斯尼亚，而奥斯曼帝国保留官方主权。根据同一条约，大国集团（奥匈帝国、英国、法国、德国、意大利王國、奥斯曼帝国和俄罗斯帝国）官方上认可塞尔维亚公国为完全主权国家。四年後，塞尔维亚公国國君米蘭一世將國家由公國變為王国，米蘭一世亦成為獨立後首個塞爾維亞國王。当时塞尔维亚的君主隶属于奥布仁诺维奇王室，仍与奥匈帝国保持着密切的外交关系，在米蘭一世及其繼位者亞歷山大一世在位時，塞爾維亞满足于统治条约所界定的领土。
target_text: According to the same treaty, the Great Group (the Orang Empire, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Italian Kingdom, the Ottoman Empire, and the Russian Empire) officially recognized the Principality of Serbia as a fully sovereign state. Four years later, the Principality of Serbia, King Milan I, transformed the country from the Principality and Milan I as the first Serbian king after independence.
title: 萨拉热窝事件

source_text:
国际大都市
现代的布鲁塞尔已经成为众多国际组织总部的所在地，其中最主要的就是欧洲联盟和北大西洋公约组织（北约）。其它还有1000多个国际性组织和2000多家跨国公司的总部设于布鲁塞尔。从每年举行的国际会议数量来看，布鲁塞尔位居全球第三位。欧盟及其它国际组织的存在，使得每年常驻在布鲁塞尔的外交官及记者的人数超过了美国首都华盛顿特区。因此，布鲁塞尔也建造了众多的国际学校，以满足在此工作的国际组织人员的需求。布鲁塞尔也号称“欧洲伊斯兰之都”，因为布鲁塞尔城的穆斯林人口已经超过了全市人口的四分之一，而且仍在上升。
target_text: The presence of the European Union and other international organizations has made the number of diplomats and journalists based in Brussels more numerous each year than in Washington, D.C. Brussels has built a large number of international schools to meet the needs of the personnel of the international organizations working there. Brussels is also known as the “Islam capital of Europe” because the Muslim population in Brussels is already more than one quarter of the city’s population and is still rising.
title: 布鲁塞尔

source_text:
歷史
第一次世界大战结束后，英国曾计划建造N3型战列舰，因《华盛顿海军条约》签定而夭折。1922年英国在条约规定的吨位内开始建造纳尔逊级战列舰。纳尔逊级采用平甲板船型，不再是以往英国战舰常用的艏楼船型。根据日德兰海战的经验教训着重提升装甲防护水準，首次采用倾斜佈置水线装甲带，是当时舷侧装甲最厚的战舰。受条约规定35000吨的限制，纳尔逊级采用3座三联装主炮炮塔全部在舰桥之前，而动力机舱集中配置在舰体后部这种非常规的布局，目的是将有限的重装甲防护区最大限度集中在重点部位，但是这样的设计造成主炮存在後方死角的缺陷，且密集排列的主砲一旦下方彈藥庫失火，連鎖反應也令人擔憂。受条约规定排水量的限制，決定在一定程度上牺牲动力性能，航速较慢(比较伊丽莎白女王级战列舰)。纳尔逊级安装16英寸口径主炮，全炮塔化的双联装6英寸口径高平两用副炮。并且该舰23节的最大速度在二战中不合适伴随高速部队如航母编队等行动，同级舰：纳尔逊号（Nelson）、罗德尼号（Rodney）。
target_text: Following the First World War, the United Kingdom planned to build the N3 battleship, which was destroyed by the signing of the Washington Naval Treaty. In 1922, the United Kingdom began to build the Nelson-class battleship within the Treaty’s stipulated tonnage. Nelson-style flat decks were no longer the type of dynasty that used to be used in British battleships, but the design focused on upgrading the armored water shield for the first time, using the most heavily tilted armour belts on the side of the ship. Under the Treaty’s provisions of 35,000 tons, the Nelson-class three-loaded main cannon towers were in front of the bridge, while the engine compartments were concentrated in the unconventional layout of the ship’s rear, with the aim of concentrating the limited heavy armour protection areas to a maximum of priority positions.
title: 纳尔逊级战列舰

source_text: 1967年到1971年，布雷默先后任美国驻阿富汗和马拉维政治经济官，期间在巴黎政治学院继续深造过；1970年代，布雷默在美国国务院供职，期间1972年～1976年任亨利·基辛格的助手；1976年～1979年任美国驻奥斯陆首席代表；回国后，从1979年～1981年任美国务院任首席执行秘书，1981年成为美国国务卿亚历山大·黑格的执行秘书和特别助理；1983年被时任美国总统的罗纳德·里根任命为美国驻荷兰大使；1986年任反暴行巡回大使；
target_text: From 1967 to 1971, Bremer served successively as United States Political and Economic Officer in Afghanistan and Malawi, continuing his studies at the Paris School of Political Science; in the 1970s, Bremer served as Assistant to Henry Kissinger in the United States Department of State from 1972 to 1976; in 1976 to 1979, he served as United States Chief Representative in Oslo; in 1979 to 1981 he served as Chief Executive Secretary of the United States Department of State; in 1981, he became Executive Secretary and Special Assistant to the United States Secretary of State Alexander Hagger; in 1983, Ronald Reagan, then President of the United States, was appointed United States Ambassador to the Netherlands; in 1986, he served as United States Ambassador to Combat Atrocities;
title: 保罗·布雷默

source_text: 当东德的局势越来越显示出恶化以及柏林墙在1989年11月9日倒塌，在未与任何联盟成员和西方盟国成员提前商议的情况下，1989年11月，科尔在联邦议会上提出了关于破除目前处于分裂中的德国、欧洲的《十点计划》（Zehn-Punkte-Programm）。在1990年5月18日与东德签署了关于货币、经济和社会联盟的政府条约。针对联邦银行主席Karl Otto Pöhl的阻力，科尔通过在工资、收入、房租以及退休金领域使东德马克按照1:1的比例兑换西德马克。然后科尔同外交部长Hans-Dietrich Genscher一同合作与二战四大战胜国进行了二加四会谈（Zwei-plus-Vier-Gesprächen），最终达成了在《二加四条约》形式下实现两德统一、北约驻扎在统一后的德国。
target_text: When the situation in East Germany became increasingly worse and the Berlin Wall collapsed on 9 November 1989, and without prior consultation with any members of the Union and Western allies, in November 1989 Cole presented to the Federal Parliament a 10-point plan for the dismantling of Germany, Europe, which is currently divided (Zehn-Punkte-Program). A government treaty on monetary, economic and social union was signed with East Germany on 18 May 1990. In response to the resistance of the President of the Federal Bank, Karl Otto Pöhl, Cole was able to convert East Demmark to West Demmark on a scale of 1:1 in the areas of wages, income, rents, and pensions.
title: 赫尔穆特·科尔

source_text:
外交官生涯
1851年，俾斯麥出駐法蘭克福邦聯會議之普魯士代表，並於不久後升為大使，而這份差事他足足做了8年。 他在邦聯議會中與議長國奧地利針鋒相對，多次阻礙奧地利推動不同法案與預算。1853年克里米亞戰爭爆發，俄羅斯向鄂圖曼帝國宣戰，英法為防止俄國擴張而支持鄂圖曼對俄羅斯宣戰，而奧地利打算與英法一起參戰，但由於奧地利財政壓力很大，於是希望在議會中通過令邦聯參戰，使各小國共同負擔軍費，俾斯麥立即串聯各小國共同杯葛修改奧地利的原議案，結果議案在大幅修改下通過，未能成功把邦國拉進參戰中。結果奧地利沒有正式參戰，雖然成功爭取簽署巴黎條約，不過英法不滿奧地利沒有參戰，而俄羅斯與奧地利從此反目，神聖同盟崩潰。結果令奧地利被孤立起來。而俄國則與反對參戰的普魯士走得很近。
target_text: In 1851, Pysmey’s Prussia delegate to the French Union Conference, and shortly after he became an ambassador, worked for eight years on this task. He was in a state council in which Austria was under great pressure to fight against Austria’s president, repeatedly blocking Austria’s efforts to promote a different bill and budget. In 1853, Russia declared war on the Ottoman Empire, and England’s support for Ottoman’s war against Russia to prevent the expansion of Russia, and Austria’s intention to fight alongside the British and French was not formally to fight, but, because Austria’s political power was so high, it was hoped that the small countries would join forces in fighting the Union, that Bismarck would immediately join the small nations in modifying the original case of Austria, and that it would not be successful in bringing the country to war.
title: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦

source_text: 在1862年春，俾斯麥回到柏林，普王因為內部的壓力，並不能升他為首相。結果俾斯麥請辭，並被改派為駐法大使。同年，在普鲁士议会新一轮选举中自由派获得了绝对胜利，并马上否决了普鲁士政府的对军事改革的全部拨款，政府和议会陷入了僵局。在重大矛盾之下，俾斯麥成为首相的唯一可能人选。1862年9月23日，威廉一世召回俾斯麥，並任命其為首相兼外交大臣。
target_text: In the spring of 1862, Bismarck returned to Berlin, and the King was unable to promote him to the post of Prime Minister because of internal pressure. As a result, Bismarck asked for his resignation and was reassigned to the post of Ambassador to France. In the same year, the liberals won an absolute victory in a new Prussia parliamentary election and immediately rejected all the Prussia government’s allocations for military reform, and the government and parliament were deadlocked. In a major contradiction, Bismarck became Prime Minister’s only possible candidate. On September 23, 1862, William I recalled Bismarck and appointed him Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs.
title: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦

source_text: 根据1787年在宾州费城起草并在1788年获得各州批准的美国宪法，美国总统负责外交事务。1789年7月21日，美国众参两院批准立法，成立第一个联邦外交机构——外交部（），7月27日由华盛顿总统签字批准生效。1789年9月，美国又通过立法将该机构的名称改为国务院，讓該機構也處理聯邦各個政治實體之間的工作，并赋予其各种各样的国内事务。这些责职包括管理美国鑄幣局，掌管美国国玺，负责人口普查。后来，国务院的大多数国内事务最终转交19世纪建立起来的联邦各部和机构，但名稱保留至今。
target_text: In September 1789, the United States passed legislation to change the name of the United States agency to the Department of State, which also handles the work between the various political entities of the Union and assigns it a wide range of domestic matters. These responsibilities include managing the United States Monetary Bureau, managing the United States seal, and taking charge of the census. Subsequently, most of the Department's domestic affairs were transferred to federal departments and agencies established in the 19th century, but their names remain.
title: 美国国务院

source_text:
职能
美國國務卿是美國總統外交政策的主要顧問，負責策定美國政府的所有外交政策。美國國務院同時也對於海外所有對美的所有權益進行策略評估，並研擬美國未來外交上的行動。另外，國務院會向美國總統提出各邦交國的關係，承認新國家政府等相關事宜提出建言，在國際場合上代表美國締結邦交、簽署協議條約。美国国务院为美国其他部门的商业活动提供支持，如商务部和美国国际开发署。同时，美国国务院也为美国公民和外国人来美参观和移民提供各种重要服务。根据规定，国务院负责所有外交活动，诸如：美国国外代表，对外援助项目，打击国际犯罪以及对外军事培训项目等。
target_text: The U.S. Department of State also makes a strategic assessment of all overseas interests in the US, as well as a simulation of future US diplomacy. Moreover, the U.S. Department of State will propose to the U.S. President state-to-state relations, recognize the new state government, etc., and represent the United States at the international level in negotiating and signing agreements. The U.S. Department of State supports commercial activities in other parts of the United States, such as the Department of Commerce and the United States Agency for International Development.
title: 美国国务院

source_text: 条约型战列舰指美国、英国、日本、法国和意大利等五国1922年至1936年12月31日期间根据三个《限制海军军备条约》而设计、建造的战列舰。这三个限制海军军备条约是《华盛顿海军条约》（美国、英国、日本、法国和意大利于1922年签订）、《伦敦海军条约》（英国、美国、日本于1930年签订）和《第二次伦敦海军条约》（美国、英国、法国于1936年签订）。
target_text: Treaty-type battleships are those designed and constructed by the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, France and Italy between 1922 and 31 December 1936 under the three Naval Arms Limitation Treaties: the Washington Naval Treaty (signed by the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, France and Italy in 1922), the London Naval Treaty (signed by the United Kingdom, the United States, Japan and Japan in 1930) and the Second London Naval Treaty (signed by the United States, the United Kingdom and France in 1936).

The special feature of this era is that ships in advance have been ambivalent, so many of the ships serving in the post-war period have to be adapted to meet real needs. source_text: 到1870年，普奥战争带来的三大启示已经变得明显。首先，通过武力，一个强国能够挑战旧的联盟和1815年建立的势力范围体系；其次，通过外交手段，有能力的领袖能够创造一个环境使敌国首先宣战，迫使“受害者”一方的盟友进行帮助；最后，普鲁士的军事实力远超奥地利，因此它是邦联（或德意志诸国）中唯一能够保卫各国不受外部介入或入侵的国家。1866年，大多数中等规模的德意志国家都反对普鲁士，而到1870年这些国家都被迫使或诱使同普鲁士进入相互保护的同盟。如果一个欧洲国家对其中一国宣战，所有国家都会支援受到攻击的一国。通过对欧洲政治的巧妙操控，俾斯麦创造一个外交环境，使法国成为德意志事务中的进攻一方，而普鲁士则成为德意志权利和自由的保卫者。
target_text: First, by force, a powerful country could challenge the old alliance and the system of sphere of influence established in 1815; secondly, through diplomacy, capable leaders could create an environment in which the enemy could declare war first, forcing allies of the “victim” side to help; and finally, Prussia, far beyond Austria, was the only country in the Confederate (or the German States) to be able to defend against external intervention or invasion. In 1866, most medium-sized German states were opposed to Prussia, while by 1870 they were forced or lured into an alliance of mutual protection with Prussia.
title: 德国历史

source_text: 在此后的几周内，西班牙的提议成为欧洲的重要话题。俾斯麦鼓励利奥波德接受这一提议。倘若霍亨索伦-西格马林根王朝能够在西班牙登上王位，这便意味着在法国的两侧都是霍亨索伦王朝的德意志国王。这对于俾斯麦来说是有利的，但对拿破仑三世和他的外交大臣来说都是不可接受的。格拉蒙起草一封言辞尖锐的最后通牒给霍亨索伦王朝的家长威廉，称倘若任何霍亨索伦王朝的王侯接受西班牙王位，法国政府将会做出回应——虽然回应本身模棱两可。利奥波德宣布退出，解除这一危机，但法国驻柏林的大使并不愿作罢。他直接找到在巴特埃姆斯休假的威廉，要求他保证绝不会再让霍亨索伦王朝成员成为西班牙王位的候选人。威廉拒绝给予如此肯定的答复，此后向俾斯麦发出电报，描述法方的要求。俾斯麦利用这份电报——《埃姆斯密电》——为模板，起草一份公开的声明。他将言词修改得简略而尖锐，而在法国方面的翻译之后产生更大的变更，最后激起法方的愤怒。法国公众仍然对萨多瓦的失利耿耿于怀，要求开战。
target_text: In the weeks that followed, Spain’s proposal became an important topic for Europe. Bismarck encouraged Leopold’s parents to accept the offer. If the King of Hochensolen-Sigmaringen had accepted the Spanish throne, the French Government would have responded – although it had responded to its ambiguity. Leopold announced his withdrawal from the crisis, but the French ambassador in Berlin was unwilling to stop.
title: 德国历史

source_text: 德国是第一个与新苏联建立外交关系的国家。根据《拉帕洛条约》，德国在法律上给予苏联承认，两个签署国相互取消了所有战前债务并放弃了战争债权。在接下来的二十年里，俄罗斯和德国将共同努力，帮助在德国重建军队，并在列宁共产主义的集中计划的重压下，帮助俄罗斯建立一个工业强国。开始的几年，魏玛共和国不得不忙于处理左翼和右翼相继发动的叛乱和1923年的严重的通货膨胀。接下来，由于德国与战时敌人们的关系逐渐缓和和赔偿债务的放宽，情况有些好转。
target_text: Germany was the first country to establish diplomatic relations with the new Soviet Union. Under the Treaty of Laparo, Germany legally recognized the Soviet Union that the two signatories had cancelled all their pre-war debts and abandoned their war claims. Over the next two decades, Russia and Germany will work together to help rebuild their army in Germany and help Russia build an industrial power under the weight of Leninism’s concentrated plan.
title: 德国历史

source_text:
領土東擴
1939年3月20日，希特勒向立陶宛索要梅梅爾，22日吞并了立陶宛的梅梅爾。1939年3月21日，希特勒要求波兰归还曾属于普鲁士的但泽自由市和波兰走廊（这一地区将德国本土同东普鲁士分隔开）。英国则对波兰保证，若波兰遭攻击，他们将进行援助。希特勒认为英国事实上将不会采取军事行动，便命令部下制定入侵波兰的方案，定于1939年9月实施。5月23日他告诉部下德国的目标不只是波兰走廊，更重要的是以波兰为代价，将德国国土进行大规模东扩。德国再次强调罗马尼亚、挪威和瑞典间正式建立贸易关系。德国外长约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫前往苏联，并于1939年8月同苏方签署《苏德互不侵犯条约》（莫洛托夫—里宾特洛甫条约），还秘密划定苏德两国在波兰和波罗的海国家的势力范围。
target_text: On March 21, 1939, Hitler demanded from Poland the return of the formerly Prussia Free City of Tanze and the Polish corridor (which separates German mainland from East Prussia). The United Kingdom promised Poland that they would assist if Poland was attacked. Hitler, believing that the United Kingdom would not in fact take military action, ordered a programme of invasion of Poland by the Ministry, scheduled for September 1939. On May 23, he told his Ministry that the goal was not only a Polish corridor but, more importantly, a massive eastward expansion of German territory at the expense of Poland. Germany re-emphasized the formal establishment of trade relations between Romania, Norway and Sweden. The Foreign Minister of Germany, Joachim von Ribentrov, travelled to the Soviet Union and signed the Sood Non-Aggression Treaty with the Soviet side in August 1939.
title: 德国历史

source_text: 关于德国统一的条约达成于1990年2月13日，这个协议通过1990年2月14日的所谓“四加二协议”（英美苏法四个占领国和东西德国）得以实现。统一后的德国被认为是德意志联邦共和国的扩大延续而非继承国，因此仍然是欧共体（后来成为欧盟）和北约的成员国；此外，西德在所有国际组织中的成员资格均被其取代。根据1994年《柏林-波恩法案》，柏林成为统一之後的德国首都，而波昂则获得“联邦城市”（Bundesstadt）这一独有地位，保有一些联邦机关。政府迁移于1999年全部完成。后德国社会民主党政治家格哈特·施罗德当选首位红绿联盟德国总理，与联盟90/绿党共同组建政府。
target_text: A treaty on German reunification was concluded on 13 February 1990, through the so-called “four plus two” agreement of 14 February 1990 (the four occupying powers of the United States of America and the Soviet Union and East and West Germany). When reunification Germany was considered an extension of the Federal Republic of Germany, not a successor State, it remained a member of the European Community (later the European Union) and NATO; furthermore, the Western Germany was replaced by its membership in all international organizations. Under the Berlin-Bonn Act of 1994, Berlin became the German capital after reunification, while Boon was granted a unique status as “Bundestadt” with federal authorities.
title: 德国历史

source_text: 第二次倫敦海軍條約（Second London Naval Treaty）是1936年3月25日第二次倫敦海軍裁軍會議舉行後，由法、英與美三國政府所簽訂的軍事協約，該條約也造就了條約型戰艦這種產物。背景1922年签订的华盛顿海军条约和1930年签订的伦敦海军条约的有效期都止于1936年12月31日。华盛顿海军条约的缔约国——美国、英国、日本、法国、意大利于1935年12月9日在伦敦再次召开海军裁军会议。
target_text: The Second London Naval Treaty was signed by the Governments of France, England and the United States on 25 March 1936, following the Second London Naval Conference, which also created the product of a contractual warship. The Washington Naval Treaty, signed in 1922, and the London Naval Treaty, signed in 1930, ended on 31 December 1936. The Washington Naval Treaty states parties – the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, France, Italy – again convened a naval disarmament conference in London on 9 December 1935.
title: 第二次伦敦海军条约

source_text: 雖然裁軍會議原本是預計能在1942年新版的條約效期截止之前，能限制各國的海軍軍備數量，但1936年1月當時海軍強權之一的日本宣布退出裁军会议，導致會議結果無法再有效抑制住各國軍事船艦的數量上限。1936年3月25日，美国、英国、法国等国签署了新的《限制海军军备条约》（即第二次伦敦海军条约），条约的有效期到1942年12月31日止。而意大利则未在该条约上签字。
target_text: Although the Congress was supposed to be able to limit the naval reserves of the various countries by the end of the 1942 treaty-end date, the announcement by Japan, one of the naval powers at that time, in January 1936, of its withdrawal from the Conference on Disarmament led to a failure to effectively curb the ceiling on the number of military vessels. On 25 March 1936, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and others signed a new Naval Arms Limitation Treaty (the second London Naval Treaty), which was valid until 31 December 1942.
title: 第二次伦敦海军条约

source_text:
条约主要內容包括了下列項目：
簽約各國的主力舰（戰艦）标准排水量不得超过35,000吨，主炮口径不得超过14英寸。
航空母舰的标准排水量不得超过23,000吨，火炮口径不得超6.1英寸。
标准巡洋舰的标准排水量不得超过8,000吨，火炮口径不得超过6.1英寸，但是任何缔约国认为其国家安全受到影响时，可以建造排水量为1万吨的巡洋舰。
条约附加规定到1937年3月，假如日本与意大利不加入，主力舰的限定自动放宽到标准排水量45,000吨，主炮口径不得超过16英寸。
target_text: The main elements of the treaty include the following: The standard discharge volume of the main naval vessels (ships) of the signatory countries should not exceed 35,000 tons and the main artillery calibre should not exceed 14 inches; the standard discharge volume of the aircraft carriers should not exceed 23,000 tons and the artillery calibre not exceed 6.1 inches; the standard cruiser should not exceed 8,000 tons and the artillery calibre not exceed 6.1 inches; but any State party may, in the event that its national security is affected, build a cruiser with a discharge capacity of 10,000 tons.
title: 第二次伦敦海军条约

source_text: 英德海军协定是英國和德国于1935年6月18日就两国海军军备力量所簽訂的条约。条约主要规定：德国海军舰艇总吨位不超过华盛顿海军条约和伦敦海军条约所规定的大英帝國国家海军舰艇总吨位的35%。在潜艇方面，德国保证，保有的潜艇吨位不超过大英帝國国家海军潜艇总吨位的45%。
target_text: The British-German Naval Agreement was signed by the United Kingdom and Germany on 18 June 1935 in relation to their naval forces. The Treaty provides, inter alia, that the gross tonnage of German naval vessels does not exceed 35% of the gross tonnage of British and British naval vessels under the Washington and London naval treaties.
title: 英德海军协定

source_text: 北扶餘、東扶餘時期，王位以世襲方式傳承，王以下有掌管四-{出}-道的馬加、牛加、豬加、狗加（等同於部落首領）。王和四-{出}-道諸加同樣有大使，大使者、使者（外使者，宮殿使者）等臣僚，而在諸加之下的階級依次為豪民（氏族首領）、下戶（百姓）、奴婢。實施嫡長子繼承制，如長子不肖，由諸加（有參政、議政，決定國家大事的權力）共推嫡次子與庶子為王。有誤時，諸加自戰，下戶（主要由濊人組成）擔糧供應，挹婁也是他們下戶，扶餘分別對他們邑落加以統屬，並向族長收貢品，至三世紀不能再忍受扶餘人苛征（黃初中叛之），扶餘數伐之，而卒不能服。

source_text: 1912年到1949年，国际社会唯一承认的中国政府是中华民国政府。1945年第二次世界大战结束时，中华民国是联合国的创始国之一。1949年内战后，中华民国政府撤退到台湾，中國共產黨在大陸建立了中华人民共和国。1945年年到1971年，国际社会普遍承认中國國民黨執政的中华民国政府为中国的合法政府。1971年10月25日，联合国大会通过了第2758号决议，由中华人民共和国政府取代中华民国政府在联合国的席位，中华人民共和国自此成为中国在联合国的唯一代表。
target_text: From 1912 to 1949, the only Government of China recognized by the international community was the Government of the Republic of China. At the end of the Second World War in 1945, the Republic of China was one of the founding Members of the United Nations. After the war of 1949, the Government of the Republic of China withdrew to Taiwan, and the Chinese Communist Party established the People’s Republic of China on the mainland.

source_text: 新加坡於1965年加入联合国和英联邦、1967年加入东南亚国家联盟（该联盟5个发起国之一）、1989年加入亚太经合组织。新加坡在2001年－2002年担任过联合国安理会非常任理事国，并派兵参与联合国在科威特、安哥拉、柬埔寨和东帝汶等地的维和任务，2004年新加坡还派出了一支120人的医疗救援队伍参加美伊战争之后伊拉克的管制工作。
target_text: Singapore joined the United Nations and the Commonwealth in 1965, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in 1967 (one of its five sponsors) and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) in 1989. Singapore served as a non-permanent member of the United Nations Security Council from 2001 to 2002 and contributed troops to United Nations peacekeeping missions in Kuwait, Angola, Cambodia and Timor-Leste, among others, and in 2004 sent a 120-man medical rescue team to Iraq in the aftermath of the US-Iraq war.
title: 新加坡外交

source_text: 作為新加坡最近的鄰國，新加坡與馬來西亞有非常緊密的歷史和外交關係，新加坡曾是馬來西亞的一部分，但在1965年，由於政治上的分歧和種族關係之間的緊張（馬來人和華人）而導致分離，儘管如此兩國之間仍保持著高度緊密的關係，經濟和社會相互依存，新加坡的新鮮肉類，乾淨水以及蔬菜都由馬來西亞進口，許多馬來西亞人民也會到新加坡去上班工作，一些馬來西亞人在新加坡更有永久居住權，同時也有不少人是往來於柔佛州和新加坡之間，在這四十年之間，雙方關係經歷了四十年的高低起伏，現在依舊可以感受到兩邊的緊張，然而雙邊合作越來越緊密，譬如马六甲海峽的互相巡防（參照五國聯防）等等，同時兩國也經常進行聯合軍事演習。
target_text: As Singapore's closest neighbour, Singapore had a very tight history and diplomatic relationship with Malaysia, which had been part of Malaysia, but in 1965 it had been separated by political differences and tensions between races (Mauritians and Chinese), despite which the two countries had maintained a very tight relationship, economic and social interdependence, Singapore's fresh meat, clean water and vegetables had been imported from Malaysia, many Malaysians were going to work in Singapore, some Malaysians had more permanent residence rights in Singapore, and many of them had been living in the same period between the states of Johor and Singapore for 40 years, and the two sides had experienced four decades of high and low relations, and were now feeling tension between the two sides, but the two sides were increasingly cooperating, as in the case of the Malacca Coasts (the five-nation coalition) and so on, and the two countries had often worked together on military matters.
title: 新加坡外交

source_text: 外交上，與邻国马来西亚常在水源、領土、種族、宗教、教育有爭執：例如马来西亚向新加坡供水的价格问题、白礁主权争议（2008年5月23日经国际法院裁决，白礁主权属于新加坡）、新加坡填海工程和新马长堤大桥修建、2002年新加坡的一所政府学校决定开除一名坚持戴头巾上学的穆斯林女学生后，许多马来西亚人马来人就曾到新加坡驻马来西亚高级专员公署前示威抗议。
target_text: Diplomaticly, there have been regular disputes with neighbouring Malaysia over water sources, land, races, religions, and education: for example, the price of Malaysian water supplies to Singapore, the sovereignty dispute over Pedra Branca Batu Puteh (which was ruled by the International Court of Justice on 23 May 2008 that sovereignty over White Cay belongs to Singapore), the construction of the Singapore Sea Reclamation Project and the New Maroon Bridge, and the decision of a government school in Singapore in 2002 to dismiss a Muslim female student who insists on wearing a headscarve to attend school, many Malaysians protested in front of the Singapore High Commissioner ' s Office in Malaysia.
title: 新加坡外交

source_text:
马来西亚与印尼华人边缘论
2006年9月15日，李光耀在公共政策学院主办的莱佛士论坛上，发表「马来西亚和印尼政府有系统边缘化华人」相关言论，引起与邻国马来西亚与印尼的外交风波。李光耀在论坛上提到新加坡同印尼和马来西亚的关系时，指印尼前总统优素福·哈比比曾形容新加坡像绿色海洋所包围的「小红点」，而小红点就是迫使新加坡，像印尼国内的华人一样，对他言听计从。接着形容马来西亚华人被有系统地边缘化，激起马印两国政府强烈反响。马来西亚和印尼两国的政治人物纷纷对此表示不满，并要求新加坡对李光耀的言论作出解释和道歉。马来西亚前首相马哈迪·莫哈末批评李光耀傲慢及不尊重邻国，并反击说马来西亚也可以质疑新加坡把当地马来人边缘化。印尼前总统哈比比指形容「小红点」是激励印尼青年向新加坡学习，但原意被歪曲了。
target_text: When Li spoke about Singapore’s relationship with Indonesia and Malaysia, he said that former Indonesian President Yusuf Habibie had described Singapore as a “small red dot” surrounded by green seas, and that little red dots had forced Singapore, like the Chinese in Indonesia, to listen to him. title: 新加坡外交

source_text: 新加坡在印尼雅加达设有大使馆，以及在棉兰设有总领事馆。兩國關係往年因為印度尼西亞在東南亞的霸權主義而緊張，然在2005年，新加坡與印尼簽暑一項諒解備忘錄，兩國之間互相開放更多的航權，新加坡總理李顯龍在2005年印尼巴里島會見了印尼總理蘇西諾，並於2005年巴厘島爆炸案僅止兩天後，雙方就同意加強打擊恐怖主義，並討論了經濟、貿易和投資的合作，總體上印尼和新加坡關係是往好的一面展開，然而目前也有些問題如印尼禁止出口花崗岩和砂至新加坡，而這兩項材料是新加坡建築業所需要的。
target_text: Singapore has an embassy in Jakarta, Indonesia, and a Consulate General in Mindanao. Relations between the two countries have been tense in previous years because of India’s hegemony in south-east Asia. In 2005, Singapore and Indonesia signed a summer memo, the two countries opened up more space for each other, Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsienlong met with Indonesian Prime Minister Susino in Bali in 2005, and only two days after the 2005 Bali bombing, both sides agreed to fight terror and discussed economic, trade and investment cooperation. While Indonesia-Singapore relations are on the bright side, there are some issues such as Indonesia’s ban on exporting flower rock and sand to Singapore, which are needed for Singapore’s construction.

source_text:
历史
1880年代末，欧美已有16个国家先后建立社会主义政党，开展合法斗争。德国社会民主党和法国工人党“盖得派”在1887年倡议召开国际社会主义者代表大会。同时，法国工人党“可能派”联合英国、美国的同志先于决定1889年7月在巴黎召开由他们发起的国际工人代表大会。为了击败法国可能派夺取新国际组织领导权的企图，恩格斯做了大量工作，促使德、法等国社会主义政党的代表于1889年7月也在巴黎召开国际工人和社会主义者代表大会，同时纪念法国大革命一百周年。这样，在1889年7月14日，两个国际代表大会同时在巴黎开幕。恩格斯支持的大会有22个国家的393名代表参加，威廉·李卜克内西、爱德华·瓦扬、奥古斯特·倍倍尔、保尔·拉法格等27人组成大会主席团，李卜克内西和瓦扬为大会主席。可能派召开的大会有10国代表参加，其中法国人占代表总数的84％，缺乏国际性，未能建立起国际组织。从1891年布鲁塞尔代表大会起，原来出席可能派大会的组织也改为参加第二国际。
target_text: At the same time, on 14 July 1889, two international congresses were opened in Paris, with the participation of 393 participants from 22 countries, including William Libkence, Edward Wayan, August Bebeer, Paul Rafag, 27 members of the Bureau of the Congress, with the participation of Libknesi and Wayan as the second possible international representative from 189.
title: 第二国际

2012年習近平出任中共中央總書記後，提出「中華民族偉大復興的中國夢」和一帶一路構想，中國外交逐漸放棄了自邓小平以来的「韜光養晦」的政策，轉而提倡「大國外交」、「大有作為」，他更指示中國外交官對外發動「戰狼外交」。提出背景
这个词汇最初由中共中央党校的副校长郑必坚在2003年的博鳌亚洲论坛上提出。后来有中国国务院总理温家宝在亚细安会议以及访美期间反复重申。这已经成为第一个由胡锦涛和温家宝领导的第四代领导人的外交政策。
target_text: Following his appointment as Central Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party in 2012, China's diplomacy has moved away from its policy of "blindness" since Deng Xiaoping, and instead has promoted "greater diplomacy" and "manifest efforts" to instruct Chinese diplomats to engage in "wolve diplomacy" abroad. This term was originally proposed by the Vice-Chancellor of the Chinese Communist Party, Chung Bung, at the 2003 Boang Asia Forum.

source_text: 中华人民共和国則主張，中國自公元前60年开始即对该地区拥有不间断的主权，包括维吾尔文化在内的当地民族文化都是中华民族文化的一部分；该地区包括维吾尔族、哈薩克族在内的各民族均被平等对待，且少数民族人士更受到优待；当地的少数民族文化得到了保护和发扬，目前確認的疆獨多是与「暴力恐怖势力」、「民族分裂势力」与「极端宗教势力」等「三股势力」为伍的恐怖分子，海外疆獨則以意圖與西方礦業巨頭與伊斯蘭宗教勢力勾結，從此獲取個人利益的成員為主，因此必須嚴厲的對分裂行為進行制裁。
target_text: The People's Republic of China, for its part, maintains that China has continued its sovereignty over the region since 60 B.C., and that the local national culture, including Uighur culture, is part of the Chinese national culture; that all ethnic groups in the region, including the Uighurs and the Kazakhs, are treated equally and that ethnic minorities are more favoured; that the culture of the local minorities is protected and promoted, and that the vast majority of the territories currently identified are terrorists with “three forces” such as the forces of violence and terror, the “ethnic separatists” and the “extreme religious forces”, and that the overseas territories are intended to associate themselves with the powerful Western miners and the Islamist religion, and that individual interests derived therefrom must be severely sanctioned.

source_text: 2002年，美国將东伊运加入恐怖组织名單。根据美13224号行政令将‘东伊运’列为恐怖组织并支持将该组织列入联合国1267委员会综合制裁清单，13224号行政命令（Executive Order 13224），是美国总统布什在9·11恐怖主义袭击之后，于2001年9月23日颁布的行政命令。颁布13224号行政命令是美国政府认定恐怖组织和恐怖主义个人的方式之一。另一方式是美国国务院制定的外国恐怖主义组织（Foreign Terrorist Organizations, FTO）名单。中国所称的“东伊运”不在后者的名单上。
target_text: Executive Order 13224, issued on 23 September 2001 by President Bush of the United States in the wake of the terrorist attacks of 11 September. Executive Order 13224 was issued as one of the ways in which the United States Government identifies terrorist organizations and individuals as terrorists. The other way is through the list of foreign terrorist organizations established by the United States Department of State.
title: 东突厥斯坦独立运动

source_text: 2008年1月21日，中華民國空軍C-130運輸機首度降落太平島，並在島上設置「勤務派遣隊」，負責機場跑道的維護。2月2日，時任中華民國總統陳水扁搭乘的C-130運輸機於臺北時間上午「10時32分」降落登島，除慰問中華民國官兵，並主持機場跑道啟用典禮，成為中華民國首位抵達太平島的國家元首。不久，菲律賓方面由外交部長羅慕洛發表書面聲明稱，菲國對於這項發展（陳總統登島）表示「嚴正關切，並對此事感到遺憾與不幸」。菲國亦旋即向中華民國提出「抗議」。稍後，扁政府外交部發表聲明再度重申「南沙群島為中華民國之固有疆域，中華民國對太平島擁有唯一合法主權」；同時也表示將與鄰近各國持續溝通。同年9月1日，中華民國軍方決定自2009年起編列預算，對「太平島機場跑道延長工程」進行環境影響評估，預計2013年正式施工延長跑道。對於跑道必須施工延長的理由，中華民國國防部發言人表示，原有的跑道安全有顧慮，在天候不良下，C-130飛機在最大性能之下，只能實施短場起降，可能會滑出跑道，所以必須延長跑道長度。10月22日，中華民國國防部以「不符經濟效益」為由，放棄太平島機場跑道延長工程計畫。10月24日，為了加強維護「南海海域經濟主權」，中華民國經濟部秘密成立了南海小組，首次召開會議。
target_text: On 21 January 2008, the Chinese Air Force C-130 first landed on the island and set up a "duty dispatcher" to maintain the runway. On 2 February, the C-130 transporter, the then President of the Chinese People's Republic Chen Shui-bing, landed on the island of Taipei at 10.32 a.m. on the morning of the morning, in order to comfort the Chinese army and host the airport opening ceremony, and became the first head of state to arrive in the island. Shortly after, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs published a written statement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Romulo, stating that the country was using the development (the former President was on the island) as a means of maintaining the runway, and that it was the only reason for the development (the former President was on the island) to have a serious and unfortunate impact on the island.
title: 太平島

source_text: 媒體在島上親嘗南沙群島間唯一自然湧出的珍貴淡水，大啖海岸巡防署官兵以島上種植的蔬菜、畜養禽類與海產烹調的特產飯盒，見證太平島屬於自然島嶼，絕非漲潮即沒的礁岩。7月12日，荷蘭海牙常設仲裁法院在「南海仲裁案」的判決中裁定南沙群島的所有海上地物，包括太平島，均為礁岩，而不是擁有專屬經濟海域的島嶼。中華民國總統府隨後發表聲明，表示絕不接受，也主張此仲裁判斷對中華民國不具法律拘束力。7月14日，有香港记者向美國國務院發言人唐纳展示一份美國政府早前出版的地圖，该地圖標明太平島是島嶼而不是礁岩，並追问美國政府的立場，唐纳表示目前美國政府無意挑戰常设仲裁法院的裁决。7月19日，偉星艦在太平島附近海域護漁時發現一艘越南籍漁船越界捕魚，隨即交由南沙小艇驅離。7月25日，三艘屏東漁船以緊急避難申請停靠太平島碼頭獲准，並補給淡水及物資。8月16日，中華民國內政部長葉俊榮率高雄市副市長陳金德等人登島，為南沙醫院掛設「南沙2號」門牌。中華民國在太平島興建新的軍事工程，因為Google Earth更新衛星照片圖檔資料，而可以被放大檢視。此消息經國際媒體報導後，越南外交部在9月22日所舉行的每月例行記者會上，外交部發言人黎海平（Le Hai Binh）對此宣稱，台灣的作為已嚴重侵犯越方的主權。

source_text: 2002年5月塔吉克总统访问中国，同意把靠近帕米尔地区存在争议的28,000平方公里土地中的3.5%共大约1158平方公里的领土交给中国，从而结束了边界争议。 根据边界条约的十三个界点约定，中方丧失了大部分的争议领土（目前为塔吉克斯坦的山地巴达赫尚自治州大部分面积）。塔吉克国外交部部長札里非（Khamrokon Zarifi）認為，這是塔吉克斯坦的一大勝利，因為中國原本聲稱擁有的領土範圍，多達2萬8千平方公里。
target_text: President Tajiks visited China in May 2002 and agreed to hand over to China some 1,158 square kilometres of the approximately 28,000 square kilometers of disputed land near Pamir, thereby putting an end to the border dispute. According to the 13 boundary points agreed in the border treaty, China lost most of the disputed territory (currently a large part of the territory of Tajikistan’s Mt. Badakhshan Autonomous Region).
title: 帕米爾高原

source_text: 越南共和國總統拥有行政权。总统由公民选出，任期4年。总统是国家元首及共和國軍隊最高統帥，兼国家安全会议主席。总统拥有颁行法律、核定国家政策、任命总理及内阁成员、任命大使及地方行政首長、主持内阁会议、签署国际协定协议和执行戒严宵禁的权力。1974年，总统任期由4年延长至5年，且最多连任两次。副總統是总统的第一继任人，当在任的总统出缺（于任内死亡、辞职或者遭到弹劾）时，副总统将继任。同时，副总统也兼任文化教育部长、社会与经济会议主席以及少数民族会议主席。總理是国家的政府首脑，负责领导政府。总理由总统指派，负责执行国家政策。政府包括19个部，每个部门有一名部长。这19个部门包括外交部、國防部、內務部、通信部、、財政部、經濟部、司法部、农村发展部、土地改革及农渔业发展部、工程部、交通与邮电部、教育部、医疗救济部、社会部、劳动部、退伍軍人事務部、少数民族发展部及国会联络部。其中“招撫部”主要负责开展针对共产党的宣传攻势。此外，政府还包括3名国务卿，分别为文化国务卿、重建发展国务卿和国务卿办公室（文房）。
target_text: The President of the Republic of Viet Nam has executive power. The President is elected by citizens for a four-year term. The President is the Head of State and the Supreme Commander of the Republican Army and President of the National Security Council. The President has the power to enact laws, approve State policies, appoint the Prime Minister and members of the Cabinet, appoint ambassadors and heads of local administrations, preside over Cabinet meetings, sign international agreements, and enforce curfews. In 1974, the President was extended from four to five years, with a maximum of two consecutive terms. The Vice-President is the President's first successor, and the Vice-President will succeed in the event of the incumbent's vacancy (death, resignation or impeachment within the Presidency), while the Vice-President is also the Minister of Culture and Education, the President of the Social and Economic Conference and the President of the National Minorities Conference. The Prime Minister is the head of the State and is responsible for the implementation of the national policy. The Prime Minister is appointed by the President and comprises 19 ministries, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defence, the Ministry of the Interior, the Ministry of Communications, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Agriculture and
title: 越南共和国

source_text: 越南共和国共得到包括美国在内的87个国家的外交承认，由于美苏冷战的原因，包括北越、中华人民共和国、苏联在内的共产主义国家不承认越南共和国。越南共和国曾是、亚洲开发银行、世界银行、国际开发协会、国际金融公司（IFC）、国际货币基金组织、国际通信卫星组织、国际刑警组织、国际奥林匹克委员会、国际电信联盟、国际红十字运动、联合国教科文组织和万国邮政联盟等国际组织的成员国之一。1957年，美国提名南越加入联合国，联合国大会的表决结果为40票支持、8票反对。但交由联合国安理会决策时遭苏联否决，因此南越未能加入联合国。
target_text: In total, the Republic of Viet Nam has received diplomatic recognition from 87 countries, including the United States, and, as a result of the Soviet Union ' s Cold War, the communist countries, including North Vietnam, the People ' s Republic of China, and the Soviet Union, did not recognize the Republic of Viet Nam. The Republic of Viet Nam was one of the States members of international organizations such as the Asian Development Bank, the World Bank, the International Development Association, the International Finance Corporation (IFC), the International Monetary Fund, the International Telecommunications Satellite Organization, INTERPOL, the International Olympic Committee, the International Telecommunication Union, the International Red Cross Movement, UNESCO and the Universal Postal Union. In 1957, the United States nominated the South Viet Nam for membership in the United Nations, with a vote of 40 votes against.
title: 越南共和国

source_text: 中華民國與南越擁有共同的反共立場，因此在南越第一任總統吳廷琰的帶領下，中華民國與南越的關係，相較於中華民國與其他東南亞國家的關係相當親近。1955年10月26日，中華民國承認越南共和國；12月17日，雙方建立公使級外交關係、互換使節。原中华民国驻西贡总领事馆改为公使馆，原总领事蒋恩铠任公使馆代办。1956年，公使袁子健到任。1957年，雙方將公使館升格為大使館。中華民國駐南越大使館設於駐越美軍司令部附近的巴斯德街47號，後移至徵女王街175號；南越駐華大使館位於寧波西街。1960年1月10日，吳廷琰抵台訪問，與總統蔣中正會晤；1963年3月4日至3月9日，副總統陳誠訪問越南共和国，與總統吳廷琰及副總統阮玉書會晤。1969年6月阮文紹首度抵台訪問並與蔣中正會晤。1971年阮文紹當選連任總統後，時任副總統的嚴家淦曾前往西貢參加其就職典禮。1973年4月阮文紹再次訪問中華民國。
target_text: On October 26, 1955, China recognized Viet Nam’s Republic of Viet Nam; on December 17, the two sides established a diplomatic relations and exchange of ambassadors at the ministerial level. The former Consulate-General of the Republic of China in Saigon became the Embassy of the former Consul-General of the Republic of China in Saigon, and the former Consul-in-Office of the Governor-in-Office of the Governor-General. In 1956, the Minister-in-Office of the Chinese People’s Republic came to power. In 1957, the Embassy of the Chinese People’s Republic was elevated to the post of Ambassador.
title: 越南共和国

source_text: 1975年4月21日，阮文紹辭去總統後，流亡的第一站就是台灣。在當時，有相當數量的南越留學生在中華民國留學。而中華民國政府雖未直接派軍參與越南戰爭，但仍有在經濟與政治上给予南越相當程度的支持。因此中華民國駐西貢大使館亦曾遭到偽裝成華僑的越南南方民族解放陣線游擊隊攻擊。1964年至1972年中華民國駐南越大使由蔣中正之親信胡璉擔當，而南越駐中華民國大使則是由吳廷琰的弟弟擔綱。雙方首都臺北與西貢締結為姊妹市。不過，1975年4月中旬，隨著西貢市郊要塞陸續落入越共之手，中華民國駐南越大使館人員展開撤離工作，28日大使離開西貢，正式關閉。30日南越駐中華民國大使館宣布關閉。
target_text: While the Chinese government did not send its troops directly into the Vietnam war, it still provided considerable economic and political support to the south. As a result, the Embassy of the Chinese People’s Republic of China was attacked by a guerrilla group disguised as the Vietnam National Liberation Front for the South. From 1964 to 1972, the Ambassador of the Chinese People’s Republic for the South of China was replaced by a brother of the Chinese People’s Republic of China.
title: 越南共和国

source_text:
其他国家
南越在东南亚的直接或间接盟友包括泰国和菲律宾。南越同柬埔寨王国的关系不佳，柬埔寨的诺罗敦·西哈努克政权不承认吴廷琰政权的合法性。1956年2月2日，吴廷琰宣布关闭越柬边境、中止贸易往来。1970年，柬埔寨的朗诺将军发动政变夺权，建立高棉共和国。朗诺政权于1970年5月5日同南越恢复外交关系。此外，南越亦与印尼、缅甸等国维持着领事级别的外交关系，但在1964年，南越宣布与印度尼西亚断交，因印尼不承认西贡政权的合法性。
target_text: Other countries, including Thailand and the Philippines, have direct or indirect allies in South-East Asia. South Vietnam’s relations with the Kingdom of Cambodia are poor, and Cambodia’s Norodom Sihanouk regime does not recognize the legitimacy of the U Tinyung regime. On February 2, 1956, U Tingi announced the closure of the border with Cambodia and the suspension of trade.
title: 越南共和国

source_text: 根据南越当年的人口普查，1968年南越共有人口16,259,334人，农村人口占71%，城市人口占29%，人口自然增长率为2.2%。南越的最大城市是西贡，有1,736,880人，若将郊县人口计算在内则有约2,500,000人。根据1970年的统计，南越民族组成中，京族占90%，余下的10%由华族、高地族、高棉族、占族、法国人及亚欧混血儿等组成。越南语是南越的官方语言，也是国内最主要的语言。由于殖民历史因素，法语在南越的行政、教育（中学及高校尤甚）、贸易和外交领域仍具有重要地位，且形同精英统治阶层的主要语言。而由于美国对南越的强大影响力，英语逐渐成为军事领域主要使用的语言，以及外交领域的第二语言。南越国内存在的其他语言有汉语、高棉语和高地民族语言等。
target_text: According to the census of the year, in 1968 the population of the south was 16,259,334 people, with 71% of the rural population, and 29% of the urban population, with a natural population growth rate of 2.2%. The largest city in the south is Saigon, with 1,736,880 people, or about 2,500,000 if the suburban population is counted. According to the 1970 census, 90% of the ethnic composition of the south Vietnamese population, with the remaining 10% made up of the Chinese, the Highlands, the Khmers, the Mandarin, the French and the Afro-Asian mixed.

source_text:
聯合國相关決議关于西藏的主权争议，联合国大会于1959年，1961年，和1965年通过三项决议，分别为联合国大会决议第1353号（1959年）；
联合国大会决议第1723号（1961年）；
联合国大会决议第2079号（1965年）决议呼吁尊重藏族人民的基本人权、民族自決权、宗教、文化自由。藏印關係
在英屬印度時期，英國的政策是支持西藏自治，作為印度的緩衝區。
target_text: In 1959, 1961, and 1965, the United Nations General Assembly adopted three resolutions on the sovereignty dispute over Tibet, namely, United Nations General Assembly resolution 1353 (1959); United Nations General Assembly resolution 1723 (1961); United Nations General Assembly resolution 2079 (1965), which called for respect for the fundamental human rights of the Tibetan people, their right to self-determination, their religion, and their cultural freedoms. In British India, British policy was to support Tibetan autonomy as a buffer zone for India.
title: 西藏问题

source_text: 1948年初，西藏时任财政部长的夏格巴·旺秋德丹率领一支商务代表团访问美国。此行目的有三：其一，试图与美国高层领导人建立直接联系，以求在美国政府的帮助下实现“西藏独立”；其二，从美国获得金融通货；其三，在美国秘密采购武器，以准备独立时用。中華民国政府7月12日向美国驻华使馆提出书面声明和质询。在中華民国外交的压力下，美国国务院远东司中国科电告中華民国大使馆：“美国坚持承认中華民国在西藏的宗主权的一贯立场，美国政府无意变更其对西藏立场之意”。
target_text: In early 1948, the then Minister of Finance of Tibet, Shaqpa Wangqiuddan, led a business mission to the United States. The purpose of the mission was threefold: first, to try to establish direct contacts with high-ranking United States leaders with a view to achieving “the independence of Tibet” with the help of the United States Government; second, to obtain financial access from the United States; and third, to procure weapons clandestinely in the United States in preparation for independence. On July 12, the Chinese Government submitted a written statement and a query to the United States Embassy in China. Under pressure from the Chinese Foreign Office of China, China, the United States Department of State, in its Far East Department, called the Chinese Embassy of China: “The United States insists on recognizing the consistent position of the Chinese People's Republic of China on the sovereignty of Tibet, and the United States Government has no intention of changing its position on Tibet.”
title: 西藏问题

source_text:
1948年底，美国国务院派一位资深的外交家，苏联、东欧问题专家洛伊·亨德森（Loy Henderson）就任美国驻印度大使。1949年初，亨德森向国务院建议：鉴于国民党政權“有可能失去中国”，美国应该重新修订美国西藏政策，承认“西藏独立”。但经过讨论，国务院最终采纳远东司官员路丝·培根（Ruth Bacan）的观点。她认为：其一，美国对西藏的政策不仅涉及美藏关系，而且还涉及美国与中華民國政府的关系问题；其二，由于西藏地理位置偏僻，政府和社会极端落后，使西藏发挥作用十分困难；其三，只有在美国采取大量的经济和军事援助的情况下，西藏才能发挥作用，而美国采取这些援助只能取道邻国印度，如果印度不与美国合作，那么美国对西藏援助物资的运送和与西藏关系的发展会十分艰难。由此，她认为，美国对西藏政策的最佳选择是：
目前美国仅可以把西藏作为朋友相待；
要避免卷入中国对西藏问题复杂的“宗主权”的争论之中，同时等待中国形势的发展明了再作选择；
一定要避免共产党接管西藏；
要考虑西藏独立、从中国分离是否有一个可行的、合法的、永久的根据。
target_text: At the end of 1948, the United States Department of State sent a senior diplomat, the Soviet Union and Eastern European expert, Roy Henderson, as its ambassador to India. At the beginning of 1949, Henderson suggested to the State Department that, given the “risk of losing China” to the National Party, the United States should revise its Tibet policy to recognize “the independence of Tibet.” After discussion, however, the State Department eventually adopted the view of Ruth Bacan, an official of the Far East Division. First, the United States policy on Tibet related not only to American relations, but also to the relationship between the United States and the Chinese people’s government; secondly, that the United States’s best option for Tibet policy was to treat Tibet only as a friend because of its remote geographical location; thirdly, Tibet could play its role only if it was involved in China’s complex economic and military assistance, and if India did not cooperate with the United States, the United States would be very difficult to deliver Tibet aid and develop its relationship with Tibet.
title: 西藏问题

source_text: 1950年11月1日，美国国务卿迪安·艾奇遜在一次新闻发布会上宣称美国将会认真看待共产党向西藏发动进攻的任何一种新证据 。11月15日，拉美萨尔瓦多代表团团长赫克托·戴维·卡斯特罗（Hector David Castro）在联合国大会上提出讨论西藏问题，但印度和英国两个由于历史或地理等原因最有发言权的国家，不愿触怒中華人民共和國（印度不愿意因西藏而捲入“保卫西藏”的战争；英国更关心其在香港的利益受損），最后，印度强调西藏问题仍“存在和平解决的机会，联合国还可以对此做工作”。11月24日，联大总务委员会决定无限期延缓讨论这一问题。
target_text: On November 15, the head of the delegation of Latin American El Salvador, Hector David Castro, raised the issue of Tibet at the United Nations General Assembly, but India and the United Kingdom, which were the two most influential countries for historical or geographical reasons, did not want to provoke the Chinese People’s Republic (India would not like to be drawn into the war to defend Tibet; Britain was more concerned about its interests in Hong Kong), and finally, India stressed that the issue of Tibet “has a chance for a peaceful solution, and the United Nations can work on it.” On November 24, the General Committee of the General Assembly decided to postpone the discussion indefinitely.
title: 西藏问题

source_text: 2022年12月，美国财政部以吴英杰和张洪波对西藏囚犯实施酷刑，法外处决囚犯并强迫绝育為由凍結他們在美国的资产。為報復美國制裁，中方宣佈对美国国务卿办公室前中国政策首席顾问余茂春和美國國會及行政當局中國委員會副主任陶德斯坦恩（Todd Stein）实施制裁。
target_text: In December 2022, the U.S. Treasury Department tortured Tibetan prisoners, extrajudicially executed prisoners, and forced sterilization as their assets in the US. In retaliation for US sanctions, China announced sanctions against the former chief adviser of Chinese policy in the US Secretary of State’s office, Yu Mao Chun, and the Deputy Director of the China Committee of the US Congress and Administration, Todd Stein.
title: 西藏问题

source_text: 西藏的立场是要求承认和保证其完全完整的独立地位；中华民国中央政府则坚持西藏是中华民国领土不可分割的一部分，要求拥有西藏的外交和国防权利，以及一定程度的地方行政权利；英国则以划分外藏和内藏的方案进行调和，并据此提出了一个协议，內藏（青海，甘南，川西，滇北）主权归中国，外藏（除安多和康省的藏区，基本等同于今天的西藏自治区）建立西藏国，内政自治，外交归中国，中国享有其宗主权，但不拥有主权。西藏与英国签署了西姆拉条约，但中华民国政府最终拒绝在协议上签字，并拒绝承认英藏双方签订的任何条约和协议，即所谓的“麦克马洪线”将部分西藏领土划归印度。是年达赖喇嘛在西藏发行货币和邮票。1929年（中華民國十八年）在多年未有正式接触之后，蒋介石向达赖喇嘛致信，敦促其按照五族共和的理念，让西藏尽快加入中华民国。中华民国外交部发表声明宣称蒙藏皆为中华民国不可分割的一部分。1933年（中華民國二十二年）12月17日，十三世達賴喇嘛土登嘉措在拉薩圓寂。1938年（中華民國二十七年）9月24日，中华民国蒙藏委員會頒佈《喇嘛轉世辦法》，共13條。重申金瓶掣籤制度。
target_text: The position of Tibet is to demand recognition and guarantee its full and independent status; the central Government of the Republic of China insists that Tibet is an integral part of the territory of the Republic of China, demanding diplomatic and defence rights in Tibet, as well as a degree of local administrative rights; and the United Kingdom, which has signed the Simla Treaty with the United Kingdom, has finally refused to sign it and has refused to recognize any treaty and agreement between the British and British sides, the so-called “McMahun Line”, which has transferred part of Tibet to India. The Tibetan State was established by Dalai Lama (which is essentially equivalent to the Tibetan Autonomous Region of today’s Provinces), with internal affairs self-government, with diplomacy to China, with which China enjoys no sovereignty.
title: 西藏问题

source_text: 同日，噶厦政府向联合国秘书长呈交报告：“西藏人民已清楚无力阻擋中共軍隊的前進，西藏人已應允與共產黨政府進行和談。虽然长久热爱和平的西藏人民欲要战勝熟练於战争的共產黨軍隊的希望并不大，但我們相信在世界的任何地方，只要發生侵略行为，联合国是必定会帮助予以抗击的。”10月17日，面對中國人民解放軍的軍事力量，在西藏眾多僧侶的要求下，丹增嘉措提前正式繼位親政，處理政教事務。隨后达赖喇嘛丹增嘉措被迫離開拉薩，暫居西藏南部的錯模避难。1951年4月，在打败西藏东部和北部的少数藏军，解放军约几万人向西藏中部地区推进。西藏噶厦政府代表团不得不前往北京进行和谈。以阿沛·阿旺晋美为首的五人代表团前往北京。
target_text: On the same day, the King's Government reported to the Secretary-General of the United Nations: “On October 17, in the face of the military forces of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, at the request of many monks and monks in Tibet, the Tibetan people agreed to negotiate with the Communist Party government. While the long-held peace-loving Tibetan people had little hope of winning over the war-proficient Communist Army, we believed that the United Nations would help to combat any act of aggression anywhere in the world.” In April 1951, in the face of the military forces of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, the Tibetan government had to go to Beijing to discuss the situation.
title: 西藏问题

source_text: 《马关条约》（ ），又称《下关条约》（、）、《中日马关条约》、《清日講和條約》（）或《中日講和條約》，为大清帝國與大日本帝国於1895年4月17日（大清光绪二十一年三月二十三日；大日本帝國明治二十八年四月十七日），分別由大清帝國派出之欽差頭等全權大臣李鸿章和欽差全權大臣李经方，及大日本帝國內閣總理大臣伊藤博文和外務大臣陆奥宗光等，在山口縣赤間關馬關港（今稱下關港）签署之条约。

source_text: 1894年11月26日，即大山巖大将指挥的日本第二军在辽东半岛九连城登陆后不久，李鸿章即派遣天津海关税务司德璀琳前往神户，试图与日本内阁总理大臣伊藤博文会面并召开和谈，但是遭到拒绝。次年1月31日，清朝的两名全权大使，总理衙门大臣张荫桓和湖南巡抚邵友濂到达日军廣島大本營，与首相伊藤博文和外務大臣陆奥宗光会谈，次日日方以“清國全权委任状不完善”为由中断交涉。

source_text: 由於马关条约中規定將辽东半岛割讓給日本，該约簽署後六天受俄國、法國及德國的干涉，称为三国干涉。同年11月8日，中、日雙方又簽訂了《遼南條約》（《中日交還奉天省南邊地方條約》），日本被迫同意歸還辽东半岛，但清廷須繳付三千萬兩白銀的「贖遼費」作為補償。其後，俄国以「還遼有功」為名，向清政府租借旅順和大連兩港，將勢力伸入南满洲及朝鮮半島，1900年庚子條約議和後不撤兵，成為1904年日俄戰爭的原因。

南非民主大会谈判：1991年－1992年
1991年12月，南非民主大会（CODESA）在约翰内斯堡的世贸中心召开，来自19个政党的228名代表参加了会议。非国大代表团虽然由西里尔·拉马福萨带队，但曼德拉仍然是关键人物。戴克拉克利用闭幕词谴责非国大的暴动后，曼德拉上台斥责戴克拉克是“一个非法、失信的少数群体政权的头目”。由于国民党和非国大处于支配地位，会上达成的谈判极少。CODESA第二次大会于1992年5月召开，会上，戴克拉克坚持认为后种族隔离时代的南非应采用轮换主席的联邦体系，确保少数民族得到保护；曼德拉不同意，他要求采用由多数民族统治的单一政制体系。由政府教唆的因卡塔自由党激进分子对非国大积极分子发动了博伊帕通大屠杀后，曼德拉取消了谈判。后来他到塞内加尔参加非洲统一组织的一场会议时，要求召开一次联合国安理会的特别会议，并提出要求联合国维和部队到南非驻扎，以防止“国家恐怖主义”。于是，联合国派出特派使者赛勒斯·万斯到南非协助谈判。非国大号召全国大规模行动，于8月组织了一场南非历史上最大型的罢工，支持者在比勒陀利亚上街游行。
target_text: In December 1991, the South African Democratic Congress (CODESA) was convened at the World Trade Center in Johannesburg, with 228 representatives from 19 political parties. A delegation from the non-nationalist world, led by Cyril Ramafusa, continued to be a key figure. After Daikler used his closing remarks to condemn the non-national uprising, Mandela came to power and accused him of “a leader of an illegal, discredited minority regime.” With the dominance of the National Party and the non-nationals, the negotiations were very rare. At the second Congress of CODESA, held in May 1992, De Kler insisted that a post-apartheid South Africa should use a federal system of rotating presidents to ensure the protection of minorities; Mandela disagreed with his call for a single system of government ruled by most nationalities.
title: 纳尔逊·曼德拉

source_text: 以南非为先例，曼德拉鼓励其他国家通过外交手段和和解的方式解决冲突。他附和姆贝基“非洲的复兴”的呼吁，并十分关注非洲大陆的重大争端；他采取温和的外交策略撤除了萨尼·阿巴查在尼日利亚的军事政权，后来阿巴查的政权不断侵犯人权时，他又带头呼吁对其进行制裁。1996年，他被任命为南部非洲发展共同体的主席，并为结束扎伊尔的第一次刚果战争发动谈判，但以失败告终。在南非的首次后种族隔离军事行动中，曼德拉于1998年9月派兵到莱索托，保护首相帕卡利塔·莫西西利的政府，当时莱索托因一场备受争议的选举刚引发了反抗起义。
target_text: In 1996, he was appointed Chairman of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) and launched negotiations to end the first Congolese war in Zaire, but failed. In the first post-apartheid military operation in South Africa, Mandela sent troops to Lesotho in September 1998 to protect Prime Minister Pakalitha Mosisili’s Government, at a time when his regime was in constant violation of human rights.
title: 纳尔逊·曼德拉
