source_text:
联合国反应
于1948年在联合国大会通过的世界人权宣言第二十五条规定中，有下列关于住房的文本：“所有人都有权力维持自身及家属的生活水平在各个方面达到足够的健康和幸福水准，例如食物、衣着、住房、医疗和必需社会服务……。”2004年，联合国经济部和社会事务部将露宿户定义为“没有住所但在生活区内的家户，会带着一些随身所有物睡在大街、门口、栈桥等或多或少随机的地点”。
target_text: The United Nations response, in article 25 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, adopted by the General Assembly of the United Nations in 1948, contains the following text on housing: “All human beings have the right to maintain a standard of living for themselves and their families which is adequate for their health and well-being in all its aspects, such as food, clothing, housing, medical care and essential social services ...” In 2004, the United Nations Department of Economic Affairs and the Department of Social Affairs defined live-in households as “households without shelter but in their living areas, sleeping with some possessions in more or less random places, such as streets, gates, bridges, etc.”.
title: 家

source_text:
索溪峪风景区
索溪峪自然风景区内有2000多座山峰，还有19道沟壑和6条溪流。主要景点有十里画廊、鸳鸯瀑、南天门、黄龙洞等。登录过程1992年12月，被联合国教科文组织作为自然遗产列入《世界遗产名录》。
2004年2月13日，被联合国教科文组织世界地质公园专家评审会批准为首批世界地质公园。
target_text: There are more than 2,000 mountain peaks, 19 ravines and 6 streams in the Soshi River natural landscape. The main attractions are 10 miles of galleries, waterfalls, South Skygate, Yellow Dragon Hole, etc. The login process was listed as a natural heritage in the World Heritage List by UNESCO in December 1992. On 13 February 2004, the UNESCO Expert Review of the World Geological Park was approved as the first world geological park.
title: 武陵源

source_text: 悉尼大学历史上培养了一系列著名及重要的人物，包括八位澳大利亚总理、兩位澳大利亚總督、五位澳洲首席大法官、联合国大会主席、国际法院院长、世界银行行長、澳洲歷代首富，人數均為南半球最多。此外有七位校友獲得诺贝尔奖和克拉福德奖，以及110名学生获得罗德奖学金。
target_text: The University of Sydney has historically trained a number of prominent and important figures, including eight Australian Prime Ministers, two Australian Governors, five Australian Chief Justices, the President of the United Nations General Assembly, the President of the International Court of Justice, the President of the World Bank, and Australia’s richest generation, the largest in the southern hemisphere. In addition, seven alumni were awarded the Nobel and Kraft Awards, and 110 students were awarded the Rod Scholarships.
title: 悉尼大學

source_text: 工程系下辖六个学院：航天、机械及电子机械工程学院；化学及生物分子工程学院；土木工程学院；电气及資訊工程学院、資訊科技学院、工程及資訊科技學系研究生院，此外还有十多个各领域的研究所。卫生科學系 （Faculty of Health Sciences）——卫生科學系前身是1973年成立的坎伯蘭卫生学院，1979年迁至位于悉尼西区的现校区，1989年并入悉尼大学，1994年护理专业并入悉尼護理學院。下辖九个科：卫生行为和社会学、健身和体育学、卫生信息学、医疗放射学、职业病治疗、视觉矫正、物理治疗、康复咨询、语言病理学。悉尼法學院 （Sydney Law School)——1855年成立的悉尼法學院是澳洲最早成立的法學院，是澳洲公认的质量、名誉最高的两所法學院之一。在2020年QS學科排名中，悉尼法學院名列第13，全澳第二。在學術論文的下載量方面，（SSRN）在2016年将悉尼法學院排在世界第22、全澳第一，而在世界法学研究机构中排名第四。悉尼法學院曾五度赢得世界最高等级的国际法模拟法庭赛，杰萨普赛（Jessup Moot）的冠军（最近一次是2017年），成績世界第一。悉尼法學院的校友包括一位联合国大主席，一位國際法院院長，四位澳洲总理，23位澳洲最高法院法官（超过总数的50%），以及24位罗德奖学金获得者。澳洲历史上至少发生过两次（1974-1975年和1998-2001年）国家的行政、立法、司法三权首长（总督、总理和首席大法官）都是悉尼法學院毕业生的情况。
target_text: The Faculty of Health Sciences (Faculty of Health Sciences) - The Department of Health Sciences was established in 1973 as the Campbell School of Health Sciences, in 1979 as the current school district in Sydney, in 1989 as the University of Sydney, in 1994 as the nursing profession in Sydney, and in 1994 as one of the nine most recent faculties in Australia: the Faculty of Health Behaviour and Social Sciences, the Faculty of Engineering and Technology, the Faculty of Technology for Engineering and Information Technology, in addition to more than a dozen institutes in various fields. The Faculty of Health Sciences (Faculty of Health Sciences) - the former body of the Faculty of Health Sciences was moved to the Faculty of Health of Canada, in 1979 as the current school district in Sydney, in 1979 as the University of Chemistry, in 1989 as the University of Sydney, and in 1994 as the nursing profession in Sydney.
title: 悉尼大學

source_text: 在第二次布匿战争结束时，迦太基人同意对努米底亚王马西尼撒做出让步，归还他或他祖先所拥有的努米底亚的全部领土，同意不经罗马允许不得在利比亚发动任何战争。很显然，这就为马西尼撒以“寻找祖先遗留土地”为由侵占利比亚各类土地制造了机会。大约在和约签订后的30年，努米底亚王决定向迦太基最南端的几个城市进军，夺取了大莱普提斯及其他几个城市。迦太基受条约束缚，非罗马同意不能进行战争，于是派使者向罗马元老院抗议，而罗马的调解结果完全不利于迦太基人。迦太基人必须每年付给罗马200泰伦赔款50年，当她最后付清时，以为之後便不再受扎马战后所订条约的束缚。公元前151年，迦太基向努米底亚宣战。对此，罗马元老院再一次展开了激烈的争论，尽管纳西卡等人进行了多次抗议，主战派还是占了上风。一年后，罗马向迦太基宣战。
target_text: At the end of the second covert war, the Carthage people agreed to make concessions to the southernmost cities of Carmine, to return all of his or his ancestors' territory to Numidia, and to refrain from waging any war in Libya without the permission of Rome. Clearly, this created an opportunity for Masinzar to occupy various types of land in Libya on the grounds of “searching for ancestral lands.” About 30 years after the signing of the war, the Carthage decided to march on the southernmost cities of Carmage, taking over the Great Leptis and several other cities. Carthage was bound by the treaty, the non-Roman agreed not to wage war, and the Roman Senate protested against the Romans, and the outcome of the Roman mediation was totally unfavourable to the Carthage. 遣唐使的派遣目的，除了與唐朝表示友好、以及把先進的唐朝制度及文化吸收輸入以外，亦包括搜集朝鮮半島及東亚地區的情報。
遣唐使的派遣不一定只有一位使節前往。而當有多於一人參與之時，會區分“大使”及“副使”，有時還有位於大使上的押使。而隨遣唐使被派遣往唐朝的，亦包括有留學生及僧人。每次出海，都有400-500人乘坐4艘船渡海。遣唐使船一行人在出發前，都會帶同船舳先到大坂住吉的住吉大社，祈求住吉大神保祐海上安全。之後，整船人從住吉津開始出發，經住吉細江前往大坂灣，再去到難波津。經過瀨戶內海到達福岡的那津，再前往玄界灘。過去日本與朝鮮半島國家友好之時，會在朝鮮半島北岸登陸，然後經陸路進入唐朝。但自從日本與新羅交惡之後，改為由海路直接前往中國。由於當時日本的航海技術尚未完全成熟，在大海航行的遣唐一行經常遇到海難。

source_text:
遣唐使停止
875年，發生黃巢之亂。黃巢攻陷洛陽・長安，建立大齊。齊雖然在短期間滅亡，但是唐的衰落已无可挽回。因此，寬平6年（894年）的派遣在遣唐大使菅原道真的建議下停止。此次的停止並非立即中止，道真等遣唐使預定者仍繼續保有遣唐使的職位。但是，道真因昌泰之變而左遷，喪失大使職位。延喜7年（907年），唐滅亡，遣唐使走入歷史。

慈善、社會公益事業
李宁透过「李宁基金」积极参与慈善活动，并帮助现役及退役中国运动员及教练成立「中国运动员教育基金」为运动员提供学习进修及培训资助，并支持中国贫困及偏远地区的教育发展。二零零九年十月，李宁被联合国世界粮食计划署WFP）任命为中国第一位「WFP反饥饿亲善大使」。

source_text: 在1918年的大选中，在爱尔兰，主张爱尔兰独立的新芬黨赢得73%的选票，然而在阿尔斯特9郡中新教徒占优势的6郡，新芬党都输掉选举。1920年，英国政府颁布1920年愛爾蘭政府法案，将阿尔斯特省新教徒占优的6郡组成北爱尔兰，阿尔斯特省剩下的3郡与其他3省合并成南爱尔兰。1921年，爱尔兰独立战争结束以后，根据英爱条约，爱尔兰自由邦成立，北部阿尔斯特省中的6郡成为北爱尔兰，并在条约签署后一个月内自主决定是否留在爱尔兰自由邦内，而北爱尔兰议会选择退出爱尔兰自由邦，留在联合王国之内。
target_text: In the 1918 general elections, in Ireland, the New Fein Party for Ireland’s Independence won 73 per cent of the vote, while in the six counties where Protestants predominated in the 9th County of Alster, the New Fein Party lost the election. In 1920, the British Government enacted an Irish Government Act that made six counties in the Province of Alster, with Protestants superior, Northern Ireland, and the three remaining counties in the Province of Alster combined with the three other provinces into Southern Ireland. In 1921, after the end of the Irish Independence War, the Irish Free State was formed under the British Compact, six counties in the Northern Province of Alster became Northern Ireland and left within the United Kingdom within one month after the Treaty was signed.
title: 北爱尔兰

source_text: 甲午战争后所签订的《马关条约》是自第一次鸦片战争后签订的《南京条约》来对清政府危害極大的不平等条约。条约签订后，清政府喪失澎湖列島與台灣及其附屬島嶼的主權，還須承擔巨額賠款；而其中允许外國企業於境內投資设厂的條款，亦對當時正在茁壯的中國棉紡織工業產生嚴重威脅。此外，條約衍生出的三國干涉還遼事件也開啟了西方諸國瓜分中國之端。1896年，俄國以迫日還遼有功，與清政府簽署中俄密約。後來，密約泄露，列強爭相划分勢力範圍、租界與租借地。俄國在1898年租下旅順與大連兩港口；德國則強占膠州灣。
target_text: The post-Camber Treaty, signed after the first opium war, is a serious threat to the Chinese cotton-weaving industry. Moreover, the intervention of the three countries that came out of the pact opened the way for China in the West. In 1896, Russia was forced to take advantage of the signing of a treaty with China.
title: 甲午战争

source_text: 以大日本帝国憲法的发布（1889年）、撤除部分不平等条约（1894年透过日英通商航海条約取消領事裁判权）、中日甲午战争（1894 - 95年）这三个事件为契机，日本的脱亚入欧论初步取得成效。同时，作为日本近代史上第一场获胜的战争，不论对日本国内还是对当时的欧美列强都有巨大的象征意义。在日后的日俄战争结束后，欧美列强为了表示认同日本的国际地位，把日本设置在海外的外交代表機構纷纷升格为大使馆。
target_text: Japan’s de-Asianization theory has initially borne fruit with the publication of the Empire’s Constitution (1889), the withdrawal of some of the inequality treaties (1894, through the Japan-United States Treaty of Merchant Shipping), and the China-Japan-Misk War (1894-95). At the same time, as Japan’s first-ever victory in recent history, both for Japan’s own country and for the then European and American powers, there is enormous symbolic significance.

source_text: 《威斯特伐利亚和约》（，，）是指1648年五月至十月间在威斯特伐利亚地区内的奥斯纳布吕克市和明斯特签订的一系列条约，标志着欧洲一系列宗教战争的结束。威斯特伐利亚和约结束了欧洲历史上有近八百万人丧生的动荡时期。学者普遍认为，威斯特伐利亚和约的签订标志着基于威斯特伐利亚主权概念的现代国际系统的开始。
target_text: Westphalia and the Treaty (, referred to as the series of treaties signed between May and October 1648 in the city of Osnabrück and Minster in the Westphalia region marked the end of a series of religious wars in Europe. Westphalia and the Treaty ended a turbulent period in European history in which nearly eight million people lost their lives.
title: 威斯特伐利亚和约

source_text: 和约的谈判过程颇为冗长。由于双方都希望在自己的领地内进行谈判进而控制谈判，谈判主要在两个城市进行。共计110名交战国代表出席谈判，但代表们并不每次都同时出席。会议共签署三份条约以终止对应的相互交叠的战争：明斯特和約、明斯特協議和奥斯纳布吕克条约。这些条约结束了哈布斯堡及其天主教派盟友与新教势力（瑞典、丹麦、荷兰和神圣罗马帝国各邦）及其盟友法国（尽管信仰天主教但反对哈布斯堡）之间的三十年战争（1618-1648）。条约还结束了西班牙与荷兰共和国之间的八十年战争（1568-1648），前者正式的承认后者的独立地位。
target_text: The negotiations were lengthy. Because both parties wanted to negotiate within their territories and then control the negotiations, the negotiations took place mainly in two cities. A total of 110 representatives of the warring countries attended the negotiations, but representatives did not always attend at the same time. There were three treaties signed to put an end to the reciprocal overlapping wars: the Minster and Jo, the Minster Agreement and the Osnabrück Treaty, which ended the 30-year war (1618-1648) between Habsburg and its Catholic and Protestant allies (Sweden, Denmark, the Netherlands and the States of the Holy Roman Empire) and their allies France, which opposed Habsburg despite their Catholic faith. The treaty also ended the eight-year war between Spain and the Republic of the Netherlands (1568-1648), which formally recognized the independent status of the latter.
title: 威斯特伐利亚和约

source_text: 威斯特伐利亚和约的签订是以外交会议订立和约的先例。基于各个主权国家共存的概念，新的政治系统在欧洲中部形成。由于权力平衡，国家间的侵略战争得到遏制，反对干预别国内政的准则开始得到认可。随着欧洲影响力逐渐遍布全球，这些威斯特伐利亚原则，尤其是主权国家的概念，逐渐流行成为国际法和世界秩序的中心原则。
target_text: Because of the balance of power, wars of aggression between countries have been contained, and norms against interference in the internal affairs of other countries have begun to be endorsed. As Europe has gained global influence, these Westphalia principles, particularly the concept of sovereign states, have become central to international law and world order.
title: 威斯特伐利亚和约

source_text: 麥理浩是少有外交官出身的港督，也是殖民地部於1966年併入英聯邦事務部、以及英聯邦事務部在1968年與外交部重組為外交及聯邦事務部（同樣簡稱外交部）以來，首位獲任命的港督。他之前的24任港督，幾乎盡皆殖民地官僚出身。與殖民地官僚不同，雖然麥理浩不是公共行政專才，但外交部的背景使他沒有殖民地的包袱，同時對政局具備敏銳的分析力。為了重拾香港市民自六七暴動以來的信心，麥理浩甫上任便強調香港已儲備足夠的經濟能力，現在是改善生活的時候。透過大幅增加公共開支，他在任內大刀闊斧地推動前所未有的新政，幅度和深度比前任均有過之而無不及。他的政策不單令香港出現既深且廣的發展，也令政府在市民心目中重新塑造良好而正面的形象。
target_text: Unlike the colonial bureaucrats, which are not public administrators, the Foreign Ministry’s background makes him unconscionable to the United Kingdom, and has also been a keenly analytical tool for the administration. To regain the confidence of Hong Kong’s citizens in Hong Kong since the 67th riots, the British Department of Foreign Affairs re-emphasized Hong Kong’s well-positioned economic capacity, which is now the time to improve life.
title: 麥理浩

source_text: 1967年香港的暴動，以及同年在中國首都北京發生的火燒英國代辦處事件，導致中英關係陷入低潮。儘管後來事件平息，但兩國關係停滯不前，難以就香港前途問題展開對話。直到麥理浩在1971年上任後，情況才開始出現變化。當時，中共對西方國家釋出善意，而美國政府也透過-{「乒乓外交」}-，促成美國總統尼克遜在1972年2月歷史性訪華，為中美兩國日後建交奠下重要基礎。就在尼克遜訪華後不久，中英兩國隨即在1972年3月同意把兩國外交關係升格為大使級別，並且互派大使。到同年10月，外交大臣何謨爵士訪華，標誌著兩國關係重上軌道。
target_text: The riots in Hong Kong in 1967 and the burning of the British proxy office in Beijing, China’s capital, led to a decline in Chinese-British relations. Although the events subsided, relations between the two countries did not last long enough to open a conversation about Hong Kong’s future.
title: 麥理浩

source_text: 中英兩國建立大使級關係前，中华人民共和国剛在1971年10月取代中華民國成為聯合國的常任理事國之一，且成為中國在聯合國內的唯一代表。不久以後，中國常駐聯合國代表黃華在1972年初致函聯合國非殖化特別委員會，要求將香港和澳門剔出殖民地名單。建議隨後於同年6月15日獲委員會通過，並轉交聯合國大會表決。該名單所包括的地方，均屬聯合國認為應該實行非殖民地化，最終邁向獨立的殖民地。有關行動反映中共不承認香港和澳門的殖民地身份，然而，時任英揆希思主張對華友好，結果身為常任理事國之一的英國，沒有在聯合國大會行使其否決權，讓建議在1972年11月8日獲得大會批准。英政府的友好舉動，反映出英方也同意透過外交手段，而非對待殖民地的一貫方法，來處理香港問題；而外交官出身的麥理浩，正好是代表英政府與中共打交道的理想人選。
target_text: Soon after, China’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations wrote to the United Nations Special Committee on Decolonization in early 1972, demanding that Hong Kong and Macao be removed from the list of colonies. It was recommended that the committee be passed on 15 June of the same year and transferred to the United Nations General Assembly’s vote. The list included places where the United States believed that it should pursue non-colonialization and eventually move to an independent colony.
title: 麥理浩

source_text: 麥理浩是中共建國以來，首位官式訪華的香港總督，另一港督葛量洪爵士雖然曾在1955年10月訪問北京，會見時任總理兼外交部長周恩來，但他的行程僅屬私人性質。對於麥理浩訪華和計劃提出新界租約問題，英政府顯得相當隱秘，在香港，只有同行的行政局首席非官守議員簡悅強爵士和港府政治顧問衛奕信（後為爵士）得悉真正內情，而外交部方面則得到副國務次官尤德爵士和英國駐華大使柯利達（後為爵士）協調，並獲得外交大臣歐文博士支持。
target_text: In Hong Kong, where only the chief non-officer of the executive board of his peers, Sir John John and Hong Kong’s Political Counsel, who had visited Beijing in October 1955 to meet then Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs Zhou Enlai, his trip was of a personal nature. The British government appeared to be very secret about the New Territories’ tenancy agreement, and in Hong Kong, where only the former chief non-officer of the executive board, Sir Yuddh, and British Ambassador Calida (later Sir), were able to support the Foreign Secretary of State.
title: 麥理浩

source_text: 聯合國大會第2758號決議是1971年10月25日在第26屆联合国大会會議上表决并通过的，关于「恢復中華人民共和國在聯合國組織中的合法權利問題」的決議。中华人民共和国依此取代中華民國在联合国的中國代表權席位。當時中華民國政府將此決議案稱做「排我納匪案」，現今的中華民國政府則以「中華民國退出聯合國」代稱。中华人民共和国则将此事称为“中华人民共和国恢复联合国合法席位”、“重返联合国”。
target_text: The Chinese People’s Republic of China replaced the Chinese People’s Republic’s representation in the United Nations. At that time, the Chinese government referred to the decision as the “Exclusion of Bandits” and today’s Chinese government as “the withdrawal of the Chinese People’s Republic from the United Nations.” The People’s Republic of China referred to the matter as “the return of the People’s Republic of China to its rightful seat in the United Nations” and “re-entry into the United Nations”.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 1971年7月15日，阿爾巴尼亞、阿爾及利亞等國向聯合國提出決議草案「兩阿提案」，即後來表决通过的2758號決議案；17个成员国提出将“恢复中华人民共和国在联合国组织中的合法权利”问题加入第26届联合国大会的议事日程，并声称“能代表中国的中華人民共和國作为联合国的创始国和安全理事会的常任理事国，其依法所应占有的席位自从1949年以来就被系统操纵排除在联合国以外”。
target_text: On 15 July 1971, Albania and Algeria submitted to the United Nations a draft resolution, the "two-Arab proposal", which was later voted on, resolution 2758; 17 member States proposed to place the issue of “restoration of the legitimate rights of the People's Republic of China in the Organization” on the agenda of the twenty-sixth session of the General Assembly, stating that “the People's Republic of China, which represents China, as a founding Member of the United Nations and as a permanent member of the Security Council, has been systematically excluded from the United Nations since 1949”.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 1971年7月19日，美國向中華人民共和國讓步，接納中華人民共和國取得聯合國代表權，中華民國政府已經清楚地認知到美國政策趨勢改變，遂同美方馬康衛大使進行談判，表示接受於雙重代表權安排，但不公開承認的意願。並以英文說帖，說明如果第26届联合国大会有國家提出雙重代表權，也可以「了解」。因此對任何形式的雙重代表案發言反對，但不會投票反對。
target_text: On July 19, 1971, the United States gave its way to the People’s Republic of China to accept the right of the People’s Republic of China to be represented in the United Nations, and the Chinese government, clearly aware of the changes in United States policy, negotiated with the US Ambassador Makang Wai to accept the idea of double representation, but did not publicly recognize it. In English, it also stated that if the 26th United Nations General Assembly had the right to double representation, it could “understand it.” Therefore, it would not vote against any kind of double representation, but would not vote against it.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 1971年8月17日，美国驻联合国首席代表老布希向联合国秘书长递交了一封信和备忘录，正式提出「双重代表权」提案。美国总统尼克松设想「双重代表权」可以「两全其美」地既向中华人民共和国送顺水人情，又同时通过「重要问题」提案和「双重代表权」提案的双保险，让中华民国仍能保住在联合国的席位。中華人民共和國外交部在8月20日就「雙重代表權案」發表聲明，堅決反對联合国同时接纳海峡两岸双方为会员国，反对美国通过「双重代表权」提案在联合国搞「两个中国」「一中一台」，明确指出「中华人民共和国在联合国的一切合法权利必须完全恢复，必须把蒋-{}-介石集团从联合国及其一切机构驱逐出去」，並向季辛吉抗議。
target_text: On August 17, 1971, old Bush, the United States Chief Representative to the United Nations, sent a letter and memorandum to the Secretary-General of the United Nations formally proposing a "double representation". United States President Nixon envisaged that "double representation" could be a "two-size-fits-all" policy for both the People's Republic of China and a "double-representation" policy that would allow the Republic of China to remain in the United Nations. On August 20, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China stated its firm opposition to the United Nations in the "double-representation case" and to the United States' "two-China-one-one" proposal, stating that "all legitimate rights of the People's Republic of China in the United Nations must be fully restored, and that the Jiang--Si-Si-Group must be expelled from the United Nations and all its agencies" and that it should oppose Diesingi.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 1971年9月16日，中華民國代表團的周書楷（外交部部長）、劉鍇（駐聯合國常任代表）和沈劍虹（駐美國大使）在美國國務院與國務卿羅吉斯會談，接受了美國提出的「複雜雙重代表權案」。中華民國代表表示「如美國不願見中華民國被聯合國排除，美國政府一定遵守自甘迺迪和詹森政府以來保證中華民國席位的承諾」。然而美國代表表示，此為不能保證事項，美国拒絕承諾。
target_text: On September 16, 1971, the Chinese delegation’s compatriots (Ministers of Foreign Affairs), Chen (Permanent Representative to the United Nations) and Shen Kensung-Yung (Ambassador to the United States) met with Secretary of State Rogers in the United States Department of State to accept the United States’ “complex and double representation case.” The Chinese government’s representatives stated that “if the United States does not want to see the United States exclude China from the United Nations, the United States government will abide by the promises made by the Kennedy and Jensen governments to guarantee China’s seat.” The United States representative, however, stated that this was an unassured undertaking and that the United States refused to do so.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 1971年9月29日，澳大利亚、日本等22个成员国向联合国提交了「重要問題」的决议草案A/L.632以及附加文件1、2号。该决议草案提议：任何试图剥夺中华民国代表权的提案都是涉及联合国宪章第18条的重大问题，因此應以到會及投票之会员国三分之二多數決定之。因其较两阿提案晚提出，序号靠后，一般情况下应按序号顺序表决，所以澳、日等国又提出此草案需于两阿提案之前表决的动议，后于25日先对此提前表决动议表决并获通过。
target_text: On 29 September 1971, 22 Member States, including Australia, Japan and others, submitted to the United Nations draft resolution A/L.632, entitled “Major issues”, together with additional document No. 1, 2 and 2. The draft resolution proposed that any proposal seeking to deprive the Republic of China of its representation would be a major issue under Article 18 of the Charter of the United Nations and should therefore be decided by a majority of two thirds of the Member States present and voting. Since it was submitted later than the two-Arab proposal, the numbering would normally be in the order of number, so Australia and Japan proposed a motion requiring a vote before the two-Arab proposal, which would then be put to an earlier vote and adopted on 25 days.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 據美國國務院「台北5869」號解密電文，當時的駐華大使馬康衛曾應中華民國外交部次長楊西崑的要求，召開秘密會議。楊西崑向總統蔣中正提議，中華民國改名為中華台灣共和國（Chinese Republic of Taiwan），以行政命令通令全島進行公投決定台灣前途，並由台灣人民選出制憲會議。楊西崑表示此方案需要美國表態支持並說服蔣中正。美國總統尼克森及其高級顧問季辛吉因為正在籌劃北京之行，未理會這個方案。
target_text: According to a leaked message from the United States Department of State, "Taibei 5869," Chinese Ambassador Makang Wai at the time called a secret meeting at the request of Yang Xijin, Under-Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs of China. Yang Xijin proposed to the President that China change its name to Chinese Republic of Taiwan by an executive order that the island vote on Taiwan’s future and be elected by the people of Taiwan. Yang Xi Xi Xian said that the program would require the US to speak up and speak out.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text:
中華民國
2021年9月15日，針對中國國民黨指稱民主進步黨蔡英文政府透過大內宣，遮掩台灣面臨嚴峻外交困境的指責，中華民國外交部发言人欧江安表示，“自2009年起，政府决定不再提案（加入聯合國），仅洽请友邦在联大总辩论为台湾执言，敦促联合国正视台湾2,350万人被不当排除在联合国体系外的不公事实”。
target_text: On September 15, 2021, China, in response to the allegations made by the Chinese National Party (NDP) that the protagonist party, the English-language government of Chai, was covering Taiwan's difficult diplomatic situation, China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesman, Eugang An, stated that “since 2009, the Government has decided not to propose a proposal (to join the United Nations) but to ask friends to speak for Taiwan in the general debate of the General Assembly, urging the United Nations to confront the unjust exclusion of 23.5 million people from Taiwan from the United Nations system”.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text:
2021年10月22日，中華民國外交部響應美方表態，呼籲國際社會正視中華人民共和國刻意濫用聯合國大會第2758號決議施壓聯合國排除中華民國參與聯合國體系。中華人民共和國
2021年10月23日，中華人民共和國驻美国大使馆发言人表示，美国国务院东亚局官员的有关言论罔顾事实、混淆视听，本质就是要在国际上制造“一中一台”，公然挑战一个中国原则，是对中方严重的政治挑衅。
target_text: On October 22, 2021, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China echoed the American voice, calling on the international community to confront the Chinese People’s Republic of China’s deliberate attempts to use UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 to pressure the United States to exclude the Chinese People’s Republic from the United Nations system. On October 23, 2021, the spokesman for the Chinese People’s Republic of China’s Embassy in the United States stated that the statements made by officials of the East Asia Bureau of the United States Department of State ignored the facts and confused the message, in essence that they sought to create “one China, one Taiwan” at the international level, openly challenged the one-China principle and were a serious political challenge to China.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 2021年10月27日，中華人民共和國外交部发言人赵立坚针对美国务卿布林肯发表的支持台湾参与联合国的声明表示，美方声明严重违反一个中国原则和中美三个联合公报规定，向“台独”势力发出严重错误信号。中方对此强烈不满、坚决反对，已向美方表明严正立场并提出严正交涉。當天，国务院台湾事务办公室发言人马晓光表示联合国是由主权国家组成的政府间国际组织。台湾是中国的一部分，无权参加联合国。
target_text: On October 27, 2021, the spokesman for the Chinese People’s Republic of China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Zhao Liqin, in response to the statement by US Secretary of State Bush in support of Taiwan’s participation in the United Nations, stated that the US side’s statement seriously violated the one-China principle and the three joint communiqués of China and the United States, sending a serious false signal to the “Taiwan independence” forces. China was strongly disaffected and firmly opposed.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 2021年10月29日，中華人民共和國國務委員兼外交部部長王毅表示，聯合國大會第2758號決議已经从政治上、法律上和程序上彻底解决了中国在联合国以及国际机构中的代表权问题。美国等个别国家企图在台湾问题上搞突破，这一做法违背了其同中国建交时所做的政治承诺，无视广大会员国在2758号决议中表达的共同意志，是对联合国宪章宗旨和原则的损害，也是对台海和平稳定的破坏。
target_text: On October 29, 2021, the Chinese People’s Republic of China’s State Council and Minister for Foreign Affairs, Wang Yi, stated that resolution 2758 of the United Nations General Assembly had resolved the issue of China’s representation in the United Nations and in international institutions politically, legally and procedurally. The attempts of individual countries, such as the United States, to make a breakthrough on the Taiwan issue ran counter to the political commitment they had made at the time of the establishment of their relations with China, ignoring the common will expressed by a large number of Member States in resolution 2758, undermined the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations and undermined the peace and stability of the Taiwan Strait.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 2021年10月21日，美國國務院亞太副助卿（Rick Waters）表示，北京誤用2758號決議，導致台北頻頻被排除在聯合國活動外，各會員應加入美國行列，支持台北有意義參與。25日，美参议院外交关系委员会主席羅伯特·梅南德茲和参议员吉姆·殷荷菲表示，联大2758号决议授予中华人民共和国联合国会员国资格，但中国共产党卻一直在歪曲决议，试图破坏台湾在国际社会的地位和参与。10月26日，即联大2758号决议通过满50年的第二天，美国国务卿布林肯发表声明支持台湾参与联合国。
target_text: On October 21, 2021, the U.S. Secretary of State, Rick Waters, stated that Beijing misdirected Resolution 2758 to exclude Taipei from United Nations activities, and that members should join the United States to support Taipei’s meaningful participation. On October 26, the day after the adoption of General Assembly resolution 2758, US Secretary of State Lincoln issued a statement in support of Taiwan’s participation in the United Nations.
title: 聯合國大會第2758號決議

source_text: 该组织目前致力在伊拉克及沙姆地区（又稱黎凡特）建立政教合一的伊斯兰国家，是叙利亚内战反政府武装中主要的圣战组织之一，并占领伊拉克北部、及敘利亞中部的部分城市和地区。其自认为是一个独立国家，声称拥有伊拉克和叙利亚的主权，而且宣稱已于2014年11月13日拥有阿拉伯地区更多的主权，涉及利比亚、埃及、阿尔及利亚、沙特阿拉伯和也门等国家。
target_text: The organization is currently working to establish a united Islamic State in Iraq and the Sham region (also known as the Levant), one of the main jihadist groups in the anti-government forces of the Syrian civil war, and occupies parts of the cities and regions of northern Iraq and central Syria. It claims to be an independent State, claims to have Iraqi and Syrian sovereignty and claims to have more Arab regional sovereignty on 13 November 2014, involving Libya, Egypt, Algeria, Saudi Arabia and Yemen.

source_text: 《中華民國憲法》第141條規定：「中華民國之外交，應本獨立自主之精神，平等互惠之原則，敦睦邦交，尊重條約及《聯合國憲章》，以保護僑民權益，促進國際合作，提倡國際正義，確保世界和平」。外交部依據憲法，以捍衛中華民國主權及維護國家利益，致力推動繁榮臺灣之外交政策以及強化國際地位之對外關係，作為基本政策方針。
target_text: Article 141 of the Constitution of China states: "In accordance with the spirit of independence and the principle of equality and reciprocity, China's foreign policy and the strengthening of the foreign relations of Taiwan and the strengthening of the international position, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in accordance with the Constitution, is committed to promoting the foreign policy of Taiwan and strengthening the foreign relations of the United Nations, in order to protect civil rights, promote international cooperation, promote international justice and ensure world peace."

source_text: 1979年3月1日，行政院成立北美事務協調委員會（今臺灣美國事務委員會）負責與美國關係事務，業務由外交部辦理。1989年，成立「海外經濟合作發展基金管理委員會」。1992年，原領事事務司擴編為「領事事務局」。1993年，依據《政風機構人員設置條例》（2012年2月3日修正公布時改名《政風機構人員設置管理條例》）設立政風處，並於同年設立「國會聯絡組」以加強與立法院聯繫之工作。1996年7月1日，「海外技術合作委員會」與「海外經濟合作發展基金管理委員會」合併改組為「國際合作發展基金會」。2000年，設立「非政府組織國際事務委員會」，以協助國內非政府組織積極參與國際活動，為國內非政府組織從事涉外事務及活動之重要管道。2005年10月18日，設立直屬外交部部長的一級單位「日本事務會」（任務編組），外交部部長陳唐山擔任首任召集人，亞東關係協會秘書長羅坤燦擔任首任執行長；但其並非《外交部組織法》法定單位，且其職責與亞太司及亞東關係協會重疊，至2008年裁撤。2011年11月14日，修訂《外交部組織法》和所屬機關組織法。2012年5月20日，行政院新聞局裁撤後，外交部承接其國際新聞業務。9月1日，依新版的《駐外機構組織通則》開始將駐外人員之行政職稱統一以正式官銜訂定，駐外機構（大使館與代表處）之館長均稱大使，解決原先大使館、總領事館、代表處、辦事處人員職稱複雜、容易混淆的問題。
target_text: On 1 March 1979, the Executive Council established the North American Council for the Regulation of Governmental Institutions (the US Council for the Regulation of the Administration of the Gulf), which was run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. source_text: 12月17日，各地3萬餘學生在南京市大遊行。先從國立中央大學（今东南大学四牌楼校区）整队出发，经中山路、鼓楼、湖南路，过外交部（今国民政府外交部旧址）到国民党中央党部（今临时政府参议院旧址）。下午3時，游行至珍珠桥，學生不滿《中央日报》12月16日刊登評論指責學生由中國共產黨幕後支持，大肆破壞報馆。「平沪学生千余人捣毁中央日报大门、经理部、编辑部、排字房、机器房，继则纵火焚烧报馆，文件账册家具材料悉行付丙，且强阻消防队扑救，为此击伤工友10余人。」

source_text: 第二次世界大战结束后，根据1945年2月雅爾達會議的安排，原日占朝鲜由美苏两国共同托管。此后朝鲜半岛被划分为南北两块势力范围：苏联势力范围内的朝鲜民主主义人民共和国以及美国势力范围内的大韓民國。1950年6月25日，朝鲜战争爆发。苏联等共产主义阵营国家缺席，而当时美国等主导的联合国投票发动联合国军支援南韓。联合国军支援的南韓同苏联和中华人民共和国支持的北韓最终在1953年签署停火协议，朝鲜半岛沿三八线非军事区划分为两个国家政權，即今天的大韓民國和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国。
target_text: Following the end of the Second World War, the former occupation of Korea was co-trusted by the United States and the Soviet Union in accordance with the arrangements of the Yalda conference in February 1945. The Korean peninsula was divided into two areas of influence, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, within the Soviet Union, and the Great Korean nation, within the United States. On 25 June 1950, the Korean war broke out.
title: 朝鲜半岛

source_text: 1945年2月，第二次世界大战结束后，根据雅爾達會議的安排，朝鲜半岛由美苏两国以三八线为界共同托管。此后朝鲜半岛被划分为南北两块势力范围：北部由蘇聯軍事政府管理，南部則由美國軍政廳統治。兩者分別於1948年獨立為“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”（，简称“朝鮮”，）及“大韓民國”（，简称“韓國”，）。1950年6月25日，朝鲜战争爆发。因苏联等社會主義國家缺席，导致当时美国等主导的联合国投票发动了联合国军支援韩国。联合国军支援的大韩民国同苏联和中华人民共和国支持的朝鲜民主主义人民共和国最终在1953年签署停火协议，朝鲜半岛沿三八线非军事区划分为两个主權國家。
target_text: In February 1945, after the end of the World War II, the Korean peninsula was co-hosted by the United States and the Soviet Union on the 38th Line. The Korean peninsula was then divided into two areas of influence, North and South: the north was administered by the Soviet military government and the south by the United States military hall. The two were separate from the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea in 1948 (known as “DPRK”) and the Great Korean Democratic People’s Republic (known as “KORK”). On 25 June 1950, the Korean war broke out.
title: 朝鲜半岛

source_text: 屬地（或或；）是附屬於主權國家，但擁有部分或全部獨立管治權力的地區。雖然沒有完整主权，但是其政治地位异于其附屬主權國的其他領土，並且多在民政、執法、司法管轄權、邊境管制等對內之政治權力上高度自主。属地往往由殖民地轉化而成，是帝國主義時代殖民風潮遺留下來的遺跡。在第二次世界大戰之後興起的殖民地及保护国獨立建國浪潮，大幅減少此類地區的數量。今天，世界上僅有少數國家還擁有屬地，或是一些因為特殊的緣故而組成的附属或合作關係（如聯繫邦）。各国对南极的主权声索因南极条约冻结。
target_text: Land (or;) belongs to a sovereign state, but has some or all of its own powers. There is no complete sovereignty, but its political status is different from that of the other territories that are dependent on it, and it is more or less highly autonomous in its internal political power, such as civil administration, administration of justice, and border control. Dependent territories are often transformed from colonies, which are the legacy of the colonial tide of imperialism. The wave of colonies and protectors of independent statehood that emerged after the Second World War has dramatically reduced the number of such areas. Today, only a few countries in the world still have their own territory, or some of the dependent or cooperative relationships that have been formed for special reasons (e.g., associated states) that claim sovereignty over Antarctica as a result of the Antarctic Treaty.
title: 属地

自由結合（）：自由結合是一種比較特殊的國與國關係，通常加入自由結合的國家本身已擁有自己的主權與自治能力，但與自由結合的對象國（通常是之前的殖民母國或託管國）間仍然是以簽署協約等方式保持一定的合作關係，例如外交與國防問題上的代管。這種關係與一般的自治地方不大相同，因為在自治地方中，當地政府雖然有管理內部事務的權利，但該地的主權仍屬於母國擁有，而自由結合國家的主權卻是自有的，也可視為是一種國家權限沒有完全施展的主權獨立國家。

target_text: Freedom of association (): Freedom of association is a more special state-to-state relationship, in which states that are usually members of free association have their own sovereignty and autonomy, while free association with states (usually former colonial parent countries or jurisdictions) still maintains a certain degree of cooperation, such as diplomatic and defense antecedents, in such a way as to sign agreements. This relationship is not the same as in general autonomous areas where, although the local government has full autonomy over internal affairs, the sovereignty of the country is still vested in the mother country, while free association with a state is owned by itself and may be regarded as a sovereign state with no full exercise of State authority. 公元600年左右，一批愛爾蘭僧侶到此定居。
公元9世紀，維京人進佔法羅群島。
970年一度成立共和國，但實為蘇格蘭奧克尼伯爵（Earl of Orkney）的附庸國。
1280年隨奧克尼群島成為挪威佔領地。
1388年隨挪威併入丹麥。
1650年成為丹麥馮嘉保家族（Von Gabel）的封建領地。
1720年劃為丹屬冰島轄地。
1814年挪威与丹麦签订基尔条约，结束了两国的联合，条约规定法罗群岛、冰岛以及格陵兰岛并不随挪威脱离丹麦。
1816年被析置為直辖海外郡。法罗群岛自古起就拥有自己的议会（Løgting），但于1816年遭废除。
1851年议会恢复，但是直至1948年，都只是作为咨询机构，并无实权。
第二次世界大戰初期丹麥戰敗後（1940～1945年9月），英軍進佔法羅群島。
1946年9月14日法罗群岛发起独立公投。最终有效选票11,146张，50.74%支持独立。但公投结果仅具建议性质，议会无必须尊重公投结果的义务。
1948年3月30日法罗群岛自治法由丹麥國會立法，规定法罗群岛不再是丹麦的直辖郡县，而变成享有高度自治权的丹麦海外自治领地。
直到2020年11月15日法罗群岛累积-{zh-hans:2019冠状病毒病;zh-cn:新型冠状病毒;zh-hant:嚴重特殊傳染性肺炎}-确诊病例共413例。

source_text:
中華民國駐日本代表
曾在2004年至2008年間擔任中華民國駐日本代表。2004年7月5日，許世楷出任台北駐日文化代表處大使。在其任內成功地推動臺灣觀光客赴日免簽證（2005年達成）、日本承認臺灣駕照（2007年8月8日兩國代表在東京簽署〈臺日雙方駕駛執照相互承認協定〉）等。之後韓國外交部也跟進與日本簽訂相同的國民免簽交流。首相安倍晉三曾肯定許世楷對促進台日關係的傑出貢獻，並強調美日臺三地領袖有對話的必要性。
target_text: On July 5, 2004, Xu Shili became Ambassador to Japan’s Cultural Office in Taipei. During his tenure, Taiwan tourists were successfully promoted for a waiver of their visa (aggravated in 2005), Japan recognized the Taiwan driver’s licence (the agreement signed by the two Chinese delegates in Tokyo on August 8, 2007), and then the Korean Foreign Ministry joined Japan’s agreement to grant the same national visa waiver.
title: 許世楷

source_text: 關於日本政府對臺灣免簽證案曾被當時中華人民共和國駐日大使王毅加以反對，引起許世楷公開批評「王毅在日本的工作很容易，只要看台灣駐日代表處作什麼就反對什麼」。許世楷在2008年馬英九總統上任前的5月19日提出辭呈，但未立即獲准。2008年6月，臺日雙方在釣魚台海域發生聯合號海釣船事件後，遭部份人士質疑为何不向日本抗議而被外交部召回。
target_text: With regard to the Japanese government’s opposition to Taiwan’s exemption from the visa, the then Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Japan, Wang Yi, provoked Xu’s public criticism that “it is easy for him to work in Japan, as long as he sees what is done by Taiwan’s delegates.” He resigned on May 19, 2008, before President Mahinix took office, but was not granted immediate permission. source_text:

安倍晉三曾經於日本李登輝之友會主辦的送別會中說道：「許世楷是深受日臺信賴的大使，可能的話希望許世楷能留任駐日代表一職」。安倍表示「日本與臺灣的關係不但對東亞、對世界都是相當重要的，日臺今後的互信關係必須進一步加強」。安倍指出，「我外公岸信介擔任日本首相時，蔣介石政權曾經向日本政府提出交換條件，希望日本將旅日的黑名單政治犯遣返往臺，不過，我外公並沒有答應，不然可能就沒有後來的許代表了」。

source_text: 《布列斯特-立陶夫斯克條約》（；；常被简称为布列斯特条约或布列斯特和约），是第一次世界大战期间，苏维埃政权与同盟国（包括德意志帝国、奥匈帝国、保加利亚王國、奥斯曼土耳其帝国）在布列斯特-立陶夫斯克所签订的和约。1918年3月簽約，11月德國即戰敗投降，此條約與德國部分被廢止，而以1922年簽訂之《拉帕洛条约》取代之；與土耳其部分亦以1921年的卡尔斯条约取代。
target_text: The Brest-Litavsk Treaty (; commonly referred to as the Brest Treaty or Brest Treaty) was signed by Soviet regimes and allies (including the German Empire, the Austrian Empire, the Bulgarian Kingdom, the Ottoman Turkish Empire) at Brest-Litavsk during the First World War. The Treaty was signed in March 1918, when Germany was defeated in November, and the Treaty of Laparo was replaced by the Treaty of 1922; and the Treaty of Kars was replaced by the Turkish part.
title: 布列斯特-立陶夫斯克條約

source_text: 1月30日，布列斯特谈判恢复。作为外交人民委员（即外交部长）、谈判代表团团长，托洛茨基临行前与列宁约定：如果德国下了最后通牒就让步签约。结果德国果然向苏俄下了最后通牒，托洛茨基向列宁电报询问对策，列宁立即覆电坚持：接受德国条件，立即签约。但是托洛茨基没有接受列宁的建议，而是发表了拒绝签约的声明，率团离开布列斯特。德國於是執行了拳擊行動，德軍和奧軍开始对俄罗斯大举进攻，另外在高加索，奥斯曼帝国对亞美尼亞、喬治亞和亞塞拜然等新建的政權展開進攻。
target_text: As a member of the People’s Council for Foreign Affairs (namely, the Minister for Foreign Affairs) and head of the negotiating delegation, Trotsky agreed with Lenin to make a concession if Germany had given an ultimatum. As a result, Germany had given the last ultimatum to Russia, and Trotsky had asked Lenin for a response, and Lenin immediately called to insist: accept German terms and sign immediately. But Trotsky had not accepted Lenin’s offer, but had issued a statement refusing to sign, leading the group out of Brest. Germany had then carried out a boxing campaign, the Germans and the Austrians had started a major offensive against Russia, and, in the Caucasus, the Ottoman Empire had launched an offensive against the newly established regimes of Armenia, Georgia, and Azerbaijan.
title: 布列斯特-立陶夫斯克條約

source_text: 1918年10月29日德国发生十一月革命，11月9日威廉二世的德意志帝国亦崩溃，11月11日德国停戰，中央同盟宣告战败。德国于1918年11月11日与协约国签订了停战协定，其中第二款《关于德国东部边界的规定》之第15条规定德国放弃《布加勒斯特和约》及《布列斯特-立托夫斯克和约》及其补充条约。随后苏维埃政权全俄中央执行委员会亦于11月13日通过决议单方面废除此条约，使得该条约的内容实际上成了一纸空文。12月，德国斯巴達克同盟联合不莱梅左派建立德國共產黨。

source_text: 在國際法中的治外法權（），即一項免除在地法律管轄的情形，其通常為外交談判所獲得的權限。歷史上該概念的體系基礎，可溯源到起於羅馬法的商法和海事法；而其始源體系的大多數條文約定，则来自十一世紀以降意大利城邦的實際運用。1689年中俄訂約互定被認為是中國治外法權之雛形，而有關體系的制度化，則以1843年及以後所訂各種中外條約為準。治外法權可以視為國際法秩序演化的一種反映。該項概念原初是適用於個體，皆因歷史上行使的司法管轄權通常是施加於社羣，而非施於領土。於現代，該概念也可部分地適用於實體處所，諸如賦予外交機構、外國軍事基地或聯合國機構等的豁免權。現代國際中三種公認的賦權形式，即涉及外國國家和政府首腦的個人和所有物，涉及外事使節及其他外交官的個人和所有物，以及處於公海的船隻。在較狹義範圍內，其也適用於在另一國領土上的訪問軍隊，以及在外國領水內的軍艦和公有船舶。
target_text: In 1689, the Russian-Chinese pact was considered to be China’s extraterritorial regime, and the institutionalization of the system was based on the laws of 1843 and subsequent years, as reflected in the evolution of the international legal order. The concept was originally used as a body, the jurisdiction of which was traditionally exercised in Italy’s state of affairs was usually imposed on the society, not on the land. In the present era, the concept could also be applied in parts of the territory, as in the case of diplomatic institutions, foreign military bases, or United States agencies.
title: 治外法权

source_text: 中文中「治外法權」的語境，在前期是與英美法中的「extra-territorial rights」相聯繫，強調的是西方列強法權的域外效力。後期受日本影響而實際上與「exterritoriality」相掛鈎，強調的是外交官員豁免於所在國的法律管轄。而extraterritoriality與exterritoriality在實質上是有所區別：前者「指一國法律的域外適用。即該國法律對該國境外的個人、權利及法律關系的適用」，後者在國際法上，還專指外國官員、外國元首，以及經同意進入領海的外國軍艦、軍隊等所享有的各種外交豁免權及其他特權，在這個語詞和意義下，治外法權與領事裁判權不同。20世紀初以後，日本國際法語境中脫胎而來的「治外法權」, 指的就是後者：1906年京師法律學堂由日本人岩井尊聞主講的國際公法，到後中文再出版的幾種法律辭典，均將該概念與exterritoriality並列。後來的學者們聚焦於治外法權與領事裁判權的區分, 在很大程度上僅僅是民族主義情結體現的一種特殊方式，實際上並無實質意義。
target_text: The Chinese language of "extra-territorial rights" was originally linked to "extra-territorial rights" in English and United States law, underscoring the extraterritorial effects of Western powers. The latter, influenced by Japan, was effectively associated with "exterritoriality" and stressed the immunity of diplomats from the laws of their countries. While the former term “extra-territory” and the term “extra-territoriality” in English and French law, the former term “extra-territorial” in English and French law in the United States, since the beginning of the twentieth century, has been used in international law by foreign officials, foreign heads of state and foreign heads of state, as well as by those who have agreed to enter foreign military ships, armies, etc.
title: 治外法权

哥倫比亞河流域在19世纪成为英属北美太平洋西北地区的毛皮贸易区，称作哥倫比亞地區（Columbia District），但自18世纪开始沙俄和西班牙就也对此地区进行海外扩张。而美国在1803年路易斯安那购地后，派遣路易斯和克拉克组织探险队寻找到通向太平洋海岸的路，并也对哥伦比亚河流域地区宣誓主权，称其为俄勒冈乡域（Oregon Country）。在1819年《亚当斯－奥尼斯条约》和1824年《圣彼得堡条约》之后，西班牙和沙俄先后放弃对太平洋西北地区的殖民，英美两国变成了唯一的竞争者。尽管《1818年条约》明确了北纬49度线为英美在北美的边境，哥伦比亚地区实际上是两国在共治并且争相移民的争议地区。在美墨战争之后，英美两国最终于1846年签订《俄勒冈条约》，明确规定哥伦比亚地区也以49度线划分边界。為了強調49度线以北為主权屬於英國的哥倫比亞地區，英国特意加上了前缀“英屬”。1858年，英属哥伦比亚地区正式成為英國殖民地，維多利亞女王取名為英屬哥倫比亞殖民地（），
target_text: In the 19th century, the Colombian River Basin became the British North-West Pacific, known as the Columbia Region, but it has also expanded overseas since the 18th century, when Spain and Shao abandoned their colonization of the North-West Pacific, and the United States became the only competitor. Despite the fact that the 1818 Treaty clearly identified the 49-degree north as the border between the United States and the United States in North America, the Colombian region was in fact a disputed area where the two countries co-existed and emigrated. After the 1819 war in the United States of America and the 1824 Treaty of Saint Petersburg, Spain and Shao abandoned their colonization of the North-West Pacific, and the two countries became the only competitors.

target_text: Millennium Development Goals () are the eight international development goals set out at the 2000 Millennium Summit of the United Nations, in which a commitment was formally made. source_text: 陳智雄（臺灣話：Tân Tì-hiông，），臺灣日治時期生於阿緱廳（今屏東縣中北部）。曾被派至印尼擔任外交官，第二次世界大戰之後居住在印尼，冒死參與印尼獨立革命，獨立後印尼首任總統蘇卡諾授以榮譽國民的最高榮譽。因參與台灣獨立運動成為無國籍者。為了進入日本，取得瑞士國籍。曾經擔任台灣共和國臨時政府的東南亞巡迴大使，之後遭中華民國政府於日本誘捕並處決。
target_text: Chen Ji-hoon (Taiwan: Tân Tui-hihan) was born in the Angang Hall (north-north-east of the city) in Taiwan during the time of Japanese rule. He was sent to Indonesia as a diplomat, who lived in Indonesia after World War II, risked his life to participate in the Indonesian independence revolution and, after independence, was awarded the highest honour by the first President of Indonesia, Sucano, to honour the nation’s people. He became a stateless person because of his participation in Taiwan’s independence movement. To enter Japan, he gained Swiss nationality.
title: 陳智雄

source_text:
擔任台灣共和國臨時政府駐東南亞巡迴大使
目睹印尼經由人民的奮鬥而終獲獨立的過程，陳智雄不僅萌生了台灣獨立的想法，而且決定獻身於台灣獨立運動，因此，他接受了設於日本之「台灣共和國臨時政府」大統領廖文毅的委任，擔任其駐東南亞巡迴大使一年。透過陳智雄的良好關係及人脈，廖文毅曾於1955年應邀參加了在印尼舉行的「萬隆會議」，使他的國際聲望達到了最高點。當時出席的各國代表當中，除了台灣共和國臨時政府的廖文毅以外，還包括中國的周恩來、印度的尼赫魯、埃及的納瑟、马来亚联合邦（今天的马来西亚）的東姑阿都拉曼、以及印尼的蘇卡諾。後來，由於陳智雄的關係，廖文毅也應邀參加了马来亚首相（马来西亚首相）东姑阿都拉曼的就職大典。
target_text: Having witnessed Indonesia's independence as a result of the struggle of its people, Chen Ji-Hung not only gave birth to Taiwan's idea of independence, but also decided to devote himself to Taiwan's independence movement, he accepted the appointment of Liao Wen-yi, the leader of Japan's "Taiwan Republic Government" for a year as its ambassador for South-East Asia. Through his good relations and personal ties, Liao was invited to attend the Bandung Conference in 1955 and his international reputation reached its highest point.
title: 陳智雄

source_text: 1963年在第18届联合国大会讨论召开贸易和发展会议问题时，73个亚非拉发展中国家和南斯拉夫、新西兰共同提出一个联合宣言，当时称为七十五国集团。后来肯尼亚、韩国、越南共和国（前南越）加入，新西兰宣布退出。1964年6月15日，77个国家在日内瓦召开的第一届联合国贸易和发展会议上发表了《日內瓦聯合宣言》（又称为《七十七国联合宣言》），提出了关于国际经济关系、贸易与发展的一整套主张。七十七国集团由此成立。七十七国集团不设总部、秘书处等常设机构，也没有章程或预算，每次联大或贸发会议前该组织都要举行部长会议，以研究对策，统一步调。纽约和日内瓦是七十七国集团两个主要活动中心，在维也纳和罗马等多边外交活动较多的地点均有分支。集团主席由来自亚非拉三大区域的成员国按地区原则轮流担任，任期一年。2023年主席国为古巴。
target_text: On 15 June 1964, at the first session of the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development, held in Geneva, 77 countries issued the Geneva Declaration of the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (also known as the Joint Declaration of the Seventy-seven Nations Conference on Trade and Development), which set out a set of ideas on international economic relations, trade and development. The Group was established as a result. The Group of Seventy-seven had no permanent institutions, such as headquarters, secretariat, or constitution or budget, and had to meet at the ministerial level each time before the General Assembly or UNCTAD in order to study policy responses and harmonize the pace. New York and Geneva were the two main centres of activity of the Group of Seventy-seven, with branches in various locations of multilateral diplomatic activity, such as Vienna and Rome. The Group was chaired by Member States from the three major regions of Asia and Africa, on a regional basis, for one year.
title: 七十七国集团

source_text: 代理、临时、过渡，汉语用作现代政治术语时，通常作为词的前缀即术语的前一部分，有多种形式。指国家政权、多党执政国家临时组阁的政府，如临时政府、过渡政府，看守内阁；指临时行使国家元首权利的人如临时总统、“代”总统、“非常”总统、“監國”、「權知」國事，或直接称呼“代理国家元首”；政党制政府国家，未按照法定程序产生的临时政府的首脑，或者政府中未按法定程序产生的政府首脑；地方政权中未按照法定程序产生的最高行政长官；另外还有政党、各种机构组织没有按照宪章、章程的规定临时代理的党务、事务人员。護理、署理、兼理、兼領等詞各有意義。護理為官員暫代上司的職權，署理為官員暫代同級或下屬的職權。兼理、兼領為官員同時任另一職位，如特命全權大使同時出使多個國家，兼任一國駐數國之大使（亦稱雙重委派）。
target_text: Acting, temporary, transitional, and Chinese, when used as modern political terms, is usually used as the prefix to the term, in many forms. It refers to State power, the government of a multiparty, interim State, such as the interim government, the transitional government, and the caretaker cabinet; it refers to those who temporarily exercise the powers of the Head of State, such as the interim President, the “deputy” President, the “extraordinary” President, the “supervisory State”, the “principal State”, or directly referred to as “the acting Head of State”; it refers to the head of a political party, which does not produce a provisional government in accordance with the statutory procedure, or the head of government, who does not do so in accordance with the statutory procedure; it also refers to political parties, institutions and organizations that do not act in accordance with the statutory procedure; it also refers to party affairs and service personnel who do not serve on a temporary basis in accordance with the Charter, by their statutes.
title: 代理 (政治)

source_text: 临时政府、过渡政府是指国家政权更迭时，因為国家局势混乱、新政权尚未建立，这时由社会各方力量组建临时政权。是否被外国政府控制或独立，是否享有被继承者的全部或部分主权，受现实因素影响。案例1912年，中華民國以「中華民國臨時政府」的形式於南京成立後，孫中山與黎元洪曾被推舉為「臨時大總統」，並制定《臨時約法》。2月，清帝退位。中华民国继承清朝法统，获得“中国”全部主权。至後來中華民國臨時政府北遷北京，才逐步完成中央政府的組織體系。
target_text: In 1912, after the founding of the Chinese government in Nanjing in the form of the "State of China" , Sun Nakayama and Li Wonhong were presented as “President of China in the interim” and enacted the Provisional Treaty Act. In February, the Qing Emperor withdrew. The Republic of China inherited the Qing Dynasty and acquired full sovereignty over China.
title: 臨時政府

source_text: 1947年，鉴于犹太人与阿拉伯人之间的暴力冲突不断升级，和平努力受到挫败，英国政府决定从巴勒斯坦托管地脱身。联合国成立了“巴勒斯坦专门委员会”，1947年11月联合国大会表决了《1947年联合国分治方案》，33国赞成（包括美国和苏联），13国反对，10国弃权（包括英国），通过决议：将巴勒斯坦地区再分为两个国家，犹太人和阿拉伯人分别拥有大约55%和45%的领土，联合国將耶路撒冷置于其管理之下，以期避免冲突。分治方案在已开发领土上大致采取照顾传统聚居点、按人口比例均分的原则，结果划出多块相互交错的领土；考虑到未来大量犹太难民的迁入，将南部人烟稀少的沙漠地区内盖夫划入犹太国，故犹太人以1/3的人口获得了55%的领土。联大决议使当时实际只控制了巴勒斯坦6%的土地和只占巴勒斯坦人口1/3的犹太人得到了巴勒斯坦地区56%的土地（约1.52万平方公里），而已经控制了巴勒斯坦94%的土地和占巴勒斯坦人口2/3的阿拉伯人仅得到43%的土地（约1.15万平方公里）。联合国通过分治方案的当日，大卫·本-古理安接受了分治方案，但阿拉伯国家联盟认为联合国无权插手当地事务不予接受，而占领/托管国英国则对决议表决弃权。
target_text: In 1947, in the light of the escalating violence between Jews and Arabs and the frustration of the peace efforts, the British Government decided to leave the Palestine Trust. The United Nations Specialized Committee on Palestine was established in November 1947. The United Nations General Assembly voted on the 1947 United Nations partition programme, with 33 States in favour (including the United States and the Soviet Union), 13 States in opposition, 10 States in opposition, and 10 States in abstention (including the United Kingdom), adopted a resolution to divide Palestinian areas into two States, with approximately 55 per cent and 45 per cent of the Jewish and Arab population, respectively, and the United Nations placed Jerusalem under its administration with a view to avoiding the conflict. The partition programme, which largely adopted the principle of caring for traditional concentrations and proportional distribution of the population in the already developed territories, resulted in the division of several overlapping territories; given the future influx of a large number of Jewish refugees, the occupation of the southern desert area was divided into a Jewish State, and the Jewish population of one third gained 55 per cent of the territory.
title: 以巴冲突

source_text: 2018年5月14日，美國駐以色列耶路撒冷大使館開幕，正值以色列的獨立日，亦是巴勒斯坦「災難節」的前一日。加沙地帶爆發新一輪示威反對美國和以色列，批評兩國認定耶路撒冷為以色列的首都，侵佔巴勒斯坦的主權。其後以色列警方開槍鎮壓示威，超過50人死亡、至少2,000人受傷。巴勒斯坦人稱之為「大屠殺」，外界相信此次示威為近年以巴衝突中最血腥的一日。多國批評以色列的行動，其中土耳其更加驅逐外交官，以色列則以對方不尊重外交禮儀為由，驅逐土耳其外交官。而美國則支持以色列，指責哈馬斯挑起衝突。
target_text: On May 14, 2018, the United States Embassy in Israel in Jerusalem opened, on Israel’s Independence Day, the day before the Palestinian Disaster Day. A new wave of demonstrations broke out in Gaza against the United States and Israel, criticizing the two countries for recognizing Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and usurping Palestinian sovereignty.
title: 以巴冲突

source_text: 巴勒斯坦總統阿巴斯在第一時間聲明不會參與此「世紀協議」任何討論，其認為計劃本身「荒謬可悲」根本毫無約束力能強制美國守約做到其給予的油水，同時主權與意識形態不是可交易商品，不會看在錢的角度賣掉聖城耶路撒冷，同時美國本土的學者，曾擔任美驻埃及和以色列大使的普林斯頓教授库尔泽發推特文表示，看完這川普女婿籌畫兩年的世紀計畫，若是一張本科生考卷他只能給個「C」他評論可看出整群撰寫者都是對中東一無所知甚至從沒去過的人，中東問題若是如此簡易便不會成為超過半世紀以來多國外交菁英都無解的死題。

source_text: 然而瑙魯原住民並沒有充分運用這些財富，隨著磷酸鹽儲量的枯竭和採礦帶來的環境惡化，再加上管理全島財富基金的減值，瑙魯政府求助於一些不尋常的方法來獲得收入。在1990年代，瑙魯成為一個避稅天堂和洗錢中心。从2001年至2008年及自2012年起，瑙魯接受澳大利亞政府的援助，並建立一個拘留所處理非法進入澳大利亞的難民以作為回報。由於嚴重依赖澳大利亞，因此瑙鲁也被认为是澳大利亚的仆从国。在外交方面，瑙鲁是联合国会员国，同时也是太平洋岛国论坛、英联邦以及非洲、加勒比和太平洋国家集团的成员国。
target_text: In the 1990s, Nauru became a tax haven and money-laundering centre. From 2001 to 2008 and 2012, Nauru received assistance from the Australian government and set up a detention facility to deal with refugees who entered Australia illegally, in return for their environmental degradation as a result of the depletion of phosphate reserves and the erosion of mining, as well as the reduction in the value of the island’s wealth fund, and Nauru is considered to be a servant of Australia. In diplomacy, Nauru is a member of the United Nations, as well as of the Pacific Islands Forum, the Commonwealth, and the African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States.
title: 諾魯

source_text: 瑙魯利用其联合国成员的地位，多次透過承認某些国家的主權以獲得资金上的援助。1980年8月，瑙魯与阿尔及利亚建交后，又宣布承认阿拉伯撒哈拉民主共和国，阿尔及利亚此后每年给予瑙魯1,000万美元经濟援助，直至其2000年撤销承认阿拉伯撒哈拉民主共和国為止。1980年5月4日，瑙魯與中華民國政府建交；但是，2002年瑙魯與中華人民共和國簽署協議，宣佈在当年7月21日建立外交关系，同時獲得1.3億美元捐助，兩天後中華民國宣佈與諾魯斷交。2005年5月14日，瑙魯與中華民國政府恢復外交關係，同年5月31日與中華人民共和國政府斷交。2008年，瑙魯在持续得到欧盟、美国、澳大利亚和新西兰的财政支持后承認科索沃獨立，但这一承认已在2019年撤销；2009年，瑙魯承認阿布哈茲和南奥塞梯，是承認此地區主權的第四個國家，而俄罗斯以5,000萬美元資金作為人道主义援助之回報。2008年7月15日，瑙魯宣布一项港口翻新计划（並於2011年初完成），資金來自俄羅斯的900萬美元发展援助。瑙魯官方聲稱此援助與承认阿布哈兹和南奥塞梯無關。
target_text: On 4 May 1980, Nauru made use of its membership in the United Nations to obtain financial assistance through the recognition of the sovereign rights of certain countries. In August 1980, when Nauru and Algeria established a diplomatic relationship with Algeria, they announced the recognition of the Saharawi Arab Democratic Republic, after which Algeria provided $10 million annually until 2000, when the recognition of the Saharawi Arab Democratic Republic was withdrawn. On 31 May 1980, Nauru and the Government of the Republic of China established a relationship; however, in 2008, Nauru, after sustained financial support from the European Union, the United States, Australia and New Zealand, announced the declaration of Kosovo independence, but this recognition was withdrawn in 2019; in 2009, Noah and South Ossetia resumed diplomatic relations with the Saharawi Arab Democratic Republic until the end of 2000.

source_text: 自1918年11月波兰重返独立起到1922年，毕苏斯基一直是波兰的“国家元首”。1919年至1921年间，他在波苏战争中统领波兰军队。1923年，以民族民主党为主的反对派控制波兰政府，这时毕苏斯基淡出政坛。三年后的1926年5月，他发动政变，并重新回到权力中心，成为波兰“事实上的”独裁者。一位意大利驻华沙大使称他是“掩藏在旧世界骑士外表之下的自由民主主义者”。毕苏斯基自政变到1935年逝世为止一直集中精力于波兰的军事和外交领域。
target_text: Three years later, in May 1926, he staged a coup d'état and returned to the centre of power, becoming a “de facto” dictator in Poland. An Italian ambassador in Warsaw called him “the liberal democrats who hid behind the old knights of the world.” Bizuki focused on the military and diplomatic fields of Poland until the coup d'état passed away in 1935.
title: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基

source_text: 这一时期依然有两个彼此独立的政府自称为波兰的合法政府：毕苏斯基的华沙政府和德莫夫斯基的巴黎政府。为了确保波兰只有一个政府，避免内战的发生，帕德雷夫斯基会见德莫夫斯基和毕苏斯基，劝他们联合起来。巴黎和会时，德莫夫斯基和帕德雷夫斯基代表波兰出席，而毕苏斯基担任临时的国家元首和总司令。凡尔赛条约的第87至93条和小凡尔赛条约使波兰独立主权国的地位在国际领域中得到确立。
target_text: In order to ensure that there is only one government in Poland to avoid civil war, Padrewski met with Demowski and Picsowski to persuade them to unite. During the Paris peace conference, Demowski and Padrewski represented Poland, while Bishowski served as interim Head of State and Commander-in-Chief.
title: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基

source_text: 1921年2月，毕苏斯基访问巴黎，在那里他与法国总统亚历山大·米勒兰谈判，以将成立法波同盟一事确定下来，而这一同盟将在同一年晚些时候正式建立。象征波苏战争结束的里加条约在1921年签署，条约规定俄罗斯和波兰将瓜分白俄罗斯和乌克兰。毕苏斯基称这份条约是“懦弱条约”。 另外，毕苏斯基准许将军卢茨扬·热利戈夫斯基从立陶宛人手中夺下维尔纽斯，这件事和里加条约为毕苏斯基将“海间联邦”计划付诸实践之行动画上句号。
target_text: In February 1921, Bishowski visited Paris, where he negotiated with the French President, Alexander Millarland, to finalize the establishment of the Farpo Alliance, which will be formally established later in the same year. The Riga Treaty, which symbolized the end of the Persian war, was signed in 1921, according to which Russia and Poland would divide Belarus and Ukraine.
title: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基

source_text: 作为法波联盟和波罗联盟（小协约国的一环）的支持者，毕苏斯基为法国和英国在签署洛迦诺条约时显而易见的绥靖政策感到失望。 毕苏斯基因此也致力于与苏联和德国保持良好关系；故毕苏斯基与上述两大强邻签署互不侵犯条约，分别是1932年的苏波互不侵犯条约和1934年的德波互不侵犯条约。签署这两份条约的目的是加强波兰在其盟友与邻国眼中的地位。
target_text: As supporters of the French-Photo Union and the Polo Union (a link to the Small Concord States), Bissowski was disappointed by France’s and Britain’s apparent policy of appeasement at the time of the signing of the Logano Treaty. As a result, Bissowski was committed to good relations with the Soviet Union and Germany; thus, Bissowski signed non-aggression treaties with the two major neighbors, the Sopo Non-Aggression Treaty of 1932 and the Depo Non-Aggression Treaty of 1934, respectively.
title: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基

source_text: 毕苏斯基明白这些条约只是一纸空文，并论到：“签订这些条约，我们就像是跨坐两条板凳。这种日子不会太久。我们要知道我们先是因为哪条板凳而摔倒，我们也要知道我们什么时候才会摔倒。”有人为签订上述两份不侵犯条约一事对毕苏斯基提出批评，并谴责他低估了希特勒的野心并给了德国重整军备的时间；还让斯大林能够排除异己（特别是在乌克兰），而这些异己正是毕苏斯基的普罗米修斯计划所扶持的。
target_text: Bishowski understood that the treaties were a dead letter, and said, “In signing them, we are like sitting on two benches. Such days will not be long. We need to know which bench we fell first, and we need to know when we will fall.” Some criticized Bjsowski for signing these two non-aggression pacts and condemned him for underestimating Hitler’s ambitions and giving Germany time to rearmament; and allowed Stalin to rule out differences (especially in Ukraine), which were supported by the Pjsuki’s Prometheus plan.
title: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基

source_text: 在阿道夫·希特勒于1933年1月取得权力后，就有传言称毕苏斯基建议法国发起对德的预防性战争。当时的德国已经违抗《凡尔赛和约》，公然扩充军备，而此事表明了毕苏斯基曾试探过法国在对德展开军事行动一事上。法国的冷漠回應也许成为了波兰在1934年1月签署德波互不侵犯条约的原因。但是兩國間的外交文献从未提到毕苏斯基曾提出过这样的发起预防性战争的建议。
target_text: When Adolf Hitler took power in January 1933, there were rumours that Bishowski had proposed to France a preventive war against Germany. Germany had already defied the Versailles Treaty and openly expanded its armaments, a fact that showed that Bjsowski had tested France’s military action against Germany.
title: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基

source_text: 12月19日，日本外務大臣有田在東京約見中國駐日大使許世英。有田還公開表示：「中央政府如在抗日容共條件下與張學良妥協，日本決強硬反對。」為支持何「討逆」，通電關東軍停止對綏遠軍事行動，關東軍聲明要求國民政府實行「反共防共」，日本將「不惜給予援助」，日本外相召見駐日本大使許世英表示日本政府不能坐視南京與張、楊妥協。英國駐東京大使克萊夫在發給倫敦外交電報中描述日本立場：日本採取觀望態度，同時幾乎毫不掩飾得意心情，覺得世人現在一定已經認識到，正像日本人一向知道，中國人是不可救藥。12月21日，駐日使川樾奉命外交部長張群提出上述同樣警告，並聲明張學良所提八項主張，在「思想上和日本為東亞大局着眼的根本方針，恰正相反」。

source_text: 20世纪下半叶，阿根廷总统胡安·裴隆声称对群岛拥有主权，英国和阿根廷之间的关系日趨緊張。60年代期间，联合国通过了一项非殖民化的决议案，阿根廷认为这一决议案对自己的立场有利，两国间的主权争端于是愈演愈烈。1965年，联合国大会通过第2065号决议案，呼吁两国展开双边谈判，以和平手段解决争端。1966年至1968年，英国就移交福克兰群岛同阿根廷进行秘密谈判，认为群岛居民会接受这样的安排。1971年，双方就群岛和大陆间的贸易关系达成协议，阿根廷因此于1972年在斯坦利建成了一座临时机场。然而，福克兰群岛居民对此提出了异议，并通过强力游说英国议会表明了立场，再加上英国和阿根廷的紧张关系，双方的谈判一直冻结到了1977年。
target_text: In the second half of the twentieth century, Argentine President Juan Perón claimed sovereignty over the Islands, and relations between the United Kingdom and Argentina became tense. During the 1960s, the United Nations adopted a resolution on decolonization, which Argentina considered to be in its favour, and the sovereignty dispute between the two countries intensified. In 1965, the United Nations General Assembly adopted resolution 2065, calling for bilateral negotiations between the two countries to resolve the dispute by peaceful means.
title: 福克兰群岛

source_text: 1979年，撒切尔夫人当选英国首相，由于政府面临预算削减，而维持对福克兰群岛的统治又需要一定的费用，英国再次考虑将群岛主权移交阿根廷。实质性的主权谈判在1981年再度中止，双方的争端随时间的推移持续升级。1982年4月，阿根廷入侵福克兰群岛和英国在南大西洋的其他领地，分歧升级成了武装冲突，两个多月后，英国远征军重新夺回了包括福克兰群岛在内的所有领地。战争结束后，英国扩充了军力，增加了群岛的驻军规模，还建成了芒特普莱森特皇家空军基地。这场战争还遗留下了117片雷区，其中包含有近两万枚车辆和人员杀伤地雷。由于出现了大量伤亡，初步排雷作业于1983年中止。排雷作业于2009年重新开始，并于2020年10月完成。
target_text: In 1979, Mrs. Thatcher was elected Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and once again considered transferring sovereignty over the Islands to Argentina, owing to budget cuts faced by the Government and costs associated with maintaining the Falkland Islands. Substantive sovereignty negotiations were suspended again in 1981 and disputes between the two sides continued to escalate. In April 1982, the Argentine invasion of the Falkland Islands and other British territories in the South Atlantic escalated into an armed conflict and, more than two months later, British expeditionary forces regained all territories, including the Falkland Islands. After the war, Britain expanded its military capacity, increased its presence in the Islands, and built the Royal Mount Pleasant Air Force base. The war left over 117 minefields, including nearly 20,000 vehicles and anti-personnel mines. Initial demining operations were suspended in 1983 as a result of heavy casualties.
title: 福克兰群岛

source_text: 根据沙克尔顿勳爵的建议，福克兰群岛的经济活动从以绵羊为基础的单一养殖业发展成渔业、旅游业和绵羊养殖业的混合产业，群岛上还建立了专属经济区。原有的道路网络得到拓展，快活岭空军基地的建成也让岛上可以起降长途航班。石油勘探也已启动，并且有迹象显示福克兰群岛盆地有望开展商业开采。2009年，英国根据《渥太华条约》中规定的义务开始再度展开地雷清除工作，到了2012年，萨伯山区域的地雷已经清除，这一拥有历史里程碑意义的地区得以在30年来首次对外界开放。1990年，阿根廷和英国重新建立了外交关系，但由于无法对未来主权讨论的条款达成一致，双边关系自重建以来就在不断恶化。两国政府间的纠纷已经导致“一些分析师预测，由于近期福克兰群岛周边水域捕鱼业的扩张……阿根廷和英国之间的利益冲突将日益加剧”。
target_text: According to the proposal of Lord Shackleton, economic activity in the Falkland Islands has evolved from a single sheep-based farming industry to a mixed industry of fishing, tourism and sheep farming, and the Islands have also established an exclusive economic zone. The original road network has been expanded, and the construction of a Happy Ridge airbase has allowed long-distance flights to take place on the island. Oil exploration has also been initiated, and there are indications that commercial mining is expected in the Falkland Islands Basin. In 2009, Britain began a new mine clearance exercise in accordance with its obligations under the Ottawa Treaty. By 2012, mines had been cleared in the Saber region, a historic landmark area that was opened to the outside world for the first time in 30 years. In 1990, Argentina and Britain re-established diplomatic relations, but bilateral relations have deteriorated since the reconstruction, owing to a lack of agreement on the terms of future sovereignty discussions.
title: 福克兰群岛

source_text: 福克兰群岛属自治英国海外领土。根据2009年通过的宪法，群岛拥有充分的内部自治权，英国只负责外交和军事事务，保留军事力量“保护英国利益并确保领地整体上得到良好治理”。英国君主是国家元首，福克兰群岛总督代表君主行使行政权力，他还可以根据立法议员的建议任命行政长官。总督和行政长官都是政府首脑。现任总督艾莉森·布萊克于2022年7月获得任命，现任行政长官则是在2021年4月得到委任。英國現任主管福克兰群岛事務的官員是扎克·戈德史密斯，他负责管理英国有关群岛的外交政策。
target_text: The Falkland Islands are a self-governing British Overseas Territory. According to the Constitution adopted in 2009, the Islands have full internal self-government. The United Kingdom is responsible only for foreign and military affairs. It retains military power “to protect British interests and ensure good governance of the Territory as a whole.” The British monarch is the Head of State, and the Governor of the Falkland Islands exercises executive power on behalf of the Falkland Islands; he may appoint the Administrator on the advice of the Legislative Assembly. Both the Governor and the Chief Executive are heads of government. The current Governor, Alison Black, was appointed in July 2022, and the current Chief Executive was appointed in April 2021.
title: 福克兰群岛

source_text: 在英國脫歐前，福克兰群岛曾經因为与英国之间的联系而成为欧洲联盟海外国家和地区的一份子。群岛的司法系统主要沿襲英国法律，受外交及联邦事务部监督，宪法中还将领地与《欧洲人权公约》的各项原则相结合。居民有权上诉至欧洲人权法院和英国枢密院。皇家福克兰群岛警察负责执法，对群岛的军事防御则由英国提供。群岛上有英国军队驻守，福克兰群岛政府还提供资金组建了一个额外的连级轻装步兵部队，称为。根据《联合国海洋法公约》，福克兰群岛领海从其沿海基线向外延伸200海里（相当于370公里），但这一边界与阿根廷的海上边界出现了重叠。
target_text: The Falkland Islands were once part of the European Union overseas countries and territories because of their links with the United Kingdom. The Territory’s judicial system was largely based on British law, monitored by the Foreign and Commonwealth Office, and the Territory was constitutionally integrated with the principles of the European Convention on Human Rights. Residents had the right to appeal to the European Court of Human Rights and the British Privy Council. The Royal Falkland Islands Police were responsible for law enforcement, while military defence of the Islands was provided by the United Kingdom. The Islands were manned by British troops, and the Falkland Islands Government had funded the formation of an additional company-size light infantry unit called the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.
title: 福克兰群岛

source_text: 英国和阿根廷都声称拥有福克兰群岛的主权，被列入联合国非自治领土名单。英国的立场是：福克兰群岛的人民没有表现出变革的意愿，并且不存在任何有关群岛且悬而未决的问题。英国这些立场源于其自1833年起对群岛的持续管理（仅有1982年阿根廷短暂占领群岛期间例外），并且岛上居民“根据《联合国宪章》拥有自决权”。阿根廷方面政策坚持认为，福克兰群岛人没有自决的权利，声称英国在1833年以“更强大的武力”威胁驱逐了群岛上的阿根廷当局和居民，并且从此以后禁止阿根廷人民到群岛上定居。阿根廷坚称于1816年独立时从西班牙手中继承了群岛的主权，因此英国1833年的占领属于非法行为。
target_text: Both the United Kingdom and Argentina claim sovereignty over the Falkland Islands and are included in the United Nations list of Non-Self-Governing Territories. The British position is that the people of the Falkland Islands have not shown the will to change and that there are no pending issues concerning the Islands. These British positions stem from their continued administration of the Islands since 1833 (with the exception of Argentina's brief 1982 occupation of the Islands) and the fact that the islanders “have the right to self-determination in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations.” The Argentine policy maintains that the Falkland Islanders have no right to self-determination, claiming that the British threatened to expel the Argentine authorities and residents of the Islands in 1833 by “greater force” and that the Argentine people were henceforth prohibited from settling on the Islands. Argentina maintained that sovereignty over the Islands was inherited from Spain at independence in 1816, and that the British occupation of 1833 was therefore illegal.
title: 福克兰群岛

source_text: 地理北塞浦路斯位于塞浦路斯岛北部，国土多山脉和丘陵，最高点塞尔维利峰海拔1024米。属亚热带地中海型气候，夏季炎热干燥，平均气温28－35℃，冬季温和湿润，气温4－10℃。外交北塞浦路斯土耳其共和国目前只得到联合国会员国土耳其共和国的外交承认，并互设大使馆；阿塞拜疆共和国的自治共和国：纳希切万自治共和国较早前也宣佈承认了北塞浦路斯土耳其共和国，但未设立正式外交机构，亦不是主权国家。
target_text: The geographical north of Cyprus is located in the northern part of the island, with a multi-mounty and hilly country with a peak of 1024 metres above Mount Servili. It is a subtropical Mediterranean climate with a hot and dry summer, with an average temperature of 28-35°C and a warm and humid winter, with a temperature of 4-10°C. The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus currently receives diplomatic recognition and an embassy of the Republic of Turkey, a State Member of the United Nations, and the Republic of Azerbaijan ' s autonomous republic, the Nakhichevan Autonomous Republic, has earlier declared its recognition of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus without establishing a formal diplomatic body or a sovereign State.
title: 北賽普勒斯

source_text: 在這兩個基地區英軍設置有軍營、監聽站等設施，與最重要的（RAF Akrotiri），是英國在地中海地區唯一一個有長期派駐單位的空軍基地。除此之外，位於島東南的德凱利亞（Dhekelia）基地正好位於目前是由联合国維和部隊負責的緩衝帶「綠線」（Green Line）之上，包括以联合国名義出兵協助維安與原本的基地區駐軍，英國一共有約3,500人的部隊長期駐留在賽普勒斯島上。
target_text: In addition, the Dhekelia base, located in the southeast of the island, is located on the Green Line, which is now the buffer belt of the United Nations security forces, including the United Nations-sponsored presence of some 3,500 British troops on the island.
title: 亞克羅提利與德凱利亞

source_text: 1896年6月3日，中俄签订《御敌互相援助条约》即《中俄密約》。条约中將中國東北不少權益拱手讓予俄方，以尋求俄國的「保護」以抗衡日本，使國門大開，俄軍此後能長驅直入北京。如達成租借旅順港協議，1897年12月，一支俄國艦隊出現在旅順港。此舉同时解決了沙俄海軍需要不凍港的需求，並在當地修築防御工事，及部署艦隊。条约亦约定，中国允许俄国通过黑龙江、吉林修筑一条铁路至海参崴，便于俄国运输军队。在1897至1903年間，俄國與清政府在东北建造了一條由哈尔滨通过瀋陽到旅顺港的東清鐵路。東清鐵路由清政府及俄國共同擁有，这不仅是一条铁路，还包括铁路沿线区域的管辖权，管理權由雙方分担，這條使用俄國軌距的鐵路由駐东北俄軍保護下建造。鐵路公司總部設於俄建新城市哈尔滨。
target_text: On 3 June 1896, the Russian Federation signed the Treaty on Mutual Assistance between the Russians and the Russian Federation. The Treaty gave the Russian side a lot of power in the north-east of China to seek “protection” from Japan and to open the country’s doors so that Russian troops could move into Beijing. In December 1897, the Russian government built a new railway road in the north-east from Harbin to the capital of the capital. The road to the south-east was co-owned by the Qingqing government and the Russian Federation, not only by a railway, but also by the jurisdiction of the region along the railways, in order to facilitate Russian transport. In 1897-1903, the Russian government and the Qing Government built a new railway road in the north-east of the country to protect the city.
title: 日俄战争

source_text: 在接到《七项撤军新条件》的第二天，清廷外务部官员将俄国《七项撤军新条件》的內容透露给日本驻华外交官。日本与俄国进行交涉，要求俄军撤退，但遭俄方拒绝。1903年日俄談判破裂。1904年2月6日日本向俄國發出最後通牒，並宣佈斷絕日俄外交關係。1904年2月8日，日本海軍在未宣戰的情況下攻擊停泊在旅顺港的俄罗斯旅順舰队。2月9日俄國對日宣戰。2月10日，日本政府亦正式對俄羅斯政府宣戰，日俄戰爭爆發。
target_text: On February 6, 1904, Japan issued an ultimatum to the Russian Federation and announced its dissolution of the Russian diplomatic relations. On February 8, 1904, the Japanese Navy attacked the Russian naval fleet stationed in Hong Kong without a declaration of war. On February 9, the Russian government declared a war against Japan. On February 10, the Japanese government also officially declared war against the Russian government.
title: 日俄战争

source_text: 1904年戰時，日本與韓國簽定第一次日韓協約，朝鮮任用日本政府推薦的財政及外交顧問。1905年它與俄國議和後，俄國承認日本政府對韓國的指導及監督權，隨即簽定第二次日韓協約，將韓國的外交權移轉給日本，使它成為日本的保護國，並設立統監府。1909年簽定第三次日韓協約，取得內政權並解散軍隊，並於1910年被日本併吞。
target_text: During the 1904 war, Japan and Korea signed the first Japan-Korean agreement to appoint a financial and diplomatic adviser recommended by the Japanese government. In 1905, Russia recognized the Japanese government’s direction and supervision of Korea, immediately signed the second Japan-South Korea agreement, transferred South Korea’s diplomatic authority to Japan, made it a protectorate of Japan, and set up a supervisory authority. In 1909, it signed the third Japan-South Korea agreement, gained internal political authority and dissolved the army, and was annexed to Japan in 1910.
title: 日俄战争

source_text: 《樸茨茅斯和约》（，或，）是由日本和俄国在美国总统西奥多·罗斯福的调停下，於1905年9月5日在美国缅因州基特里的（因离新罕布什尔州的樸茨茅斯市不远而得名）签署的和约，结束了日俄战争。《樸茨茅斯和约》的签订标志着日本和俄国对中国东北与朝鲜半岛的重新瓜分。条约签订后，日本派代表与清朝政府代表交涉“东三省善后事宜”，通过《中日会议东三省事宜条约》使清政府承认日俄《樸茨茅斯和约》中给予日本的各项权利。
target_text: The signing of the Paktsmouth and the Treaty marked the re-splitting of Japan and Russia from the north-east of China to the Korean peninsula. Following the signing of the Treaty, Japan sent representatives of Japan to negotiate with the representatives of the Qing and the People's Republic of China on “Worse and the Afterlife in the Three Provinces of East Provinces”, and the adoption of the Treaty on the Three Provinces of the China-Japan Conference led the Qing Government to recognize Japan's rights under the Treaty on the North-East and the Treaty on the North-East of New Hampshire.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text:
背景
日军于1895年（光緒二十一年）在甲午战争中击败清军后，双方签订的《马关条约》中規定將辽东半岛等处割讓給日本。但該约簽署後六天受俄国、法國及德国的干涉，要求日本归还辽东半岛给中国，史称三国干涉。同年11月8日，中、日雙方又簽訂了《遼南條約》（《中日交還奉天省南邊地方條約》），日本被迫同意由清廷支付「贖遼費」以贖回辽东半岛。其後，俄国以「還遼有功」為名，向清政府租借旅順和大連兩港，將勢力伸入南满洲。尽管日本被迫在外交上妥协，但对三国尤其是俄国的行为非常不满。
target_text: The Japanese army, after defeating the Qing army during the midday war, in 1895 (Word for 21 years), provided for Japan to be ceded to the Liaodong Peninsula, among others. But six days after the signing of the Treaty, Japan was called upon by Russia, France, and Germany to return the Liaodong Peninsula to China, which it has called intervention by the three countries. On 8 November of the same year, China and Japan signed the South China Treaty (a treaty to return to the southern part of the province of China).
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text: 第三条 日俄两国互相约定各事如下；一、除辽东半岛租借权所及之地域不计外， 所有在满洲之兵，当按本条约附约第一款所定，由两国同时全数撤退；二、除前记之地域外，现被日俄两国军队占领及管理之满洲全部，交还中國接收，施行政务；俄国政府声明在满洲之领土上利益，或优先的让与，或专属的让与，有侵害中國主权及有违机会均等主义各，一概无之。
target_text: Article III. The Russian and Russian sides agree on the following matters: First, with the exception of the territory covered by the Liaodong Peninsula tenancy rights, all soldiers in Manchuria shall be withdrawn simultaneously by the two countries in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1 of the annex to this Treaty; secondly, all the continents occupied and administered by the Russian and Russian forces shall be returned to China for reception and administration, with the exception of the territories previously mentioned; and the Russian Government shall declare that its interests in the territory of Manchuria, or preferential concessions, or exclusive concessions, are incompatible with China ' s sovereignty and with the principle of equality of opportunity.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text: 第九条 俄国政府允将库页岛南部及其附近一切岛屿，并各该处之一切公共营造物及财产之主权，永远让与日本政府；其让与地域之北方境界，以北纬五十度为起点，至该处确界须按照本条约附约第二条所载为准。日俄两国彼此商允在库页岛及其附近岛屿之各自所属领地内，不筑造堡垒及类于堡垒之军事上工作物；又两国约定凡军事上之措置有碍于宗谷海峡及鞑靼海峡航行自由者，不得施设。
target_text: Article IX The Russian Government undertakes to grant permanent sovereignty over the southern part of the island and all the islands surrounding it, and over all the public works and property therein, to the Government of Japan; its boundary with the northern part of the territory, starting at 50 degrees north latitude, until such time as the boundary is established in accordance with the provisions of article II of the present Treaty. The two countries agree with each other to refrain from building forts and military objects similar to forts in the respective territories of the islands on and around the island; and the two countries agree that military measures shall not be imposed on persons who impede the freedom of navigation in the Straits of Zonggu and Tatar.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text: 第十二条 日俄通商航海条约，因此次战争作废，日本国政府及俄国政府允诺以开战前所施行之条约为本，另订通商航海新约；其未定以前，所有进口税、出口税、关章、子口税、船钞，并代表臣民船舶，由此国进彼国领土或由彼国进此国领土时之许可及待遇，均照相待最优之国办理。
target_text: Article XII. The Treaty between Japan and the Russian Federation on Merchant and Maritime Navigation, as a result of which the war was declared null and void, and the Government of Japan and the Russian Federation have promised to make a new agreement on commercial navigation based on the treaties in force prior to the war; all import duties, export duties, customs seals, sub-customs, boat bills and ships representing its subjects, from which the permission and treatment of the States entering the territory of the other State or of the other State entering the territory of the other State shall be treated in the best manner.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text: 日俄两国政府一俟交还俘虏完毕后，将虏犯自被掳或投降之日起至死亡或交换之日止，所有因照管：及留养该犯之一切费用细帐互相交换后，俄国政府应将日本实用数目中，除去俄国实用数目，尚差若干，当由俄国从速偿还日本。第十四条 本条约当由日本国皇帝陛下及全俄国皇帝陛下批准，从速在华盛顿互换，自签字之日起，无论如何当于五十日以内，由驻扎日本之法国公使及驻扎俄国之美国大使，各通知驻在国政府，宣布之后，本条约即全部生效。
target_text: Once the prisoners have been returned, the Russian and Russian Governments will take prisoners from the date of their abduction or surrender until the date of their death or exchange. After all the details of the costs of keeping the prisoners have been exchanged, the Russian Government shall remove the practical amount of Japan from Russia, which is a few short of it, and pay it back as soon as possible. Article XIV. This Treaty shall be ratified by His Majesty the Emperor of Japan and His Majesty the All-Russian Emperor, exchanged in Washington, D.C., as soon as possible, and, in any case, within fifty days from the date of its signature, by the French ambassador in Japan and by the Ambassador of the United States in Russia, who shall notify the Government of Japan and declare that it shall enter into force in its entirety.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text:
第十五条 本条约缮就英文法文各两本，分别签字，其本文虽全然符合，设有解释不同之处，以法文为准。为此两国全权委员署名盖印，以昭信守。

source_text: 第一条 此条应附于正约第三条。日俄两国政府彼此商允，一候讲和条约施行后即将满洲地域内军队同时开始撤退；自讲和条约施行之日起，以十八个月为限，所有两国在满洲之军队除辽东半岛租借地外，一律撤退。两国占领阵地之前敌军队当先行撤退。
target_text: Article I should be annexed to article III of the Treaty. The Russian and Russian Governments have agreed to withdraw their troops in Manchuria at the same time as the treaty will be in force; from the date of the treaty, all their troops in Manchuria will withdraw, with the exception of land on the Liaodong peninsula, for a period of 18 months. The enemy forces will withdraw before the two countries occupy their positions.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text: 该条约于1905年10月4日由日本枢密院批准。尽管日本通过条约取得了很多收获，包括得到了半个库页岛等，但这并不是日本民众原先预期中的结果，因为日本在最初的谈判中已要求俄国割让整个库页岛并赔偿军费等，一部份右翼積極分子更主張將伊爾庫茨克以東的俄國領土割讓給日本。这种落差所造成的挫折和不满情绪引发了同年的日比谷縱火事件，而桂太郎內閣亦于次年1月總辭。
target_text: The Treaty was ratified by the Privy Council of Japan on 4 October 1905. While Japan has achieved much through the Treaty, including half of the island, this is not the result that Japan’s people had originally expected, since Japan, in its initial negotiations, had asked Russia to cede the entire island and to compensate for military expenses, and a portion of the right-wing activists were more than willing to cede the territory of the Russians east of Irkutsk to Japan.
title: 朴茨茅斯和约

source_text: 政治八國聯軍直接造成義和團被消滅，以及京津一帶清軍的潰敗，迫使慈禧太后挾光緒帝逃往陝西西安；最終清廷被迫與包含派兵八國在內的十一國簽訂《辛丑条約》，付出賠款，簽条约允许各国在北京驻军及构筑永久要塞。八国联军之役後，主事义和团虽已被报复，外国人安全问题也已解决，但各国藉口防止排外事件再度發生，遂把北京分成不同的占领区駐軍，实行军事统治。日占区还设立“安民公所”，德占区设立了“华捕局”。清朝政府付出庞大的赔款，并丧失多项国家主权，华北大乱之际，东南各省督抚自行宣布中立，从此清中央政府权威低落，汉族权臣抬头，客观而言，八国联军加速清朝的灭亡，后来美国向清政府减少约1千万两白银的赔款，退款主要用于清朝向美国派遣公费留学生，清华大学也是在这样的背景下建立，美国的两次退款，产生很大的国际影响，加上第一次世界大战后，中華民國也是战胜国，因此停止对战败的德、奥赔款支付；各国都表示愿与中華民國“友好”，以便用和平的办法维护和扩张其在华利益，所以都紧跟美国的腳步，其中英、日、荷三国将庚款余额修改偿付办法，一方面间接促进中国向西方学习的进程，另一方面，加强列强对中国的控制，另外，俄国十月革命胜利后，苏俄於1920年宣布放弃俄国部分的庚款余额。
target_text: While the G-8 forces have directly caused the demise of the G-8 troops, and the collapse of the Qing army in Kingjin, forcing the Qingqin Empire to flee to Xianxian, where they have finally been forced to sign the “Sin Qin Treaty” with 11 countries including the G-8, paying damages and signing treaties allowing countries to establish permanent strongholds in Beijing. The GDR has also set up an “Among House” and the Dynasty District has set up a “Find Bureau”; China has paid a huge sum of compensation to the government and has lost a number of its national sovereignty; China’s provinces have declared their own neutrality, the control of the central government has been weakened, the Han has raised, and the U.S.
title: 八國聯軍

source_text:
名称含义
中国方面，早年将其称为“旅大租地”（例如1898年《旅大租地条约》、《续订旅大租地条约》）、“辽东半岛租地”（1898年《东省铁路公司续订合同》）等，在吸收日语“租借地”后，逐渐使用“旅大租借地”。至1923年要求归还旅大运动时，“旅大租借地”一词已经为中国社会广泛使用，学术界也逐渐严格区分租界和租借地。
target_text: On the Chinese side, earlier in the year, it had been referred to as a “troop lease” (e.g., the 1898 Treaty on Brigade Tenancy, the renewal of the Treaty on Brigade Tenancy), the “Liaodong Peninsula Rent” (the 1898 Renewed Contract for Eastern Province Railways), etc., and after absorbing Japanese-language “rent land”, the term “troop lease” was gradually used. By 1923, the word “troop lease” had been widely used in Chinese society, and the academic community was gradually drawing a strict distinction between the renting area and the leased land.
title: 关东州 (日本)

source_text:
日本接管辽东半岛时，沿袭俄罗斯的用法称该地为关东州，“关东”意为位于山海关以东。历史
1895年日本在甲午战争中打败清朝后，通过《马关条约》割占辽东半岛，但俄国为保障自己在整个满洲地区的利益，随即联合德國和法國对日本进行外交施压，即“三国干涉还辽”。11月8日，中、日雙方正式簽訂了《遼南條約》，清廷贖回了遼東半島。
target_text: Japan took over the Liaodong Peninsula in 1895, after defeating the Qing Dynasty during the midday war, by cutting off the Liaodong Peninsula through the Treaty of Manchuria, along the lines of Kantengzhou, which is known as Kantung State, and “Kantang” is located east of the mountain customs. In order to safeguard its interests throughout Manchuria, Russia joined Germany and France in exerting diplomatic pressure on Japan to “retrieve intervention by the three countries.” On 8 November, China and Japan formally signed the Qingnan Treaty, which was redeemed by the King.
title: 关东州 (日本)

source_text: 明治31年（1898年）6月與板垣退助建立憲政黨，同年6月30日拜命出任首個薩長派閥以外的内閣總理大臣，組建日本首個政黨内閣。但是因爲舊自由黨與舊進步黨對立嚴重，又有文相尾崎行雄因而辭職，在繼任人選上矛盾激化，對舊自由黨的犬養毅繼任文相感到不滿的舊進步黨人單方面宣稱解散憲政黨，另立新的憲政黨。同時因應美國吞併夏威夷事件，對美國威廉·麦金莱總統展示強硬姿態，稱「從未見過此等激烈的外交文書，簡直就是宣戰聲明無異的最後通牒」，從而引發外交危機。綜上種種，在組閣僅4個月的11月8日内閣總辭。
target_text: In June of the 31st year (1898), Mingji helped to establish the Constitutional Party, and, on 30 June of the same year, ordered the Prime Minister to be the first Minister to form Japan’s first political party, other than the Chairman’s party. But, in response to the US invasion of Hawaii, the President of the United States, William McKinley, showed a strong stance, claiming that “the heated diplomatic writings he has never seen were tantamount to a clear and final ultimatum” during the successor’s election, leading to a diplomatic crisis.
title: 大隈重信

source_text:
外交攻防
1330年代後期，愛德華三世開始為戰爭進行準備工作。1337年，他開始一系列的外交行動拉攏盟友，範圍一路由北海到接近瑞士。其中代表性的盟邦為布拉邦特公國、埃諾伯國、洛林公國、荷蘭伯國、海爾德公國、巴伐利亞公國、萊茵-普法茲伯國。但在南方的外交行動較為不順利，西班牙王國和那不勒斯王國都傾向支持法蘭西。
target_text: In the late 1330s, Edward III began preparations for war. In 1337, he began a series of diplomatic campaigns to promote allies from the North Sea to close to Switzerland.
title: 百年战争

source_text:
1993年1月18日，第四十七届联合国大会作出47/193号决议，根据联合国环境与发展会议通过的《二十一世纪议程》第十八章所提出的建议，确定每年的3月22日为“世界水日”。其旨在推动对水资源进行综合性统筹规划和管理，加强水资源保护，解决日益严峻的缺乏淡水问题，开展广泛的宣传以提高公众对开发和保护水资源的认识。2003年12月23日的58/217号决议中，大会宣布从2005年3月22日的世界水日开始，2005年至2015年为“生命之巾
”国际行动十年。联合国水机制和联合国人居署负责对全球的世界水日活动进行协调。
target_text: On 18 January 1993, the forty-seventh session of the United Nations General Assembly adopted resolution 47/193 establishing 22 March as World Water Day each year, in accordance with the recommendations of chapter XVIII of Agenda 21 adopted by the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development. Its purpose is to promote integrated planning and management of water resources, enhance their protection, address the growing scarcity of freshwater, and undertake wide-ranging advocacy to raise public awareness of the development and protection of water resources. In its resolution 58/217 of 23 December 2003, the General Assembly proclaimed the International Decade for Action, “Scarves of Life”, from 2005 to 2015, the beginning of the World Water Day on 22 March 2005. UN-Water and UN-Habitat are responsible for coordinating the activities of the Global World Water Day.
title: 世界水日

source_text: 在中东地区，除了气候原因影响，持续的武装冲突使该地区水资源和年久失修的供水系统达到几近崩溃的程度。交战方有时攻击供水供电基础设施，或为了军事或政治目的蓄意干扰水电供应。红十字国际委员会中东行动部主任罗伯特·马尔迪尼表示 :"在冲突中用限制获取水源作为战术或武器，或攻击供水或能源设施，这不仅违反了武装冲突法，而且对那些健康状况不佳之人的生活造成了非常有害的影响。"最近几年，许多国际组织，如联合国儿童基金会(UNICEF)、世界银行和红十字国际委员会提供资金建造和修理许多钻孔和井，以便为冲突或灾害地区平民提供干净用水。
target_text: In the Middle East, in addition to climate-related impacts, the ongoing armed conflict has led to near collapse of water resources and ageless water systems in the region. Warring parties have sometimes attacked water and electricity infrastructure, or deliberately interfered with electricity and water supplies for military or political purposes. Robert Maldini, Director of the Middle East Operations Department of the International Committee of the Red Cross, has stated: "The use of restricted access to water as a tactic or weapon in the conflict, or attacks on water or energy facilities, not only violates the law of armed conflict, but also has had a very harmful impact on the lives of those in poor health." In recent years, many international organizations, such as the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), the World Bank and the International Committee of the Red Cross, have funded the construction and repair of numerous boreholes and wells to provide clean water to civilians in conflict or disaster-affected areas.
title: 世界水日

source_text: 民族主義（，，），亦稱國民主義、国族主义、国粹主义，是一種意識形態，其旨在追求民族的生存、发展、兴盛。民族主义者往往认为民族拥有自我治理的主权，而不应受他人干涉，即民族拥有民族自决权，而这一观念则起源于人民主权论。民族主义中的“民族”既可能是基于语言、族裔、部落或种族的团体，也可能是一国、一地之公民集体，还可能是某一宗教的信徒。
target_text: Nationalism (, etc.), also known as national democracy, nationalism, populism, is an ideology aimed at the survival, development and flourishing of the nation. Nationalists tend to believe that the nation has the sovereign right to govern itself without interference from others, i.e. that the nation has the right to self-determination, which stems from the doctrine of the sovereignty of the people. “Nationality” in nationalism may be based on linguistic, ethnic, tribal or racial groups, or a group of citizens of a country or a region, or may be followers of a religion.
title: 民族主義

source_text: 2010年8月，范徐麗泰在北京出席全國人大常委會會議期間，發生馬尼拉前警員劫持香港旅行團事件，范太指香港不是主權國家，特首不能與菲律賓總統直接對話是外交慣例，並希望中央人民政府關注事件，及促請外交部要求菲律賓政府向香港人合理解釋及交代。
target_text: In August 2010, during a meeting of the Standing Committee of the National People ' s Congress in Beijing, Fan Xu Litai was called upon by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to request the Philippine Government to provide a reasonable explanation and explanation to the people of Hong Kong in the event of the abduction of Hong Kong by former police officers of Manila. Fan Tai states that Hong Kong is not a sovereign country and that it is a custom for the Chief Executive not to speak directly to the President of the Philippines.
