On March 15, Ambassador Fu Qin of the Soviet Union sent a reply to Marshall and Bevan to the Minister of Foreign Affairs on March 13th, and requested that the Chinese government hand over to Molotov, saying that the Chinese government could not attend the meeting of the four foreign ministers and demanded that “the US, the United Kingdom and the three foreign ministers stop any discussion of China’s internal affairs.”

source_text: 3月16日，王世-{杰}-在中國國民黨三中全會作外交報告，闡明外交政策為：擁護及支持聯合國機構，對美保持傳統友誼，對蘇嚴格實行中蘇條約，對日本不採取報復，而要求軍事方面充分保證，不使其再事侵略。3月18日，中國國民黨三中全會舉行第三次大會，開始質詢外交報告，若干中央執行委員抨擊外長王世-{杰}-對蘇聯外交政策屈膝無能；王世-{杰}-作答時表示準備在三中全會閉幕時辭職。3月24日，中國國民黨三中全會紀念周與中樞紀念周合併舉行，蔣在席上為前行政院長宋子文、外交部長王世-{杰}-及台灣行政長官陳儀辯護，稱「批評應有所根據，不能捕風捉影。三中全會通過之決議案大部分屬破壞性，黨內派別紛爭殊為扼腕」；要求大家精誠團結，渡過此嚴重關頭。4月28日，蔣主持中國國民黨中央政治委員會舉行恢復後第一次會議，王世杰報告外交工作。

source_text: 7月12日，外交部長王世-{杰}-發表聲明，歡迎魏德邁來華，表示魏氏此行將「增進中美間之友感與合作」。8月29日，蔣主持國務會議，王世-{杰}-外長報告外交，就魏德邁之離華聲明作簡要說明；蔣強調中國應自力更生，勵精圖治，自立自勉。8月31日，國民政府派王世-{杰}-，顧維鈞、蔣廷黻、劉鍇、張彭春為出席聯合國第二屆大會代表。9月5日，王世杰發表談話，聲明參加聯合國第二屆全體大會之立場：一、對於修改憲章，準備充分尊重大會之多數意見；二、對日和約問題，不輕作放棄某些國家之合作而單獨與日本媾和之擬議。9月6日，王世-{杰}-離開上海飛往美國，出席聯合國第二屆全體大會。

source_text: 1483年卡齐米日四世与迫切希望摆脱莫斯科大公国控制的特维尔大公米哈伊尔·鲍里索维奇缔结条约。但后来，米哈伊尔·鲍里索维奇终于迫于莫斯科大公伊凡三世的威吓废除了该条约。不过卡齐米日四世在伊凡三世於1485年彻底消灭特维尔公国前，一直秘密与米哈伊尔·鲍里索维奇保持联系。總的來說，卡齊米日並未建立一個對莫斯科的有效防禦系統，因此當1486年伊凡三世發起對立陶宛的進攻時，不少附庸於立陶宛大公國的低級羅斯親王，就脫離立陶宛成為莫斯科大公国的附庸。而在其離世後立陶宛大公的羅斯君主頭銜號召力進一步削弱，結果到了1494年亚历山大一世·雅盖隆契克更無奈承認莫斯科統治者持有着「全羅斯」最高主宰等一系列的頭銜。
target_text: However, in 1483, Qazimi Day IV and Tewire Borisovitch, who were eager to escape Moscow’s control, concluded a treaty with the Grand Duchy, Mikhail Borisovich. However, in 1486, when Ivan III was attacked by the Grand Duke of Moscow, Mikhail Borisovich was forced to denounce the treaty.
title: 卡齐米日四世·雅盖隆契克

source_text: 日本国宪法规定主权在民的国民主权。另外，在政治上规定了立法、行政、司法三权分立，分别由国会、内阁、裁判所（法院）行使分立的三权。以国会为国家最高权力机关，实行议会民主政治，由国会和内阁协作实行议会内阁制。另外，设置帝制天皇作为“日本国的象征、日本国民统合的象征”。但宪法规定天皇没有参与国政的权力，日本內閣總理大臣為国家政府领导人及自衛隊的最高指揮官。
target_text: The Japanese Constitution provides for sovereignty over the national sovereignty of the people. Politically, the separation of legislative, executive, and judicial powers is provided for by the National Assembly, the Cabinet, and the courts.

黑田清隆的外交主張不傾向急劇對外擴張，不隨便對相鄰的清朝及俄國作出挑釁。明治6年，明治政府內部出現支持征韓論與否的爭議。當時黑田從重視內政的立場上反對了西鄉隆盛等『武治派』征伐李氏朝鮮的主張。並在明治7年（1874年）時，日本因琉球王國商家在台灣遇害而出兵後，主張不和清朝全面開戰，儘快進入外交談判，防止清朝及俄羅斯帝國對日本斷然出兵。1875年，黑田利用江華島事件，朝鮮軍隊炮轟於朝鮮水域進行測量的日本船作為契機，在2月份擔當和朝鮮談判的全權辦理大臣，簽訂了日朝和睦條文規定。
target_text: During the seven years of Mingji (1874), Japan, after the killing of its neighboring Qing Dynasty and the Russian Federation, opened a full-scale war against the Qing Dynasty, and as soon as possible entered into diplomatic negotiations to prevent the Qing Dynasty and the Russian Empire from fighting against Japan. In 1875, Kuroda took advantage of the incident on the island of Jianghua, using the Korean army as an opportunity to test the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s waters, signed a letter of agreement between Japan and the Democratic Party of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.
title: 黑田清隆

source_text: 1894年6月，甲午战争爆发，战後日本与清政府签订了《马关条约》，朝鲜从此变为日本傀儡；清政府被迫割讓辽东半岛、台湾和澎湖列岛，以及赔款兩亿两白银。1895年4月，山县有朋提出了一份旨在扩大日本军备力量的意见书，日本国防战略思想从「维护主权线」彻底转向「扩张利益线」，使日本後來更主張「满蒙是日本的生命线」。当时俄国修建中东铁路、「三国干涉还辽」等远东「新方针」对日本的满蒙政策产生巨大威胁，「朝满问题」这一概念由此出现在日俄两国对外扩张政策当中，加剧了双方矛盾，最終导致1904年日俄战争的爆发。
target_text: In June 1894, when the war broke out, Japan signed the Ma Guan Treaty with the Qing government, and North Korea became a puppet in Japan; the Qing government was forced to cut off the Liaodong Peninsula, Taiwan, and Lake Shilling Islands, as well as to pay compensation for 200 million silver. In April 1895, Shanzhou presented an opinion paper aimed at expanding Japan’s arms forces, and Japan’s strategic defence philosophy shifted completely from the line of “preservation of sovereignty” to the line of “exploitation of interests” which led to Japan’s “exploitation of Japan’s life line.” At that time, Russia’s construction of the Middle East Railway, the “new approach to intervention by the three countries” in the Far East posed a huge threat to Japan’s full-fledged policy, and the concept of “opposition” appeared in the foreign expansion policies of Japan and Russia, exacerbating the conflict between the two sides, eventually leading to the outbreak of the 1904 war in Russia.
title: 山縣有朋

source_text: 1882年8月，山县有朋在一份意见书中认为，目前不存在欧洲各国入侵日本的可能性。就在这一时期，沙俄将其对外政策的重心从西方移到远东，准备修建一条横贯西伯利亚的铁路，企图控制太平洋上的一切国际商业活动，这当然引起了日本的警觉。1889年12月山县有朋组阁，他出任首相不久，向内阁提出了《外交政略论》和他在1888年写成的《军事意见书》。《外交政略论》以明治政权海外扩张的基本国策为基础，明确地提出影响日本对外政策的重大理论———「主权线」和「利益线」的扩张理论。他强调：「国家独立自卫之道有二：一曰捍卫主权线，不容他人侵害；二曰防护利益线，不失自己的有利地域。所谓主权线乃国家之疆域，利益线系与主权线紧密相关之邻近区域是也。凡能保全主权线及利益线者，方成为国家。当今列国并立，仅防守主权线已不足以维护国家之独立，必须进而防卫利益线。」山县有朋这一主张，已公然将当时视清帝国为其宗主国的朝鲜、以及滿洲划入其利益线之内，防止俄国染指這些地区。为此，山县有朋大肆扩充日本海陆军；还出台了《出师储备物资管理委员会条例》、〈战时大本营条例〉和〈海军军令部条例〉，日本已经抢先于沙俄，争夺其利益线———朝鲜半島和滿洲。

title: 山縣有朋

麻生太郎 - 日本政治人物，在他擔任日本首相時，多間動漫畫產業的股價都上升，亦不否認自己被人發現在機場看漫畫。因為曾被拍到觀看漫畫《薔薇少女》，所以有「薔薇麻生」（）的綽號。另外，他作為外務大臣時的外交計劃亦利用日本的動漫文化，被稱為漫畫外交或動漫外交，其中一環就是促成國際漫畫獎的設立，他本人在香港頒發國際漫畫賞時以廣東話發表自己是漫畫迷，香港《文匯報》則直接稱他為御宅族。

周鲠生（），原名览，號蔭松，湖南长沙人，中華民国及中華人民共和国的国际法学家、外交史家、教育家。主要在武漢大学从事学術活動，因严厉批判李顿调查团的報告書而著称。晩年加入中国共产党。生平留学時代、民初的活動
周鲠生生于一个塾師家庭。1900年（光緒26年），入譚延闿創設的湖南省立第一小学。因成績優秀，1905年（光緒31年）被派往日本留学，入早稻田大学学习政治经济。留学期间，加入中国同盟会。

source_text: 中華人民共和国成立初期，政务院总理兼外交部长周恩来聘请了国际法等方面的专家到外交部工作。其中，周鲠生、梅汝璈、涂允檀为外交部顾问，刘泽荣、凌其翰、陆殿栋、叶景莘、张炯伯为外交部条约委员会专门委员。1954年，他当选第一届全国人大代表。9月，他出席第一届全国人大第一次会议讨论宪法草案，期间并发言。后来，1956年倪征𣋉被增聘为外交部条约委员会专门委员。1958年8月，周鲠生、刘泽荣、倪征𣋉应召到北戴河见毛泽东和周恩来，为两位领导做有关领海宽度和领海法律制度等问题的咨询，共计2小时。三位专家认为，中国应以12海里为领海宽度。1958年9月，中华人民共和国政府颁布《中华人民共和国关于领海的声明》，第一条宣布“中华人民共和国的领海宽度为12海里”。自此，中国有了法定领海宽度。文化大革命开始后，周鲠生曾被抄家，但未受进一步迫害，被闲置起来。
target_text: In the early days of the People's Republic of China, the Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Chinese People's Congress hired experts in international law and other fields to work in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Of these, Zhou Jianxeng, Mayu-Ju, Liu Zhe-hung, Liu Zhe-hung, Luang, Ye Gyeong-chung, Zhang Xian-Bing, who was a special member of the Treaty Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In 1954, he was elected as the first representative of the National People's Congress. In September, he attended the first session of the National People's Congress to discuss the draft constitution, during which he spoke. Subsequently, in 1956, he was recruited as a special member of the Treaties Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

source_text:
被中華人民共和國列入外国使团
2020年3月18日，中华人民共和国外交部宣布，针对美方将5家中国媒体驻美机构列为“外国使团”，中方对等要求美国之音、《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》、《华盛顿邮报》、《时代周刊》等5家美国媒体驻华分社向中方申报在中国境内所有工作人员、财务、经营、所拥有不动产訊息等书面資料。中华人民共和国外交部要求《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》、《华盛顿邮报》年底前记者证到期的美籍记者从即日起4天内向外交部新闻司申报名单，并于10天内交还记者证，今后不得在中华人民共和国，包括香港、澳门特别行政区继续从事记者工作。
target_text: On 18 March 2020, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China announced that, in response to the United States listing of five Chinese media outlets in the United States as “foreign missions”, China had reciprocally requested the Voice of the United States, the New York Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Washington Post, the Times, and five American media outlets in China to declare to China all their staff, financial services, business and real estate information in China in writing. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China requested that American journalists whose press cards expired before the end of the year of the New York Times, the Wall Street Journal and the Washington Post should submit their names to the Press Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs within four days of that date, and that they should return their press cards so that they could not continue their work in the People's Republic of China, including Hong Kong and the Macao Special Administrative Region.
title: 华盛顿邮报

source_text: 麥加斯梯尼是一位著名的希臘大使，曾在孔雀王朝宮中擔任職務，其著作《印度史》是了解孔雀王朝的主要文獻來源。根據阿里安的記載，麥加斯梯尼（約公元前350年至約公元前290年）早年居住在阿拉霍西亞之後至華氏城為官。麥加斯梯尼描述孔雀王朝社會愛好自由，因此塞琉古帝國不用時刻擔心東部國土遭入侵，然而事實上，孔雀王朝縱使入侵也難以取勝。在後來的幾年裡，塞琉古帝國者根據返回的大使提供的類似報告與孔雀王朝持續保持外交關係。
target_text: Magastini is a well-known Greek ambassador who served in the peacock palace and whose book, The History of India, is the main source of information about the peacock dynasty. According to Aryan, Magastini (350 B.C. to 290 B.C.) lived in the city of Washington earlier in his early years, after living in Aarhosia.
title: 孔雀王朝

source_text: 賓頭娑羅在位期間與希臘世界保持友好的外交關係， 塞琉古皇帝安條克一世派遣擔任賓頭娑羅的宮廷大使，戴馬古斯記道：「華氏城的國王歡迎了一位希臘作家」，而這位國王通常被認為是賓頭娑羅。老普林尼則記道埃及國王托勒密二世派遣一位名叫的使者到印度，近代學者認為這發生在賓頭娑羅的統治期間。
target_text: During his tenure, the Head of State maintained a friendly diplomatic relationship with the Greek world, and Emperor Sélégué Achilles I sent an ambassador of the court to the head of the family, Daimagos, who wrote: "The King of the Wall has welcomed a Greek writer," and the king is usually considered to be the head of the family. The old Prince wrote that the King of Egypt, Tolemi II, sent an ambassador named India, and that recent scholars believed that this had taken place during the reign of the Head of State.
title: 孔雀王朝

source_text: 安吉丽娜·朱莉（又译作安杰利娜·朱莉）（，），本名安潔莉娜·裘莉·沃特（）是一位美国女演员、慈善家、社会活动家。美國紐約大學校友，联合国儿童亲善大使，曾任聯合國難民署高級專員特使。她兩度入圍奧斯卡金像獎，並在2000年以《女生向前走》獲得第72屆奧斯卡最佳女配角。
target_text: Angelina Julie (also translated as Angelina Julie) is an American actress, philanthropist, and social activist. A friend of the United Nations University in New York, the United Nations Children’s Goodwill Ambassador, served as the Special Envoy of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees. She has twice entered the Oscars, and won the 72nd Oscars in 2000 with Girls Walking Forward.
title: 安吉丽娜·朱莉

source_text: 為表揚其慈善工作，特別是在發起運動消除戰區性暴力問題方面的工作，她在2014年獲英國政府以名譽性質授予DCMG勳銜。2012年4月17日，在擔任聯合國難民署親善大使十多年後，朱莉晉升為高級專員安东尼奥·古特雷斯的特使，成為該組織內首位擔任此類職務的人。在她擴大的角色中，她被授權在外交層面代表古特雷斯和聯合國難民署，重點關注重大難民危機。
target_text: In recognition of her charitable work, and especially her work in campaigning against sexual violence in the war zone, she was awarded DCMG by the British government in 2014 with honour. On April 17, 2012, after 10 years as Goodwill Ambassador for the United Nations Office for Refugees, Julie was promoted as Special Envoy of Senior Commissioner Antonio Guterres, the first person in the organization to be in this category. In her expanded role, she was authorized to represent Guterres and the United Nations Office for Refugees in the diplomatic service, focusing on the plight of refugees.
title: 安吉丽娜·朱莉

source_text: 師承朱光潛、吳宓罗裕昌，1945年毕业于武汉大学電機工程系,被譽為台灣鐵路電氣化之父。章曙，1944年考入武汉大学外文系，中华人民共和国第一批外交官，联合国安全理事会事务司副司长、中华人民共和国驻比利时特命全权大使、中华人民共和国驻日本特命全权大使、外交学院院长黃孝宗，1942年畢業於武漢大學機械系，美國麻省理工學院機械工程博士，曾任美国NASA阿波罗登月器动力总工程师、美国航太推进系统公司总工程师曾擔任台灣中山科學院代理院長，研製IDF戰機、雄風導彈、天弓導彈、天劍導彈等武器系統趙耀東，1940年畢業於武漢大學機械系，為中華民國第十五任經濟部部長，素有「趙鐵頭」之稱，組建中國鋼鐵股份有限公司傅正，1949年肄業於政治系，1957年在國立臺灣大學政治系完成學士學業，曾任東吳大學等校教職，亦曾在《自由中國》等黨外雜誌擔任編輯，1986年與費希平、許信良等人創立民主進步黨（民進黨「18人建黨工作小組」成員之一）。
target_text: He graduated from the Wuhan University Department of Mechanical Engineering in 1945 and was awarded the honor of being the father of the electric gasification of the Taiwan Railway. source_text: 最後通牒（），是指一个团体向另一个团体提出的最后的条件，是一种最高威胁：表明或意隐含着如果条件不被接受就以严厉的惩罚相威胁的声明，尤指在外交谈判中这样的声明。中文早期亦有按音譯成「哀的美敦書」，其語源為拉丁语中「最後一個」。外交上的最後通牒通常是沒有談判餘地的最後要求。如果最後通牒不被接納，下一步就是严厉的制裁，甚至是宣战。有时候，有意宣戰的國家會以最後通牒為開戰手段。這些通牒一般含有較苛刻的條款，而開立者知道對方是不會全盤接受的。導致第一次世界大戰爆發、由奧匈帝國向塞爾維亞王國發出的七月最後通牒（通牒被無視）；以及1939年3月納粹德國对立陶宛發出交還梅梅爾的最後通牒（通牒被接受）即屬此類。
target_text: The last ultimatum of diplomacy is usually the last requirement without negotiation. If the last ultimatum is not accepted, the next step is a severe sanction, or even a declaration of war. Sometimes, war-provoked countries use the last ultimatum as a means of waging war. These ultimatums usually contain harsher terms, and their proponents know that they will not be accepted in their entirety.
title: 最後通牒

source_text:
擔任柬埔寨經濟顧問
2009年11月4日，柬埔寨政府任命他信為柬埔寨首相洪森的經濟顧問。柬埔寨官方電視臺隨即發表，由於柬埔寨相信他信受到政治迫害，因此不會將他信逐出柬埔寨國境。次日，泰國政府召回駐柬埔寨大使，以表示抗議。泰國總理艾比希声言：這是『第一步外交報復』。他認為柬埔寨-{干}-涉了泰國司法制度，聲稱將重新審視雙邊的一切合作協議（在柬埔寨政府決定此事的一個月前，兩國軍隊因邊境的柏威夏寺而有領土爭議）。當晚，柬埔寨方面也同樣召回了駐泰國大使以為外交報復。柬埔寨副首相兼閣員則認為，柬埔寨這項任命是符合國際慣例的決定。
target_text: The following day, the Thai government called back its ambassador to Cambodia to protest. The Thai Prime Minister, Abhisit, said: "This is the first step in a diplomatic revenge." He argued that Cambodia – {Ghan} – was involved in the Thai justice system, claiming that all cooperation agreements between the two sides would be re-examined (a month before the Cambodian government decided on the matter, the two armies had had an indigenous dispute over the border's Temple of Preah Vihear).
title: 達新·欽那瓦

source_text: 1965年2月，美国开始进行针对越南北部的空袭行动，于1965年3月将大量地面兵力投入越南南方，打响“局部战争”。美国政府发表了《越南问题从何而来》的白皮书，把越战归咎于越南民主共和国，并通知联合国，美军愿意在“北越停止对南越的侵略战争”的情况下全部撤离。在此背景下，1965年12月召开的越党三届十二中全会指出，“我们要坚持战略决心，采用政治斗争与外交斗争相结合的策略并将其与军事攻击配合，主动攻击敌人”。1967年1月召开的越党三届十三中全会决议决定“南北推进战斗，提出外交斗争主张”，造成边打边谈的局面，迫使美方降级战争。为了实施新的外交斗争主张，越南推出了策略性的口号：“只有美国无条件停止轰炸等针对越南民主共和国的抗活动，越南才会同美方谈判。”越党中央于1968年1月通过决议：“情况让我们将南方革命战争转入进攻与崛起新时期，旨在争取决定性胜利。”越共在南方四大城市及44个市县、数百个乡镇进行了春节总攻势与崛起，震动了全世界，挫败了美国以军事手段在越南战争取胜的信念，迫使约翰逊总统于1968年3月31日宣布“部分停炸”，停止针对越南北部的轰炸行为（非军事区除外）并于1968年5月13日坐到巴黎谈判桌前。1968年10月31日美国大选前夕，约翰逊总统宣布对越南民主共和国“全面停炸”，直至1973年初才又恢复轰炸。
target_text: In February 1965, the United States launched an air strike against northern Viet Nam. In this context, the United States, in December 1965, stated at the 3nd plenary meeting of the Viet Nam Party, that “we will maintain our strategic resolve to use a strategy that combines political and diplomatic struggles with a military attack and actively attack the enemy.” In January 1967, the 13th plenary meeting of the Viet Nam Party issued a white paper on where Viet Nam came from, blaming the Viet Nam Democratic Republic of Viet Nam and informing the United Nations of the willingness of the United States forces to withdraw completely from the war in the context of “the cessation of the Viet Nam's aggressive war against the south.” In order to implement the new diplomatic campaign, Viet Nam introduced a tactical slogan: “On the return of the United States to negotiations with the United States against the Democratic Republic of Viet Nam, with a strategy of combining political and diplomatic struggle with military attacks, and actively attacking the enemy.” In January 1968, the central of the Viet Nam adopted a resolution, “Let us turn the war on the south into a new era of diplomatic struggle, leading to a decisive victory on the side of the border between the US and the south of the US President'sto the
title: 越南共产党

source_text: 查爾斯在1997年6月到訪香港並主持香港交接儀式，查爾斯在其撰寫的日誌表示，香港是管理良好殖民地的典範，又對香港交接儀式後的法制及自由社會遭到侵蝕表達擔憂，而查爾斯私下發表的意見和觀點在2005年11月被英國傳媒公開。《星期日泰晤士報》在2012年10月引述英國外交官古沛勤新出版的回憶錄稱，香港總督尤德爵士在1986年12月突然逝世後，英國外交部曾將查爾斯列為繼任港督的第一人選，不過首相戴卓爾夫人最後選擇較熟悉中港事務的衛奕信爵士在1987年接任香港總督。
target_text: Charles visited Hong Kong in June 1997 and presided over Hong Kong’s handover ceremony. Charles wrote a journal in which he stated that Hong Kong was a model of good colonial governance and that he was concerned that the rule of law and the liberal society had been violated since Hong Kong’s handover, while Charles’s private comments and observations had been made public by the British media in November 2005. The Sunday Times quoted British diplomats in October 2012 as having published a recent memoir that, after the sudden death of Hong Kong’s Governor Sir Judd, in December 1986, the British Foreign Ministry had elected Charles as the first person to succeed Governor of Hong Kong, although the Prime Minister, Mrs. Djoll, had finally chosen to take over the post of Governor of Hong Kong in 1987.
title: 查爾斯三世

source_text:
茶陵一中
1952年11月，全省中学均以所在地地名冠其校名，改称“湖南省茶陵第一中学”，进入湖南省首批重点中学行列。
1962年6月，发生学生自杀教师被判无期徒刑的龙普腾事件，湖南千人受株连，影响全国教育行业。
1968年4月，文化革命，茶陵一中停办。
1969年8月，茶陵一中复办。
1969年至1973年，文革期间，中国外交部在茶陵县虎踞茶场设有“五七”干校子弟入該校高中部116班，俗称为“外交部子弟班”。
1980年6月，茶陵一中列为湖南省属重点中学。
1996年春，授予“湖南省重点中学”匾牌。
target_text: In November 1952, the provincial secondary schools became the first priority secondary schools in Hunan Province under the name of their geographical names. In June 1962, a student suicide teacher was sentenced to life imprisonment in the Ropeten incident, with thousands of people living in Hunan, affecting the country’s educational sector.
title: 茶陵县第一中学

source_text:
民間信仰
谢玄逝世之後，被民間尊奉為神祇，尊為王孫大使、謝府元帥、獻武尊王，其信徒多稱謝玄為“王孫爺”。在某些福建道士的心中，“王孫大使”是水神、戲神、酆都城的守護神，所以牽亡或觀落陰，必定「請王孫」，如《牽亡歌》「烏土路頂烏昏昏，前面騎馬是王孫」。
target_text: After Xiegen's death, he was held by the people as a god, and was the King's grandson, the Chief Marshal of Xie, and the King of Wushu, and his followers called him “The King's grandson.” In the hearts of some of the founding fathers, “Ambassador Wang” is the guardian of the water god, the theatre god, and the capital city, so that he dies or falls, and must be called the King's grandson, like the song of death, “The twilight of the earth, the horse is the king's grandson.”
title: 谢玄

source_text:
法律與政府
路易斯安那州的政府是行政、立法和司法三项都是有自主权，只有国防与外交例外。民主黨和共和黨在这州势均力敌。美國眾議院有六個代表來自路易斯安那州，其中五個是共和黨人，而一個則是民主黨人。按照地理区分，路州的大城市如新奥尔良、巴吞鲁日、什里夫波特等地是自由派的民主党的阵地，而广大乡村地带则是保守派共和党阵地。
target_text: The U.S. Congress has six representatives from Louisiana, five of whom are Republicans, and one of whom is Democratic. Geographically, the major cities of Luzhou, such as New Orleans, Baton Rouge, and Shrifport, are liberal Democrats, while the vast countryside is conservative Republicans.
title: 路易斯安那州

source_text:
名胜古迹
2004年2月，五大连池被联合国教科文组织批准为首批世界地质公园。五大连池还是中国国家首批重点风景名胜区，4A级景区，首批国家地质公园。五大连池生物圈保护区于2003年被联合国纳入人与生物圈计划。黑龙江五大连池火山自然保护区和大沾河湿地自然保护区是国家级自然保护区。五大连池市山口湖水利风景区是国家级水利风景区。
target_text: In February 2004, five companies were approved by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) as the first geological parks in the world. The five pools were also the first priority attractions in the Chinese country, the 4A-class landscape, and the first national geological parks. The five biosphere reserves were incorporated into the Man and the Biosphere programme by the United Nations in 2003.
title: 五大连池市

source_text: 近年来，瑞士在许多联合国和国际组织中的角色减轻了世界该国对中立的担忧。2002年，瑞士选民以55%的选票支持并加入了联合国。在此之前，瑞士公民历经数十年的辩论，终于1986年以3比1的全民投票结果拒绝加入欧盟。瑞士妇女在1971年获得了国家级选举，并于1981年通过了一项平等权利修正案，但直到1990年，法院才在全国范围的所有选举中为妇女确立了全面投票权。
target_text: In recent years, Switzerland's role in many United Nations and international organizations has allayed the concern of the world about neutrality. In 2002, Swiss voters supported and joined the United Nations with 55 per cent of the vote. Prior to decades of debate, Swiss citizens eventually refused to join the European Union in 1986 with a referendum of three to one. Swiss women obtained national elections in 1971 and adopted an equal rights amendment in 1981, but it was not until 1990 that the courts established full voting rights for women in all national elections.
title: 瑞士历史

source_text: 特命全權大使，簡稱大使，是一國元首向駐在國元首派遣的等級最高的外交代表，在駐在國有代表本國國家元首和政府向駐在國表達意見或者同駐在國达成协议的全权，享有完全的外交豁免权，其所享外交礼遇也是驻在国政府给予使领馆所有外交人员中最高规格的礼遇。
target_text: Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, known briefly as Ambassador, is the highest-ranking diplomatic representative of a head of State to the head of State in the country. He has full authority to represent his or her head of State and Government in the country, to express his or her views to the country or to reach an agreement with the country in question. He or she enjoys full diplomatic immunity. He or she is also accorded the highest degree of diplomatic courtesy by the Government of his or her country of residence to all diplomatic personnel of diplomatic missions and consulates.
title: 特命全權大使

source_text:
起源
“大使”一詞最早出現於凱薩所著的《高盧戰記》中。最早的常駐大使出現在14世紀的歐洲，1341年，義大利的曼圖亞城邦向巴伐利亞王國宮廷派遣大使，被認為是現代意義上的大使的起源。此後威尼斯、佛羅倫斯、西班牙、法国、英格蘭、神圣罗马帝国等國紛紛互派大使。1559年法國國王和西班牙國王簽訂《卡托－康佈雷齊和約》（Peace Treaty of Cateau-Cambrsis）時，首次出現向國際會議派遣的大使。
target_text: The term “Ambassador” was first found in the Gaul War Book by Caesar. The first permanent ambassador appeared in Europe in the 14th century, in 1341, when the Italian city of Mantua sent its ambassador to the court of Bavaria, which was considered to be the origin of the modern-day ambassador. Since then, the ambassadors of Venice, Florence, Spain, France, England, the Holy Roman Empire, etc. The first ambassadors sent to the International Congress when the King of France and the King of Spain signed the Peace Treaty of Cateau-Cambrsis in 1559.
title: 特命全權大使

source_text: 根據1815年維也納會議上通過的《關於外交人員等級的章程》，外交代表分為4類，即特命全權大使（Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary）、特命全權公使（Envoy Extraordinary and Minister Plenipotentiary）、常駐公使（Minister Resident）和代办（Chargé d'affaires）。最初大使僅僅在實行君主制的大國之間互派，後來也向共和制國家（如法蘭西共和國和美國）派遣大使。例如到1860年時，英國只向法国、俄罗斯帝国和奥斯曼帝国派出過三位大使。由於抱有強烈的共和主義思想，美國直至1893年仍只向別國派遣公使，其理由是公使只需與駐在國政府來往，不必參加君主及宮廷舉行的典禮及儀式。1893年美国向英国、法国、德国和意大利派出頭一批4名大使。
target_text: According to the Charter on the Class of Diplomatic Personnel, adopted at the Vienna Conference in 1815, diplomatic representatives were divided into four categories, namely, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to the Republic (such as the French Republic and the United States), Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to France, the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire in 1860, Ambassador Permanent Representative and Chargé d'affaires of the United States until 1893.
title: 特命全權大使

source_text: 地位在中世纪及近代的欧洲，大使在身份上等同于派他出驻外国的本国君主。他们有权享受其主人应享有的礼遇。从法律意义上讲，大使没有自己的人格，不能成為控诉對象，也不能控诉别人。大使随身带有主人的豁免权，任何人对他进行伤害，即等于直接伤害了他的君主。这一惯例在1815年维也纳外交会议上得以确认，即大使在其驻在国的身份，与其派遣国的国家元首是等同的。大使享有全部外交豁免权，包括免受驻在国一切法律管辖的豁免权，人身和财产不受侵犯的豁免权，以及免税权利。但是在古代的欧洲也曾有逮捕和囚禁敌对国大使的先例。大使視同本国国家元首的代表，但这一规则在确定该大使在其驻在国外交使团中的位次问题时不予采用。由于古代认为欧洲各国的大使均為本国君主的代表及化身，因此在出席典礼和仪式时为了争夺位次经常发生争吵，甚至武斗。1504年教宗儒略二世曾试图解决这一问题，规定在外交场合中，神圣罗马帝国的大使排在第一位，法国大使排在第二位，西班牙大使排在第三位，以此类推。但是这一规定到18世纪时已经名存实亡。1815年维也纳外交会议上，各国达成协议，即在外交场合中各国大使的位次不考虑其本国的地位和国力，而只考虑大使在其驻在国工作的时间长短。
target_text: At the 1815 Vienna Diplomatic Conference, it was confirmed that ambassadors in their country of residence were equivalent to the heads of State of their sending countries. They were entitled to all diplomatic immunity, including immunity from all legal jurisdiction in the country of residence, immunity from infringement of persons and property, and the right to tax exemption. But in ancient Europe, there was also a precedent for arresting and imprisoning hostile ambassadors. In view of the representative of the country’s head of State, this rule was not applied when determining the Ambassador’s position in the diplomatic corps of the country in question.
title: 特命全權大使

source_text:
大使的别名
联合国的外交代表稱駐地協調員，具有在行政上協調該國所有駐地機構的意義。
英联邦国家之间互派的大使級使節称高級專員。其他非英聯邦國家驻英的大使均称为“（某国）駐圣詹姆斯宫廷大使”。
聖座派驻别国的外交代表称「教廷大使」（Apostolic Nuncio）。其办公机构称聖座大使馆或“宗座代表驻地”（Apostolic Nunciature）。
中華民國在部分非邦交國的交流往來是以非官方名義派駐代表，其機構為「代表處」，而派駐的最高外交代表对外称“代表”，对内仍稱為「大使」。
卡扎菲治下的利比亚的外交代表在1980年代和1990年代曾称为「人民办事处書記」（现利比亚已改回一般的命名）。
target_text: Other ambassadors of non-British states in the United Kingdom are known as “Ambassador to St. James’s Palace.” The Holy See’s diplomatic representatives in other countries are known as “Ambassadors of the Holy See.” Its offices are known as the Holy See’s Embassy or “Community’s Representative Office” (Apostolic Nunciature).
title: 特命全權大使

source_text: 1948年联合国大会通过《世界人权宣言》后，联合国人权委员会开始起草国际人权公约。1950年，第五届联合国大会审议人权委员会提交的仅保护个人的公民权利和政治权利的公约草案。大会认为这一公约草案不全面，没有包括《世界人权宣言》的全部内容，未对经济、社会和文化权利予以保护，要求人权委员会对草案进行补充和修正。鉴于公民和政治权利与经济、社会和文化权利难以共用一套监督机构，1952年，第六届联合国大会决定由人权委员会起草两个人权公约，一个包括公民和政治权利，另一个包括经济、社会及文化权利。1954年，人权委员会将《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约草案》（同时提交的还有《公民权利和政治权利国际公约草案》）提交第九届联合国大会审议。1966年12月16日，第二十一届联合国大会第2200A号决议通过，并开放各国签字、批准和加入。1976年1月3日生效.。截至2018年9月，《盟约》共有169个缔约方。包括美国在内的另外四个国家已经签署但尚未批准该公约。
target_text: Following the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948, the United Nations Commission on Human Rights began drafting the International Covenants on Human Rights. In 1950, the fifth session of the United Nations General Assembly considered the draft convention on the protection of the civil and political rights of individuals submitted by the Commission on Human Rights to the General Assembly. The Assembly considered that the draft convention was not comprehensive and did not include all the elements of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and did not provide for the protection of economic, social and cultural rights, and requested the Commission to complement and amend it. In view of the difficulty of sharing a set of monitoring bodies on civil and political rights and economic, social and cultural rights, in 1952, the sixth session of the United Nations General Assembly decided that the Commission on Human Rights would draft two human rights conventions, one covering civil and political rights and the other covering economic, social and cultural rights. In 1954, the Commission on Human Rights submitted the draft international convention on economic, social and cultural rights (along with the draft International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights) for consideration at the ninth session of the General Assembly. On 16 December 1966, the twenty-first session of the United Nations General Assembly adopted resolution 2200
title: 经济、社会及文化权利国际公约

source_text: 與中國共產黨談判同時，張治中亦負責談判統一新疆的工作。1944年到1946年6月，張治中任全權代表多次赴迪化（今烏魯木齊），在蘇聯領事調停下，与伊宁事变领导人談判解決新疆問題。1945年9月13日，蔣介石召派張治中赴新疆處理「伊寧事變」，是日張治中由重慶飛抵迪化。9月14日，中國各戰區、方面軍自是日起開始解決除日軍武裝，至次年2月13日止繳械基本結束，總計俘虜日軍128.3206萬人；張治中在迪化會見蘇聯駐迪化代總領事葉謝也夫，徵詢對「伊寧事變」意見。9月16日，張治中晉謁蔣介石，報告解決新疆伊寧事變之途徑，建議請蘇聯政府調解伊寧事變。9月20日，國民政府外交部向蔣介石請示後答覆蘇聯駐華大使彼得羅夫，對蘇聯政府願意協助伊寧事變表示感謝，並請蘇駐伊領事代為通知與介紹伊寧領事代為通知與介伊寧事代表到迪化晉謁張治中，商洽進行和平解決辦法。1946年3月，张治中出任国民政府軍事委員會委員長西北行轅主任。5月，蔣介石任張治中為新疆省政府主席。6月6日，「伊寧事件」最後協議在迪化簽字，張治中下令釋放全新疆之政治犯。

source_text:
调查
2005年2月25日，负责调查哈里里被谋杀事件的联合国调查小组在贝鲁特宣布开始调查工作。该调查组在3月底提交给联合国安理会的一份报告中说，黎政府组织的调查没有按照可以接受的国际标准进行。调查组建议对哈里里遇害案展开独立的国际调查。4月7日，安理会一致通过第1595号决议，决定设立一个独立的国际调查委员会，对哈里里遇害一事展开全面调查。5月13日，联合国发言人宣布，科菲·安南秘书长已决定任命德国资深检察官德特勒夫·梅利斯为哈里里遇害案国际调查委员会负责人。
target_text: On 25 February 2005, the United Nations investigation team charged with investigating the Hariri murder opened its investigation in Beirut. In a report submitted to the United Nations Security Council at the end of March, the team stated that the investigation organized by the Lebanese Government had not been conducted in accordance with acceptable international standards. The investigation team recommended an independent international investigation into the Hariri murder. On 7 April, the Council unanimously adopted resolution 1595, by which it decided to establish an independent international commission of inquiry to conduct a full investigation into the Hariri murder. On 13 May, the United Nations spokesman announced that Secretary-General Kofi Annan had decided to appoint Senior German Prosecutor, Detlev Mehlis, as head of the international commission of inquiry into the Hariri murder.
title: 拉菲克·哈里里

source_text: 2006年1月11日，安南任命来自比利时的塞奇·布拉默茨接替梅利斯担任国际调查委员会负责人。3月29日，安理会通过第1664号决议，要求安南与黎巴嫩政府进行协商，以成立调查哈里里遇害案的国际法庭。9月25日，独立调查委员会第三份报告称，哈里里确实死于自杀式汽车炸弹袭击，但尚不清楚这起袭击事件的幕后操纵者及袭击者的动机。12月12日，国际独立调查委员会递交的一份报告表示，有证据表明哈里里遇害案与之前发生在黎巴嫩的14起谋杀案有关联。2007年5月30日，联合国安理会通过决议，决定在黎巴嫩设立国际法庭以审理哈里里遇害案。
target_text: On 11 January 2006, Annan appointed Serge Brammertz, from Belgium, to replace Mehlis as head of the International Commission of Inquiry. On 29 March, the Council adopted resolution 1664, in which it requested Annan to consult with the Government of Lebanon in order to establish an international tribunal to investigate the Hariri murder. On 25 September, the third report of the Independent Inquiry Committee stated that Hariri had indeed died as a result of a suicide car bomb attack, but the motives of the masterminds and attackers behind the attack were not known. On 12 December, a report submitted by the International Independent Investigation Commission indicated that there was evidence that the Hariri murder had been linked to the 14 murders that had previously occurred in Lebanon. On 30 May 2007, the United Nations Security Council adopted a resolution establishing an international tribunal in Lebanon to try Hariri.
title: 拉菲克·哈里里

source_text: 2020年8月18日，联合国黎巴嫩问题特别法庭宣布裁决，黎巴嫩真主党成员萨利姆·阿亚什在2005年暗杀了黎巴嫩前总理哈里里罪名成立，其他三名真主党嫌疑人因证据不足被免除指控。真主党组织秘书长哈桑·纳斯鲁拉一再表示，他不会移交任何组织成员。联合国法院不允许起诉国家，政府或组织，而只能对个人作出判决，因此移交犯人主要处决于真主党及其盟国控制的黎巴嫩政权。
target_text: On 18 August 2020, the United Nations Special Tribunal for Lebanon announced its decision that Salim Ayash, a member of Hizbullah in Lebanon, had been found guilty of the assassination of former Lebanese Prime Minister Hariri in 2005 and that three other Hizbullah suspects had been acquitted for lack of evidence. The Secretary-General of Hizbullah, Hassan Nasrallah, has repeatedly stated that he will not hand over members of any organization. The United Nations Court did not allow the prosecution of the State, Government or organization, but only the sentencing of individuals, and thus the transfer of prisoners was mainly carried out against the Lebanese regime under the control of Hizbullah and its allies.
title: 拉菲克·哈里里

source_text: 纵横家，是中國战国时期連合政軍外交聯盟的一派，《汉书·艺文志》列为“九流十家”之一。縱橫家出現於戰國至秦漢之際，多為遊說策辯之士，可稱為中國史上最早之外交政治家。他們的出現主要是因為當時列國割據紛爭，需要在國力富足的基礎上，利用聯合、排斥、威逼、利誘不戰而勝，或輔之以兵法以較少的損失獲得最大的收益。縱橫家朝秦暮楚，事無定主，反覆無常，策計劃謀多基於國際現實政治要求。合縱派的主要代表是公孫衍和蘇秦，連橫派的主要代表是張儀。
target_text: The main reason for their appearance is that they were the first diplomatic statesmen in China’s history. Their presence was due to the bitterness of the country at the time, and the need to take advantage of the foundations of the country’s strength, to take advantage of the alliance, exclusion, coercion, profit, or to use the laws of war to achieve the greatest gains.
title: 纵横家

source_text:
歷史發展
先秦典籍《韓非子/五蠹》：「從者（合縱），合眾弱以攻一強也；而衡者（連橫），事一強以攻眾弱也。」“纵”与“横”的来历，据说是因南北向称为“纵”，东西向称为“横”。「縱」指「合縱」，指戰國時齊、楚、燕、韓、趙、魏等六國結盟南北向聯合抗秦的外交策略。「横」指「連橫」，即一強連一弱以破獲眾弱，指六國分别與秦國東西向結盟的外交策略。

source_text:
今日的縱橫家
雖然縱橫家在秦朝以後就已從歷史上消失，但是今日的外交人員卻可以視為縱橫家。因為外交人員和使者，甚至是間諜在世界上各個國與國之間活動，進行遊說等工作，都與縱橫家類似。因此外交人員、使者和國際間諜也是縱橫家的現代版。
target_text: Today’s barbarians, although they have disappeared from history since Qin’s Qin dynasty, today’s diplomats can be regarded as barbarians. As diplomats and messengers, and even spies, operate between countries and countries around the world, they do the same thing by speaking out. So diplomats, envoys, and international spies are also modern versions of barbarians.
title: 纵横家

source_text:
争议
在2020年4月29日的外交部记者会上，有《澳大利亚人报》的记者抱怨警察不允许外国记者进入该公园，却没有援引任何法律条文，經記者向外交部新聞司人員查詢，亦無相關規定。对此发言人耿爽表示其应该询问警察，也可以找新聞司的同仁协助疏通障礙。
target_text: At a Foreign Office press conference on April 29, 2020, journalists from the Australian newspaper complained that the police did not allow foreign journalists to enter the park, without invoking any legal provisions, and that there was no rule for journalists to consult with members of the Department of Foreign Affairs’ Press Department. In response, the spokesman said that he should question the police, and that he could seek the help of his colleagues in the Press Department.
title: 北京中山公园

source_text: 进入21世纪后，海峽兩岸的经贸活動已相當緊密，並擁有一定程度的物資及人員流通自由。2008年中國國民黨籍的馬英九就任總統後，兩岸恢復官方交流。2015年11月7日，两岸领导人在新加坡會面，是為兩岸關係的重大進展。2016年民主進步黨籍的蔡英文就任總統後，表示不接受九二共識，中華人民共和國方面即宣布兩岸官方交流中斷。2016年末以来，中国人民解放军軍機開始繞台灣島飛行，中華民國大陸委員會稱此舉是針對臺灣的施壓與騷擾。2017年，中國大陸方面認為中华民国外交部长李大维對於推动台湾参与联合国的言論，以及总统蔡英文进一步提高国防预算，視為對中國大陸的挑釁。2019年，解放軍軍機越過臺灣海峽中線。2021年11月，國臺辦将行政院长蘇貞昌等三位政要列入“台独”顽固分子清单施行制裁，使兩岸關係降到1980年代雙方恢復交流以來的新低點。
target_text: On November 7, 2015, leaders from both sides met in Singapore to mark a major advance in relations between the two sides. Following the inauguration in 2016 of the President of the Democratic Progressive Party, the Chinese People’s Republic of China announced that official exchanges between the two sides had been disrupted. Since the end of 2016, Chinese People’s Liberation Army (SPLA) planes had begun to fly around Taiwan, and China’s National Land Commission had claimed that they were pressuring and harassing Taiwan.

source_text: 1990年代，包括中華民國政府在内的台湾各界对两岸关系的政治定位，可归为五大类：“国内关系”、“国际关系”、“国内关系中的特别关系”、“国际关系中的特别关系”、“准国际关系”，以及李登輝政府确立的与中华人民共和国政府接触时的两岸对等原则。蔡英文执政时期，中华民国政府认为“中華民國是主權國家，臺灣從來不是中華人民共和國的一部分”、“台湾是主权独立的国家，与中国互不隶属”。
target_text: In the 1990s, the political orientation of Taiwan’s cross-Strait relations, including that of the Chinese government, was grouped into five main categories: “domestic relations”, “international relations”, “special relations”, “special relations in internal relations”, “special relations in international relations”, “quasi-international relations”, and the principle of cross-Strait reciprocity in contacts with the Government of the People’s Republic of China, established by the Government of Li Denghui. During the English-language regime, the Government of the Republic of China considered that “China is a sovereign country, and Taiwan was never a part of the People’s Republic of China.” Taiwan was a sovereign and independent country and did not belong to China.

source_text: 此段期間，美國並不否認中華民國對台灣行使權力，卻在國軍節節敗退中為擺脫以往美國介入台灣的責任，改而採取袖手旁觀政策（Hands-off Policy，1949年12月23日美國國務院向遠東地區使節發表之秘密備忘錄），隨後因朝鲜战争認識台灣戰略地位的重要性，為防止中華人民共和國佔領台灣轉而正式提出台灣地位未定論，美國一方面維持與中華民國的外交關係，又認為中華民國實際控制的台灣是主權未決。雖然美國與中華民國成為軍事防禦同盟，其間美國並未放棄與中華人民共和國政府保持聯繫，1954年6月起雙方即在日內瓦展開大使級會談。
target_text: During this period, the United States did not deny the importance of China’s exercise of power over Taiwan, but instead took a stand-in by-view policy (Hands-off Policy, a secret memo of 23 December 1949 by the United States State Department to the Far East) in the defeat of the US military, in order to escape its previous responsibility to intervene in Taiwan. The United States, on the one hand, maintained diplomatic relations with the Chinese People’s Republic and believed that Taiwan, which is effectively controlled by the Chinese People’s Republic, had not been ruled out. Although the United States and the Chinese People’s Republic had become military defense allies, the United States had not given up relations with the Chinese People’s Republic and the Chinese Government, and since June 1954, the two sides had opened an ambassador’s conference in Geneva.

source_text: 1950年11月8日，中華人民共和國中央人民政府代表伍修权應安理會邀請出席朝鮮問題辯論，並就第七艦隊進入台灣海峽，指責「美國政府武裝侵略中國神聖的領土台灣」是「非法的犯罪的行為」，並與代表「中國」的中華民國代表當面對質，譴責其「辜负违背了中国人民的意愿，他没有任何权利代表中国。这个发言的人可能不是中国人，因为伟大的四億七千五百万中国人民的语言，他都不会讲」（當时中華民國代表在聯合國使用的語言是英式英語）。中華民國代表則指稱聯合國的「中國」席位只能屬於「自由獨立神聖的中國政府」。這是中華人民共和國首次出席聯合國會議，也是海峽兩岸雙方唯一一次當面外交對質。在朝鮮戰爭結束後的1954年日內瓦會議上，中華人民共和國派出外交部長周恩來出席會議，成為中華人民共和國首次出席的重大國際會議。1955年，聯合國秘書長哈馬捨爾德訪問北京，成為首位訪問中華人民共和國的國際組織領導人。在1950年代期間，中華人民共和國的外交形勢大有改觀，与苏联、10个社會主義国家（保加利亚、罗马尼亚、匈牙利、朝鲜、捷克斯洛伐克、波兰、蒙古、東德、阿尔巴尼亚和越南）、4个亚洲新興独立国家（巴基斯坦、缅甸、印度尼西亚、印度）和4个西方国家（芬兰、瑞典、丹麦、瑞士）建立外交关系，並接連與英國等多個國家展開正式外交往來。
target_text: On November 8, 1950, the Central People’s Government of the People’s Republic of China and the Government of the People’s Republic of China invited the Democratic People’s Republic of China to attend a debate on the question of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and on November 8, 1950, the Security Council of the People’s Central People’s Republic of China invited the Chinese government to the Taiwan Straits, accusing the “American Government of armed aggression against China’s sacred land of Taiwan” of “illegal criminal acts” and blaming the representatives of the Chinese People’s Republic of China for “defeating against the will of the Chinese people, who did not have the right to represent China. source_text: 美國於1972年承認中華人民共和國後，中華民國的外交關係為此大受打擊，至1976年與中華民國政府維持邦交的國家計23國，其餘世界各國多轉向承認中華人民共和國，包括1972年與中華人民共和國建交的英国、日本及1979年的美國。美國是最後一個與中華民國斷交的聯合國安全理事會常任理事國，其轉向卻早于1972年2月美國總統尼克森訪問北京，在2月28日與中華人民共和國國務院總理周恩來發表聯合公報（即上海公報），該公報內容言明「美國認識到，台灣海峽兩岸中國人均認為只有一個中國，台灣是中國的神聖領土一部分，美國對此一立場不提出異議」，僅管當時尼克森未言明「中國」係指中華人民共和國或中華民國，且前者尚未獲美國外交承認，但中華人民共和國已在聯合國內代表「中國」。隨後1973年5月中華人民共和國與美國正式在對方首都設立聯絡辦事處。1976年美軍顧問團從金門、馬祖撤離。中華人民共和國與美國間的實質外交關係日漸增強、中華民國與美國間的實質外交層次則逐漸降低，終於在1979年1月1日美國與中華人民共和國簽署中美建交公報，斷絕與中華民國的外交關係。

source_text: 1889年，为纪念法国大革命100周年，法国政府（法兰西第三共和国）把凡尔赛宫改造为公共博物馆，里面的展品全部供人展出、一般市民也可参观。1919年，第一次世界大战所召开的巴黎和会在鏡廳召开，法国政府（法兰西第三共和国）借此羞辱战败德国、报德国统一时候的一箭之仇；但同时，被羞辱的德国也因此记恨法国，为二战埋下伏笔，间接导致煽动德国爱国情绪的希特勒崛起。协约国于6月28日在鏡廳与德国签订《凡尔赛和约》。1920年，在大特里亚农宫签订制裁匈牙利王国的特里亚农和约。1937年，凡尔赛宫作为历史博物馆对公众开放。法国政府多次在宫中和花园中举办外事活动，召开国际会议，签署国际条约。
target_text: In 1889, in commemoration of the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution, the French Government (the Third Republic of France) transformed the Versailles Palace into a public museum, where all the displays were displayed and also accessible to the general public. On 28 June, in the mirror, it signed the Versailles Treaty with Germany. In 1920, at the Greater Terian Palace, it imposed sanctions on Triano of the Kingdom of Hungary. In 1937, the Versailles were opened to the public as a museum of history.

source_text: 关键分歧在于双方对开战问题的观点不一致。清朝认为，在没有正式宣战之前则不为开战状态，应遵循“国际法”中关于中立国船只保护的规定。而日本认为，既然爆发军事冲突，即适用“战时国际法”，而且“高陞”号运载的是交战国的军队，属于敌对行为，所以不应作为中立国船对待。此外日本还有观点认为，清日天津会议专条规定了双方如要在朝鲜派兵应知会对方，而且在19日日本给清国送去了5日期限的最后通谍说希望拿出适当的解决方案，如果此期间发现清朝派兵进入朝鲜将视之为威胁（在外交术语中意味着将会开战），因此即使真是日方先开火的，也不是不宣而战。
target_text: Japan is of the view that, since the military conflict has broken out, “war-time international law” is applicable, and the Takahami is carrying the armies of the belligerent states and is hostile, it should not be treated as a neutral state ship. 經濟制裁
經濟制裁是由於特定國家的行為，所做出的懲罰行為。經濟制裁是一個（多個）國家封鎖對特定國家的所有貿易，是由外部強加、嚴重孤立特定國家的行為。像美國自從1958年3月14日起，就針對古巴進行經濟制裁（美國對古巴的禁運）。一般而言，經濟制裁都是短期的，例如亞美尼亞曾在2020年12月31日起對土耳其的產品實施臨時禁運，停止從土耳其進口商品。此次禁運是在考量土耳其對亞美尼亞的敵意，以及亞美尼亞的糧食安全下，所做的舉動。
target_text: Economic sanctions are sanctions imposed by a particular country. Economic sanctions are imposed by a country (many) blocking all trade with a particular country. They are acts of foreign coercion and severe isolation of a particular country. Like the United States, which has imposed economic sanctions on Cuba since March 14, 1958 (the United States embargo on Cuba). Economic sanctions are generally short-term, as in the case of Armenia, which imposed a temporary ban on goods from Turkey on 31 December 2020 and stopped imports from Turkey.
title: 贸易

source_text: 1966年，聯合國區域集團進行了重新劃分，英國主導的“英聯邦”國家組解散，英國及英聯邦中的大國（加拿大、澳大利亞、新西蘭）加入“西歐及其他”組，其他英聯邦國家則加入了相應的地區組。這一改變也象徵性的表示了英國在國際外交上的超級大國地位已經結束。雖然英國至今在世界範圍內仍具有相當的影響力，在政治、外交、軍事及經濟上均有超出其人口、國土、經濟比重的影響力，但一般對於各國國力的排名中都把英國列爲“大國”之一，而不是超級大國。
target_text: In 1966, the United Nations regional blocs began to regroup, the British-led “British Union” countries were dissolved, the Great Britain and the United Kingdom (Canada, Australia, New Zealand) joined the “Western Europe and others” group, and other British states joined the corresponding group. This change is also symbolic of the end of Britain’s ultranational status in international diplomacy.
title: 超级大国

source_text: 战后，几乎所有的欧洲国家都与美国或苏联之中的一者结盟。尽管国际上存在着建立起一套多国的联合司法体制（如联合国）的尝试，但是事态越来越明晰：美国和苏联就是在初露头角的冷战中占全球统治地位的两个政治和经济力量。不过人们对战后的世界应该是如何却有很大的分歧。这在北大西洋公约和华沙条约的签订所形成的两大军事联盟上有所体现。这种种现象都表明美苏将在即将出现的两极世界，而不是战前的多极世界里面扮演重要的角色。不知道是否对这种世界格局的反应，除了英、美、蘇以外的法国和中国，以及其他一些國家，都纷纷做起包括研制核武器在内的各种努力，来保证自己独立的“强权”地位，以及能够在国际舞台上扮演一个“世界性的角色”。
target_text: After the war, almost all European countries were allied with the United States or one of the Soviet Union. source_text: 穷竭法 (; )，有时被误译为“穷举法”，是一种求图形面积的方法，其通过构造一个多边形序列，使这些多边形的面积收敛到所求图形面积。如果这个多边形序列构造得当，那么其第n项的面积与所求图形面积之差在n足够大时便可以小于任意给定正数。因为这个面积差可以任意小，是故该图形面积的可能值便系统性的被该多边形序列中的成员的面积所给出的一系列下界“穷竭”掉了。
target_text: The exhaustion method (;) is sometimes misinterpreted as “exhaustible”, which is a way of looking for a graphic area by constructing a polygonal sequence, so that the area of these polygons is condensed to the area sought. If the polygon sequence is properly constructed, the difference between the size of item n and the area of the graphics sought is less than a given number of squares at a sufficiently large n. Because the area difference can be arbitrary, the potential value of the area is thus systematically “depleted” by a series of lower bounds given by the size of the members of the polygon series.
title: 穷竭法

source_text: 阿基米德使用穷竭法来计算圆周所围住的面积，具体说来就是用一个面积越来越大，边数越来越多的多边形来填充这个圆。当多边形的边数越来越多时，其面积与圆半径的平方之商可以任意接近π，由此证明半径为r的圆周所围面积为πr2，其中π定义为圆的周径之比(C/d)或圆面积与半径平方之比(A/r²).
target_text: Archimedes uses the exhaustion method to calculate the area surrounding the circle, specifically to fill the circle with an ever-increasing area and a growing number of polygons. When the number of sides of the polygon is increasing, it is possible for traders to approach the square of the radius at will, thus proving that the radius is r2, which is defined as the radius ratio of the circle (C/d) or the radius ratio of the radius to the radius square (A/r2).
title: 穷竭法

source_text: 《第一次日韩协约》，又称《第一次韩日协约》、《日韩新协约》，是1904年8月22日朝鲜王朝（时称大韩帝国）和日本於漢城签订的不平等条约。條約主要內容為韩国僱用由日本政府推薦的财政顾问和外交顾问及与外国缔结条约前要与日本协商等等。韩国代表為外部大臣尹致昊，日方代表為駐韓公使林權助。
target_text: The First Japan-Korean Concord, also known as the First Korea-Japan Concord, the Japan-Korean New Concord, is an unequal treaty between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (then known as the Great Korean Empire) and Japan in Seoul on 22 August 1904. The treaty deals mainly with South Korea’s employment of financial and diplomatic advisers, recommended by the Japanese government, and consultation with Japan before entering into a treaty with a foreign country.
title: 第一次日韩协约

source_text:
代理第一夫人
早在学生时期，朴正熙和陆英修就让朴槿惠参与一些外交场合，对外出访时也有时会让朴槿惠同行。1972年10月，年仅20岁的朴槿惠就代替繁忙的陆英修应邀出访了西班牙，用西班牙语帶稿做出5分钟的演讲，首次登上外交舞台。1973年1月，她再次代替陆英修出访夏威夷，参加那里的韩国移民10周年庆典活动。
target_text: The Acting First Lady, Park Jung-hee and Lu Young-suk, have been involved in a number of diplomatic events since their students’ time, and have sometimes been accompanied by Park Geon-hye on their trips abroad. In October 1972, Park Geun-hye, a 20-year-old, was invited to Spain instead of the busy Lu Young-suk, where she gave a five-minute lecture in Spanish with a text, and joined the diplomatic stage for the first time. In January 1973, she took the place of Lu Young-suk to Hawaii, where she took part in the 10-year celebration of South Korean immigrants.
title: 朴槿惠

source_text:
背景
本條約在中國、朝鮮和美國三國互動、協商的情況下達成。朝鮮王朝在1870年代以前实行鎖國政策，但在1876年，日本以武力強迫朝鮮簽訂《江華條約》，成功打開朝鮮的國門。此后西方列强纷纷进入，《朝美修好通商條約》就是在这个基礎上簽定的。在协商中，中国清朝代表李鴻章要求在条约中載入“朝鮮是中國屬邦”一句，但由于受到美国代表薛斐尔的反对，決定朝鮮政府在該條約外，另外發布照會表明中朝之間的宗藩關係。
target_text: In 1876, Japan succeeded in opening the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s door by force, forcing the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea to sign the Jianghua Treaty. Since then, Western powers have entered, and the Treaty on the Restoration of Business between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the United States has been signed on this basis.
title: 朝美修好通商条约

source_text: 不平等条约的稱謂是中国国民政府于1920年代提出的，最初用來指西方與清朝及北洋政府所簽署的一系列條約，這些條約雖然多是強加的，但其中有許多其實是平等條約（例如列強強迫清朝與他們平等建交，外國強索外國人在中國傳教與居住的權力）。後來不平等条约的概念逐漸發展，在國際上亦有被其它國家使用。但現在法學上對何謂不平等條約還是沒有很明確的定論。有些人認為只包括使用武力或胁迫下達成的条约。這種定義下，不平等條約基本上等同於強加條約。但亦有學者認為不平等條約可以指更多不同手段下造成的不平等。這種定義下的不平等條約，包括了任何在本質上對締約國存在不平等的條約。
target_text: The notion of an inequality treaty, originally proposed by the Chinese national government in the 1920’s, was initially used to refer to a series of treaties signed by the West and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the North Korean government, which, although much of it is strong, are actually equality treaties (e.g., forced by the Qing dynasty to work on an equal footing with them, foreign powers to demand foreign nationals’ right to teach and reside in China). The concept of inequality treaties has evolved and is used internationally.
title: 強加條約

source_text:
華為财务长孟晚舟引渡案
2018年12月1日，華為董事會副主席孟晚舟在加拿大被捕，並被要求引渡到美國。中國政府隨即發表聲明，指控孟晚舟被捕是“嚴重侵犯中國公民合法合法權益，無法無天、無理無情、極其惡毒”並警告會有“嚴重後果”。中國駐加拿大大使盧沙野直接指責加拿大是“西方自負和白人至上”。其後雙方的外交紛爭不斷升級，令中美加三國的關係陷入低點。
target_text: On December 1, 2018, China was arrested in Canada as Vice-President of the Board of Directors, and requested to be extradited to the United States. The Chinese government immediately stated that the arrest was a “serious violation of the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese citizens, and that it could not be done with impunity, recklessly, and with extreme perniciousness” and warned of “serious consequences.” The Chinese Ambassador to Canada, Lushano, directly accused Canada of “Western arrogance and white supremacy.”
title: 引渡法

source_text: 中國與俄羅斯的經貿關係在兩國簽訂《尼布楚条约》後正式展開；《尼布楚条约》被稱為中俄貿易的起始性条约，容許两国持护照的人民越界贸易。兩國其後簽訂《恰克图条约》、《瑷珲条约》、《北京条约》及《天津条约》等協约，進一步規範中俄貿易的地点、性質，以及有關的。中藥大黃在俄羅斯一度非常暢銷，利润也頗為可观：大黃的进口价約為12卢布，轉運到圣彼得堡後，價錢隨即上升至110卢布。由於大黃主要在恰克图進口，恰克图的貿易曾因大黃而繁荣起來。
target_text: China’s trade-related relations with Russia have been officially opened since the signing of the Nebuchu Treaty between the two countries; the Nebuchu Treaty is known as the initial treaty of trade facilitation between China and Russia, allowing the people of the two countries with passports to cross the border. The two countries have subsequently signed agreements such as the Chaquetu Treaty, the Penang Treaty, the Beijing Treaty, and the Tianjin Treaty to further regulate the location, nature, and related aspects of Russia’s trade.
title: 中俄关系史

source_text: 1924年，苏联當局與张作霖的奉系军阀簽訂《奉俄协定》，是苏联首次与中国地方政府签訂协議；由於苏联是主权国家、奉系军阀則只是地方政府，此协约被質疑抵觸国际法中的规定。1927年11月17日凌晨，张发奎、黄琪翔等人在广州发动政变，改组国民党广东省党部，即广州张黄事变。南京国民政府认为，此事为苏联一手操纵。12月11日又爆发广州起义。12月14日，南京国民政府发布了对苏联的断绝邦交令。
target_text: In 1924, the Soviet Union signed an agreement with the local government of China for the first time in the Russian Federation, signed by the Soviet authorities and Zhang's Bong warlord; since the Soviet Union was a sovereign state and a warlord was only a local government, this agreement was questioned against the provisions of international law. In the early hours of November 17, 1927, Zhang Fukwe and Huang Ki-Sun, among others, staged a coup d'état in Guangzhou, restructuring the Guangdong provincial party department of the National Party, Zhang Guangzhou. The Nanjing National Government considered the matter to be one of its own manipulation. On December 11, another Guangzhou uprising broke out. On December 14, the Nanjing National Government issued an order to cut off the Soviet Union.
title: 中俄关系史

source_text: 1929年，張作霖之子張學良試圖收回蘇聯在滿洲地區北部的特殊權益；他首先奪回蘇聯在東清鐵路的特權，蘇聯抗議並要求賠償，但沒有進一步行動。其後，張氏轄下的有關部門就東清鐵路一事提出交涉，蘇聯同意讓中國人出任鐵路要職。1929年中旬，張學良派員搜查蘇聯駐哈爾濱總領事館，又逮捕大量蘇方人員，試圖奪取東清鐵路路權；蘇聯當局提出抗議，宣佈中國駐蘇聯的外交代表機構不再享有治外法權，但張學良不為所動，在1個月後以蘇聯違背《奉俄協定》為由，收回東清鐵路管理權，又派人查封蘇聯企業、拘捕蘇聯人員。蘇聯方面起初希望召集會議，和平解決事件，但國民政府仍然態度強硬；同月，蘇聯政府宣布斷絕與中國的外交關係。中蘇兩國隨後激戰3個月，是為中東路事件；最終，中方落敗，與苏联簽署《伯力會議議定書》。事件中，蘇聯和第三国际要求中國共產黨「武装保卫苏联」，但當時中國的民眾普遍不支持此主張。
target_text: In 1929, Zhang Xing’s son, Zhang Xianqian, tried to recover the special rights of the Soviet Union in the northern part of Manchuria; he first took back the Soviet privilege of the Soviet Union on the East China Railway, and the Soviet Union protested and demanded compensation, but did not move further. In mid 1929, Zhang Qing Qing’s search for the Soviet Prime Minister’s office in Halqian resulted in the arrest of a large number of Soviets, and attempted to take back the Soviet Union’s special rights on the East China Railway; the Soviet Union protested that China’s diplomatic representatives no longer had the power to rule outside the country, but that it was unmotivated by the Soviet Union’s defiance of the Russian Federation’s Russian Federation’s Russian Federation, which, after a month, demanded that the Soviet Union’s Soviet Union’s 3-month-long military command should be suspended on the pretext of the Soviet Union and the Soviet Union’s.

source_text: 1949年10月，中華人民共和國成立。蘇聯是首個承認中華人民共和國、並與之建立邦交的國家；1949年10月2日，蘇聯表示願意與中華人民共和國建立外交關係，中方於翌日同意兩國建交。同月7日，蘇聯驻中华人民共和国大使尼古拉·瓦西里耶维奇·罗申到达满洲里，時任中央人民政府政務院總理周恩來、副總理董必武等人亲自迎接他；中華人民共和國政府以此種礼遇接待大使，在現代外交史上並不常見。中华人民共和国驻蘇聯大使王稼祥在1949年10月20日起程離國，周恩來總理親自為他送行；當天，時任中共中央主席兼中央人民政府主席的毛澤東親自致函蘇共中央總書記兼蘇聯部長會議主席斯大林，向後者介紹王稼祥的職責，是中華人民共和國唯一一次由最高領導人親自為駐外大使寫介紹信。
target_text: The Soviet Union was the first country to recognize the People’s Republic of China and to establish ties with it; on 2 October 1949, the Soviet Union expressed its willingness to establish diplomatic relations with the People’s Republic of China, and China agreed to do so the following day. On 7 October, the Soviet ambassador to the People’s Republic of China, Nicolas Vasilievitch Roshin, arrived in Manchuria, where he was greeted by Zhou Enlai, the Vice-President of the Central People’s Government, Bivwu, and others; the Chinese People’s Republic of China welcomed the Ambassador for such courtesy, not so often in the history of modern diplomacy. title: 中俄关系史

source_text: 1949年12月，毛澤東以給斯大林祝壽為名，出訪蘇聯；同時，中國國內也舉行了各式各樣的祝壽活動，如酒會、巡遊等，不少團體和學校均有致送賀禮。毛澤東乘祝壽之機，和斯大林商談签订条约一事，但斯大林刻意迴避。祝寿完後，毛泽东待在孔策沃别墅內发牢骚，不肯出外参加活动，令斯大林尴尬，更有谣言指斯大林软禁毛泽东，亦有傳朱德和刘少奇政变；後來，毛泽东向記者暗示，如果中蘇兩國無法簽訂條約，他就不會回國。斯大林只好让步，在1950年1月2日同意订立同盟条约；於是，毛泽东致函周恩来，派其赴蘇跟斯大林谈判。
target_text: In December 1949, Mao Zedong paid a visit to the Soviet Union in the name of his birthday to Stalin; in the same time, China held a variety of birthday celebrations, such as wine fairs, tours, etc., and a number of groups and schools offered congratulations. Mao Zedong took the opportunity to celebrate his birthday and negotiated a treaty with Stalin, but Stalin deliberately avoided it. After that, Mao was in a state of disarray at the Kontzevo Villa and refused to take part in the event, embarrassing Stalin, and there were more rumours that Stalin had banned Mao Zedong, as well as the coup d'état of Judddh and Liu Shakchi. Mao Zedong then suggested to reporters that he would not return to the country if the Sino-Soo countries could not sign the contract. Stalin agreed to enter into an alliance treaty on 2 January 1950; then Mao sent a letter to Zhoun and sent him to negotiate with Stalin.

source_text: 1991年末，蘇聯解體，包括俄羅斯在內的蘇聯加盟共和國分別成為了獨立的國家。中華人民共和國政府在當年12月27日宣佈承認俄羅斯聯邦政府；同日，中國外交部部長錢其琛致電俄羅斯聯邦外交部部長安德烈·科济列夫，表示中方決定改任原來的駐蘇聯大使王藎卿為中國駐俄羅斯聯邦大使。
target_text: In late 1991, the Soviet Union, including Russia’s Soviet Republic, became an independent state. The Chinese People’s Republic announced on 27 December of that year that it had recognized the Russian federal government; on the same day, the Chinese Minister for Foreign Affairs paid the Chinese Minister for Foreign Affairs to the Russian Minister for Foreign Affairs, Andrei Kozilev, who said that China had decided to change his post to that of the former Soviet Ambassador, Wang Xiaoqing, as the Chinese Ambassador to the Russian Federation.
title: 中俄关系史

source_text: 2001年7月中旬，江泽民與俄罗斯总统普京簽訂有效20年的《中俄睦邻友好合作条约》，確定了中俄兩國合作的原则；其後，江泽民表示条约将以法律形式鞏固中俄友好，並规划了中俄關係在21世纪的發展。2004年10月中旬，中俄兩國簽訂《中俄邊界東段補充協定》，成功勘分98%的東段和西段國界；翌年，剩餘部分國界的勘分和相關立法程序亦告完成，中俄領土爭議到此為止。
target_text: In mid-July 2001, Jiang Zemin and Russian President Vladimir Putin signed the 20-year-old Treaty on Good-Neighbourly Relations and Cooperation between China and Russia, confirming the principles of cooperation between China and Russia; after that, Jiang Zemin stated that the Treaty would legally entrench Chinese-Russian friendship and plan the development of Chinese-Russian relations in the twenty-first century. In mid-October 2004, China and Russia signed the Eastern Sector Plus Agreement on the Russian-Chinese Border, which succeeded in demarcating 98% of the Eastern and Western Sectors.
title: 中俄关系史

source_text: 古墳時代之後，5世紀後期至6世紀初期，福岡縣開始出現獨自的古墳文化，代表性古墳有石人山古墳、岩戶山古墳等地。4世紀之後，大和朝廷的勢力開始擴張到九州北部地區，並在6世紀時已取代當地的豪族勢力，成為福岡縣的支配勢力。7世紀初，由於福岡縣是對東亞大陸重要的外交窗口，大和政權在福岡地區設立-{筑紫}-大宰，主管對中國和朝鮮半島的外交。7世紀中期，倭國在白江口之戰中不敵唐朝、新羅聯軍。戰後倭國在福岡地區設立大宰府，並修築大野城等防禦設施，設筑紫館作為接待外國使節的場所。

After the fourth century, the power of the Great and the Yangtze Court began to spread to the northern part of Kyushu, replacing the local hordes in the 6th century. At the beginning of the 7th century, as an important diplomatic window for the Great Lakes region, the Great and the Government set up {violet}- Dazes in the Fukuoka region, and led a diplomatic mission to China and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea. In the middle of the 7th century, the Lao People’s Democratic Republic did not oppose the Tang Dynasty or the New Romans in the battle on the White River.
title: 福冈县

source_text: 《美巴條約》（英語：Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty ；西班牙語：Tratado Hay-Bunau Varilla）是巴拿马与美国就巴拿马运河歸屬所签订的条约，1903年巴拿马为从哥伦比亚合众国独立以换得美国在外交、军事、经济上的援助而签订。条约规定巴拿马以1000万美元的价格向美国出让運河主权，以及运河两侧各8公里，面积1673平方公里的土地以并转交给美国永久使用。巴拿马因此获得美国的帮助而独立，并且，巴拿马运河的建设全部资金人力都是由美方完成。
target_text: The American-American Pact (Hay-Bunau-Varilla Treaty; Spanish: Tratado Hay-Bunau Varilla) is a treaty between Panama and the United States on the attribution of the Panama Canal, signed in 1903 by Panama in exchange for diplomatic, military, and economic assistance from the United States. The treaty provides for Panama’s sovereign right to the United States of America at a price of US$ 10 million, as well as 8 kilometres of land on each side of the Canal, covering an area of 1673 square kilometres, to be transferred to the United States for permanent use.
title: 美巴条约

source_text: 大多数法学家认为，联合国大会的大部分决议都不是强制性的：根据《联合国宪章》第十二条以及第十四条的说法，大会所通过的决议只是“建议”。但是对于联合国安理会的决议是否具有强制性，争议就比较多。《宪章》第二十五条规定“联合国会员国同意依宪章之规定接受并履行安全理事会之决议¹。”但是一些专家认为并不是所有的“决定”都是强制性的，而只是那些涉及《宪章》第七章所称的“和平之威胁、和平之破坏及侵略行为”的决议才是强制性的。而即使动用了第七章，仍然有些大国有能力无视决议做出违反的举动。
target_text: According to most jurists, most United Nations General Assembly resolutions are not mandatory: according to Article 12 and Article 14 of the Charter of the United Nations, resolutions adopted by the General Assembly are simply “recommendations.” But there is more controversy about whether United Nations Security Council resolutions are mandatory. Article 25 of the Charter provides that “Member States of the United Nations agree to accept and implement Security Council resolutions in accordance with the provisions of the Charter.” Some experts, however, believe that not all “decisions” are mandatory, but only those relating to Chapter VII of the Charter, which refers to “threats to the peace, breaches of the peace, and acts of aggression.” And even with Chapter VII, there is still a capacity on the part of some major Powers to ignore resolutions in violation.
title: 联合国决议

source_text: 联合国大会决议由联合国全体成员国投票决定，大部分只要获得参与投票（即排除那些未投票或投弃权票的成员国）的过半数以上成员国的支持即获得通过。但是凡涉及“维持国际和平及安全之建议、安全理事会非常任理事国之选举、经济及社会理事会理事国之选举、托管理事会理事国之选举、对于新会员国加入联合国之准许、会员国权利及特权之停止、会员国之除名、关于施行托管制度之问题，以及预算问题”等“重要问题之决议”，则需要获得参与投票的三分之二以上成员国的支持才可通过。联合国大会通过的决议并无任何法律约束力，仅有道德上的意义。
target_text: The resolutions of the General Assembly of the United Nations are adopted by a vote of all States Members of the United Nations, mostly with the support of a majority of those participating in the voting (i.e., those that have not voted or abstained in the voting), but with regard to “advices for the maintenance of international peace and security, the election of non-permanent members of the Security Council, the election of the members of the Economic and Social Council, the election of the Trusteeship Council, the admission of new Members to the United Nations, the suspension of the rights and privileges of Member States, the delisting of Members, the question of the implementation of the trusteeship system and the question of the budget”, resolutions adopted by the General Assembly require the support of more than two thirds of the members participating in the voting. The resolutions adopted by the General Assembly are not legally binding and have only moral significance.
title: 联合国大会决议

source_text: 亨利·阿尔弗雷德·基辛格（，），本名海因茨·阿尔弗雷德·基辛格（） ，是一位出生於德國的美国猶太裔政治家、外交家、国际政治理论家及地缘政治学者。曾任美国总统国家安全事务助理，后担任理查德·尼克松政府的国务卿並在水门事件之后继续在杰拉尔德·福特政府中担任此职。作为一位现实政治的支持者，基辛格在1969年到1977年之间在美国外交政策，尤其是“三角外交”中发挥了中心作用。在这段时期内，他倡导缓和政策，使美苏之间紧张的关系得到缓解，並在1971年秘密访问中国，与中华人民共和国国务院总理周恩来的会谈中扮演了至关重要的角色，為了1972年尼克松访华鋪路，促成新的战略性反苏中美联盟。他与越南政治家黎德壽一同为1973年诺贝尔和平奖获得者。1976年在福特总统连任失败后，基辛格成为乔治城大学沃尔什外交学院的教授。
target_text: Henry Alfred Kissinger (,) Heinz Alfred Kissinger, a German-born American Jewish politician, diplomat, international political theorist and geopolitician, served as Assistant to the President of the United States for National Security Affairs, then Secretary of State to the Richard Nixon Government, and continued to hold this position in the government of Gerald Ford after the Watergate incident. As a supporter of real politics, Kissinger played a central role in United States foreign policy between 1969 and 1977, especially “triangular diplomacy.” During this period, he advocated de-escalation, easing tensions between the United States and the Soviet Union, and, in 1971, played a crucial role in talks with Premier Zhoun of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, promoting a new strategic anti-Sino-American alliance for the purpose of visiting China in 1972.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text: 基辛格被公认为是國際關係學中世界秩序与现实主义權力平衡大师，其理论主要聚焦在美苏两极对抗的国际环境下如何运用国家外交手段，建立政治联盟，对抗苏联一极的压力；即在美国处于劣势的情况下联合各种力量遏制苏联的强势状态，从而达到两极力量的相对的平衡。基辛格理论为西方在冷战中取得最后的胜利奠定了基础，后来被广泛运用于国家外交活动中、作为国家对外关系的理论来源；典型的表现在美国总统理查德·尼克松和罗纳德·里根的外交政策之中。
target_text: Kissinger is widely recognized as the master of the balance of power between world order and realism in international relations, and his theory focuses on the use of national diplomacy in the international context of the bipolar confrontation between the United States and the Soviet Union to build political alliances against the pressure of the Soviet Union; that is, to unite forces to curb the power of the Soviet Union in a situation of disadvantage, thereby achieving a relative balance between the two powers. The Kissinger theory, which laid the foundation for the Western’s final victory in the cold war, was then widely applied in the country’s diplomatic activities as a source of theory for the country’s external relations; it is typically manifested in the foreign policy of US President Richard Nixon and Ronald Reagan.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text: 1946年回国复员后，进入哈佛大学学习，在1950年以一等荣誉取得政治学学士学位。他分別於1952年及1954年獲得哈佛大學的哲學碩士和哲學博士。他題為《被修復的世界：梅特涅、卡蘇里及和平的問題1812—22》的19世纪的欧洲外交史研究，常被說為是哈佛博士論文中最長的一篇（魏登菲尔德和尼科尔森出版長達365頁）。论文主要观点认为，1809年维也纳和约之后欧洲协调国际秩序下的百年和平，主要归功于梅特涅和卡苏里并没有对战败的拿破仑法国采取过多的报复，而是更重视国际体系下的力量均衡。基辛格在哈佛是师从威廉·杨德尔·艾略特的指导，他的这位老师是有名的美国历史学家，曾为六任美国总统担任过政治和历史问题的顾问。在老师的关照和学院的有利条件下，他多次出席战后对国际形势的研讨会，积攒起了进入华盛顿从政的人脉，其中值得一提的是日后的日本首相中曾根康弘就在这时候与其相识。博士毕业之后的基辛格开始在政治学部的教学工作，通过参加美国政府举办的外交问题评议会，为同时代的外交政策提出了积极的建议。作為一個渴望能對美國外交政策有更大的影響的開明的共和黨人，基辛格成了纽约州州长纳尔逊·洛克菲勒的支持者和顧問，後者在1960年、1964年及1968年爭取成為共和黨總統提名人。
target_text: After his demobilization in 1946, he went to Harvard University, where he obtained a bachelor’s degree in political science with first-rate honours in 1950. He was distinguished from Harvard University’s Bachelor of Philosophy and Doctor of Philosophy in 1952 and 1954. He addressed the 19th century’s study of the history of European diplomacy on the theme “A rehabilitated world: Metne, Kasuri and peace” 1812-22, and was often described as one of the finest of the Harvard dissertations (Weidenfield and Nickerson publishers of 365 pages). The paper focused on the view that 100 years of peace under the European Union’s coordinated international order after 1809, thanks mainly to Maitne and Kasuri’s, who did not take a great deal of revenge against war-torn France, but rather focused more on the balance of power under the international system.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text: 为了继续对苏联施加外交压力，在1971年7月和10月，基辛格两度秘密访问中华人民共和国，与时任中华人民共和国国务院总理周恩来协商，並负责美国政府的对华政策，承诺美国将逐步减少驻台的军事力量；不支持“两个中国”或“一中一台”，不支持台獨。这为1972年尼克松访华的中美高峰会议铺路以及为中美关系正常化奠定了基石，结束了中华人民共和国和美国两国间23年的敌对与隔阂，从而完成了战略性的外交政策转变。基辛格亦与中国共产党中央委员会主席毛泽东见面。基辛格常被中華人民共和國政府称为“中国人民的老朋友”，与多任中国领导人都有交情（日后基辛格曾多次访华并得到邓小平、江泽民、胡锦涛、习近平等历任中国最高领导人的接见）。基辛格的外交对两国的经济文化都带来了很大影响，在1979年美国放弃承认中华民国，並与中华人民共和国建交。
target_text: In order to continue to exert diplomatic pressure on the Soviet Union, Kissinger made two secret visits to the People's Republic of China in July and October 1971, consulted with then Premier Zhou Enlai of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and was responsible for the United States Government's policy towards China, promising that the United States would gradually reduce its military presence; did not support “two Chinas” or “one China, one Taiwan” and did not support Taiwan independence. This paved the way for the 1972 Nixon summit in China and laid the groundwork for normalizing relations between the two countries, ending 23 years of hostility and separation between the People's Republic of China and the United States, thus completing a strategic foreign policy shift.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text: 尽管苏联在勃列日涅夫时期极力在中东地区扩张，扩大了苏联在中东的势力范围，但当苏联支持的埃及和叙利亚在1973年的第四次中东战争中再次败给以色列之后，基辛格在以、阿之间的穿梭外交谈判，哈菲兹·阿萨德领导下的叙利亚开始谋求在美国与苏联之间进行平衡外交，不再专一依赖苏联。萨达特领导下的埃及与苏联彻底闹翻、反目成仇。
target_text: Despite the Soviet Union’s aggressive expansion in the Middle East during the Brezhnev period, which expanded the Soviet Union’s reach in the Middle East, Kissinger began to seek a balanced diplomacy between the United States and the Soviet Union under the leadership of Hafez Al-Assad, after the Soviet-backed Egypt and Syria once again lost to Israel in the fourth Middle East war in 1973. Egypt, led by Sadat, has completely turned against the Soviet Union.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text:
奥古斯托·皮诺切特军事政变
1970年的智利总统大选中，来自社会主义阵营，左派的阿连德以微弱优势胜出，他的马克思主义和亲古巴政策令华盛顿非常担心。尼克松政府曾考虑授权中情局组织军事政变来阻止阿连德就职並重新进行大选，不过计划因政府对反对派的信心不足而流产。基辛格是否支持这个计划已经不得而知。在阿连德执政期间美国和智利的关系一直处于冰封状态，许多涉及美国利益的智利企业被收归国有，其中包括有美资的铜矿，美国国际电报电话公司（AT&T）在智利的分公司等。美国以此对智利实施经济制裁，中情局也资助了1972和73年的反政府大罢工。在这期间，基辛格关于智利政府的一些言论颇具争议，他说“情况已经太严重了，我们不能再放手让他们的选民自己决定前途”，“我看不到有什么理由放任一个国家因为其不负责任的人民而走向共产主义”。这些言论激起了很多媒体的愤慨，认为这是对智利主权的干涉和践踏。在1973年9月11日，奥古斯托·皮诺切特在美国的支持下发动政变，推翻阿连德政权。在政变中阿连德是被杀还是自杀直到现在仍无定论。
target_text: In 1970, the Chilean presidential coup of Augusto Pinochet came from the socialist camp, the left-wing Allende won with a slight advantage, and his Marxist and pro-Cuban policies were very worrying to Washington. The Nixon government had considered authorizing the CIA to organize a military coup to prevent Allende from taking office and re-election, although the plan was aborted by a lack of government confidence in the opposition. In the meantime, Kissinger’s statements about the Chilean government were controversial. “The situation is too serious, and we cannot afford to let their constituents decide their future”, and “I see no reason to allow a country to lead to co-production because of its irresponsible people.” These statements, which the United States also financed the anti-government strike in Chile in 1972 and 73 years, have provoked a lot of media outrage, arguing that the current coup d’état was supported by the United States, and that it was still a coup d’état, and that it was a coup d’état, and that it was a coup d’état, and that it was a coup d’état.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text: 2015年1月3日，基辛格在日本《读卖新闻》說，“日本对本国安保承担起更多的责任、对国际安保发挥更积极的作用，是难免的；总而言之，日本将成为一个普通国家”，普通国家意味着日本将和其他国家一样可以拥有军队并参加战争，但“如果日本推行独断且具有攻击性的外交政策，将成为地区隐患”；就亚洲局势，基辛格說，“亚洲地区缺乏一个可以关怀弱小国家、维护地区平衡的国家，中国周边国家都通过与美国合作来保持（和中国之间的）平衡”，“我反对美国对中国建立包围网，也不赞成以中美关系为核心的外交政策”。
target_text: On 3 January 2015, Kissinger said in Japan's Read-Sales News that “Japan takes more responsibility for its own security and plays a more active role in international security is inevitable; in general, Japan will become an ordinary country, which means that Japan, like other countries, will have an army and participate in war, but that “if Japan pursues an arbitrary and aggressive foreign policy, it will become a regional problem”; in the Asian context, Kissinger said that “the Asian region lacks a country that can take care of the weak and maintain regional balance, and the countries surrounding China maintain a balance (between China and China) through cooperation with the United States”, and that “I reject the United States' siege network against China and the foreign policy centred on Chinese-American relations”.
title: 亨利·基辛格

source_text: 美國國務卿（），直译为美國國務部長，前稱即其前身為美国外交部长（）是美國國務院的首長，同時為美國內閣閣员，主管美国外交事务。国务卿代表美国总统執行對外政策，相当于美国外交部长，其地位要比其他内阁部长高，是所有內閣部長中的首席。现任美国国务卿为安東尼·布林肯，于2021年1月26日上任。
target_text: U.S. Secretary of State (US Secretary of State), translated directly as U.S. Secretary of State, formerly known as U.S. Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs (US Secretary of State), was the head of the U.S. Department of State (US Secretary of State) and US Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs. The Secretary of State, acting on behalf of the U.S. President of the United States, exercised foreign policy equivalent to that of the U.S. Secretary of State, who was the chief of all cabinet ministers. The current U.S. Secretary of State, Anthony Bulkin, took office on 26 January 2021.
title: 美国国务卿

source_text:
歷史沿革
其前身為美国外交部长，始建于1781年1月10日，终止于1789年9月15日，《邦联条例》允许邦聯議會选择“可根据需要选拔对美国外交事务的委员会和人员。”1780年1月10日，联邦国会成立了外交部门。1781年8月10日，美国国会选择一个来自纽约州的国会代表羅伯特·李維頓作为首任外交部长，1781年10月20日，他正式宣布就职，他的任期一直到1783年6月4日。他的继任者约翰·杰伊的任期一直到1789年3月4日。
target_text: His predecessor, the United States Foreign Minister, was established on 10 January 1781 and terminated on 15 September 1789, and the Confederate Regulations allowed the Federation Council to choose “to select committees and staff for United States foreign affairs as needed.” On 10 January 1780, the Federal Congress established the diplomatic service. On 10 August 1781, the United States Congress chose Robert Levyton, a representative of the New York State, as its first Foreign Minister, and on 20 October 1781, he officially announced his term of office, which lasted until 4 June 1783. His successor, John Jay, remained in office until 4 March 1789.
title: 美国国务卿

source_text:
國務卿相當是外交部長，而不是政府總理，因為美國是總統制國家，總統是政府首脑並领导内阁。国务卿的職責
根據憲法，美國總統決定美國的外交政策。國務卿由總統在參議院建議和同意下任命，是總統的首席外交顧問。國務卿通過國務院和美國外交部執行總統的外交政策。
target_text: The Secretary of State is quite a minister of foreign affairs, not a prime minister of government, because the United States is a presidential country, and the President is the head of government and heads the cabinet. Under the Constitution, the Secretary of State determines the foreign policy of the United States. The Secretary of State, who is appointed by the President on the advice and with the consent of the Senate, is the chief diplomatic adviser to the President. The Secretary of State pursues the foreign policy of the President through the House of State and the United States Department of Foreign Affairs.
title: 美国国务卿

source_text:

進行與合眾國外交事務有關的談判；

就合眾國大使、部長、領事和其他外交代表的任命向總統提供建議；

source_text:
内战
麦克尔·考林斯签署的英爱和平条约承认爱尔兰的分裂，但议会中的小部分人和共和国总统伊蒙·德·瓦勒拉不承认这个条约。议会、新芬党内部和爱尔兰共和军内部对这个条约的见解分歧都存在。德·瓦勒拉辞总统职。在此后的爱尔兰内战中他领导“共和军”与新的由新芬党组织的政府的爱尔兰正规军。1923年共和军投降，内战结束。1926年德·瓦勒拉退出新芬党成立了一个新的政党爱尔兰共和党。1932年爱尔兰共和党在大选中获胜，德·瓦勒拉成为爱尔兰首相。
target_text: The British Peace Pact signed by Michael Collins recognized Ireland's division, but a small part of Parliament and the President of the Republic, Emón de Valera, did not recognize the Treaty. Dissenting views on the Treaty existed within Parliament, the Sinn Fein Party, and within the Irish Republican Army. De Valera resigned as President. In the Irish Civil War that followed, he led the “Republican Army” and the new Irish regular government, organized by the Sinn Finn Party. In 1923, the Republican Army surrendered and the civil war ended. De Valera withdrew from the New Fein Party in 1926 and established a new party, the Irish Republican Party. In 1932, the Irish Republican Party won the election, and De Valera became Prime Minister of Ireland.
title: 愛爾蘭歷史

source_text: 1985年英国和爱尔兰就北爱尔兰问题达成协议，爱尔兰在这个问题上有发言权。1994年近爱尔兰共和军的新芬党宣布单方面停火，为和平谈判制造了前提。1997年爱尔兰总统玛丽·罗宾逊成为联合国人权委员会主席。1998年4月10日爱尔兰政府、英国政府和北爱尔兰的党派签署了条约，爱尔兰放弃其在宪法中规定的对北爱尔兰的主权要求。在此后的全民公投中94%的选民同意删除宪法中的这一条。
target_text: Ireland had a say in the question of Northern Ireland in 1985 when the British and Irish parties reached an agreement on Northern Ireland. In 1994, the recent announcement of a unilateral ceasefire by the Irish Republican Army, the Sinn Fein Party, created a precondition for peace negotiations. In 1997, Irish President Mary Robinson became Chairman of the United Nations Commission on Human Rights. On 10 April 1998, the Irish Government, the British Government and parties in Northern Ireland signed a treaty, and Ireland waived its constitutional claim to sovereignty over Northern Ireland.

source_text: 5月15日清晨，中華人民共和國外交部副部長羅貴波召見英國駐華代辦，遞交外交部的抗議聲明，把騷亂事件定性為「英國政府勾結美帝國主義反對中國的陰謀」，又指「港英當局利用人造花廠勞資糾紛，對中國居民和工人進行迫害」，要求英國政府責成港府接受工人和居民的正當要求、停止一切法西斯措施等5項條件。當日，有紅衛兵到北京的英國駐華代辦處門前示威，《人民日報》亦發表題為「香港英國當局必須懸崖勒馬」的評論員文章，重申中華人民共和國政府的立場。中華人民共和國政府表態支持香港暴動及召見英國駐華代辦抗議的舉動對香港的左派團體具有吶喊助威的作用，香港的左派報章包括《文匯報》及《大公報》均在頭版廣泛報道，驅使香港左派團體決意發起更大規模的騷亂。5月17日，中共領導的中華全國總工會致電香港工聯會表態支持香港左派工人以「毛澤東思想」鬥垮港英政府，並發動北京群眾遊行到英國駐中國代辦處示威及舉行聲討港英政府的大會。

source_text: 南斯拉夫在1990年代初期解體，1992年，作為主体部份的塞爾維亞和黑山重組成立由塞爾維亞主導的南斯拉夫聯盟共和國（南聯盟）。1999年科索沃戰爭後联合国建立联合国科索沃临时行政当局特派团，并结束20世纪90年代的南斯拉夫内战。2003年，南斯拉夫聯盟共和國重新組建，將國名改為塞爾維亞和黑山。2006年5月21日，黑山透過公民投票決定正式獨立，6月3日蒙特內哥羅議會正式宣佈獨立，6月5日塞爾維亞國會亦宣佈獨立並且成為塞蒙聯邦的法定繼承國，塞蒙聯邦因而解散。10月28日，塞爾維亞就是否接受新憲法草案舉行全民公決，結果顯示草案獲得通過。2008年2月17日，科索沃自行宣佈獨立為科索沃共和國，但塞爾維亞拒絕承認。。

source_text: 塞爾維亞的前身南斯拉夫於中華人民共和國成立時即予以承認，但是在蘇南交惡後，中華人民共和國選擇站在蘇聯一邊，導致兩國關係十分緊張。雖然兩國於1955年1月2日正式建交，但是兩國關係依然十分冷淡，並於1958年因南斯拉夫抵制蘇聯爲國際共產主義運動之首一事再次交惡，一直持续到1977年南斯拉夫總統狄托访华后关系才正常化。中華人民共和國在貝爾格萊德擁有大使館，並在普里什蒂納設有一辦公室。而塞爾維亞在北京擁有大使館，並在上海設有一總領事館。中華人民共和國於科索沃戰爭期間支持南斯拉夫聯盟共和國，反對北約轟炸南斯拉夫，對美军轰炸中国驻南联盟大使馆非常不滿。中國反對北約干預科索沃事務，擔心鼓勵在西藏或新疆的分離主義。
target_text: Although the two countries officially established their relationship on 2 January 1955, the relationship between the two countries remained very cold, and in 1958, when the Yugoslav boycott of the Soviet Union as the leader of the international communist movement continued until 1977 when Yugoslav President Dito visited China. The Chinese People’s Republic chose to stand by the Soviet Union, with its embassy in Belgrade and an office in Pristina.

source_text: 2008年2月17日，科索沃單方面宣佈從塞爾維亞獨立，建立科索沃共和國，并获得美国、英国、加拿大、日本、法国、德国等多数联合国会员国的承认。但包括塞爾維亞共和國、俄羅斯、中華人民共和國、阿爾及利亞、摩洛哥、希臘、斯洛伐克、墨西哥、越南、羅馬尼亞、烏克蘭、西班牙、印度、巴西、尼日利亞、南非、阿根廷、白俄羅斯、巴勒斯坦、玻利維亞等國家拒絕承認科索沃的獨立地位。塞爾維亞亦正在阻止科索沃加入其它國際組織。科索沃共和國現时尚未是聯合國成員國。目前共有98個聯合國成員國、中華民國、馬耳他騎士團 、紐埃以及庫克群島承認科索沃的獨立地位。儘管如此，由於受到來自联合国安全理事会常任理事国中的俄羅斯以及中華人民共和國方面的強大壓力，科索沃成為聯合國成員國的可能性依然渺茫。而莱索托、苏里南、布隆迪、所罗门群岛、巴布亚新几内亚、科摩罗、多米尼克、格林纳达、帕劳、马达加斯加、中非共和国、多哥、塞拉利昂、加纳、瑙鲁这些国家则是先前承认科索沃独立，后来撤销承认独立的国家。塞爾維亞方面對承認科索沃獨立的國家，則採取撤回大使的方式以示抗議。這些國家包括美國、阿爾巴尼亞、保加利亞、北馬其頓、哥倫比亞、克羅地亞、法國、德國、匈牙利、土耳其、斯洛文尼亞以及英國。

source_text: 不结盟运动是一个擁有120个成员国和17个观察员国的松散国际组织。它成立于冷战时期，其成员国奉行独立自主的外交政策，不与美苏两个超级大国中的任何一个结盟。联合国中有三分之二的会员是该组织的成员国，全球约55%的人口也生活在不结盟运动国家。不结盟运动定期举行首脑会议，到目前为止已经在前南斯拉夫、埃及、赞比亚、阿尔及利亚、斯里兰卡、古巴、印度、津巴布韦、印尼、哥伦比亚、南非、马来西亚、塞尔维亚、委内瑞拉和阿塞拜疆举行会议。
target_text: The Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) is a loose international organization with 120 member States and 17 observer States. It was established during the cold war period, and its members pursued an autonomous foreign policy and did not associate themselves with any of the two super-Powers of the United States and the Soviet Union. Two thirds of the United Nations members are members of the organization and about 55 per cent of the global population lives in NAM countries. The Movement holds regular summits, which have so far met in the former Yugoslavia, Egypt, Zambia, Algeria, Sri Lanka, Cuba, India, Zimbabwe, Indonesia, Colombia, South Africa, Malaysia, Serbia, Venezuela and Azerbaijan.
title: 不结盟运动

source_text: 1961年9月，在前南斯拉夫总统铁托的努力之下，由埃及、南斯拉夫、印度、印度尼西亚、阿富汗五国发起的第一次不结盟运动首脑会议终于在南斯拉夫首都贝尔格莱德召开，共有25个国家的首脑参与了会议并通过了《不结盟国家的国家和政府首脑宣言》，反对任何形式的“殖民主义、帝国主义和新殖民主义”，要求簽订国际性的裁军条约，消除经济不平衡，废除国际贸易中心的不等价交换。同时宣言还明确表态支持阿尔及利亚、安哥拉、突尼斯、古巴等国的民族解放運動，以及爭取中华人民共和国在联合国的席位。
target_text: In September 1961, thanks to the efforts of President Tito of the former Yugoslavia, the first summit of the Non-Aligned Movement, sponsored by Egypt, Yugoslavia, India, Indonesia and Afghanistan, was held in Belgrade, the capital of Yugoslavia, with the participation of a total of 25 heads of State and Government of the Non-Aligned Countries, who adopted a Declaration against any form of “colonialism, imperialism and neocolonialism”, which called for the signing of international disarmament treaties, the elimination of economic imbalances and the abolition of the price differentials at the International Trade Centre. The Declaration also unequivocally expressed support for the national liberation movements of Algeria, Angola, Tunisia and Cuba, as well as the struggle for a seat at the United Nations for the People's Republic of China.
title: 不结盟运动

source_text:
成员国
不结盟运动是一个十分松散的国际组织：它不设总部及常设机构，起初甚至没有定期的会议机制，后来才规定每3年举行一次首脑会议，并由会议举办国担任主席国，任期亦为3年。截至2012年5月，不结盟运动共有120个成员国、17个观察员国，还有非洲联盟、阿拉伯国家联盟、伊斯兰合作组织和联合国等10个观察员组织。
target_text: The Non-Aligned Movement is a very loose international organization: it does not have a headquarters and a permanent body, initially without even a regular meeting mechanism, and only subsequently it was mandated to hold a summit every three years, with the host country chairing it for a period of three years. As of May 2012, the Movement had 120 member States, 17 observer States and 10 observer organizations, including the African Union, the League of Arab States, the Organization of Islamic Cooperation and the United Nations.
title: 不结盟运动

target_text: On 24 April 2022, in response to a question from a journalist, the State spokesman for Taiwan, Ma Xiaoqwang, stated that the so-called “San Francisco Peace Pact” was an illegal and invalid document issued by the United States of America after World War II, which, in the absence of the People's Republic of China, the Soviet Union, excluded the People's Republic of China and the Soviet Union, had singled out the day for peace. From the outset, the Chinese Government solemnly stated that “San Francisco and the Treaty” were illegal and could not be recognized by the Chinese Government.

source_text: 《反分裂国家法》共有10条，法律首先表明“世界上只有一个中国，中華人民共和國為中國唯一合法代表，台湾属於中国，中国的主权和领土完整不容分割。维护国家主权和领土完整是包括台湾同胞在内的全体中国人民的共同义务。”该法第三条将台湾问题定义为是“中国内战的遗留问题”，因此是中国内部事务，不受外国势力干涉。
target_text: The anti-secession law contains 10 articles, the first of which states: “There is only one China in the world, the People's Republic of China is the only legitimate representative of China, Taiwan belongs to China, and China's sovereignty and territorial integrity cannot be separated. The preservation of national sovereignty and territorial integrity is a common obligation of all Chinese people, including Taiwan's compatriots.” Article 3 of the law defines the question of Taiwan as “a legacy of the Chinese civil war” and is therefore an internal matter of China, free from foreign interference.
title: 反分裂國家法

source_text: 俄羅斯外交部声明，俄罗斯外交部发言人雅科文科专门就中国全国人大常委会会议将审议「反分裂國家法」发表谈话。他说，根据2001年7月16日签署的《俄中睦邻友好合作条约》的规定，俄方支持中方在涉及国家统一和领土完整问题上采取的政策。关于台湾问题，俄罗斯认为，世界上只有一个中国，中华人民共和国政府是代表全中国的唯一合法政府，台湾是中国不可分割的一部分。俄罗斯反对任何形式的台湾独立，也不能接受“两个中国”或“一中一台”。俄罗斯一贯支持中国为和平解决台湾问题所做的努力。俄罗斯总统普京当晚在法国总统府与法国、德国、西班牙领导人共同举行的记者招待会上回答记者提问时表示，俄罗斯支持中国制定《反分裂国家法》以维护领土主权和完整的做法。他说，原苏联以及俄罗斯一贯支持中国维护领土完整，理解中国领导层为此所作的努力，这一立场没有改变。
target_text: On the question of Taiwan, Russia believes that there is only one China in the world, that the Government of the People's Republic of China is the only legitimate government representing all China, and that Taiwan is an integral part of China. Russia opposes any form of Taiwan's independence and does not accept “two Chinas” or “one China” as such. Russia has consistently supported China's efforts to resolve the Taiwan issue peacefully. President Vladimir Putin, in response to a question from journalists at a press conference in the French Presidency with the leaders of France, Germany and Spain, said that Russia supported China's approach to developing an anti-secession law to preserve territorial sovereignty and integrity.
title: 反分裂國家法

source_text: 澳大利亚外交部长亚历山大·唐纳表示，如果台湾海峡发生战争，根据澳-{zh-cn:新;zh-tw:紐}-美安全条约，澳大利亚将被要求与美国协商，但视情况而定，它不一定会让澳大利亚参战。他说，“我们认为中国不应以军事方式解决台湾地位问题，必须通过与台湾的谈判来解决”。唐纳进一步评论说，假使中国不通过反分裂国家法，澳大利亚会更愿意那样去做。

source_text: 1965年4月20日，庫克群島完成公投，民意支持制憲與成立一個半自治的政體，同年7月26日紐西蘭通過《s:庫克群島憲法修正法案》（Cook Islands Constitution Amendment Act），賦予庫克群島居民紐西蘭公民身分，可以自由進出紐西蘭，而庫克群島與紐西蘭之間則以自由聯合（Free Association）的型態合作，並且透過選舉決定自己的政府。政府擁有完整的自治權利，而在外交事務上，就由紐西蘭來監督其外交與國防方面的事務。目前，庫克群島國家元首是查爾斯三世。
target_text: On 20 April 1965, the Cook Islands completed a referendum to support a constitution and establish a semi-autonomous government, and on 26 July of the same year New Zealand passed the Cook Islands Constitution Amendment Act, which gave Cook Islands residents of Cook Islands New Zealand the status of citizens of New Zealand who could freely enter and leave New Zealand, while the Cook Islands and New Zealand co-operate in the form of Free Association and decide on their own government through elections. The Government has full autonomy, and in foreign affairs New Zealand is responsible for overseeing its foreign affairs and defense.

source_text: 1935年，第一任土耳其總統及土耳其國父穆斯塔法·凱末爾·阿塔图爾克將聖索菲亞大教堂變為博物館。地毯被移走，覆蓋在鑲嵌畫上的石膏由專家煞費苦心地擦去，地面飾品得以展示。成为博物馆之后的圣索菲亚教堂被改名为阿亚索菲亚博物馆，实际上该博物馆的展品主要就是建筑物自身以及其中的镶嵌画艺术品。20世纪40年代中，由美国拜占庭研究会以及敦巴顿橡树园现场委员会（Dumbarton Oaks Field Committee）牵头的考古学家们开始了对圣索菲亚大教堂的修复工作。1985年，圣索菲亚大教堂所在的伊斯坦布尔文化区被联合国教科文组织选为世界文化遗产。但是博物馆的修復工作并不理想，1993年，一个联合国教科文组织的考察团在其报告中指出，博物馆日久失修，墙上的石膏正在脱落，有些破损的窗户没有及时被修复，大理石的清理進度也不理想，一些颜料已经被潮湿的空气侵蚀了。同年，博物馆在其穹顶之下搭建起了整修用的鷹架，这一“临时”建筑一直在博物馆内存在着，直到2010年拆除。1996年至1998年，阿雅索菲亚博物还被世界文化遗产基金会选为其百大濒危遗产。如今的阿雅索菲亚博物馆大约每年接待二百五十万外国游客，随着伊斯坦布尔当选为2010年的欧洲文化之都，对圣索菲亚大教堂的修复工作被重新提上议程。重达160吨的鷹架在同年被拆除。
target_text: In 1935, the first Turkish President and father of Turkey, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, turned the Church of St. Sofia into a museum. source_text: 起初，艾森豪威尔曾担心卫星飞行经过一个国家超过高时，可能会被认为是侵犯国家领空。他担忧苏联会指控美国非法飞越领空，因此自己花钱为苏联制造政治性胜利。艾森豪威尔和他的顾问认为一个国家的领空主权不应扩展到外太空，并且在1957年至1958年国际地球物理年的开展中，使这一原则在国际法中得以确立。艾森豪威尔还担心他可能会引起国际事件，如果把军事导弹作为发射器的话，可能被人称为“战争贩子”。因此，他选定美国海军研究实验室的，该火箭尚未试验，只是在实验研究中的做助推器。这就意味着冯·布劳恩的团队不被允许应用火箭使卫星进入轨道，原因在于该卫星充当未来军事工具的作用。1956年9月20日，冯·布劳恩和他的团队的确发射了可使卫星进入轨道的的火箭，但该发射仅限用于前椎体再入技术的亚轨道。
target_text: At first, Eisenhower feared that a satellite flight could be considered a violation of national airspace if it passed over a country’s height. He feared that the Soviet Union would accuse the United States of flying illegally over its airspace, thereby spending its own money to create a political victory for the Soviet Union. Eisenhower and his advisers argued that the sovereignty of a country’s airspace should not be extended to outer space, and that it had been established in international law during the International Geophysical Year 1957–1958. Eisenhower also feared that he might cause an international incident in which military missiles could be called “war traffickers” if used as launchers.

source_text: 1949年1月5日，針對蔣介石準備向臺灣撤退之事，美國駐華大使司徒雷登的私人顧問傅涇波拜訪了中華民國副總統李宗仁。李在其回憶錄中對此記載：「司徒大使遣其私人顧問傅涇波來見我說，美駐華軍事代表團團長巴大維將軍聞悉蔣氏有計畫地放棄大陸，經營台灣，甚為詫異。……巴大維將軍並認為台灣係美軍從日本手中解放出來的。雖開羅會議時有歸還中國的協定，但在對日和約尚未簽訂之前，其主權誰屬，究未有法律的根據。今蔣總統即欲據為已有，作為撤退海、空軍的基地，似有潛越之嫌。巴大維將軍擬請司徒大使向蔣總統提出口頭的抗議，但是司徒大使尚未決定採取任何行動，故特遣傅君先來問問我的意見。」同一天，陳誠正式就任臺灣省主席，並在就職記者會上強調要使臺灣成為一個復興中華民族的堡壘。不過陳誠的這番話並未獲得蔣介石的認同，蔣介石在1月12日致電告誡他：「須知此時何時，台灣何地，尚能任吾人如往日放肆無忌，大言不慚乎。台灣法律地位與主權在對日和會未成以前，不過為我國一託管地之性質，何能明言作剿共最後之堡壘與民族復興之根據地，豈不令中外稍有常識者之輕笑其太狂囈乎。」

source_text: 1958年11月19日，英國下議院議員、左翼亲苏联人士科尼·齊利亞克斯向英國外交部詢問英國政府目前對於開羅宣言及波茨坦宣言的政策，英國外交大臣塞爾文·勞埃答覆：「經過波茨坦宣言確認的開羅宣言只不過是一個共同目的聲明，兩者都是在只有一個實體自稱代表中國的時候制訂的。從那時以來，中國發生了內戰，各國對於『誰現在代表中國政府』仍然意見分歧。臺灣問題已經變成了國際問題，與若干國家都有了牽涉，不能僅靠參考開羅及波茨坦宣言來解決。」
target_text: On November 19, 1958, British Congressman Kony Zilyaks, a left-wing Sovietist, asked the British Foreign Office about the British government’s current policy with regard to the Cairo Declaration and the Potsdam Declaration, and British Foreign Secretary Selvin Laoe replied: “The Cairo Declaration, confirmed through the Potsdam Declaration, was merely a statement of common purpose, both of which were made when only one entity claimed to represent China. Since then, there has been a civil war in China, and there has been disagreement among countries over who is now representing the Chinese government.
title: 台灣地位未定論

聯合國立場
联合国不承認“台灣地位未定論”，認為台灣是中國的一個省。
2012年12月14日，台湾中时电子报报道，台湾青年气候联盟理事长张良伊以“Taiwan，Province of China”（中国台湾省）名义当选联合国组织官方青年代表，引发朝野立委质疑。
2016年2月9日，联合国秘书长发言人杜加里克在纽约总部举行的记者会上表示，潘基文秘书长对中国台湾省6日发生的地震表示关切。
2017年6月媒体报道，联合国不认中华民国护照，要求欲进入联合国人权理事会旁听的台湾人出示台胞证。

On 9 February 2016, at a press conference at United Nations Headquarters in New York, the Spokesman for the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Dugarik, expressed the concern of Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon at the 6-day earthquake in Taiwan Province of China.
