target_text: In accordance with the Beijing Treaty between China and Russia, the Russian government sent the Minister in Beijing directly to serve as an official diplomat, and the competence of the Beijing Mission of Mission was again transferred to the Supreme Council of the Russian Orthodox Church as a result of the presence of the Minister in China. In 1864, the Conference decided to appoint Baladi Kafarov, the Grand Priest of the Beijing 13th Mission of Mission, as the Grand Priest of the 15th Mission of Mission.
title: 东正教北京传道团

source_text: 相对于传道，外交和政治事务是北京传道团更主要的任务，从第一届传道团开始，这个宗教团体就被俄国政府赋予了直接搜集中国和间接搜集欧洲情报的任务，1727年中俄《恰克图条约》签订后，传道团更是直接肩负外交的使命。在将近200年的历史中，传道团搜集的关于中国社会经济政治和中国东北、蒙古等地区的情报是俄国政府制定远东政策的重要依据。传道团在这方面的作用在1860年之后达到顶峰，他们不仅以提供情报的方式间接参与了欧洲国家与中国的战事，第十四届传道团的大司祭固里甚至作为沙皇的谈判代表直接参与了《北京条约》的制定。从这一角度讲，东正教北京传道团可以看作俄国政府以传道名义安插在中国首都的一个重要情报机构。
target_text: From the beginning of the first mission, the religious community was entrusted by the Russian Government with the task of collecting intelligence directly from China and indirectly from Europe, and after the signing of the 1727 Treaty of Chactu between China and Russia, the mission was given a direct diplomatic mandate. In almost 200 years of history, intelligence gathered by the mission on China’s socio-economic politics and the north-east, Mongolia, etc., was an important basis for the Russian government’s policy on the Far East. The mission’s role in this regard reached its peak in 1860, and it was not only indirectly involved in the war between European countries and China by providing information, but was even directly involved in the formulation of the Beijing Treaty by the chief ministers of the fourteenth mission’s chief ministers, who were even directly involved as representatives of the tsars.
title: 东正教北京传道团

source_text: 贺南洪（；），又譯何南豐，柬埔寨政治人物，柬埔寨人民黨黨員，有柬埔寨华人血统。他於2004年起至2023年擔任柬埔寨副總理，1990年至1993年及1998年至2016年先後兩次擔任外交部長。2011年維基泄密（Wikileaks）所揭露的一份外交機密文件中，美國駐柬大使館前行動辦事處副主任指稱贺南洪曾是紅色高棉的領導人之一。贺南洪否認，並要求美方澄清。
target_text: He also translated Ho Namhong, a Cambodian politician and a member of the Cambodian People’s Party, with Chinese origin. He was Vice-Minister of Cambodia from 2004 to 2023, and was Minister of Foreign Affairs two times from 1990 to 1993 and from 1998 to 2016. In a confidential diplomatic document revealed by Wikileaks in 2011, the Deputy Director of the former operations of the United States Embassy in Cambodia claimed that Namhong was one of the leaders of the Khmer Rouge. Hor Nanhong denied and asked for clarification from the United States.
title: 贺南洪

source_text: 在战争开始后，霍斯勞一世迅速侵入叙利亚，并把古城安条克的居民强制迁徙。他在泰西封附近为这些移民建立了一座新城市“霍斯勞-安条克”。接着他又發起21年的（541-562年），並在科尔客斯、黑海和美索不达米亚都打了胜仗。查士丁尼一世派遣他最优秀的将领贝利撒留来亚洲与霍斯勞一世作战（541年～544年；贝利撒留在530年曾打败波斯人），但战况仍无所进展。到545年，除科尔客斯外其他地区的战斗事实上都已停止。560年霍斯勞一世由于不得不关注东方新崛起的突厥人的力量，决定与拜占庭停战。到562年，一份50年和平条约得以签订（實際只維持了十年和平，572年兩國又爆發20年的戰爭）。根据此条约，拜占庭保住了科尔客斯地区，但必须每年向波斯交年貢；同时，霍斯勞一世保证善待萨珊帝国境内的基督教徒。
target_text: After the war began, Hoslow I quickly invaded Syria and forced the inhabitants of Anchok in the ancient city. He built a new city, “Hosrauk” for these immigrants near the title of Tessi. He then fought 21 years (541-562), and won the battle in Corsus, the Black Sea, and Mesopotamia. Justin I sent his best general to Asia to fight against the city (541-544 years; Belisa stayed against the Persians in 530), but the war was still in progress. By 545 the fighting in other parts of the country, except Corus, had in fact stopped. In 560 the Hosslau I, having had to focus on the newly emerging Turks in the east, decided to cease the war with Byzantium. From 562 to 550, a peace treaty was signed with the city of Hosla.
title: 霍斯劳一世

source_text: 1941年他与黄炎培等人将统一建国同志会改组为中国民主政团同盟，他任常务委员。1944年（民国33年）9月，民主政团同盟改组中国民主同盟（民盟），他继续任常務委員。1945年4月，他代表中国出席联合国国际组织会议，任联合国宪章大会组委员，于1946年4月至6月，代表中国签署联合国宪章。
target_text: In 1941, he was re-established as a permanent member of the Chinese League of Democratic Leagues in 1941, together with Huang Yung Pei and others. In September 1944 (33), the League of Democratic Leagues (UDC) restructured the China Democratic Alliance (CDU) and he continued to serve on the Standing Committee. In April 1945, he represented China at the United Nations Conference on International Organizations, as a member of the United Nations Charter Conference, and from April to June 1946, he signed the Charter of the United Nations on behalf of China.
title: 张君劢

source_text: 1958年，岸信介主导的自民党政府开始与美国交涉改定日美之间的安全保障条约（即后来的《美日安保条约》，又称“新安保条约”）。决定与美国在防务上加强合作的决定激起了日本国内的反对声浪。1959年3月，反对改订安保条约的各方结成了“安保改定阻止国民会议”，日本社会党是参与方之一。安保斗争期间，日本社会党委员长是浅沼稻次郎。浅沼1959年3月访华时曾对毛泽东表示：“美帝国主义是中日两国人民的共同敌人。”1960年10月12日，在东京举行的一次各政党党首参加的辩论会上，正发表演说的浅沼稻次郎被一名冲上讲台的右翼青年山口二矢刺杀。浅沼遇刺的场面经电视转播到日本全国，引起冲击。虽然最后新安保条约在自民党坚持下强行通过，但此事也导致岸信介内阁的总辞职。日本社会党内部关于《美日安保条约》的意见分歧导致西尾末广一派于稍早的1960年1月脱党，另组民主社会党。
target_text: The decision to strengthen cooperation with the United States in defence matters provoked opposition in Japan. In March 1959, the protagonists in the security treaty formed a “Security Change Stop National Conference” in which the Socialist Party of Japan was one of the participants. During the security struggle, the member of the Socialist Party of Japan was the head of the Assemblage, who, when he visited China in March 1959, stated to Mao that “United States imperialism is a common enemy of the Chinese and Japanese people.” At a debate in Tokyo on 12 October 1960, the head of the political party, the Assemblage was killed by a young man on the right side of the podium. The shooting of the Assassin field was televised to the whole of Japan, causing a shock. Although the last New Security Treaty was forcibly adopted by the People’s Party, it also led to the resignation of the Cabinet as a whole.
title: 日本社会党

source_text: 20世纪50年代至60年代，正值美苏冷战高潮。美国担心如果社会党等左翼政党成为日本的执政党，将会强化日本的中立地位，甚至倒向苏联一方。此外，美国方面也怀疑日本社会党收受苏联的秘密援助。为了配合自身的战略目标，这一时期美国一方面向自民党政治家提供了秘密援助，一方面对日本社会黨进行监控并设法弱化日本社会党的力量。例如，美国艾森豪威尔政府于1958年众议院选举前给予自民党等保守亲美政党秘密经济援助，同时向他们提供了一些选举上的建议；CIA长期将内线混入日本社会党以及与社会党关系密切的青年团体、学生团体、工会等组织，以便进行监控。2006年美国国务院主编的外交史料集记载，为达成压制日本的左翼势力、缓解执政的自民党政府压力的目标，艾森豪威尔政府于1959年决定扶植一支“更加温和”、较为亲美的左翼势力。为达成这一目的，美国中央情报局（CIA）暗中给予西尾末广等部分日本社会党内的右派人物秘密金援，鼓动他们从日本社会党独立。作为结果，1960年，西尾末广等部分社会党右派宣布脱离日本社会党，另行组建立场较日本社会党偏右、支持安保条约的“民主社会党”（民社党）。根据统计，截至民社党结党，CIA一共给予相关人物共计7万5千美元的金援。直到1964年为止，CIA每年都给予民社党同样数额的经济援助。
target_text: For example, the US government of Eisenhower gave secret economic assistance to conservative pro-US political parties, such as the Socialist Party, before the 1958 elections to the House of Representatives, while providing them with election advice; the CIA permanently mixed its inner lines with youth groups, student groups, trade unions, and others close to the Socialist Party, in order to monitor its strategic objectives. The US government’s diplomatic history of the US State Department, on the one hand, monitored the Socialist Party of Japan and managed to weaken the Socialist Party of Japan. For example, the US government of Eisenhower gave secret economic assistance to conservative pro-US parties, such as the Socialist Party of Japan, before the elections to the House of Representatives in 1958, while providing them with election advice; and the CIA permanently mixed its inner lines with youth groups, student groups, trade unions, and other organizations close to the Socialist Party of Japan, in order to monitor it.
title: 日本社会党

source_text: 日本社会党长期反对修改日本的和平宪法、支持路线，反对自卫队、日美安保条约。20世纪70年代后，日本社会党对自卫队等议题采用了更加温和的表述，提出“违宪合法论”等观点。1986年1月，日本社会党通过《1986年宣言》，宣布放弃先前坚持的“科学社会主义”，改走更加温和的路线。1994年9月村山富市时代，在与自民党组成联合政府的大背景下，日本社会党对党的方针做出了较大调整，放弃了过去坚持的，在当年9月党大会上宣布接纳国旗上的日之丸图案、国歌君之代、以及自卫队与日美安保条约的存在，并认定自卫队符合和平宪法。
target_text: In January 1986, the Socialist Party of Japan adopted the 1986 Declaration, by which it renounced its earlier insistence on “scientific socialism” and changed its path to a more moderate one. In September 1994, in the context of a coalition government with the Democratic Party, the Socialist Party of Japan made a major adjustment to the Party's approach, abandoning its previous insistence on the inclusion of the Japanese pill on the flag, the son of the National Song and the existence of the Self-Defence Forces and the Japan-United States Security Treaty, and determined that the Self-Defence Forces were in conformity with the Peace Constitution.
title: 日本社会党

source_text: 2004年5月9日，成立藝能事務所「有限公司 悟空」。2022年現在是悟空所屬，也兼任社長。2017年10月27日，被任命為滋賀縣長濱市的長濱市公關大使（聲音觀光大使），並於同一天舉行的「角色聲音任命儀式」中，負責長濱觀光協會的公關角色「秀吉君」的聲音。2019年，獲頒第13屆聲優Awards富山敬獎。
target_text: On 27 October 2017, he was appointed as the Governor of Goku City's Public Relations Ambassador (Voice and Viewing Ambassador) and, on the same day, in the "Role of Roles" ceremony, he was given the voice of the public relations role of the Association for the Advancement of Tourism. In 2019, he was awarded the 13th award of the Awards Fukuyama Prize.
title: 山口勝平

source_text: 《联合国安理会687号决议》是1991年4月3日在联合国安理会的第2981次会议上通过的。导致第687号决议的事件是此前伊拉克对科威特的侵略，此后的海湾战争和科威特的解放。安理会的15个国家中12个国家投赞同票，一个国家反对（古巴），两个国家弃权（厄瓜多尔和也门）。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 687, adopted on 3 April 1991 at the 2981st meeting of the United Nations Security Council, led to the earlier Iraqi aggression against Kuwait and the subsequent Gulf War and the liberation of Kuwait. Twelve of the 15 States in the Council voted in favour, one against (Cuba) and two abstained (Ecuador and Yemen).
title: 聯合國安全理事會第687號決議

source_text: 联合国安理会687号决议最重要的内容是要求伊拉克无条件摧毁它的大规模杀伤性武器和对这些武器的研究，以及决定由国际原子能机构帮助对伊拉克进行裁军检查。由于伊拉克不愿或被指责不愿与联合国的裁军检查合作或被指责继续发展和研究大规模杀伤性武器而导致了1991年后伊拉克与美国、英国等驻军的冲突，包括对伊拉克施行的贸易封锁、1998年的沙漠之狐行动和2003年的美伊战争。
target_text: The most important elements of United Nations Security Council resolution 687 are the demand that Iraq unconditionally destroy its weapons of mass destruction and the study of those weapons, and the decision that the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) should help to carry out disarmament inspections in Iraq. Iraq’s unwillingness or accused of unwillingness to cooperate with United Nations disarmament inspections or of continuing to develop and study weapons of mass destruction have led to post-1991 conflicts between its troops and those of the United States and Britain, including the trade blockade imposed on Iraq, Operation Desert Fox of 1998 and the US-Iraq war of 2003.
title: 聯合國安全理事會第687號決議

source_text:
邱吉爾復任首相（1951年－1955年）
在1951年，保守黨於擊敗了執政工黨，丘吉尔再度出任首相，并凭借其文学功底在1953年获得诺贝尔文学奖。任內他與美國維持著「特殊關係」，並著手重整戰後的秩序，積極推動韓戰停戰，使英國得以退出朝鮮半島的戰事。基於香港問題，邱吉爾明白必須和新中國建立外交關系，在1954年派遣副首相兼外交大臣安东尼·艾登与中国总理兼外长周恩来一起出席联合国安理会成员国外长1954年日内瓦会议，达成两国之间互派代办的协议，从而使英国成为了第一个和中国建立正式外交关系的欧洲国家。也是在这一年（1954年），在他担任首相期间，在瑞士举行的世界杯赛上，英格兰队历史上首次打进世界杯八强。然而他的本土事務卻受著一連串的海外危機的陰影所籠罩，而海外危機之發生卻是因為英國戰後國力之衰退所促成的。儘然英國在戰後國力開始衰弱，但邱吉爾仍然視英國為一股重要的國際力量，並經常介入海外危機。在此後歷任的保守黨政府，儘管邱吉爾、安東尼·艾登爵士、哈羅德·麥美倫和道格拉斯-休姆爵士大抵上繼續推行了一些相對自由之貿易限制，以及減少國家干預經濟，但事實上，保守黨接受了英國的戰後共識（Post-war Consensus），繼續執行工黨執政時所留下的「福利國家」的政策，以及一系列的工業國有化政策。
target_text: In 1951, the Conservative Party defeated the ruling Labour Party, and Churchill again won the Nobel Prize in 1953, thanks to his literary work. He maintained a “special relationship” with the United States, and re-established the post-war order in Korea, which enabled Britain to withdraw from the Korean peninsula. In 1951, the Conservative Party, aware of the need to establish diplomatic relations with the new China, sent Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Anthony Aydin with the Chinese Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Zhou, to attend the 1954 Geneva meeting of the Foreign Ministers of the United Nations Security Council, and to reach an agreement between the two countries, thus making the United Kingdom the first European country to establish formal diplomatic relations with China.
title: 保守黨 (英國)

source_text: 艾登（1955年－1957年）1955年4月，邱吉爾宣佈退休，艾登遂接替他出任英國首相。艾登憑藉著俊朗的外表、魅力和他在大戰的政績，使他在國內成為受歡迎的人物。因此當他一上任首相，便立即舉行了1955年大選，並為保守黨在下議院帶來更大的多數優勢。可是，艾登從未出任過有關本土事務的職位，故缺乏處理經濟事務的經驗。為此，艾登把這些事務一概交給他的副手們，如拉博·巴特勒等，至於自己則專注在外交事務，並和美國總統艾森豪結成緊密的同盟。而艾登的名言：「要永遠以和平為大前提。」（Peace comes first, always）更使他的受歡迎程度有增無減。但是，這個英美同盟在日後被證明是徒具虛名的。在1956年，艾登聯合法國，企圖阻止埃及總統納賽爾將蘇伊士運河國有化，因為蘇伊士運河自十九世紀以來，都是蘇伊士運河公司的資產，而該公司則由英國和法國的股東所擁有。面對著蘇伊士運河國有化，艾登根據他在1930年代的外交經驗，視納賽爾為墨索里尼的翻版，認為兩人皆如出一轍，都是急激的民族社會主義者，並會入侵其他國家。然而其他意見卻認為，納賽爾的舉動是愛國主義的表現，合情合理。結果在1956年10月，經過了幾個月的談判和嘗試斡旋後，最終勸阻納賽爾失敗。於是英國和法國，聯同以色列出兵埃及，並佔領了蘇伊士運河地區。不過在出兵以後，艾森豪立即表示了強烈的反對，譴責這是殖民主義的死灰復燃。
target_text: As soon as he was Prime Minister, Eden immediately held the 1955 elections and brought greater power to the Conservative Party in the House of Commons. But Eden, who had never taken up his post in relation to local affairs, had no experience in dealing with economic matters. Eden, for that reason, gave these things to his deputies, such as Rabbo Butler, to his colleagues in the Great War. As soon as he became Prime Minister, he immediately held the 1955 elections, and gave the Conservative Party much greater advantage in the House. But Eden, who had never taken up his post in relation to local affairs, had no experience in dealing with economic matters.
title: 保守黨 (英國)

source_text: 由于环境保护运动在世界范围内的兴起，1990年第二十届地球日活动的组织者希望将这一美国国内的运动向世界范围扩展，为此他们致函中国、美国、英国三国领导人和联合国秘书长，呼吁他们采取措施，举行会晤缔结关于环境保护议题的多边协议，协力扭转环境恶化的趋势；同时地球日的组织者还呼吁全世界愿意致力环境保护的政府在1990年4月22日各自动员国民开展环境保护运动。地球日活动组织者的倡议得到了亚洲、非洲、美洲、欧洲许多国家和众多国际性组织的响应，最终在1990年4月22日全世界有来自140多个国家的逾2亿人参与了地球日的活动。从此世界地球日成为全球性的环境保护运动。
target_text: As a result of the worldwide rise of the environmental protection movement, the organizers of the twentieth Earth Day in 1990 wished to extend the movement within the United States to the world. To that end, they had written to the leaders of China, the United States, the United Kingdom and the Secretary-General of the United Nations, calling on them to take steps to meet to conclude multilateral agreements on environmental protection issues and to work together to reverse the deterioration of the environment; and the organizers of Earth Day had called on Governments throughout the world that were willing to work towards environmental protection to mobilize their own nationals on 22 April 1990. The initiative of the organizers of Earth Day had been echoed by many countries in Asia, Africa, the Americas, Europe and many international organizations, culminating in the participation of more than 200 million people from more than 140 countries worldwide in Earth Day on 22 April 1990.
title: 世界地球日

source_text: 1971年9月29日，崇正總會總會金禧大慶時，張發奎在世界客屬懇親大會上致詞云「大半同胞陷於水深火熱之中，惟賴海外數千萬愛國僑胞，大義當前，知所抉擇」，張呼籲「支反共國策，發動國民外交，以為我政府外交之後循」。此文見於歷年崇正總會印行之紀念特刊。
target_text: On September 29, 1971, on the occasion of the golden jubilee of the General Conference of the General Council, Zhang Shik-kyu made a statement at the World Meeting of Friends, in which he said, "Most of his fellow citizens are trapped in deep water, but thousands of loved ones are living abroad, and were known to have chosen to do so," and called for "an anti-communist policy to launch national diplomacy, which he thought would be followed by our government's diplomacy." This article was published in the special edition of the anniversary of the General Conference.
title: 張發奎

source_text: 中华人民共和国建国后，1949年设置福贡县和碧江县；贡山设治区迁治茨开镇。1950年，泸水设治区属保山专区，兰坪、福贡、碧江3县及贡山设治区属丽江专区。1952年改泸水设治局为泸水县。1952年改贡山设治区及福贡、碧江两县为傈僳族自治区，属丽江专区。1954年4月6日批准设立怒江傈僳族自治区（同时撤销贡山、福贡、碧江3个傈僳族自治区，改为县，并与泸水县划归怒江傈僳族自治区），自治区政府驻碧江县知子罗（今福贡县匹河怒族乡知子罗）；同年8月23日正式成立，归丽江专区代管。1956年10月，贡山县改设贡山独龙族怒族自治县。1957年1月改自治区为怒江傈僳族自治州；同年将丽江专区的兰坪县划归怒江州。1961年6月，中国和缅甸根据《中缅友好和互不侵犯条约》和《中缅边界条约》，中国收回片马地区，设片古岗特区，由丽江专区直属。1966年9月片马地区划属泸水县，设立片马乡。1973年8月，怒江州不再由丽江地区代管，改归云南省领导。1975年州政府迁至泸水县六库镇。1986年9月，撤销碧江县，分别并入泸水、福贡二县。1987年11月，兰坪县改设兰坪白族普米族自治县。2004年1月，泸水县驻地由鲁掌镇迁至六库镇。2016年6月，撤销泸水县，设立县级泸水市。
target_text: Following the establishment of the State of the People ' s Republic of China, in 1949 the districts of Fukugun and Bingjiang were set up as autonomous regions of the Rigang region, and on 6 April 1954 the district of Ngang Shan was established as a special district of the Paoshan region, and the district of Rangang, Fogun, Beijiang 3 and Gunshan were transformed into a special district of the Yangtze district. In 1952, the Authority was established as a special district of the Yugang region and the district of Bingjiang and the district of Bingjiang was established as an autonomous district of the Yangtze district. On 6 April 1954, the district of Kanshan and the district of Kantang province were removed as an autonomous district of the Majiang district, and the district of Yutang province was transferred to the town of Yuiji district in January 1957.
title: 怒江傈僳族自治州

source_text:
十项原则的内容：
尊重基本人权、尊重《联合国宪章》的宗旨和原则。
尊重一切国家的主权和领土完整。
承认一切种族的平等、承认一切大小国家的平等。
不干预或干涉他国内政。
尊重每一个国家按照《联合国宪章》单独地或集体地进行自卫的权利。
不使用集体防御的安排来为任何一个大国的特殊利益服务；任何国家不对其他国家施加压力。
不以侵略行为或侵略威胁或使用武力来侵犯任何国家的领土完整或政治独立。
按照《联合国宪章》，通过如谈判、调停、仲裁或司法解决等和平方法以及有关方面自己选择的任何其他和平方法来解决一切国际争端。
促进相互的利益和合作。
尊重正义和国际义务。
target_text: Respect for fundamental human rights, respect for the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations, respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all States, recognition of the equality of all races, recognition of the equality of all States large and small, non-intervention or interference in the internal affairs of other States, respect for the right of every State to self-defence, individually or collectively, in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations, non-use of arrangements for collective defence in the service of the special interests of any of the major Powers, no pressure by any State against other States, non-aggression or threat of aggression or the use of force against the territorial integrity or political independence of any State, settlement of all international disputes through peaceful means such as negotiation, mediation, arbitration or judicial settlement, as well as any other peaceful means chosen by the parties themselves, in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations, promotion of mutual interests and cooperation, respect for justice and international obligations.
title: 萬隆會議

source_text: 香港的對外事務有別於外交事務，後者主要以主權國為單位（只能以香港經濟貿易辦事處形式活動），由中華人民共和國政府按照《基本法》第2章第13條及第7章條文負責。中華人民共和國外交部在香港設有特派員公署，負責與香港有關的外國政治與外交事宜。此外，多國亦於香港設有外交代表機構，而特區政府接待外交人員的工作，則由政府總部的禮賓處負責。
target_text: Hong Kong's foreign affairs are different from foreign affairs, and many countries have diplomatic representation (only in the form of the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office), which is the responsibility of the Chinese People's Republic in accordance with articles 13 and 7 of Chapter 2 of the Basic Law. The Chinese People's Republic of China has a special office in Hong Kong for foreign politics and diplomacy.
title: 香港對外事務

source_text: 殖民地時期，香港的外交事務由當時的宗主國英國負責。由於英聯邦各成員共尊英國君主為最高元首，因此在英聯邦內各成員之間派駐對方的外交代表機構稱為高級專員公署（High Commission），而非大使館或領事館。因此1997年7月1日之前，英聯邦國家於香港派駐的最高外交使節為專員（High Commissioner）。英國亦設有英國駐港商務專員公署，專責處理英國和香港之間的商務關係。而香港對外則由當地英國大使館或高級專員公署的一個特別辦公室負責。
target_text: In the colonial era, foreign affairs in Hong Kong were the responsibility of the British monarch at that time. Since the British monarch was the highest head of state, members of the British Federation sent diplomatic representatives to each other within the United Kingdom as High Commissioner’s Office, rather than an embassy or consulate.
title: 香港對外事務

target_text: As an example of the 1972 list of overseas Hong Kong representatives, Hong Kong ceased to be a member of the United Kingdom on 1 July 1997, and the High Commissioner for Foreign Affairs of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland changed its name to Head Office, while British embassies in various countries cancelled their foreign representative organizations.
title: 香港對外事務

source_text: 謝絕了大量電影邀約之後，張曼玉積極參與公益活動；2008年5月四川汶川地震发生后，她为灾区捐款200万人民币。2010年，她被任命为联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）中国大使，并分别于2010年、2011年與2012年探访了云南、四川、江蘇等地的儿童。此外，通過其在時尚界的影響力，2010年她與美國設計姊妹花Rotarte姐妹合作，共同為聯合國兒童基金會推出特別設計系列，該系列的五套服裝之靈感來自張曼玉五部電影中的造型，拍賣所得歸兒基會。

source_text: 1974年，中华人民共和国政府自在1949年建国后，首次派遣赴美留学生。章啟月与其他四名中学生被选中，公派到美国学习英语；其中也包括毛泽东英文教师章含之的女儿洪晃。其被选中的原因之一是，其父章曙当时已在联合国工作一年。由于联合国给国际职员的子女报销教育费，为节省赴美路费开支，政府将其选中。
target_text: In 1974, the Government of the People’s Republic of China sent students to the United States for the first time since the founding of the country in 1949. The first four other secondary school students were selected to study English in the United States during the first month of the first month; this also included the daughter of Mao Zedong’s English teacher’s chapter, Hung. One of the reasons for his selection was that his father had worked at the United Nations for one year at the time. As the United Nations reimbursed the children of international staff members for their education, the Government chose them in order to save money on their journey to the United States.
title: 章启月

source_text:
在美国学习三年后，章啟月于1977年回国；并进入北京外国语大学学习。工作經歷
1982年毕业后，考入联合国译员训练班，后在美国纽约联合国总部、驻日内瓦办事处秘书处，担任同声传译工作。1987年回国后，章进入外交部国际司，历任国际司三秘、二秘、副处长、一秘。1995年，被派赴中国驻联合国代表团工作。
target_text: After three years of study in the United States, he returned to his country in 1977 and went to Beijing University of Foreign Languages. After completing his work in 1982, he was admitted to the United Nations Interpreter Training Course and later served as a simultaneous interpreter at United Nations Headquarters in New York and at the secretariat of the United Nations Office at Geneva. After returning in 1987, he entered the Department of International Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, where he served as Third Secretary, Second Secretary, Deputy Director and First Secretary of the Department of International Affairs. In 1995, he was sent to the Chinese Mission to the United Nations.
title: 章启月

source_text: 1998年底，章啟月回国出任外交部新闻司副司长，并于1999年1月26日，首次以外交部新闻发言人的身份主持例行记者招待会，成为中国第三位女外交部发言人。2005年2月，接替关呈远任驻比利时特命全权大使。2008年8月，接替兰立俊任驻印度尼西亞特命全权大使。2011年回國，任中华人民共和国外交部机关党委常务副书记。2014年7月，調任常驻联合国代表团公使銜參贊。2014年12月接替孙国祥出任駐紐約總領事，2018年5月卸任。
target_text: He returned to the country in August 2008 as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Belgium. He returned to the country in 2011 as Deputy Secretary of State of the Party Committee of the organs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In July 2014, he was transferred to the Permanent Mission of the People ' s Republic of China to the United Nations as Minister of State for Foreign Affairs.
title: 章启月

source_text: 《黄埔条约》（法语：Traité de Huangpu或traité de Whampoa）又稱《中法五口通商章程》，是法國七月王朝与清朝签订的一个不平等条约。1844年（道光二十四年），清政府代表两广总督耆英與法國特使兼全權公使拉萼尼在澳門进行谈判，最后于1844年10月24日，在停泊於廣州黄埔港的法國軍艦「阿基米德」號（）上，簽訂此条约。1845年8月25日在澳門交換批准。
target_text: The Huang Po Treaty (in French: Traité de Huangpu or Traité de Whampoa), also known as the Central Chinese Five Trade Charter, is an unequal treaty between the French dynasty and the Qing dynasty in July. In 1844 (in Dogwang 24), the two Governor-General Qing Qing and the French Special Envoy and Full Secretary-General, Lajuni, negotiated in Macau, and finally signed the treaty on 24 October 1844 on the French military vessel Archimedes ( " Akimid " ), which is based at Huang Dynasty Port, Guangzhou. On 25 August 1845, the treaty was exchanged for ratification in Macau.
title: 黄埔条约

source_text:
條約內容
条约一共36款，外加“海关税则”。其主要內容为：
法国人可以在五个通商口岸（广州、厦门、福州、宁波、上海）享有永久居住、贸易、领事、停泊军舰等权利。
清政府将来改变海关税则需要先与法国政府商议同意。
法国在中国享有领事裁判权。
法国得到片面最惠国待遇。
法国可以在通商港口建立天主教教堂和坟地。清政府有保护教堂的义务。
target_text: French citizens have the right to permanent residence, trade, consular, and port of call at the five ports of commerce (Changzhou, Xiamen, Fuzhou, Ningbo, Shanghai, etc.). A future change in customs duties requires prior agreement with the French government.
title: 黄埔条约

source_text: 中国在第一次鸦片战争中战败后，与英国签定了《南京條約》。南京条约雖然已經明訂條款，但僅能說是綱領，英國為求明確，于是在1843年由大清代表钦差大臣耆英和英国代表璞鼎查代表雙方，在香港簽訂了《中英五口通商章程》，作为《五口通商附粘善後條款》（虎门条约）的附件。
target_text: After the defeat of China in the first opium war, China signed the Nanjing Treaty with the United Kingdom. The Nanjing Treaty, although it has made clear the terms, can only be said to be the rule. In 1843, the United Kingdom signed the Charter of Trade among the Five Chinese and British People in Hong Kong, as an annex to the Five Trades with Good Will (the Tigers Treaty), on both sides.
title: 中英五口通商章程

source_text:
沿革
1969年，在第24次联合国大会上，当时的联合国秘书长吴丹提出了设立联合国大学的设想、并得到了以第三世界国家为中心的广泛支持，並邀請秘書長組成專家小組，與聯合國訓練研究機構（United Nations Institute for Training and Research，UNITAR）共同研究可行性。1972年9月，专家小组向联合国经济及社会理事会提交了有關開設聯合國大學研究报告，其後其創建決議在1973年12月11日第27次联合国大会上正式通過。並在隔年第28次联合国大会上通過《联合国大学章程》。日本政府在創設聯合國大學的過程中，拨款1亿美元设立捐赠基金，联合国大学在1975年9月正式开展学术工作。1974年，联合国秘书长和联合国教科文组织任命了首届联合国大学理事会成员，同时委任（James M. Hester）博士担任联合国大学首任校长，并于1975年1月20日在联合国大学东京总部临时大楼里为其举行了正式任职典礼。
target_text: In September 1972, at the 24th United Nations General Assembly, the then Secretary-General of the United Nations, U Thant, presented the idea of establishing UNU, which received broad support from the countries of the third world, and invited the Secretary-General to form an expert group to study feasibility jointly with the United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR). In September 1972, the Panel of Experts submitted to the United Nations Economic and Social Council a study on the establishment of the United Nations University, whose founding resolution was formally adopted by the 27th United Nations General Assembly on 11 December 1973, and the Charter of the United Nations University was adopted by the 28th United Nations General Assembly in the following year. In the course of the founding of the United Nations University, the Government of Japan allocated $100 million to the Endowment Fund, which was formally launched by UNU in September 1975. In 1974, the Secretary-General of the United Nations and UNESCO appointed Dr. James M. Hester as the first Rector of UNU and officially inaugurated the University on 20 January 1975 in the interim building at UNU headquarters in Tokyo.
title: 联合国大学

source_text: 聯合國大學原為研究各項國際問題的學術機構，設立之初並未有招收學生及頒予學位的規劃，2009年12月21日在第64次联合国大会上通過《联合国大学章程》修正案，授權聯合國大學得以頒發碩士及博士學位，2013年12月20日第68次联合国大会上通過章程修正案，將聯合國大學理事會（The UNU Council）人數由24人減半至12人。
target_text: At the 64th United Nations General Assembly, on 21 December 2009, the University adopted an amendment to the Charter of the United Nations authorizing the University to award a bachelor ' s and doctoral degree, and at the 68th United Nations General Assembly, on 20 December 2013, it adopted a constitutional amendment that reduced the membership of the United Nations University Council from 24 to 12 members.
title: 联合国大学

source_text: 自英國在1907年與奧斯曼帝國傳統敵人俄羅斯修好及結盟，奧斯曼帝國便開始質疑過去百年來聯英抗俄的外交政策能否持續。而德國自協助建成柏林-巴格達鐵路後，對奧斯曼帝國的影響力有增無減，更積極拉攏奧斯曼帝國，以在近東牽制俄羅斯。第一次世界大戰爆發後，由於英國在外交策略上的輕忽，德國將兩艘無法逃出地中海的新式戰艦格本號大巡洋艦和布雷斯勞號小巡洋艦「贈與」奧斯曼帝國，將他們半拖半就加入同盟國的行列，結果導致當時西歐援助俄羅斯最重要的黑海航道遭到封鎖。只有少數封凍港可用的俄羅斯海運吞吐量因此萎縮到僅剩百分之五的地步，這對俄羅斯繼續戰鬥的影响很大，並可能導致協約國輸掉戰爭。

source_text: 1981年，西哈努克创立奉辛比克党时曾邀请拉那烈回国。但拉那烈不同意奉党与红色高棉的联系而拒绝了这个邀请。1983年，在西哈努克的催促下，他辞去了法国的教职回国，并加入奉党。他成为西哈努克驻扎泰国曼谷的个人代表，活跃于外交场合。1985年3月，被任命为奉辛比克党的武装（Armee Nationale Sihanoukiste）的督察长，1986年1月担任总司令兼总参谋长。1989年8月成为奉党秘书长。1991年10月参加巴黎和平协定的签字，结束了柬越战争。1992年2月当选奉辛比克党主席，并被任命为联合国柬埔寨过渡时期权力机构的委员之一。
target_text: In 1981, when Sihanouk founded the Bong Sinbik Party, he invited Ranaleh to return to his country. Ranare did not agree with his association with the Khmer Rouge and refused to do so. In 1983, at the urging of Sihanouk, he resigned from his teaching post in France and joined the Bong Party. He became Sihanouk's personal representative in Bangkok, Thailand, and was active in diplomacy. In March 1985, he was appointed Inspector-General of the Bongbik armed party, Armee Nationale Sihanoukiste, and became Chief of Staff in January 1986. He became Secretary-General of the party in August 1989. The signature of the Paris Peace Accords in October 1991 ended the war in Cambodia. He was elected Chairman of the Bongbik Party in February 1992 and was appointed as a member of the United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia.
title: 諾羅敦·拉那烈

source_text: 1927年4月初，中国國民黨右派在上海開會，會上提出「共产党连结容纳于国民党之共产党员，同有谋叛证据」。汪精衛回國後，以中間派出面領導武漢政府。4月6日，張作霖在得到公使團同意，派遣中國軍警突袭北京的苏联大使馆、遠東銀行、中東鐵路辦公處，逮捕了躲藏在其中多時的58名中國人，包括中國共產黨主要創始人之一李大釗，還查獲並向外界公開共產國際發來大量指示、训令、颠覆材料（與馮玉祥合作颠覆文件、紅槍會及煽動農民的紀錄、中國共產黨文件等，「蘇聯陰謀文證彙編」），證實蘇聯全面指揮顛覆中國政府運動。。蘇聯與中國共產黨則強烈譴責中國國民黨粗暴侵犯蘇聯使館尊嚴，並稱此事件乃「帝國主義的挑撥，中國政府已淪為帝國主義者的工具」。4月12日，中国國民黨右派及蒋中正正式與中国共产党決裂，先後在上海、廣西、廣州等地搜捕中国共产党員與蘇聯要員，中国國民黨稱為「清黨」。4月18日，南京成立國民政府，汪兆銘則不同意清黨，南京與武漢一度分裂（寧漢分裂）。南京國民政府發令通輯中国共产党要員約二百人。4月19日，蘇聯召回北京駐華代辦及大使館職員。史達林在事後坦承以中國共產黨來分化國民黨為錯誤之舉。

source_text:
香灰莉木学院
香灰莉木学院（Tembusu College）是大学城首批开放的本科生居住学院之一。住在这里的学生大多是本科生。新生进入新加坡国立大学可以同时申请入住此学院。但是申请非常具有竞争性，申请要经过英文作文以及面试等环节。一年只能容纳200到230人入住。Tembusu College提供5个跨学科课程。现任的学院院长是原新加坡大使，前联合国大使以及前国大法学院院长Prof. Tommy Koh。
target_text: Tembusu College is one of the first open undergraduate residential colleges in the city. Most of the students living here are undergraduates. New students can apply for admission to the National University of Singapore at the same time.
title: 新加坡国立大学

source_text: 永禄10年（1567年），美濃三人眾的稻葉良通、氏家直元、安藤守就成為信長的內應尾張放逐齋藤龍興，織田信長得到美濃國，入主稻葉山城並將其改名為岐阜城，同時開始實施天下布武。一說為以武家政權的力量支配天下，另一說為以武力統治天下。有感於鄰近西方近江淺井家勢力強盛，織田信長為確保上洛進軍的道路，於是將妹妹阿市初嫁予無妻的長政，以姻親結盟保障日後途經淺井家的上洛之路。織田一方派遣外交使者市橋長利、不破光治與淺井家外交使者安養寺經世會談方締結曇花同盟。當時織田信長讓不破光治開出織田家願意支付與淺井家婚姻同盟的所有費用，但在與織田家結成同盟前，淺井家展開軍會議討論淺井家與織田家的同盟關係，首先親朝倉派家臣認為「朝倉當主朝倉義景遲早與織田信長會有一戰(織田朝倉祖先本是斯波氏世仇而因此對立)」，其後親織田派家臣則認為「織田當主織田信長勢力如日中天，若與織田家同盟有利於日後發展勢力。」，淺井家中產生了意見分歧。鑑此，當主淺井長政提出「不可以與朝倉家為敵」作為締結同盟的條件，信長當時表示沒有問題，長政成婚後尊信長為義兄。

伦佐·皮亚诺（，），意大利建筑师。1998年第二十届普利兹克奖得主。因对热那亚古城保护的贡献，他亦获选联合国教科文组织亲善大使。生平

target_text: Renzo Piano (, Italian architect), winner of the twentieth Prizk Prize in 1998. For his contribution to the protection of the ancient city of Genoa, he was also elected UNESCO Goodwill Ambassador. He was born in Genoa, where he is still settled and worked. He was taught and later taught the Polytechnic University of Milan (Politecnico di Milano). From 1965 to 1970, he worked for Louis Conn and Makowsky. source_text: 在返回途中，弗朗巴尔和一些盎格鲁-诺曼男爵劝说罗贝尔领导一场对英格兰的入侵，以从他的兄弟亨利手中夺回王位。1101年，罗贝尔和他的军队在朴次茅斯登陆，但由于他在英格兰缺乏普遍的支持加上入侵战术失误，使得亨利可以反抗这场入侵。罗贝尔被迫在奥尔顿条约中通过外交方式放弃了对英格兰王位的要求。在第一次十字军东征中，有人说罗贝尔是一个杰出的战场指挥官，但却是一个糟糕的战略家。
target_text: On his way back, Francobar and some Baron Anglo-Norman persuaded Robert to lead an invasion of England in order to take back the throne from his brother Henry. In 1101, Robert and his army landed in Park Chimouth, but his lack of universal support in England, coupled with the tactical error of the invasion, allowed Henry to resist the invasion. Robert was forced to give up his claim to the throne of England diplomatically in the Orton Treaty. In the first Crusade, Robert was said to be an outstanding field commander, but to be a bad strategist.
title: 諾曼第公爵羅貝爾二世

source_text: 1842年8月，清政府与英国签订了中英《南京条约》，规定中国开放广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海五处为通商口岸，即史上有名的五口通商，中国的锁国体制就此被打破。1858年日本与美国、英国、法国、荷兰、俄国签订《安政五国条约》，也被迫开放神奈川（横滨）、长崎、兵库（神户）、新潟、函馆五处港口。1876年2月26日，日本与朝鲜在江华岛签订《江华条约》，开放釜山、仁川、元山三个港口。
target_text: In August 1842, the Qing Government signed the Treaty of Nanjing between China and the United Kingdom, which provided that China would open five ports of commerce, namely, Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo, Shanghai, which is known for its history, and that China’s system of lock-in states would be broken. In 1858, Japan signed the Treaty of An Qing Five with the United States, the United Kingdom, France, the Netherlands, and Russia, and it was forced to open five ports, namely Kanagawa (Yokohama), Nagasaki, Hyogo, Shinjia, and Yuanshan. On 26 February 1876, Japan signed a Treaty of Jianghua between Japan and Korea in Jianghua Island, opening three ports, Busan, Ingawa and Yuanshan.

source_text: 2020年5月29日，美國總統特朗普因中國大陸方面推行《港區國安法》，認為中國大陸方面“將香港原來的一國兩制變成一國一制”，違反《中英聯合聲明》，下令將取消香港特殊貿易地位、制裁大陸及香港參與《港區國安法》制定的相關官員及人物。2020年6月25日，對支持中国大陸“限制香港自治“的人或公司進行制裁的《香港自治法案》（）獲得美國參議院全票通过。
target_text: On May 29, 2020, United States President Trump introduced the Hong Kong District National Security Act on the Chinese mainland, arguing that China's mainland side “is turning Hong Kong's original one-state system into a single-nation system” in violation of the United Chinese-British Declaration, ordering the removal of Hong Kong's special trading status and the sanctioning of mainland and relevant officials and figures for Hong Kong's participation in the Hong Kong District National Security Act. On June 25, 2020, the Hong Kong Autonomy Act (the Hong Kong Autonomy Act) against those who support China's mainland “restricted autonomy” was passed by the United States Senate.

source_text: 2023年7月13日，美國參議院外交委員會一致通過《香港經濟貿易辦事處認證法》(Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office (HKETO) Certification Act)議案，要求美國總統在議案頒布後的30天內，訂明三所分別位於華盛頓特區、紐約及三藩市的香港經濟貿易辦事處是否能夠延長在美國的特別外交待遇及豁免權，否則三所辦公室需於六個月內停止運作。
target_text: On 13 July 2023, the Foreign Affairs Committee of the United States Senate unanimously passed the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office Recognition Act (Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office (HKETO) Act, requesting the President of the United States, within 30 days of the resolution, to determine whether the three separate economic and trade facilitation offices in Washington, D.C., New York and San Francisco could extend special diplomatic treatment and immunity in the United States, or whether the three offices would be suspended for six months.

source_text: 中華民國外交是指中華民國的外交關係，其與邦交國的外交關係在過去是建立在承認中華民國政府是代表中國的唯一合法政府的基礎上，自1988年李登輝繼任總統之後則改採務實外交而不再強求中國代表權。目前中華民國與世界13個主權國家擁有正式外交關係，其餘國家則因一個中國政策而不承認中華民國，使得中華民國成為不受國際廣泛承認的國家；雖然如此，中華民國仍與多數無邦交國家維持往來，並視情形互設代表機構。
target_text: Chinese diplomacy refers to Chinese diplomacy, which was based on the recognition of the Chinese government as the sole legitimate government representing China, and the change of power to China’s representation since 1988 when Li Teng-hee took over as President. China now has formal diplomatic relations with the world’s 13 dominant countries, while the rest of the country’s refusal to recognize China because of a Chinese policy makes it a non-internationally recognized country.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 1917年，中华民国北洋政府與德国斷交，并對德、奧宣戰，从而加入第一次世界大战。战后中国作为戰勝國出席巴黎和會，但因五四运动，拒绝在《凡尔赛和約》上簽字。1928年6月中华民国国民政府外交部长王正廷发动了一场以修订不平等条约为中心的“革命外交”，包括恢复关税自主权、取消治外法权、收回租界、收回租借地，以及收回铁路利权、内河航行权、沿海贸易权等。1929年7月，张学良收回苏联控制的中东路时，引发了中东路事件，导致苏联政府与南京国民政府断交。苏军沿中东路一线向中国进攻。中国军队损失巨大，被迫请求停战，并签订了《中苏伯力会议议定书》，恢复了苏联在1929年7月10日以前在中东铁路的一切权益。1941年12月9日，中国政府对德、意、日宣战，加入同盟国参加第二次世界大战。1942年，中華民國與英國和美國的不平等條約廢除，英美放棄在華的租界、领事裁判权、驻兵权、内河航行权。二戰結束後，中華民國作為戰勝國，收复了被日本占领的东北，並開始統治台灣，也参与创建了联合国并成為聯合國安理会五个常任理事國之一。
target_text: In June 1928, the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China launched a “revolutionary diplomacy” centred on the revision of the inequality treaty, which included the restoration of customs autonomy, the withdrawal of extraterritorial jurisdiction, the withdrawal of leases, the withdrawal of concessions, and the restoration of all rights of the Soviet Union in the Middle East railways until 10 July 1929. In July 1929, Zhang Quang, during his defeat of the Soviet-controlled Middle East road, refused to sign the Middle East Road, which led to the dissolution of the Soviet Government and the Nanjing National Government. The Soviet army attacked China along the Middle East Road. The Chinese army was forced to demand a truce and signed the Protocol to the Conference on Central and South Africa, which restored the Soviet Union to all its interests in the Middle East Railways until 10 July 1929. The Chinese Government declared a war on Germany, Italy, and joined the United States in the Second World War. In 1942, the Chinese military forces were forced to call for a truce, and the United Kingdom and the United States of America took part in the creation of the United States.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 1949年，中華民國政府迁往臺灣。1950年代之后，以苏联为首的社会主义国家和新加入联合国的第三世界国家普遍支持中华人民共和国取代中华民国在联合国大会与安理会的中国席次。1952年，中華民國向聯合國控告蘇聯。1961年，中华民国默认蒙古加入联合国。1971年，中華民國宣布退出联合国，中华人民共和国依据聯合國大會第2758號決議取得原由中華民國在聯合國的「中國席位」。之後自1993年起，中華民國試圖重返聯合國皆未成功。目前絕大部分國家和中華民國没有正式外交關係，但部分国家有在台灣設立代表機構，與台灣保持經貿、文化乃至政治上的往來。由於此種交流模式在1972年與日本斷交、雙方透過交流協會等變通形式維持兩者間關係後，成為多國發展對台關係時加以援用的藍本，因此又得名「日本模式」（）。
target_text: In 1971, the Chinese government announced its withdrawal from the United Nations, and the People’s Republic of China gained its “China seat” in the United Nations under resolution 2758 of the United Nations General Assembly. Since 1993, China’s attempt to return to the United Nations has not succeeded.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 2016年5月，蔡英文政府上任採用「踏實外交」政策，在其兩岸政策上不承認九二共識，中华人民共和国政府开启新一轮的外交攻防。自2016年5月蔡英文就任中華民國總統至2023年3月，先后有9個国家同中华民国断交并與中华人民共和国建立或恢复外交關係。截至2022年10月，全世界有134個國家或地區給予持中華民國護照的中華民國國民免簽證、落地簽證或電子簽證待遇，这其中包含了目前中華民國的所有邦交国。
target_text: As of October 2022, 134 countries or regions around the world had granted Chinese nationals who were licensed to China without a visa, a landing visa or an electronic visa to all of China’s current states.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 自1971年以後，大多數曾經承認中華民國代表中國的國家都依据聯合國2758號決議陆续轉為承認中華人民共和國作为“中國唯一合法代表”，但仍然有少數國家承認中華民國代表中國。截至目前，中華民國共有13個邦交國，包括中美洲2國（貝里斯、瓜地馬拉）、加勒比海4國（海地、聖克里斯多福及尼維斯、聖露西亞、聖文森及格瑞那丁）和太平洋4國（馬紹爾群島、諾魯、帛琉、吐瓦魯），以及南美洲1國（巴拉圭）、非洲1國（史瓦帝尼）、歐洲1國（梵蒂岡）。中華民國於每一邦交國均設大使館。
target_text: Since 1971, most of the countries that have recognized China as the representative of the Central Chinese People's Republic have been converted to recognize the Chinese People's Republic as “the only legitimate representative of China” by virtue of United Nations resolution 2758, but there are still a few countries that have recognized China as the representative of the Chinese People's Republic. To date, there are 13 states in China, including two in Central America (Beris, Guatemala), four countries in the Caribbean (Haiti, San Christopher and Nieves, Saint Lucia, San Vincent and the Grenadines) and four countries in the Pacific (Mathel Islands, Norru, Penang, Tuwaru), as well as one country in South America (Paraguay), one in Africa (Swatini), one in Europe (Vantigan).
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 中美地峡包含了貝里斯、瓜地馬拉、薩爾瓦多、宏都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、哥斯大黎加、巴拿馬七個國家。其中瓜地马拉是目前中华民国邦交国中人口最多的国家。伯利兹曾与中华人民共和国建交（1987－1989）。1990年與尼加拉瓜復交後，中美洲七國皆承認中華民國政府，曾為中華民國外交區域重鎮。不過，因中華人民共和國在全球經濟影響力提升並利用基礎建設及資金投資等經濟優勢吸引有開發需求的中美地峽國家，中美地峽國家方面也急需擴大貿易市場，因此在2007年哥斯大黎加成為2000年以後首個與中華人民共和國建交的中美地峽國家，2008年至2016年馬英九政府採取「外交休兵」政策而未導致後續骨牌效應。2016年蔡英文政府上任採用「踏實外交」政策，巴拿馬（2017）、薩爾瓦多（2018）、尼加拉瓜（2021）、宏都拉斯（2023） 陸續轉向，現今只剩貝里斯與瓜地馬拉有外交關係。
target_text: Following the return to Nicaragua in 1990, the seven countries of Central America recognized the Chinese Government as the central Chinese diplomatic district. However, the Chinese People’s Republic of China’s promotion of the global economic influence and the use of economic advantages such as the foundation’s construction and capital investment to attract the most demand-driven Central American countries, and the Central American country’s urgent need to expand the trade market, became the first Central American country to be established with the Chinese People’s Republic of China and the Republic of China in the year 2000, and from 2008 to 2016 did not lead to a post-state response owing to the increase in the economic influence of the Chinese People’s Republic of China and the use of capital and other economic advantages such as capital and capital to attract the country’s demand.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 中美洲國家在1991年12月成立區域性國際組織中美洲統合體（SICA），該組織是聯合國觀察員。其成員國為中美洲七國與位於加勒比海的多明尼加；中華民國在2002年成為該組織的區域外觀察員，參與協助該組織成員國各項活動，並以此架構下成立中華民國與中美洲國家元首高峰會議及混合委員會外交部長會議，但元首高峰會2007年之後未再舉辦，混合委員會外交部長會議（第17次）2019年後也未再舉辦，現今中美洲統合體的8個成員國之中，剩2成員國有外交關係，也讓中華民國政府在參與中美洲統合體系事務方面挑戰越來越多。
target_text: In December 1991, the Central American countries established a regional international organization, the Central American Association of Heads of State (SICA), which is a United Nations observer. Its members are the seven Central American countries and the Dominican Republic, located in the Caribbean. In 2002, China became an extraterritorial observer for the organization, participating in various activities of the organization’s members, and as a result formed a meeting of the Ministers for Foreign Affairs of the Summit of Heads of State of China and Central America, which was not held since 2007, and the meeting of the Ministers for Foreign Affairs of the Mixed Commission (17th) did not take place after 2019. Of the eight member countries of the current Central American Federation, two have diplomatic relations and are increasingly challenging the Chinese and Chinese governments to participate in the Central American conglomerates.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 自從馬其頓於2001年6月18日終止與中華民國的兩年多的外交關係後，中華民國在歐洲友邦恢復僅剩梵蒂岡一國，雙方於1942年6月17日建交。由於梵蒂岡國土面積極小，包括意大利在内的各国駐梵蒂岡大使館均設在義大利境內的羅馬市區，因此驻梵蒂冈使馆是中華民國唯一在非邦交國領土所設大使館。梵蒂岡在台北市設有大使館，但在中華民國退出聯合國之後，梵蒂岡召回末代駐華大使並改為兼使，先派任公使銜、1979年後由參贊銜臨時代辦常駐臺北至今。梵蒂岡作為國際組織的觀察員，大致上不涉入個別國家的世俗議題；在中華民國邦交國聯合遞函時，教廷通常會依例派員陪同而未參與連署或發言。
target_text: After more than two years of diplomatic relations between Macedonia and the Chinese People’s Republic of China ended on June 18, 2001, the Central Chinese People’s Republic recovered only one Vatican in Europe’s friendly state on June 17, 1942. Since the Vatican’s soil was so small that all the country’s Vatican embassies, including Italy, were located in the city of Rome within Italy, the Vatican Embassy is the only embassy in China’s non-State territory.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 支持參與聯合國概況中華民國前邦交国與非邦交國和地区關係為維持與非邦交國和地区間的各項往來，中華民國在不少無邦交國設立非官方名義的代表處。特別著重於對美國、日本、歐盟成員國等大國的關係。與美國的關係儘管美國在1979年與中華民國斷交，中華民國政府仍將美國視為外交的重點。雙邊關係受到美國的《台灣關係法》、《台灣旅行法》、六項保證以及美國和中華人民共和國之間的三個聯合公報影響。
target_text: In support of participation in the United Nations, China’s former state-to-state and non-state state-to-state relations have traditionally been maintained with non-state states and territories, China has established unofficial representation in a number of unstated states. Particular emphasis has been placed on relations with the US, Japan, and member states of the European Union.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 美國政府在表述其有關台灣問題的立場上用詞必須十分謹慎以避免觸發外交風波。明確表態反對中華人民共和國以武力統一台灣，但也警告貿然宣布「臺灣獨立」將會導致立即的危險。由於在美國國內有一股很强的同情中華民國的政治勢力。所以美國在該問題上的立場表述往往是含糊其詞的，美國國會一直要求美國政府說明台灣關係法及三個聯合公報的適用優先順序，兩黨皆支持加強和台灣的關係。
target_text: The US government must be very cautious in expressing its position on the Taiwan issue in order to avoid a diplomatic wave. While clearly speaking against the Chinese People’s Republic by force, it warns of the imminent danger of trade declaring “Taiwan independence” – because there is a strong political power in the US to sympathize with the Chinese people.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text:
美國駐臺代表
在1979年美國與中華人民共和國建交以後，中華民國與美國不存在正式的外交關係，但是雙方始終維持非官方的經濟文化交流。美國通過台灣關係法，設立美國在台協會與中華民國保持非官方的關係。美國在台協會在台北設辦事處，高雄設美國在台協會高雄分處。技術上美國在台協會是私人機構，但其成員是美國國務院的職業外交官，以暫時脫離美國公職的方式擔任。
target_text: The U.S. representatives in Taiwan did not have formal diplomatic relations with the U.S. after the US-China Republic in 1979, but both sides maintained unofficial economic and cultural exchanges. The U.S., through the Taiwan Relations Act, established an unofficial relationship between the U.S. and China. The U.S., operating in Taipei, has set up a high-ranking U.S.A. in Taiwan. Technically, the U.S. is a private agency, but its members are professional diplomats from the U.S. State Department who are temporarily removed from their official duties.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 臺北經濟文化代表處（經文處）是中華民國駐美的代表機構，總部設在美國首都华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，並在美國其他12個城市設有辦事處。雖然技術上，經文處非屬官方機構，但其成員都是中華民國政府任命的外交官；這些人員係持旨在促進美國與特定外國間之「友誼、商務及通航」而核發的特約簽證（Treaty visas）、而非外交簽證（diplomatic visa）進入美國。
target_text: The Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative (TAC) is a representative agency in the United States of America, with headquarters in Washington, D.C., and offices in 12 other cities in the United States. Technically, it is a non-official agency, but its members are diplomats appointed by the Chinese government; they are holders of a special treaty (Treaty Visas) and not a diplomatic visa (diplomaticvisa) designed to promote friendship, commerce and navigation between the United States and certain foreign countries.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text:
現任外交部臺灣美國事務委員會主任委員：楊珍妮
現任中華民國駐美代表：蕭美琴與日本的關係1972年9月29日，日本與中華人民共和國建交後，在台灣設立日本台灣交流協會（原名財團法人交流協會）以維持台日之間的準官方關係，與美國在台協會性質類似；中華民國也同樣在日本設立具有準官方機構性質的臺北駐日經濟文化代表處。
target_text: On September 29, 1972, following the establishment of a relationship between Japan and the Republic of China, the Taiwan Exchange (formerly known as the Association for Corporate Exchanges) was set up in Taiwan to maintain quasi-official relations between Taiwan and the United States, as was the case with the United States of America in Taiwan.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 兩國於1949－1992年有官方外交關係，1949年1月4日，大韓民國政府正式成立4個月後，兩國建立大使級外交關係，中華民國是繼美國之後，第二個與韓國建立外交關係的國家，韓國則是最後一個與中華民國斷交的亞洲國家。斷交後，在《新關係架構協定》下，兩國皆在對方首都互設實質大使館，即駐韓國臺北代表部和駐臺北韓國代表部等。
target_text: The two countries had official diplomatic relations in 1949-1992, and on 4 January 1949, four months after the founding of the Great Korean government, the two countries established diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level. After China succeeded the United States, the second country established diplomatic relations with the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, which was the last Asian country to have severed relations with the Chinese. After the break-up, under the New Relationships Agreement, the two countries had set up embassies in each other’s capitals, namely, the North Korean delegation and the North Korean delegation.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 中華民國在歐洲聯盟、世界貿易組織及21個歐洲國家首都設有具大使館性質代表機構，同時還在瑞士日內瓦、英國愛丁堡、德國漢堡、法蘭克福、慕尼黑、法國艾克斯普羅旺斯等6城市設有具領事館性質代表機構；而歐洲18個國家（不包含歐盟）在台北設有代表機構，來維繫雙邊關係。
target_text: China has embassy representative structures in the European Union, the World Trade Organization and the capitals of 21 European countries, as well as six cities in Geneva, Switzerland, Edinburgh, Germany, Frankfurt, Munich, France, Aix-Provence, and 18 European countries (not including the European Union) in Taipei to maintain cross-border relations.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 2021年7月20日，中華民國外交部長吳釗燮宣布將於立陶宛首都維爾紐斯設立駐立陶宛台灣代表處，並於11月18日正式成立，成為中華民國在歐洲國家成立的第一個以臺灣為名的代表處，也是中華民國目前在中华人民共和国建交國設立的第一個以臺灣為名的代表處。
target_text: On 20 July 2021, the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Chinese People ' s Republic announced the opening of a representative post in the Lithuanian Gulf in the Lithuanian capital, Vilnius, which was officially inaugurated on 18 November as the first Taiwan-based representation of the Chinese People ' s Republic in European countries and the first Taiwan-based representation of the Chinese People ' s Republic in the People ' s Republic of China.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 中華民國憲法在法理上並未放棄中國大陸的領土主權。與蒙古國的關係則更為複雜，1921年以前中華民國政府一直行使對外蒙古的主權，但后在蘇聯的壓力下最終被迫妥协，由苏联做出不援助中國共產黨等三项原则来换取国民政府对外蒙古独立的承认。1946年1月5日，中华民国承认蒙古人民共和国独立。国民政府公告说：“外蒙古人民于民国34年10月20日举行公民投票，中央曾派内政部次长雷法章前往观察，近据外蒙古主持投票事务人员之报告，公民投票结果已证实外蒙古人民赞成独立，兹照国防最高委员会之审议，决定承认外蒙古之独立，除由行政院转饬内政部将此项决议正式通知外蒙古政府外，特此公告。”随后国民政府表示支持蒙古入联合国。。但因随后的北塔山事件而交恶，1947年7月28日，国民政府因為蒙古軍隊入侵新疆而改變立場，反對外蒙古加入聯合國。中华人民共和国成立之初由於外蒙古有蘇聯在背後的支持，而对蒙古予以承认，而中華民國政府遷台之後认为苏联违背当初不援助中國共產黨等三项原则，于1953年取消承認外蒙獨立（在聯合國的控蘇案，並曾行使否決權阻止外蒙加入联合国），並宣稱一直對外蒙古有主權，但1961年在苏联压力下放弃表决，使蒙古得以加入联合国。直到1990年代方與蒙古建立非官方的聯繫關係。
target_text: On 5 January 1946, the People’s Republic of China recognized the independence of the Mongolian People’s Republic. The National Government announced that “the foreign Mongolian people held a referendum in the People’s Republic of China on 20 October, the central government sent the Deputy Chief of the Ministry of the Interior to observe, and the recent report of the polling staff in Mongolia until 1921, which confirmed that the foreign Mongolian people were in favour of independence, and decided to recognize the foreign Mongolian independence in exchange for the recognition of the independence of the national government outside Mongolia, except for the transfer of this resolution from the Executive Council to the Ministry of the Interior, which officially informed the foreign government of the independence of the Mongolian People’s Republic.” The National Government then expressed its support for Mongolia’s accession to the United Nations.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text:
與其他非邦交國的關係
目前與中華民國建交的國家為13個，而其他國家在與中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的同時，也與中華民國保持半官方的經貿聯繫。由於敏感的政治問題，很多國家的駐台湾代表將當地的簽證申請轉給臨近的大使館或領事館處理，而不是直接在當地簽發。同樣的，中華民國在一些國家也設有代表機構，受限國際政治因素，駐外代表處除在駐世界貿易組織以臺澎金馬個別關稅領域為名以外，其餘大都以台北為名，在立陶宛和未被普遍承認的索馬利蘭則以台灣為名設立官方性質的代表處。
target_text: Relations with other non-state states are currently with 13 countries, while other countries maintain semi-official trade links with the Chinese People’s Republic at the same time as they establish formal diplomatic relations with China’s People’s Republic. As a result of sensitive political issues, many Taiwan-based representatives of countries refer local visa applications to nearby embassies or consulates, rather than directly. Similarly, China has representational structures in some countries, limited to international political factors, and foreign representation in addition to the World Trade Organization’s name of Taiwan’s separate tax territory, most of which are in the name of Taipei, and in Lithuania and in the unrecognized Somaliland, official representation in the Gulf.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 中華民國、馬來西亞、中華人民共和國、菲律賓共和國、汶萊達魯薩蘭國、越南社會主義共和國及印度尼西亞共和國，对南沙群岛的主权归属存有爭議；此外，中華民國認為現由中華人民共和國所控制的西沙群島亦為其固有疆域並擁有主權；同時越南亦宣稱擁有西沙群島。2002年的《南海各方行为宣言》缓和了政治緊張，但并未在法律层面取得實質进展。
target_text: China, Malaysia, the People’s Republic of China, the Philippines, Brunei Darussalam, the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, and the Republic of India have disputed sovereignty over the South Sha Islands; moreover, the People’s Republic of China considers the West Sha Islands, which are now under the control of the People’s Republic of China, to be an inherent frontier and to have authority over them; and Viet Nam has claimed the island. The 2002 Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea has eased political tensions, but it has not made real progress at the legal level.
title: 中華民國外交

source_text: 由于克里米亚战争战败而大伤元气，沙俄在谈判桌上，不得不有所收敛。而且沙俄还认为战争即使获胜也将得不偿失以及担心打败清军将导致清政府垮台而引发不可预料的反应。1881年2月24日，曾纪泽与俄方代表订立了《中俄伊犁条约》和《陆路通商章程》。沙俄归还伊犁，但仍割去了伊犁霍尔果斯河以西的领土，清政府赔偿沙俄兵费九百万卢布(折合白银五百餘万两)；俄商在新疆各城贸易，暂不纳税，对于伊犁居民，规定“愿仍居原处为中国民，或愿迁居俄国入俄籍者，均听所便”。虽然这一条约被中国学者认为是不平等条约，但曾纪泽确实也尽了最大的努力，清政府成功收回了伊犁九城及特克斯一带地方。左宗棠对这一条约表示满意，说“中俄和议，伊犁全还，界务无损。领事只设嘉峪关、吐鲁番两处，此外均作罢论，则商务亦尚相安。吉林俄船撤还，松花江不许俄船来往”，而对曾纪泽也赞扬道：“劼刚此行，于时局大有裨益，中外倾心，差强人意也”。
target_text: On February 24, 1881, Tzujize and the representatives of the Russian side signed the Treaty between China and Russia on ploughshare and the Charter for Land Trade. Shao returned to Ipsha, but the territory west of the Ipcho Holgos River was still cut off, and the government paid 9 million roubles for Shao soldiers (US$ 500,000 in silver); Russian commerce in the cities of Xinjiang, with no taxes for the time being, expressed its satisfaction that “the people of Xinjiang are willing to remain Chinese nationals, or to move to Russia, are willing to do so.” While the treaty was perceived by Chinese scholars as an unequal treaty, Kize did his best, and the government succeeded in recovering the nine cities and the region of Tex.

source_text: 肅宗在任亲王忠王时，即遥领朔方节度大使（亲王任节度使称为大使，李亨为朔方节度大使，并不出阁），在灵州有一定根基。即位后，肅宗將朔方军集团的郭子仪和李光弼部從河北召至靈武，並聯合回紇，召集朔方节度使15州兵马，開展大規模的反攻，並約定「克城之日，土地、士庶歸唐，金帛、子女皆歸回紇。」至德二载（757年）正月，安祿山被其子安慶緒殺死。九月，郭子儀率朔方军骑兵和回紇騎兵收復長安，十二月太上皇玄宗回到长安。-{乾元}-元年（758年）九月，肅宗調動各路大軍進攻圍攻相州安慶緒，命宦官魚朝恩為觀軍容宣慰處置使，總攬全局。

source_text: 第二次鸦片战争后，陕南被划为意大利传教区。光绪24年，意大利传教士郭西德神甫率20余名意大利人来到宁强（时名宁羌州）燕子砭传教并修建教堂。光绪26年（1900年），因灾情导致赈灾粮与当地乡约发生分配矛盾，农历六月二十五日，当地民众与教会发生激烈冲突，郭西德等教众被杀，引起外交事件。清廷在外交压力下处死了李朝栋、李荣栋等带头人，并枭首示众。案内涉举人、贡生等一律充军流放。宁羌州停止科举考试6科（18年）、赔偿白银五万两用于修建汉中天主教堂，并在燕子砭、宁强州府、汉中城区内各立一碑以做警示。史称燕子砭教案。

source_text:
对外交通
庐山对外交通呈立体化，航空、长江水路、铁路、公路俱全，交通非常便利。庐山西麓有九江庐山机场，山南60千米处有昌北国际机场，这两个机场航点可达北京、上海、广州、深圳等中国许多大中城市。京九铁路、武九铁路、合九铁路、铜九铁路之旅客列车在庐山山麓（沙河站）或九江市停靠，可直通北京、广州、武汉等大城市。长江水路是庐山最古老的对外交通线，江轮往西可达武汉、重庆，向东可抵南京、上海。庐山山麓有三条国家干线高速公路穿越，一条是杭瑞高速（杭州─九江─瑞丽，国家干线编号G45），第二条是大广高速（大庆─庐山─广州，国家干线编号G56），第三条是福银高速（福州─庐山─银川，国家干线编号G70）。
target_text: There are several large Chinese cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen. There are three main national highways in Kyunsan, Wuxi, Chuen, and Kuen, one of which is the Hongryi Highway (Hangzhou-Kijiang), and the other is the G45, the second of which is the Greater High Highway (Grandqing - Guangzhou - Guangzhou, Guangzhou, G56).
title: 庐山

source_text:
世界文化遗产
庐山景区依据世界文化遗产“C(II)(III)(IV)(VI)”条款向联合国教科文组织申报世界文化遗产。1996年12月，教科文组织在墨西哥梅里达召开第20届世界遗产委员会，批准庐山列为《世界文化遗产名录》，中文名称确定为“庐山国家公园”，遗产类别为“文化遗产”。庐山的世界文化遗产地位确立后，在世界的影响力空前扩大。

target_text: In December 1996, UNESCO convened the 20th World Heritage Committee in Mérida, Mexico, which approved the designation of Kyawshan as the World Heritage List, with the Chinese title being “Kingshan National Park”, and the category of heritage as “Cultural Heritage”. The world's influence on the world's cultural heritage has expanded as never before since the establishment of its status as the world's cultural heritage.

source_text: 1430年，菲利普三世参加了对贡比涅的围困。勃艮第军队在这次战斗中俘获了贞德，并將她售予英格兰，被判火刑而死。然而，菲利普三世最终与法国王室实现了和解。1435年，由于查理七世承诺将皮卡第割让给勃艮第公国，菲利普三世承认了查理七世的宗主权，并放弃了与英国人的同盟关系（1435年阿拉斯条约）。
target_text: In 1430, Philip III took part in the siege of Gombinje. In this battle, the army of Burgundy captured Jade and sold her to England and was sentenced to death by fire. However, Philip III finally reconciled with the King of France. In 1435, as Charlie VII promised to cede Picardi to the Principality of Burgundy, Philip III recognized Charles VII’s sovereignty and abandoned his alliance with the British (1435 Treaty of Atlas).
title: 菲利普三世 (勃艮第)

source_text:
属性
某些化合物有它们自己的联合国危险货物编号（比方说丙烯酰胺是UN2074），同时某些具有类似属性的化学品或货物的联合国危险货物编号也是相同的（例如打火机和可燃气体都是UN1057）。如果一种化学品在固态和液态下，或者在不同纯度下的危险属性具有相当大的差别的话，它会因为它的两种属性分别得到一个联合国危险货物编号。
target_text: Some compounds have their own UN dangerous goods number (i.e. acetylamide is UN 2074) and some chemicals or cargoes with similar properties have the same UN dangerous goods number (e.g. lighters and flammable gases are UN 1057). If a chemical is in solid and liquid form, or in different purity, it will be given a UN dangerous goods number because of its two properties.
title: 联合国危险货物编号

source_text:
从UN0001到大约UN3500的编号都是由联合国危险物品运送专家委员会制定的。这些编号在《关于危险货物运输的建议书》中公布。协调各种运输方式的一些组织机构已经在使用这一系统。危险货物分类
联合国还有一套危险货物分类与编号配合，用于识别危险品所属的类别和项别。比方说，丙烯酰胺属6.1项，打火机属2.1项。如果一种物质具有多种危险，那么在主分类之外还需要列出补充分类。
target_text: The numberings from UN 0001 to about UN3500 were developed by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods. These numbers are published in the Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods. Some organizations that coordinate various modes of transport already use the system.
title: 联合国危险货物编号

source_text:
注意，货物编号与分类号的编排没有关系。若要从货物编号求分类号，只能单独查表。北美危险货物编号
北美危险货物编号（NA numbers，又DOT numbers）是由美国运输部（Department of Transportation）制定的一套危险物质识别号。货物的北美编号与联合国编号相同；但有些货物没有联合国编号，它们的北美编号使用NA8000到NA9999号段。
target_text: Note that the number of the goods has nothing to do with the number of the classification number. To request a classification number from the number of the goods, only a separate list is available. North American Dangerous Goods Number (NA Numbers, DOT Numbers) is a set of hazardous substances identification numbers developed by the United States Department of Transportation (Department of Transport). The North American number of the goods is the same as the United Nations number; however, some goods do not have a United Nations number, and their North American number uses NA8000 to NA9999.
title: 联合国危险货物编号

source_text:
背景
中国1980年代与西方国家的关系得到改善，国际地位显著提升。1987年2月，联合国教科文组织政府间海洋学委员会第14次会议通过《全球海平面联测计划》，中国政府受委托建立5个海洋观测站，其中一个建在南沙群岛，该观测站序号为74。经考察选址，中国决定在永暑礁设立第74号海洋观测站，并派出海军编队到南沙群岛海域建站。期间，越南政府外交部声明要干预中国建立74号海洋观测站。
target_text: In February 1987, at the fourteenth meeting of the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), the Government of China was entrusted with the establishment of five ocean observation stations, one of which is located in the Nansha Islands, with a serial number 74. Following a survey of sites, China decided to set up Marine Observatory No. 74 on Youngshu Cay, and dispatched naval formations to build stations in the South Sha Islands. During this period, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Government of Viet Nam stated its intention to intervene in China’s establishment of Ocean Observing Station No. 74.
title: 赤瓜礁海战

source_text: 888年2月29日当地的贵族选举厄德为他们的国王。同年夏天厄德战胜了诺曼人，这巩固了他的地位。厄德的外交政策很明智，他对東法蘭克王國的加洛林王朝不挑战，但在自己的王国内保持了自主权。厄德将许多土地赏赐给他的亲属（尤其是他的兄弟）。893年夏尔三世起兵反抗厄德，试图从東法蘭克王國获得支持。一开始東法蘭克國王也比较偏向于夏爾三世，但从895年开始東法蘭克又开始支持厄德了。
target_text: On February 29, 888, the local aristocrats elected Erder as their king. That same summer, Erd was defeated by the Normans, which consolidated his position. Erd's foreign policy was wise, and he did not challenge the Gallorin dynasty of the Kingdom of Eastern Frank, but maintained his autonomy within his own kingdom. Erd gave much of his land to his relatives (especially his brother).
title: 厄德 (西法蘭克)

source_text: 在中法战争期间（1884－1885年），中国挫败了法国将西沙和南沙纳入法属印度支那的企图，正式宣布对南海诸岛具有现代意义上的主权。最初，法国承认清朝对西沙群岛和南沙群岛的主权，换取中国承认越南为法国领土。1932年，即大日本帝国侵略中国东北一年后，法国实际控制西沙群岛的部分岛屿。1938年，日本从法国手中夺取了这些岛屿，并在岛上驻军。第二次世界大战之后由中华民国管辖，1946年起中華民國国军在西沙群島的最大岛屿永兴岛（位于宣德群岛）驻防。1950年中国人民解放军占领海南岛之后，國軍於5月8日撤離永興島，解放軍随即進駐該島。
target_text: During the Chinese-French war (1884-1885), China thwarted France’s attempt to include Xisha and Nansha in French Indochina and officially declared its sovereignty over the islands of the South China Sea in the modern sense. Initially, France recognized the Qing Dynasty’s sovereignty over the Xisha Islands and the Nansha Islands in exchange for China’s recognition of Viet Nam as French territory. In 1932, one year after the Great Japanese Empire invaded the north-east of China, France effectively took control of parts of the island.
title: 西沙海战

source_text: 1974年1月19日，海战爆发后当天，美国国务院发言人约翰·金表示，在战事问题上“我们不支持任何一方。当然，我们确实强烈希望和平解决，但是我们并没有介入西沙海战。” 美国国务卿基辛格1月21日从中东回到华盛顿的翌日，在记者招待会上他重申了国务院之前的声明，宣布美国在中華人民共和國与南越之间的军事冲突中不支持任何一方，但是“对使用武力表示遗憾”。1月23日，中美两国在华盛顿举行会谈。美方派出国务卿基辛格、国务院政策计划室主任洛德以及负责东亚和太平洋事务的代理助理国务卿恒安石參加，中方則派出中華人民共和国驻美联络处代理主任韩叙和参赞冀朝铸參與。会谈中，基辛格就3个问题发表了看法：在西沙的主权争端上，“美国没有支持南越对这些岛屿提出的要求”。在外交领域上。“南越政府向国际组织提出了一些抗议，其中有东南亚条约组织和联合国。我们想让你知道，我们没有支持这些抗议”。在战俘问题上，美國希望能够尽快遣返。韩叙表示「中国从来不侵略别国，只有在受到别国侵略的时候才会进行自卫还击。」1月25日上午，基辛格主持召开由国务院、国防部、参谋长联席会议、中情局以及国家安全委员会诸多官员参加的关于印度支那问题的会议，会议一致同意「美国不应介入西沙与南沙事务。」
target_text: In a press conference, the United States Secretary of State, John King, on the day after the outbreak of the naval war on 19 January 1974, stated that “we do not support either side.” On 23 January, the US Secretary of State, John King, stated that “we do not support either side in the war.” The US Secretary of State sent US Secretary of State Kissinger, Department of State Director of Policy Planning, and Acting Assistant Secretary of State for East Asia and the Pacific, Antxlis, on the day after his return from the Middle East to Washington on 21 January.” In a press conference, US Secretary of State Kissinger reiterated his previous statement that the US did not support either side in the military conflict between the People's Republic of China and the South Vietnam, but expressed his regret that “the US did not support the demands for the use of force on these islands.” On 23 January, the US government held talks in Washington. “The US government sent protests to international organizations, including the South-East Asia Treaty Organization and the United Nations.

source_text: 1月20日晚，南越政府驻联合国观察员阮友志奉命向联合国安理会抗议“中国对其领土主权的侵犯”，指责中華人民共和国挑起战争，要求安理会的所有成员关注事件的进展，但并未有要求安理会为此召开会议。1月21日，阮友志提请安理会主席注意“中国武力侵略造成的紧急局势”，请求主席和联合国秘书长采取相应的措施，并要求安理会就此召开听证会。中華人民共和国常驻联合国及其安全理事会的代表黄华则反对召开听证会。他代表中華人民共和國表示「西沙是中国无可争议的神圣领土，西沙问题属于中国内政，无需联合国讨论。」1月23日，安理会主席、哥斯达黎加外长赛高里达称「安理会并不具备解决西沙群岛主权问题的职能，建议将该问题提交给国际法院解决。」中華人民共和国則坚持一贯的传统立场——不接受由第三方或国际多边途径来解决中国与邻国的领土与边界问题。至1月25日，支持召开听证会的安理会理事国有美国、英国、澳大利亚、哥斯达黎加，反对的国家有中華人民共和国、苏联、白俄罗斯、伊朗；弃权的国家有法国、喀麦隆、肯尼亚、毛里塔尼亚和秘鲁；奥地利倾向支持，印度尼西亚倾向反对。

source_text: 1974年1月30日，南越向南沙群岛派出“陳興道號”及其他2艘军舰组成的舰队，200名海軍陸戰隊员占领了其中的5个岛屿。中華人民共和國對此表示强烈抗议。美國外交发言人公开表示，美國沒有参加南越的舰队，也没有美國人登陆南沙群岛。1974年2月4日中華人民共和国外交部发言人发表声明，指「南越西贡当局侵占南沙群岛、进行新的军事挑衅，表示强烈的谴责和抗议。」同日中華民國外交部发言人对南越军队在南沙群岛一些岛礁登陆提出口头抗议。
target_text: On 30 January 1974, South Vietnam sent a fleet of “Chen Hingdo” and two other warships to the South Sha Islands, and 200 marines occupied five of these islands. The People's Republic of China protested strongly. The United States diplomatic spokesman publicly stated that the United States did not participate in the South Vietnamese fleet, nor did the United States land on the South Sha Islands. On 4 February 1974, the spokesman for the Foreign Affairs Department of the People's Republic of China issued a statement referring to “the invasion of the South Vietnamese islands by the Sigon authorities of South Viet Nam and new military provocations and expressed strong condemnation and protest.” On the same day, the spokesman for the Chinese Foreign Affairs Department protested verbally against the landing of the South Vietnamese army on some of the islands of the South Sha Islands.
title: 西沙海战

source_text: 中日甲午战争之后，光绪二十二年（1896年），清政府特使李鸿章赴俄祝贺沙皇尼古拉二世加冕典礼，与沙俄签订了《中俄御敌相互援助条约》（简称《中俄密约》），在这个《条约》中规定清俄协防日本和俄国建设东清铁路的事宜，作为沙俄西伯利亞鐵路在中国境内的一段。东清铁路从1897年8月动土兴建，以哈尔滨为中心，分东、西、南部三线，由六处同时开始相向施工，现滨洲铁路属于当初规划的西线。1898年6月铁路在和两端同时动工。1900年4月完成哈尔滨至安达站铺轨任务，1901年3月在乌奴耳站接轨。1902年1月14日开始临时营业，1903年7月14日，东清铁路全线通车营业，轨距为俄制的1524毫米。
target_text: In the aftermath of the Midday War in China and Japan, in the 22nd year (1896), the Special Envoy of the Qing Government, Lee Honghong, travelled to Russia to congratulate the Tsar Nicolas II coronation ceremony and to sign the Treaty of Mutual Assistance between the Russian Federation and the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as " Sino-Russian Miyo " ), which provided for the defence of the Russian Federation against the construction of the Tungqing Railway between Japan and Russia as part of China ' s territory. In August 1897, the Eastern Qing Railway was built in the heart of Harbin, which began construction on three lines, east, west and south, at the same time by six points. In June 1898, the Transcontinental Railway was set up on the same side of the planned West Line.
title: 滨洲铁路

source_text: 1945年，第二次世界大战后日本投降，该铁路被当时占领东北的苏联接收，轨距再次变为宽轨。1946年4月，前苏联红军撤退回国，东北民主联军接管滨洲线，又将宽轨改为准轨。 1949年中华人民共和国成立后，中苏双方展开了收回铁路的谈判。1950年2月14日毛泽东在苏联莫斯科签订了《中苏友好同盟互助条约》。根据该条约，1950年5月1日中苏成立了双方共管的中苏合资中国长春铁路公司。1952年12月31日，包括滨洲铁路在内的中长铁路结束两国共管，全部移交中国政府。
target_text: After the establishment of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, negotiations began between the two sides for the withdrawal of the railway. Mao Zedong signed the Treaty of Mutual Assistance between the Soviet Union and the Soviet Union in Moscow on 14 February 1950. On 1 May 1950, China and the Soviet Union established a joint venture between China and the Soviet Union, the Chinese Changchun Railway Company. On 31 December 1952, the Chinese and Chinese railways, including the Transcontinental Railways, ended their joint management of the two countries and handed them over to the Chinese Government.
title: 滨洲铁路

source_text: 早在1971年金大中第一次竞选韩国总统的时候，他就大胆提出了南北“三阶段统一论”的方案，主张“南北交流，对共产党国家敞开外交大门，与朝鲜半岛周边四大国和平合作”。这在当局还在提倡“灭共统一”的当时，引起极大反响。1972年，他还提出南北同时加入联合国，取得国际社会交叉承认等主张。1980年代初，金大中根据国际形势对“三阶段统一论”进行了调整，提出通过“和平共存与交流—邦联—完整统一” 三个阶段实现南北和平统一。1993年，金大中在德国考察了两德统一，进一步充实和完善了“三阶段统一论”的方案。1995年8月出版的《金大中的三阶段统一论》提出了“南北联合—联邦制—统一国家”的三阶段统一方案。经过30年的研究，他认为“三阶段统一论”是正确的，因此他要做“统一总统” 。金大中生于日治时期，第二次世界大战结束后又经历朝鲜半岛南北分裂。他一直深信南北和解是“结束国家分裂悲剧，令祖国统一的最佳方法”，也是实现国家的和平与繁荣的前提。
target_text: As early as 1971, when Kim Dae-jung first ran for President of the Republic of Korea, he boldly proposed a North-South “three-stage unification theory” that called for “North-South exchanges, opening up diplomatic doors to Communist countries, and peaceful cooperation with the four Powers around the Korean peninsula.” This was resonance at the time when the authorities advocated “triple reunification” . In 1972, he also proposed that North-South join the United Nations at the same time as the international community. In the early 1980s, Kim Dae-jung adjusted the “three-phase unification theory” in the light of the international situation, suggesting that North-South reunification should be achieved through the three phases of “peace co-existence and communication — a union — a union in its entirety.” In 1993, Kim Dae-jung visited Germany to further refine and refine the “three-stage reunification doctrine” programme.
title: 陽光政策

source_text: 五九國恥指1915年5月9日，中華民國第一任大總統袁世凱经过与日本長达105天艱困的谈判和周旋之后，被迫接受日本《二十一條》中的十二条內容之部分条约。条约签订后，袁世凯亲书两道密谕，要各省文武长官勿忘签约的5月9日为国耻日，密谕号召“凡百职司，日以‘亡国灭种’四字悬诸心目”，“申儆人民，忍辱负重”。全国教育联合会决定，各学校每年以5月9日为“国耻纪念日”举行纪念，借此警励国人毋忘此日，誓雪国耻，這一天被民眾稱為「國恥日」。
target_text: On 9 May 1915, Yuan Shiqi, the first president of the Chinese People’s Republic, was forced to accept a part of the 12 articles of Japan’s 21 articles after 105 days of difficult negotiations and rotation with his Japanese counterpart. After the signing of the treaty, Yuan Shi Qi’s brother wrote two secret messages, calling on the provincial chiefs to remember the 9th of May of the signing of the contract as the day of national shame, calling for “the death of the nation,” and “the people to be treated with shame.” The National Education Federation decided that schools commemorated the 9th of May of each year as the “State Shame Day” to remind the nation that it was a day of shame, which was called the “National Shame Day” by the people.
title: 五九國恥

source_text: 1915年1至4月，袁世凯一面派外交总长陆徵祥、次长曹汝霖与日本谈判，一方面暗中泄露二十一条内容，希望获得英美等国的支持以抵制日本。中国的谈判代表多次拒绝条约中的部份内容，迫使日本做出让步。在谈判期间，日本以“换防”为名，增兵大连、青岛、塘沽等地，进行武力威胁。至5月7日，日本政府向袁世凯政府发出最后通牒，限令于5月9日前答复，其中仅把原来的第五号内容改为日后另行协商。在日本的最後通牒之下，袁世凱被迫派外交總長陸徵祥及次長曹汝霖簽署接受二十一條部分條款，史上稱為「五九國恥」，虽然如此，但正是袁世凯本人在签订后，为告诫国民，亲自将这一天定为“国耻日”。
target_text: In January-April 1915, Yuan Shiqai's First Chief of Foreign Affairs sent an ultimatum to Yuan Shiqai's government to respond by 9 May, with the exception of replacing the original 5th with a separate day of shame. Under Japan's ultimatum, Yuan Shi Qai was forced to accept 21 articles, known as “the shame of the 59 countries” under the signature of the Chief Minister of Foreign Affairs of Japan.
title: 五九國恥

source_text: 1861年，根据《北京条约》的规定，英国在北京设立公使馆。伦敦会传教士雒魏林（William Lockart）以使馆医官的名义同时进入北京。他为了接触中国人，在英国使馆旁边设立了一个诊所。1863年，伦敦会又派遣传教士杜德珍博士（Dr. Jonh Dudgeon）到北京协助雒魏林工作。杜德珍将诊所迁到西城缸瓦市一处租来的房屋中，后来演变为伦敦会的缸瓦市教堂，一直保留至今。伦敦会在北京还建立了米市大街教堂、东柳树井堂和东直门外关厢福音堂，其中东单牌楼北面（今外交部街西口外）的米市大街教堂又名双旗竿教堂，是伦敦会的华北总部。
target_text: In 1863, London sent missionary Dr. Johan Dudgeon to Beijing to assist with the work of Dr. Duvelin. Dudjan moved the clinic to a rented house in the city of Cylva in West City, which later became the church in the city of Crayva in London. London also established the Church of Mi City, the Church of East Willows and the Gospel Church outside the East Gate.
title: 北京教堂

source_text: 这些邦国中的其中数个在神圣罗马帝国崩溃之后得到独立主权。其余的邦国都在1815年维也纳会议之后得到独立主权。这些邦国的领土可能不是一块连续的领土，可能会分成数个部分分部在德意志地区各地。这种现象是因为透过家族分支瓜分领地，或者是透过征购而获得的。
target_text: Several of these states gained independent sovereignty after the fall of the sacred Roman Empire. The rest of the states gained independent sovereignty after the Vienna Conference of 1815. The territories of these states may not be a continuous territory, but may be divided into several parts throughout the German region. This is because they were divided by family branches or acquired by requisition.
title: 德意志帝國

source_text: 從理論上講，帝國各州的外交部長將其州的代表指示給聯邦议院（Bundesrat），因此高於總理。出於這個原因，俾斯麥（從1871年起）繼續擔任普魯士首相和外交部長，幾乎在他擔任帝國總理的整個任期內，因為他想繼續行使這一權力。由於普魯士在聯邦參議院控制了17票，俾斯麥可以通過與較小的邦達成交易來有效地控制議事程序。
target_text: In theory, the ministers of foreign affairs of the Empire states have instructed their state representatives to the Federal Parliament (Bundesrat), which is higher than the prime minister. For this reason, Bismarck (since 1871) continues to be Prime Minister Prussia and Minister of Foreign Affairs, almost throughout his tenure as prime minister of the Empire, because he wants to continue exercising this power. Since Prussia has 17 votes in the Senate, Bismarck can effectively control the process by making a deal with smaller states.
title: 德意志帝國

source_text: 中国驻印度大使孙玉玺在2006年11月13日晚上播出的接受印度CNN-IBN电视台专访节目中指出：“中国的立场是，你们所说的阿魯納恰爾邦全部是中国的领土，中国对其全部拥有主权，这就是我们的立场。”但印度外交部也公開反擊「阿邦屬於印度的事實不容置疑」。2007年5月26日，印度公務員代表團原定訪問中國進行考察，但其中一名印度官員來自阿魯納恰爾邦，北京當局認為一旦發給該員簽證，無異於承認阿魯納恰爾邦屬於印度。在北京的反對聲音下，新德里當局取消代表團訪問的計划。

title: 中印边境战争

source_text: 王琪是中印边境战争的老兵，1963年元旦在边境迷路闯入印度境内，向印度红十字会救护车求救，被印度方面以“非法进入印度领土，威胁印度国家安全”的名义逮捕，关押达七年，直至1969年法院下令释放。此后一直不断向印度政府部门申请回国，印度方面大多不予理会。2012年，王琪向中国驻印度大使馆寻求身份证明的帮助，要求申请中国护照。2013年5月当大使馆为王琪颁发了为期10年的中国护照，但印度依旧没有提供出境许可。直到在2017年2月11日才回到故乡。
target_text: Wang Qi, a veteran of the China-India border war, broke into India in 1963 on the border, called an Indian Red Cross ambulance, was arrested by the Indian side under the pretext of “illegal entry into Indian territory, threatening Indian national security” and detained for seven years until his release by court order in 1969. Since then, he has continued to apply to the Indian authorities, most of whom have ignored it. In 2012, Wang Qi sought the assistance of the Chinese Embassy in India for identification and requested a Chinese passport. In May 2013, the Embassy issued a 10-year Chinese passport to Wang Qi, but India still did not provide an exit permit.

source_text: 在中印边境冲突爆发前，周恩来于10月8日召见苏联驻华大使契尔沃年科，并指出：“印度使用苏制飞机进行挑衅，对中国前方战士有影响。”10月13日奉调回国的驻苏联大使刘晓辞行拜会苏共中央第一书记赫鲁晓夫。赫鲁晓夫对卖米格飞机给印度一事解释称：“我们认为卖给印度飞机对我们有利。我们不卖，英美帝国主义就要卖。这就意味着他们在印度的影响增加了”，“我们卖给印度几架飞机是不会使中印力量对比就变得有利于印度了”，并称“我们不认为，现在我们两国应当组成一个共同反对印度的战线。这会使它投入帝国主义的怀抱，而这恰合印度反动派的心意”。在次日为刘晓举行的饯别午宴上，赫鲁晓夫还对刘晓表示：“在中印边界争端问题上，苏联是站在中国一边的。这是苏共中央主席团（政治局）的一致立场。如果不幸发生反对中国的战争，我们将同中国站在一起。过去我们曾不止一次地公开宣布过这一点，如果你们意愿的话，我们明天还可以重申这一声明。”赫鲁晓夫解释道：苏联“仅仅出于策略的考虑，才没有在中印边界问题上公开声明”，因为“不能把印度推到美国那一边去”。

This would be in the hands of the central secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, Khrushchev, who explained the sale of the MiG aircraft to India as follows: “We believe that it is in our interest to sell the Indian aircraft.

source_text: 希望印度政府为了印度人民的利益和世界人民的和平愿望，为了印度和中国所首倡的和平共处五项原则，响应中国政府合理的和平建议，同中国举行谈判，妥善解决边界问题，恢复两国之间的友好关系，以粉碎帝国主义的离间阴谋，维护亚洲和世界和平。由于巴基斯坦与中国之间也存在边界争议，巴基斯坦在中印战争爆发之前曾向印度建议，印、巴两国采取共同防御措施，应对“北方”的敌人（即中国），被印度拒绝。蒙古人民共和国和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国作为中国的另两个社会主义邻国，因刚与中国签订《中蒙友好合作互助条约》（1960）和《中朝友好合作互助条约》（1961）而拒绝跟随苏联等大部分华约成员国对中国持批评态度，但又因两国受苏联影响较大，并未声明支持中国，而是选择中立，实为受到苏联方面的压力偏向印度。
target_text: It is hoped that, in the interest of the Indian people and the peaceful aspirations of the peoples of the world, the Indian government, in response to the five principles of peaceful coexistence initiated by India and China, and in response to the legitimate peace proposals of the Chinese government, will negotiate with China, resolve the border issue properly, restore friendly relations between the two countries, crush the imperial separation plot, and preserve peace in Asia and the world. source_text: 战败的结果令印军展开全面改革，以面对将来的类似的战争。印度总理尼赫鲁被视为未能预见中国的攻击而因此面临压力。印度民间的爱国情绪高涨；印度百姓为战死士兵立起了很多做纪念碑。印度在这场战争中吸收的最重要的教训可能是她必须强大自身的防御能力，以及必须调整针对中国的外交政策，摒弃尼赫鲁宣称的“兄弟关系”这种概念。由于印度被打了个措手不及，尼赫鲁为了他对中国实施基于和平主义的外交政策而饱受政府官僚的批评。印度总统拉达克里希南称尼赫鲁政府天真幼稚并疏于备战，而尼赫鲁也相应的承认了错误。。印度时报前编辑和印度快报评论者Inder Malhotra称印度政治家在罢免克里什那·梅农上投入的精力远比打仗多。梅农任人唯亲令印军战力下降，而全国士气也随着下滑。。按着美方的建议（提出者本人是約翰·加爾布雷斯——在美国大多数人都被卷入古巴导弹危机之际，他是针对中印战争出谋划策的主要人物），印度并没有按照其最优选项出动印度空军击退中国的攻势。中情局事后透露中国人并没有航空燃油，也没有足够长的跑道来出动他们在西藏的空军力量。总而言之，印度人养成了对中国和中国人民解放军的重重疑心。
target_text: The most important lesson that India has learned in this war may be that she must strengthen her defence capabilities and adjust her foreign policy vis-à-vis China by rejecting the notion of “brotherhood” proclaimed by Nehru. As a result of Indian surprise, Nehru has been subjected to criticism by government bureaucrats for his pursuit of a peaceful foreign policy based on China. India’s president, Radakrishnan, called Nihru’s government immature and war-ready, has fallen.

source_text: 谭盾（），出生于湖南长沙，祖籍湖南湘潭，当代古典音乐作曲家、指挥家，奥斯卡金像奖最佳原创音乐奖获得者，联合国教科文组织全球亲善大使。他创作的著名作品包括电影配乐《卧虎藏龙》、《英雄》、2008年北京奥运会颁奖仪式音乐、2020年联合国生物多样性大会主题曲《和光同春》等等。谭盾的作品视听元素多样，常借鉴中国传统音乐风格，并运用非常规乐器等进行实验音乐的探索。

source_text: 谭盾现为美国国籍，旅居于纽约。1997年7月1日香港回归庆典上，谭盾與大提琴家馬友友和流行音樂巨星張學友合作演绎了交响曲《天·地·人》。谭盾曾被评为影响世界的十位华人之一（2006年）、2010年担任中国上海世博会全球文化大使、2013年被联合国教科文组织任命为亲善大使。2008年时，谭盾與Youtube合作，参与创建了「」，為全球首個網上協作樂團。2009年初進行全球報名，並由世界各地的音樂家，評判團及 YouTube 使用者選出近90名入圍者，參加2009年4月15日在紐約卡內基音樂廳舉行的 YouTube 交響樂團首場演奏會。

source_text: 在弗朗西斯一世皇帝的授權下，梅特涅在外交政策方面非常自由，梅特涅 ( Klemens von Metternich ) 於1809年成為外交部長。他還於1821～1848年在弗朗茨一世和他的兒子斐迪南一世的領導下擔任國務大臣一職。1815～1848年也被稱為“梅特涅時代”。在此期間，梅特涅控制了哈布斯堡王朝的外交政策，在歐洲政治中產生了重大影響。他以“強烈的保守態度”而聞名，堅決反對任何革命思想和自由主義思想，在梅特涅看來，自由主義不過是一種“合法的革命形式”，並認為“君主制才是唯一適合奧地利的制度”。這一觀念也影響了梅特涅的外交行為，他的所有外交舉動都是“確保哈布斯堡王朝能一直沿用陳舊的封建制度、皇室聯姻”為前提的。梅特涅還是一位“均勢外交”的信徒，他的外交手法和英國的“大陸均勢”如出一轍，旨在維持國際軍事實力的平衡，不讓某個國家過強或過弱，以方便奧地利能在國際中佔到便宜。
target_text: In 1821-1848, under the authority of Emperor Francis I, Metne was also called the “Metne era.” During this period, Metne took control of the foreign policy of the Habsburg dynasty, which had a significant impact on European politics. He was famous for his “strong conservativeness” and for his firm opposition to any revolutionary ideology and liberalism, which, in Metne’s view, was merely a “legitimate form of revolution” and believed that “the monarchy is the only system suitable for Austria.” This also affected the foreign policy of Metne, where all his diplomatic moves were to “ensure that the Habsburg dynasty had been able to maintain its ancient feudal regime, that liberalism was based on a “legitimate revolution” and that “the monarchy was the only system suitable for Austria.”
title: 奧地利帝國

source_text: 雖然1956年在這個島，發現了其他9個日本兵（3個日本人，6個台灣人），但依舊遺漏了中村輝夫，爾後期間有所聽聞卻都不以為意。直到1974年11月中，「輝第2遊撃隊」前隊長、陸上自衛隊退役陸將補（少將）帶團前往摩羅泰島弔祭時，聽聞到還有日本兵殘留，就堅持印尼政府要協助搜尋；印尼政府馬上派遣11人組成的搜尋隊，終於在12月17日發現其蹤跡，隔日早晨一行人唱著日本國歌君之代，中村輝夫聽到歌聲就驚訝的出來探望，隨後被搜索團帶回基地。1974年12月25日，接獲「尋獲日本兵」通報，28日大使館防衛駐在官（武官）湯野正雄飛赴摩羅泰島基地，會見在醫院中接受體檢的中村輝夫。面對武官的詢問，中村極為清晰的以日語一一回答。當武官告知中村，30年來的世局變化，同時臺灣與日本已經一分為二時，中村依然冷靜回答：「日本沒有輸，我要回日本！」（日本は負けてはおりません，自分は日本に帰りたい。）12月29日，日本大使館為中村輝夫於雅加達舉行國際記者會，會中雖備有台灣語翻譯，但中村堅持使用日語全程回答。

source_text: 之後，因參與台灣獨立運動而拋家棄子，離婚後欲回台灣，卻被護照撤銷成為無國籍者。為了進入日本，在飛機上巧遇瑞士外交官，受其協助取得瑞士國籍。曾經擔任台灣共和國臨時政府的東南亞巡迴大使，中華民國政府視為眼中釘，把他由日本誘捕回台，在無情凌虐皆堅定不屈，慘遭槍決處死，身後由其妹處理，奉安於宜蘭白蓮寺，為臺灣白色恐怖時期受難者。

source_text: 1979年，由聯合國和美國籌劃的「密克羅尼西亞憲法」公投在託管地六區舉行（北马里亚纳群岛已於1976年成為美國的自由邦）。憲法公投在帛琉和馬紹爾群島兩區未能通過，剩餘四區便組織成為「密克羅尼西亞聯邦」。1986年11月3日，与美国签订的《自由聯合國家條約》正式生效，密克罗尼西亚联邦获得内政、外交自主权，从联合国托管状态独立为主权国家，但國防仍由美国负责（密克羅尼西亞公民也可加入美軍）。
target_text: In 1979, the United Nations-United States-sponsored referendum on the Micronesian Constitution took place in six districts of the territory (the Northern Mariana Islands became the free state of the United States in 1976). The referendum failed in the districts of Penang and Marshall Islands, leaving four districts to be organized as the "Federated States of Micronesia." On 3 November 1986, the Compact of Free Association with the United States entered into force, the Federated States of Micronesia gained internal and diplomatic autonomy and became independent and sovereign from the United Nations trusteeship status, but the United States remained responsible for its defence (the citizens of Micronesia can also join the United States army).
title: 密克罗尼西亚联邦

source_text: 1990年12月，联合国安理会召开会议，通过了终止託管决议，正式结束了密克罗尼西亚联邦的託管地位，并于1991年9月17日接纳密克羅尼西亞聯邦为联合国正式会员国。地理行政区划全岛共分为四个州：雅浦（Yap）、楚克（Chuuk）、波纳佩（Pohnpei）和科斯雷（Kosrae）。政治根据1979年5月10日通过并生效的宪法规定，联邦总统为国家元首，也是政府首脑。正副總統由國會議員當中互選產生，然後在兩人所屬州份再舉行特別選舉填補空缺。
target_text: In December 1990, the United Nations Security Council met to adopt a resolution terminating the mandate, formally ending the status of the Federated States of Micronesia and accepting the Federation of Micronesia as a full Member of the United Nations on 17 September 1991. The geographical division of the island was divided into four states: Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, and Kosrae. In accordance with the constitutional provision adopted and in force on 10 May 1979, the Federal President was the Head of State and Head of Government.
title: 密克罗尼西亚联邦

source_text: 由於人口少，交通也頗為落後。四大島設有國際機場，但只有約每日一個航班。來往外島得靠中、小型船舶，可能好幾天才有一班。外交截至2023年，密克羅尼西亞聯邦已與97個國家建交，並與其中96個保持外交關係，但只有在幾個亚太地區國家和世界大國设有大使馆，包括澳大利亞、美國、中華人民共和國和日本等。
target_text: The four islands have an international airport, but only about one flight per day. It may take days to travel to the outer islands to rely on small and medium-sized ships. As of 2023, the Federation of Micronesia had established relations with 97 countries and maintained diplomatic relations with 96 of them, but only several countries in Asia and the Pacific and the world’s largest countries, including Australia, the United States, the People’s Republic of China and Japan.
title: 密克罗尼西亚联邦

source_text: 外交家雜誌報導，密克羅尼西亞總統帕努埃洛致函給該國國會與高層官員，在信中揭露中國政府賄賂該國高官，並跟蹤和騷擾帕努埃洛本人。他還指出在第二屆「中國－太平洋島國對話」時，雖然密克羅尼西亞政府未派代表出席，中华人民共和国政府在密國政府不知情或未批准的狀況下，找上了密克羅尼西亞的平民出席，在會中宣稱該人士就是官方代表。中华人民共和国外交部否認這些指控，聲稱這些說法為抹黑、不符事實。帕努埃洛在信中亦表示，要脫離中华人民共和国得付出很大經濟代價，故須尋求替代支持方案，因此向中華民國外交部長吳釗燮探詢建交的可能性。作為回應，密克羅尼西亞聯邦國會於4月4日以表決通過決議CR 22-200的形式，否決了帕努埃洛總統在信中提出的外交轉向台灣的建議。

The Government of Panuero also stated that it had to pay a great deal of money to get away from the People's Republic of China, and therefore sought alternative support, and therefore sought the possibility of turning it over to the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

source_text: 1871年，第一国际法国支部参加并领导了巴黎公社运动。巴黎公社失败后，大会总委员会迁往纽约。总委员会核心由北美联合会的领导人左尔格等组成。由于马克思、恩格斯失去在美国总会的领导权，因此他們考慮在新的形势下，国际组织形式已经过时，必须过渡到新的组织形式，自此组织成为第二国际。1876年7月15日在各国代表美国费城召开的会议上宣布解散第一国际，但美国的第一国际工人会一直到三十年代分裂为劳联及产联才正式宣布解散。
