source_text:
建党初期
1905年，工人国际法国支部成立。1920年12月30日，工人国际法国支部在图尔代表大会上发生分裂，大部分党员组成共产国际法国支部，其余党员仍以工人国际法国支部的名义活动。1921年，共产国际法国支部改名为共产党。此后法共发展并不快，因为很多法国人对发生在俄国的十月革命心存疑虑，1933年前，法国共产党党员数仅为2.8万左右。
target_text: In 1905, the French branch of Workers’ International was formed. On 30 December 1920, the French branch of Workers’ International split at the Touré Congress, with most of its members forming the French branch of Comunist International and the rest still operating in the name of the French branch of Workers’ International. In 1921, the French branch of Comunist International changed its name to Communist Party.
title: 法国共产党

source_text:
2003年10月1日，联合国维持和平部队接管了利比里亚，着手解除内战各方武装。时至今日，仍有5500名联合国军人驻扎在利比里亚。虽然骚动事件屡有发生，但是解除武装的工作仍在缓慢进行中。民主选举
2003年8月18日，布拉政府与各政党社团共同签署《阿克拉和平协定》，并于10月中旬组建全国过渡政府。查尔斯·久德·布赖恩特被推举为全国过渡政府主席，并于10月14日宣誓就职。
target_text: On 1 October 2003, the United Nations peacekeeping force took over Liberia and proceeded with the disarmament of all parties to the civil war. To date, 5,500 United Nations military personnel remain in Liberia. Despite repeated disturbances, disarmament is proceeding slowly. Democratic elections, on 18 August 2003, led to the signing of the Accra Peace Agreement between the Government of Bula and political party associations, and the formation of the National Transitional Government in mid-October. Charles Gyude Bryant was elected Chairman of the National Transitional Government and sworn in on 14 October.
title: 利比里亚历史

source_text:
开辟
由于清朝在第二次鸦片战争中战败，而在1858年《中英天津条约》第十款中，规定“准将自汉口溯流至海各地，选择不逾三口，准为英船出进货物通商之区”。第二次鸦片战争结束后，1861年初，英国参赞巴夏礼乘坐军舰前往根据条约新开辟的长江口岸勘察形势，选定将要开辟的租界界址。在镇江和汉口两地租界界址划定之后，3月22日，巴夏礼从汉口返回九江。他一度计划改到控扼鄱阳湖口的湖口开辟商埠，但是经过江西省官员的一再劝说，最终确定在九江开辟商埠。3月25日，江西布政使张集馨与英国参赞巴夏礼订立开辟九江英租界的约章《九江租地约》。租界的位置位于九江府城以西，长江与甘棠湖之间的狭窄地段，西面到龙开河，东西向长150丈（即沿长江岸线长度），南北向进深为60丈。面积150亩。租界南部包括湓浦港的一部分。湓浦港原是长江的江汊，早已淤塞成池塘。
target_text: In early 1861, following the Second Opium War, British Counsellor Bachali travelled on a military ship to the newly opened Yangtze border under the Treaty and selected the rental boundary to be opened. Following the demarcation of the boundary between the town and the Han Pass, on 22 March Bashali returned from Hanguchi to the Qinjiang River. He planned to open a business base at the lake entrance at the entrance to the town, but was determined to open a business in the Qijiang province, after repeated persuasions by officials. On 25 March, Jiang Sib, the Governor of Jiang Sib, and British Counsellor Bachar, established a lease site to open the boundary between the Qijiang and Hanang.
title: 九江英租界

source_text: 1927年1月6日，九江英租界被大批中国民众冲击。2月20日，武汉国民政府外交部长陈友仁与英方代表欧玛利签订《收回九江英租界之协定》。3月4日，武汉国民政府中央政府会议，通过外交部所拟《收回九江英租界之协定》3月15日，武汉国民政府正式收回九江英租界。
target_text: On February 20, the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Wuhan National Government, Chen Yoon-in, and the representative of the United Kingdom, Omari, signed the Agreement on the Repossession of the Xinjiang British Tenant Area. source_text: 天津日租界是天津的九国租界之一，同时也是近代中国5个在华日租界中最大、也是惟一较繁荣的一个（另外4个是汉口日租界、苏州日租界、杭州日租界和重庆日租界）。设立1896年7月21日，清朝政府和日本政府签订《中日通商行船条约》。1898年8月29日，根据《中日通商行船条约》，清朝政府和日本政府签订《天津日本租界协议书及附属议定书》，划定日本租界，南临天津法租界，西北与天津老城相望。但没有进行开发。

source_text: 1905年11月11日，辜鸿铭被任命为上海黄浦江浚浦局（浚治局）督办（「監督」或「總辦」），時荷蘭籍奈格（德·萊克）簽約成為該局總工程師，辜在致信愛丁堡校友骆任廷時直言，奈格入職一事為辜「自從擔任上海的這一職位以來」唯一滿意的一件事。1908年宣统即位，辜任外交部侍郎，1910年，他辞去外交部职务，赴上海任南洋公学教务长。1911年辛亥革命后，辜辞去公职，1915年在北京大学任教授，主讲英国文学。其著作《中国的牛津运动》于1909年出版，《中国人的精神》（《春秋大义》）于1915年出版。
target_text: On November 11th, 1905, he was appointed Governor of the Hoang Pu River River River Bureau of Shanghai (the “supervisor” or the “head office”) when he signed the contract to become the director-general of the Bureau in Holland. After the 1911 Singhe Revolution, he resigned from public office and was a professor of English literature at Beijing University in 1915. source_text: 施密特被视为是亲华派，是德国与中国打交道最密切的政治家，这与他全面投入中国的事项有关。1960年代末70年代初，他以国防部长的身份周游中国，并成功会见毛泽东。当时，西方政客直接前往北京是不被接受的，而施密特自此开启了他在中国最重要的外交利益政策。在毛泽东去世后，施密特赢得了中国改革家邓小平的信任，两人谈论了1980年代的经济改革。即使后来施密特不再担任总理一职，中国仍然是他在外交政策方面最重要的兴趣，他与1987年至1989年担任中共总书记的政治家赵紫阳详细讨论了经济开放的风险。在施密特的政治生涯中，他并不在意西方对中国人权的关注，施密特认为，外交政策不应与价值观挂钩，而应以和平为基础。施密特的许多著作都在中国被翻译成中文，这使得他在中国的声誉良好，而在公开露面时，他始终表现出对中国方面的兴趣。在施密特逝世后，他获得中国官方和媒体的强大凭吊和慰问。《德国之声》对此评论，没有其他已故的外国人能像施密特那样在中国受到如此多的尊重。
target_text: Even after the death of Mao Zedong, Schmidt won the trust of China’s reformist Deng Xiaoping, who spoke about economic reforms in the 1980’s. Even though Schmidt was no longer a prime minister, China’s most important interest in foreign policy remained in China, and he discussed the risks of economic openness in detail with Zhao Yiyang, a politician who served as Secretary-General of China from 1987 to 1989.
title: 赫尔穆特·施密特

source_text: 他想为自己外交政策辩护，却屡次犯了严重的错误，反而使得外交关系更恶劣。最著名的例子，是他在1908年接受英国报章《每日电讯报》的访问。他想借此机会宣扬德英的友好关系。可是，他逞口舌之快，竟然冒犯英国、法国、俄国以及日本。他指出，德国人并不喜欢英国人、法俄两国曾煽动德国干预第二次布尔战争，以及德国的海军扩张是针对日本，而非英国。（他还讲了一句：“你们这些英国人真是疯了。”） 因为他这番激进的言论，连他的部下也噤若寒蝉。而威廉二世本人在此事之后几个月，都保持低调。比洛由于没有适当编辑并取舍当天访问的纪录，被威廉给辞退。
target_text: He tried to defend his foreign policy, but repeatedly made serious mistakes, making diplomatic relations worse. The most famous example was his interview with the British newspaper The Daily Telegraph in 1908. He wanted to take this opportunity to promote German-British friendship. But, by speaking quickly, he offended Britain, France, Russia, and Japan.
title: 威廉二世 (德国)

source_text: 威廉尝试缓和法国的复仇心理，但还是跟对英国的建立外交政策一样，最后都宣告失败，这是因为他实在缺乏随机应变的能力。1906年，第一次摩洛哥危機发生——他访问丹吉爾时，不经意地提出支持摩洛哥独立的言论，触怒了想在该地扩展势力范围的法国。所幸，外交官员表现出色，才成功在阿爾赫西拉斯會議上避免德国与法国及两者同盟正面交锋。
target_text: William tried to ease France’s feelings of revenge, but, like his foreign policy with the United Kingdom, he ended up failing because of his lack of capacity to react. In 1906, the first Moroccan crisis – when he visited Tangier, he inadvertently spoke in favour of Morocco’s independence – provoked France’s desire to expand its influence in the area.
title: 威廉二世 (德国)

source_text: 辞退俾斯麦以后，跟俄国签订《再保險條約》在1890年失效，威廉二世未积极与俄国洽谈如何延续该条约。这令德国失去俄国的支持，从此之后无法保证俄國在德法两国有冲突时会保持中立。威廉的性格和主张，让德国对于英法俄三国的外交政策始终摇摆不定。一方面，他坚持与奥匈帝国的同盟——1889年，他甚至向奥皇表示，只要奥国以任何理由出兵，德军也会全力支持，曾兼任奧地利陸軍元帥；此外，德国又与英国合作，甚至曾经想跟法俄两国组成强大的欧陆联盟─—威廉自认为在1905年与沙皇尼古拉二世会面后，就已经得到俄国的支持。
target_text: After his resignation from Bismarck, William II failed to actively negotiate with Russia for the continuation of the Reinsurance Agreement in 1890. This deprived Germany of Russia’s support, and since then there has been no guarantee that Russia will remain neutral in the event of a conflict between Germany and France. William’s character and claims keep Germany uncertain about the foreign policy of the three countries. On the one hand, he insisted on his alliance with the Austro-Hungarian Empire – even in 1889, he offered His Majesty the full support of the German army, who had served as military marshal of the Austrian Army for any reason whatsoever; and, on the other hand, Germany cooperated with the United Kingdom and even wanted to form a strong Euro-Land alliance with the two countries – William believed that he had received Russian support since his meeting with the Emperor Nicolas II in 1905.
title: 威廉二世 (德国)

source_text: 奥国向塞尔维亚发出最後通牒，塞尔维亚于7月26日表示，除了第六条以外，接受其他所有条款：塞尔维亚认为第六条条款违反了塞国的宪法规定，有损国家主权，所以拒绝接受此条款。威廉于7月28日赶回柏林。浏览过塞国的回应后，他回应：“非常好。情况比我想像的更好。奥国赢了道义上的胜利。既然赢了，就再没有任何开战理由了。奥地利外交大使Giesl其实应该安心留在贝尔格莱德。读过这份文件后，我不应该下达总动员的命令。”

William returned to Berlin on 28 July. After reading the State's response, he responded: “Better. The situation is better than I thought. The State won the moral victory.

source_text: 约翰·杰伊（，），出生于英屬美洲纽约省，是一位美国政治家、革命家、外交家和法学家，1783年《巴黎条约》的谈判者和签署者。在18世纪80年代的大部分时间里，他指导了美国的外交政策。他与本杰明·富兰克林和约翰·亚当斯一同出使法国、他是联邦党人的重要领袖，与亚历山大·汉密尔顿和詹姆斯·麦迪逊一起撰写了《联邦党人文集》。他从1789年到1795年出任美国首席大法官。1829年逝世于纽约威斯特徹斯特郡。
target_text: John Jay (,), born in British New York Department of the Americas, is an American politician, revolutionary, diplomat and jurist, negotiator and signatory of the 1783 Treaty of Paris. For most of the 1980s, he guided American foreign policy. Together with Benjamin Franklin and John Adams, he led France, an important leader of the federal party, and with Alexander Hamilton and James Madison, he wrote the Humanities of the Federal Party. He served as Chief Justice of the United States from 1789 to 1795. He died in Westchester County, New York, in 1829.
title: 约翰·杰伊

source_text:
早年
杰伊出生于纽约的一个富有的商人家庭和纽约市政府官员的荷兰后裔，杰伊的祖父奥古斯都·杰伊(Augustus Jay)和他的妹妹圣·杰伊(Saint Jay)从法国搬到了弗吉尼亚殖民地，然后又搬到了纽约，在那里他建立了一个成功的商业帝国。杰伊的父亲彼得·杰伊(Peter Jay)，1704年出生在纽约，成为一名富商，从事皮草、小麦、木材和其他商品的生意。他在国王学院（后来的哥伦比亚大学的前身）就读后与罗伯特·利文斯顿一起在纽约作律师。并加入了纽约通信委员会，在美国革命前组织反对英国政策。战争结束后，杰伊担任外交部长，根据《联邦政府条例》指导美国的外交政策。他还担任了临时国务卿。
target_text: Earlier in the year, Jay was born in New York of a rich businessman family and Dutch descendants of New York City government officials, and Jay’s grandfather Augustus Jay and his sister Saint Jay moved from France to the Virginia Colony, where he moved to New York, where he built a successful business empire. Jay’s father, Peter Jay, was born in New York in 1704 as a wealthy businessman in the business of fur, wheat, timber and other commodities. After studying at King’s College (later to Columbia University), he worked with Robert Livingston in New York. He joined the New York Communications Committee, which organized opposition to British policy before the United States revolution.
title: 约翰·杰伊

source_text:
美国革命
杰伊在纽约建立了名声，因此被选为第一次和第二次大陆会议的议员。这两次会议的内容是讨论美洲殖民地是否应该从英国独立。从1778年12月10日到1779年9月27日他被选为大陆会议的第五任主席。此后他成为美国革命最重要的外交官之一，1779年至1782年，担任驻西班牙大使。他说服西班牙为美国提供财政援助，他还调停促成了西班牙与法国之间的和平。
target_text: The American Revolution, Jay, established his reputation in New York, was elected as a member of the First and Second Continental Conferences. The two meetings were devoted to discussing whether the American colonies should be independent from Britain. From 10 December 1778 to 27 September 1779, he was elected as the fifth president of the Continental Conference. He became one of the most important diplomats of the American Revolution, the Ambassador to Spain from 1779 to 1782. He convinced Spain to provide financial assistance to the United States, and he brokered peace between Spain and France.
title: 约翰·杰伊

source_text:
但是《联邦条例》所规定的联邦政府实际上无法工作。杰伊、汉密尔顿和麦迪逊称为章程的批评人。杰伊认为章程中规定的政府太软弱，无法有效地实行政府工作。他考虑道：
联邦条例规定国会有权宣战，但却无权征募士兵或金钱来维持作战的需要；它有权议和，但却无权控制和平条约的满足；它有权结盟，却无权完成联盟的义务；它有权签署贸易条约，却无权在国内外遵守条约。一句话，它可以顾问、劝告、要求和请求。谁愿意可以去理会它。
target_text: But the federal government, as provided for in the Federal Regulations, is practically unable to work. Jay, Hamilton and Madison are called critics of the statutes. Jay believes that the government provided for in the statutes is too weak to be effective in government. He considers that: the federal regulations provide that Congress has the power to declare war, but not to recruit soldiers or money to sustain its needs; it has the power to negotiate and control the satisfaction of peace treaties; it has the right to associate, but it has the right to fulfil its obligations; it has the right to sign trade treaties, but it does not have the right to comply with them at home or abroad. In a word, it can consult, advise, demand and request.
title: 约翰·杰伊

source_text: 1794年杰伊作为特使前往英国来商议避免战争的新条约。这个条约后来被称为杰伊条约。杰伊本人和美国政府都认为这是当时能够达成的最好的条约了。华盛顿和国会（持保留态度并要求修改后）签署了这个条约，虽然如此许多人反对这个条约，使得杰伊也非常不受欢迎。杰伊有一次说他可以藉着焚烧他的肖像的光从波士頓去费城。这个条约显然也使杰伊被选为美国总统的可能性消失了。
target_text: In 1794, Jay travelled to England as Special Envoy to negotiate a new treaty to avoid war. This treaty was later called the Jay Treaty.
title: 约翰·杰伊

source_text: 法国人在那不勒斯的所作所为又把他们如来时一样神速的赶出了意大利：土地和官职都归了法国人，支持他们的当地安茹派并没有获得比阿拉贡派更好的处境，因此愤愤不平；供应久缺，行政腐败，占领军的残暴肮脏恶名远扬。查理八世于1495年5月20日率法军主力离开那不勒斯，留下吉尔伯·德·蒙庞西埃担任总督。此时，各地已发生起义，不久斐迪南多二世和费代里戈便成为他们的首领。他们偷渡入境，以西西里岛作为重新收复意大利半岛本土的根据地。阿拉贡的天主教国王费迪南德决心阻止法国在那不勒斯建立统治。他的军队由天才名将贡萨洛指挥，在西西里集结待命。他又通过外交手段将对法国迅速坐大感到震惊的各派势力结合成第一次反法神圣同盟(因签订《威尼斯条约》又称“威尼斯同盟”)。该同盟于1495年3月31日订立，缔约各方有罗马教宗、神圣罗马帝国皇帝、西班牙、威尼斯和米兰。表面条款上看，这个同盟于过去意大利各国间维护和平的各种协定并无二至，但这个包括了神圣罗马帝国和西班牙的同盟实质上已经说明，意大利不能再控制自己的命运。
target_text: On May 20, 1495, Charles VIII led the French army to leave Naples, leaving Gilbert de Monponsié as governor. At that time, when the land and official positions were handed over to the French, the pro-Fedinando II and Federigo became their leaders shortly after. They smuggled into the country, using the island of Sicily as a base for the restoration of the Italian peninsula. The Catholic King of Aragon, Ferdinand, resolved to prevent France from establishing its rule in Naples. His army was commanded by a genius, Gonzalo, assembled in Sicily.
title: 意大利战争

source_text: 路易十二既得米兰，下一个目标就指向那不勒斯。费代里戈提出将那不勒斯王国作为法国采邑，自己成为路易的附庸（此前在理论上说，教皇对那不勒斯享有宗主权）；路易十二本应明智的接受这个建议，但是他却宁愿采取1500年格拉纳达条约所议定的冒险方针，即与西班牙国王费迪南德联手征服并瓜分这个王国。费代里戈直到入侵开始前还不知道这桩买卖，对他的求援，费迪南德和贡萨洛始终置之不理。他只得仓促于土耳其结盟。这正是费迪南德等待着的借口。法西两国同时进兵，费代里戈知道大势已去，在法军占领并洗劫卡普亚后，便向路易投降，宁可相信公开的敌人，也不相信出卖他的亲戚了。他受到宽大对待，被送往法国并授予安茹公国，以补偿他失去的王国。这样，路易拥有那不勒斯的北半部，费迪南德则占据了阿普里亚和卡拉布里亚。
target_text: Louis XII received Milan, and his next goal was to divide the kingdom to Naples. Federigo offered to use the Naples Kingdom as a French pick-up, and he himself became an accessory to Louis (previously theoretically, the Pope had great sovereignty over Naples); Louis XII was wise to accept the proposal, but he preferred the adventurous approach agreed upon in the Treaty of Granada of 1500, which was to surrender to Louis after the French occupation and the looting of Capua, instead of believing in the open enemy and selling his relatives. He was treated in a generous manner, was sent to France, and was given credit for his loss of the kingdom. That is the pretext that Ferdinand was waiting for the two countries to join forces.
title: 意大利战争

source_text: 除去法国和西班牙两国以外，克雷皮合约在其他地区所收到的反响普遍是负面的，奥斯曼帝国的苏莱曼大帝将法国的背弃看作可耻的背叛，法国王太子亨利因为条约有利于自己的弟弟查理而心生嫉妒，他与父亲的关系降至冰点，英王亨利八世并未参与该次和谈，他在围困滨海布洛涅时方才得知查理五世已与法王单独议和，亨利八世对于查理五世背弃盟约的行为大为光火，这一事件也进一步加剧了二人之间的嫌隙。而后亨利八世尝试于加莱与法王弗朗索瓦一世议和，未果，亨利不愿放弃已经攻下的滨海布洛涅，弗朗索瓦也拒绝结束对于苏格兰的经济与军事支持，双方不欢而散。而后法国一度派遣军队登陆苏格兰与英格兰的怀特岛，但前者因遭受风暴而未获成效，后者则因崎岖的地形同样宣告失败。双方海军也在索伦特海峡发生摩擦，未产生决定性结果。1546年筋疲力尽的双方终于签订非决定性的《阿尔德尔条约》草草收场。查理五世的弟弟斐迪南和神圣罗马帝国并未被包括于和谈之中，他将領導奧地利軍隊，繼續在東方與土耳其軍交戰（挽救西軍在1541年北非遠征失敗後的劣勢）。
target_text: Apart from France and Spain, the resonance of the Crepe contract in other regions was generally negative, with King Suleiman of the Ottoman Empire treating France’s renegade as shameful betrayal, with Prince Henry being jealous of the treaty’s favour for his brother, Charlie, his relationship with his father falling to an ice point, and King Henry VIII’s refusal to end his economic and military support for Scotland, which he did not take part in. It was only when he was besieged that Charles V was alone with the King of France, and Henry VIII’s failure on Charles V’s breach of the pact was greatly exacerbated by the storm, and the latter’s failure on the ground.
title: 意大利战争

source_text: 查理五世的欧洲霸权计划失败，正在兴起的近代欧洲民族国家如法国、英国等国的主权地位得到进一步加强。查理五世的七零八落的帝国所面临的是法国这样的领土和政治基本统一的民族国家与中央集权国家，这些国家的社会各组成部分已围绕经济、政治和民族利益而基本团结起来，初步形成了民族意识，反对外来威胁，并在此过程中进一步增强了作为主权国家的凝聚力。与此同时，德意志新教诸侯反对皇帝的斗争已带有明显的民族主义感情，这种民族感情与法、英等国的正在兴起的民族主义互相影响，促使欧洲国家独立和主权地位的逐渐增强，推动欧洲国家间关系进一步朝着多极化方向发展，而不再是走向统一或帝国的方向，西欧大国间开始形成一种政治均势。法国等欧洲国家和新教诸侯意识到，欧洲大陆不能是一个只有一个大国居于主宰地位的政治结构，虽然佛朗西斯一世及其同时代的君主并没有在理论上阐述均势的原则，但却在反对查理五世的战争中大力推行并实践着这种政策，这对后世的影响是巨大而深远的。
target_text: At the same time, the German neo-Chancellor’s struggle against the Emperor has gained a clear sense of nationalism, which interacts with the emerging nationalism of countries such as France and Britain, which has led to the gradual strengthening of the independence and sovereign status of European countries, the further development of European inter-State relations in a multipolar direction, rather than in the direction of unification or empire, and which has begun to develop a political balance among the major Western European countries. European countries, such as France, and the Protestants, have realized that the European continent cannot be a dominant political structure, although France and its contemporary monarchies are not theoretically speaking of the principle of parity, but have vigorously pursued and practised such policies in the war against Charles V.
title: 意大利战争

source_text: 战争推广了意大利城邦国家体系的那种常设外交代表制度，从而开始将欧洲各国纳入一种多边国际政治结构。随着意大利战争的展开，欧洲各国间逐渐采纳意大利城邦国家体系的常设外交代表制度，意大利城邦与欧洲国家之间、欧洲主要国家之间通过常驻外交代表进行经常性联系的做法普遍化了。到战争的第二年，威尼斯向欧洲大国全都派遣了大使，佛罗伦萨在法国和西班牙有它的常驻代表，连一向惟我独尊的教皇国也先后向奥地利、西班牙、法国和威尼斯派遣了大使。就欧洲主要国家而言，1495年《威尼斯条约》后，西班牙率先扩大外交机构，相继向威尼斯、米兰、英国、奥地利派遣了常驻大使；奥地利先后在罗马、威尼斯、米兰、马德里、伦敦有了常驻代表；法国向教皇国、威尼斯和米兰派遣了大使，它对其他国家兴趣不大，如英王亨利八世曾在1514年建议英法互换大使，但直到1518年法王弗朗索瓦一世才予同意 ，因为此时的法国需要借助英国来抗衡西班牙和奥地利；英国从1505年起先后向奥地利、佛罗伦萨、米兰、尼德兰、法国和教皇国派遣了常驻大使。欧洲各国互派常驻外交代表，加强了彼此间的交流与联系，加深了相互了解，促成了许多谈判， 缩短了一些战争的过程，促使其相互关系开始成为一种多边的国际政治联系。
target_text: In the second year of the war, Venice sent ambassadors to all of the major European countries, France and Spain with its permanent representatives, and even my exclusive Pope sent ambassadors to Austria, Spain, France, and Venice. With respect to the major European countries, the Treaty of Venice of 1495, Spain took the lead in expanding the diplomatic service to include permanent contacts between Venice, Milan, Britain, and Austria through permanent diplomatic representatives.
title: 意大利战争

source_text: 1976年１月，圖瓦盧完全脫離吉爾伯島的管轄。1978年２月在倫敦舉行的一次會議最後所定獨立憲法，6月，图瓦卢实行自治。1978年10月1日，图瓦卢宣布独立，仍奉英国君主为国家元首，留在英联邦内，成為英聯邦特別成員。1979年，同美国签订友好条约（1983年9月生效），根據這一條約，美国放弃对图瓦卢南部四小島的领土要求，图瓦卢疆域確認。與中華民國建立外交關係。
target_text: Tuvalu was completely removed from the island of Gilbert in January 1976. An independent constitution was finally established in London in February 1978, and Tuvalu became self-governing in June. On October 1, 1978, Tuvalu declared independence and remained as head of state in the Commonwealth as a special member of the Commonwealth. In 1979, a treaty of friendship was signed with the United States (which came into force in September 1983), under which the United States waived its territorial claims on the four islands in the south of Tuvalu.

source_text: 马丁上任後，曾有意改善克里蒂安执政时期时就明显降温的加美外交关系，并继续在两国边境控制、难民申诉、防务，特别在阿富汗问题上与美国政府合作，还指派了经验丰富的自由党政客担任驻美大使。然而，2005年2月24日，加拿大外交部长宣布加拿大将不会加入美国的弹道导弹防御系统，同时马丁政府希望美国在其导弹飞越加拿大领空前征询加拿大的同意。当时的民意调查也显示，加拿大人反對参加美国的导弹防御计划。然而，马丁政府受到批评称其将加拿大和美国的关系越拉越远。马丁还曾经许诺每年将0.7%GDP投入到国际救援中去，但也因承诺未兑现而受到批评。马丁还提倡将G8扩大为由二十个国家组成的G20，并没有获得很大的成功。此外，马丁与中华人民共和国建立更紧密的关系。在2005年9月，中国国家主席胡锦涛对加拿大进行国事访问的时候，双方宣布加中建立战略伙伴关系。
target_text: However, on 24 February 2005, Canada’s Foreign Minister announced that Canada would not join the United States ballistic missile defence system, while Martin’s government hoped that the United States would agree before its missiles flew over Canadian airspace. source_text: 联合国教科文组织孔子扫盲奖（），简称孔子扫盲奖，是2005年联合国教科文组织第172届执行局会议上决定设立的扫盲奖项，根据《联合国教科文组织孔子扫盲奖章程》“奖励在从事农村成年人、辍学青年、尤其是妇女和女童的扫盲工作中表现突出的个人、政府或政府机构以及非政府组织（NGOs）所做的工作”由曲阜市人民政府每年出资150,000美元（按当期汇率以人民币出资），每年颁发一次，一次颁发两份，联合国教科文组织5个“扫盲奖”的每份奖金均为2万美元，2006年在联合国教科文组织巴黎总部首次颁发。
target_text: The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization ' s Confucius Literacy Award (UNESCO ' s Confucius Literacy Award) is a literacy award decided upon at the 172nd session of the UNESCO Executive Board in 2005. According to the UNESCO Charter of the Confucius Literacy Award, "Rewards for the work of individuals, governmental or governmental institutions and non-governmental organizations (NGOs) that are prominent in the literacy work of rural adults, out-of-school young people, especially women and girls", the Quaker City People ' s Government spends US$ 150,000 per year (funded at current rates in renminbi), awarded once a year and twice a prize of US$ 20,000 for each of the five UNESCO ' s Literacy Awards, which was awarded for the first time at UNESCO headquarters in Paris in 2006.
title: 孔子扫盲奖

source_text:

source_text: 微型国家（），有时也被称为“超小国家（）”，指的是国土面积和或人口数量皆非常小的主权国家。但是，国际法中并未明确定义这里的“国家”和“非常小”。 最近一些对于微型国家的定义更加侧重于确定与其规模和人口相关的定性特征，例如会将其部分主权（国防事务等）委托于较大国家。
target_text: Micro-States () – and sometimes referred to as “super-small states”) – refer to sovereign states with very small size and population. But there is no clear definition in international law of “states” and “very small” here. Some recent definitions of micro-States have focused more on identifying qualitative characteristics relevant to their size and population, for example, by entrusting part of their sovereignty (defence affairs, etc.) to larger countries.
title: 微型国家

source_text: 而还有一种说法则是将微型国家定义为“现代受保护国”。 按照学者杜米恩斯基在2004年所提出定义，“微型国家是现代受保护国，即主权国家单方面将某些主权部分委托给更大的国家，以换取对其政治和经济生存能力的良性保护，使其免受地理或人口的限制。” 采用这种方法可以限制微型国家的数量，并将它们与小国和自治区或属地区分开。 被理解为现代受保护国的微型国家案例包括列支敦士登、圣马力诺、摩纳哥、纽埃、安道尔、库克群岛和帕劳等国家。
target_text: This approach may limit the number of micro-States and separate them from small States and autonomous regions or regions. The case of micro-States understood as modern protected States includes Liechtenstein, San Marino, Monaco, Niue, Andorra, the Cook Islands and Palau.
title: 微型国家

source_text: 当今被承认为主权国家的最小政治实体是梵蒂冈。然而，国际法教授莫里斯·门德尔森（对将梵蒂冈定义为一个国家的资格提出了异议；他认为它不符合“国家地位的传统标准”，并且“梵蒂冈的特殊地位可能被认为是确保教皇可以自由行使其精神职能的一种手段，在这方面，它与国际组织的总部有点类似。”
target_text: The smallest political entity recognized today as a sovereign State is the Vatican. However, the professor of international law, Maurice Mendelsen (disputing on his qualification to define the Vatican as a State; which, in his view, does not meet the “traditional criteria of statehood” and “the special status of the Vatican may be seen as a means of ensuring that the Pope can freely exercise his spiritual functions, which is somewhat similar to that of the headquarters of international organizations”.
title: 微型国家

source_text:
微型国家与国际关系
微型国家通常依靠其他国家生存，因为它们的军事能力很小并且资源匮乏。这导致一些研究人员相信微型国家被迫从属于更大的国家，从而损害了它们的主权并降低了其独立性。 然而，研究表明，微型国家战略性地与其他国家建立了“保护人－附随者关系”。 这使他们能够将某些特权与最能促进其利益的国家进行交易。这方面的例子是那些建立避税港或在国际委员会中出售其支持以换取军事和经济支持的微型国家。
target_text: Micro-States and international relations Micro-States often depend on other countries for their survival because of their small military capabilities and scarce resources. This leads some researchers to believe that micro-States are forced to belong to larger countries, thereby undermining their sovereignty and reducing their independence.
title: 微型国家

聯邦主體分為6類：
48個州（，oblasti、單數，oblastʹ）—最常見的行政規劃，民選州長，輔以民選議會。通常以州府（行政中心，又是最大城市）命名。（包含主权争议的扎波羅熱州、赫爾松州）
24個共和国（，respubliki、單數，respublika）—名義上自治，擁有自己的憲法、總統和議會，也擁有地區語言的法律地位，但實際上聯邦政府擁有絕對主權。外交事務由聯邦政府負責，自治共和國是為某些少數民族而設。（包含主权争议的克里米亚共和国、盧甘斯克人民共和國、頓涅茨克人民共和國）
9個边疆区（，kraya、單數：，kray）—類似州但位置比較偏遠。
4個自治区（，avtonomnyye okruga、單數，avtonomnyy okrug）—自治程度比州高，但低於自治共和國。為以少數民族為主的地區而設。
3個联邦直辖市（，federalʹnyye goroda、單數，federalʹnyy gorod）。（包含主权争议的塞瓦斯托波爾）
1個自治州（，avtonomnaya oblast）

source_text: 1958年，中国文化部电影局打算和德国合作拍摄一部反映各国科学家到金星探险的科幻电影。经过研究，文化部决定派懂英文的金焰去德国拍片。在德的近两个月，金焰的胃病恶化，幸亏电影剧本改了两个月也没有改好，德国方面先让各国演员回国了。临别前，摄制组主任和副导演邀请他一起去德国百货商店购物。他希望买台录音机用于提高语言表达能力，因此很高兴地与他们去了百货商场。他挑选了一台功能齐全的录音机后，正准备付款，但售货员却告诉他已经有人为他付过款了。副导演解释说，“这是制片厂送给您的”。金焰婉言谢绝，但对方坚持要进地主之谊。无奈，金焰只能收下了礼物。为表示对他们的感谢，金焰选了一家高级酒店请他们两人一起吃了顿饭。之后，有人写信给中国大使馆，说金焰收受贿赂。大使馆写了封信给文化部，并让他代劳送到文化部。回到北京后，金焰第一件事就是把大使馆的信交给文化部，但没成想那是封数落他的罪证书。金焰由于劳累过度，胃大出血昏倒在酒店卫生间内。当时有人给秦怡发电报说金焰病危，让她速来北京。可金焰为了不让秦怡劳累，又发了电报说他明天就返沪。
target_text: In 1958, the Chinese Ministry of Culture ' s Film Bureau decided to cooperate with Germany in the production of a science-fiction film that reflected the presence of scientists in Venus. After studying, the Ministry decided to send a fully fledged recording machine to Germany, where it was prepared to pay for it. After almost two months in Germany, the film was made worse, thanks to the fact that the script had not changed for two months, the German side sent the country ' s actors back. Before leaving, the director of the film team and the deputy director asked him to go to Germany ' s mall. He wanted to buy a tape recorder to improve his ability to express his language, so he was pleased to go to the mall with them. After selecting a fully functioning tape recorder, the seller told him that he had already paid for it. The deputy director explained that "it was sent to you by the studio" but insisted that he would go to the owner ' s shop for the purpose of sending a message to the owner ' s home, but that it was a message to the owner ' s home, and that it was a message that it was a message that he had lost his head of the bomb.
title: 金焰

source_text:
维也纳会议期间
困难的地理位置、变换的战局、等待奥地利的援助、弗里德里希·奥古斯特一世犹豫不决的态度，使萨克森王国遭受厄运。早在1813年初，普俄签订同盟条约时，双方便约定：华沙公国大部分并入俄罗斯；普鲁士得到提尔西特条约后放弃的波兰领土，并吞并萨克森王国。普鲁士的目的是实现腓特烈大王企图吞并萨克森选侯国，却在七年战争结束后破灭的旧梦。莱比锡战役后，普俄没有与萨克森结盟的意图。弗里德里希·奥古斯特一世被普俄联军关押在柏林附近。
target_text: As early as 1813, when Russia signed the treaty of alliance, the two sides agreed that the Principality of Warsaw was largely integrated into Russia; that Prussia had given up the Polish territory after the Treaty of Tirsit and annexed the Kingdom of Saxony. The objective of Prussia was to achieve the old dream that King Petrius had tried to annex Saxony after seven years of war.
title: 弗里德里希·奥古斯特一世 (萨克森国王)

source_text: 2015年11月27日，郭飛雄據報被廣州天河區法院裁定，聚眾擾亂公共場所秩序、及尋釁滋事罪罪成，兩罪並罰，判囚6年。天河区法院还将刘远东判三年，孙德胜被判两年六个月。郭飞雄发表声明说：“这个判决是反正义、反法律的，是中国反民主的黑暗势力对我和孙德胜所作的卑劣的政治迫害。我们是完全无罪的。”美、加、英、德四國家大使馆外交官员都到法庭现场声援郭飞雄案，法院附近所有路口都有警察及便衣把守，並要求查看路人身份证。至2019年8月7日早上由广东英德监狱刑滿釋放。
target_text: On November 27, 2015, Kwok Fei-hung was reported to have been convicted by the Guangzhou Tianxi District Court of two counts and six years' imprisonment for the crime of mobilising the order of public places, and for the crime of sedition. The Tianhe District Court also sentenced Liu to three years' imprisonment and Sun De Win to two years and six months' imprisonment. Kwok Fei-hung stated: “This verdict is anti-justice, anti-law, and a despicable political persecution of me and Sun De Shing by China's anti-democratic dark forces.

source_text:
生平
生于法国的圣西尔万贝勒加德。1971年加入社会党。1974年从法国国立行政学院毕业后，先在文化部任特派员，后调到环境部任局长，一年后被调到外交部对外文化关系局担任中东问题协调人。1981年5月进入爱丽舍宫，与密特朗总统共事十年，先后任密特朗总统的外交顾问和总统府发言人。1993－1995年在“左右共处”时期任爱丽舍宫秘书长。1995年离开爱丽舍宫后，在一家专门处理国际纠纷的律师事务所担任律师。
target_text: Born in 1971 in the Socialist Party of Saint-Sylvan Belgader, France. Graduated from the French National School of Administration in 1974, he was appointed Special Representative in the Ministry of Culture, then as Director-General of the Ministry of the Environment, and, a year later, as coordinator of the Middle East issue in the Department of External Cultural Relations of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Entered the Palace of Elise in May 1981 to work with President Mitterrand for 10 years, serving as diplomatic adviser to President Mitterrand and spokesperson to the Office of the President. Secretary-General of the Palace of Elise in 1993-1995, during the period of “coexistence around” . After leaving the Palace of Elise in 1995, he worked as a lawyer at a law firm specializing in international disputes.
title: 于贝尔·韦德里纳

source_text: 上莱茵省是法国大革命期间，根据1789年12月22日的法律和1790年1月8日的条例，于1790年3月4日建立的。它北与下莱茵省，西与孚日省，以及西南与贝尔福地区省交界。同时，它的东侧沿莱茵河与德国，南侧与瑞士接壤。历史上，阿尔萨斯大部分地区曾经于1871年根据法兰克福条约被划归德国，留在法国的部分形成了贝尔福地区；1919年凡尔赛条约将其重新划归法国，但仍与贝尔福地区分离。
target_text: Upper Rhine was established on 4 March 1790, during the French Revolution, under the law of 22 December 1789 and the regulation of 8 January 1790. It is bordered on 4 March 1790 by the north by the lower Rhine, by the west by the south and by the south-west by the Belfort. It is bordered on the east by Germany on the Rhine and on the south by Switzerland. Historically, most of Alsace was transferred to Germany in 1871 under the Frankfurt Treaty and remained in France in the Belfort area; and it was reassigned to France by the Versailles Treaty of 1919, but is still separated from the Belfort region.
title: 上莱茵省

source_text: 乔治城大学共设立11所学院，包括文理学院、外交学院、法学院、商学院、医学院等。主校区距白宫西北面两英里左右，在政治学、国际关系学等学科成绩突出，乔治城大学沃尔什外交学院在外交领域享有盛誉，位列《外交杂志》国际关系院校排名全球榜首，设有21个全球研究中心，校友包括美国总统比尔·克林顿，西班牙国王费利佩六世和许多外交官。此外，该大学还有27人獲得罗德奖学金、36人獲得马歇尔奖学金、33人獲得杜鲁门奖学金。
target_text: George Town University has 11 colleges, including the Faculty of Arts and Science, the Diplomatic Academy, the Faculty of Law, the Faculty of Business, the Faculty of Medicine, and others. The main campus is about two miles north-west of the White House, with outstanding achievements in political science, international relations, etc. The University of George Town ' s Walsh School of Foreign Affairs is well known in the diplomatic field and ranks among the leading international relations institutes in the world, with 21 global research centres, alumni of which include the President of the United States, Bill Clinton, King Felipe VI of Spain, and many diplomats. In addition, the University has 27 scholarships, 36 Marshall scholarships, and 33 Truman scholarships.
title: 乔治城大学

source_text:
扩建时期
1870年法学院建立后，希利和他的继任者希望把各个专业学院联合起来组建成一所综合性大学，并使之专注于高等教育。1医学院于1901年增设牙科学院，与1903年增设颁发本科学位的护理和健康研究学院。1919年，乔治城预备校从校园中重新选址并于1927年和大学完全分离。1919年，外交学院由埃德蒙·A·沃尔什建立，以培养外贸和外交方面的领导人才。1957年，商学院和外交学院分离，并于1998年以罗伯特·E·麦克唐纳之名重新命名为麦克唐纳商学院。
target_text: After the establishment of the Faculty of Law in 1870, Healy and his successor wished to combine the various professional colleges into a comprehensive university, focusing on higher education.1 The College of Medicine established an additional College of Dental Sciences in 1901, together with the School of Nursing and Health Studies, which awarded this degree in 1903. In 1919, the Georgetown Preparatory School was re-established from its campus and completely separated from the University in 1927. In 1919, the Diplomatic Academy was established by Edmund A. Walsh to prepare leaders in foreign trade and diplomacy. In 1957, the College of Commerce and Diplomacy was separated and renamed the MacDonald Business School in the name of Robert E. MacDonald.
title: 乔治城大学

source_text: 当今教职员中包括美国哲学学会会长詹姆斯·J·奥唐纳、神学家约翰·霍特、社会活动家山姆·马鲁洛和范德布卢姆及知名嘻哈学者迈克尔·埃里克·戴森。许多前政治家也选择在乔治城教书，如美国前国务卿马德琳·奥尔布赖特、美国国际开发署前署长安德鲁·纳齐奥斯、国家安全事务顾问安东尼·雷克、中央情报总监（中央情报局局长）乔治·特尼特。在国际上，该学校吸引了不少其他国家的原大使和国家元首，如沙烏地阿拉伯大使图尔·基阿尔·费萨尔亲王、西班牙前首相何塞·玛丽亚·阿斯纳尔和哥伦比亚前总统阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦·贝莱斯。
target_text: Many former politicians have also chosen to teach in George Town, such as the former Secretary of State, Madeleine Albright, the former Administrator of the United States Agency for International Development, Andrew Natsios, the National Security Adviser, Anthony Lake, and the Director of Central Intelligence, George Tenet. At the international level, the school attracts former ambassadors and heads of state of other countries, such as Prince Tur Kiar Faysal, Saudi ambassador, José María Asnar, former Prime Minister of Spain, and former President Alvaro Uribe Beles, former President of Colombia.
title: 乔治城大学

source_text:
職業生涯
穆罕默德·巴拉迪於1962年在開羅大學取得法律學位，随后在日内瓦高级国际关系学院进修國際法，並於1974年於紐約大學法學院完成博士課程。他在1964年便在埃及的外交部開始職業生涯，曾兩度成為埃及駐聯合國的常駐代表。1984年開始出任國際原子能機構的要職，專責處理核安全與控制核武器擴散，1997年擔任該組織的總幹事，先後經歷了伊拉克、伊朗和朝鮮核危機的挑戰。2005年年初美國一度嫌巴拉迪對伊朗「太軟弱」欲攆走他，但9月的國際原子能機構第49屆大會通過對巴拉迪第三次的總幹事任命，新任期從同年12月1日開始，共4年，直至2009年正式卸任。
target_text: Mohamed ElBaradei obtained a law degree at the University of Cairo in 1962, then advanced international law at the Higher Institute of International Relations in Geneva, and completed a doctorate course at the Faculty of Law at the University of New York in 1974. He started his career in the Foreign Ministry in Egypt in 1964, and became a permanent representative of the United Nations in Egypt twice. In 1984, Mohamed ElBaradei began his post at the International Atomic Energy Agency to deal with nuclear safety and the spread of nuclear weapons, and in 1997 became the organization’s principal, after facing a nuclear crisis in Iraq, Iran, and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.
title: 穆罕默德·巴拉迪

source_text: 在伊朗核問題上，美國不斷指責伊朗，巴拉迪卻認為在沒有找到確鑿証據的情況下，應對伊核問題採取冷處理，反對對伊朗採取制裁措施。在巴拉迪的斡旋下，2003年12月，伊朗簽署了《不擴散核武器條約》附加議定書。在推動朝鮮半島無核化進程方面，巴拉迪希望通過外交途徑和平解決，一方面敦促朝鮮與國際原子能機構合作，一方面呼籲朝鮮在核試驗問題上保持透明度并及時向國際原子能機構通報。
target_text: In December 2003, Iran signed an additional protocol to the Non-Exploration of Nuclear Weapons Treaty. In moving forward with the nuclear non-nuclearization of the Korean peninsula, ElBaradei sought a peaceful diplomatic solution, urging Korea to cooperate with the International Atomic Energy Agency, while calling for transparency in the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s nuclear tests and timely reporting to the International Atomic Energy Agency.
title: 穆罕默德·巴拉迪

頭銜
蒙上帝及共和國恩典，英格蘭、蘇格蘭、愛爾蘭共和國護國公阁下萊茵邦聯拿破崙在1806年建立的萊茵邦聯也曾有類似的頭銜，自稱莱茵邦聯的護國主（，，1806-1813 年）。 这个头衔是由莱茵邦聯条约创造的，这是皇帝和一些德国親王之间的国际条约。条约文本只明确提到皇帝：
target_text: By the grace of God and the Republic, and by His Excellency the Lords of England, Scotland, Ireland, and the Republic of Ireland, the Union of the Rhine, founded by Napoleon in 1806, once had the same title as the Sovereign of the Confederation of the Rhine (1806-1813). This title was created by the Treaty of the Union of the Rhine, an international treaty between the Emperor and a number of German princes.
title: 护国公

source_text: 国际原子能机-{}-构（，縮寫作 ），港台译为國際原子能總-{}-署，是致力于和平发展原子能的独立政府间国际组织，成立於1957年7月29日，总部位于中立国奥地利首都维也纳。国际原子能机构是与联合国系统相关的独立国际组织，其与联合国的关系由特殊协议监管，每年需向联合国大会进行报告。
target_text: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is an independent intergovernmental organization dedicated to the peaceful development of atomic energy, established on 29 July 1957 in Vienna, the capital of the neutral country. The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is an independent international organization associated with the United Nations system whose relationship with the United Nations is governed by special agreements and is required to report annually to the United Nations General Assembly.
title: 国际原子能机构

source_text: 1954年9月23日，美国国务卿约翰·福斯特·杜勒斯在第九届联合国大会上发表讲话，决定推进国际原子能机构的建立，欢迎各国加入，并同时向联大提交报告，要求在会议日程中增加有关推进和平利用原子能的国际合作项目。次日，苏联和英国对美国提出的要求表示支持，并决定于同年11月5日在联大第一委员会中进行推进讨论。同年12月，第九届联合国大会通过决议，要求成立一个专门致力于和平利用原子能的国际机构。
target_text: On 23 September 1954, the United States Secretary of State, John Foster Durers, addressed the ninth session of the United Nations General Assembly and decided to promote the establishment of the International Atomic Energy Agency, to welcome the accession of all States and to submit a report to the General Assembly calling for the inclusion in the agenda of the Conference of an international cooperation project on the promotion of the peaceful uses of atomic energy. The following day, the Soviet Union and the United Kingdom expressed their support for the United States request and decided to hold further discussions in the First Committee of the General Assembly on 5 November of the same year. In December of the same year, the ninth session of the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution calling for the establishment of an international body dedicated to the peaceful uses of atomic energy.
title: 国际原子能机构

source_text:
初步准备
1814年的《休蒙条约》重申了将在1814-1815年召开的维也纳会议中被正式批准的决定。这些决定包括在德意志建立邦联，将意大利分割为多个独立国家，使波旁王朝重掌西班牙，以及扩大荷兰的领土，使之包括现今的比利时。《休蒙条约》成为了欧洲联盟的奠基石，打造了持续数十年的欧洲权力均衡。其他决定则在《巴黎条约》和《基尔条约》（涉及斯堪的纳维亚问题）中已经涉及。《巴黎条约》中议定应当在维也纳召开一次“大会”，并将邀请“双方一切参与战争的列强”。会议的开幕时间定为1814年7月。
target_text: The initial preparations for the 1814 Houston Treaty reaffirmed the decisions to be formally ratified at the Vienna Conference to be held in 1814-1815. These decisions included the creation of a German union, the division of Italy into an independent State, the reincarnation of the Bourbon dynasty over Spain, and the extension of the territory of the Netherlands to the present-day Belgium. The Houston Treaty became the cornerstone of the European Union, creating a decades-long balance of power in Europe. Other decisions were addressed in the Paris and Stockholm treaties (on Scandinavia). The Paris Treaty agreed that a “General Assembly” should be held in Vienna and invited “all the Powers involved in the war” to open the Conference in July 1814.
title: 维也纳会议

source_text: 四大反法同盟成員和波旁法国四大列强在先前是第六次反法同盟的中坚力量。在拿破仑战败前夕，列强便已在《休蒙条约》（1814年3月）中确定了共同的立场，并在波旁复辟期间与波旁法国订立了《巴黎条约》：奥地利帝国的代表是其外相梅特涅亲王和他的副手约翰·冯·维森堡男爵。由于会议在维也纳召开，日耳曼邦聯主席弗朗茨一世紧密关注会议的进展。英国的代表最先是其外交大臣卡斯尔雷子爵，在1815年2月卡斯尔雷回国之后则更换为威灵顿公爵。在百日王朝期间威灵顿公爵离开前去同拿破仑作战，代表换为克兰卡蒂伯爵。俄罗斯帝国皇帝亚历山大一世是当时欧洲最有权势的君主，他的代表团由外交大臣卡尔·罗伯特·内塞尔罗德伯爵带领。皇帝的主要目标有二，分别是夺取波兰和推动欧洲各国的和平共处。他成功地建立了1815年的神圣同盟，这一同盟名义上是以基督教之爱为基础建立，实际上则是为了抵抗革命和共和主义。普鲁士的代表是总理卡尔·奥古斯特·冯·哈登堡亲王，以及外交官和学者威廉·冯·洪堡。普鲁士国王腓特烈·威廉三世本人也身在维也纳，在幕后进行活动。作为法國正統代言人的波旁王朝由外交大臣塔列朗和全权公使达尔贝格公爵代表。
target_text: On the eve of Napoleon’s defeat, the Powers established a common position in the Houston Treaty (March 1814) and concluded the Paris Pact with Bourbon France during the resumed period: the Austrian Empire was represented by its Foreign Minister, Prince Maitne, and his deputy, Baron John von Wiesenberg. As a result of the meeting in Vienna, the President of the German Union, Franz I, followed closely the progress of the Conference. The British representative was first Foreign Secretary, Lord Castle, who, after his return in February 1815, was replaced as Duke of Wellington.
title: 维也纳会议

source_text:
1814年巴黎条约的其他签订者
下列国家没有参加休蒙的会议，但参加了《巴黎条约》的商定：
西班牙 – 佩德罗·戈麦斯·拉布拉多，拉布拉多侯爵
葡萄牙和阿尔加夫王国 – 佩德罗·德·索萨·荷尔斯泰因，帕尔梅拉公爵；安东尼奥·德·萨尔达尼亚·达·伽马，圣港伯爵；乔吉姆·罗博·席尔维拉，奥里奥拉伯爵
瑞典-挪威 – 卡尔·勒文赫尔姆伯爵
target_text: Other signatories of the 1814 Paris Treaty did not participate in the meeting in Houston, but the following States participated in the agreement of the Paris Treaty: Spain - Pedro Gómez Labrador, Marquis de Labrador - Portugal and the Kingdom of Algaf - Pedro de Sosa Horstein, Duke of Palmera; Antonio de Saldania da Gama, Count of Port Saints; Jojim Robo Silva, Count of Oriola - Norway - Count of Carl Levenheim
title: 维也纳会议

source_text: 美国采取了多项措施制裁“流氓国家”，例如对伊朗、利比亚、古巴、苏丹、阿富汗等采取严厉的经济制裁。1991年海湾战争后，美国在伊拉克禁飞区布置了空中力量，禁飞区内禁止伊拉克飞机飞行，以此制裁伊拉克，迫使其遵守联合国安理会687号决议（裁军）和688号决议（保护库尔德人的人权）。1998年，为打击报复基地组织爆炸袭击美国驻坦桑尼亚大使馆和驻肯尼亚大使馆，美国实行了无限延伸行动，向阿富汗和苏丹发射导弹。1999年，北约轰炸南斯拉夫，作为对南斯拉夫军队镇压科索沃阿尔巴尼亚人分离势力的回应。
target_text: The United States has taken a number of measures to sanction “rogue countries,” such as severe economic sanctions against Iran, Libya, Cuba, the Sudan, Afghanistan, etc.. Following the 1991 Gulf War, the United States placed air forces in Iraq's no-fly zones and banned Iraqi aircraft, thereby sanctioning Iraq and forcing it to comply with United Nations Security Council resolutions 687 (Disarmament) and 688 (Protection of the human rights of Kurds). In 1998, in retaliation for the Al-Qaida bombings against the United States Embassy in Tanzania and the Embassy in Kenya, the United States carried out an indefinite extension operation to fire missiles against Afghanistan and the Sudan. In 1999, NATO bombed Yugoslavia as a response to the Yugoslav army's repression of the Kosovo Albanian separatist forces.
title: 流氓國家

source_text: 2006年，利比亚与美国的外交关系取得进展，美国将利比亚从支持恐怖主义的国家名单中移除。2015年，美国重开驻古巴大使馆，再次与古巴政府建立外交关系，美国随即将古巴从支持恐怖主义的国家名单中移除，后来再也没有称呼古巴为“流氓国家”。特朗普上台后，由于委内瑞拉政府侵犯人权、经济崩溃及人口过度死亡、反美立场以及参与国际贩毒，又将其标为“流氓国家”。
target_text: In 2006, Libya made progress in its diplomatic relations with the United States, which removed it from the list of countries that support terrorism. In 2015, when the United States reopened its embassy in Cuba and established diplomatic relations with the Cuban Government, the United States immediately removed Cuba from the list of countries that support terrorism and did not call Cuba a “rogue State” after it came to power.
title: 流氓國家

source_text:
沿革
1947年，以「國立臺灣大學附設留用日僑子女教育班」之名的中小學部在台北市溫州街成立，並開始招收學生。
1949年，關閉中學部。
1951年，移轉至國立臺灣大學校園内（今台北市大安區羅斯福路）。
1953年，重新開設中學部，並改稱「台北日本人小・中學校」。更名「台北日本人中小學」。
1958年，中學部再度關閉。
1959年，搬遷至臺北市廈門街99巷34号，校名改稱「台北日本人小學」。
1963年，搬遷至臺北市敦化南路369巷3號。
1965年，校名改為「在中華民國日本國大使館附屬台北日本人小學校」。
1968年，開辦中學，校名又改名為「在中華民國日本国大使館附屬台北日本人學校」。
1969年，校區遷移至臺北市松山區福德街151巷12號。
1972年，日本與中華民國斷交後，名稱改為「臺北日本人學校」。
1973年，校名改為「私立台北市日僑學校」。
1976年，小林亞星完成學校校旗與校歌。
1977年：臺中校區成立。
1983年：校區遷移台北市士林區中山北路6段785號現址。
2020年：於現址重建新校舍。
2022年：新校舍啟用。
target_text: In 1947, the Middle and Middle Schools Department, under the name of "The Japanese Children's Education Programme at the National University of Taiwan" was established and began recruiting students. In 1949, the Secondary and Secondary Departments were closed down on Winzhou Street in Taipei. In 1951, it was transferred to the National University campus in Taiwan (Rosford Road, Taiwan City). In 1953, the secondary and secondary departments were reopened and renamed the "Taiwan Japanese Small and Middle School" . In 1958, the secondary school was re-opened on the name of the "Taiwan Middle and Middle School for Japanese Children" and was re-opened on the name of the "Taibei Secondary School" . In 1959, the secondary school moved to 34th Street in the capital city of Taipei, where the school was renamed the "Taibei Little School" .
title: 台北市日僑學校

source_text: 中華民國護照是中華民國外交部所核發的護照 ，申請資格為具有中華民國國籍者。大陸地區人民、香港居民、澳門居民在轉換身分為臺灣地區人民之前不適用護照條例，除經中華民國外交部等主管機關認為有特殊考量及持用中華民國護照之必要之申請資格外，原則上不予核發，中華民國護照與加簽之核發與執行由外交部領事事務局掌理，中華民國護照由外交部、駐外使領館、代表處、或辦事處（以下簡稱駐外館處）負責簽發。
target_text: Chinese passports are issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China, which has the status of a citizen of the People’s Republic of China. People of China, Hong Kong residents, and Macao residents are not eligible to apply for passports until they have changed their status to the people of the Gulf, except for requests from competent agencies such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China for special consideration and necessary applications to use China’s nationality passports, which have not been approved, and the issuance and execution of China’s passports and signatures by the Office of the Superintendent of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China, which is under the authority of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, foreign embassies, representatives, or offices (hereinafter referred to as the Foreign Office).
title: 中華民國護照

source_text: 1929年，在允許雙重國籍及出籍從嚴、復籍從寬的原則下，國民政府公佈了《護照條例》和辦理華僑登記。此兩措施，皆為將中華民國護照法制化之準備。其相關條例有《外交部編製外交統計圖表規則》，利用統計數字，來控管「出洋護照」數量，同年12月30日又陸續公佈《外交部頒發出國護照暫行辦法》和《外交部駐外使領館發給回國護照及簽證外人來華護照暫行條例》。其中，《外交部頒發出國護照暫行辦法》將出國護照分為「外交護照」、「官員護照」和「普通護照」3種。其中，以華僑、留學生適用的普通護照，最為普遍通行。規定有需出具2間商家保証且到達國外目的地後須向當地中華民國使領館呈驗護照以便登記、1年期滿後，需向當地中華民國使領館呈銷舊照換新照的規定。1930年，該辦法再度放寬，除了放寬國籍限制外，也將1年護照驗證期限延至3－5年，甚至視護照種類大幅度放寬（華僑護照即可放寬至10年）。
target_text: In 1929, under the principle of dual citizenship and dual citizenship, the National Government published the Passport Regulations and the Charter of Immigration. Both measures are intended to legalize the granting of passports to Chinese nationals. The relevant regulations are the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Regulations for the Development of Foreign National Accounts, which use statistics to control the number of "exceeding passports" and the issuance on 30 December of the same year of the Foreign Ministry's Interim Measures for the Distribution of National Passports, and the Foreign Ministry's Embassies for the Return of National Passports and Visas to Foreign Nationals. In addition, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued the Interim Rules for the Distribution of National Passports to China.
title: 中華民國護照

source_text: 1940年代，國民政府雖因中日戰爭影響，1948年正式行憲後改組的中華民國政府，又面對國共戰爭等-{干}-擾，仍致力於護照制度正常化。1944年7月22日，位於重慶的國民政府頒發公佈《出國護照條例》，條例中規定護照之申請、核發、制定及管理，由中華民國外交部負責，並加入國際慣例的不得扣留、護照種類（外交護照、公務護照及普通護照）等規定。另外，發放機關制定上，中華民國外交護照及公務護照，由中華民國外交部核發，普通護照，由中華民國外交部或駐外大使館、領事館及其他外交部授權機構核發。此項達17條的條文，已是相當完備的護照基礎規範。
target_text: In the 1940s, despite the effects of the Chinese-Japanese war, the Chinese government, which was replaced by the Constitution in 1948, continued to work towards normalizing the system of passports. On July 22, 1944, the Government of China, which was in the process of celebrating, issued the Regulations on Passports and Passports, issued by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, issued by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs and approved by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, or by the foreign embassies, consulates and other foreign ministries.
title: 中華民國護照

source_text: 2003年6月12日外交部舉行記者會，正式宣布加註「TAIWAN」字樣之護照自2003年9月1日起發行。陳水扁政府決定在封面國徽和「護照」二字之間加入「TAIWAN」字樣，目的在於顯示中華民國與中華人民共和國的不同，使臺灣旅客在國外時不致被誤認為中華人民共和國籍，以免被錯認為不適用免簽證待遇致登機受阻，使持護照的中華民國國民能清楚地向各國海關說明自己是來自臺灣而非中國大陸，以避免遭到禁止入境或於國外時因遭誤認為中華人民共和國人民而惹來麻煩困擾。政府稱措施目的在於便民，但引來泛藍陣營強力批判，同時也導致抵制預算審查。立法委員周錫瑋質疑，加註「臺灣」字眼將引發意識形態對立，同時勢必會讓對岸視為是一種不友善的舉動；立法委員馮滬祥批評說，此舉無異不顧臺灣安危，將害死臺灣；並呼籲在野聯盟應群起抗議，並以行動否決此案。以美國為基地的臺灣獨立運動團體「正綠社」的陳姓顧問更抨擊，此舉非但不是走向臺灣獨立，反而是走回20世紀初期「殖民地護照」的老路；他還質問，如果此舉如此重要，長年在外的外交使節持有的外交護照是否應該更早完成更換。外交部長簡又新說明，護照加註台灣字樣主要是為了讓國人在海外旅遊時方便，避免被誤解或混淆為中華人民共和國護照的持有人，這只是一項行政措施，外界不必有過度的政治解讀。
target_text: On June 12, 2003, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs held a press conference in which it officially announced that the passport had been issued as of September 1 2003 and that the passport had been issued under the symbol "TAIWAN". Chen Shui-bian government decided to add the name "TAIWAN" between the seal and the "passport" in order to show the difference between the Chinese and the Chinese People's Republic of China, so that Taiwan tourists outside the country would not be mistaken for the Republic of China's Republic of China, so that it would be wrong to believe that it would be inappropriate to use a visa-free visa to block the boarding of the plane, so that the people of the Chinese People's Republic of China could clearly say that they were from Taiwan, not China, that they were from China, in order to avoid being harassed by the ban on entry or the people of China outside the country.
title: 中華民國護照

source_text: 2017年12月18日，外交部宣布將現有的晶片護照改版為第二代，除護照內頁圖案設計大幅度更新外，還增加「持照人第三影像」、「金屬化表面凸起」等防偽設計，於12月25日啟用。2017年12月25日，外交部領事事務局開放民眾換發第二代護照，但其中一張內頁照片誤植為華盛頓杜勒斯機場。2018年2月5日，外交部重新發行修正後的二代晶片護照。
target_text: On December 18, 2017, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it would change the current chip passport to a second generation, adding, in addition to the substantial updating of the passport's internal page design, a number of security devices, such as the third image of the holder, and the "meta-meta-curved surface," to be introduced on December 25th. On December 25, 2017, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Department of the Presidency opened a second-generation passport for the people, but one of the internal pages was wrongly installed at the Dulls airport in Washington, D.C. On February 5, 2018, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs reissued a second-generation chip passport.
title: 中華民國護照

source_text:
外交護照
封面英文名稱為DIPLOMATIC PASSPORT，表皮為深藍色。適用對象如下：
外交、領事人員與眷屬及駐外使領館、代表處、辦事處主管之隨從。
中央政府派往國外負有外交性質任務之人員與其眷屬及經核准之隨從。
外交公文專差。
上述所稱眷屬，以配偶、父母及未婚子女為限。
target_text: Diplomatic passports are covered in English by the name of DIPLOMATIC PASSPORT, which is dark blue. The following are suitable examples: Foreign Affairs, Consuls, and Family and Directors of Foreign Missions, Representations, Offices, and Offices.

source_text: 2020年9月2日，外交部宣布將於2021年1月發行提升台灣辨識度的新版護照，保留現行版本的元素及架構，包括中華民國、REPUBLIC OF CHINA、國徽、TAIWAN、護照、PASSPORT，以及顏色不變，主要仍是以凸顯台灣辨識度為原則。並放大「TAIWAN」字樣並將「TAIWAN」及「PASSPORT」字樣緊鄰，強調為「台灣的護照」，清楚且容易辨別。而英文正式國名「REPUBLIC OF CHINA」環繞於國徽外圈，維持尊崇性，更增添設計感。2020年11月30日，外交部領事事務局宣布提升台灣辨識度的新版護照將於2021年1月11日正式開放換發。
target_text: On September 2, 2020, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it would issue a new passport to raise the visibility of Taiwan in January 2021, keeping the elements and structures of the current version, including the Chinese People’s Republic, the REPUBLIC OF CHINA, the State emblem, TAIWAN, the Passport, PASSPORT, and the same color, mainly based on the recognition of the Gulf. On November 30, 2020, the Ministry’s Department of Foreign Affairs announced that a new edition of the TAIWAN and PASSPORT would be officially launched on 11 January 2021 to raise the profile of the Taiwan State.

source_text:
護照遺失時之處理方式
遺失補發之護照，主管機關及駐外館處得縮短其效期。其-{程序}-是：
於國內遺失時：需立即持身分證明文件親自向遺失地或戶籍地警察局分局刑事組報案，之後提具警察機關核發的護照遺失作廢申報表及申請護照應備文件向外交部領事事務局或外交部各辦事處申請補發。
於國外遺失時：需提具當地警察機關遺失報案證明文件及其他申請護照應備文件向鄰近我駐外館處申請補發。
target_text: In the event of a loss of passport, the competent administrative authority and a foreign office have a shorter period of service. The procedure is: In the event of a loss in the country: an identity document must be submitted to the criminal division of the local police station in the event of a loss of residence or residence, and a copy of the document containing the missing passport issued by the police authority should be submitted to the diplomatic department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or to the offices of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

source_text: 12月26日晚，外交部召开记者会，承认用错图片并向公众道歉，同时联系中央印制厂重新印制，并延后签发新版护照。至于已签发的护照，外交部会联系民众免费更换。27日外交部领事事务局长陈华玉自请处分，降为外交部参事但後續又將前任領務局長龔中誠（已經在一年多前轉任駐加拿大代表）調職，其喊冤說早就離開職務一年多，連新護照都沒看過，造成有媒體質疑是民進黨藉機搞政治鬥爭清除不同立場的公務員。
target_text: On the evening of December 26, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs convened a press conference to acknowledge the use of the wrong images and apologize to the public, and contacted the central printing plant to reprint and postpone the issuance of a new version of the passport. As for the passports issued, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs contacted the people to change it free of charge. On 27 December, the Director of Consular Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Chen Huayu, took his own initiative and was downgraded to the Councillor of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, but subsequently transferred the former Director General of the Department (who had been appointed representative of Canada more than a year ago) to the post, complaining that he had left his post for more than a year, and that the new passport had not been seen, causing media to suspect that it was the PM’s political campaign to clear the various sides.

source_text: 2018年1月24日，外交部宣布将用贴防伪贴纸的方式，蓋住护照内页“注意事项”页原本誤植的杜勒斯機場主建築，并在该页加注过去护照上未曾印制过的旅游安全宣导事项，而该贴纸預計1月底到2月初正式發行。外交部還表示“加贴贴纸不影响护照效力，民眾出國不會有疑慮”，但严格来说，世界各地出入境机关审查护照标准不一，出入境工作人员可能不承认这一防伪贴纸，因此台湾民众凭贴有防伪贴纸的护照进入其他国家或地区，可能会遭到入境受阻。而今后印刷的护照的第4、5頁，则使用桃园机场的照片。
target_text: On 24 January 2018, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it would cover the main building of the Dulles airport, which had been wrongly planted on the “notes” page of the passport, in a way that was not printed in the previous passport, and that the bill was officially issued by the end of January and early February. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs also stated that “the sticker does not affect the validity of the passport, and the population does not have doubts about leaving the country.” But, strictly speaking, the entry and exit authorities around the world have different standards for the examination of passports, which may not be recognized by the entry and exit staff, so that the people of Taiwan may be prevented from entering other countries or areas on the basis of passports with false stickers.
title: 中華民國護照

source_text:
護照正名
時至2020年4月，中華民國已在2019冠狀病毒病疫情中捐贈口罩援助世界多國，卻因英文國名中的「China」（中國），多次遭誤認為中華人民共和國，此事掀起國內關於中華航空改名及中華民國護照正名的討論。7月22日，立法院通過護照與華航更名決議案，宣告華航更名已入法。其中，台灣民眾黨、時代力量、民進黨、與台灣基進皆投下贊成票，而國民黨則全員未出席。2021年1月外交部發行新版護照外交部預訂於明(110)年1月發行提升台灣辨識度的新版護照 2010.9.2。
target_text: By April 2020, China had donated masks to assist many of the world’s countries in the 2019 crown virus epidemic, but the Chinese People’s Republic of China (China) had repeatedly been misconstrued as having voted in the name of China’s People’s Republic of China, triggering discussions about China’s change of name from China Air and China’s passport. On July 22, the Legislative Chamber declared the change of China’s name to be legal. Of these, the Taiwan People’s Party, the Time Force, the Democratic Party, and the Taiwanese People’s Party had voted in favour of Taiwan’s People’s Republic of China, while the National Party did not attend. In January 2021, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a new edition of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs’s passport to raise the recognition of Taiwan’s Gulf in January 2010.9.2.

source_text: 一位小朋友曾到曼聯訓練基地找球員，回家途中突然下雨，C朗拿度特地駕車送了小球迷回家。C朗拿度在一件葡萄牙國家隊球衣上籤名，並將簽名球衣交與葡萄牙四川地震援助會拍賣，所得款項捐給地震災區。C朗拿度每星期都會抽一天來閱讀世界各地球迷寄給他的信件，而且親自簽名寄出，每月要花大約二千英鎊。已故的流行曲之王米高·積遜的父親祖積遜曾在2010年世界盃前推銷一款足球形的燒烤爐，並希望藉C朗拿度協助推銷。C朗拿度亦是“救助兒童會”的全球形象大使，全球形象大使的責任是幫助世界上生存條件差的孩子與飢餓對鬥爭。德國《明鏡週刊》就以科學化的方式研究誰是跑步速度最快的球員，結果時速高達33.6公里的C朗拿度成為當時的球壇第一飛人，但在2012年4月3日，英超聯賽布萊克本對陣曼聯的比賽，曼聯球員華倫西亞以時速35公里的衝刺速度，打破了這個記錄。C朗拿度的肌肉由較多白纖維組成，而白纖維是肌肉爆發力的泉源，成為C朗拿度成為球壇飛人的主因。C朗拿度繼08年後， 在2013年再向紅十字會會捐錢， 主要用途會是幫助在阿富汗因誤踏地雷而斷肢的受害者， 而該筆善款多達8.6萬鎊。2013年12月，C朗拿度在家鄉豐沙爾的個人博物館開幕，展出自己職業生涯所贏得的榮譽和獎項。C朗拿度在2014年入選《時代週刊》全球百大影響力人物。

source_text: 紐倫堡審判（，，或称纽伦堡大审），是盟军根据国际法和二战后的战争法设立的国际军事法庭（，又称纽伦堡国际军事法庭或欧洲国际军事法庭）所举行的一系列军事审判。 这些审判中最为引人注目的是对纳粹德国政治、军事、司法和经济领导人员的起诉。他们策划、执行或以其他方式参与了大屠杀和其他战争罪行。由于审判主要在德国纽伦堡市举行，故被称为纽伦堡审判。这些判决标志着古典国际法与现代国际法之间的转折。
target_text: The Nuremberg trials (or the Nuremberg trials) are a series of military trials conducted by the Allied International Military Tribunal (also known as the Nuremberg International Military Tribunal or the European International Military Tribunal) under international law and the war laws of the Second World War. The most notable of these trials were the prosecutions of Nazi German political, military, judicial, and economic leaders. They planned, executed, or otherwise participated in the Holocaust and other war crimes.
title: 纽伦堡审判

source_text: 其中一项针对威廉·凯特尔，阿尔弗雷德·约德尔，和约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫的指控包括共谋实施1939年侵略波兰。1939年8月23日的《苏德互不侵犯条约》的秘密协定提出德国苏联瓜分波兰（随后在1939年9月执行）；然而，苏联领导人并没有作为共谋一同受审。相反，法庭错误地宣布互不侵犯条约秘密议定书是伪造的。此外，同盟国英国和苏联也没有因为准备并进行了英苏入侵伊朗和冬季战争而受到审判。1915年，同盟国，英国，法国，俄罗斯，联合签署协议，首次明确地指控樸特犯了“反人类罪”。但直到《伦敦宪章》进一步阐释该项罪名时它才有了明确的含义。即使按照《伦敦宪章》对于反人类罪的定义，在很多情况下，在犯罪实施阶段依旧无法确定构成反人类罪的要件。因此“反人类罪”违反了禁止追溯原则和刑法中罪刑法定原則。法院同意苏联领导层免于作为战犯出席庭审，以掩盖他们的战争罪行，以及他们的军队在1939年瓜分波兰和三个月后入侵芬兰的战争罪行。这种“排除请求”由苏联提出，随后由法院的管理层批准。纽伦堡审判运用的是自创的证据规则，不承认相似非难，有人声称整个审判的精神就是“胜利者的正义”。国际军事法庭宪章允许使用一般来说不予受理的证据。纽伦堡国际军事法庭（IMT）章程第19条规定：“法庭不应受制于证据的技术规则……并应采纳任何法庭认为有作为呈堂证供价值的证据。
target_text: One of the charges against William Ketel, Alfred Yodel, and Joachim von Ribbentrop, included conspiracy to commit aggression against Poland in 1939. The secret agreement of 23 August 1939, the Sood Non-Aggression Treaty, introduced the German Soviet Union into Poland (subsequently implemented in September 1939); however, the Soviet leaders were not tried together as conspiracies. On the contrary, the Tribunal wrongfully declared that the secret protocol of non-aggression against the Treaty was false. Moreover, the Allied Britain and the Soviet Union were not tried for preparing and conducting the Insult invasion of Iran and the Winter War. In 1915, the Allied Power, the United Kingdom, France, Russia, signed a joint agreement explicitly charging the Soviet leadership with crimes against humanity for the first time.
title: 纽伦堡审判

source_text:
合法性
对纽伦堡国际军事法庭一项批评认为，由于没有签署，一些条约对轴心国没有约束力。这是解决在审判有关战争罪和反人道罪，其中包含一个扩展习惯法：“1907年《海牙公约》明确表示，它的目的是修改一般法律和战争惯例。从而确认它在当时是存在的，但到1939年在《伦敦宪章》第6条(b)款，公约的这些规则为所有文明国家所承认的，就被视为战争的规则和惯例了。”国际法意味着如果足够多的国家签署了一个条约，且该条约已在一段足够长的时间内生效，那么它可以被解释为对所有国家具有约束力，而不只是签署该原始文件的国家。这是国际法极具争议的一个方面，至今国际法学术界仍在激烈争论。
target_text: A criticism of the Nürnberg International Military Tribunal that some treaties were not binding on the Axis States because they had not been signed. This was a solution to the war crimes and crimes against humanity, which contained an extended customary law: “The Hague Convention of 1907 makes it clear that its purpose is to modify general law and customs of war, thereby confirming that it existed at the time, but by 1939, in article 6 (b) of the London Charter, these rules of the Convention were recognized by all civilized nations as the rules and practices of war.” International law meant that if a treaty had been signed by a sufficient number of States and the treaty had entered into force for a sufficient period of time, it could be interpreted as binding on all States, not just on those that had signed the original document. This is an area of international law that is highly controversial, and is still subject to intense debate in the academic world of international law.
title: 纽伦堡审判

source_text: 1919年在巴黎通过的航空管理公约，其所承认的基本原则是国家对天空拥有主权。这公约在芝加哥于1944年的国际民用航空公约所取代的。其承认“每个国家对其领土上空的区域拥有完全的及排他的主权”。芝加哥公约还有规定是飞行在一国领空的航空器以内的人也属于该国法律管辖。航空器还须遵守当地的航空规则和空中交通管制，涵盖出入境、移民、关税、护照、健康以及关于机组人员、乘客和货物的事项等规定。各国都有依据芝加哥公约授予的权利管理外国飞机在其领空内的航空行为。
target_text: The Convention on Aviation Management, adopted in Paris in 1919, recognized the fundamental principle of State sovereignty over the sky. This Convention was replaced in Chicago by the Convention on International Civil Aviation of 1944, which recognized that “each State has full and exclusive sovereignty over the areas above its territory.” The Chicago Convention also provides that persons who fly within the airspace of a State are also subject to the laws of that State. Aircraft are subject to local air traffic rules and air traffic controls, covering entry, exit, immigration, customs, passport, health and matters relating to crews, passengers and cargo.
title: 航空器

source_text:
逸聞
當時被美國太空總署遴選為太空梭的成員，出發前慣例每位太空人可以帶一面自己出生地的國旗跟著升空，而這件事被中華人民共和國駐美大使館知道，透過正式外交管道向美國政府交涉，不准王赣骏攜帶中華民國國旗，理由是那不是他出生地的「國旗」。他後來得知太空人臨行前唯一有隱私的位置是「内衣」後，一不作二不休把中華民國國旗藏匿在内衣里伴隨升空。後來回臺灣時，王贛駿把那面國旗交給中華民國行政院長俞國華。
target_text: As a member of the space shuttle that was chosen by NASA at the time, it was customary for every astronaut to fly with a flag of his own birth, a matter that was known to the Chinese People’s Republic and the United States Embassy to the United States that, through official diplomatic channels, the King should not take the Chinese flag to the United States, on the grounds that it was not the “flail” of his place of birth. After learning that the only hidden position of the spacefarer before his trip was “underwear”, he kept the Chinese flag hidden in his underwear. When he returned to Taiwan, the King handed the flag over to the Governor of the Chinese Administrative Court of China.
title: 王赣骏

source_text: 联合国粮食及农业组织（联合国粮农组织，FAO）成立于1945年10月16日。于是第20届联合国大会于1979年11月将10月16日定为世界粮食日，1981年起施行。设立此主题日旨在唤起世界对发展粮食和农业的高度重视。这是世界各国政府每年在10月16日围绕发展粮食和农业生产举行纪念活动的日子。在这一天，世界各国应围绕联合国粮农组织确定的当年主题展开宣传活动。
target_text: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) was established on 16 October 1945. The twentieth General Assembly of the United Nations designated 16 October as World Food Day in November 1979, with effect from 1981. It was established to raise the world’s awareness of the importance of food and agriculture for development.
title: 世界粮食日

source_text:
节日由来
1972年，由于连续两年气候异常造成的世界性粮食歉收，加上苏联大量抢购谷物，出现了世界性粮食危机。联合国粮农组织于1973年和1974年相继召开了第一次和第二次粮食会议，以唤起世界，特别是第三世界注意粮食及农业生产问题。但是，问题并没有得到解决，世界粮食形势更趋严重。关于“世界粮食日”的决议正是在这种背景下做出的。
1979年，联合国粮食及农业组织（粮农组织）第20届大会决定从1981年起，把每年的10月16日（粮农组织创建纪念日）定为世界粮食日，旨在促进人们重视粮食生产，鼓励发展中国家开展经济和技术合作，增强公众对于世界饥饿问题的了解，促进发达国家向发展中国家转让技术等。选定10月16日作为世界粮食日因为联合国粮农组织创建于1945年10月16日。联合国粮农组织在关于世界粮食日的决议中要求，各国政府在每年10月16日要组织举办各种多样、生动活泼的庆祝活动。
target_text: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), at its twentieth session, in 1979, decided to designate 16 October of each year (the World Food Day) as World Food Day, starting in 1981, in order to promote the importance of food production, encourage economic and technical cooperation among developing countries, increase public awareness of the world's hunger problem, and promote technology transfer between developed and developing countries. It was chosen as World Food Day as World Food Day because FAO was created on 16 October 1945. FAO, in its resolution on World Food Day, requested Governments to organize a variety of dynamic celebrations every year on 16 October.
title: 世界粮食日

source_text:
宗旨目的
促进人们重视农业粮食生产，为此激励国家、双边、多边及非政府各方作出努力；
鼓励发展中国家开展经济和技术合作；
鼓励农村人民，尤其是妇女和最不利群体参与影响其生活条件的决定和活动；
增强公众对于世界饥饿问题的意识；
促进向发展中国家转让技术；

source_text: 夏威夷主权运动（）是夏威夷原住民发起的一場政治及文化運動，争取夏威夷原住民主權、自決和自治，甚至希望能从美国分离，重建獨立的夏威夷国家。一些原住民團體要求美國平為其在1893 年推翻利留卡拉尼女王及1898年吞併夏威夷的行為，對原住民採取某種形式的補救措施。他們認為夏威夷被美國「長期軍事佔領」，認為推翻及吞併夏威夷王國都是非法的。1946年新成立的联合国也将夏威夷列入了联合国非自治领土范围，根据该条例，美国负有责任引导其逐渐独立。但是在1959年美国政府在夏威夷举行全民公投后，宣布夏威夷作为美国第五十个州加入联邦。分离主义者认为在这次公决中大量美国军事相关人员也参与投票，不能完全代表土著居民的意愿，拒绝承认公决的法律效力。巴美拉環礁及斯凱亞納島曾為夏威夷王國的領土，因此也被一些爭取獨立的人士認為，這兩處跟夏威夷群島一樣正處於非法佔領之下。
target_text: The Hawaiian Sovereign Movement (HSM) is a political and cultural movement of Hawaiian natives that seeks the sovereignty, self-determination, and self-government of Hawaiian natives, even hoping to secede from the United States, and to re-establish an independent Hawaiian state. Some First Nations groups demand that the United States do exactly what it did in 1893 to overthrow Queen Lillucani and annex Hawaii in 1898, and take some form of relief against the natives. They believe that Hawaii is “long-term military occupation” by the United States, and that overthrowing and annexing the Hawaiian Crown is illegal.
title: 夏威夷主权运动

source_text: 美國曾長期否認夏威夷是被非法占領及奪去的，但在相關團體多年的爭取下，最終在推翻利留卡拉尼女王的100年後，美國國會通過的道歉決議承認夏威夷王國是在美國代理人和美國公民的積極參與下被推翻，夏威夷原住民從未通過任何正式的公民投票或表決，放棄他們對自身國家土地的主權，承認1893年推翻夏威夷王國是非法行為，但道歉決議不具任何法律效力，美國沒有對夏威夷原住民作出任何索賠。主權倡導者認為許多土著社區的問題，根源是原住民缺乏對主身社區、土地、文化及政治上的自決，這些問題包括無家可歸、貧困、經濟邊緣化和土著傳統的侵蝕等等。夏威夷主权运动者當代較關注的議題包括冒納凱亞天文台的建設、卡胡拉威島的強制人口遷移及其後美軍在當地實彈演練導致的環境問題，及夏威夷的紅山海軍油庫燃油外洩問題等等。近年来，夏威夷独立运动采用和平手段，主要通過教育倡議和立法行動來實現他們的議程。除了在整個夏威夷島嶼、美国首都华盛顿以及波士顿、洛杉矶等大城市举行示威游行外，主权运动者還向美國軍隊和聯邦政府提出了法律挑戰。
target_text: The U.S. has long denied that Hawaii was illegally occupied and taken, but, after years of struggle by related groups, the U.S. has failed to claim any compensation for the indigenous people of Hawaii. The U.S. Congress adopted an apology decision recognizing that the Hawaiian Crown was being overthrown with the active participation of U.S. agents and United States citizens, that the Hawaiian indigenous people had never passed any formal referendum or decision to renounce their title to their own national land, that the overthrow of the Hawaiian Crown in 1893 was illegal, but that the apology decision had no legal effect and that the U.S. had not claimed any compensation for the indigenous people. The main cause of the indigenous community’s problems was the lack of indigenous self-determination over the main community, land, culture, and politics, including the lack of access to homes, poverty, economic marginalization, and indigenous tradition.
title: 夏威夷主权运动

source_text: 在與西方文明接觸的頭一百年裡，由於疾病和戰爭夏威夷人口減少了百分之九十，到1876年只剩下5萬人左右。美國傳教士在 1820年首次到達夏威夷群島，然後在當地獲得了巨大權力和影響力，實際上控制了夏威夷王国。1875年，美国政府签署了《美夏互惠条约》，美国武力占据了珍珠港。儘管當時美國和其他世界大國正式承認夏威夷王國的主權，但王國於1893年在美國軍隊的幫助下，當地美國侨民策劃了政變推翻了利留卡拉尼女王。1893年美國眾議院外交關係委員會發表布朗特報告，指美國在違背夏威夷大多數人口意願下，同謀僑民及在美國軍隊幫助下，推翻合法、和平的夏威夷王國政府。美國駐夏威夷部長約翰·L·史蒂文斯 (John L. Stevens)支援政變，以虛假或誇大的藉口，命令USS Boston上的海軍陸戰隊入侵夏威夷，以支持政變人士的陰謀，最終推翻了利留卡拉尼女王的統治。
target_text: In 1875, the U.S. government signed the Treaty of Reciprocal Reciprocal Affairs, and the US took control of Pearl Harbor by force. Although the United States and the rest of the world formally recognized the sovereignty of the Hawaiian Crown in 1893, with the help of the U.S. military, the U.S. diaspora plotted to overthrow the Queen of Leuqani in 1893. In 1893, the US House of Commons Foreign Relations Committee issued a Brownette report, which ordered the US, in violation of the wishes of most of the Hawaiian population, to overthrow the legitimate and peaceful government of Hawaii, and the US government of Hawaii, with the help of the U.S. military, to overthrow the legitimate and peaceful government of Hawaii.
title: 夏威夷主权运动

source_text: 1959年3月，夏威夷作为第50个州加入美国，成为美国国旗上的第50颗星。1970年代开始，夏威夷原住民中组成主权申索团体，拒绝承认1893年推翻夏威夷女王的政变和1898年的兼并，并且要求美国政府对这两个事件和1898年后长期的军事占领进行道歉和赔偿。1978年，美国宪法规定在夏威夷州将夏威夷语与英语同为夏威夷州的官方语言。
target_text: In March 1959, Hawaii joined the United States as the fiftieth state, becoming the fiftieth star on the United States flag. In the 1970s, the First Nations of Hawaii formed a group of sovereign claims, refusing to recognize the 1893 coup d’état against the Queen of Hawaii and the 1898 annexation, and demanding an apology and compensation from the United States government for both events and the prolonged military occupation since 1898.
title: 夏威夷主权运动

source_text: 中蘇互不侵犯条约是指中华民国与苏联于1937年8月20日在南京签订的条约，规定：“倘缔约国之一方受一个或数个第三国侵略时，彼缔约国约定，在冲突全部时间内，对该第三国不得直接或间接予以任何援助……”，通过该条约蘇联政府向中国提供物资援助，1937年11月派遣空军志愿队来华作战。
target_text: The Sino-Soviet Non-Aggression Treaty refers to the Treaty between the Republic of China and the Soviet Union, signed in Nanjing on 20 August 1937, which provides that: “When one of the Contracting Parties is subject to aggression by one or more third States, the Contracting Parties agree that no assistance shall be given, directly or indirectly, to that third State during the entire period of the conflict ...”. Through the Treaty, the SUS Government provided material assistance to China and sent a voluntary air force to fight in China in November 1937.
title: 中苏互不侵犯条约

source_text:

source_text: 查理大帝的弟弟死于771年，这样查理就成为王国的唯一统治者了。查理依然受他父亲与教宗之间的条约束缚，由于伦巴底人不承认这个条约，他继续与伦巴底人作战。774年他占领了整个伦巴底王国。同时他支持向东的传教工作。到785年为止，他与萨克森人的战争决定着他的政治。785年，萨克森公爵威德金特臣服于查理，但双方之间的战争一直持续到804年。
target_text: Charlie's brother died in 771, so that Charlie became the sole ruler of the kingdom. Charlie was still bound by a treaty between his father and the Pope, and he continued to fight against the Lompattians because the Lombardians did not recognize it. In 774, he occupied the entire Lombardy kingdom. He also supported missionary work to the east. Until 785, his war with the Saxons determined his politics. 785, the Duke of Saxon Widkint served with Charlie, but the war between the two sides lasted until 804.
title: 法兰克王国

source_text: 路易死于840年，他的儿子洛泰尔一世成为唯一的统治者，但是843年他的三个儿子还是在《凡尔登条约》裡决定三分法兰克帝国。帝国后来在855年的普吕姆分割、870年的《墨尔森条约》和880年的《利贝蒙条约》中又多次被细分。此后法兰克帝国再没有被统一过。各个不同的帝国部分发展出不同的习俗、民风、语言，成为了独立的国家。有一段时间裡，人们还称分开的国家为东法兰克王国、西法兰克王国和中法兰克王国。在之后的一百年内，加洛林家族对东部王国和西部王国的统治纷纷被王国境内的贵族家族所取代。虽然直至12世纪，两个王国依旧称为东西法兰克王国，但人们称之为非加洛林系的法兰克王国东部和西部，国王被称为非加洛林家族的“法兰克人的国王”。西法兰克王国后来被称为法兰西王国，东法兰克王国则演变为神圣罗马帝国，继续维持着罗马皇帝的传统。
target_text: Louis died in 840, when his son, Lottel I, became the sole ruler, but in 843 his three sons decided in the Treaty of Verden to split the Empire three ways. The Empire was later divided in 855 by Plüme, in 870 by the Treaty of Melbourne and in 880 by the Treaty of Libermont. Since then, the Empire has not been unified. Different parts of the Empire have developed different customs, folk styles, languages, and become independent States. For some time, the divided country has been called the Kingdom of Eastern Frank, the Kingdom of Western Frank and the Kingdom of Central Frank.
title: 法兰克王国

source_text: 855年，洛泰尔在普吕姆分割中，将他的中法蘭克王國分给儿子们。洛泰尔的儿子们死后，秃头查理和日耳曼人路易在870年的《墨尔森条约》中，瓜分中法蘭克王國。最後，西法蘭克及東法蘭克瓜分了洛塔林吉亚及普羅旺斯兩地，而意大利則繼續維持現狀。秃头查理试图占领整个中法蘭克王國，但没有成功。路易三世在《利贝蒙条约》获得了中法蘭克王國的西部，法兰克帝国的瓜分大致成形。东部与西部之间的界限在整个中世纪几乎没有改变过。
target_text: In 855, Lottell divided his Central Frank Kingdom into sons in Plüm. After Lotelle’s sons died, bald Charlie and German Louis split the French Kingdom into the western part of the Central Frankenstein Treaty of 870. source_text: 在中華人民共和國公佈識別區後，美国、日本、韩国及菲律賓均對其主張不予承認，澳洲和多個歐盟国家亦认为此举将加剧紧张局势。美国曾派出B52轰炸机進入中華人民共和国劃定的防空识别区飞行，而日本也派F-15J軍機跟進，此举被媒体视作对中華人民共和国的警告和反制。中華人民共和国外交部批評日本是在「到處煽風點火」、「只許自己放火，不准別人點燈」，做法「毫無道理，別有用心。」，並要求美、日停止對於中國不負責任的指控。日本防衛省回應指「中国单方面的做法是国际社会不能允许的。」澳洲反對改變東海現狀的任何強制性或單方面行為，不承認中國大陸劃設的東海防空識別區，並曾召見中國大陸駐澳大使。歐盟和法國認為中華人民共和國的聲明將加劇地區緊張局勢的因素，此舉無益於解決歧見，呼籲各方冷靜克制。菲律宾认为中国大陸损害国际领空航行自由并破坏民航安全，除拒绝承认空识区之外，亦擔心中國大陸進一步設下南海防空識別區。韓國國防部指防識區乃中國大陸單方面劃定，韓國飛機經過離於島（中國大陸稱蘇岩礁）上空時將不會向中方通報，且將擴大韓國防空識別區，涵蓋離於島以因應中國大陸日前劃定東海航空識別區與韓方出現重疊的問題。

target_text: Wolfgang Schüssel, born in Vienna, is a member of the Austrian People’s Party (APP) politician. He was Prime Minister of Austria from 2000 to 2007. source_text: 由於澳大利亞采用聯邦制的君主立憲制度，其六個州政府和一個聯邦政府都是具有部分主權的政治實體，雖然由同一人擔任各州和聯邦的君主，但在主權層面上這七個王位互不隸屬。各州和聯邦的法理關係由《澳大利亞憲法》管制，具體來説在各州（）境内，聯邦政府掌握由各州通過憲法賦予的部分立法、行政、司法權（例如国防、外交、进出口等涉及主权的外部事务和经济政策、税收以及一些全国范围的立法和公共服务，比如福利署和邮政），其他政府權力（例如教育、衛生等）由各州保留。此外，聯邦政府直接領有聯邦領地(）。在各「領地」，聯邦政府通過聯邦立法設立了領地政府，其中一部分領地政府具有與各州政府相似的自治權，但聯邦可以通過立法限制或取消領地的自治權。而一些其他較小的領地政府則更接近聯邦的直屬行政機構。在州和地域最大的自治領地（北領地），州和領地政府下轄具有一定自治權的地方政府，是爲第三級政府，例如道路、規劃、綠化、垃圾處理等地方性的政府職能下放到地方政府層面。在地域較小的自治領地，例如首都領地，領地政府直接擔負地方政府職能。

source_text: 所有七大宗教是泛指的，没有任何宗教有更多的奖励。但是，两个同样宗教的文明（也就是说玩家和一个AI文明）会在贸易和外交上更为友好。拥有某一宗教圣地城市的玩家，随着该宗教传播到更多的城市，玩家将获得更多的金钱收入——这对于游戏的初期发展尤为重要。AI文明不再拥有整个地图的知识；他们现在和玩家平等。外交系统作了改进，选项更多了。有些操作元素被引入，例如可以同时选中多个部队并对他们下达指令。更多的重点也被放在音乐上；大量使用了巴洛克时期（巴赫），文艺复兴时期（德普瑞和帕莱斯特里纳等），古典时期（勃拉姆斯和贝多芬）和自创作的（主要由傑夫·布里吉完成）音乐，使得音乐在游戏中使用的程度超越了所有前作。每个领袖（除了忽必烈）都有自己的外交音乐主题。
target_text: All seven religions are generic, with no more rewards. But two civilizations of the same religion (i.e. the player and an AI civilization) are more friendly in trade and diplomacy. Players with a religious holy city will receive more money as the religion spreads to more cities – particularly important for the early development of the game. AI civilization no longer has knowledge of the entire map; they are equal with players; the diplomatic system has improved, with more options. Some operational elements are introduced, such as selecting multiple troops and giving them instructions. More emphasis is also placed on music; the Baroc period (Bach), the Renaissance period (Depres and Pales Trina, etc.), the classical period (Breams and Beethoven) and the self-created (mainly done by Jeff Bridge) make music more useful than all previous topics.

干练大臣
1828年，他重返政界，在威灵顿公爵领导的政府中任兰开斯特公爵领大臣。让他出任此职是未来表彰他的远见卓识，因为当时天主教徒解放是一个及其重要的问题，而阿伯丁是苏格兰长老会的一名教徒。阿伯丁同时代的人说他“虔诚而有涵养，待人宽厚，办事谨慎，令人无懈可击，举止斯文，只是有些古板的人。”换言之，他被看成一个郁郁寡欢、迟钝呆板的人。实际上他是一个不幸的人。当时，他同第一个妻子生的三个女儿钟的最后一个幸存者也快死了。利特尔顿夫人说，从表面上看，他是令人失望的：“他比以前更清瘦了，骨瘦如柴，像木头一样毫无表情。” 1828年，威灵顿让他出任外交大臣，后来在罗伯特·皮尔领导的第一届内阁中出任陆军和殖民大臣。接着，在皮尔赢得1841年大选之后又重返外交部。在担任两任外交大臣期间，他帮助希腊获得独立（希腊独立战争），并解决了英属北美（加拿大）和美国之间的一些棘手的边界争端问题 。
target_text: In 1828, he returned to politics as Lord Lancaster, head of the government led by the Duke of Wellington. His appointment to this post was a matter of vision for the future, since the liberation of the Catholics was a matter of importance, and Aberdeen was a member of the Scottish Presbyterian Church. Aberdeen’s generation said that he was “blesser than ever, as thin as wood, as cautiously and indefensiblely, as though he were a man of the past.” In 1828, Willington allowed him to serve as Foreign Secretary, then as Minister of the Army and Minister of Colonism in the first Cabinet led by Robert Pier. He was also an unfortunate man. At that time, the last survivor of his bell with his first wife’s three daughters was about to die.

source_text: 新保守主義：自小布什後成為共和黨的主流外交政策，目的是維護美國企業在國外的利益，強調干涉主義。新保守主義最初是由一群有異心的自由主義者所提出，欧文·克里斯托被認為是該思想的先驅，將「新保守主義者」定義為「被現實搶劫的自由主義者」。雖然最初被視為是國內政策的一種方法（克里斯托的《The Public Interest》未包含外交事務），但在迪克·錢尼、罗伯特·卡根、、和比尔·克里斯托等人的影響下，新保守主義成為小布希及共和黨的主要外交政策。新保守主義認同為保障美國的國家利益及維護國際地位，有必要介入別國的事務。這在海灣戰爭、阿富汗戰爭及伊拉克戰爭充分體現。經濟自由主義：強調嚴謹闡述美國憲法，尤其是關於聯邦權力的部份，主張限制聯邦政府的權力。這種思維模式往往信奉自由放任市場經濟，蔑視及不信任聯邦政府。在經濟方面自1980年代成為共和黨的主要政策，反對社會主義、計劃經濟、公有制與社會福利，捍衛私有產權、小政府大社會、徹底的自由市場經濟，減稅、縮減政府開支和社會福利、取消奧巴馬健保計劃、維護公平的國際貿易等。茶黨運動不但激烈批評奧巴馬推動的全民健保，更主張消滅教育部、國稅局甚至聯邦儲備局。古典保守主義：1980年代興起，強調基督教文化傳統和傳統家庭對社會的重要性。古保守主義者強烈反對政府干預人民生活。
target_text: New Conservativeism: Although initially seen as a method of internal policy (the Palestinian Interest of Christo does not include foreign affairs), neoconservativeism was initially proposed by a group of dissident liberals, such as Dick Cheney, Robert Kagen, and Bill Christo, who were considered to be the leading foreign policy of the smaller Bushes and Republicans, defining "new conservatives" as "frees who have been robbed of their lives" . source_text: 美国联邦政府对一些联邦承认的美洲原住民部落在其保留地的土地上授予有限的自治。部落土地被认为是“国内的附属国（内藩）”；并平行运行独立于保留地所在州的治理和法律体系，这有时包括独立的警察部队。例如，一些部落被允许经营赌博场所并生产在周边州可能是非法的毒品。但是保留地不是州，在国会中没有直接代表，保留地的公民以他们所在州的公民身份投票。此外，与州立法机关的主权不同，部落主权和土地所有权不受宪法保障，仅由国会法案授予，可随时废除或更改。
target_text: The United States federal government grants limited autonomy to a number of federally recognized Native American tribes on their reserve lands. Tribal lands are considered to be “domestic dependencies” and operate in parallel independently of the governance and legal systems of the state where the reserve is located, sometimes including independent police forces. For example, some tribes are allowed to operate gambling sites and produce drugs in neighbouring states that may be illegal.
title: 地方自治

source_text: 石油換食品計劃 (簡稱OIP；OFFP)，又名以油換糧計劃，是联合国于1995年设立（按照联合国安全理事会第986号决议）、於2003年末结束的计划，其目的是允許伊拉克在国际市场上出售石油，以換取食品、药品、以及普通伊拉克公民的其它人道需求，而不允许伊拉克重建它的军队。
target_text: The oil-for-food programme, known as OIP; OFFP, or the oil-for-food programme, was established by the United Nations in 1995 (in accordance with United Nations Security Council resolution 986) and ended in 2003 with the aim of allowing Iraq to sell oil on the international market in exchange for food, medicine and other humanitarian needs of ordinary Iraqi citizens, and not to allow Iraq to rebuild its army.
title: 石油换食品计划

source_text: 此一计划是美国克林顿政府在1995年所提出的 ，以回应一种观点：“普通伊拉克公民被國際经济制裁過份影响，而制裁原意是令萨达姆·侯赛因在第一次海湾战争后解除武装。”2003年美伊战争后，制裁不再继续，人道职能交予联盟驻伊拉克临时管理当局。在联合国的赞助下，价值超过650亿美元的伊拉克石油在国际市场销售。官方上，约460亿美元用于人道需求；额外的收入通过一个赔偿基金支付海湾战争赔款，支持联合国在该计划上管理和營運的成本（2%），支付武器核查计划的成本（0.8%）。
target_text: This plan was proposed in 1995 by the Clinton Administration of the United States in response to the view that “the ordinary Iraqi citizens were disproportionately affected by international economic sanctions, which were intended to disarm Saddam Hussein after the first Gulf war.” After the 2003 US-Iraq war, the sanctions ceased to exist, and humanitarian functions were handed over to the Coalition Provisional Authority in Iraq. Iraqi oil worth over $65 billion was sold on the international market under the auspices of the United Nations. Officially, approximately $46 billion was spent on humanitarian needs; additional revenues were paid through a compensation fund to cover Gulf war compensation, to support the cost of United Nations management and operation of the plan (2 per cent) and to cover the cost of the weapons verification programme (0.8 per cent).
title: 石油换食品计划

source_text:
有迹象显示，在该计划完结後，有人虧空公款；2018年電影「暗算」（Backstabbing for Beginners）即是描寫此事，以影射Benon Sevan。背景和摘要
石油换食品计划是为了减轻伊拉克人民在联合国对伊拉克强制性经济制裁和武器禁运制裁下所带来的痛苦而制定的。该决议因伊拉克1990年8月入侵科威特而实施。伊拉克开始拒绝，但是在1996年5月签订谅解备忘录，开始准备执行计划。
target_text: There are indications that, after the completion of the plan, there was a loss of public funds; the Backstabbing for Beginners film of 2018 describes this insinuates Benon Sevan. Background and summary The oil-for-food programme was designed to alleviate the suffering of the Iraqi people under the United Nations coercive economic sanctions against Iraq and the arms embargo. The resolution was implemented as a result of Iraq’s invasion of Kuwait in August 1990. Iraq began to reject it, but signed a memorandum of understanding in May 1996 and began to prepare the implementation plan.
title: 石油换食品计划

2006年1月16日，澳洲政府开始就澳大利亚小麦出口有限公司是否在石油换食品计划中向萨达姆政权支付數億美金回佣一事进行调查。1月19日，该公司总裁安德鲁·林德伯格交代，他们欺骗联合国，不断提高小麦价格，并替萨达姆政府偿还债务，他在很多场合同澳洲外交部长唐纳讨论过向伊拉克出口小麦的交易。4月13日，澳洲总理约翰·霍华德在调查听证会上作证，表明自己并不知晓该公司是否向伊拉克前政权支付巨额回扣。
target_text: On 16 January 2006, the Australian government opened an investigation into whether Australia Wheat Export Limited had paid hundreds of millions of dollars back to Saddam’s regime under the oil-for-food programme. On 19 January, the company’s president, Andrew Lindbergh, told the United Nations that they had deceived the United Nations, continuously raised wheat prices and paid off debts on behalf of Saddam’s government, and that he had discussed the export of wheat to Iraq in a number of contracts with Australian Foreign Minister Donald Downer. On 13 April, Australian Prime Minister John Howard testified at an investigation hearing that he did not know whether the company had paid large rebates to Iraq’s former regime.
title: 石油换食品计划

source_text:
其他政見

source_text: 劉兆玄起用前財政部長邱正雄為行政院副院長。前國科會副主委薛香川為行政院秘書長。國民黨副秘書長廖風德為內政部長，駐瓜地馬拉大使歐鴻鍊為外交部長。前監委、前真調會主委王清峰為法務部長、前交通部次長毛治國為交通部長。劉兆玄起用一些以前有部長經驗者，或在政府為副部長級的人士或學者入閣，也是配合馬英九的立即上手的想法。這個內閣，被媒體稱為「博士內閣」。
target_text: Liu Mok-hyun used the former Minister of Finance, Chuo Jung-hoon, as Vice-President of the Executive Council. The former Vice-President of the National Council of Science, Xue Sheung-chun, was the Secretary-General of the Executive Council. The Deputy Secretary of the National Democratic Party, Liao Feng-de Dynasty, was the Minister of the Interior, and Ambassador Eugène to Guatemala, the Minister of Foreign Affairs. The former Supervisory Board, former Chairman of the Truth Commission, Wang Qing Feng, was the Minister of Justice and former Under-Secretary of Transport, Mao, the Minister of Transport.
