source_text: 《禁止在海床洋底及其底土安置核武器和其他大规模毁灭性武器条约》（，英语直譯：海底武器控制条约）是由联合国发起的，美国、前苏联、英国等22个国家首先签字承认的，目前已经有84个国家参加的军事条约。条约规定禁止在海岸线12海里以外的公海海底中放置、试验核武器和大规模杀伤性武器，允许签字国监督任何其他签字国在海岸线12海里以外的海底“活动”。条约在1972年5月18日起正式生效。
target_text: The Treaty on the Prohibition of the Emplacement of Nuclear Weapons and Other Weapons of Mass Destruction on the Sea-Bed and the Ocean Floor and in the Subsoil Thereof (English Interpreter: Undersea Weapons Control Treaty) was initiated by the United Nations and was first signed by 22 States, including the United States, the former Soviet Union and the United Kingdom, and is now a military treaty to which 84 States are party. The Treaty provides for a ban on the placement, testing of nuclear weapons and weapons of mass destruction on the seabed of the high seas beyond 12 nautical miles of the coastline and allows signatory States to supervise the “activities” of any other signatory beyond 12 nautical miles of the coastline. The Treaty entered into force on 18 May 1972.
title: 禁止在海床洋底及其底土安置核武器和其他大规模毁灭性武器条约

source_text: 为了防止产生国际冲突，保证无核化地区不存在核武器，已经签定了三个国际条约：《南极条约》、《外层空间条约》和《拉丁美洲无核化条约》。这个条约是对其他三个条约的扩展和补充。1960年代，海洋学技术的发展和对海底扩大未开发资源的日益增长的兴趣容易导致国际争端，尤其是对利用洋底作为军事设施使用的场所，包括放置核武器，引起人们的担心。而当时又缺乏清晰的法律和规定。
target_text: In order to prevent the emergence of international conflicts and to ensure that nuclear weapons do not exist in denuclearization zones, three international treaties have been signed: the Antarctic Treaty, the Outer Space Treaty and the Latin American denuclearization Treaty. This treaty is an extension and a complement to the other three treaties. In the 1960s, the development of oceanographic technology and growing interest in the expansion of untapped resources on the seabed were likely to lead to international disputes, in particular concerns about the use of the ocean floor as a place for military installations, including the placement of nuclear weapons.
title: 禁止在海床洋底及其底土安置核武器和其他大规模毁灭性武器条约

source_text: 根据马耳他驻联合国大使帕尔多于1967年8月向联合国秘书长提出的建议，1967年12月18日的联合国大会指定一个特别委员会研究和平利用海底的问题，目标是保证：“对海洋底部的开发和利用必须遵守联合国宪章的原则和目标，要有利于维护国际和平和安全，要造福于全人类”。第二年，这个委员会成为常设委员会。
target_text: In accordance with the proposal made to the Secretary-General of the United Nations by the Ambassador of Malta to the United Nations, Parr, in August 1967, the United Nations General Assembly, on 18 December 1967, appointed a special committee to study the peaceful uses of the seabed with the objective of ensuring that “the development and exploitation of the bottom of the ocean must be in accordance with the principles and objectives of the Charter of the United Nations and in the interest of maintaining international peace and security and for the benefit of all mankind”.
title: 禁止在海床洋底及其底土安置核武器和其他大规模毁灭性武器条约

source_text: 《凡尔赛条约》或《凡尔赛和约》（；），全称《协约国及聯繫國與德國之間的和平條约》（，），是第一次世界大战后，战胜的协约国和战败的同盟国签订的和约。协约国和同盟国于1918年11月11日宣布停火，经过巴黎和会长达7个月的谈判后，于1919年6月28日在巴黎的凡尔赛宫签署条约，这一条约的签署标志着第一次世界大战正式结束。得到国际联盟的承认后，《凡爾賽條約》于1920年1月10日正式生效。
target_text: The Treaty of Versailles or the Versailles Treaty (;), known as the Treaty of Peace between the Convergence and the Associated States and Germany (,) was signed by the defeated Concord States and the defeated Allied Powers after the First World War. The Treaty of Versailles entered into force on 10 January 1920, after recognition by the League of Nations, following a ceasefire declared on 11 November 1918 and the signing of the Treaty at the Palais de Versailles in Paris on 28 June 1919, after seven months of negotiations by the Paris Peace Council.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 克莱蒙梭的主张可以简单归为以下：德国对战争中法国的损失（包括人员、财产等）进行战争赔偿，将其军力削减至不再对法国构成威胁，象征性的惩罚德国军国主义以使德国再也不能恢复到1914年以前的政治格局，当众处死德国皇帝（在战争结束前退位並流亡至荷兰）。法国收回阿尔萨斯-洛林，建立莱茵兰非军事区，甚至要在法德之间建立一个“莱茵共和国”作为两国之间的缓冲国，由战胜国瓜分德国的海外殖民地。将德国军力削减至较低水準。同时他还希望签订封锁德国海岸线的秘密条约，以便法国能控制德国的进出口贸易。因为这些严苛的条件，克莱蒙梭也得到了“老虎”的绰号。
target_text: The claim of Clemonso can be summarized simply as follows: Germany's war compensation for France's losses during the war (including people, property, etc.), reduction of its military strength to no longer pose a threat to France, symbolic punishment of German militarism so that Germany can no longer return to the pre-1914 political landscape, and public execution of the German Emperor (departed before the end of the war and exiled to the Netherlands). France's withdrawal of Alsace-Lorrin, the establishment of the Rhineland demilitarized zone, and even the creation of a buffer between France and Germany of a “Région républicaine” as a buffer between the two countries, divided by the defeat of the German State.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 尽管英国本土在战争中未遭战火，但仍有许多英军士兵在战争中丧生，因此英国国内广泛的民意仍希望严惩德国。英国首相戴维·劳合·乔治支持惩罚德国，但在具体措施上较法国为轻。乔治认识到，一旦法国提出的条件全都得到满足就会成为欧陆的超级强国并破坏欧陆均势，这和英国意图维持一个均衡的欧洲的传统政策相悖。同时乔治对美国总统伍德罗·威尔逊的“民族自决”政策感到忧虑，因为英国有庞大的海外殖民地。但他赞同签订秘密条约封锁德国海岸线。
target_text: Despite the absence of war in the British mainland, a large number of British soldiers have been killed in the war, and there is widespread public opinion in the United Kingdom that Germany will still be severely punished. British Prime Minister David Lloyd George, who supports the punishment of Germany, is less effective than France in terms of concrete measures.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 威尔逊意识到为了达到建立国际联盟的目的，他的十四点建议需要做出妥协。而且他坚持“民族自决”政策，例如刚从一战后的德国和俄国中重新获得独立的波兰。同时他极力反对建立秘密条约，例如秘密军事联盟等。不过他同意要削弱德国军力到一个较低的水準。
target_text: Wilson realized that, in order to achieve the goal of an international coalition, his 14-point proposal required compromise. And he insisted on a policy of “national self-determination,” such as Poland, which had recently regained its independence from Germany and Russia after World War I. At the same time, he strongly opposed the establishment of secret treaties, such as secret military alliances.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text:
威尔逊的十四点建议具体如下：
公开的和平条约应该以公开的方式缔结而成。
在各国领海以外的大洋和水域，有绝对的航行自由，不管是在平时或战时都一样。
尽最大可能地消除经济障碍，并在所有同意接受和平及协同维持和平的国家之间建立平等的贸易条件。
互相充分的保证各国的军备减少到符合保卫国家内部安全的最低程度。
各国对各殖民地的权利的主张，应该做自由，开明和大公无私的调整。
撤退现在在俄罗斯领土上的所有军队。
在比利时的占领军应该撤退，其领土应该恢复，并不得企图限制她与其他自由的国家同样地享有主权。
法国全部的领土应该获得自由。被侵占的法国地区应该归还。
意大利和原奥匈帝国的疆界必须依照民族特性加以清楚的确定。
东欧人民按照民族自决原则建立独立国家。
罗马尼亚，塞尔维亚及门的内哥罗独立。同时巴尔干诸国的政治及经济的独立和领土的完整应透过国际条约予以保障。
奥斯曼土耳其帝国各民族自决前途。
波兰独立，并获得波罗的海出海口。
建立国际联盟以保证国际秩序。
target_text: There is absolute freedom of navigation in the seas and waters outside the territorial waters of each country, whether in peacetime or in war. To the greatest extent possible, economic barriers should be removed, and equitable terms of trade established between all countries that agree to peace and to cooperate in maintaining peace should be established.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 从1919年三月开始，谈判由五个战胜国（英国、法国、美国、意大利、日本）政府首脑和外长组成的“十人委员会”主导，该机构组成复杂，矛盾重重，难以做出有效决定。谈判过程中日本和其余各国外长先后退出十人委员会，实际上只剩“四巨头”，后意大利因对南斯拉夫的阜姆（现里耶卡）的领土要求被拒绝也退出时，最终的谈判由三大国（英国、法国、美国）的政府首脑，即英国首相乔治、法国总理克莱蒙梭、美国总统威尔逊把持，意大利首相维托里奥·奥兰多的作用微乎其微。德国甚至不准参与条约讨论。因为各国谈判目标不一致甚至存在冲突，每个决定都是经过“不愉快的妥协”后才能达成。亨利·基辛格称之为“美国式理想主义和欧洲式偏执狂之间的脆弱妥协”。
target_text: Starting in March 1919, the negotiations were led by a “Ten-member Commission” composed of the heads of Government and foreign ministers of the five winning countries (the United Kingdom, France, the United States, Italy, Japan), which was complex and contradictory in its composition and made it difficult to make effective decisions. In the course of the negotiations, Japan and the remaining foreign ministers withdrew from the Ten-member Commission, effectively leaving only the “Four”, after Italy had rejected and withdrawn its territorial claims against Yugoslavia (now Rijeka), and the final negotiations were led by the heads of Government of the three countries (the British, the French, the United States), the British Prime Minister Georges, the French Prime Minister Clemonso, and the United States President Wilson, whose role was minimal.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 1919年6月，协约国宣称若德国不签署条约，战争将继续进行。菲利普·谢德曼领导的政府无法在内部达成一致，而其本人亦不愿接受条约，故宣布辞职。新政府领袖古斯塔夫·鲍尔发出电报，表示愿意签署，但希望去除第227、230和231条。协约国方回应德国必须接受条约，否则其军队将于24小时内自莱茵河发动入侵。6月23日，鲍尔最终让步，发出第二封电报表示德国将很快派出代表团签署条约。1919年6月28日，萨拉热窝事件五周年纪念日，和约正式签署。条款内容大至战争罪行，禁止奥地利和德国在未经国联批准下合并，欧洲主要河流自由通航权，小至将一本古兰经归还予汉志国王。
target_text: In June 1919, the Convergence declared that the war would continue if Germany did not sign the treaty. The Government of Philip Shedman was unable to reach an internal agreement, and he himself was unwilling to accept the treaty, and announced his resignation. The new government leader Gustave Bauer, by telegram, expressed his willingness to sign, but wished to remove articles 227, 230 and 231. The Concording Party responded that Germany must accept the treaty, or its troops would launch an invasion from the Rhine within 24 hours. On 23 June, Paul finally conceded, sending a second telegram indicating that Germany would soon send a delegation to sign the treaty. On 28 June 1919, the fifth anniversary of the Sarajevo incident, and the treaty was formally signed.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 根据条约规定，德国失去了的领土和近7,000,000的人口，并被要求放弃在《布列斯特-立陶夫斯克条约》中获得的领土及允许其保护国独立。在西欧，德国承认比利时对莫雷斯内特拥有主权，并割让奧伊彭-馬爾默迪地区控制权。在转交控制权六个月内，比利时将举行公民投票以决定这一地区将归属比利时或回归德国，并将结果上报国联，接受国联裁定。为补偿被毁的法国煤矿，德国将把萨尔煤矿的产出交予法国，并将萨尔的控制权交予国联；十五年后将举行公民投票以决定其主权归属。条约还將1871年的《凡尔赛条约》和《法兰克福条约》废除，由此阿尔重新劃入洛林，並追溯至1918年11月11日，即停戰之日亦回归法国。石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因的主权归属亦将由未来的公民投票决定（见1920年石勒苏益格公投）。
target_text: Within six months of the transfer of control, Belgium will hold a referendum to determine whether the area will belong to Belgium or return to Germany, and the results will be reported to the League of Nations. In order to compensate for the destroyed French coal mine, Germany will hand over the output of the sal coal mine to France and the control of the sarcophagus to the Union; a referendum will be held in 15 years to determine its sovereignty. The treaty will also abolish the 1871 Treaty of Versailles and the Frankfurt Treaty, thereby re-entering Lorraine and returning to France on 11 November 1918, the date of the cessation of the war.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 在东欧，德国承认捷克斯洛伐克独立，并将上西里西亚部分领土移交。德国亦承认波兰独立，并放弃“该领土所有权利及头衔”。上西里西亚部分领土被割让给波兰，而其余领土归属则将由公民投票决定。国境的具体规划将根据每个区域的投票结果及地理和经济因素决定。波森省（今波兹南）在大波兰起义时已归波兰控制，今将正式归属波兰。根据历史和民族因素考量，东波美拉尼亚将移交予波兰，由此波兰将获得入海权，称波兰走廊。东普鲁士南部地区的主权将由公民投票决定，而位于华沙和但泽铁路线中间的索尔陶地区则不经投票直接交予波兰。根据这一安排，波兰共由德国处获取的领土。梅梅尔将移交协约国及其盟国，由其处置。波罗的海沿岸的但泽及其内陆地区（包括维斯瓦河三角洲）将归予国联，由其建立但泽自由市。
target_text: In Eastern Europe, Germany recognized Czechoslovakia's independence and handed over part of Upper Silesia. Germany also recognized Poland's independence and renounced “all the rights and titles of the territory.” Part of Upper Silesia was ceded to Poland, while the rest of the territory would be ceded to a referendum. The specific planning of the border would be determined by the results of the vote in each region and by geographical and economic factors. The Province of Potsen (now Poznan) would be under the control of Poland at the time of the Greater Poland uprising and would now be officially owned by Poland.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 条约第119条要求德国放弃其前殖民地主权，第22条则将这些领土转变为由协约国控制的国际联盟托管地。多哥兰及德属喀麦隆被移交予法国；卢旺达及乌隆地被移交予比利时；德属西南非洲被移交予南非；德属东非被移交予英国。作为对德国入侵葡属非洲的补偿，葡萄牙获得位于前德属东非莫桑比克北端的基翁加三角地区。第156条将德国在中国山东的权益转交予日本而非中国。日本亦获得了赤道以北太平洋的所有德国领土，而赤道以南的领土则归予澳大利亚（除德属萨摩亚归予新西兰）
target_text: Article 119 of the Treaty requires Germany to renounce its former colonial sovereignty, while article 22 converts these territories into an international union trust under the control of the allies. Togoland and German Cameroon were transferred to France; Rwanda and Ulon territory were transferred to Belgium; Germany south-west Africa was transferred to South Africa; and Germany East Africa was transferred to the United Kingdom. As compensation for Germany’s invasion of Portuguese Africa, Portugal received the Kionga triangle, located at the northern end of Mozambique, former German East Africa. Article 156 transferred Germany’s interests in Shandong, China, to Japan rather than China. Japan also acquired all German territory in the North Pacific Ocean, north of the equator, while the territory south of the equator was returned to Australia (with the exception of Samoa to New Zealand).
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text:
軍事限制
条约对战后德国军队（国家防卫军）的发展状况做出了详细和复杂的限制。这些条款旨在使国家防卫军无法发动攻势，并推动国际武装解除。德国将在1920年3月31日前充分解除动员，其总军人数量不得超过100,000人，至多允许有7个步兵师和3个骑兵师。条约还对师及其支援单位的构成做出了规定，并撤销了总参谋部的设置。军官学校被限制至3个，三军各有一个，征兵体系被废除。列兵及士官队伍将至少维持十二年，军官队伍至少25年，前军官不得参与军事演习。为避免德国产出大量培训士兵，准许提前退伍的人数将受限制。
target_text: The treaty also provides for the composition of the division and its support units, and for the abolition of the General Staff. The officer schools are limited to three, one for each of the three armies, and the recruitment system is abolished. The army and the ranks will remain in place for at least 12 years, and the army will not be allowed to participate in military exercises for at least 25 years.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 支持陆军的平民官员队伍被裁減，而警察力量亦被裁減至战前规模，其增长水準同人口挂钩；准军事部队被禁止存在。莱茵兰地区将被去军事化，全区及莱茵河东侧内所有防御工事均将拆除且不得新建。黑尔戈兰群岛的所有军事设施和防御工事亦当拆除。德国不得参与军事贸易，所有武器的类别和数量受到限制，并不得生产或贮存化学武器、装甲车、坦克及军用飞机。德国海军只允许拥有六艘前无畏舰、六艘轻巡洋舰（吨位不超）、十二艘驱逐舰（吨位不超）及十二艘鱼雷艇（吨位不超），并不允许拥有潜艇。海军总人数不得超过15,000人，这一数额包括舰上、海防、信号站、行政、其他陆上队伍、军官及所有级别军人。军官和军士长数量不得超过1,500人。八艘战列舰、八艘轻巡洋舰、四十二艘驱逐舰和五十艘鱼雷艇将被解除武装。三十二艘武装商船亦将被解除武装并转为民用。第198条禁止德国组织空军（包括海军航空队），并要求德国移交所有与空军有关材料物资；而在条约签署六个月内，德国亦被禁止生产或进口飞行器及相关材料。
target_text: All military installations and defences in the Hergoran Islands shall also be dismantled. Germany shall not engage in military trade, all types and quantities of weapons shall be restricted, and no production or storage of chemical weapons, armoured vehicles, tanks and military aircraft at all levels shall be permitted. The German Navy shall permit the possession of only six former dauntless ships, six light cruisers (not exceeding the tonnage), twelve destroyers (not exceeding the tonnage) and twelve torpedo boats (not exceeding the tonnage) and not more than fifteen thousand naval personnel, including naval defence, signal stations, administration, other land forces, military officers and all ranks.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text:
战争赔偿
第231条要求德国对“德国及其盟国之侵略行为”造成的战争损失和破坏负责。此后的条款要求德国对协约国进行赔偿，并于1921年建立“赔偿委员会”，评估德国的资源状况和赔款能力，听取德国政府的意见，并决定具体数额。在此之前，条约要求德国赔偿2,000亿金马克，以黄金、商品、舰船、股票及其他形式进行支付。赔款亦可用于承担协约国占领的费用及为德国购置食品和原材料。
target_text: Article 231 requires Germany to be responsible for war losses and damage caused by “acts of aggression by Germany and its allies.” Subsequent provisions require Germany to compensate the contracting State and, in 1921, to establish a “compensation commission” to assess Germany's resource situation and its ability to pay compensation, to listen to the German Government and to determine the amount. Prior to that, the treaty required Germany to compensate Germany for 200 billion gold marks, to be paid in gold, commodities, ships, stocks, and other forms.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 为保证条约得到执行，莱茵兰及莱茵河以东桥头堡将由协约国军队占领，为期十五年。若德国未进行攻击性行动，军队将分阶段撤出；五年后将撤出科隆桥头堡及鲁尔河以北领土；十年后将撤出科布伦茨桥头堡以北领土；十五年后剩余军队将全部撤出。若德国未履行条款规定，桥头堡将立即被重新占领。
target_text: In order to guarantee the implementation of the Treaty, the Fort of the Bridge to the east of the Rhineland and Rhine Rivers will be occupied by the Allied Powers for a period of 15 years. In the absence of any offensive action by Germany, the Army will withdraw in stages; in five years it will withdraw from the Fort of Cologne Bridge and from the territory north of the Ruhr River; in 10 years' time it will withdraw from the territory north of the Fort of the Fort of Koblenz Bridge; and in 15 years all remaining troops will be withdrawn. If Germany fails to comply with its terms, the Fort of the Bridge will be reoccupied immediately.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 法国认为自己没有完全得到满足，克里蒙梭在随后的大选中下台。从整体而言英国对条约比较满意，德国东部边界得到了一定的安全，如波兰的独立和但泽自由市的成立。在某种程度上英国甚至认为条约对德国过分苛刻，这可能导致德国的不满并成为未来的不稳定因素。美国认为条约是欧洲的麻烦所在，而且对德国过于苛刻。1919年美国国会投票决定拒绝签署凡尔赛条约并拒绝加入国际联盟。
target_text: France believes that it has not been fully satisfied, and that Clemonso fell out of the post-election elections. On the whole, Britain was satisfied with the Treaty, and Germany’s eastern borders were given some security, such as Poland’s independence and the establishment of the Free City of Danzig.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 《凡尔赛条约》的主要目的是惩罚和削弱德国。中國基於山東問題和國內爆發五四運動等因素下，最終沒有簽署《凡爾賽條約》，但與德國另簽訂和約。德国的反应当德国了解到条约内容后，愤怒和屈辱感迅速在德国国内蔓延，德国人认为他们对发动战争未有责任而且他们已经战败，起初德国政府拒绝接受条约，德国海军以自沉舰艇的方式表达对条约的不满。
target_text: The main purpose of the Treaty of Versailles is to punish and weaken Germany. China ultimately did not sign the Treaty of Versailles on the basis of Shandong’s problems and the outbreak of five or four movements in the country, but signed another treaty with Germany.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 随后保皇派、民族主义者和前军队将领开始质疑条约。魏玛共和国的政治家、社民党人、共产党人、犹太人被他们视为叛国者，因为这些所谓的“十一月罪犯”是魏玛政权的既得利益者，也是他们刀刺在背傳說。这种论调在德国投降后具有广阔市场，因为当时德国已经取得了东线的胜利并和俄国布尔什维克政权签订了布列斯特-立陶夫斯克条约，而西线德军仍在法国和比利时境内。但实际上西线德军的春季攻势因给养不足而被迫停止，在批评者眼中这次失败被归罪于后方的罢工，尤其是犹太人。而他们却忽略了交战双方已经卷入了总体战中，前线的局部战术优势无法扭转德国在战略上的失败。尽管如此，这种论点在德国国内仍引起了广泛共鸣并被纳粹党作為宣傳。
target_text: The politicians of the Weimar Republic, the SNSP, the Communists, and the Jews are regarded as traitors, because the so-called “November criminals” are vested interests in the Weimar regime, and they are being stabbed in the back of the legend. Such arguments have been widely marketed after Germany surrendered, because Germany had won the Eastern Line and signed the Brest-Litavsk Treaty with the Russian Bolshevik regime, while the Western German Army is still in France and Belgium.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 战后的德国经济非常脆弱，只支付了条约规定的赔偿金额中的一小部分，但即使这一小部分也给德国经济造成了极大负担并导致了近1/3的通货膨胀（德國記者兼作家賽巴斯提安·哈夫納的著作《從俾斯麥到希特勒》筆下則描述當政的布呂寧政府實際上是刻意放任經濟失控來達成擺脫賠款的目的）。条约规定德国以矿产资源和工业设备赔偿未能以现金支付的部分更激起了德国民众的不满。
target_text: The post-war German economy was very fragile, paying only a small portion of the compensation under the treaty, but even this small part placed a heavy burden on the German economy and led to nearly a third of inflation (the German journalist and writer Sebastian Hafner’s book “From Bismarck to Hitler” describes the regime’s Bushin administration as in fact deliberately letting the economy out of control in order to get out of the way. The treaty’s provision of compensation for mineral resources and industrial equipment in Germany’s failure to pay in cash has fuelled the dissatisfaction of the German population.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 1922年4月16日魏玛共和国和俄国苏维埃政府在意大利拉帕洛签订拉帕洛条约，双方宣布放弃在布列斯特-立陶夫斯克条约及一战后向对方提出的领土和金钱之要求。而且，两国也同意外交正常化并“友好合作，在经济上互惠互利”。在双方于29日签署的秘密附件中规定德国可在俄国训练部队、试验凡尔赛条约中禁止的坦克和飞机等武器。
target_text: On 16 April 1922, the Republic of Weimar and the Russian Soviet Government signed the Rapalo Treaty in La Palo, Italy, in which they renounced the territorial and monetary claims made to each other in the Brest-Litaufsk Treaty and after the war. Moreover, the two countries also agreed to diplomatic normalization and “friendly cooperation and mutual economic benefit”. The secret annex signed by the two sides provided for Germany to train troops in Russia, test tanks and aircraft, etc. prohibited by the Versailles Treaty.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 1935年3月希特勒宣布恢复徵兵制并扩充德国军队，包括建立凡尔赛条约中禁止德国拥有的海军武器、装甲部队和空军。1936年3月希特勒宣布德国重新占领莱茵兰非军事区。1938年3月希特勒宣布德国与奥地利合并。1938年9月希特勒在慕尼黑協定後宣布占领捷克斯洛伐克苏台德地区的部分。
target_text: In March 1935, Hitler announced the restoration of the conscription system and the expansion of the German army, including the naval weapons, armoured troops and air force prohibited by the Treaty of Versailles. In March 1936, Hitler declared Germany ' s reoccupation of the Rhineland demilitarized zone. In March 1938, Hitler declared Germany ' s integration with Austria. In September 1938, after the Munich agreement, Hitler announced the occupation of parts of the Souded region of Czechoslovakia.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 1939年3月希特勒宣布占领捷克斯洛伐克除苏台德地区的其余部分。1939年9月德军闪击波兰，第二次世界大战爆发。评价一般认为虽然一战西线战事绝大部分发生在法国，法国因此遭受了重大损失，但克莱蒙梭的政策仍过分激进，对德国过分苛刻。而且条约是胜利者强加于失败者的和平，是对德国的一种羞辱。时至今日史学界对此仍有不同观点。
target_text: Hitler announced his occupation of Czechoslovakia in March 1939, except for the Sudeten region. In September 1939, the German army struck Poland, and the Second World War broke out.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 凯恩斯在其著作《和約的经济后果》中说，这是“迦太基式的和平”，意即将战胜了德国的法国比作与在布匿战争中战胜了迦太基并将其彻底摧毁的罗马帝国。后来法国经济学家埃蒂涅·曼托索在给凯恩斯的公开信中发表了他的不同观点，并指出凯恩斯的战后预言并未成真，如凯恩斯预言欧洲钢铁产量会下降，实际上1929年的产量较1913年增加了10%，凯恩斯预言德国钢铁产量会下降，实际上1927年德国的钢和铁产量较1913年分别增加了30%和38%，且1913年的数据包括了战后德国割让的领土。又如凯恩斯预言战后德国国内储蓄不会超过20亿马克而实际上1925年的数字是64亿，1927年76亿。凯恩斯预言德国在条约生效30年内无法支付高于20亿马克的赔款，曼托索称在1933年至1939年间德国在重整军备上花费了7倍于此数的金钱。
target_text: In his book, The Economic Consequences of the Peace Agreement, Cairns stated that this was “a Carthage-style peace” and that France was about to prevail over Germany’s Roman Empire, which had defeated Carthage in the war of Bush. Then, in an open letter to Keynes, the French economist Etienne Mantoso expressed his different views and stated that Keynes’ post-war predictions, such as Keynes predicted that European iron and steel production would decline by 10 per cent in 1929 over 1913, Keynes predicted that German steel production would decline by more than DM 2 billion in 1930, that German steel and iron production would increase by 30 per cent and 38 per cent in 1927 over 1913, and that data for 1913 included post-war German-cut territories. And, as Cairns predicted, Germany’s domestic savings would not exceed DM 2 billion in the post-war period, compared to $6.4 billion in 1925 and $7.6 billion in 1927. Keynes predicted that Germany would not pay more than DM 2 billion in compensation within the 30 years of the Treaty’s entry into force, and Mantosee claimed that Germany spent seven times in the period of 1933-1939
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 现在回顾一下，在1919年时德国其实取得了较五年前战争爆发时更有利的战略态势，尤其是德国的东方，原来在经济和军事上都不断膨胀且亲法的俄罗斯帝国消失了，取而代之的是一个外交上孤立，内部纷争不断且卷入内战的苏维埃俄国。在南方，德国的前盟友奥匈帝国分裂为数个弱小的共和国，对德国的再次崛起已经无法构成威胁了。
target_text: It will now be recalled that in 1919 Germany actually achieved a more favourable strategic stance than it did five years ago when the war broke out, especially in the east of Germany, which was once economically and militarily inflated and pro-legal Russian empires disappeared, replaced by a diplomatic isolation, internal strife, and civil war in Soviet Russia. In the South, Germany’s former ally, the Austro-Hungarian Empire, divided a few weak republics, no longer poses a threat to Germany’s re-emergence.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 英国军事史学家科热里·巴尼特声称，与德国所期待的一旦赢得战争后他们强加于协约国的和平条约相比，凡尔赛条约实际上是相当仁慈的。对比布列斯特-立陶夫斯克条约，俄国失去了1/3的人口，一半的工业，90%的煤产地以及60亿马克的战争赔偿。巴尼特同样认为德国在签订条约后的战略态势较1914年更好，以前在德国东方可以起到平衡德国作用的俄罗斯帝国和奥匈帝国消失，而且德国和新生的俄国之间有波兰作为缓冲。在西方只有无论是经济实力还是人口都不如德国的法国和比利时。巴尼特还认为英法两国应通过一种彻底摧毁俾斯麦一手创立的统一的德国并使其重新分裂为多个较弱小的政治实体的方式实现欧洲大陆的永久和平，只有这样做才能彻底解决德国给欧洲带来的麻烦，但英国并未达成自己参战的目的。
target_text: The British military historian Kojeri Barnett claims that the Versailles Treaty is in fact quite humane compared to the peace treaties that Germany expected to impose on the co-contracting countries once it won the war. The Biblest-Litovsk Treaty, with Russia losing a third of its population, half of its industry, 90% of its coal estate, and 6 billion marks of war compensation.
title: 凡尔赛条约

source_text: 该组织于1978年成立，当时名为，为了针对苏联对1975年《赫尔辛基协议》的获利情况。日益壮大后，该组织又以“观察委员会”的名义涉及到世界上的其他地区。1998年，所有委员会在人权观察的旗帜下统一起来。Robert L. Bernstein是该组织的创建者之一，并担任主席。1998年，人权观察作为六个国际非政府组织之一，参与创建了制止使用童兵联盟。人权观察还是国际反地雷组织的联合主席，这个国际小组联盟的成功游说促成了《渥太华条约》的诞生，《渥太华条约》明文禁止杀伤性地雷（反步兵地雷）。
target_text: Founded in 1978, under the name of the “Observatory Committee” in response to the gains made by the Soviet Union to the 1975 Helsinki Agreement. source_text: 2021年3月1日，复旦大学国际关系与公共事务学院教授沈逸表示，人权观察和其他类似组织存在三个最大的问题：“首先，该组织所倡导的人权是工具性的：它只服务于该组织以及美国外交政策和战略背后的力量。其次，该组织对人权的理解是有缺陷的：他们认为，其他国家应该无条件学习美国政治制度，而不考虑其他国家政治、经济和社会发展的利益。第三，该组织已不再是活化石，而是冷战后世界的僵尸；换句话说，它的人权理念在实践中已经破产，它已经死了。”
target_text: On 1 March 2021, Professor Shenzhen, University School of International Relations and Public Affairs, stated that Human Rights Watch and other similar organizations had three of the greatest problems: “First, the human rights that the organization advocates are instrumental: it serves only the strength behind the organization and the United States foreign policy and strategy. 1938年水晶之夜后，纳粹对犹太人的迫害逐步升级，犹太人为避免被抓入集中营，只有离开欧洲，但要想逃离就必须获得外国签证，于是成千上万的犹太人奔走于各国使馆之间申请签证，在当时一张签证就可以拯救一条生命，因而被称为“生命签证”。但1938年7月6日在法国埃維昂萊班召开的国际难民会议上，与会的美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、爱尔兰和新西兰等32国均拒绝接受犹太移民。此时何凤山基于人道主义立场，不顾上司驻德大使陈介的反对，在中華民國驻维也纳领事馆向数以千计的犹太人发放了“生命签证”。从1938年到1940年5月何凤山奉调回国，2年间他共签发多少张“生命签证”其准确数字已无从统计，根据已找到的签证看，一份1938年6月的签证的号码为200号，另一份1938年10月27日的签证号码为1906号，也就是说半年间他共签发了近2000份签证。納粹當局也以總領事館原屬於猶太人房產為由，將總領事館沒收。而在國民政府又拒絕出資租房後，何鳳山自掏腰包在約翰内斯巷22號租下一套小公寓，把總領事館搬到那裏，繼續堅持發放簽證。1939年4月何鳳山被外交部記過一次。

陈介1885年出生于浙江杭州，1902年毕业于杭州府中学堂后，官派留学日本，先就读东京弘文学院、东京第一高等学院、东京帝国大学。1907年又留学德国，在柏林大学学习法政、经济，通晓日语、德语、英语、法语和拉丁语。中華民國1912年成立後歸国，历任工商部商务司长、农商部工商司司长、并兼任國立北京大学、明德大学教授、1916年任国务院参议、山东省实业厅厅长、全国水利局副总裁等职。1928年后历任上海中華滙業銀行、盐业银行经理、1935年任外交部常务次长、1938年任中華民國驻德国大使、1943年任驻巴西大使、1944年任驻墨西哥大使、1945年任驻阿根廷大使，1951年病逝于布宜诺斯艾利斯。
target_text: He was born in 1885 in Zhejiangzhou, graduated from the Hangzhou High School in 1902 and sent to Japan to study, first in Tokyo, Hiroshi University, Tokyo I Higher School, Tokyo Imperial University. He studied in 1907 in Germany, where he studied law, economics, Japanese, German, English, French and Latin at the University of Berlin. After his founding in 1912, China returned to the country as Director of Commerce and Industry of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Director of Commerce and Industry of the Ministry of Agriculture and Commerce of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry of the Republic of China, Professor of the University of Beijing, Minde University of Mind, Minister of State in 1916, Director of Industrial Affairs of Shandong Province and Vice-President of the National Hydraulic Authority. After 1928, he served as Managing Director of the Shanghai Bank, Salt Bank, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1935, Ambassador of China to Germany in 1938, Ambassador to Brazil in 1944, Ambassador to Mexico in 1944, Ambassador to Argentina in 1945, and died of his illness in Buenos Aires in 1951.
title: 陈介

source_text:
精銳化
虽然德国军队的规模受到限制，但德国军方仍然继续研究在一战中的失败经验，并与苏联红军签订《拉帕洛条约》。该秘密条约使得德军可以在苏联领土上与红军合作，研发测试秘密新武器，建设了喀马坦克学校、利佩茨克战斗机飞行员学校、汤姆卡毒气实验场等，为德国培养了坦克和战斗机等大量军事人才。而且，纵使军方被禁止成立参谋部，但他们设立了「部隊局」（Truppendienst），并让它拥有如参谋部一般的功能。这个时候，很多后来如海因茨·古德里安一般成为防卫军领袖的人，早已构思出一些在几年后大派用场的军事计划。
target_text: The secret treaty allowed the German army to cooperate with the Red Army in developing and testing secret new weapons in Soviet territory, building the Kama Tank School, the Lipetsk School of Fighters, the Tomka Gas Laboratory, etc., and training large numbers of German military personnel, such as tanks and fighter jets. And, even though the military was prohibited from establishing the General Staff, they established the "Strupendienst" and gave it functions similar to those of the General Staff.
title: 威瑪防衛軍

source_text: 墨西哥在皇家军队和叛乱分子之间为争取独立而进行了十年的冲突之后，在没有外国干预的情况下，于1821年根据科尔多瓦条约从西班牙帝国获得独立。冲突摧毁了萨卡特卡斯和瓜纳华托的银矿区。墨西哥最初是一个主权国家，其主要出口的未来金融稳定性遭到破坏。墨西哥曾短暂地尝试过君主制，但在1824年成为共和国。这个政府的特点是不稳定，并且在1846年与美国爆发战争时，它没有为一场重大的国际冲突做好准备。墨西哥成功地抵制了西班牙的企图在1820年代重新征服其前殖民地，并在1838年所谓的糕点战争中抵抗法国人，但分裂主义者在德克萨斯州和尤卡坦州反对墨西哥中央集权政府的成功显示了其政治弱点，因为政府多次易手。墨西哥军队和墨西哥天主教会都是拥有保守政治观点的特权机构，在政治上比墨西哥国家更强大。
target_text: Mexico gained independence from the Spanish Empire in 1821, without foreign intervention, after a decade of conflict between the Royal Army and the rebels for independence. The conflict destroyed the silver mines of Zacatecas and Guanajuato. Mexico was originally a sovereign country, with its main export, whose future financial stability was undermined. Mexico briefly tried the monarchy, but became a republic in 1824. The government was characterized by instability and, when the war broke out with the United States in 1846, it was not prepared for a major international conflict.
title: 美墨戰爭

source_text:
19世纪，美國國内流行昭昭天命政治口号
，其中一層含義就是美國人是“天選之民”必須要擴張領土與勢力，傳播他們的價值觀。美国1803年购买路易斯安那导致西班牙殖民地与美国之间的边界直接接壤，但很多地方并不不明确。美国和西班牙之间的一些边界问题通过1818年的《亚当斯-奥尼斯条约》得到解决。美国谈判代表约翰·昆西·亚当斯希望明确拥有东部佛罗里达州和美国在北纬42度线以上提出主权要求，而西班牙试图限制美国向现在的美国西南部扩张。从1825年开始，美国试图从墨西哥购买领土，以解决其中的一些问题。美国总统安德鲁杰克逊持续努力获得墨西哥北部领土，但没有成功。
target_text: In the 19th century, America’s popular political slogan, one of which is that Americans are “the people of the sky” who must expand their lands and power and spread their values. The US buys Louisiana in 1803, which led to a direct border between the Spanish colony and the US, but much of it is not clear. Some border issues between the US and Spain were resolved through the 1818 Adams-Onis Treaty.
title: 美墨戰爭

source_text:
墨西哥北部的分裂倾向
无论是殖民地墨西哥还是新主权的墨西哥国家都没有有效控制墨西哥的遥远的北部和西部。墨西哥于1821年从西班牙获得独立后，其军事和外交能力下降，并使该国北部的一半地区容易受到科曼奇人、阿帕奇人和纳瓦霍印第安人的攻击。尤其是科曼奇人，利用墨西哥国家的弱点，向该国数百英里的范围内进行大规模突袭，以获取牲畜供自己使用，并供应得克萨斯州和美国不断扩大的市场。
target_text: Mexico, after gaining independence from Spain in 1821, reduced its military and diplomatic capabilities and made half of the northern part of the country vulnerable to attacks by the Comanche, Apache, and Navajo Indians. In particular, the Comanche, taking advantage of the weakness of the Mexican state, carried out large-scale raids within hundreds of miles of the country to obtain livestock for their own use and to supply the expanding markets of Texas and the United States.
title: 美墨戰爭

source_text: 1834年，墨西哥保守派掌握了政治主动权，安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安娜将军成为墨西哥的中央集权总统。保守派主导的国会放弃了联邦制，取而代之的是一个单一的中央政府，取消了各州的权力。将政治留给墨西哥城的人，圣安娜将军率领墨西哥军队推翻了得克萨斯州的半独立状态。他在科阿韦拉做到了这一点（1824年，墨西哥将德克萨斯和科阿韦拉合并为庞大的科阿韦拉和特哈斯州）。奥斯汀号召得克萨斯人武装起来，他们于1836年宣布从墨西哥独立。圣安娜在阿拉莫战役中击败德克萨斯人后，他被山姆休斯顿将军指挥的得克萨斯军队击败，并在圣哈辛托战役中被俘。作为交换，圣安娜与得克萨斯州总统大卫·伯内特签署了结束战争并承认得克萨斯独立的条约。该条约没有得到墨西哥国会的批准，因为它是由一名俘虏在胁迫下签署的。尽管墨西哥拒绝承认得克萨斯独立，但得克萨斯巩固了其作为独立共和国的地位，并得到了英国、法国和美国的正式承认，它们都建议墨西哥不要试图重新征服这个新国家。大多数得克萨斯人想加入合众国，但吞并得克萨斯在美国国会引起争议，辉格党和废奴主义者在很大程度上遭到反对。1845年，得克萨斯同意美国国会提出的兼并提议并于1845年12月29日成为第28个州，直接引发了美国和墨西哥的冲突。
target_text: In 1834, the conservatives of Mexico took control of the political initiative, and General Antonio López de Santa Ana became the central president of Mexico. The conservative-led Congress abandoned the federal system and replaced it with a single central government, eliminating the powers of the states. The people who left politics to Mexico City, General Santa Ana, led by the Mexican army, were defeated in Texas. He did so in Coahuila (1824, Mexico merged Texas and Coavira into the vast State of Coavira and Texas). Austin called on the Texas people to be armed and declared independence from Mexico in 1836.
title: 美墨戰爭

source_text: 根据德克萨斯人在圣哈辛托战役后俘获圣安娜将军后签订的贝拉斯科条约，德克萨斯州的南部边界被划为“北里奥格兰德”。德克萨斯人声称这将南部边界置于现代的格兰德河。墨西哥政府基于两个理由对这一安排提出异议：首先，它拒绝德克萨斯独立的想法；其次，它声称条约中的格兰德河实际上是努埃西斯河，因为现在的格兰德河在墨西哥一直被称为“RioBravo”。然而，后者的说法掩盖了墨西哥河流的全名：“RioBravodelNorte”。1841年不幸的德克萨斯圣达菲探险队试图实现对格兰德河以东新墨西哥领土的要求，但其成员被墨西哥军队俘虏并监禁。在吞并条约在参议院失败后，美国国会的吞并决议中省略了对德克萨斯州格兰德河边界的提及，以帮助确保通过。波尔克总统声称格兰德河边界，当墨西哥派兵越过格兰德河时，这引发了一场争端。
target_text: The Mexican Government objected to this arrangement on two grounds: first, it rejected Texas’s idea of independence; secondly, it claimed that the Grand River in the treaty was actually the Nuecis River, because the current Grand River was known in Mexico as “Rio Bravo”; however, the latter’s claim masked the entire Mexican river’s full name, “Rio Bravodel Norte.” In 1841, the unfortunate Texas Santa Fe expedition attempted to fulfil its demands on New Mexican territory east of the Grand River, but its members were captured and imprisoned by Mexican troops. After the collapse of the annexation treaty in the Senate, the Congress of the United States omitted a reference to the border of the Grand River in Texas to help ensure passage.
title: 美墨戰爭

source_text: 由于美国军队占领了墨西哥首都和大部分腹地，谈判和平条约是一件迫在眉睫的事情，佩尼亚和佩纳为此离任。佩德罗·玛丽亚·安纳亚于1847年11月13日至1848年1月8日重返总统职位。安纳亚拒绝签署任何将土地割让给美国的条约，尽管美国占领了首都。佩尼亚和佩纳于1848年1月8日至1848年6月3日重新担任总统，在此期间签署了瓜达卢佩伊达尔戈条约，以此结束了战争。
target_text: As the United States forces occupied the capital and most of the interior of Mexico, it was urgent to negotiate a peace treaty, which led to the departure of Peña and Peña. Pedro María Anaya returned to the presidency from 13 November 1847 to 8 January 1848. Anaía refused to sign any treaty to cede land to the United States, despite the fact that the United States occupied the capital. Pénia and Peña resumed the presidency from 8 January to 3 June 1848, during which time the Guadalupeidalgo Treaty was signed, putting an end to the war.
title: 美墨戰爭

source_text:
影响
历史学家在《》称，五月革命对社会的主要影响是人民与统治者之间的关系的范式转变。在那之前，最盛行的是共同利益，即君主权威得到尊重，但西班牙王室的命令如果有损当地居民的共同利益，那命令就不会被执行或者部分执行。随着革命，莫雷诺、或等人提倡的人民主权取代了共同利益。他们认为在没有合法权威的情况下，人民有权指定统治者。随着时间的推移，人民主权变为多數決原則。
target_text: According to historians, the main impact of the May revolution on society was a paradigm shift in relations between the people and the rulers. Until then, the most prevalent was the common interest, that is, the sovereign authority was respected, but the Spanish royal order would not be implemented or partially enforced if it was detrimental to the common interests of the local population.
title: 五月革命

source_text: 联合国艾滋病规划署（，缩写UNAIDS）是全球范围内组织、推广及协调世界艾滋病运动的机构。规划署旨在唤起全球对艾滋病的认识并作出承诺，其目的在于充分发挥联合国系统的多样性，使其成为全球150多个国家强有力的和独特的合作伙伴，以减缓艾滋病流行及减轻其对发展造成的影响。
target_text: The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS), a global organization that organizes, promotes and coordinates the World AIDS Campaign, aims to generate global awareness and commitment to AIDS, with the aim of maximizing the diversity of the United Nations system as a strong and unique partner in more than 150 countries around the world in order to reduce the epidemic and its impact on development.
title: 联合国艾滋病联合规划署

source_text: 作为联合国系统新机制的尝试者和改革的先行者，成立于1996年1月的联合国艾滋病规划署通过其六个发起组织并以他们的名义开展工作。这六个发起组织是：联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）、联合国开发计划署（UNDP）、联合国人口基金（UNFPA）、联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）、世界卫生组织（WHO）和世界银行，总部均设在瑞士日内瓦。
target_text: The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS), established in January 1996 as a pilot and leader of the new United Nations system mechanism, works on their behalf and through its six sponsoring organizations: the United Nations Children ' s Fund (UNICEF), the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA), the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), the World Health Organization (WHO) and the World Bank, both based in Geneva, Switzerland.
title: 联合国艾滋病联合规划署

source_text: 1996年，联合国艾滋病规划署于北京设立办事处，其政府归口协调单位为卫健委。中國还成立了由各部门高层领导组成的多部门协调委员会，在国务院的领导下定期召开会议。联合国艾滋病规划署驻华办事处的主要职责是协调和提供支持，包括开发和宣传倡导，资源动员，追踪艾滋病的流行趋势及其相关行动评估，促进信息的有效交流，增强合作伙伴关系，以支持中国的艾滋病防治工作。
target_text: In 1996, UNAIDS established its office in Beijing, and its government focal point is the Commission. China has also established a multisectoral coordination committee, composed of senior heads of departments, which meets regularly under the leadership of the State Council. The main responsibilities of the UNAIDS office in China are to coordinate and provide support, including development and advocacy, resource mobilization, tracking trends in the AIDS epidemic and related assessments of action, promoting effective exchange of information and strengthening partnerships in support of the fight against AIDS in China.
title: 联合国艾滋病联合规划署

source_text: 黃志芳（），現任國際自由聯盟副主席，中華民國對外貿易發展協會董事長，職業外交官出身（公務員資格），臺灣臺南市人。曾任外交部部長、總統府副秘書長及總統府公共事務室主任，2015年加入民主進步黨、擔任民進黨國際事務部主任，2016年出任總統府新南向政策辦公室主任，2017年轉任中華民國對外貿易發展協會董事長。
target_text: Huang Zhifan, current Vice-President of the International Confederation of Free Trade Unions, Chairman of the China-China Association for Foreign Trade and Development, professional diplomat of Taiwan City (competent civil servant), former Minister of Foreign Affairs, Deputy Secretary of the Office of the President of the Republic and Director of the Public Affairs Department of the Office of the President of the Republic, member of the Democratic Progressive Party in 2015, head of the International Affairs Department of the Democratic Progressive Party of the Democratic Progressive Party, head of the New South Policy Office of the Office of the President of the Republic in 2016, and member of the Board of Directors of the China-China Association for Foreign Trade and Development in 2017.
title: 黃志芳

source_text:
早年生平
黃志芳畢業於臺南一中；就讀國立臺灣大學時原為農業工程系，大二時轉入政治系國際關係組。中華民國外交特考第18期合格，後進入外交部任職，1985年擔任當時外交部常務次長程建人的「機要秘書」、駐英國代表處薦任主事，1986年任外交部北美司科員，1991年擔任駐美代表處國會組秘書，1996年任北美司第一科科長、專門委員。1999年轉調陸委會，擔任聯絡處副處長、專門委員、研究委員，多次出席亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）幕僚工作會議。2002年獲蔡英文推薦出任總統府公共事務室主任，2004年躍升總統府副祕書長，深獲當時總統陳水扁賞識。
target_text: An early year, Huang Chifan graduated from the University of Taiwan in mid-Tainan, and became a member of the Department of Agricultural Engineering at the University of Taiwan, where he was transferred to the Department of International Relations at the second grade. In 1999, the National Committee for Transition, which was the Deputy Director-General of the Liaison Office, a member of the Special Committee, and a research committee, took up his post in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1985 as the Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs' Permanent Deputy Chief Executive Officer, and was recommended by the United Kingdom's Representative to head the North American Department of Foreign Affairs in 1986; in 1991, he served as Secretary of the United States Secretariat of Representatives; and in 1996, he was the First Chief of the North American Department, a member of the Special Committee on International Relations; in 1999, he served as Deputy Director of the Liaison Office, a member of the Special Committee, a research committee and a member of the Council of Directors of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation Council (APEC); in 2002, he was recommended as Director of the Public Affairs Department of the Office of the President of Foreign Affairs; and in 2004, he promoted the Vice-Secretary of the Office of the President of the President of the United States
title: 黃志芳

source_text:
外交部長
2006年1月，黃志芳獲陳水扁總統拔擢出任外交部長，2007年4月30日，中華民國成功與西印度群島島國聖露西亞復交，並全面恢復大使級關係，該國為中華民國第25個邦交國。2007年6月7日，哥斯大黎加宣布與中華人民共和國建交而與中華民國斷交，黃請辭外交部長負起政治責任，獲行政院長張俊雄慰留。2008年1月14日，中華民國與馬拉威斷交。
target_text: On 7 June 2007, Costa Rica announced a cut off from the People’s Republic of China to the People’s Republic of China. On 30 April 2007, the People’s Republic of China successfully resumed relations with the West Indies, Saint Lucia, and fully restored its ambassadorship, the country’s twenty-fifth state. On 14 January 2008, the People’s Republic of China and Malawi broke up their relations with the People’s Republic of China.
title: 黃志芳

source_text:
2008年5月6日，因「巴紐外交公款侵吞案」爆發，黃志芳為承擔責任請辭下台。卸任後
2010年5月10日，新加坡法院就「巴紐案」判決認定中華民國外交部遭到外交掮客訛詐，此外中華民國法院判決認定黃志芳與邱義仁等人並未涉及收賄或經費入帳問題。2015年1月21日，黃志芳在民進黨秘書長吳釗燮陪同下向傳媒宣布加入民進黨，並接任民進黨國際事務部主任，被外界視為對民進黨主席蔡英文經營民進黨與美國關係有所幫助。
target_text: On May 6, 2008, Huang Chifan resigned from office in connection with the outbreak of the “Pano misappropriation” of diplomatic funds. On May 10, 2010, following his resignation, the Singapore court ruled that the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs had been defrauded by diplomatic brokers, and that the Chinese court had found that Huang Zhifan and Qiu Yi-in had not been involved in collecting or paying for money. On January 21, 2015, Huang Zhifan, accompanied by the secretary-general of the PNP, announced to the media that he would join the PNP and take over as head of the PNP's International Affairs Department, and was seen by the outside world as helping the PNP President, Mr. Tsai’s relationship with the US.
title: 黃志芳

source_text: 事件线索2005年9月17日，丹麥《政治家報》（Politiken）以「批評伊斯蘭的深層恐懼」為題，報道丹麥作家哥勒·布律根在找尋畫家為他關於穆罕默德的兒童讀物繪畫插圖時，基於畫家恐懼遭受極端伊斯蘭教徒襲擊，而遇到困難。9月30日，丹麦銷量最大的日報《日德蘭郵報》刊登了12幅描绘穆罕默德的漫画。該報的文化版編輯費林明·羅斯（Flemming Rose）表示，這是呼應布律根找不到插畫師的事。当天报社就接到几个以死威胁电话。10月14日，3,500 人在《日德兰邮报》哥本哈根分社门前举行和平示威。漫画家当中的两人在接到死亡威胁后接受建议转入地下。10月19日，十一位伊斯兰国家的駐丹麦大使约见丹麦首相安諾斯·福格·拉斯穆森，希望他与《日德兰邮报》刊登的漫画以及丹麦媒体上的其他对伊斯兰教不友善的言论保持距离。首相以言论自由不得干预为理由谢绝会见这些大使。10月20日，伊斯蘭團體向首相拉斯穆森表達不滿。12月19日，二十二位退休丹麦大使批评首相拉斯穆森拒绝会见十一位伊斯兰国家大使。2006年1月6日，丹麥日德蘭維堡地方檢察官決定就「公開汙辱宗教信條」、「藉個人信仰而汙辱特定族群」等兩項刑事罪名，免予偵查及起訴。該項決定的理由是，沒有足够理由質疑《日德蘭郵報》的行為對國家造成犯罪，同時言論自由必須得到保障。1月10日，挪威一报纸刊登了这些漫画。1月26日，沙特阿拉伯召回駐丹麦大使以示抗議。

source_text: 《排华法案》是议员Horace F. Page提出，美国總統切斯特·艾倫·阿瑟于1882年5月6日签署的一项法案，成為《美国法典》的一部分。美国两党人士均參與了對該法案的推動。此法案为1880年对《天津条约续增条约》的修订，允许美国暂停华人移民。国会根据修订的条约，很快就制定了这項法案。
target_text: Congressman Horace F. Page proposed a bill signed by US President Chester Allen Arthur on 6 May 1882 as part of the United States Code. source_text: 两国联军则公然无视皇帝权威，开入该公国境内。火上浇油的是，哈布斯堡家族的死敌、波旁王朝的法王亨利四世和荷兰共和国次年初分别派出两万多人的军队支援新教联军，以期彻底切断西班牙军道。不料亨利四世于当年5月14日遇刺身亡，而天主教各诸侯也害怕战争由小规模冲突升级为大规模宗教战争而拒绝参战，才避免战争进一步扩大。皇帝把公国完整地封给萨克森公爵克里斯蒂安二世的决定在1610年5月在布拉格召开的会议上被否决，而联军虽然军事占领了公国，但财力耗尽且得不到各方势力的承认。1612年6月鲁道夫二世之弟、新任神圣罗马帝国皇帝马蒂亚斯即位后确认了把公国封给萨克森的决定，导致形式再次紧张，但由于西吉斯蒙德改信加尔文宗而沃尔夫冈-威廉皈依天主教，勃兰登堡候国和普法尔茨-诺伊堡伯爵国在1614年初时已经断绝了官方往来。因此，当年5月战端重开的时候，前者与其大金主荷兰共和国并肩作战，后者则协助人称“伟大将领”（西班牙文：El Gran Capitán）的热那亚人安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉侯爵麾下的西班牙军队。同年10月交战双方在英法调停下开始和谈并于次月签订克桑滕条约，条约规定普法尔茨-诺伊堡伯爵国获得于利希和贝尔格两公国，以及位于今荷兰南部的拉文施泰因；和则归勃兰登堡候国所有。

source_text: 尽管马克西米利安四世约瑟夫同情法国大革命，但巴伐利亚的军事和财政状况让他根本无法摆脱奥地利的控制。1800年12月，法军在霍亨林登戰役中击败奥地利-巴伐利亚联军后，让·维克多·莫罗率领的法军再次占领慕尼黑。1801年2月9日，法国与神圣罗马帝国签订《吕内维尔条约》，巴伐利亚失去了莱茵-普法尔茨、和于利希公国（虽然条约第七款中提到要给予巴伐利亚领土补偿）。奥地利这种完全不把巴伐利亚的利益放在眼里的行为促使巴伐利亚于同年8月跟法国秘密签订了和平同盟条约，转而与法国结盟，而当时担任第一执政的拿破仑则承诺用于补偿巴伐利亚的领土将从神圣罗马帝国获取。
target_text: In December 1800, after the French army defeated the Austrian-Bavaria coalition in the Battle of Hohelinden, Jean Victor Morrow’s French army reoccupied Munich. On 9 February 1801, France signed the Treaty of Reneville with the Holy Roman Empire, where Bavaria lost Rhine-Pfaltz, and the Ulysses (although paragraph 7 of the Treaty refers to compensation for Bavaria’s territory). Austria’s total disregard for Bavaria’s interests prompted Bavaria’s clandestine signing of the Treaty of Peace with France in August of the same year and its alliance with France, while Napoleon, then the first in power, promised that the territory of Bavaria would be taken from the Holy Roman Empire.
title: 维特尔斯巴赫王朝

source_text: 巴伐利亚则将1803年获得的维尔茨堡选侯国（次年8月神圣罗马帝国解散后被升格为维尔茨堡大公国）让给费迪南三世作为补偿。此外，巴伐利亚还从奥地利获得了蒂罗尔、福拉尔贝格、布尔高侯国、霍恩埃姆斯和柯尼赛格-罗腾菲尔斯伯爵国、阿根、特南和林道等领土。条约还规定神圣罗马帝国须承认巴伐利亚和符腾堡为王国并尊重其主权。1806年1月1日，巴伐利亚选帝候马克西米利安四世约瑟夫即位为首任巴伐利亚国王（史称马克西米利安一世约瑟夫）。作为政治交换，他不太情愿地把女儿奥古斯塔公主许配给拿破仑第一任妻子约瑟芬皇后与前夫所生的独子欧仁·德·博阿尔内。此外，长支的另一个旁支普法尔茨-茨魏布吕肯-比肯费尔德支-克里伯格支在继承瑞典王位的同时统治（1654-1719年）。
target_text: In addition, Bavaria received from Austria the territory of Tirol, Vorarlberg, Burgoho, Hornems, and Cornises-Rottenfields. The treaty also provided for the sacred Roman Empire to recognize Bavaria and Vürttemberg as kingdoms and respect for their sovereignty. On 1 January 1806, Bavarian chose the first King of Bavaria (St. Maximian I.) as King Bavarian. source_text: 蔣中正對於塞克特的建議書稱「敬佩不已」，請求其於德國幫忙物色各類顧問，並告知魏澤爾的總顧問職位保留，但該人不在時亦可由一位「高級顧問」代理，這實際上也暗示塞克特，蔣中正希望由後者出任此職，並賦予其比魏澤爾更大的權力。1933年11月2日，塞克特返回德國不久，朱家驊便代表蔣致函給塞克特，正式邀請他來華擔任顧問。然而當時德國夾在關係已很緊張的中國和日本之間，處於既想擴大在華影響力、又想從日本佔領中國東北而設立的傀儡政權——滿洲國中獲得利益的尷尬境地，因此對華政策十分謹慎，在德國外交部長康斯坦丁·馮·紐賴特要求下，塞克特便以年事已高為由謝絕中方的邀請，同時也推薦兩名退役軍官——亞歷山大·馮·法肯豪森與赴華擔任蔣的顧問。從德國軍方來看，與中國密切交往對自身重整軍備有直接性的好處，包括對華軍火輸出有助於國內兵工廠的發展，以及取得德國急需的戰略原料，如鎢、銻（這些原料在歐洲都被英國嚴格控制著），還能強化德國顧問團的影響力，然而國防部長维尔纳·冯·勃洛姆堡受外交部影響，最初亦頗遲疑。最終，蔣堅持要塞克特本人來華，並透過中國駐德大使館向德國外交部施壓，不惜語帶威脅地稱將聘請法國顧問、解聘當前所有的德籍顧問。
target_text: On November 2, 1933, Secht’s representative sent a letter to Seckt’s former Foreign Minister, formally inviting him to come to China, but in his absence he could also be represented by a “high-level” adviser, suggesting that Seckt, who wanted to be appointed by his successor, would be given greater authority than Weisel’s. source_text: 希特勒聞塞克特即將返國，特派一名將軍前去德國與瑞士邊境迎接。希特勒於總理府聽取塞克特的對華工作經驗，後者建議德國應有對華固定友好政策，希特勒當下笑然接納。歷史學者傅寶真認為，由於當時興登堡總統逝世不久，希特勒尚無法完全控制陸軍，故多與塞克特和其他將領有所聯絡，爭取其好感以利鞏固納粹政權。塞克特亦發揮影響力，讓中德外交關係從公使館升為大使館，並將德駐華使館自北平遷至南京，此為中國國民政府多年要求卻未成功者，也時常為中方代表團引介希特勒，為中德間重要聯絡人。

source_text: 战略对话指的是国际上的双方（或多方），就重大的、关键性的问题进行交换态度、沟通意见的外交活动。议题可以涉及政治、经济、外交等诸多方面，也可扩展到防务、金融、环保等其他专业领域。同时，议题涉及的对象也不限于对话各方。可以说，只要对话双方感兴趣的问题，都有机会成为议题。战略对话不一定是双方领导人会晤，双方相关高层官员对话的情形更普遍些。
target_text: Strategic dialogue refers to a diplomatic exchange of views and opinions on important and critical issues at the international level. The issues can be political, economic, diplomatic, or other areas of specialization, such as defence, finance, and environmental protection.
title: 战略对话

source_text: 战略对话有助于加深彼此信任，减少对话双方的误判与敌对，增进国际关系的务实化。战略对话是一种积极的国际间的互动形式。中美外交中的战略对话中华人民共和国方面将2005年8月开始，目前仍在进行的多轮中美对话称作“战略对话”（Strategic Dialogue），而美国一方称为“高层对话”（Senior Dialogue），原因是美方认为只有与盟友的相关对话才能称为“战略对话”。
target_text: Strategic dialogue helps to deepen mutual trust, reduce miscalculation and hostility on both sides of the dialogue, and enhances the pragmatism of international relations. Strategic dialogue is a positive form of international interaction. The China side of strategic dialogue in Chinese-American diplomacy will begin in August 2005, and the many ongoing rounds of Chinese-American dialogue will be called the “Strategic Dialogue” (Strategic Dialogue), while the United States side will be called the “Senior Dialogue” because the United States believes that only related dialogue with allies can be called the “Strategic Dialogue”.
title: 战略对话

source_text: 外交代表機構，通常稱為使領館或領使館等，是一個國家駐外外交人員居住與工作的地方，可分為大使館、公使館、高級專員公署、领事馆等種類，外交代表機構通常設在另一國的首都或重要城市。在國際法的規範下，外交代表機構應享有治外法權，虽然外交代表機構的所在地實際上仍属駐在國領土，但其內部空間则被視為當事國領土的一部份。此外，属于外交代表机构之外交人員依照维也纳外交关系公约享有免受派駐在国法律制裁之保障，外交人員亦只須交付等同於本國稅率的相關稅金予駐在國。
target_text: Diplomatic representations, commonly referred to as embassies or embassies, are places of residence and work for foreign diplomats abroad, which can be divided into embassies, embassies, high-level government offices, consulates, etc. Diplomatic representatives are usually located in another country’s capital or in important cities. Under international law, diplomatic representatives are subject to extraterritorial jurisdiction, and while diplomatic representatives are in fact located in the country’s territory, their internal space is regarded as part of the territory of the country concerned. Moreover, diplomats who are members of diplomatic missions are guaranteed immunity from the laws of their country, in accordance with the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, and diplomatic agents are only required to pay taxes corresponding to their national tax rates.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text:
外交代表机构分类根据1815年维也纳会议上通过的《关于外交人员等级的章程》，外交代表分为三类，即大使、公使和代办，因此外交代表机构也对应为大使馆、公使馆和代辦處三级。另外不屬於前三類的為領事館，主要處理領務與商務事宜。大使馆
等级最高的外交代表机构，其称大使。
target_text: The classification of diplomatic representations is based on the Charter on Diplomatic Grades adopted at the Vienna Conference of 1815, which divides diplomatic representatives into three categories, namely, ambassadors, ministers and deputies, so that diplomatic representations should also be at the level of embassies, embassies and correspondent offices. The other three categories do not fall under the first three categories, namely, consulates, which deal primarily with matters of responsibility and business. The highest rank of diplomatic representatives in embassies is called ambassadors.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 英文「embassy」一詞普遍指大使與職員的辦事處。就嚴格法理而言，「embassy」指外交代表團本身，其辦公地點則稱為「chancery」，但實際上很少人會這樣區分。大使通常居住在大使官邸，大使官邸可设置于大使馆的院區范围，也可设置于大使馆之外的街區，但官邸享有大使館的相同權利。
target_text: The English term “embassy” refers generally to the work of the ambassador and his staff. In strict jurisprudence, “embassy” refers to the diplomatic corps itself, whose place of business is called “chancery,” but in fact very few people do so. The ambassador usually resides in the Ambassador’s residence, which can be located in the area of the embassy’s courtyard, or in a street area outside the embassy, but the residence has the same rights as the embassy.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 各国也可以向国际组织派遣外交代表，如驻欧盟大使、驻联合国大使等。这些大使在驻在国（比如比利时和美国）享有与其他国家外交人員完全相同的权利。欧盟也向某些国家派出大使，但联合国没有单独的驻各国大使，而是设立相关的外交代表处。
target_text: States may also send diplomatic representatives to international organizations, such as ambassadors to the European Union, ambassadors to the United Nations, etc. These ambassadors have the same rights as foreign diplomats in countries where they are based (e.g. Belgium and the United States). The EU also sends ambassadors to certain countries, but the United Nations does not have separate ambassadors to countries, but has established relevant diplomatic offices.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 其它例外，如英联邦国家之间的外交代表机构称「」。所有成員國駐聯合國的使節團均稱，其最高代表為「常駐代表」與大使。教廷（梵蒂冈）派驻别国的外交代表称「教廷大使」（Apostolic Nuncio），其办公机构称「教廷大使馆」或「宗座代表驻地」（Apostolic Nunciature）。利比亞的使節駐外機構在1980年代和1990年代曾稱「人民辦事處」，其最高代表稱為「秘書」（现已改回一般命名）。
target_text: Other exceptions, such as the Foreign Representation of Commonwealth countries, are called "it" by all members of the diplomatic corps accredited to the United Nations, whose highest representatives are known as "the Permanent Representative" and the Ambassador. The diplomatic representatives of the Holy See (the Vatican) accredited to other countries refer to Apostolic Nuncio, whose offices are known as the "Ambassador of the Holy See" or "the Pontifical Representative Office" (Apostolic Nunciature).
title: 外交代表機構

source_text:
公使馆
等级次于大使馆的外交代表机构，館長称公使。第二次世界大战后，各国之间的外交代表级别普遍由公使提升为大使，公使馆也升格为大使馆。代办处
等级最低的国家间外交代表机构，其主事称代办。代办处的外交人员仍享有完全的外交权益，并受外交关系公约保障。
target_text: After the Second World War, diplomatic representation between countries was generally promoted by a minister to an ambassador, and by an embassy to an embassy. The office-in-charge of the lowest-ranking inter-state diplomatic representation, the office-in-charge of which is the office-in-charge, continues to enjoy full diplomatic interests and is guaranteed by the conventions governing diplomatic relations.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 領事館與外交機構相似，但與其並不等同，在《維也納外交關係公約》有清晰的界定。領事館主要處理個人與商務事宜，例如簽證、護照等旅行證件發放、文書驗證及領事保護等。駐外領事通常派駐在一國首都以外的地區（通常是大城市以及該國人經常前往、僑民聚居的城市）。如英國駐美大使館設在華盛頓，而領事館則設在洛杉磯、紐約與休斯敦等。但各國駐荷兰的外交機構卻是反例，在首都阿姆斯特丹頂多設有總領事館，大使館幾乎都設於荷蘭政府所在地海牙。一些規模較小或業務量少的駐在國，可能以大使館內設立領事部門的方式提供領事服務，而不另設領事館。
target_text: The consulates are similar to, but not identical to, diplomatic agencies. They are clearly defined in the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 外交代表機構的職責是在國際法許可下保護本國在派駐地的利益，代表本國與派駐地的政府進行談判，使用合法的手段取得派駐地的情報，在派駐地進行促進兩國友好的活動，並且發展兩國的經貿、文化與科學合作。使馆除了行使外交职责外，还可以同时办理领事事务。
target_text: The functions of diplomatic missions are to protect the country’s interests in the field, as permitted by international law, to negotiate on behalf of the country’s government, to use legal means to obtain information about the location, to carry out activities to promote friendship between the two countries, and to develop trade, culture and scientific cooperation between the two countries. In addition to exercising diplomatic duties, embassies can also conduct consular affairs.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 英联邦成員國的外交代表機構有著一個附加職責，其會為英联邦的其它成員國的公民提供外交服務，前提是受助公民的國家與欲聯繫國家沒有外交關係；歐盟成員國的外交代表機構亦有此類附加的職責。（例如：南非公民如果需要取得與泰国相關的外交服務時，可以到加拿大外交機構尋求協助）
target_text: The diplomatic representations of the Commonwealth member states have an additional duty to provide diplomatic services to citizens of other Commonwealth member states, provided that the recipient country has no diplomatic relations with the country that wants to be contacted; the diplomatic representations of the European Union member states have such an additional duty. (For example, South African citizens may seek assistance from Canadian diplomatic agencies if they need diplomatic services related to Thailand.)
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 在两国因战争或其他原因而宣布终止外交关系时，通常关闭互相派驻的外交代表机构。派遣国可以委托第三国在其驻在国的外交机构代管其外交利益。即使兩國發生爭論，召回駐另一國的大使以示不滿仍是較為少見的。不過召回大使的手段已較斷絕外交關係溫和，而使節團仍會或多或少地運作，由權力有限的大使銜代辦暫為處理。值得注意是在兩個大使交接期間，一個「過渡時期大使銜代辦」可能會被任命為看守人，而這並不意味著對派駐國的敵意。派遣国由于经济或安全原因关闭驻外外交代表机构并不影响与驻在国之间的外交关系。
target_text: Even in the case of disputes between the two countries, the recall of ambassadors to another country is less satisfying. But the methods used to recall ambassadors have been more or less severed, and the group will operate more or less under the authority of a limited number of ambassadors. It is worth noting that during the exchange of two ambassadors, a “missing ambassador” may be appointed as a caretaker, which does not mean an enemy of the sending country.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 中華民國因中華人民共和國抵制而成為未被國際普遍承認的國家，故除了中華民國設立之駐邦交國大使館及若干總領事、領事館外，駐美國、日本、英國、法國、德國、俄罗斯、加拿大、新加坡、澳大利亚及其他非正式邦交國家的代表機構通常稱為「臺北經濟文化代表處」（或「台北代表處」），雖然正式機構稱謂並非大使館，但經由中華民國外交部之官方授權及與駐在國之平等互惠或互設代表機構，可行使大使館或等同之外交機構的相關職責，如核發签证、中華民國護照及相關文書正式認證等。
target_text: The Chinese People's Republic of China has become a non-internationally recognized country as a result of the boycott of the People's Republic of China, so that, in addition to the embassies and consulates established by the Chinese People's Republic of China, representatives of institutions in the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Russia, Canada, Singapore, Australia and other non-official states, often referred to as the “Taibei Economic and Cultural Representative Office” (or the “Taiwan Representative Office”), official institutions, which are not ambassadors, may exercise the functions associated with embassies or other diplomatic institutions, such as the granting of visas, China's national passport and the official accreditation of correspondence with the Chinese People's Republic of China, which are authorized by the official authority of the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs and equal reciprocity or mutual representation of the United States.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 非正式邦交國家如美國會給予「臺北經濟文化代表處」及其外交人員，享有等同「國際組織及其人員」或是其他名義的有限度外交禮遇。而相對地，無正式邦交國駐中華民國的機構，會以「駐台北辦事處」或「在台協會」等非官方名義運作。其駐中華民國代表相當於大使，通常由該國外交部門選擇退休外交官（許多曾擔任駐外大使）或是名義上暫時脫離該國公務人員身分的外交官擔任。而駐中華民國之代表機構也會受到中華民國外交部的特殊禮遇，例如使用、派駐警察保護等。
target_text: Non-official states, like the US, give the “Taiwan Economic and Cultural Representative” and its diplomatic staff a limited diplomatic courtesy equivalent of “international organizations and their personnel” or others. On the other hand, non-official state agencies in China operate under unofficial names such as the “Taiwan Office” or the “Taiwan Council.” Its representatives in China are equivalent to ambassadors, usually elected by the Foreign Office of the country’s retired diplomats (many of whom have served as ambassadors abroad) or temporarily removed from the country’s official capacity.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text:
其他
事實存在的這些外交機構很多是只被稱為代表機構或代表使節。如被認為是土耳其傀儡政權的北塞普勒斯土耳其共和國派駐美國首都華盛頓的使節團；索马里兰在伦敦、罗马、亚的斯亚贝巴與華盛頓的使節團；納戈爾諾-加拉巴赫駐華盛頓的使節團均只被稱為代表機構。
target_text: Many of the other diplomatic structures that exist are called mere representative bodies or representatives. For example, the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, which is considered to be a puppet regime in Turkey, is sent to Washington, DC; Somaliland, Rome, Addis Ababa, and Washington, D.C.; and Nagorny-Garabah, which is only called representative bodies.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text:
未建交国家
與、
美國與朝鲜目前並沒有任何外交關係，但因朝鲜為聯合國會員國之一，在紐約設有駐聯合國代表團，此代表團同時也是與美國的非正式對話管道，被稱為「紐約渠道」。另外美國也未同伊朗正式建交，故以第三國（如瑞士）從中與雙方交涉對外事宜，或是在當地設立非正式使館規格的代表機構；美国设立“瑞士驻伊朗大使馆美国利益代表处”作为美国在伊朗的非正式代表机构。
target_text: The United States has no diplomatic relations with the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and the United States does not currently have any diplomatic relations with the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, but, because the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea is a member of the United Nations, has a United Nations delegation in New York, which is also known as the “New York channel” for informal conversations with the United States. Nor has the United States entered into an official relationship with Iran, so that the third country (e.g. Switzerland) deals with foreign affairs from China or has set up an informal embassy representative structure in the country; and the United States has established the “Swiss Embassy in Iran’s United States Interests Office” as the United States’s informal representative agency in Iran.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text:
非常任外交代表
常驻一国的外交代表同时可兼驻两个国家或多个国家的外交代表。一些国家由于经济、政治或業務需求原因，在與某几个国家建立外交关系时，只在其中一国设立外交代表机构，該外交代表兼任驻其邻近国家的使节，例如科威特的驻巴西大使兼任驻智利、厄瓜多尔和乌拉圭大使等。由驻他国大使兼任的，称為「非常任大使」。
target_text: A non-permanent diplomatic representative to a country may also be a diplomatic representative to two or more countries. Some countries, because of their economic, political or professional needs, establish diplomatic relations with a few countries only in one country, where the diplomatic representative also serves as an envoy to neighbouring countries, such as the Ambassador of Kuwait to Brazil to Chile, Ecuador, Uruguay, etc. The Ambassador to another country also serves as a “non-permanent ambassador.”
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 另外，有些国家會指定「巡迴大使」来往于数个国家之间，進行相關外交事務。例如中華民國政府設有無任所大使，聘請資深退休外交官及社會各界賢達出任。而在一國的國慶及元首就職等國家慶典時，有些國家會派出「特使」以代替該國元首前往參加，特使通常由副元首、總理（首相）、國會議長、内阁部长等高級官員或者退休高官擔任。
target_text: For example, China’s government has an unattended ambassador who hires highly qualified retired diplomats and senior officials from all walks of life. At national celebrations such as the National Day and the inauguration of the Head of State, some countries send “special envoys” to replace the Head of State, who are usually held by senior officials such as the Deputy Head of State, the Prime Minister, the President of the National Assembly, Cabinet Ministers, etc.
title: 外交代表機構

source_text: 1796年4月波拿巴翻越阿尔卑斯山脉，1796年4月12日在蒙特诺特战役中击败皮埃蒙特军，1796年4月21日在蒙多维战役中击败了皮埃蒙特军，波拿巴将注意力转向了皮埃蒙特南部，以应对教皇统治。波拿巴对分裂指挥的入侵持怀疑态度，向内阁写了两封信。这些信件让政府暂时缓和了这种入侵。1796年5月10日，奥地利人在洛迪战役中战败，撤退到米尼科。根据1797年2月19日签署的托伦蒂诺条约，罗马被迫接受法国共和国的大使。1798年2月，法国人入侵教皇国，动机是1797年12月法国将军马图林·伦纳德·杜弗特被杀。入侵成功后，教皇国成为附属国，重新命名为罗马共和国，由波拿巴的将军之一路易·亚历山大·贝尔蒂埃领导。1798年2月20日，教皇庇护六世被俘，被押送出罗马，流放到法国，后来在那里去世。
target_text: In April 1796, Bonaparte crossed the Alps, defeated the Piedmont army in the Battle of Montenot on 12 April 1796, defeated the Piedmont army in the Battle of Montedowi on 21 April 1796, and Bonaparte turned his attention to the south of Piedmont in response to the Pope’s rule. Bonaparta was suspicious of the invasion of the separatist command and wrote two letters to the Cabinet. These letters allowed the Government to temporarily ease the invasion. On 10 May 1796, the Austrians defeated the battle of Loti and withdrew to Minique. In accordance with the Treaty of Torrentino signed on 19 February 1797, Rome was forced to accept the Ambassador of the French Republic. In February 1798, the French invaded the Pope’s country, motivated by the killing of French General Maturín Leonard Duvert in December 1797.
title: 罗马共和国 (18世纪)

source_text: 梁翠萍（英文名：，），藝名梁靜茹（英文名：），馬來西亞華裔女歌手，1999年在台灣演藝圈出道，有「情歌天后」、「療癒系天后」、「大馬之光」之美譽，其作品也被冠上「情歌本格派」及「梁式情歌」之稱。至今已發行14張音樂專輯和2張精選輯，全球銷量近2000萬張，並累計超過140場世界巡迴售票演唱會，其中世界巡迴演唱會的觀賞人數突破200萬人次，在全球華人世界擁有極高的知名度與廣大粉絲。除歌唱事業外，梁靜茹亦曾參與公益活動，擔任馬來西亞世界展望會愛心大使和創世基金會愛心大使。
target_text: Leung Trei Ping (English name: Leung Jie-ju), a female singer of Malaysian descent, has appeared in Taiwan in 1999 with the reputations of "Beyond Love", "Beyond Physics" and "The Light of the Horse" and has also been crowned with the name "Song of Love" and "Liang-style Love Song". source_text: 虽然卢梭喜爱仁君胜过其它的政府形式，他对此含糊其辞。他阐明政府必须分成三个部分：主权者代表公共意志，这个意志必须有益于全社会；由主权者授权的行政官员来实现这一意志；最后，必须有形成这一意志的公民群体。他相信，国家应保持较小的规模，把更多的权利留给人民，让政府更有效率。
target_text: Although Rousseau loved In-Gon over other forms of government, he was vague. He stated that the government had to be divided into three parts: sovereigns represented the public will, which must benefit society as a whole; officials authorized by sovereigns to do so; and, finally, there must be a group of citizens who formed it. He believed that the State should remain small, leaving more power to the people and making the government more efficient.
title: 社会契约论

source_text: 社会秩序来源于共同的原始、朴素的约定。当自然状态中，生存障碍超过个人所能够承受的地步，人类就被迫改变生活方式。人类不能产生新的力量，而只能是集合并形成力量的总和来克服生存的阻力。“要寻找出一种结合的形式，使它能以全部共同的力量来卫护和保障每个结合者的人身和财富，并且由于这一结合而使每一个与全体相联合的个人又只不过是在服从自己本人，并且仍然像以往一样地自由。”解决办法就是形成一个约定，使每个人都把自身的能力置于“主权者”的指导下。主权者是尽可能包括最多社会成员的、道德的与集体的共同体。共同体中的约定对于每一个成员都是平等的。共同体就以这同一个行为获得了它的统一性、它的公共的大我、它的生命和它的意志。共同体可称为“国家或政治体”，至于结合者就称为人民；个别地，作为主权权威的参与者，就叫做公民，作为国家法律的服从者，就叫做臣民。有了这个契约，人类就从自然状态进入社会状态，从本能状态进入道德和公义状态。人类由于社会契约而丧失的是天然的自由以及对于他所企图得到的一切东西的无限权利；而他所获得的，乃是社会的自由以及对于他所享有的一切东西的所有权。
target_text: The social order is derived from a common original, simple agreement. When a state of nature is more difficult to survive than an individual can afford, human beings are forced to change their way of life. Human beings cannot create new forces, but can only assemble and form forces to overcome the resistance to survival. “To find a form of union in which they can defend and safeguard the person and wealth of each and every one of them with all their common strength, and by which each and every individual and all of them can be called “the State or the political entity” and the people of the union.” The solution is to create an agreement whereby each and every individual, as a sovereign participant, places his or her capabilities under the guidance of the “sovereigner.” The sovereign is a community of nations, with the greatest possible members of society, a moral and collective force. The community is equal for each and every member. With this act, the community has its unity, its public power, its life and its will. The community can be called “the State or the political body” of the union and its freedom of all human beings from the nature and from the freeness of the essence of the goods and the objects of the human society; and the
title: 社会契约论

source_text:
第二卷
第二卷阐述主权及其权利。主权是公意的运用，不可以转让，不可分割。主权由共同利益所决定和约束，藉着法律而行动。法律是以公共利益为依归的公意的行为。虽然公意总是对的，但是它并非总是能作出明智的判断，因此也并非总能找到共同利益之所在，于是立法者的存在就是必要的。然而立法者本身并没有权力，他们只是指导者。他们起草和提出法律建议，只有人民自己（或者说主权者、公意）才有权设立法律。
target_text: Volume II deals with sovereignty and its rights. Sovereignty is a consensual exercise that cannot be transferred and indivisible. Sovereignty is determined and bound by the common good and acts by law. The law is an act of justice that is based on the public interest. While it is always true, it is not always wise to judge, and therefore it is not always possible to find the common good, so it is necessary for the legislator to exist. But the legislator itself does not have the power, and they are merely the mentors.
title: 社会契约论

source_text:
第三卷
第三卷阐述政府及其运作形式。对于主权体而言，仅有立法是不够的，法律的强制实施亦非常必要。虽然主权体有立法权，但是它不能赋予自身执法权。它需要一个介于主权体和国民之间的中介者，在公意的指示下实施法律。这就是政府的角色，政府是主权者的执行人，而非主权者本身。政府中的执政者只是受委托来行使行政权力；他们是主权者的官吏，他们的职能不是契约的结果，而是以主权者的名义行使被托付的权力。他们从主权者接受命令，并将命令转达给国民。主权者可以根据自己的意愿限制、改变或收回行政权。
target_text: Volume III deals with government and its form of operation. For the body of sovereignty, legislation alone is not sufficient, and enforcement of the law is necessary. While the body of sovereignty has the power to legislate, it does not give itself the power to enforce it. It requires an intermediary between the body of sovereignty and its nationals to enforce the law on the basis of good will. That is the role of government, which is the executor of the sovereign, not the sovereign itself. Those in government are simply entrusted with the exercise of executive power; they are the officers of the sovereign, whose functions are not the result of the contract, but rather the exercise of the power entrusted to them in the name of the sovereign. They take orders from the sovereign and transmit them to the national. Sovereigns can limit, change or reclaim executive power according to their will.
title: 社会契约论

source_text: 结构越简单的政府是越好的；实际上，政府都是混合形式的，都或多或少地借鉴了其他形式。没有一种政府适用于一切国家，但是一个国家的政府必须与其人民的特点相适应，一个不靠外来移民的办法、不靠归化、不靠殖民地的政府，而在它的治下公民人数繁殖和增长得最多的，就确实无疑地是最好的政府。为了防止少数人篡夺国家的权力，必须由法律保障人民定期集会，终止一切现有的行政权，让权力回到人民手中。在集会中，人民必须解决两个问题, 第一个是：“主权者愿意保存现有的政府形式吗？”第二个是：“人民愿意让那些目前实际在担负行政责任的人们继续当政吗？”介于主权者和政府之间的一种力量是议员，但是主权是不可转让的，所以议员代表不了人民，只是人民的办事员，他们并不能作出任何肯定的决定。凡是不曾为人民所亲自批准的法律，都是无效的。政府行政权的创制不是契约，而是法律。政府的行政官不是人民的主人，他不可以建立契约，而是遵守现有的契约。
target_text: The simpler the structure of government is the better; indeed, government is a hybrid form, drawing more or less on other forms. No government is applicable to all countries, but the government of one country must adapt to the characteristics of its people. The second is, “Is the people willing to allow those who are actually responsible for the administration to remain in power?” A power between the sovereigns and the government is a member of parliament, but sovereignty is not transferable, so it is not the people’s clerk, and it is not the people’s clerk who can make any definitive decision. The law that was not approved by the people themselves is not the contract, but the law.

關於衝鋒隊的暴力事件
另外，納粹衝鋒隊在納粹黨擁有一定的自主性。衝鋒隊是由一戰後的自由軍團演變而來，他們大多的成員都是認為德國是被「十一月的罪犯」（社会主义者和犹太人）出賣的，他們反對那時新成立的威瑪政府，也反對共產主義。共產黨在德國逐漸發展時，衝鋒隊便與共產黨發生激烈的爭鬥。這種激烈衝突也對戰後有實驗性質民主政體的威瑪政府相當的不穩定。以1932年6月為例，超過400次的街頭爭鬥，造成82人死亡。這種社會上的不穩定是讓希特勒崛起關鍵性因素，許多德國人確信一旦希特勒被任命為總理，地方性的械鬥便會停上。隨他成為總理後，除了納粹黨之外的政黨一律被鎮壓，包含共產黨也被瓦解。但有關衝鋒隊的暴力事件仍層出不窮，有時毆打路人或遏阻他們的警察。在1933年中期左右，衝鋒隊被普通人認為是傲慢及無禮的，有外交官抱怨過外國大使被衝鋒隊無理的對待。這樣的行為讓中產階級與其他保守團體如德軍有了意見。

source_text: 1844年，中美《望厦条约》签订，内容参照了中英《南京条约》。此后，美国的传教士和商人也开始前来上海。与英国侨民以商人为主不同，美国侨民中传教士的比重较高，包括1845年来到上海的美国圣公会、1847年来到上海的美南浸信会、1848年来沪的美南监理会、1850年来沪的美北长老会等。由于传教士的目的是向中国居民传教，所以他们并不聚居在租界，而是分散居住在县城内外的各个角落，如美南浸信会的晏马太立足于老北门外护城河边，美南监理会立足于不远处的郑家木桥，美北长老会立足于大南门外。美国圣公会在城内立足后，1848年，主教文惠廉又请求上海地方官府允许美国侨民在虹口开辟租界，但并未正式划定界限。上海开埠初期，虹口美国租界由于有苏州河的阻隔，甚为荒凉，只在江边建成少数的船坞、码头，和为水手们服务的娱乐场所。1846年，第一名美国商人吴利国（Ltentry G.Wolcott）进入上海，被委任为代理领事，在英租界九江路自己的洋行升起美国国旗，这是租界内第一面升起的外国国旗（当时英国领事馆还设在上海县城内），此事引发了英国领事的干涉。此后，绝大多数美国洋行都设在苏州河以南的英租界内。19世纪美国在上海最著名的商业机构是旗昌洋行。
target_text: Unlike the British diaspora, which is dominated by businessmen, the American Episcopal Council, which came to Shanghai in 1845, the Southern American Baptist Church, which came to Shanghai in 1847, the Southern American Supervisory Council, which was founded in 1848, and the Northern American Elders Council, which was founded in 1850, followed by the South American Elders Council. Since their mission was to teach Chinese residents, American missionaries and businessmen began to come to Shanghai. Instead of living in the rental community, they are scattered across all corners of the county, such as the South American Baptist Church, which is located near the Old North Gate, where the South American Supervisory Council is based on a long-distance Jungwood bridge, the North American Elders are based outside the Great South.
title: 上海历史

source_text: 1894年，中日甲午战争爆发，上海形势也趋于紧张，碍于各国在上海的势力，日本暂对外宣布上海为中立区域，并许诺不将战火蔓延到上海。中国战败后，日本不仅得到了朝鲜的宗主权和台湾，也得以成为在华列强之一，在汉口、天津乃至重庆、苏州、杭州开辟了一批租界，但是其在上海开辟租界的企图归于失败。此外，根据战后的《马关条约》，外国人可以在中国开办工厂，此后，日本、英国等国在黄浦江下游的杨树浦地区陆续开设众多的近代企业。上海也迅速发展成中国最大的工业中心。
target_text: After China’s defeat, Japan not only gained Korea’s sovereignty and Taiwan, but was able to become one of China’s powers, opening a pool of concessions in Hanguchi, Tianjin, and even Chongqing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou, but its attempts to open a lease in Shanghai failed. Moreover, under the post-war Ma’uan Treaty, foreigners could open factories in China, and Japan and the United Kingdom were able to open a large number of recent businesses in the Yang Jiu area, which is on the lower side of the Huangpo River.
title: 上海历史

source_text: 联合国粮食及农业组织（，缩写为; ，缩写为），简称粮农组织，是一个联合国专门机构，带头开展战胜饥饿的国际努力。粮农组织以中立的论坛运作，为发达国家和发展中国家服務；在该论坛上，所有国家均平等相处，共同磋商协议，讨论政策。粮农组织也是知识和-{zh-hans:信息; zh-hant:資訊;}-的来源，帮助发展中国家和转型国家实现农业、林业和渔业现代化和发展，确保人人获得良好的营养和粮食安全。它的拉丁文格言「」翻译成中文就是“让我们有面包”。截至2013年10月，FAO有194个成员国、1个成员组织（欧洲联盟）和有2个准成员（法罗群岛、托克劳群岛）。
target_text: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) (in acronyms;) FAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations that leads international efforts to combat hunger. FAO operates as a neutral forum for developed and developing countries; in that forum, all countries live together on an equal footing and agree to consult together to discuss policies. FAO is also a knowledge and {zh-hans: information; zh-hant: information;}-source to assist developing countries and countries in transition in modernizing and developing agriculture, forestry and fisheries to ensure good nutrition and food security for all. Its Latin motto, “Let's have bread”, has been translated into Chinese. As of October 2013, FAO had 194 member States, one member organization (European Union) and two associate members (Faroe Islands, Tokelau Islands).
title: 联合国粮食及农业组织

source_text: 计划和成果世界粮食安全首脑会议世界粮食安全首脑会议将于2009年11月16日至18日在意大利罗马举行。举办首脑会议的决定是根据粮农组织总干事雅克·迪乌夫博士的提议，由联合国粮食及农业组织理事会在2009年6月作出。期待国家和政府首脑参加在粮农组织总部举行的这次峰会。
target_text: The World Summit on Food Security, the Plan and Outcome, will be held in Rome, Italy, from 16 to 18 November 2009. The decision to hold the Summit was taken by the Council of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations in June 2009, on the proposal of the Director-General of FAO, Dr. Jacques Diouf. Heads of State and Government are expected to participate in the Summit at FAO headquarters.
title: 联合国粮食及农业组织

source_text:
粮农组织应对粮食危机
2007年12月，粮农组织实施应对粮价飞涨计划帮助小生产者提高产量并增加收入。这个计划也是粮农组织对2008年4月成立的联合国全球粮食危机高级别工作组制定的全面行动框架的贡献。粮农组织已经在25个国家实施项目，赴近60个国家执行机构间任务。通过全球粮食和农业-{zh-hans:信息; zh-hant:資訊;}-及预警系统提高监测工作，对国家提供政策建议，同时支持他们在提高粮食产量方面所作的努力，鼓励农业投资。该计划也与欧盟密切合作。例如，在海地实施一个一千万美元的优质种子分发和培育项目；该项目显著提高了粮食产量，降低了粮价，增加了农民收入。。
target_text: FAO responded to the food crisis in December 2007 by implementing a plan to respond to soaring food prices to help small producers increase their production and incomes. This plan is also a contribution of FAO to the comprehensive framework for action developed by the United Nations High-level Task Force on the Global Food Crisis, established in April 2008. FAO has implemented projects in 25 countries to carry out inter-agency missions in nearly 60 countries. Through global food and agriculture — {zh-hans: information; zh-hant: information;}-and early warning systems to improve monitoring, provide policy advice to countries while supporting their efforts to increase food production and encourage investment in agriculture. The plan also works closely with the European Union. For example, in Haiti, a $10 million high-quality seed distribution and breeding project has been implemented; the project has significantly increased food production, reduced food prices and increased farmers ' incomes.
title: 联合国粮食及农业组织

source_text:
国际植物保护公约
粮农组织在建立1952年国际植物保护公约，该国际条约组织旨在防止植物和植物产品有害生物的扩散和传入。其中的功能是维护植物有害生物名录，追踪有害生物爆发情况，协调成员国之间的技术援助。到2009年7月，173个政府已正式通过该公约。
target_text: FAO is in the process of establishing the 1952 International Plant Protection Convention, an international treaty organization that aims to prevent the proliferation and transmission of harmful organisms from plants and plant products. Its functions are to maintain a list of harmful organisms from plants, to track outbreaks of harmful organisms and to coordinate technical assistance among member States. By July 2009, 173 Governments had formally adopted the Convention.
title: 联合国粮食及农业组织

source_text: 1945年，联合国粮食及农业组织在战后重建的理想主义中建立了，它在建立之时力求增加世界各地的农业产量，使饥荒成为历史。在随后的75年里，粮农组织的观念和工作内容中加入了新的维度，即环境和可持续性。到2020年，要获得持续的成功，我们需要做出战略调整。
target_text: In 1945, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations was founded in the idealism of post-war reconstruction, which sought to increase agricultural production around the world and make famine history. In the ensuing 75 years, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) added a new dimension to its vision and work, namely, environment and sustainability. To achieve sustained success by 2020, we need to make strategic adjustments.
title: 联合国粮食及农业组织

source_text:
粮农组织亲善大使
粮农组织亲善大使计划始于1999年。其主要目的是吸引公众和媒体的注意力，让他们认识到一个令人无法接受的事实，那就是在这个物质前所未有丰富的时代中，世界上仍有10亿多人在遭受长期饥饿和营养不良。这些人过着悲惨的生活，被剥夺了最基本的人权：获得食物的权利。
光靠政府是无法消除饥饿和营养不良的。要想打破长期饥饿和贫困的恶性循环，我们就需要动员公共和私有部门，让民间社会参与进来，并集中集体和个人的资源。
每位粮农组织亲善大使 – 来自艺术界、娱乐界、体育界和科学领域的名流，如诺贝尔奖获得者丽塔·列维-蒙塔尔奇尼，著名演员巩俐，歌唱家米瑞安·马卡贝，足球运动员罗伯特·巴乔和劳尔·冈萨雷斯·布兰科等很多名人 – 为粮农组织的愿景，做出了个人和职业承诺，那就是为我们这一代和子孙后代建设一个粮食有保障的世界。亲善大使们利用他们的智慧和影响力，带动老少、贫富所有人一起投身于这场消除饥饿的全球运动，他们的目标是力争在21世纪实现“人人有粮”。
target_text: The FAO Goodwill Ambassador program began in 1999. Its main purpose is to draw the attention of the public and the media to the unacceptable fact that more than 1 billion people in the world are still suffering from chronic hunger and malnutrition in an age of unprecedented material wealth, such as the Nobel Laureate Rita Levy-Montarchini, the famous actor who has been denied the most basic human rights: the right to food, the Government alone cannot eradicate hunger and malnutrition. To break the vicious cycle of chronic hunger and poverty, we need to mobilize the public and private sectors, involve civil society, and focus collective and individual resources.
title: 联合国粮食及农业组织
