source_text: 自1962年荷兰殖民政府从荷属新几内亚撤出以后，1963年印尼开始履行管理，当时印度尼西亚根据与联合国签订尊重任何结果的进行巴布亚全民公投（印尼政府称之为自由选择法案，，实际上并不公平）。事实相反，这一投票并不是在全体居民中进行，而是印尼军队强迫部落酋长投票加入印尼。尽管有抗议，由于同联合国签订有协议尊重任何结果，名义上这一结果得到维护，国际社会也承认巴布亚加入印尼。这加剧了西巴布亚原住民的独立运动，加深了从1963年荷兰人撤出巴布亚即开始的地区冲突。这一冲突一直持续到现在，印度尼西亚安全部队在镇压独立运动方面被指控侵犯人权。印度尼西亚政府对该地区实行严格的管控，禁止外国记者或者人权监测员进入。
target_text: Following the withdrawal of the Dutch colonial government from the Netherlands New Guinea in 1962, Indonesia began its administration in 1963, when the Indonesian referendum on Papua was conducted on the basis of an agreement with the United Nations that respected any outcome (the Indonesian Government called the free choice bill, which was in fact unfair). On the contrary, the vote was not carried out among the entire population, but was forced by the Indonesian army to vote for Indonesia. Despite protests, the international community recognized Papua’s accession to Indonesia in spite of an agreement with the United Nations to respect any result. This intensified the independence movement of the indigenous peoples of West Papua, deepening the conflict in the region, which began with the withdrawal of the Dutch from Papua in 1963.
title: 巴布亚省

source_text: 1660年，荷兰人承认了蒂多雷苏丹拥有新几内亚岛的主权。1793年英国人试图在今马诺夸里建立定居点，结果以失败告终。1824年英国和荷兰同意新几内亚岛的西部成为荷属东印度群岛的一部分。1828年荷兰人试图在Lobo（今凯马纳附近）建立定居点，也以失败告终。三十年后，德国人在马诺夸里附近的海岛建立了第一个传教定居点。虽然荷兰人分别在1828和1848年宣称拥有东经141°以西的南海岸和洪堡湾以西的北海岸，但是他们在1896年才试图再次开发该地区，在马诺夸里和法克法克附近建立居民点，以响应澳大利亚对新几内亚岛东部的主权要求。英国和德国同意了荷兰在1885、1895年的条约中所提要求，同时英国也声称拥有东南新几内亚，也就是后来成为巴布亞領地的地区；德国则宣称拥有东北新几内亚，后来成为了德属新几内亚。荷兰殖民活动收效甚微，大多数人回到爪哇，1938年时，荷兰仅在荷兰地亚有50名定居者、马诺夸里有258名定居者。荷兰殖民当局在塔纳默拉成立了用以关押政治犯。
target_text: In 1660, the Dutch recognized the sovereignty of the Sudan over the island of New Guinea. In 1793, the British failed in their attempt to establish settlements in the western part of the island of New Guinea. In 1824, the United Kingdom and the Netherlands agreed that the western part of the island would become part of the Netherlands East Indies. In 1828, the Dutch attempted to build settlements in Lobo (near today’s Kemana). Thirty years later, the Germans established their first missionary settlement on the island near Manochuri. Although the Dutch claimed to have a south-east New Guinea in 1828 and 1848, respectively, the northern coast west of the Bay of Humboldt, Germany claimed to have a new north-east Guinea, and to have a settlement near Manoqari and Fakfaq, in response to Australia’s claim of sovereignty over the eastern part of the island of New Guinea.
title: 巴布亚省

source_text: 1945年8月17日印度尼西亚宣布独立，并声称拥有荷属东印度群岛的所有领土，包括荷属新几内亚。荷兰和印尼发生了四年半的武装外交斗争。1949年12月，斗争结束，荷兰承认了印度尼西亚对荷属东印度群岛的主权，但是荷属新几内亚除外。双方无法对该地区达成妥协，同意在一年内继续讨论这个问题。
target_text: On 17 August 1945, Indonesia declared independence and claimed all the territory of the Netherlands East Indies, including the Netherlands New Guinea. The Netherlands and Indonesia had four and a half years of armed diplomatic struggle. In December 1949, the struggle ended and the Netherlands recognized Indonesia’s sovereignty over the Netherlands East Indies, with the exception of the Netherlands New Guinea.
title: 巴布亚省

source_text: 为了防止印度尼西亚控制巴布亚，荷兰当局显著提高了对巴布亚的开发支出，并鼓励巴布亚的民族主义。他们建立了许多学校以培养当地人才，为1970年的西巴布亚独立建国做准备。1961年4月5日巴布亚议会开始运作，预备于10年之内完成独立。1961年10月19日巴布亚的议员在新几内亚议会大厦举行了6小时的会议，选举出制定独立与自治宣言的全国委员会，还选出了国旗、国徽和国歌（Oh My Land Papua），并呼吁人们自称为巴布亚人。1961年12月1日，荷兰认同其议会所选择的国歌以及订定的晨星旗为新的国旗。1961年12月19日，印尼军方展开特里科拉行动，侵入荷属新几内亚，冲突过后西巴布亚由联合国管理。1962年8月15日，印荷在联合国总部签署，其中包括在1969年之前举行公民投票的规定。
target_text: In order to prevent Indonesia from taking control of Papua, the Dutch authorities have significantly increased development spending on Papua and encouraged Papuan nationalism. They have established many schools to prepare local talent for the independence of West Papua in 1970. On 5 April 1961, Papua's Parliament became operational, with independence to be completed within 10 years. On 19 October 1961, Papua's parliamentarians held a six-hour meeting in the New Guinea Parliamentary House to elect a national committee to formulate a declaration of independence and self-government. They also elected the flag, the emblem and the national anthem (Oh My Land Papua), and called for people to call themselves Papuans. On 1 December 1961, the Netherlands endorsed the national anthem chosen by its Parliament and the established flag of the morning stars as a new flag. On 19 December 1961, the Indonesian military launched Operation Tricola, which invaded New Guinea and was administered by the United Nations after the conflict in West Papua, and signed at United Nations Headquarters on 15 August 1962, including the provisions for a referendum to be held before 1969.
title: 巴布亚省

source_text: 尽管施米特在希特勒上台之前还没有成为納粹主義的支持者。1933年至1936年間，施米特因受戈林提拔而擔任普魯士政府成員，並享有眾多學術職位，包括著名的《德意志法學家報》（Deutsche Juristen-Zeitung）主編一職。之后他改为站在纳粹的立场，很快在法律界获得了影响力的地位，而被人们视为民族社会主义的「法学家」，并致力于捍卫希特勒对反納粹人士的法外处决以及对犹太人的種族清洗。1936年後，施密特因其在納粹執政前後態度之轉變、及其入黨甚晚的事實而漸受部份黨政高層質疑，且受到親衛隊機關報《黑衣軍團》的攻擊。在戈林的斡旋下，施米特終保其性命，卻付出了失去所有官職的代價。在纳粹德國后期，施米特的工作主要集中在對国际法以及納粹主義擴張的學術研究，他認為国际法於二十世紀向自由主义的转变将是破坏稳定和合法的国际法律秩序的条件。施密特在国际法基础上所做的理论工作最终写成《歐洲公法中之國際法的大地之法》（Der Nomos der Erde im Völkerrecht des Jus Publicum Europaeum）。
target_text: From 1933 to 1936, Schmidt was a member of the government of Prussia because he was promoted by Göringi and enjoyed a wide range of academic posts, including the well-known Deutsche Juristen-Zeitung editor of the German Lawman’s newspaper Deutsché-Juristen-Zeitung. He then turned to the Nazis’ position, quickly gained influence in the legal community, was perceived as a “jurisprudence” of national socialism, and was committed to defending Hitler’s extrajudicial execution of the Nazis and the ethnic cleansing of Jews. After 1936, Schmidt’s work focused on international law and its late entry into the party’s history, and was attacked by a group of protagonists, the Black Army.
title: 卡尔·施米特

source_text:
豐臣政權時代
天正11年（1583年）成為山城守。天正12年（1584年）狩野秀治病倒，逐漸由兼續負責內政與外交。秀治死後則完全由擅長外交的兼續一人擔當。家臣們稱景勝為「御屋形」（主公），稱兼續為「旦那」（主人）。天正14年6月22日（1586年8月7日），兼續陪同景勝上洛，天皇冊封景勝為從四位下左近衛權少將，兼續為從五位下。
target_text: During his 12 years (1584), Tianzheng took responsibility for internal affairs and diplomacy. After his death, he was replaced by a single person who was very good at diplomacy. My subjects called the "King Shao" and continued to be "Dana" (master). On June 22, 14th (1586, August 7th, 1586), they accompanied him, accompanied by a five-member Lieutenant General for left-hand and left-hand near-guards.
title: 直江兼續

source_text:
设立
1860年，英、法两国组成联军攻占天津和北京后，要求清政府续订条约的时候，美国与俄国共同作为居间调停人。北京条约签订后，英国和法国相继在天津划分了各自的租界。清政府为了表示不歧视美国，主动在英租界的南面划出一片土地作为美国在天津的租界。
target_text: In 1860, when the British and French combined forces took over Tianjin and Beijing, and asked the government to renew the treaty, the United States and Russia joined the Russians as interlocutors. Following the Beijing treaty, Britain and France divided their respective rental boundaries in Tianjin.
title: 天津美租界

source_text:
发展
与其他国家租界由本国领事管辖不同，天津开埠的前十年，美国领事都商人兼任，没有职业外交官专任领事。由于在天津的美国侨民较少，美国政府还曾聘用非美国人在领事馆任职，先后有英、法、荷、俄国公民曾担任美国驻津副领事。直到1871年，美国国会才批准任命美国职业外交官担任专职驻津领事。
target_text: Unlike other countries where the leasing community is under the authority of their consular authorities, the first decade of Tianjin’s existence has been held by American consuls, all of whom are non-professional diplomats. Because of the small number of American expatriates in Tianjin, the US government has also hired non-Americans to serve in consulates, with British, French, Dutch, and Russian citizens serving as vice-consuls in the United States.
title: 天津美租界

source_text: 安德烈·亚努阿里耶维奇·维辛斯基（；），苏联政治家、法学家、外交家。他在1931年至1939年期间担任苏联总检察长，在苏联的大清洗中扮演重要角色，也是莫斯科审判和纽伦堡审判的公诉人。此后，在1949年至1953年期间担任苏联外交部部长，曾代表苏联签订德国投降文书以及中苏友好同盟条约。
target_text: Andrei Yanuarievich Wiesinski (;) Soviet statesman, jurist, diplomat. He played an important role in Soviet cleansing between 1931 and 1939, as well as in Moscow and Nürnberg. He then served as Minister for Foreign Affairs of the USSR between 1949 and 1953 and signed on behalf of the Soviet Union the German surrender instrument and the Treaty of the Central Soviet Friendship.
title: 安德烈·维辛斯基

source_text: 1939年他从司法界转入外交界，曾代表苏联签订德国投降文书以及中苏友好同盟条约。1949年至1953年期间调任苏联外交部长，任苏联常驻联合国首席代表，在冷战期间积极推进苏联的外交政策。1948年联合国起草世界人权宣言时曾嘲笑该宣言，1954年11月22日在纽约因患急性心脏病突然逝世，终年70岁。
target_text: In 1939, he was transferred from the judiciary to the diplomatic community, where he signed on behalf of the Soviet Union the instruments of German surrender and the Treaty of the Central Soviet Union. From 1949 to 1953, he was transferred to the post of Foreign Minister of the Soviet Union as Chief Permanent Representative of the Soviet Union to the United Nations and actively promoted the foreign policy of the Soviet Union during the cold war. The United Nations mocked the Universal Declaration of Human Rights when it was drafted in 1948, when he died suddenly in New York on 22 November 1954 as a result of an acute heart attack.
title: 安德烈·维辛斯基

source_text: 杨洁-{zh-cn:; zh-tw:; zh-hk:}-（），上海市人，中华人民共和国外交官，原副国级领导人，南京大学历史学系世界史专业毕业，曾任中共中央政治局委員，中央外事工作委员会秘书长兼办公室主任、中央對臺工作領導小組秘书长、国务委员、外交部长、第十二届国务院党组成员。1968年9月参加工作，1971年12月加入中国共产党，是中共第十六届中央候补委员，第十七、十八、十九届中央委员，十九届中央政治局委员。曾任中华人民共和国外交部部长助理兼中华人民共和国外交部北美大洋洲司司长、副部长、驻美国大使、外交部常务副部长、外交部长等职。
target_text: Yang Jie-{zh-cn:; zh-tw:; zh-h-hk:} () Shanghai Cityman, diplomat of the People ' s Republic of China, former deputy head of State, graduate of the History Department of Nanjing University, member of the Central Political Bureau of the Chinese Communist Party, Secretary-General of the Central Foreign Affairs Committee and Chief of Staff, Secretary-General of the Central Counterpart Team, State Secretary, Minister for Foreign Affairs, member of the Party Group of the Twelfth State Council. Working in September 1968, joined the Communist Party of China in December 1971, serving as the sixteenth Central Alternate of the Communist Party of China, 17th, 18th and 19th Central Committee, and 19th Central Political Bureau.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 在其职业外交生涯中，曾经三度被派往海外工作，并且每次都派驻美国，前后在中国驻美国大使馆工作过12年，与布什家族建立了良好关系。有媒体披露，布什家族在某些情况下，会选择与杨洁篪私下沟通，作为與中国政府沟通的管道。杨洁篪在美国外交场上的绰号“老虎杨”（），就是美国前总统老布什取的。
target_text: During his career in professional diplomacy, he was sent abroad three times, each time in the United States, and for 12 years before and after he worked at the Chinese Embassy in the United States, he established good relations with the Bush family. In some cases, the media revealed that the Bush family would choose to communicate privately with Yang Jiechi as a channel of communication with the Chinese government. Yang Jiechi’s nickname “Tiger Yang” in the United States diplomatic arena was taken by former US President Bush.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 1975年杨洁篪毕业后回国，被分配到外交部翻译室担任专职翻译。1977年，老布什应邀访问中国时，杨洁篪被派为全程陪同翻译。外交生涯1983年起，杨洁篪历任中国驻美国大使馆二秘、一秘、参赞，北美大洋洲司参赞、兼处长、副司长。1993年任驻美国使馆公使，1995年任外交部部长助理兼美大司司长。1998年2月，48岁的杨洁篪升任外交部副部长。
target_text: In 1977, when Bush was invited to China, Yang Jiechi was assigned as a full-time interpreter. Since 1983, Yang Jiechi has served as Second Secretary, First Secretary, Counsellor, Counsellor at the Chinese Embassy in the United States, Counsellor and Deputy Director of the Department of Oceania in North America. Minister of Embassy in the United States in 1993 and Assistant Minister of Foreign Affairs and Director of the United States Department of Foreign Affairs in 1995. In February 1998, Yang Jiechi, 48, was promoted as Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 2001年2月16日，第九届全国人大常委会决定任命51岁的杨洁篪接替李肇星为中华人民共和国第七任驻美国大使。这也是中美建交22年来，中国派出的最年轻的大使，比其前任李肇星年轻了10岁。2001年4月，就在杨洁篪出任驻美大使不久，中美南海撞机事件发生，他曾经一日之内四次奔走于美国国务院、国会与中国驻美国大使馆之间，表达中方的立场，全力化解国会方面对中国的反弹敌意。还曾经一天两次出现在美国电视上，阐述中方看法。这场危机最终得以化解，而杨洁篪也赢得了个人威望。2003年宋美齡去世时，杨洁篪受中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会的委托，参加宋美龄的吊唁活动。在驻美大使期间，杨洁篪在职攻读钱乘旦的博士，并于2006年获得南京大学历史学系世界史专业博士学位。
target_text: On 16 February 2001, the Ninth Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress decided to appoint Yang Jiechi, aged 51, as the seventh ambassador to the United States of America. China’s youngest ambassador, 10 years younger than his predecessor, Li Zhaoxing, had been appointed to China’s 22-year post. In April 2001, Yang Jiechi, who was commissioned by the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference in 2003, took part in a visit to the Chinese State Department, Congress and the Chinese Embassy in the United States on four occasions to express China’s position in an effort to defuse the resistance of Congress against China.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 6月1日，外长杨洁篪同哥斯达黎加外交部长斯塔诺在北京代表各自政府共同签署了《中华人民共和国和哥斯达黎加共和国关于建立外交关系的联合公报》，决定两国自签署建交公报之日起建立大使级外交关系。6月6日至10日，杨洁篪陪同中共中央总书记、国家主席胡锦涛出席在德国举行的八国集团同发展中国家领导人对话会议（G8+5），并对瑞典进行国事访问。7月12日至15日，应俄罗斯联邦外交部长谢尔盖·维克托罗维奇·拉夫罗夫邀请，杨洁篪对俄罗斯进行访问。9月3日至9月9日，杨洁篪陪同胡锦涛对澳大利亚进行国事访问，并出席在悉尼举行的亚太经合组织第十五次领导人非正式会议。
target_text: On 1 June, Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi signed a joint communiqué on the establishment of diplomatic relations between the People ' s Republic of China and the Republic of Costa Rica on behalf of their respective Governments in Beijing with the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Costa Rica, deciding to establish diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level from the date of the signing of the communiqué on the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries. From 6 to 10 June, Yang Jiechi accompanied the Central Secretary of the Communist Party of China and its President Hu Jintao to the G8+5 meeting in Germany for dialogue between the leaders of the Group of Eight and developing countries, as well as a State visit to Sweden. From 12 to 15 July, Yang Jiechi visited Russia at the invitation of the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation, Sergei Victorovich Lavrov. From 3 to 9 September, Yang Jiechi accompanied Hu Jintao on a State visit to Australia and attended the 15th Informal Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders Meeting in Sydney.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 9月18日，台湾发动14个邦交国企图在第62届联合国大会上，就总务委员会建议不将台湾申请入联的提案列入议程予以翻案，杨洁篪率领中华人民共和国动员了141个国家发言反对。9月23日，正在纽约出席联合国大会的杨洁篪会见美国国务卿赖斯，赖斯就台湾问题表示美国坚持一个中国政策。12月4日至12月9日，杨洁篪对英国、马来西亚、老挝进行访问。12月5日，他在伦敦会见英国外交大臣戴维·米利班德，英国明确表示反对台湾的入联公投计划。12月8日，马来西亚总理阿都拉·巴达威在总理官邸会杨洁篪，随后杨洁篪同马来西亚外长赛义德举行会谈，双方表示将加紧制定战略性合作共同行动计划。
target_text: On September 18, Taiwan launched 14 states to try to reverse the General Committee’s proposal not to include Taiwan on the agenda of the 62nd session of the United Nations General Assembly, and Yang Jiechi led the People’s Republic of China to mobilize 141 countries to speak against. On September 23, Yang Jiechi, who was attending the United Nations General Assembly in New York, met with United States Secretary of State Rice, who stated that the United States was committed to a one-China policy on Taiwan. From December 4 to December 9, Yang Jiechi visited Britain, Malaysia, and Laos. On December 5 he met with British Foreign Secretary David Miliband in London, where the United Kingdom made clear its opposition to Taiwan’s accession plan.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 按照中国外长新年首次出访均为非洲国家的外交惯例，1月7日至11日，杨洁篪出访刚果、南非、布隆迪、埃塞俄比亚。1月31日至2月5日，对柬埔寨、文莱、澳大利亚进行访问，并启动中澳战略对话。同年3月第十一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上，他连任外交部部长。同日国家主席胡锦涛签署主席令（第二号）正式任命。3月26日，马拉维驻华大使馆在京开馆，马拉维总统穆塔里卡和杨洁篪共同主持了开馆仪式。4月17日至4月20日，访问日本，双方为胡锦涛访问日本做前期准备。5月6日至10日，他陪同胡锦涛对日本进行了国事访问，这次访问是中国国家元首时隔10年首次访日，双方并签署《中日关于全面推进战略互惠关系的联合声明》。
target_text: In accordance with the diplomatic practice of the Chinese Foreign Minister, who visited all African countries for the first time in the New Year, Yang Jiechi visited the Congo, South Africa, Burundi, and Ethiopia from 7 to 11 January. From 31 January to 5 February, he visited Cambodia, Brunei, Australia, and initiated a strategic dialogue between China and Australia. He was re-elected Minister of Foreign Affairs at the eleventh session of the National People ' s Congress in March of the same year. The President signed the Presidential Decree (No. 2) on the same day. On 26 March, Malawi ' s Embassy in China, in Tokyo, co-chaired the opening ceremony with Malawi ' s President Mutharika and Yang Jiechi. From 17 April to 20 April, he visited Japan, preparing for Hu Jintao ' s visit to Japan. From 6 to 10 May, he accompanied Hu Jintao during his country visit to Japan, which was the first visit of 10 years after the Chinese Head of State, and signed the China Joint Declaration on the Comprehensive Advancement of Strategic Reciprocal Relations.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 7月7日至9日，杨洁篪陪同中共中央总书记、国家主席胡锦涛出席在日本札幌举行的八国集团同有关国家领导人对话会议。7月29日，杨洁篪抵达华盛顿白宫，会见美国总统布什，落实中美元首在日本北海道会晤共识。同日出席中国驻美国大使馆新馆开馆仪式并致辞。8月25日至30日，杨洁篪陪同胡锦涛访问韩国、塔吉克斯坦、土库曼斯坦，并出席上海合作组织杜尚别峰会。8月31日至9月1日，对保加利亚进行访问。9月2日至4日作为胡锦涛主席特使赴赞比亚出席姆瓦纳瓦萨总统葬礼。9月7日，出席中国驻印度加尔各答总领事馆开馆仪式。9月底，抵达联合国总部出席第63届联合国大会。9月22日，出席非洲发展高级别会议。11月14日至15日，他陪同胡锦涛出席在华盛顿举行的二十国集团领导人金融市场和世界经济峰会，以商谈全球国家合力对应世界金融危机问题；并随后陪同胡锦涛对哥斯达黎加、古巴、秘鲁、希腊进行国事访问。12月2日至6日，杨洁篪外长对尼泊尔、缅甸进行访问。
target_text: On 29 July, Yang Jiechi arrived at the White House in Washington, D.C., meeting with United States President Bush, to follow up on the consensus reached in Hokkaido, Japan. On the same day, he attended the opening ceremony of the new Chinese Embassy in the United States. From 25 to 30 August, Yang Jiechi accompanied Hu Jintao to South Korea, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Dushanbe. From 31 August to 1 September, he visited Bulgaria. From 2 to 4 September, as Special Envoy of President Hu Jintao, visited Zambia to attend the funeral of President Mwanawasa. On 7 September, he attended the ceremony of the Chinese Consulate General in Kolkata, India. He attended the sixty-third session of the United Nations General Assembly at the end of September. On 22 September, he accompanied Hu Jintao to the High-level Conference on African Development. From 14 to 15 November, he accompanied Hu Jintao to the World Economic Summit of Group of Twenty leaders in Washington to discuss the global financial crisis and to discuss the global financial crisis.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 7月24日，他在北京钓鱼台国宾馆与联合国秘书长潘基文举行会谈。8月11日，他出访约旦，并与约旦首相扎哈比、代国王费萨尔进行会面。8月12日，他抵达日内瓦，出席裁军谈判会议，并会见联合国裁军谈判会议秘书长奥尔忠尼启泽、世界卫生组织总干事陈冯富珍。8月13日，会见联合国难民署高级专员古特雷斯、世界经济论坛主席施瓦布。8月19日，他与来华访问的新加坡外交部长杨荣文举行会谈。8月20日，与来访的塞尔维亚外长耶雷米奇会谈。8月21日，与来访的马里外交和国际合作部长瓦内会谈。8月24日，会见巴基斯坦总统阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里。8月30日，会见了来访的土耳其总理特别代表、国务部长恰拉扬。9月2日，与古巴外长罗德里格斯举行会谈；同日会见法国总统外事顾问雷维特。
target_text: On 24 July, he met with the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Ban Ki-moon, at the hotel of the Beijing fishing counter. On 11 August, he travelled to Jordan and met with Prime Minister Jahabi of Jordan, King Fayssal. On 12 August, he arrived in Geneva to attend the Conference on Disarmament and met with the Secretary-General of the United Nations Conference on Disarmament, Ordzhonikidze, Director-General of the World Health Organization, Chen Feng Fung-jin. On 13 August, he met with the High Commissioner of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, Guterres, President of the World Economic Forum, Schwab. On 19 August, he met with the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Singapore, Yang Yong-moon. On 20 August, he met with the visiting Minister for Foreign Affairs of Serbia, Jeremić. On 21 August, he met with the visiting Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Mali, Vane. On 24 August, he met with the President of Pakistan, Asif Ali Zardari. On 30 August, he met with the visiting Special Representative of the Prime Minister of Turkey, Minister of State Charayan. On 2 September, he met with the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Cuba,
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 9月8日，他在北京与来访的非洲联盟委员会主席让·平共同主持了中国－非盟第二次战略对话。9月19日，在京出席新中国60年外交理论研讨会开幕式。9月21日至25日，他陪同胡锦涛出席联合国系列峰会和二十国集团领导人第三次金融峰会。9月28日第三次中日韩外长会议在上海举行，他会见日本外相冈田克也、韩国外长柳明桓。9月29日，会见了来华访问的美国常务副国务卿斯坦伯格。
target_text: On 8 September, in Beijing, he co-chaired the second China-AU strategic dialogue with the visiting Chairperson of the African Union Commission, Jean Ping. On 19 September, he attended the opening of the New China 60-year diplomatic theory seminar in Kyoto. From 21 to 25 September, he accompanied Hu Jintao to the series of United Nations summits and the third financial summit of G-20 leaders. The third meeting of the Foreign Ministers of China and Japan was held in Shanghai on 28 September, where he met with Foreign Minister Tanya Tanaka of Japan and Foreign Minister Liu Ming Dynasty of South Korea. On 29 September, he met with Permanent Secretary of State Stanberg, who visited China.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 10月4日至10月6日，他陪同国务院总理温家宝访问朝鲜，参加中朝建交60周年活动。10月27日，杨洁篪出席中俄印三国外长会晤并达成重要共识，三国外长发表了《中华人民共和国、俄罗斯联邦和印度共和国外交部长会晤联合公报》。11月10日至13日，杨洁篪陪同中共中央总书记、国家主席胡锦涛访问马来西亚、新加坡并出席在新加坡举行的亚太经合组织第十七次领导人非正式会议。11月20日，在东京会见日本首相鸠山由纪夫。11月29日，杨洁篪在南京同欧盟轮值主席国瑞典外交大臣比尔特、欧盟委员会对外关系委员瓦尔德纳和欧盟候任主席国西班牙外交国务秘书洛萨达举行会晤。
target_text: From 4 October to 6 October, he accompanied Premier Wen Jiabao of the State Council on his visit to North Korea to participate in the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese-Chinese Empire. On 27 October, Yang Jiechi attended a meeting and reached an important consensus between the Foreign Ministers of China and the Russian Federation, who issued a joint communiqué on the meeting of the Ministers for Foreign Affairs of the People ' s Republic of China, the Russian Federation and the Republic of India. From 10 to 13 November, Yang Jiechi accompanied the Central Secretary of the Communist Party of China, Chairman Hu Jintao, on his visit to Malaysia, Singapore and attended the seventeenth informal meeting of leaders of APEC, held in Singapore. On 20 November, he met with Prime Minister Yukio Hatoyama of Japan in Tokyo. On 29 November, Yang Jiechi held a meeting in Nanjing with the Swedish Minister for Foreign Affairs of the EU Presidency, Bilt, the European Commission Commissioner for External Relations, Waldner, and the Spanish State Secretary for Foreign Affairs of the EU Presidency-designate, Rosada.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 12月9日，杨洁篪和外交部部长助理翟隽分别会见了美国副国务卿伯恩斯。12月10日，杨洁篪在北京会见了阿曼外交部秘书长赛义德·巴德尔。12月12日，在阿斯塔纳会见哈萨克斯坦国务秘书兼外长绍达巴耶夫。12月17日至18日，他陪同国务院总理温家宝赴丹麦出席哥本哈根气候变化会议领导人会议。12月28日，杨洁篪会见来京述职的香港特区行政长官曾荫权。12月29日，在京会见陪同尼泊尔总理尼帕尔访华的尼泊尔副总理兼外长苏贾塔·柯伊拉腊。同日，与来访的吉布提外交和国际合作部长优素福举行会谈。12月30日，杨洁篪外长会见韩国新任驻华大使柳佑益。
target_text: On 9 December, Yang Jiechi accompanied Prime Minister Wen Jiabao of the State Council to Denmark at the meeting of leaders of the Copenhagen Climate Change Conference. On 28 December, Yang Jiechi met with the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in Kyoto. On 29 December, Yang Jiechi met with the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs of Nepal, Sojata Koirala, who accompanied Nepal Prime Minister Nepal to China. On the same day, he met with the visiting Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Djibouti, Yusuf. On 30 December, Yang Jiechi met with the new Ambassador of South Korea in Hua.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 1月5日，马尔代夫总统纳希德在首都马累会见到访的中国外长杨洁篪。2010年1月6日至7日，杨洁篪访问非洲肯尼亚，并与肯尼亚总统齐贝吉和总理奥廷加会面。8日至9日，访问尼日利亚。9日至10日，访问塞拉利昂，与塞拉利昂总统科罗马会面。10日至11日，访问阿尔及利亚，与阿尔及利亚总统布特弗利卡会面。11日至12日，访问摩洛哥，与摩洛哥首相法西会面。12日至13日，访问沙特阿拉伯，与沙特阿拉伯国王阿卜杜拉会面。1月14日，就联合国人员在海地伤亡向潘基文致慰问电，1月17日，他向在海地地震中因执行联合国维和任务牺牲的战士家属致唁电。1月25日，他对土耳其进行访问，期间作为中国领导人胡锦涛的特别代表出席在伊斯坦布尔举行的土耳其阿富汗问题地区峰会，并与阿富汗总统卡尔扎伊、土耳其总理埃尔多安会面。1月28，出席在伦敦举行的阿富汗问题国际会议。2月1日，他对塞浦路斯进行访问，并与塞浦路斯总统赫里斯托菲亚斯会面。2月3日，他出访法国，并同法国外长库什内举行会谈。2月4日与法国总统萨科齐会面。2月5日至7日，他出席在慕尼黑举行的安全政策会议。
target_text: From 6 to 7 January 2010, Yang Jiechi visited Kenya in Africa and met with Kenyan President Kibaki and Prime Minister Otingga. From 8 to 10 January, he visited Nigeria. From 9 to 10 January, he visited Sierra Leone to meet with Sierra Leone President Koroma. From 10 to 11 January, he visited Algeria to meet with Algerian President Bouteflika. From 11 to 12, he visited Morocco to meet with Prime Minister Fassi of Morocco. From 12 to 13, he visited Saudi Arabia to meet with King Abdullah of Saudi Arabia. On 14 January, he sent a message of condolences to Ban Ki-moon on the deaths and injuries of United Nations personnel in Haiti, and on 17 January, he gave a message of condolences to the families of fighters who had lost their lives in connection with the United Nations peacekeeping mission in Haiti. On 25 January, he visited Turkey, during which a special representative of Hu Jintao, who was the leader of China, attended the regional summit on Afghanistan in Istanbul, and met with President Karzai of Afghanistan and Prime Minister Erdoğan of Turkey, who met with the Foreign Minister of France on 2 February.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 2011年1月4日，外长杨洁篪在华盛顿白宫会见了美国总统奥巴马；同日，他与美国参议院外委会首席成员卢格及众议院“美中工作小组”共同主席拉森、布斯坦尼、前共同主席、联邦参议员柯克及众议员鲍尔森等会面。随后他会见了美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿、美国财政部长盖特纳和商务部长骆家辉，为胡锦涛即将对美国进行国事访问有关准备工作及中美关系交换意见。1月6日，他与联合国秘书长潘基文会面。1月7日，在芝加哥会见芝加哥市市长理查德·戴利。1月10日，杨洁篪同来华访问的第65届联合国大会主席约瑟夫·戴斯举行会谈。1月11日上午，在北京会见了美国国防部长盖茨。1月18日至1月21日，他陪同胡锦涛对美国进行国事访问，期间两国发表《中美联合声明》，双方同意建设全面互利的经济伙伴关系。1月19日，杨洁篪与美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿分别代表中美两国政府在华盛顿签署了《关于建立中美省州长论坛以促进地方合作的谅解备忘录》，支持中国人民对外友好协会和美国全国州长协会建立中美省州长论坛。
target_text: On 4 January 2011, Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi met with United States President Barack Obama at the White House in Washington; on the same day, he met with the Chief Member of the United States Senate's Foreign Affairs Committee, Luger, and the co-chairmen of the United States-China Working Group. On 7 January, he met with the Mayor of Chicago, Richard Daley. On 10 January, Yang Jiechi met with the President of the 65th United Nations General Assembly, Joseph Deiss, who visited China. On the morning of 11 January, he met with United States Secretary of Defense Gates in Beijing. From 18 January to 21 January, he accompanied Hu Jintao in his country visit to the United States, during which he issued a joint statement by the United States Secretary-General, Pan Ki-moon. On 7 January, he met with the Mayor of Chicago, Richard Daley.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 1月3日，杨洁篪外长访问科特迪瓦，并与科特迪瓦总统瓦塔拉会面。1月4日，他抵达尼日尔，同尼日尔外交部长巴祖姆会谈，并与尼日尔总统优素福会面。1月5日，同纳米比亚外长乌托尼举行会谈。1月12日，他在北京篪蒙古国外长赞达沙塔尔会谈。1月13日，会见来华出席中美“二轨”高层对话第三次会议的美国前国务卿基辛格。2月6日，同柬埔寨副首相兼外交国际合作部大臣会谈。2月8日，在北京会见印度外长克里希纳。2月12日，同来华访问的越南外交部长范平明举行会谈。2月13日至17日，杨洁篪陪同国家副主席习近平访问美国。2月28日，在北京同来访的哥伦比亚外长奥尔古因举行会谈。2月29日至3月2日，他出访印度、韩国。3月1日，在新德里同印度外长克里希纳举行了会谈，为金砖国家领导人第四次会晤做准备；同日他与印度总理辛格会面。3月2日，杨洁篪在首尔与韩国总统李明博会面。3月8日，杨洁篪在北京会见澳门特别行政区行政长官崔世安，期间杨洁篪感谢特区政府对外交部和驻澳门公署工作的支持。3月16日，与以色列副总理兼外长利伯曼举行会谈。3月21日，他在北京与来访的埃及外长阿姆鲁举行会谈
target_text: On 3 January, Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi visited Côte d'Ivoire and met with President Ouattara of Côte d'Ivoire. On 4 January, he arrived in Niger to meet with Foreign Minister Bazoum of the Niger and with President Yusuf of the Niger. On 5 January, he met with Foreign Minister Van Pingmin of Viet Nam, who visited China. On 12 January, he accompanied Vice-President Xi Jinping to the United States on 13 and 17 February. On 28 February, he met with former United States Secretary of State Olguin in Beijing at the third meeting of the “Second Track” high-level dialogue. From 29 February to 2 March, he met with the Deputy Prime Minister of Cambodia and Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of India, Mr. Krishna, in New Delhi on 8 February. He met with the Foreign Minister of India, Mr. Krishna, in preparation for the fourth meeting with the leadership of the Kimbing State; he met with the Prime Minister of India, Mr. Sheung Sheung, in Beijing, on 21 March, and with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Egypt, who met with the Minister of South Africa, Mr.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text:
2013年
2013年3月16日，第十二届全国人大第一次会议决定，根据李克强总理的提名，任命杨洁篪为国务委员，晋身党和国家领导人，并不再担任外交部长，由国务院台湾事务办公室原主任王毅接任外交部长。同日习近平签署《中华人民共和国主席令》（第二号）正式任命。同年8月起，杨洁篪兼任中共中央外事工作领导小组办公室主任。12月6日，杨洁篪与南非、巴西、俄罗斯、印度高级官员出席在南非开普敦举行的金砖国家安全事务高级代表第四次会议。
target_text: On 16 March 2013, the First Meeting of the Twelfth National People ' s Congress decided, on the basis of the nomination of Prime Minister Li Keqiang, to appoint Yang Jiechi as State Councillor, to take over the leadership of the Party and the State, and to replace him as Minister for Foreign Affairs, with Wang Yi, former Director-General of the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council. On the same day, Xi Jinping signed the Presidential Decree of the People ' s Republic of China (No. 2). Yang Jiechi also served as Chief of Staff of the Central Foreign Service Team of the Communist Party of China since August of the same year. On 6 December, Yang Jiechi attended the fourth meeting of the High Representative for the National Security of the BRICS, held in Cape Town, South Africa.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text:
2017年
2017年10月25日，67岁的杨洁篪在中共十九届一中全会上当选中共中央政治局委员。这是时隔15年后，再一次有高级外交官进入中共中央政治局，上一位进入中共中央政治局的外交官还是2002年卸任的钱其琛。12月19日，会见意大利外长阿尔法诺，同日与法国总统外事顾问埃蒂安举行中法战略对话。12月22日，中印边界问题特别代表第二十次会晤在新德里举行，杨洁篪同印度国家安全顾问多瓦尔进行会谈，并会见了印度总理莫迪。
target_text: On 25 October 2017, Yang Jiechi, 67 years old, was elected as a member of the Central Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China at the 19th plenary session of the Chinese Communist Party. This was another 15 years later, when senior diplomats entered the Central Political Office of the Communist Party and the last diplomat who entered the Central Political Office of the Communist Party of the People's Republic of China was dismissed in 2002 for money. On 19 December, he met with the Italian Foreign Minister, Alfano, and on the same day he held a China-France strategic dialogue with the French Foreign Adviser to the President, Etienne. On 22 December, the 20th meeting of the Special Representative for the China-India border took place in New Delhi, where Yang Jiechi met with India's National Security Adviser, Dovar, and with Indian Prime Minister Modi.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text:
2018年
2018年1月11日，在北京会见英国首相国家安全顾问塞德维尔。3月19日卸任国务委员职务，专任中央外事工作委员会办公室主任。9月29日，在北京会见哥斯达黎加前总统奥斯卡·阿里亚斯·桑切斯。10月18日，在俄罗斯索契出席瓦尔代国际辩论俱乐部年会外交议题讨论会并发表讲话。11月9日，杨洁篪在华盛顿主持第二轮中美外交安全对话后，同国务委员兼国防部长魏凤和，以及美国国务卿蓬佩奥和国防部长马蒂斯共同会见记者。
target_text: On 11 January 2018, a meeting was held in Beijing with the National Security Adviser to the British Prime Minister, Cedeville. On 19 March, he resigned as Chief of Staff of the Central Foreign Service Commission. On 29 September, a meeting was held in Beijing with the former President of Costa Rica, Oscar Arias Sánchez. On 18 October, he attended and spoke at the annual meeting of the Valdé International Debate Club in Sochi, Russia. On 9 November, Yang Jiechi hosted the second round of the Chinese-American diplomatic and security dialogue in Washington, D.C., he met with the Secretary of State and Secretary of Defense, Wei Feng, as well as with United States Secretary of State Pompao and Secretary of Defense Mattis.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 4月15日，他应约同美国国务卿蓬佩奥通电话。5月初中印边境冲突爆发，印度国家安全顾问与杨洁篪进行会谈，并坚持印中两国有足够的双边机制循外交途径解决边境冲突。6月16日至17日，杨洁篪应约同美国国务卿蓬佩奥在美國夏威夷举行对话。8月14日，前往越南驻华使馆，吊唁原越共中央总书记黎可漂逝世。8月20日，会见新加坡总理李显龙。8月22日，在釜山同韩国国家安保室长徐薰举行磋商。
target_text: On 15 April, he spoke with the United States Secretary of State, Pompeaux, on the telephone. At the beginning of May, the Indian National Security Adviser met with Yang Jiechi, who insisted that there were enough bilateral mechanisms between the two countries to resolve the border through diplomatic means. On 16 and 17 June, Yang Jiechi held a dialogue with US Secretary of State Pompeyo in Hawaii. On 14 August, he travelled to the Vietnamese Embassy in China to pay tribute to the death of former Viet Nam's central secretary. On 20 August, he met with Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Long. On 22 August, he held a consultation in Busan with the head of the South Korean National Security Office, Seo-soo.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 9月1日，杨洁篪访问缅甸，并与缅甸总统温敏、国务资政昂山素季、缅甸国防军总司令敏昂莱会面，并表示中国会优先共享疫苗技术给缅甸。9月3日，他到访西班牙，并与西班牙首相佩德羅·桑切斯、西班牙外交大臣阿兰查·冈萨雷斯在马德里进行会谈。9月4日，他访问希腊，并在雅典与希腊总统卡特琳娜·萨凯拉罗普卢、总理基里亞科斯·米佐塔基斯会谈。9月24日，出席由中国人民对外友好协会、古巴驻华大使馆共同举办的庆祝中古建交60周年招待会，并会见古驻华大使佩雷拉。
target_text: On 1 September, Yang Jiechi visited Myanmar and met with the President of Myanmar, Daw Aung San Suu Kyi, the Minister of State Administration, and the Commander-in-Chief of the Myanmar Defence Force, Min Aung Lei, and stated that China would give priority to sharing vaccine technology for Myanmar. On 3 September, he visited Spain and met with the Spanish Prime Minister, Pedro Sanchez, and the Spanish Minister for Foreign Affairs, Alain González, in Madrid. On 4 September, he visited Greece, where he met with the Greek President, Katrina Saquilaroplu, Prime Minister Chiriacos Mitsotsakis. On 24 September, he attended a reception to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the Chinese-Congregation, organized jointly by the Chinese People ' s Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and the Cuban Embassy in China.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 2021年1月29日，杨洁篪视频会见第75届联大安理会改革政府间谈判机制共同主席、波兰常驻联合国代表维罗涅卡和卡塔尔常驻联合国代表阿尔萨尼。2月2日，在北京同美国美中关系全国委员会举行视频对话。2月6日，杨洁篪应约同美国国务卿布林肯通电话。应卡塔尔、乌干达、赞比亚、科威特政府邀请，杨洁篪于2月19日至23日对上述四国进行正式访问。2月20日，卡塔尔埃米尔塔米姆·本·哈邁德·阿勒薩尼在多哈会见杨洁篪。
target_text: On 29 January 2021, Yang Jiechi met with the co-chairs of the 75th session of the United Nations General Assembly intergovernmental negotiations on Security Council reform, the Permanent Representative of Poland to the United Nations, Veronika, and the Permanent Representative of Qatar to the United Nations, Alsani. On 2 February, a video dialogue was held in Beijing with the United States-China National Committee on Relations with the United States. On 6 February, Yang Jiechi spoke with the United States Secretary of State, Bulkin. At the invitation of the Governments of Qatar, Uganda, Zambia and Kuwait, Yang Jiechi made an official visit to those four countries from 19 to 23 February. On 20 February, the Emir of Qatar, Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani, met with Yang Jiechi in Doha.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text: 3月18日至19日，中美兩國高層，包括美国国务卿布林肯及白宮國家安全顧問苏利文和中国国务委员兼外交部長王毅及中央外事工作委员会办公室主任杨洁篪等，在阿拉斯加安克拉治舉行拜登总统任期內首次面對面會談。双方代表两日内共展开了三轮会议，会议大部分时间闭门进行，但向媒体开放、约定只限于各二分钟的开场白部分，却因双方激烈交锋而延长至一个小时以上。此次会谈结束后，双方没有发表联合声明，也没有召开联合记者会。3月31日，杨洁篪在北京分别会见柬埔寨驻华大使西索达、老挝驻华大使坎葆、科威特驻华大使赛米赫。各方表示支持中国“一国两制”方针并支持中国在涉港问题上的正当立场。
target_text: From 18 to 19 March, three rounds of meetings were held between representatives of the United States and the United States, most of which were closed, but which were opened to the media and agreed to be limited to two minutes of opening white space, were extended for more than an hour by intense confrontation between the two sides. At the end of the talks, neither a joint statement nor a joint press conference was issued. On 31 March, Yang Jiechi met in Beijing with Cambodia’s Ambassador to China, West Soda, Lao Ambassador to China, Kanya, and Kuwait’s Ambassador to China, Samih. The parties expressed support for China’s “one country, two systems” approach and supported China’s legitimate position on Hong Kong.
title: 杨洁篪

source_text:
退休
2022年10月23日，72岁的杨洁篪在中共二十届一中全会后卸任中共中央政治局委员，并在2023年1月1日卸任中央外事办主任一职退休，由王毅接任。个人生活
杨洁篪的业余爱好比较广泛，他酷爱读书、音乐、书法和乒乓球。他担任过外交部京剧协会名誉会长；2008年外交部京剧演唱会上，杨洁篪最后上台，扮演陈宫演唱《捉放曹》。他还曾在外交部内部联欢会上高歌《敖包相会》。
target_text: On October 23, 2022, Yang Jiechi, age 72, resigned as a member of the Central Political Bureau of the Central Communist Party after the 20th plenary session of the Chinese Communist Party, and retired as Director of the Central Foreign Office on January 1st, 2023, and was replaced by Wang Yi. The personal life of Yang Jiechi is more extensive, and he loves reading, music, book law and ping-pong. He served as the Honorary President of the Tokyo Theatre Association of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Yang Jiechi finally took office at the 2008 Tokyo Theatre concert of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, playing the role of " Sequete Cao " .
title: 杨洁篪

source_text:
周文重（），籍贯江苏镇江，生于重庆，中华人民共和国外交家，大学本科学历。第十二届全国政协常委。曾任外交部副部长和驻美国大使。生平

target_text: Zhou Wenqiang, born in Chongqing, a diplomat from the People ' s Republic of China, and a university-level scientific calendar. Twelfth National Standing Committee of the Political Consultative Conference. Former Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs and Ambassador to the United States. target_text: In September 1990, he was Ambassador of the People ' s Republic of China to Barbados and Ambassador to Antigua and Barbuda. 章文晋祖父章一山，父亲章以吴（周恩来天津南开中学同学），母亲朱淇筠（前北洋政府交通总长朱启钤之女）。章文晋少年时代1927年赴德国留学；1931年回国参加抗日；1935年考入清华大学机械系；1943年获清华大学工学士学位。1949年任天津市人民政府外事处处长；1954年进入外交部；1966年8月至1967年2月任中国驻巴基斯坦大使；1971年1月至1972年5月任欧美司司长；参与了中美关系正常化过程的工作。1973年9月至1976年12月任中国驻加拿大大使。1978年1月至1982年10月任中国外交部副部长。1983年3月至1985年4月任中国驻美国大使。
target_text: In 1927, he went to Germany to study in 1927, returned in 1931 to take part in protest days, joined the Faculty of Mechanics at the University of Qinghua in 1935, received a Bachelor of Arts degree at the University of Qinghua in 1943, served as Head of the Foreign Affairs Department of the People ' s Government of Tianjin City in 1949, entered the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1954, served as Ambassador of China to Pakistan from August 1966 to February 1967, served as Director of the European and American Division from January 1971 to May 1972, and participated in the process of normalizing relations between China and the United States. He served as Ambassador of China to Canada from September 1973 to December 1976. He served as Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of China from March 1983 to April 1985.

source_text: 1978年夏，柴泽民出任中国驻美国联络处主任，参与了中美关系邦交正常化的谈判。1978年底，中美两国达成协议，定于1979年1月1日正式建立外交关系，于3月1日互设大使馆并互换大使。柴泽民由此成为首任驻美大使。由于对中美关系的建立与发展所做出的贡献，美国密西根州立大学等三所大学授予柴泽民名誉法学博士学位及名誉教授职位。
target_text: At the end of 1978, China and the United States agreed on the formal establishment of diplomatic relations on 1 January 1979, and on the exchange of embassies and ambassadors on 1 March 1979. As a result, Zaizen became the first Ambassador to the United States. As a result of its contribution to the establishment and development of relations between China and the United States, three universities, including the Michigan State University, were awarded the position of Honorary Doctor of Law and Honorary Professor of Zaizen.

source_text: 部分媒体认为，中国早已经严格限制非政府组织在中国境内的活动，受到制裁的非政府组织在中国境内并没有设立任何办事处，这种制裁也被认为仅具有象征意义。在香港，接受国家民主基金会拨款的劳工倡导和人权组织有、等。中国政府指控这些被制裁的非政府组织是“通过各种方式支持反中乱港分子，极力教唆他们从事极端暴力犯罪行为，煽动‘港独’分裂活动”的“反华势力”。美国国务院官员对此否认，并认为针对美国非政府组织为“外国干涉势力的不实指控”，是为了“意在分散人们对香港人合理诉求的关切”，哈德逊研究所外交政策分析师兼前官员白邦瑞则表示，他们通过当地的领事馆，执行确保香港民主的香港政策法案，通过该基金来资助这些组织，所以从这个意义上中国的指责并非完全错误。2020年8月10日，包括国家民主基金会总裁卡尔·格什曼在内的11名美国官员及人士遭中国政府制裁。
target_text: In Hong Kong, labour advocacy and human rights organizations that receive funding from the National Democracy Fund (NDF) are known to some of the media as “anti-China forces” who have long restricted the activities of non-governmental organizations (NGOs) in China. The United States Department of State denied that the sanctions were “untruthful accusations against foreign interventionists” and “intrusive concerns about Hong Kong's legitimate claims”, while Hudson Institute Foreign Policy Analyst and former official Pai Bong Ri stated that they were using local consulates to implement the Hong Kong Policy Bill to ensure Hong Kong democracy and to finance these organizations through the Fund, and that China's accusations in this sense were not entirely wrong. On 10 August 2020, 11 United States officials and persons, including Carl Gushman, President of the National Democratic Foundation, were sanctioned by the Chinese Government.
title: 美国国家民主基金会

source_text: 馬爾他騎士團因其極為特殊歷史，現世也處於非常態的情況，一般說來，將馬爾他騎士團視為一主權實體，應該比定位為一個主權國家更準確。騎士團位於羅馬，擁有兩棟建築，享有治外法權。其一為總部馬爾他宮，是大教長官邸及團部政府行政中心。一為馬爾他部，主管者為羅馬修道院院長，該部是馬爾他騎士團外交部，也是马耳他骑士团驻意大利兼駐聖座大使館。
target_text: The Knights of Malta, because of their extraordinary history, are also in a very unusual situation in the world. In general, it should be more precise to treat the Knights of Malta as a sovereign entity than to position them as a sovereign country. The Knights are based in Rome, with two buildings with extraterritorial jurisdiction. They are the headquarters of the Marta Palace, the administrative centre of the residence of the Dean of the Church and the delegation. The head of the Order of Malta is the head of the Order of Rome, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Order of Malta, and the Order of Malta's Embassy in Italy.
title: 馬爾他騎士團

source_text: 雖然大部份的學者均接受國際法對馬爾他騎士團主權獨立地位的解釋，而馬爾他騎士團也享有派駐特命全權大使之權利，但在德國國際法學專家所著的《國際法》（，1964年由Springer出版，1530頁）一書中指出，拒絕馬爾他騎士團派遣的大使等於是承認其為主權國家地位。聖座於1953年曾宣佈馬爾他騎士團為以神之名之功能組織，因此事實上騎士團應該是相對於共主邦聯之地位。
target_text: Although most scholars have accepted the interpretation of international law of the autonomy of the Knights of Malta and the right of the Knights of Malta to send full-time ambassadors, the book International Law (published by Springer in 1964 on page 1530), written by German international law experts, states that refusing the Ambassador sent by the Knights of Malta is tantamount to recognizing him as a sovereign state. The Order proclaimed the Knights of Malta as a functional organization in the name of God in 1953.
title: 馬爾他騎士團

source_text: 馬爾他騎士團在外交上以推動人道救援為主，而騎士團透過目前分佈在全球一百多個國家以上的合法機構實行此目標。在國際政治範圍裏，騎士團持中立、公正及非政治化的態度參與相關事務，也因此騎士團能在受一國請求調停爭議時，扮演好調停者的角色。近年來騎士團在外交領域呈穩定成長狀態，目前在一百多個國家設有大使館及分會。
target_text: In the international political arena, the Knights are involved in matters of neutrality, impartiality, and non-politicization, so that the Knights can play the role of adjuster when a country asks to settle a dispute. In recent years, the Knights have grown steadily in diplomatic circles and now have embassies and branches in more than a hundred countries.
title: 馬爾他騎士團

source_text: 他的统治体现了对法国的同情和启蒙運動的色彩。在最新组建的内阁中，曾一度扮演马克西米利安·约瑟夫私人秘书的角色，他的“启蒙化”和法国化强烈影响了马克西米利安·约瑟夫。农业、商业渐渐地发展起来，法律被改良，一部新的刑法在勾勒中，税收上废除了一些因封建特权而产生的不平等，宗教建筑的数量被缩减且它们的收支更多的应用于教育等有用的方面。在外交上，马克西米利安·约瑟夫直到1813年都是拿破仑最忠实的德国盟友，他们的关系由于马克西米利安·约瑟夫之女与拿破仑义子欧仁·德·博阿尔内亲王1806年初的婚姻而更加坚固。随着西元1805年12月26日普雷斯堡条约的签定，马克西米利安·约瑟夫得到了国王的称号和在施瓦本与法兰克尼亚的重要土地。他于次年正式使用国王的称号。
target_text: His rule was marked by sympathy and enlightenment for France. In the most recent cabinet, Maximilien Joseph was the personal secretary of Napoleon until 1813, when his “enlightenment” and Frenchization strongly affected Maximilien Joseph. Agriculture, commerce, and the law were gradually developed, and a new penal code was amended, in which inequalities arising from feudal privileges were removed from taxes, the number of religious buildings was reduced, and their payments were more applied to education, among other useful aspects. In diplomacy, Maximilien Joseph was Napoleon's most loyal German ally until 1813, and his relationship was reinforced by the marriage of Prince Napoleon's son, Eugène de Boarne, in early 1806.
title: 马克西米利安一世 (巴伐利亚国王)

source_text: 巴伐利亚的新王成了萊茵聯邦最重要的君主，在莱比锡战役之前，他仍是拿破仑的盟友。直到1813年10月8日巴奥里德条约的签定，巴伐利亚在保持完整独立的前提下退出莱茵邦聯，加入以奥地利帝國、英国、俄国、普鲁士王國等为首的第六次反法同盟，并于10月14日向法国宣战。在1814年6月3日的第一次巴黎条约中，巴伐利亚将蒂罗尔让给奥地利帝國交换来维尔茨堡。在维也纳和会上，巴伐利亚对奥地利帝國做出了更大的让步。马克西米利安一世在维也纳会议上坚决反对德意志的重建，因为这将危及到巴伐利亚的独立地位。他坚持认为新成立的德意志邦联应是一个建立在各邦国充分享有主权的前提下的宽松的组织，这一点他实现了。1818年5月26日，马克西米利安一世带给国民们一部自由主义的宪法。
target_text: The new King of Bavaria became the most important monarch of the Rhine, and before the battle of Leipzig, he remained Napoleon’s ally. Until the signing of the Treaty of Baolid on 8 October 1813, Bavaria withdrew from the Rhine, while maintaining full independence, and joined the sixth anti-law coalition, headed by the Austrian Empire, Britain, Russia, and the Prussia, which declared war to France on 14 October. In the first Paris Pact of 3 June 1814, Bavarian gave Tyrol to the Austrian Empire in exchange for Wiltsburg.
title: 马克西米利安一世 (巴伐利亚国王)

source_text: 国际人道法（）是规制武装冲突中行为的法律（战时法）。它是国际法的一个分支，旨在保护不再参与敌对行动的人并限制和规制战斗员所能够使用的作战手段和方法，从而限制武装冲突的影响。国际人道法的创立源于人道方面的考虑和减少人类苦难。“国际人道法包含一套由条约或习惯确立的规则，旨在保护受到或可能受到武装冲突影响的人员和物体并限制交战双方对所选择作战方式和手段的使用。”它包括“日内瓦公约和海牙公约以及一些其他条约、判例法和习惯国际法。”它规定了交战国、中立国和参与战争的个人的行为以及他们对于彼此以及对于受保护的人（通常指非战斗员）所应承担的责任。它旨在维持人道考量与军事必要性之间的平衡，它使战争受到法律的规制，从而限制战争的破坏性影响和减少人类苦难。
target_text: International humanitarian law (IHL) is the law governing the conduct of armed conflict (the law of war). It is a branch of international law designed to limit the effects of armed conflict by protecting persons no longer taking part in hostilities and limiting and regulating the means and methods of warfare available to combatants. The creation of IHL stems from considerations of humanity and the reduction of human suffering. “IHL contains a set of rules established by treaties or custom to protect persons and objects affected or likely to be affected by armed conflict and to limit the use by belligerents of the means and means of warfare chosen.” It includes “the Geneva Conventions and Hague Conventions, as well as a number of other treaties, case law and customary international law.” It sets out the conduct of belligerents, neutrals and individuals involved in war, as well as their responsibilities towards each other and towards protected persons (usually non-combatants). It aims to maintain a balance between humanitarian considerations and military necessity, which makes war subject to legal regulation, thus limiting the devastating effects of war and reducing human suffering.
title: 國際人道法

source_text: 《日内瓦公约》的范围反映出红十字国际委员会关注的重点在于战争受难者的需求。但到19世纪末期，各国政府开始推介人道法的一个分支——规制作战方法的国际规则《海牙公约》。在一战即将结束之时，红十字国际委员会呼吁停止化学战。随后的讨论促成了1925年禁止化学武器条约的通过，该条约的一系列规则至今仍然有效。
target_text: The scope of the Geneva Conventions reflects the focus of the International Committee of the Red Cross on the needs of war victims. By the end of the nineteenth century, however, Governments began to promote the Hague Convention, a branch of humanitarian law, the international rules governing methods of warfare. At the end of World War I, the International Committee of the Red Cross called for the cessation of chemical warfare.
title: 國際人道法

title: 黃金寶

source_text: 潘基文出生于今韩国忠清北道。在忠州上高中的时候，他曾参加美国红十字会主办的“外国学生访美计划（VISITA）”的选拔，后与其他三名韩国学生代表出访美国各地，并受到时任美国总统约翰·肯尼迪的接见。此次经历使他立志成为一名外交官，后考入首尔大学外交系学习。1970年大学毕业后，潘基文以优异的成绩进入韩国外交部。他先后在金泳三、金大中和卢武铉三届韩国政府中担任外交要职，受到韩国朝野器重。
target_text: Ban Ki-moon was born in Hokkaido, Korea. When he was in high school in Chongzhou, he was selected by the American Red Cross for the VISITA programme for foreign students, and then travelled to various parts of the United States with three other Korean student representatives, who were received by then US President John F. Kennedy. This experience made him a diplomat and later joined the Department of Diplomacy at Seoul University. After graduating from college in 1970, Ban Ki-moon entered the South Korean Foreign Service with excellent grades.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2006年10月13日，潘基文在第61届联合国大会上当选联合国第八任秘书长。他是首位来自东亚，也是第二位来自于亚洲的联合国秘书长（首位是缅甸的吳丹）。2007年1月1日，潘基文接替科菲·安南出任联合国秘书长一职。2011年6月21日，潘基文在第65届联合国大会上获得连任，任期至2016年12月31日。
target_text: On 13 October 2006, Ban Ki-moon was elected as the eighth Secretary-General of the United Nations at the 61st session of the United Nations General Assembly. He was the first Secretary-General of the United Nations from East Asia and the second from Asia, Oh Than, Myanmar. On 1 January 2007, Ban Ki-moon succeeded Kofi Annan as Secretary-General of the United Nations. Ban Ki-moon was re-elected at the 65th session of the United Nations General Assembly on 21 June 2011 for a second term until 31 December 2016.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 高二的时候，他参加美国红十字会主办的“外国学生访美计划（VISITA）”的选拔，入选为出访美国的四位韩国学生代表之一。他因此有了“忠州英语神童”的称呼。1962年7月30日至8月31日，他与其他三名韩国学生代表出访美国各地，受到此次活动发起人，时任美国总统约翰·肯尼迪的接见。有117名来自43个国家的学生参加了此次活动。在潘基文当选联合国秘书长之后，他曾表示高中时期与肯尼迪总统见面的经历使他萌生当外交官的想法。肯尼迪总统的弟弟美国国会议员爱德华·肯尼迪还将1962年潘基文在白宫与其它学生代表聆听肯尼迪总统讲话的照片做成礼物送给潘基文，祝贺他的当选。
target_text: In his second year, he took part in a selection sponsored by the American Red Cross for the Foreign Students' Visit to the United States (VISITA) as one of the four Korean student representatives who visited the United States. He therefore had the name “Anglophone Boy” as he called him. From 30 July to 31 August 1962, he travelled with three other Korean student representatives to various parts of the United States, where he was received by United States President John F. Kennedy. 117 students from 43 countries attended the event. After Ban Ki-moon was elected Secretary-General of the United Nations, he said that meeting with President Kennedy in high school had given him the idea of becoming a diplomat.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 1963年，潘基文如愿考入首爾大學外交系。不过当时的朴正熙政府改任军人为外交官，随后取消了外交官考试。1964年，朴正熙试图与日本建交，引发大规模学生抗议游行，学校也被停课。潘基文决定暂时休学提前服兵役。1968年，在潘基文退役后不久，韩国恢复了外交官考试。1970年，潘基文从漢城大学毕业，并以优异的成绩通过韩国外交部的公务员考试，进入外交部。
target_text: In 1963, Ban Ki-moon joined the Department of Diplomacy at Seoul University. However, the then government of Park Jong-hee was replaced as a diplomat, and the diplomatic examination was cancelled. In 1964, Park tried to establish a relationship with Japan, triggering large-scale student protests, and the school was suspended. Ban Ki-moon decided to temporarily suspend early military service. In 1968, shortly after Ban Ki-moon retired, South Korea resumed the diplomatic examination.
title: 潘基文

source_text:
平步青云
1970年潘基文大学毕业进入韩国外交部后，在外交官研修考试中取得了第一名的成绩。按韩国外交部的惯例，考取第一名的事务官应派往美国华盛顿的韩国驻美大使馆，开始外交生涯的第一份在外工作。不过，潘基文因家庭经济情况较差放弃了去美国的机会，而是自愿选择到相对落后印度工作。这样可以省下些钱，补给家里。1972年2月，时任韩国总统朴正熙为与不结盟运动领袖印度建交，任命洛杉矶总领事卢信永为驻新德里领事。潘基文因英语水平出众被卢信永任命为印度总领事馆副领事。
target_text: In accordance with the practice of the South Korean Foreign Office, the first officer to be selected should be sent to the South Korean Embassy in Washington, D.C., to begin his first diplomatic career. But, because of his family’s poor economic situation, Ban Ki-moon has given up his chances of going to the US and voluntarily chose to work in India, which is relatively backward.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 1973年，韩国与印度正式建交后，卢信永晋升韩国驻印度大使，后升任外交部部长、国家安全企划部部长、国务总理等要职。在卢信永的提拔和引荐下，潘基文也开始平步青云。1976年，时任韩国外交部部长将潘基文拔擢为一等秘書。1978年10月，潘基文被任命为驻联合国代表部一等秘書。1980年，卢信永升任外交部部长后，潘基文即被任命为聯合國课课长。1983年8月至1985年4月，潘基文就读于美国哈佛大学肯尼迪政府学院，并获得公共行政硕士学位。1985年，卢信永升任国务总理后，只有三等秘書之衔的潘基文被破格任命为应由一等秘書担任的禮賓秘书官，后又在1987年升任理事官（二等）。同年，外交部長委派潘基文为驻美公使，并在一周之内将他提升为一等。
target_text: In 1976, the then Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea made Ban Ki-moon a first-class secretary. In October 1978, Ban Ki-moon was appointed as First Secretary of the Department of Representatives to the United Nations. In 1980, following his appointment as Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ban Ki-moon was appointed Chief of Staff of the United Nations. From August 1983 to April 1985, Ban Ki-moon studied at the Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University in the United States and obtained a Master ' s degree in Public Administration. In 1985, only Pan Ki-moon, the title of Third Secretary, was appointed as Secretary of State of the United Nations.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 1990年6月， 潘基文结束为期三年的驻美总领事工作后，外交部长任命他接替升任通商局长的金三勋，出任外交部核心要职美洲局局长。金泳三执政期间，潘基文更是得到重用，先后担任外交部助理次官、青瓦台首席礼宾秘书、外交首席安保秘书等职务。
target_text: In June 1990, after Ban Ki-moon had completed his three-year post as Consul General in the United States, the Minister for Foreign Affairs appointed him to replace Kim San-hoon, who was promoted Director of Commerce and Commerce, as Director of the Central American Bureau of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
title: 潘基文

source_text:
被解职
1998年金大中就任韩国总统之后，潘基文的事业发展变得不再顺利。1998年，他就任，期间曾任《全面禁止核试验条约》（CTBT）会议主席。2000年，由于外交部长洪淳瑛提名的次長人选被金大中否决，已在奥地利1年6个月的潘基文才被调回国，替人出任外交部次官的职务。
target_text: Ban Ki-moon’s career was overtaken by the dismissal of Kim Dae-jung in 1998 as President of the Republic of Korea. In 1998, he was President of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT).
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2001年2月，时任俄罗斯总统普京访韩，与金大中总统举行了韩俄首脑会谈，并联合发表共同声明。《联合声明》中明确载入维护和强化《反弹道导弹条约（ABM）》的条款。但当时美国布什政府正在推进防御朝鲜、伊拉克等所谓敌对国家导弹攻击的《国家导弹防御系统（NMD）》。虽然声明中使用的是国际通用语句，但由于声明是在韩美首脑会谈即将举行之际，这被韩国媒体理解为金大中政府对美国NMD体系的反对。尽管韩国外交部对此进行解释，但并没能挽回局面。韩国各大媒体都进行了韩国反对NMD的报道，美国、俄罗斯、英日本等国的媒体也同样态度对此进行了报道，变得不可收拾，给3月出访美国的金大中总统带来巨大的压力。同年4月，作为外交部次官的潘基文与外交部长一起被金大中解职。
target_text: In February 2001, Russian President Vladimir Putin visited Korea, where he met with President Kim Dae-jung, and made a joint statement. The Joint Statement clearly contained provisions to preserve and strengthen the Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty (ABM).
title: 潘基文

source_text: 潘基文从次官落马后，《月刊朝鲜》在同年5月发表了长达50页稿纸的报道，引用了很多外交官对此的感叹。新上任的外交部长韩升洙是潘基文在1990年代担任驻美公使时的驻美大使，他对潘基文的印象很好。他以《月刊朝鲜》的报道和外交部对潘基文的评价为依据，希望青瓦台能再给他工作机会。2001年9月，韩升洙担任联合国大会主席后，恢复了潘基文的外交官身份，任命他为联合国大会主席秘书室室长兼驻联合国总部大使。这段在联合国的经历，也为他日后当选联合国秘书长起到很大的帮助。
target_text: Ban Ki-moon was impressed by Ban Ki-moon, the new Foreign Minister, Han Seung-soo, who was his ambassador to the United States in the 1990s when he served as Minister to the United States. On the basis of the newspaper North Korea and the Foreign Ministry’s evaluation of Ban Ki-moon, he hoped that he would be offered another job. In September 2001, Han Seung-soo resumed his diplomatic status as President of the United Nations General Assembly and appointed Ban Ki-moon as Secretary-General of the United Nations and Ambassador to United Nations Headquarters. This period also helped him in his future election as Secretary-General of the United Nations.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2003年，卢武铉当选韩国总统后，潘基文被调回国担任卢武铉的外交政策顾问，成为卢武铉的“左膀右臂”。卢武铉出任韩国总统后奉行“自主外交”，与美国矛盾不断。时任韩国亲美外交部长与卢武铉在重大外交事务中存在重大分歧，甚至在私下或公开场合评判卢武铉的“自主外交”。最终尹永宽外長和北美局局长魏圣洛被解职。2004年1月16日，潘基文取代尹永宽成为韩国外交部部长。潘基文“既不是独立派，也不是联盟派”，因此他的出任在韩国国内外普遍受到欢迎，认为其能够弥合外交部与青瓦台的裂痕，并维持韩美同盟关系。驻首尔的外交人士也普遍认为“没有比他更适合的人了”。在潘基文就任外长仅五分钟，时任美国驻韩国大使就致電向他表示祝贺。
target_text: In 2003, when Lu Moo-hyun was elected President of the Republic of Korea, Ban Ki-moon was transferred back as Lu Moo-hyun's foreign policy adviser and became his “left arm” of Lu Moo-hyun's “right arm.” After his appointment as President of the Republic of Korea, Lu Moo-hyun pursued “autonomous diplomacy” and ran an ongoing conflict with the United States. There was a great deal of disagreement between the then South Korean pro-American Foreign Minister and Lu Moo-hyun in important foreign affairs, even judging Lu Moo-hyun's “autonomous diplomacy” in private or in public.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 潘基文是公认的“美国通”，凭借其在美国的人脉，他在推行卢武铉政府自主外交政策的同时很好地维系了韩美同盟关系。与此同时，他是朝核问题的斡旋者，在2005年六方会谈上促成具有里程碑意义的朝核问题《共同声明》，为缓和朝鲜半岛局势发挥了重要作用。卢武铉执政期间，韩日关系因独岛主权、日本历史教科书、日相小泉纯一郎参拜靖国神社等问题，出现危机。但在这些关系到韩国国家利益的原则问题，潘基文态度强硬，丝毫不让步，被称为“丝绒手套包裹的铁拳”。
target_text: Ban Ki-moon is a well-known “Americans” who, by virtue of his personal connections in the United States, maintained Korean-American ties well while pursuing the autonomous foreign policy of the Lu Wu-hyun government. At the same time, he was a broker on the Korean-Korean nuclear issue, brokered a landmark Joint Statement on the Korean-Korean nuclear issue at the six-party talks in 2005, and played an important role in defusing the situation on the Korean peninsula.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2005年，随着时任联合国秘书长科菲·安南任期即将结束，各个国家纷纷推出自己的候选人参加下届联合国秘书长的竞选。韩国原本是打算力推原韩国驻美大使洪锡铉，但由于爆出洪锡铉政治献金丑闻，韩国政府改潘基文为联合国秘书长候选人。韩国上下认为如果潘基文能当选联合国秘书长将是提升韩国国际地位，推动朝鲜半岛和平发展的好事，因此都给予积极的支持。2006年2月，潘基文正式宣布参加下任联合国秘书长的角逐，并于同年5月前往联合国总部为竞选拉票，期间发表了题为《如何恢复联合国活力》的演讲。
target_text: In 2005, as the then Secretary-General of the United Nations, Kofi Annan, came to an end, countries launched their own candidates for the next United Nations Secretary-General’s election. South Korea had intended to push for the former Ambassador of Korea to the United States, Hong Xi-hyun, but the Korean government had become Ban Ki-moon’s candidate for the Secretary-General of the United Nations due to a political scandal in Hong Xi-hyun.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 除潘基文外，参加此次联合国秘书长竞选的候选人还有时任联合国副秘书长印度人、时任泰国副总理、约旦常驻联合国代表、斯里兰卡总统顾问、拉脱维亚女总统維拉·薇契-斐柏嘉。根据联合国的规定，当选联合国秘书长需要取得包括5个常任理事国在内的9个理事国的支持。2006年7月、9月中旬和9月下旬，联合国安理会15个成员国对候选人进行了三次摸底投票。潘基文在这三轮投票中得票率始终是领先于其它候选人，三轮得票均超过确保当选必需的9张赞成票，但每次都有一张反对票。10月2日，在第四轮意向性投票中，15个理事国中有14个国家对潘基文投了赞成票，时任联合国理事国成员的日本投了弃权票。2006年10月13日，第61届联合国大会上与会的102个成员国代表以鼓掌的方式通过决议，正式任命潘基文为新一任联合国秘书长。同年11月10日，潘基文结束了其韩国外交通商部长官的工作。11月15日，潘基文抵达联合国总部，开始于时任秘书长安南进行工作交接。他的联合国秘书长的宣誓就职仪式于12月14日举行。
target_text: In addition to Ban Ki-moon, the candidate for the United Nations Secretary-General's election was India, the then Deputy Prime Minister of Thailand, the Permanent Representative of Jordan to the United Nations, the Adviser to the President of Sri Lanka and the female President of Latvia, Vera Vitch-Fiberja. The Secretary-General of the United Nations was elected with the support of nine members, including five permanent members, as stipulated by the United Nations. In July, mid-September and late September 2006, 15 members of the Security Council of the United Nations voted three times to ground the candidate. Ban Ki-moon was consistently ahead of the other candidates in these three rounds of balloting, with more than nine votes obtained in each round than were required to ensure his election, but with one vote in each case. On 2 October, 14 of the 15 members voted in the fourth round of indicative ballots in favour of Ban Ki-moon, while Japan, which was a member of the United Nations, abstained. On 13 October 2006, 102 representatives of Member States at the sixty-first session of the General Assembly of the United Nations formally appointed Pan Ki-moon as the new Secretary-General of the United Nations.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2007年1月初，潘基文任命坦桑尼亚外长阿莎-罗丝·米吉罗为他的联合国常务副秘书长，英国驻法国大使约翰·霍姆斯为联合国人道事务与紧急援助副秘书长 。为兑现竞选承诺，潘基文任命了许多女性担任联合国要职。在潘基文任期的第一年，更多非潘基文亲自任命的女性担任了联合国的相关职务。其中巴林女外交官被选举为联合国大会主席，成为联合国大会历史上的第三位女主席。
target_text: In early January 2007, Ban Ki-moon appointed the Tanzanian Foreign Minister, Asha-Rose Migiro, as his Deputy Secretary-General of the United Nations, and the British Ambassador to France, John Holmes, as the United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Assistance. In fulfilment of his campaign commitments, Ban Ki-moon appointed many women to key positions in the United Nations. During the first year of his tenure, more women than Ban Ki-moon personally appointed to relevant positions in the United Nations.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 在入职的头个月，潘基文提出了两项主要的联合国改革建议：一是将联合国维持和平行动部分为两个部门；另一个是将联合国政治事务和裁军部门合并成一个部门。当时有传言说潘基文合并联合国政治事务和裁军部门是为了让美国人担任合并后部门的负责人。因此该提议遭到联合国大会许多发展中国家的强烈抵制。时任美国常驻联合国代表也表示美国支持此提议。经过与联合国代表的协商，潘基文最终放弃了这项合并提议。但是他继续推行了联合国人事任免改革，要求将联合国相关职务任期统一改为五年，所有职务每年都要进行严格的绩效评估，财务对外公开。虽然他的这些改革措施在联合国纽约总部并不受欢迎，但却在联合国在世界其它地区受到欢迎，并得到联合国观察员的赞扬。潘基文的另一项将维和部门分成运作和武器两个部门的提议于2007年3月最终被联合国所采纳。
target_text: During the first month of his tenure, Ban Ki-moon made two major proposals for United Nations reform: first, the partial integration of United Nations peacekeeping operations into two departments; and secondly, the consolidation of the United Nations political affairs and disarmament components into one department. There were rumours that Ban Ki-moon had merged the United Nations political affairs and disarmament components to allow Americans to head the post-integration departments. That proposal was therefore strongly resisted by many developing countries in the United Nations General Assembly. The United States, too, expressed its support for the proposal by the then United States Permanent Representative to the United Nations.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 潘基文将应对全球变暖作为其任期的一个重要课题。他在美国白宫与时任美国总统乔治·W·布什会面时敦促美国采取措施减少温室气体的排放。2007年3月1日和2009年9月3日，他分别在联合国大会和日内瓦世界气候大会发表演说，表达对全球气候变化的担忧。2014年9月，他还参加了纽约市的活动，并召集世界各国领导人参加联合国气候变化首脑会唔，为2015年在巴黎举办的作准备。
target_text: On 1 March 2007 and 3 September 2009, he addressed the United Nations General Assembly and the World Climate Conference in Geneva, respectively, to express his concerns about global climate change. In September 2014, he also participated in events in New York City and convened world leaders to participate in the United Nations Climate Change Summit in Paris in preparation for 2015.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2003年8月，伊拉克巴格达遭到空袭，造成22人死亡后，联合国在伊拉克的作用已经变得非常有限。但潘基文却仍然表示联合国要为伊拉克的社会与政治发展寻求出路。2007年3月22日，潘基文上任不久后首次出访中东。他与伊拉克总理努里·马利基在巴格达绿区的举行新闻发布会遭到火箭弹的袭击。火箭弹在距离会场仅50米处爆炸，所幸潘基文和马利基都没受伤。
target_text: The role of the United Nations in Iraq has become very limited in August 2003, when 22 people were killed as a result of an air strike in Baghdad. But Ban Ki-moon continues to say that the United Nations is looking for a way out for the social and political development of Iraq. On 22 March 2007, Ban Ki-moon visited the Middle East for the first time shortly after taking office.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2011年，在潘基文第一任期的最后一年，利比亚内战爆发。潘基文从始至终一直为和平解决危机游说，多次指出反对对利比亚动武，认为外交手段是解决利比亚危机更好的方法。但他也承认如果卡扎菲拒绝停火协议，那联合国部队别无选择只能武装介入以保护利比亚人民人权。卡扎菲政权最终被推翻，卡扎菲本人也在战争中被击毙。
target_text: In 2011, the last year of Ban Ki-moon’s first term, the Libyan civil war erupted. Ban Ki-moon lobbied for a peaceful solution to the crisis, repeatedly stating his opposition to the use of force against Libya, arguing that diplomacy was a better way to resolve the Libyan crisis.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 潘基文就任后的首次出访是参加2007年1月在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴举行的非洲联盟首脑会唔，以加强与七十七国集团的联系。达尔富尔 是他任期中最重要的人道援助目标。他与时任苏丹总统奥马尔·巴希尔进行了多次面对面的会谈，劝说苏丹允许联合国维和部队进入达尔富尔地区。2007年7月31日，安理会同意派遣26,000名维和军人进入该地区，与那里的7000人非洲联盟部队汇合。此次决议被认为是直面处理达尔富尔战争的重要突破。2007年10月，联合国开始执行第一期达尔富尔维和任务。
target_text: Ban Ki-moon's first visit was to participate in the African Union Summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, in January 2007 to strengthen ties with the Group of 77. Darfur was the most important humanitarian aid objective of his tenure. He held numerous face-to-face meetings with the then President of the Sudan, Omar Al-Bashir, to persuade the Sudan to allow United Nations peacekeeping forces to enter Darfur. On 31 July 2007, the Council agreed to send 26,000 peacekeepers into the region and join the 7,000 African Union forces there. The resolution was considered an important breakthrough in addressing the Darfur war. In October 2007, the United Nations began its first Darfur peacekeeping mission.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2011年6月6日，潘基文正式宣布谋求连任，并得到了五个常任理事国的支持。他是唯一一位公开表示参加竞选的候选人。2011年6月21日，联合国大会以全体鼓掌的方式通过了潘基文的第二个任期。2012年3月2日，潘基文任命瑞典外交官扬·埃利亚松为联合国副秘书长。
target_text: On 6 June 2011, Ban Ki-moon officially announced his candidacy for re-election, supported by the five permanent members. He was the only candidate to publicly present his candidature. On 21 June 2011, the United Nations General Assembly adopted Ban Ki-moon ' s second term by acclamation. On 2 March 2012, Ban Ki-moon appointed the Swedish diplomat Jan Eliasson as Under-Secretary-General of the United Nations.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 由于利比亚内战和阿拉伯之春，中东问题成为潘基文第二个任期开始的工作重心。整个2012年，潘基文都在关注以巴冲突，特别是的绝食事件，以及加沙地带的居民行动受限的问题。2012年8月30日，潘基文在伊朗举行的不结盟运动首脑会议上，对伊朗领导人有关摧毁以色列，否认犹太人大屠杀历史存在的言论进行了批评。2013年8月16日，潘基文与以色列学生会谈的时候承认联合国对以色列有偏倚，并说这种情形是“不幸的”。但几天后，潘基文又否认联合国对以色列有任何歧视。2016年1月26日，在巴勒斯坦袭击以色列后，潘基文说：“与人类历史上被压迫民族一样，这是人性对侵略的自然反映，这也经常会成为仇恨与极端主义的孵化器”。同年12月16日，他在接受采访时说联合国批评以色列的决议、报告和会议数目过多。
target_text: As a result of the Libyan civil war and the Arab Spring, the Middle East became the focus of Ban Ki-moon’s second term of office. Throughout 2012, Ban Ki-moon was concerned about the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, in particular the hunger strike, and about restrictions on the movement of residents in the Gaza Strip. On 30 August 2012, at the summit of the Non-Aligned Movement in Iran, Ban Ki-moon criticized Iranian leaders for their statements about the destruction of Israel and the denial of the history of the Holocaust. On 16 August 2013, when he met with Israeli students, Ban Ki-moon acknowledged that the United Nations was biased against Israel and said that the situation was “unfortunate.” But a few days later, Ban Ki-moon denied that the United Nations had any discrimination against Israel.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 潘基文批评沙特领导的干预也门行动说：“由于冲突的升级，对儿童的严重侵害大幅增加”2016年6月，潘基文将沙特领导的联合军从侵犯儿童人权名单中去除，之后声称沙特威胁如果不把沙特从在也门杀害儿童的黑名单上删除，沙特将停止对巴勒斯坦和其它联合国项目的援助。有消息称，有威胁说利雅德的伊斯兰会议要发布反联合国的伊斯兰教令，将联合国定义为反穆斯林组织，号召伊斯兰合作组织成员不与联合国接触，不对联合国任何项目进行援助。
target_text: Ban Ki-moon criticized the Saudi-led intervention in Yemen for “a significant increase in grave violations against children as a result of the escalation of the conflict.” In June 2016, Ban Ki-moon removed the Saudi-led coalition forces from the list of violations of the human rights of children, after claiming that the Saudi threat would cease to provide assistance to Palestinian and other United Nations projects if Saudi Arabia were not removed from the list of killings of children in Yemen. There were reports that the Islamic Conference in Riyadh was threatening to issue an Islamic decree against the United Nations, defining the United Nations as an anti-Muslim organization, calling on the members of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation not to engage with the United Nations and not to assist any United Nations project.
title: 潘基文

source_text: 2012年3月7日，潘基文在联合国人权理事会上呼吁消除对同性恋的歧视，在世界各地倡导LGBT权利。他的演说遭到部分与会代表中途退出会场的抗议。在一次联合国总部纪念国际人权日的演说中，潘基文对那些设有反同性恋法规的国家进行了谴责，并列举了76个将同性恋定罪的国家。他说在现代社会仍有这么多的国家继续将因仅喜爱另一个同一性别的人类而视为犯罪是骇人听闻的。他对联合国高级管理人员说对同性恋的歧视是不可接受的，并指出像乌克兰这样将公开讨论同性恋定罪是对基本人权的威胁。他进一步指出政府有保护弱势群体的义务。2013年4月，他称LGBT权利是当前最被忽视的人权之一，并指出宗教，文化和传统不能成为剥夺人权的理由。
target_text: On 7 March 2012, at the United Nations Human Rights Council, Ban Ki-moon called for the elimination of discrimination against homosexuality and the promotion of LGBT rights around the world. His speech was protested by some delegates who dropped out of the room. In a speech commemorating International Human Rights Day at United Nations Headquarters, Ban Ki-moon condemned those countries that had anti-homosexual legislation and listed 76 countries that had criminalized homosexuality. He said that it was appalling that so many countries in modern society continued to criminalize human beings simply because they loved another sex. He said that discrimination against homosexuality was unacceptable to senior United Nations managers and that public discussion of homosexuality, such as in Ukraine, was a threat to fundamental human rights. He further noted that the Government had an obligation to protect vulnerable groups. In April 2013, he described LGBT rights as one of the most neglected human rights at the present time, and noted that religion, culture and tradition could not justify the denial of human rights.
title: 潘基文

source_text:
第一型人格 —— 理想崇高者、完美主義者（The Reformer）：完美者、改進型、捍衛原則型、秩序大使、正確主義型。
第二型人格 —— 古道熱腸者、熱心助人者（The Helper）：成就他人者、助人型、博愛型、愛心大使、服務型。
第三型人格 —— 成就追求者、成就至上者（The Achiever）：角色主義型、實踐型、實幹型。
第四型人格 —— 個人風格者、浪漫悲憫者、藝術型（The Individualist）：浪漫者、藝術型、自我型、多感型。
第五型人格 —— 博學多聞者、格物致知型（The Investigator）：觀察者、思考型、理智型。
第六型人格 —— 謹慎忠誠者（The Loyalist）：尋求安全者、謹慎型、忠誠懷疑者。
第七型人格 —— 勇於嘗新者、享乐主義者（The Enthusiast）：創造可能者、活躍型、享樂型。
第八型人格 —— 力量的強者（The Challenger）：挑戰者、權威型、力量型、指揮型。
第九型人格 —— 嚮往和平者、和平主义者（The Peacemaker）：和諧忘我者、和諧型、平淡型。
target_text: The ideal type of personality - the ideal nobler, the perfecter: the perfecter, the perfecter, the champion of the principle, the ambassador of order, the right type. The second type of personality - the ancient enthusiast, the passionate helper (the Helper): the performer, the helper, the lover, the love ambassador, the service type. The third type of personality - the seeker of achievement, the best of achievement (the Achiever): the character of the role. The fourth type - the personality of the individual, the romantic gloomist, the artist, the artist (the Individualist): the romantic, the artist, the self-style, the multi-minded.
title: 九型人格

source_text: 2002年，在立法院委員關沃暖強烈質疑違憲的情況下，行政院将《細則》中涉及的地區修订为「指中共控制之地区」，此後行政院、外交部、內政部等均認蒙古為獨立國家。同年9月1日，陳水扁政府於乌兰巴托設立辦事處，維持與蒙古的非正式外交關係至今。2006年後，行政院新聞局不再出版包含外蒙古的《中華民國年鑒》。2008年馬英九政府上臺後，亦承認蒙古已獨立，不再認為外蒙古為中華民國領土。2012年，行政院大陸委員會發佈新聞參考資料，資料引述外交部2002年說法稱：「外蒙古不是固有領土」、「國家承認不可撤回」。
target_text: On September 1, 2002, the Chen Shui-bian government set up an office in Ulaanbaatar to maintain informal diplomatic relations with Mongolia. After 2006, the Press Department of the Executive Council no longer published the Chinese People’s Year Book, which contains foreign Mongolia. In 2008, the government of Ma Yin-kyu acknowledged Mongolia’s independence and no longer considered it to be China’s land. In 2012, the Council issued a press review, citing the Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ statement in 2002 that “Mongolia is not an inherent land” and that “the country recognizes that it cannot be withdrawn.”
title: 蒙藏委員會

source_text:
佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫（，拉丁化：Pervez Musharraf，），巴基斯坦第10任总统、军事将领。经历
佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫於1943年8月11日生于当时仍屬於英国殖民地的印度新德里，1947年移民到巴基斯坦的卡拉奇。他的父亲在新成立的巴基斯坦国里当外交官。穆沙拉夫从6岁开始就随父母到驻土耳其大使馆生活，生活了7年，故精通土耳其语。
target_text: Pervez Musharraf (Latinization: Pervez Musharraf), Pakistan’s tenth president and military general. After being born on 11 August 1943 in New Delhi, India, which was still a British colony at the time, in 1947, he emigrated to Karachi, Pakistan. His father was a diplomat in the new State of Pakistan.
title: 佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫

source_text: 2010年3月30日，世博会倒计时30天推广歌曲《2010等你来》及其MV在世博局举行首发仪式。此歌由缪森作曲、张鹏作词、韩雪原唱，推广歌曲改为由世博形象大使成龙、郎朗、姚明、杨澜、亲善大使刘德华、健康大使李宁、慈善爱心大使李冰冰演唱并出演MV。有网友指出此歌曲与日本歌手岡本真夜1997年发表的歌曲《不变的你就好》()有90%以上的相似度。事發之後，上海世博向岡本真夜以及其事務所請求授權，岡本真夜和事務所爽快答應。除此之外，她本人還表示在這種重要盛會上歌曲能被選用，是她的榮幸。4月22日，作曲人缪森发表声明否认抄袭，但遭到冈本事务所反驳，甚至导致在野党议员在国会追究亲中首相的政治问题。
target_text: On March 30, 2010, the World Expo started a 30-day rollout of the song " Waiting for you in 2010 " and its MV at the Web Bureau. The song was written by Mussen, Zhang Ping, Han Xuehara, and the song was replaced by a call for power from Shibo image ambassadors Chenglong, Lang Long, Yao Myung, Yang Liang, Goodwill Ambassador Liu Dynasty, Health Ambassador Li Ning, and charity ambassador Li Bing Bing Bing to perform the MV. On April 22, the author of the song was denied a 90% similarity to the song "You will remain the same" published by Japanese singer Okamoto in 1997.
title: 中國2010年上海世界博覽會

source_text: 蒙莫朗西出生後，由當權的王室公主─法蘭西的安妮擔任教母，安妮把自己的名字──Anne，給了這個初生男嬰。蒙莫朗西與弗朗索瓦一世一起長大，弗朗索瓦一世1515年即王位後，开始受到重用。他参加了1515年发生于義大利马里尼亚诺附近的战役和梅济耶尔防卫战，表现突出；1522年，他晉升為法国元帅。1524年保衛普羅旺斯，後又回義大利作戰。1525年，他与弗朗索瓦一世一起在帕维亚战役中被西班牙军队俘虏，獲釋後參加馬德里條约的签订。1526年任郎格罗克总督和王家管家（Grand Master of France），帶來巨額收入；他又奉命从事外交工作，后成为国王的首席大臣，主管国防、王室、公共工程和外交事务。1527年他使英格兰加入科尼亚克联盟，反对神圣罗马帝国皇帝卡尔五世，但1529年又参与议定法国与卡尔五世之间的康布雷和约。1536年再次与卡尔五世作战，先是在普罗旺斯，后在意大利北部。1538年议和，被任命为法国王室統帥，幾乎主導了法國的內外政策，也標誌着国王对他的宠信达到了顶峰（身兼最高二職─王室統帥與王室管家）。但不久弗朗索瓦一世怀疑蒙莫朗西与王太子结党，从1541年起禁止他进入宫廷。
target_text: After his birth, he was raised with François I in 1525, when he was captured by the Spanish army in the Battle of François I, and was released to Madrid in 1527. In 1526, he was Governor Rangroc and Head of the King's House (Grand Master France), who brought in huge revenues; in 1522 he was ordered to defend Provence and then returned to Italy in 1524, where he became the King's chief minister in charge of defence, royal trust, public works and foreign affairs.
title: 安内·德·蒙莫朗西

source_text: 意大利社会共和国是意大利歷史上的第二个也是最后一个法西斯政权，由前意大利王國首相（1922-1943）墨索里尼和他由國家法西斯黨改革成的共和法西斯党领导。国家宣布罗马为其首都，但实际上权力中心在薩羅(因此有了薩羅共和国这一名称)，这是加尔达湖上的一个小镇，靠近布雷西亚，墨索里尼和外交部的总部就在那里。意大利社会共和国在意大利北部和中部行使名义上的主权，但主要依靠德国军队来维持控制。
target_text: The Italian Social Republic is the second and last fascist regime in Italian history, led by the former Prime Minister of the Italian Crown (1922-1943) Mussolini and his Republican fascist party, which was reformed by the State fascist party. The country has declared Rome its capital, but in practice the centre of power is in Saroo (and hence the Republic of Saroo), a small town on Lake Galda, near Bresia, where Mussolini and the headquarters of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are. The Italian Social Republic exercises nominal sovereignty in northern and central Italy, but relies mainly on the German army to maintain control.
title: 意大利社会共和国

source_text: 1943年7月，在同盟国将意大利及德國軍隊赶出意屬北非并随后入侵西西里岛之后，大法西斯委员会在维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世国王的支持下推翻并逮捕了墨索里尼。新政府开始与同盟国秘密进行和平谈判。9月8日意大利投降时，德国做好了准备，并迅速进行干预。德国出兵控制了意大利北部，在12日並救出了墨索里尼，并把他带到德国占领区建立傀儡政权。意大利社会共和国于1943年9月23日宣布成立。尽管该政权声称对意大利全境拥有主权，但其事实上的管辖范围只扩大到意大利的一小部分地区。意大利社会共和国只得到轴心国及其卫星国（芬兰和维希法国除外）的外交承认，并与阿根廷、葡萄牙、西班牙和瑞士保持非正式关系。梵蒂冈城不承认意大利社会共和国。
target_text: In July 1943, the Great Fascist Commission overthrowed and arrested Mussolini with the support of King Vittorio Emanuele III, following the expulsion of Italian and German troops from Italy and the subsequent invasion of the island of Sicily by the Allies. The new government began secret peace negotiations with the Allies. When Italy surrendered on 8 September, Germany was prepared to intervene quickly. German troops took control of northern Italy, rescued Mussolini on 12th, and took him to German-occupied areas to establish a puppet regime. The Italian social republic was proclaimed on 23 September 1943. Although the regime claimed sovereignty over all Italian territory, its de facto jurisdiction extended to only a small part of Italy. The Italian social republic received only diplomatic recognition from the Axis and its satellite countries (except Finland and France), and maintained informal relations with Argentina, Portugal, Spain and Switzerland.
title: 意大利社会共和国

source_text: 国际稻米年是1999年，國際稻米研究所（）基于稻米发展中产生的严重问题，而与联合国粮农组织合作共同发起的。2002年，菲律宾政府联合四十三个国家在联合国全体会议上正式要求将2004年定为国际稻米年。这也是联合国首次用一年的时间来宣传一种农产品。2003年10月31日，国际稻米年由粮农组织总干事雅克.迪乌夫先生在纽约的联合国总部正式启动。
target_text: The International Year of Rice was launched in 1999 by the International Rice Research Institute (IFRI), in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), on the basis of the serious problems arising from rice development. In 2002, the Government of the Philippines, together with forty-three countries, formally requested the designation of 2004 as the International Year of Rice at a United Nations plenary meeting. This was the first time that the United Nations had spent a year promoting an agricultural product. On 31 October 2003, the International Year of Rice was officially launched by the Director-General of FAO, Mr. Jacques Diouf, at United Nations Headquarters in New York.
title: 国际稻米年

source_text: 1637年，最后的波美拉尼亚公爵博古斯瓦夫十四世（Bogusław XIV）去世，并没有儿女继位。三十年战争期间，瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世占领了波美拉尼亚。北方战争结束后，法国、瑞典和勃兰登堡开始谈判。勃兰登堡外交官、冯·布卢门塔尔（von Blumenthal）家族的约阿希姆·弗里德里希·冯·布卢门塔尔和他的儿子克里斯托夫·卡斯帕·冯·布卢门塔尔，取得继承勃兰登堡统治权的权利。根据威斯特伐利亚和约，瑞典得到西波美拉尼亚；普鲁士则得到东波美拉尼亚。不过，勃兰登堡与瑞典的争议依然没有平息，尤其关于西波美拉尼亚，一直到1720年签署斯德哥尔摩条约为止。根据该条约，勃兰登堡普鲁士得到斯德丁。

The dispute between diplomats of Brandenburg, the von Blumenthal family, Joachim Friedrich von Blumenthal, and his son, Christoph Kaspa von Blumenthal, remained unresolved until 1720, when they signed the Stockholm Treaty.

source_text: 李鴻章在同西方列强谈判、签约、通商、互派外交人员等外交活动中，看到西方列国庄严悬挂国旗，而清国却无旗可挂，深感有失“天朝威仪”。于是上奏慈禧太后，提出在外交场合中需要有代表清国的旗帜，请求颁制国旗。慈禧就命李鸿章负责设计图案。经过多方徵集筛选，李鸿章上呈了黄龙旗、八卦旗、麒麟旗、虎豹旗等多种方案，供慈禧太后选定，最后决定使用黄龙旗为大清国旗。并于光緒十四年（1888年）《北洋海军章程》颁定本为海军旗的「黄底蓝龙戏红珠图」为大清国旗。
target_text: In diplomatic activities such as negotiating, contracting, commercializing, and exchanging diplomats with Western powers, Li Xingzhang has seen the Western countries solemnly flying their flag, while the Qing State has no flag and has lost its sense of “the Qing dynasty.” So, after Xiang Jianqiang, he proposed that a flag representing the Qing dynasty should be required in the diplomatic arena to request the issuance of a flag. source_text: 在外交方面，1951年占領條例修正後，西德聯邦政府成立外交部，艾德諾出任西德第一任外交部長直到1955年。在外交部長任內與法國等同盟國和解，並得到時任法國外交部長罗贝尔·舒曼善意回應，提出舒曼計劃。共同掌管成員國煤鋼工業，並免除相關關稅，並建立歐洲煤鋼共同體，促成西歐進一步經濟合作。1955年與同盟國締結巴黎條約，回復主權。對法國方面，艾德諾極力修補雙方在二次大戰的破裂關係，並與法國總統戴高樂交好，德法的友好關係導致1963年簽訂了德法合作條約（）。而對東德的外交政策，則奉行哈爾斯坦主義，宣示西德為德國唯一代表政權，對承認東德建立外交關係的國家除蘇聯外予以斷交，並先後與南斯拉夫、葉門斷交。

普鲁士王国
1740年，腓特烈大帝夺得西里西亚，受到当地居民的欢迎——不单是新教人口和德裔人口。根据布热格条约（见宗教改革），他以布热格主权为借口发动奥地利王位继承战争。战争在1748年结束。普鲁士夺得西里西亚绝大部分地区，除了其东南方的泰申公国和奥帕瓦公国仍然属于奥地利。七年战争中，普鲁士再度击败奥地利，巩固对西里西亚的统治。西里西亚此后成为对普鲁士最忠诚的省份之一。1815年，原本属于萨克森，格尔利茨附近的地区在拿破仑战争后并入西里西亚。这时，德语已经成为下西里西亚最主要语言；郊区的绝大多数居民，则常用受德语影响的波兰语和捷克语。在多数西里西亚的城市，德语是最常用的语言。
target_text: The war ended in 1748. Prussia seized most of the territory of Sicily, apart from its south-eastern capital, the Teshen and Opava. In 1815, the area that belonged to Saxony, near Gretz, was integrated into Silesia after the Napoleon War. German was the dominant language in Lower Silesia; the majority of the inhabitants of the suburbs, Polish and Czech, are often influenced by German.

source_text: 中國社會經濟研究所：成立之初主要定位為國家智庫，隸屬「匪情研究組」，後改制為「第四研究所」，研究之領域包括中國大陸的社會、經濟、文化、教育、法律、區域研究等。其中國農村研究團隊為全台灣第一批進入中國深山農村，進行蹲點研究，而且持續至今未中斷，累積了豐厚的田野資料。氣候變遷、水治理、西部大開發乃至兩岸鄉村治理與發展、經濟往來、中國大陸高等教育、農業及工業、非政府組織、國營企業等，皆是第四研究所的研究領域。當代日本研究中心（Center for Modern Japan Studies, CMJS）：政治大學當代日本研究中心成立於2009年9月24日，本研究中心是由日本交流協會以及日本國際交流基金資助設立，主要目的希望強化國內的日本研究。並成為兩國之間的學術交流平台。臺灣非洲研究論壇（Forum of African Studies in Taiwan, FAST）：未來非洲國家在國際社會的影響力，將成為我國在外交困境下的援助力，因此非洲研究論壇的成立，可以讓非洲國家駐中華民國人員，能有更多的機會參與不同活動與國人交流。如此一來，不僅讓非洲國家更了解我國，也使得國民能更認識來自非洲的朋友的背景文化和事務，促進雙方文化的交流，並且了解兩岸問題在國際外交上和其他的方面所造成的困難。亞太安全合作理事會中華民國委員會秘書處（Secretariat of Taiwan of the Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia Pacific, CSCAP Taiwan Secretariat/CSCAPTaiwan）：是一個區域性的安全智庫網絡。

source_text: 理論现实主义国际关系理论有四个核心假设：国际体系的无政府性（anarchy）。由于无政府性是既定的、高度稳定的，所以国际关系的性质——战争与冲突也是不会改变的。在无政府状态下，主权国家是国际体系最重要的行为体。现实主义者将国家视为分析国际关系的基本单元，国际社会的基本特征是以主权国家为中心、以主权国家间的交往为主要内容的。国际关系的主体——主权国家是单一的、理性的行为体。在现实主义者看来，尽管国家内部具有多元的政治力量，但在国际舞台上，国家是一个统一实体，是超个人、超阶级、超社会集团的。按照这种假设，当国家处于相同的环境和面对同样的问题时，任何国家都会做出基本相似的理性决策，那么国家的行为就是可以预期的。国际社会的无政府性决定了国际体系中主要行为体——国家只能自保。合作是有限的、脆弱的、不可靠的。国家的根本利益是追求权力和安全。在现实主义者眼里，国际关系的历史和现实无非是人类集团与集团之间为获取安全、威望和权力而进行的一场持久的斗争。現實主義有幾項重要論點：古典現實主義最主要的假設是人類天性自我中心而且有競爭性。國際體系是無政府狀態：在國家之上沒有足以約束國家互動的威權，即法律上國家平等，誰也沒權利號令誰。
target_text: In a state of anarchy, sovereign states are the most important actors in the international system. Realists view the state as the basic unit of analysis of international relations, with the international community's fundamental characteristics as being centred on sovereign states, with the interaction among sovereign states as its main element. The central actor in international relations — sovereign states — is a single, rational actor. In the eyes of realists, while there is a pluralistic political power within the state, the fundamental interest of the state in the international arena is power and security. In the eyes of realists, the history and reality of international relations are no more than those of super-persons, super-classes, super-social groups.
title: 現實主義 (國際關係)

source_text:
主张人性恶，自私和贪婪是人的本性不可能改变，政治家的任务不是去教育改造而是建立机制限制它；
生存是國家應考慮的首要任務，國際社會如同原始叢林，無政府狀態，弱肉強食。
抽象的道德原则不适用于政府行为，国家利益的行为准则不同于个人的行为准则；
国际组织和国际法在政治权力和利益面前微不足道，后者是国家间关系的核心问题，权力和实力是国际话语权的唯一保障；
国际政治学的主要任务是说明世界的现状，不是未来的行为准则，应面对现实，谋求本国的权力和利益。
target_text: An abstract moral principle does not apply to the actions of governments, and the norms of national interest differ from those of individuals; International organizations and international law are insignificant in the face of political power and interests, which are at the core of inter-State relations, and power and power are the only guarantees of international discourse; The main task of international political science is to explain the state of the world, not the norms of the future, but the pursuit of national rights and interests in the face of reality.
