source_text:
问题与争议
自从20世纪90年代开始，为了追求更多的自决权或者完全独立，民族自决原则导致许多国家内出现内部冲突，而其他群体、政府兩者之间的矛盾，则引发了诸多暴力。。对于这些运动，出于政治或者其他因素，国际社会的反应也十分不一致，往往出现政治因素大于原则的情况。在2000年联合国公布的《联合国千年宣言》中，也只是规定“给予仍处于殖民统治和外国占领下的人民以自决权”。
target_text: Since the 1990s, in pursuit of greater self-determination or full independence, the principle of self-determination of peoples has led to internal conflicts in many countries, while conflicts between other groups, Governments and others have given rise to many acts of violence. The response of the international community to these movements, for political or other reasons, has also been highly inconsistent, with political factors often exceeding principles. In the United Nations Millennium Declaration, published in 2000, it was simply stated that “the right to self-determination is granted to peoples still under colonial domination and foreign occupation”.
title: 自決 (人權)

source_text:
谁拥有自决权
在《联合国宪章》、《公民及政治权利国际公约》、《经济、社会、文化权利国际公约》等国际公约和框架中，均指明拥有自决权的是“人民”（people），而在其相对应的中文翻译中，也绝大多数翻译为人民。而在现行国际法中，对于“人民”并没有公认的定义。有学者研究了国际法和联合国的相关决议，发现在不同的情况下，人民可以包含有以下四个完全不同的含义：
独立国家或地区（state）的所有人；
非自治领土的所有人；
被外国军事占领下共同生活的所有人；
在相关政体中没有代表权或被压迫的所有人。
在上面的这些含义中，“所有人”并没有限定于他们之间是否有共同的习俗、文化、历史等，也没有表明少数民族或其他特殊群体拥有自决权。而自由主义者认为，自决权取决于民族（nation，按地区、文化等划分的群体)与国家（state）之间，支持少数民族的自决。
target_text: In international covenants and frameworks such as the Charter of the United Nations, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, all indicate that the right to self-determination is enjoyed by “peoples” (peoples), and the majority of their corresponding translations in Chinese are translated into people. In these senses, “all persons” is not limited to the existence of common customs, culture, history, etc. between them, nor does it indicate that minorities or other special groups have the right to self-determination. In the opinion of liberals, the right to self-determination depends on the right to self-determination between peoples (national, regionally, culturally, etc.) and the State (state).
title: 自決 (人權)

source_text:
自决与领土完整
作为“人民”的意志，自决好像是对国家领土完整原则和主权合法性的一个挑战，因为这意味着人民可以按照他们的意志自由地选择他们的政体或领土疆域。然而，现有的民族远远多于现有的国家数量，并且在绝大多数国家的法律中，并没有相关的法律规定国家的疆域由人民的意志决定。1975年签署的《赫尔辛基最后文件》，联合国、国际法院、国际法专家等诸多共识，均认为，自决原则与领土完整原则之间并没有矛盾，领土完整原则优先于自决原则。
target_text: Self-determination and territorial integrity, as the will of the “peoples”, seemed to be a challenge to the principle of territorial integrity of States and to the legitimacy of sovereignty, which meant that people could freely choose their own form of government or territorial boundaries according to their will. However, there were far more ethnic groups than existing ones and, in the laws of the vast majority of countries, there was no relevant law that stipulated that the boundaries of the State were to be determined by the will of the people. The Helsinki Final Act, signed in 1975, the United Nations, the International Court of Justice, experts in international law, among others, had agreed that there was no contradiction between the principle of self-determination and the principle of territorial integrity and that the principle of territorial integrity took precedence over the principle of self-determination.
title: 自決 (人權)

source_text:
有学者认为，下面的三个理论可以用于与自决相关的国际关系：
领土主权重于自决。在冷战期间，此理论被各国推行；
自由国际主义已经成为自决的替代品，它降低了国家与国家之间的战争的可能性，提高了个体的自由，同时也有促进了全球市场的扩张以及国家与国家之间的合作，降低了国家领土完整的重要性，并且在一定程度上允许人民拥有更大的自决权；
世界自由主义认为应当建立一个世界性的政府组织，这样就避免了领土的分裂问题和边界的变更问题。当然，这也意味着自决届时将不再存在。
target_text: The following three theories, according to scholars, could be used in international relations related to self-determination: the sovereignty of the territory was more important than self-determination. During the cold war, the doctrine was promoted by States; Liberal internationalism has become a substitute for self-determination, reducing the possibility of wars between States and States, increasing individual freedom, and promoting the expansion of global markets and cooperation between States, diminishing the importance of the territorial integrity of States and, to some extent, allowing for greater self-determination of peoples; World liberalism believes that a world-wide organization of government should be established, thus avoiding the division of territories and the alteration of borders.
title: 自決 (人權)

source_text: 立陶宛维陶塔斯·马格纳斯大学（Vytautas Magnus University）法学院学者Vita Gudeleviciute认为，在非自治领土或被他国军事占领的国家，民族自决原则优先于国家领土完整原则；依据现行国际法，在由当地少数族群建立的国家政权中，这些少数族群其實可以被視为独立的人民，而他们可以有权利进行自决。另一方面，她发现，现行的国际法很少會涵盖单一制国家的分离问题，这也意味着在单一制国家，不願哪个群体可以选择分裂出去。
target_text: Vytautas Magnus University, Faculty of Law, Vytautas Magnus University, Lithuania, observed that the principle of self-determination of peoples took precedence over the principle of territorial integrity of States in a Non-Self-Governing Territory or in a country under military occupation by another State; under existing international law, those minorities could be regarded as independent peoples in State regimes established by local minorities, who had the right to self-determination.
title: 自決 (人權)

source_text: 为了消除殖民主义带来的影响，一部分国家宣称对某些地区拥有主权，这在现行国际法中，是合理的。在《给予殖民地国家和人民独立宣言》中，第六条规定：“任何旨在部分地或全面地分裂一个国家的团结和破坏其领土完整的企图都是与联合国宪章的目的和原则相违背的。”这一宣言适用于因殖民問題造成的国家分裂，在这种情况下，领土内的人民有权进行自决来维护国家的领土完整。但一些國家拒絕接受這一解釋，他們認為儘管該宣言第二條規定了“所有的人民都有自决权”，但第六條規定這不得用於對領土的要求。設立第六條規定的初衷，是為了確保將自決權限定於殖民地范圍內，而不是國家的次地區（如州、省等） 。西班牙和阿根廷曾經在聯合國大會上發起提議，試圖在有领土争议的情況下限制自決權，但卻被聯合國大會以自決權是一項普遍的權利駁回。
target_text: In the Declaration on the Granting of Independence to Colonial Countries and Peoples, article VI states that “any attempt aimed at the partial or total division of a country’s unity and the disruption of its territorial integrity is contrary to the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations.” This declaration applies to the division of a country as a result of colonial problems, in which case the people within its territory have the right to self-determination in order to preserve the territorial integrity of the country. But some countries refuse to accept this explanation, considering that article II of the Declaration stipulates that “all peoples have the right to self-determination” but that article VI stipulates that it cannot be applied to claims against the land.
title: 自決 (人權)

source_text: 大正民主（）是指日本自1912年桂内阁总辞至1932年犬养毅遭暗杀的20年間，所推行之符合現代民主的政治體制及政策，由於大部分時間落在大正時代內而得名。在第一次大正政變後這期間，日本內閣多為政黨政治的互動，內政上以民意所趨為主，外交則採取對中國內政不干涉、日蘇友好等策略（幣原外交）。
target_text: During the period following the first coup d’état, Japan’s Cabinet was most interactive in party politics, its internal politics was dominated by popular opinion, and diplomacy resorted to tactics such as non-interference in China’s internal affairs, Japanese-Soviet friendship, and so forth.
title: 大正民主

source_text:
歷史
雍正五年（1727年），清廷與俄國簽定《布連斯奇條約》（《恰克圖條約》），有滿、蒙、俄、拉丁四種文本，規定清俄兩國以薩彥嶺為界，立鄂博為界牌，歸烏里雅蘇台將軍管轄。在外蒙古獨立、蘇聯兼併唐努烏梁海、以及中华人民共和国成立前，薩彥嶺曾經是中華民國版圖名義上的最北點。而自1949年后退守臺灣的中華民國政府曾經未承認蘇聯在唐努烏梁海的主權。但目前「為尊重國際社會的共識」，因此認同其為俄國境內下屬之83個「聯邦主體（federal subject），類似州或省」之一。而中华民国外交部網站上的俄羅斯聯邦地圖也包含圖瓦共和國。中华人民共和国成立初期，毛澤東實行對蘇聯一面倒的外交政策，故默認蘇聯史達林對薩彥嶺的領土主張。而唐努烏梁海現已成為蒙古國西北部的一部分與俄羅斯聯邦主體圖瓦共和國的一部分。
target_text: Before the independence of Mongolia, the Soviet Union and the People’s Republic of China, Sarpen was one of the northernmost points of the Chinese version of the Constitution (Chaqtu Treaty), and the Chinese government, which had withdrawn from Taiwan since 1949, had failed to recognize the Soviet Union’s central authority in the Sea of Tanguulu. However, it is now known as the 83 “federal subjects” of the Russian Federation’s foreign policy, part of which is part of the Russian Federation and of the Russian Federation’s northern Soviet Union.
title: 薩彥嶺

source_text: 1900年6月，颜惠庆毕业，8月回国，此后任圣约翰大学英文教授。1905年（光緒31年）任上海《南方報》英文版編輯、商务印书馆编辑，在此期间编撰了《英华大辞典》。1906年（光緒32年）9月，参加清朝政府举行的留学生考试，获得全国第二名，赐譯科进士出身，授翰林院檢討。1907年（光緒33年）冬，颜惠庆任中国駐美國公使館二等参贊，隨公使伍廷芳赴任。驻美期间，颜惠庆在乔治·华盛顿大学系统进修了外交理论和国际法知识，並加入美國国際法学会。
target_text: In 1900, Yan Huiqing graduated in June and returned to his country in August as an English-language professor at St. John’s University. In 1905 (Gwang-yun 31), he was editor of the English edition of the Shanghai Journal of the South and editor of the Business Print Book, during which time he compiled the English Dictionary of the Great Enghua. In September 1906 (Hwang-yun 32), he took the Chinese government’s student examination, won the second national entrance examination, gave him a degree in interpretation, and examined him at the School of the Führer. In 1907 (Hwang-yun 33), Yan-hye became a second-class delegate to the Chinese Embassy in the United States of America, accompanied by Minister Utting Fung. During his stay in the United States, Yan Qing studied diplomatic theory and international law in the George Washington University system, and joined the American Academy of International Law.
title: 颜惠庆

source_text:
民国初期
民国元年（1912年），颜惠庆出任唐绍仪内阁的外交部次长，1913年春，颜惠庆任驻德国、瑞典、丹麦三国公使。1919年，以顾问身份参加中国代表团，出席巴黎和会。1920年回国。1920年（民国9年）8月，颜惠庆奉大總統徐世昌之命出任外交总长直到1922年（民国11年）8月，任内基本採取親英美路綫，重視對日本的交涉，尤其是有關山東問題的交涉。1921年（民国10年）5月，恢復和德國的邦交。11月華盛頓会議，颜惠庆派出施肇基、顾维钧、王宠惠三人为全权代表。1921年12月18日代理国务总理，1922年6月12日正式任国务总理。
target_text: At the beginning of the First Anniversary of the People's Republic of China (1912), he served as Under-Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Downshoi Cabinet, in spring 1913, as Minister of Foreign Affairs of Germany, Sweden and Denmark. In 1919, he participated as an adviser in the Chinese delegation to the Paris Peace Conference. He returned home in 1920. In August 1920 (September) he was appointed Chief Foreign Affairs Officer by the Prime Minister, Xu Shichang, until August 1922 (November) of the People's Republic of China. He took up his duties as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
title: 颜惠庆

source_text:
国民政府时期
1931年九一八事变后，颜惠庆以外交元老身份应南京国民政府外交部長王正廷征召，任對日特種委員会委員。11月，任駐美國公使，到華盛頓赴任。1932年1月，被任命为中国驻國際聯盟代表团首席代表。1932年，颜惠庆代表中国在国联大会上提交了日本侵略中国案，促请国联大会和行政院制裁日本。同年，作为中国政府首席代表出席日内瓦国际军缩会议期间，同苏联展开秘密外交，于当年12月12日成功地与苏联外交人民委员李维诺夫签订复交协议。1932年，颜惠庆任南开大学校董会董事。1933年（民国22年）2月日本松岡洋右在國聯發表退出国聯宣言，顔恵慶針鋒相對地發表了反對演説。1933年1月31日，颜惠庆被任命为中国驻苏联大使，1936年因健康原因辞职回国。
target_text: In January 1932, he was appointed Chief Representative of the Chinese delegation to the International League of Nations. In 1932, he presented the case of Japan’s invasion of China on behalf of China at the National Assembly, urging the General Assembly and the Executive Council to sanction Japan. In the same year, in his capacity as chief representative of the Chinese Government during the Geneva International Military Retrenchment Conference, he opened secret diplomacy with the Soviet Union and successfully concluded a return deal with the Soviet Union’s Foreign Affairs Commissioner, Levinov, on 12 December that year. In 1932, he was appointed Director of the South Open College Board of Governors. In February 1933, the Chinese General Assembly issued a declaration of withdrawal from the United States, urging the General Assembly and the Executive Council of the League of Nations to impose sanctions on Japan. On 31 January 1933, Yan Qing was appointed Ambassador of China to the Soviet Union for health reasons.
title: 颜惠庆

source_text: 《德意日三國同盟條約》，又作《三國公約》、《三國盟約》、《三方公约》、《柏林公约》（；；；），是德国、意大利和日本于1940年9月27日在柏林分别由德意日三國代表里宾特洛甫、齊亞諾和來棲三郎签署的协议。它是一个防御性军事联盟，後來匈牙利（1940年11月20日）、罗马尼亚（1940年11月23日）、保加利亚（1941年3月1日）和南斯拉夫（1941年3月25日）以及德国傀儡国斯洛伐克（1940年11月24日）加入。南斯拉夫加入两天后在首都贝尔格莱德。德国、意大利和匈牙利以入侵南斯拉夫作为回应。由此产生的意大利-德国共同創立的傀儡国，即克罗地亚独立国，于1941年6月15日加入了该条约。
target_text: It is a defensive military union, signed by Germany, Italy and Japan in Berlin on 27 September 1940, by the representatives of Germany, Germany, Germany, Italy, and Japan, Ribbentrop, Ziaño, and come to Sanchiro, respectively. It was followed by a defensive military alliance in Hungary (20 November 1940), Romania (23 November 1940), Bulgaria (1 March 1941) and Yugoslavia (25 March 1944), as well as by the German puppet State, Slovakia (24 November 1940). Yugoslavia joined in Belgrade two days later. Germany, Italy and Hungary responded by invading Yugoslavia. The resulting Italian-German puppet State, the Independent State of Croatia, acceded to the treaty on 15 June 1941.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 然而，官方和大多数媒体报道了一个略有不同的版本，其中使用了“对该协议怀有善意”而不是“加入”。可能指其他国家没有加入该条约，里宾特洛甫说错了。因此，全国委员会的官方记录更正了他的话，删除了其他国家对“加入”的任何提及，在这个过程中产生了尴尬的措辞。
target_text: However, the official and most of the media reported a slightly different version, using “good faith in the agreement” instead of “accession”. It might mean that other countries were not parties to the treaty, and Ribbentrop was mistaken. Thus, the official records of the National Committee corrected his words and deleted any reference to “accession” from other countries, creating awkward language in the process.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
匈牙利
匈牙利王国是第四个签署该协议的国家，也是1940年9月27日后第一个加入该协议的国家。匈牙利驻柏林大使什托哈伊在收到签署协议和里宾特洛甫演讲的消息后，立即致电匈牙利外交部长伊斯特万·查基。他敦促萨基加入该协议，甚至声称德国和意大利都希望匈牙利加入。他认为匈牙利在罗马尼亚之前签署该协议尤为重要。作为回应，他要求什托哈伊就匈牙利加入该协定及其在该协定下的潜在义务进行询问。9月28日，德国外交国务秘书通知匈牙利，里宾特洛甫的意思不是“正式加入”，而只是“本着《公约》精神的态度”。意大利人的回答是相似的。尽管如此，在一周内，匈牙利政府就发出了“精神上遵守”该协议的正式通知。
target_text: The Hungarian Kingdom was the fourth country to sign the agreement and was the first to accede to it after 27 September 1940. The Hungarian Ambassador to Berlin, Stohay, immediately after receiving information about the signing of the agreement and the speech by Ribbentrop, immediately called the Hungarian Minister for Foreign Affairs, Esteban Chaki. He urged Saki to join the agreement, even claiming that Germany and Italy wanted Hungary to do so. He considered it particularly important that Hungary signed the agreement before Romania. In response, he asked Stohay for an inquiry into Hungary's accession to the agreement and its potential obligations under the agreement. On 28 September, the German State Secretary for Foreign Affairs informed Hungary that Ribbentlov meant that it was not “official accession”, but simply “in the spirit of the Convention”. The Italian answer was similar.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 在匈牙利“精神上的坚守”之后的一周，巴尔干局势发生了变化。德国批准了罗马尼亚的请求，派遣军队守卫罗马尼亚油田，匈牙利批准了德国的请求，允许其军队过境匈牙利前往罗马尼亚。1940年10月7日，第一批德国军队抵达普洛伊。罗马尼亚加入该协议的时间很可能被推迟到德国军队到位，因为担心苏联采取先发制人的行动来保护自己的油田。反过来，匈牙利的加入被推迟到罗马尼亚的加入谈判结束。10月9日左右，魏茨泽克从里宾特洛甫向什托哈伊发送了一条信息，通知他德国元首希特勒现在希望“友好国家”加入该条约。里宾特洛甫在10月9日或10日与齐亚诺的电话交谈中声称，匈牙利已发出第二次加入该协定的请求。意大利首相墨索里尼勉强同意。10月12日，里宾特洛甫通知什托哈伊，意大利和日本都同意匈牙利加入。由于匈牙利摄政王霍尔蒂特别指示什托哈伊要求匈牙利成为第一个加入该条约的新国家，里宾特洛甫批准了这一请求。
target_text: In the week following Hungary’s “spiritual commitment” the situation in the Balkans changed. Germany granted Romania’s request to send troops to guard the Romanian oil fields, and Hungary granted Germany’s request to allow its army to transit through Hungary to Romania. On 7 October 1940, the first German army arrived in Pleu. Romania’s accession to the agreement was likely to be postponed until the German army, fearing that the Soviet Union would take pre-emptive action to protect its oil fields.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
斯洛伐克
1939年3月14日，斯洛伐克共和国在捷克斯洛伐克解体的过程中宣布成立。希特勒邀请約瑟夫·蒂索主教担任斯洛伐克總統。斯洛伐克成立后不久就卷入了。斯洛伐克与德国签署了《保护条约》，但德国拒绝干预。战争导致匈牙利以斯洛伐克为代价获得领土。尽管如此，斯洛伐克还是在1939年支持德国入侵波兰。
target_text: Slovakia, on 14 March 1939, the Slovak Republic was proclaimed in the process of the dissolution of Czechoslovakia. Hitler invited Bishop Joseph Tiso to become President of Slovakia. Slovakia was involved shortly after its establishment. Slovakia signed the Treaty of Protection with Germany, but Germany refused to intervene. The war led Hungary to acquire territory at the expense of Slovakia.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 《三國公约》签署后不久，斯洛伐克在匈牙利的领导下，向德国和意大利发出了“精神上坚持”的信息。1940年11月24日，罗马尼亚签署《三國公约》的第二天，斯洛伐克总理兼外交部长前往柏林会见里宾特洛甫，并签署了斯洛伐克加入《三國公约》的协议。他的目的是提高图卡在斯洛伐克相对于他的竞争对手蒂索的地位，尽管德国人无意允许蒂索被免职。
target_text: Shortly after the signing of the Three Nations Convention, Slovakia, under the leadership of Hungary, sent a message of “spiritual insistence” to Germany and Italy. On 24 November 1940, the day after Romania signed the Three Nations Convention, the Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs of Slovakia travelled to Berlin to meet with Ribbentrop and signed an agreement on Slovakia's accession to the Three Nations Convention.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
保加利亚
保加利亚王国一直是德国的盟友，在第一次世界大战中处于戰败的一方。从一开始，德国就向保加利亚施压，要求其加入《三國公约》。1940年11月17日，沙皇鲍里斯三世和外交部长伊万·波波夫在德国会见了希特勒。根据德国驻巴尔干半岛特使赫尔曼·诺伊巴赫的说法，保加利亚与轴心国的关系在那次会议上完全解决了。然而，11月23日，保加利亚驻柏林大使彼得·德拉加诺夫通知德国人，虽然保加利亚原则上同意加入该协定，但希望暂时推迟签署。
target_text: Bulgaria, the Kingdom of Bulgaria, has always been an ally of Germany and was on the side of the war in the First World War. From the outset, Germany pressured Bulgaria to accede to the Three-Nation Convention. On 17 November 1940, Tsar Boris III and Foreign Minister Ivan Popov met Hitler in Germany. According to German Special Envoy to the Balkans, Herman Noybach, Bulgaria’s relations with the Axis countries were fully resolved at the Conference. However, on 23 November, the Bulgarian Ambassador to Berlin, Peter Draganov, informed the Germans that, while Bulgaria had agreed in principle to accede to the Agreement, it wished to postpone its signature for the time being.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 与希特勒的会晤促使苏联外交官阿尔卡迪·索博列夫于11月25日访问保加利亚。他鼓励保加利亚人签署一项互助协议，该协议于1939年10月首次讨论。他表示苏联承认保加利亚在希腊和土耳其的主权。然而，保加利亚政府对保加利亚共产党对会谈的颠覆行动感到不安，显然是在苏联的敦促下。
target_text: The meeting with Hitler prompted the Soviet diplomat Alkadi Sobolev to visit Bulgaria on 25 November. He encouraged the Bulgarians to sign a mutual assistance agreement, which was discussed for the first time in October 1939. He expressed the Soviet Union’s recognition of Bulgaria’s sovereignty over Greece and Turkey.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 保加利亚最终因德国希望干预希意战争而被迫采取行动，这将需要军队通过保加利亚。由于不可能在军事上抵抗德国，1941年3月1日，保加利亚总理博格丹·菲洛夫在维也纳签署了保加利亚加入该条约的协议。他宣布，这在一定程度上是为了感谢德国协助保加利亚与罗马尼亚签订《克雷奥瓦条约》，这不会影响保加利亚与土耳其或苏联的关系。当天晚些时候，里宾特洛甫向菲洛夫承诺，希腊沦陷后，保加利亚将在斯特鲁马河和马里察河之间获得爱琴海海岸线。
target_text: Bulgaria was finally forced to act because of Germany’s desire to intervene in the Greek war, which would require the military to pass through Bulgaria. As it was impossible to resist Germany militarily, Bulgaria’s Prime Minister Bogdan Filov signed an agreement on Bulgaria’s accession to the Treaty in Vienna on 1 March 1941. He announced that it was partly to thank Germany for helping Bulgaria to sign the Treaty of Creova with Romania, which would not affect Bulgaria’s relations with Turkey or with the Soviet Union.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 根据《塔尔诺沃宪法》第17条，条约必须由国民议会批准。就《三国公约》而言，政府试图在没有辩论或讨论的情况下批准该条约。17名反对派代表提交了质询，其中一名代表伊万·彼得罗夫询问为什么没有事先咨询国民议会，以及该协议是否使保加利亚卷入战争。他们被忽视了。该协定以140票对20票获得批准。
target_text: According to article 17 of the Tarnovo Constitution, a treaty must be ratified by the National Assembly. In the case of the Tripartite Convention, the Government tried to ratify it without debate or discussion. Seventeen opposition representatives submitted an inquiry, one of whom asked Ivan Petrov why the National Assembly had not been consulted in advance and whether the agreement had involved Bulgaria in the war. They were ignored. The agreement was approved by 140 votes to 20.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
苏联
就在《三国公约》形成之前，苏联获悉其存在及其加入的可能性。莫洛托夫因此被派往柏林，讨论该条约和苏联加入的可能性。苏联认为加入《三国公约》是对与德国现有协议的更新。在访问柏林期间，莫洛托夫原则上同意，如果能够解决一些细节，例如苏联吞并芬兰，苏联将加入该协议。苏联政府于11月25日向德国发送了该协定的修订版。为了展示伙伴关系的好处，苏联向德国提供了大量经济援助。
target_text: During its visit to Berlin, the Soviet Union, in principle, agreed that the Soviet Union would accede to the agreement if certain details could be resolved, such as the annexation of Finland by the Soviet Union. The Soviet Government sent a revised version of the agreement to Germany on 25 November. In order to demonstrate the benefits of the partnership, the Soviet Union provided substantial economic assistance to Germany.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
芬兰
芬兰和德国之间的军事合作始于1940年末，当时芬兰在冬季战争中因苏联侵略而失去了大量领土。芬兰于1941年6月25日加入巴巴罗萨行动，开始了持续战争。11月，芬兰与许多其他与德国结盟的国家签署了《反共产国际協定》，这是一项针对苏联的反共产主义协议。很快，德国建议芬兰签署《三國公约》，但芬兰政府拒绝了，因为芬兰将其战争视为与第二次世界大战“独立的战争”，并认为其目标与德国不同。芬兰还希望与盟国，特别是美国保持外交关系。第二次世界大战期间，德国多次要求芬兰签署该协议，但芬兰政府拒绝了所有提议。芬兰和美国的外交关系一直维持到1944年6月，尽管美国大使已经被召回。然而，英国于1941年12月6日向芬兰宣战，以支持其盟友苏联。
target_text: In November, Finland signed the Anti-Communist International Agreement with many other countries allied to Germany, an anti-communist agreement against the Soviet Union. Soon after, Germany proposed that Finland sign the Three Nations Convention, but the Finnish Government rejected it because Finland viewed its war as a “war of independence” with the Second World War and considered its objectives to be different from those of Germany. Finland also wished to maintain diplomatic relations with its allies, particularly the United States. During the Second World War, Germany repeatedly asked Finland to sign the agreement, but the Finnish Government rejected all offers.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
泰国
日本于1941年12月8日02:00袭击泰国。日本大使坪上贞二告诉泰国外交部长，日本只想允许其军队通过泰国，袭击英屬马来亚和英屬缅甸。07:00，泰國總理鑾披汶·頌堪在曼谷召开紧急内阁会议，很快，停火命令下达。披汶随后会见了坪上贞二，后者向他提供了四个选择：与日本缔结日泰攻守同盟條約，加入《三國公约》，在日本军事行动中合作，或同意共同防御泰国。泰国选择了和日本的军事合作，但加入《三國公约》遭到拒绝。
target_text: Thailand, Japan attacked Thailand on 8 December 1941 at 0200. Japanese Ambassador Pao Jinji told the Thai Foreign Minister that Japan only wanted to allow its troops to attack British Malaya and British Myanmar through Thailand. 0700, Thai Prime Minister Pibeon Songqan convened an emergency cabinet meeting in Bangkok, shortly after which a ceasefire order was issued. Pei-bong then met Jeong-ji, who offered him four options: to conclude an agreement with Japan to defend Japan’s alliance, to accede to the Three Nations Convention, to cooperate in Japanese military operations, or to agree to a joint defence against Thailand. Thailand opted for military cooperation with Japan, but accession to the Three Nations Convention was rejected.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
三方关系，1940–1943
1940年12月20日的一项协议设立了该协议所要求的“联合技术委员会”。他们将在每个首都成立一个总务委员会，由东道国外交部长和其他两个合作伙伴的大使组成。总务委员会下设军事委员会和经济委员会。1941年12月15日，三个委员会在首都柏林举行了第一次会议，称为“三方公约会议”。会议决定成立一个“三方公约国常设理事会”，但在两个月内什么也没发生。只有日本人不信任的意大利人推动了更大的合作。
target_text: Triangular relations, an agreement of 20 December 1940 establishing the “Joint Technical Committee” called for in that agreement. They will establish a General Committee in each capital, composed of the Foreign Minister of the host country and the ambassadors of the two other partners. The General Committee includes the Military Committee and the Economic Committee. On 15 December 1941, the three Committees held their first meeting in Berlin, the capital, called the “Trilateral Convention Conference”. The Conference decided to establish a “Trilateral Permanent Council of Convention States”, but nothing happened within two months. Only the Italians, who did not trust the Japanese, promoted greater cooperation.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
“没有单独的和平”协议
1941年12月2日，日本首次向德国施压，要求德国對美国宣戰，而就在两天前，日本通知柏林其开战意向。日本没有得到任何回应，便接近意大利。12月5日凌晨4时，里宾特洛甫向日本大使提出了加入战争并共同宣戰的建议，该建议已得到意大利的批准。1941年12月7日，日本偷襲珍珠港引發太平洋戰爭。12月11日，就在德国和意大利对美国宣战的同一天，三国签署了一项协议，该协议已于12月8日敲定，禁止与美国或英国单独和平。它“旨在作为宣战的宣传伴奏”。
target_text: On December 5, 1941, Japan first pressured Germany to declare war on the United States, and just two days ago, Japan notified Berlin of its intention to go to war. Japan, without any response, approached Italy. On December 5, at 4 a.m., Ribintrov proposed to the Ambassador of Japan to join the war and to jointly declare war, which Italy approved. On December 7, 1941, Japan stormed Pearl Harbor to provoke the Pacific war. On December 11, on the same day that Germany and Italy declared war on the United States, the three countries signed an agreement, which was finalized on December 8, prohibiting separate peace with the United States or the United Kingdom.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text:
遗产
由于该公约下的防御联盟从未被援引，而且主要签署国在欧洲和亚洲之间利益存在广泛分歧，限制了欧洲和亚洲签署国之间的合作，因此该公约的影响是有限的。历史学家保罗·W·施罗德曾将其描述为“1940年末的重要地位迅速下降到1941年末的名义地位”，到1941年12月“几乎不起作用”。然而，事实证明，该条约有助于说服美国人相信日本正在与德国结盟。关于《公约》是协调侵略和实现世界统治努力的一部分的指控也构成了在纽伦堡对纳粹领导人提起的诉讼的一部分。同样，东京审判也侧重于在德国、日本和意大利之间建立委员会，作为调查《公约》签署后不久就开始运作的证据，并在《公约》之下的侵略中表现出相互支持，但委员会从未实际运作过。
target_text: The impact of the Convention has been limited by the fact that the defence alliance under the Convention has never been invoked and the major signatories have extensive differences of interest between Europe and Asia, limiting cooperation between European and Asian signatories. Historial Paul W. Schröder described it as “a rapid decline in importance at the end of 1940 to the notional status at the end of 1941” and as “almost ineffectual” in December 1941. However, the Treaty has proved useful in convincing Americans that Japan is allied with Germany. The allegations that the Convention is part of an effort to coordinate aggression and achieve world domination have also formed part of the proceedings against Nazi leaders in Nuremberg. Similarly, the Tokyo trial also focused on the establishment of a commission between Germany, Japan and Italy, which became operational shortly after the signing of the Convention and demonstrated mutual support in the aggression under the Convention, but the Commission never actually functioned.
title: 三国同盟条约

source_text: 中華民國駐美國大使列表，列舉中華民國政府駐美国代表機構的歷任館長。1912年1月1日，中華民國成立，不再承認大清國公使的身份，另行任命駐美國外交代表。2月12日，清朝皇帝溥仪退位，袁世凱就任臨時大總統後，美國于4月承认中華民國，以其代表为驻美公使。1935年，兩國外交關係升格為大使级。
target_text: On 1 January 1912, the Chinese government was established and no longer recognized as Minister of the People’s Republic of China and appointed another diplomatic representative to the United States. On February 12, following the resignation of the Emperor of Qing, the United States recognized the People’s Republic of China in April, with its representative as Minister of State in the United States. In 1935, diplomatic relations between the two countries rose to the rank of ambassador.
title: 中華民國駐美國大使列表

source_text: 美國在1979年1月1日與中華民國斷交，改與中華人民共和國建交，中華民國改派駐美國臺北經濟文化代表處代表（简称驻美代表）。至2012年9月1日，《駐外機構組織通則》修法後，中华民国駐外人員之行政職稱統一以正式官銜訂定，駐外機構的大使館與代表處之大使級館長外交職務皆稱大使，但代表處館長对外仍称代表。
target_text: On 1 January 1979, the United States broke ties with the Chinese People’s Republic of China, re-established its relations with the Chinese People’s Republic, and the Chinese People’s Republic reassigned its representative to the United States Economic and Cultural Office in Taipei (known as the Representative to the United States). As of 1 September 2012, after the amendment of the General Act on the Organization of Foreign Institutions, the executive functions of the Republic of China’s foreign staff were regulated by official regulations, and the diplomatic post of Ambassador and Head of Delegation in the Foreign Office is known as the Ambassador.
title: 中華民國駐美國大使列表

.aq為南極國家及地區頂級域（ccTLD）的域名。.aq为在南极洲工作的组织而保留，也用于推广南极洲和南冰洋地区。这一域名由新西兰奥克兰的Mott联营公司管理。一般情况下到南极洲的因特网连接只能通过卫星通信进行。
根据南极条约规定，用于任何南纬60度线（60°S）以南的事物。AQ域名可用于南极条约签署国的政府组织，及在南极实际存在的其他注册机构。
target_text: .aq is the domain name of the Antarctic countries and geographical tops (ccTLD). .aq is reserved for organizations working in Antarctica and is also used to promote Antarctica and the Southern Ice Ocean. This domain is managed by Mott Associates in Auckland, New Zealand. Internet connections to Antarctica can normally be made only through satellite communications.
title: .aq

source_text: 陈光诚（），山东沂南人，著名中華人民共和國盲人維權人士，入选美国《時代雜誌》2006年时代百大人物。自学法律知识维护村民與残疾人士的权益，被媒体譽為「赤脚律师」。他曾於2006年至2010年入獄，自2005年起妻子、女兒就遭軟禁於家中（陳向CNN強調应称“非法监禁”）。2012年4月下旬，他進入了北京的美國駐華大使館尋求庇護，引發外交風波。5月19日，他與家人離開中國，抵達美國。
target_text: Chen Guangcheng, a Shan Dong-nan, a prominent member of the Central Chinese People's Republic of China's blind defender of rights, was elected to the US Times magazine in 2006. He learned to defend the rights and interests of villagers and persons with disabilities and was recognized by the media as a "freefoot lawyer". He went to prison from 2006 to 2010, and his wife and daughter were kept in house since 2005 (as formerly known to CNN as “unlawful imprisonment”). In late April 2012, he went to Beijing to seek refuge at the U.S. Embassy in China, leading to a diplomatic wave. On May 19, he left China with his family and arrived in the United States.
title: 陈光诚

source_text: 同时4月26日深夜11时，临沂双堠镇镇长张健带领多名不明身份者闯入陈光诚大哥陈光福家中，陈光福之子陈克贵在遭遇到攻击时持刀将张健和其他人砍伤，陈光福被不明身份者带走。陈克贵报警两个多小时后，亦被当地警方带走。据美國之音报道，沂南县政府网站提到了陈光诚的侄子陈克贵，说他“持刀砍伤当地政府干部及工作人员”、“畏罪潜逃”。此时外界才知道陈光诚已经不在东师古村。4月27日，BBC引用人权组织“对华援助协会”负责人的话，指出中国一支组织救援陈光诚的人权人士何培蓉和郭玉闪队伍将其从家中偷偷带出，身處美國駐華大使館且非常安全，但中國外交部和美國國務院一直拒絕證實事件。上午11时，组织救援陈光诚的何培蓉被警方从南京家中带走。当日中午，博讯网放出一段时长为15分钟陈光诚的视频，视频中，身穿黑色耐克运动上装的陈光诚向国务院总理温家宝提出“依法惩治罪犯”、“依法保障家人安全”、“依法惩治腐败”三个请求。胡佳稱，陳到美國大使館並非尋求政治庇護，更沒有打算離開中國；而陳光誠的腸胃病也變得嚴重，希望他可以盡快接受治療。根据《华尔街日报》的报道，在大使馆期间，美国大使馆的官员与陈光诚进行了密集的交流，以确认他下一步的意愿。
target_text: At 11 a.m. on 26 April, Chen Guangfook, Chen Guangfu's son, Chen Kegui, was killed with a knife during the attack, and Chen Guangfu was taken away by unknown persons. Chen Kefu, after two hours of reporting to the police, was taken away by the local police. According to the American Voice, Chen Guangcheng's government website referred to Chen Guangcheng's nephew Chen Kegui, who “cut down local government cadres and staff members with knives” and fled.” At 11 a.m., Chen Guangcheng's son Chen Guangqquu was not in his village. On 27 April, BBC, citing the head of the human rights organization “Assistance to China”, said that Chen Guangcheng's human rights team had secretly taken him from his home in the United States Embassy of America and was very secure, but the Chinese Foreign Ministry and the United States Agency refused to testify.
title: 陈光诚

source_text: 5月2日，陳光誠在美國駐華大使駱家輝陪同下進入北京市朝陽醫院，与中国政府从山东带来的妻子和孩子会面。同日，中國官方首次對陳光誠事件開腔回應，中方批評美方以非正常方式將陳帶入使館，干涉中國內政，要求美方道歉。美方则表示会持续关注事件的进展。到晚间，病房門外有便衣公安看守，禁止记者入內。隨後，医务人员以探视时间已过要求美国官员离开，甚至到了晚上陈光诚一家都无法吃到饭。他在与友人滕彪、曾金燕通话后感到事态严重，改变了要留在中国的初衷，希望尽快离开中国。而據香港電台報道，陳在美國駐華大使館逗留期間受到中國當局威脅，獲告知如果不離開美國大使館，其家人就會有危險，但美方否认这些说法。有评论批评美方希望尽快结束此事，以不致影响即将进行的美中战略与经济对话。5月3日，美方官员开始为他们的行动辩解。但是美方已经无法在医院与陈光诚会面，只在当天早上在医院外面见到了他的妻子。到了下午，美国国务院承认陈光诚想要离开中国的想法。随后陈光诚通过电话在美国国会听证会上表达了他的要求：他想和家人一起暂时离开中国一阵，在美国的大学休息，可能还会学习一段时间。5月4日，中国外交部发言人刘为民称，陈光诚目前正在医院接受治疗。
target_text: On the same day, China’s official responded for the first time to Chen’s incident, criticizing the US for bringing it into the embassy in an irregular manner and interfering in China’s internal affairs, asking the US for an apology. The US side said it would keep following the incident. At night, there were plain-clothes security guards outside the ward, who banned journalists from entering the hospital. As soon as the medical staff had asked US officials to leave, even Chen Guangcheng’s family could not eat at night.
title: 陈光诚

source_text: 2012年4月下旬，陳光誠在四位网友的协助下逃離上百警察与村委監視，進入了北京的美國駐華大使館。5月2日，陳在美國駐華大使駱家輝的陪同下離開大使館，到達北京市朝陽醫院。后经中美兩國政府談判，陳与家人离开中国，抵达美国纽约，居住于格林尼治村并在纽约大学担任访问学者，期间学习英语和钻研民主与法治的基本概念。5月29日，陈光诚通过《纽约时报》发表文章批判中国政府和中国共产党“对他和他的家庭在过去七年中所作出的非法惩罚”、“那些处理我案件的人可以堂而皇之多年违反这个国家的法律”。
target_text: In late April 2012, Chen Guangcheng, assisted by four netizens, escaped from surveillance by hundreds of police and village councils and entered the United States Embassy in China in Beijing. On May 2, Chen left the embassy accompanied by the Ambassador of the United States to China, and arrived at the Beijing city hospital in Sunyang. After negotiations between the Chinese and United States governments, Chen and his family left China, arrived in New York, lived in Greenwich Village and worked as visiting scholars at New York University, learning English and the basic concepts of democracy and the rule of law. On May 29, Chen Guangcheng published an article in the New York Times criticizing the Chinese Government and the Chinese Communist Party for “unlawful punishment imposed on him and his family over the past seven years.”
title: 陈光诚

source_text: 儘管在2000年10月達成了和平協議，但 2002 年 3 月，當兩名紐西蘭外交官和其他幾名外交官遇害後，霍尼亚拉發生了暴力事件。2003年7月，霍尼亞拉的治安情況變得糟糕，以至於由澳洲領導的多個太平洋國家組成的(RAMSI) 應所罗门群岛政府的邀請進入該國以恢復秩序。2006年，斯奈德·里尼當選總理後爆發騷亂，唐人街部分地區被毀，1000多名中國居民無家可歸。騷亂摧毀了城鎮和城市的旅遊業，在2021年所罗门群岛骚乱後，唐人區受到嚴重影響。
target_text: Despite the peace agreement reached in October 2000, violence in Honiara occurred in March 2002 after two New Zealand diplomats and several other diplomats were killed. In July 2003, the security situation in Honiara deteriorated so that many Pacific countries led by Australia (RAMSI) entered the country at the invitation of the Solomon Islands government to restore order.
title: 霍尼亚拉

source_text: 《圣斯特凡诺条约》（，）是俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国在俄土战争结束后，于1878年3月3日在圣斯特凡诺 (1925年前叫，现在称为，亦即今土耳其伊斯坦堡西部的）签署的条约。俄方代表是伊格那提耶夫伯爵与亚历山大·涅利多夫，而土方的代表是外长薩菲特帕夏与驻德国大使萨杜拉贝伊。
target_text: The Treaty of San Stefano ( " the Treaty of St. Stefano " ) was signed by Russia and the Ottoman Empire on 3 March 1878 in San Stefano (known as the western part of Istanbul, Turkey, until 1925). The Russian side is represented by Count Ignatiev and Alexander Neridov, while the Turkish side is represented by Foreign Minister Safitpasha and German Ambassador Sadurabey.
title: 聖斯特凡諾條約

source_text: 尽管从沙俄签署条约反映的官方想法来看，沙俄只想划出临时缓冲区来与列强达成最终解决方案，但这个条约却成为保加利亚外交政策的核心，并导致了灾难性的第二次巴爾幹戰爭和其后更为严重的参加一战，直到1944年。条约終結了奥斯曼帝国对保加利亚近500年的统治，成立了保加利亚大公国，条约签署的日期成为保加利亚的国庆日。
target_text: Although it appears from the official thinking reflected in the signing of the Treaty by the Republic of Belarus that it was only trying to draw a temporary buffer zone to reach a final settlement with the powers, the Treaty became the core of Bulgaria’s foreign policy and led to the disastrous second and more serious participation in the war until 1944. The Treaty ended nearly 500 years of the Ottoman Empire’s rule over Bulgaria, establishing the Bulgarian Grand Duchy, the date of which became Bulgaria’s national day.
title: 聖斯特凡諾條約

source_text:
列强反应
欧洲列强不满俄罗斯企图扩张的行为，尤其是英国首相本杰明·迪斯雷利；塞尔维亚与希臘则恐惧大保加利亚的建立会减少他们可夺得的奥斯曼领土。结果，德国首相俾斯麦主动邀请列强参与柏林会议，并最后签署了《柏林条约》。罗马尼亚在对土耳其战争前与俄国签下密约，希望保证前者的领土完整。战争中，罗马尼亚付出很大代价，但最后却很失望。将南比萨拉比亚割让给俄国，同时获得北多布罗加作为补偿。奥匈帝国因未能扩大其在波黑的影响力而对条约不满。
target_text: As a result, German Prime Minister Bismarck took the initiative to invite him to the Berlin Conference and finally signed the Berlin Treaty. Romania signed a secret pact with Russia before the war against Turkey, hoping to guarantee the territorial integrity of the former. Romania paid a great price in the war, but in the end was disappointed.
title: 聖斯特凡諾條約

source_text: 20世纪中期，随着工厂和制造业不断迁离纽约，纽约市的人口开始减少。摩斯着手为纽约设计标志性建筑来帮助确保其政治、经济、文化中心的地位，并且推动了纽约在后工业时代城市功能的转变。联合国大厦和林肯中心是摩斯“拯救纽约”策略的关键，联合国大厦的设立使纽约成为了世界的中心，林肯中心则凸显了它文化方面的重要性。为了这两个项目，摩斯不仅在工程选址、筹集资金、具体施工等方面亲力亲为，还要与复杂的政治力量斡旋。他使得纽约的城市地位得到了巩固和提升。
target_text: In the middle of the twentieth century, with factories and manufacturing moving away from New York City, New York City’s population began to decline. Moss began to design landmark architecture for New York to help ensure its political, economic, cultural centre and facilitate the transformation of New York’s urban function in the post-industrial era.
title: 羅伯·摩斯

source_text: 亚历克斯·巴特利特（，），所罗门群岛政府前外交部长，以前曾担任当地反政府武装“马莱塔之鹰”的总书记，2004年因为在所罗门群岛种族冲突期间曾犯有多项刑事罪，被解除外交部长职务，并被判刑。2006年2月，在被监禁17个月后，因健康原因保释出狱。在4月份骚乱中指示动乱分子放火抢劫唐人街，并因再度受审。
target_text: Alex Bartlett (,), former Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Solomon Islands Government, formerly Secretary-General of the local anti-government armed “Maretta Eagle”, was removed from the post of Foreign Minister in 2004 for several criminal offences committed during the Solomon Islands ethnic conflict and sentenced. In February 2006, after 17 months in prison, he was released on bail for health reasons. During the April riots, rioters were instructed to set fire to Chinatown and to be tried again.
title: 亚历克斯·巴特利特

source_text: 1938年8月，辭任駐德大使，10月，返回重慶。12月13日，任国立四川大学校長，於3月6日就任。川大師生因不滿程之教育理念和省籍區隔開展“拒程運動”。1939年9月，任三民主義青年团中央監察会監察。1943年，因張道藩調任中央宣傳部長，蔣介石提名程天放繼任国立中央政治学校教育長，兼任国防最高委員会常務委員。1945年5月，当选中国国民党第六届中央監察委員。9月，作為联合国教育、科学及文化组织憲章制定会議中国代表之一，和胡適、羅家倫、李書華、趙元任等一同出席。1946年3月，回到重慶主持政校遷回南京的工作。8月，辭任國立政治大學教育長。行憲後，膺選江西省第一區立法委員，旋兼中央黨部宣傳部長，並赴歐出席聯合國教育科學文化組織會議。
target_text: In September 1939, he joined the Central Monitoring Board of the Three Democratic Youth Leagues. In March 1943, he was re-elected as Minister of Communication of the Central Government, and in March 1943, as Minister of Education of the National Supreme Council for National Defence, who was appointed Chairman of the Supreme Council for National Defence. In May 1945, he was elected as a member of the Sixth Central Monitoring Board of the Chinese National Party. In September, he was one of the Chinese delegates to the Constitutional Council of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), and was joined by Huuan, Lo Jilan, Li Shuhua, Zhao Yuan, and others. In March 1946, he returned to Quixiang to host the School of Political Education in Nanjing.

source_text: 1973年8月27日，坦赞铁路在坦桑尼亚境内976km正线全线通车，铺轨进入赞比亚，坦桑尼亚总统尼雷尔和赞比亚总统卡翁达为跨国境的通杜马隧道两侧的两块镶嵌铜字的大理石横匾揭幕，观看了在通杜马隧道赞比亚一侧纳孔德铺设第一条钢轨的情景。坦桑尼亚交通和工程部长卢辛德和赞比亚动力、运输和工程部长穆利基塔拧紧这条铁轨上的螺丝。中国驻坦大使李耀文和驻赞大使李强奋与会。完成任务的工程队回国休假探亲3个月，然后转入赞比亚境内施工。第四年，修建国境站通杜马至谦比西（通谦段）。通谦段的重点工程是横跨谦比西河的大桥，全长267米，河床淤积有十几米厚的沙层，1972年6月，六机队就安排了一个分队在这里施工。1973年11月4日完成。第五年，修建谦比西直奔终点卡比里姆博希（谦卡段）。中国援建坦赞铁路工作组在姆皮卡设分组，靠前指挥。1974年8月2日铺轨到姆皮卡。1975年6月7日，铺轨到新卡比里姆博希，全线铺通。
target_text: On 27 August 1973, Tanzania’s Tanzan railway was set up on the 976 km main line in Tanzania, where it was paved into Zambia, and Tanzania’s President Nirere and Zambia’s President Kaunda, where the engineering team returned for three months to visit relatives on both sides of the cross-border Tumma tunnel and then moved to Zambia for construction. In the fourth year, the construction of the border station was completed on 4 November, with the construction of the first steel track at Nakonde on the Zambian side of the Tunduma tunnel.

source_text: 1939年9月1日，纳粹德国与斯洛伐克入侵波兰，在半个月后的9月17日，苏联根据《苏德互不侵犯条约》的秘密协定，宣称波兰政府已经无力控制国内局势，《波苏互不侵犯条约》失效。同日苏联红军从东方侵入波兰。起先英国、法国与波兰缔结了英波同盟和法波同盟以防范德国的入侵，这一目的失败后，英国、法国及英联邦其他成员国不得不对德国宣战。但除了法国的萨尔攻势外，几乎未给波兰提供军事支援。这一举动被称为“假战”和“西方盟国的背叛”。
target_text: On 1 September 1939, Nazi Germany and Slovakia invaded Poland, and on 17 September, half a month later, the Soviet Union declared that the Polish Government had no control over the internal situation under the secret agreement of the Sood Non-Aggression Treaty and that the Bosun Non-Aggression Treaty had lapsed. On the same day, the Soviet Red Army invaded Poland from the east. Following the defeat of the British, French and Polish Alliances of the British and the French and the French and the Commonwealth, the British and other members of the Commonwealth had to declare war against Germany.

广告赞助
约翰逊曾出演卡尔文·克雷恩、欧莱雅和路易·威登等品牌的广告，2009年起她还是西班牙的代言人。2009年初，她与两位意大利设计师现身大都会艺术博物馆服饰研究馆，随后宣布成为杜嘉班纳新的化妆品分支的代言人，2009年7月31日，她以个人身份出现在伦敦的塞尔福里奇百货商店，宣传推广杜嘉班纳的新化妆品产品。同年，约翰逊签约为酩悦香槟的代言人，并多次出现在品牌广告和商业活动中，由此成为第一个担任香槟酒庄大使的好莱坞明星。2014年1月，汽水公司宣布约翰逊成为品牌首位全球大使。
target_text: In early 2009, with two Italian designers, she appeared at the Metropolitan Museum of Arts and was later announced as a spokesperson for the new cosmetic branch of Ducha Banner, and on 31 July 2009, she appeared personally at Selfridge's department store in London to promote the new make-up product of Dugabana. In the same year, Johnson was signed as a spokesperson for champagne and appeared in brand advertising and business events, becoming the first Hollywood star to be a Champagne Ambassador. In January 2014, the Motorwater Company announced Johnson as its first global ambassador.

source_text: 2014年1月，约翰逊辞去了乐施会的慈善大使职务，起因是她代言以色列汽水公司苏打气体（），而该公司在约旦河西岸的犹太人屯垦区开设了工厂，乐施会声明反对与剥削屯垦区的犹太企业做生意，认为这侵犯了巴勒斯坦人的利益。约翰逊回应称，她和乐施会“在抵制、撤资和制裁的反以色列运动上，有着根本性的观点差异”，她辩护说，这家公司致力于“为以色列和巴勒斯坦的和平牵线搭桥”。乐施会接受了她的辞职并声称：“我们非常感激她的诸多贡献……她一直帮助我们宣传自然灾害的破坏，并为拯救生命和抗击贫困而筹款。”
target_text: In January 2014, Johnson resigned from her post as charity ambassador to Oxfam because she spoke of the Israeli soda company, which opened a factory in the Jewish resettlement area of the West Bank, stating that it was against the interests of the Palestinians by opposing doing business with Jewish enterprises that exploited the settlement. Johnson responded that she and Oxfam had “a fundamental difference of opinion in the anti-Israel campaign of resistance, divestment and sanctions”, arguing that the company was committed to “bridging the line of peace between Israel and Palestine”. Oxfam accepted her resignation and claimed that “we are very grateful for her contributions...She has been helping us to promote the destruction of natural disasters and raise funds to save lives and fight poverty”.
title: 史嘉蕾·喬韓森

source_text: 金·克里斯奇·比兹利，AC（英语：，），澳大利亚工党籍政治家、外交官。1948年12月生于西澳州Subciaco，毕业于西澳大学。1980年当选为澳洲国会议员，其后曾陆续担任过内阁部长、国家副总理及工党副领袖、国会反对党领袖兼工党领袖等职务。2010年至2016年任澳大利亚驻美国大使，2018年至2022年任西澳大利亚州督。
target_text: Kim Christy Bizli, AC (English,), Australian Labour Party politician and diplomat. Born in Subciaco, Western Australia, in December 1948, graduate from the University of Western Australia. Elected member of the Australian Congress in 1980, he served as Cabinet Minister, Deputy Prime Minister of the State and Deputy Leader of the Labour Party, Leader of the Opposition in Congress and Leader of the Labour Party. Australian Ambassador to the United States from 2010 to 2016, and Governor of Western Australia from 2018 to 2022.

source_text: 1911年12月16日，大蒙古国在俄罗斯帝国支持下宣布独立，以八世哲布尊丹巴为“日光皇帝”，开始使用独立年号，驱逐中国清朝驻当地官员。1912年11月25日，中华民国袁世凯政府外长陆徵祥声明“外蒙古领土主权完全属于中华民国”，并与俄国外交代表在北京谈判。1913年，中国发生二次革命，袁世凯政府无力北顾，遂于1913年与俄国签订《中俄声明文件》，在文件中双方“承认外蒙古为中国领土之一部分，中国政府为自治蒙古的宗主”，并约定中俄蒙三方将于蒙古境内举行谈判以解决蒙古最终地位。這是對俄國最有益的，因為如蒙古真正獨立，就會與外國建交，不再是俄國勢力範圍，因此不及在中國的自治下控制那麼有利；加上內有革命問題，外有可能受干涉，因此同意和談。
target_text: On 16 December 1911, with the support of the Russian Empire, the Great Mongolian State declared its independence and began to use the Independence Year as the “Japanese Emperor”, expelling Chinese officials in China. On 25 November 1912, the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Government of the Republic of China, Yuan Shikai, declared that “the sovereignty of the territory of the Republic of China belongs exclusively to the Republic of China” and negotiated with its diplomatic representatives in Beijing. In 1913, the second revolution took place in China, the Government of the People's Republic of China was unable to exercise control over the territory of China, and signed a declaration with Russia in 1913, in which both sides “recognize the foreign country as part of the territory of China and the Chinese Government as the head of the autonomous country” and agreed that the three sides of China and Russia would enter into negotiations in Mongolia to resolve Mongolia's final status. This would be most beneficial to the Russian Federation, since, if Mongolia were truly independent, it would be no longer in Russia's power and, therefore, would not be in a position to control China's autonomy; and there would be any interference with the internal revolution, which could result.
title: 共戴

source_text: 1973年2月，拉姆斯菲尔德受尼克松委派，出任美国驻北约大使。1974年8月，尼克松因水门事件被迫辞职，副总统杰拉尔德·福特接任总统。拉姆斯菲尔德被福特任命为幕僚长。1975年10月底，福特对内阁实行大洗牌（史称“万圣节大屠杀”），原任国防部长詹姆斯·R·施莱辛格因与福特不和而被迫辞职，拉姆斯菲尔德被任命为新的国防部长，成为美国历史上最年轻的国防部长。他原来担任的白宫办公厅主任职务被迪克·切尼接任。在国防部长任内，他持鹰派立场，强调苏联的威胁，不支持对苏缓和，积极主张增加国防经费。后来福特戏称，“限制战略武器条约”的搁浅，应由勃列日涅夫和拉姆斯菲尔德二人负责。拉姆斯菲尔德则诙谐地回应，他对福特的这一评价“欣然接受”（见拉姆斯菲尔德回忆录“已知与未知”）。
target_text: At the end of October 1975, Rumsfeld was appointed Chief of Staff by Nixon as the United States Ambassador to NATO. In August 1974, Nixon was forced to resign in response to the Watergate incident, Vice-President Gerald Ford took over as President. Ramsfield was appointed Chief of Staff by Ford. At the end of October 1975, Ford shuffled his cabinet (the “Handlight Day massacre”) and former Defense Minister James R. Schlesinger was forced to resign because of disharmony with Ford, and Ramsfield was appointed as the newest Secretary of Defense in the history of the United States. His former post as Chief of Staff of the White House was replaced by Dick Cheney.
title: 唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德

source_text:
结盟原因
1871年德意志帝国成立，德国首相俾斯麦希望显示国家看似爱好和平、令欧洲維持現狀的形象，以确保德国能和平崛起。然而1878年俄土战争结束，俄罗斯击败了奥斯曼帝国并借着圣斯特凡诺条约企图在巴尔干建立大保加利亚，以期扩张，虽然奥匈与俄罗斯是三帝同盟的成员，但因为此事件而产生嫌隙。德国也是成员国并因此想修补奥俄关系，俾斯麦召开柏林会议，邀请欧洲列强解决巴尔干问题。会后达成的柏林条约，令俄罗斯失去大部分在圣斯特凡诺条约的所得，并让奥匈帝国管理波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维纳。
target_text: In 1871, German Prime Minister Bismarck wanted to show that the country seemed to be peace-loving and to maintain a current image in Europe, in order to ensure a peaceful rise in Germany. Yet, in 1878, after the end of the Russian-Turkish war, Russia defeated the Ottoman Empire and attempted to establish Greater Bulgaria in the Balkans on the basis of the San Stefano Treaty, with a view to expansion, although the Austrian-Russian alliance was a member of the triad, which caused the gap.

source_text:
駐越南共和國大使
1964年，美軍開始進入越南，越南戰爭面臨重要轉捩關頭。政府為肆應亞太地區情勢演變，亟謀加強中越邦交，從而在全盤外交上有所策進。國府權衡至當，特任胡璉為駐越南全權大使，賦予他無比重大之使命。11月，胡璉到達西貢，1972年12月因病辭職，駐越共達8年之久。中華民國駐越南共和國大使館位於西貢咸宜大道（Hàm Nghi Boulevard）與巴斯德街（Pasteur Street）路口。
target_text: In 1964, the U.S. military began to enter Vietnam, and the war in Viet Nam came to an important turning point. The Governor’s authority was vested with Hu as Vietnam’s full-power ambassador, giving him an enormous mission. source_text: 法國欧洲-{zh-tw:暨; zh-hk:及; zh-cn:和}-外交事務部（），通称法国欧洲和外交部、法国外交部，是法國政府部門之一，專門負責管理法國與外國的關係。外交部現在位於巴黎的奧塞碼頭（），所以「奧塞碼頭」一詞成了外交部的代號。外交部的中央行政則位於南特。現任外交部長是卡特琳·科隆纳。
target_text: French Europe – {zh-tw: and; zh-hk: and; zh-cn: and}- Ministry of Foreign Affairs of France, known as the Ministry of European and Foreign Affairs of France and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of France, is one of the French government departments responsible for regulating relations between France and the outside world. The Foreign Ministry is now located at the Osse dock in Paris, so the word “Ossehead” has become the Ministry’s codename. The central administration of the Foreign Office is in Nantes. The current Foreign Minister is Catherine Colona.
title: 法國外交部

source_text: 法国外交部的前身可以追溯到1547年。在1589年，四位法國國務大臣的職責經歷了專門化，其中一位專責外交事務；在1723年，波旁王朝首次正式任命外務大臣一職。在1791年，由於法國大革命的影響，這一職位更名爲外交部長。在1794年，所有部長職位被國民公會廢除，但隨後即在1795年由督政府重新設立。在1980年代，外交部長曾一度改名為對外關係部長。如今，該部門的正式名稱為法國欧洲-{zh-tw:暨; zh-hk:及; zh-cn:和}-外交事務部。
target_text: In 1791, under the influence of the French Revolution, the post of Minister for Foreign Affairs was changed to that of Minister for Foreign Affairs. In 1794, all ministerial posts were abolished by the National Assembly, but subsequently re-established by the Governor-General in 1795. In the 1980s, the Minister for Foreign Affairs changed his name to Minister for Foreign Affairs. Today, the official name of the Department is European {zh-tw: and; zh-hk: and; zh-cn: and}-Foreign Affairs.
title: 法國外交部

source_text: 7月20日密謀案是在第二次世界大戰後期，由德國抵抗運動主導說服軍方並刺殺納粹德國元首阿道夫·希特勒與後續政變行動，密谋藉此推翻以納粹黨為首的德國政府、進而和西方的同盟國達成和平協議。儘管在這之前納粹德國各個抵抗運動成員曾多次嘗試推翻納粹德國政府，密謀案一開始便計畫以成功暗殺希特勒為前提，緊接著實施一連串德國政治、軍事乃至於親衛隊等權力移交計劃。經過後續調查，大約有近200多名納粹德國各界高層參與7月20日密謀案，其中包括陸軍元帥埃爾溫·馮·維茨萊本、19名將級軍官、26名上校、2名大使、7名外交官、1名部長、3名國務秘書與秩序警察局長，以及數名、和。

Despite many attempts to overthrow the Nazi German government before that, the conspiracy planned, at the beginning of which was based on the successful assassination of Hitler, a succession of German political, military, and even private forces. source_text:
早期行動
早在1938年至1939年，希特勒主張原本屬於捷克的蘇台德地區為德國領土，並且為此召開慕尼黑會議。但是面對不斷惡化，以軍隊高級將領為首的密謀份子為了防止其進一步發動德國與英國和法國間的世界戰爭，決定擬定出推翻希特勒之反抗計畫。當時接替路德维希·貝克職位的弗朗茲·哈爾德則選擇站在貝克的立場，認為如果有必要的話將發動政變推翻希特勒。其中密謀成員分別計劃由哈爾德負責逮捕希特勒的軍事行動，之後將以希特勒精神狀態不穩為由要求轉移政治權力。另外，軍方還決定分別與阿勃維爾副局長漢斯·歐斯特、德國外交部國務秘書合作。歐斯特的友人其兄弟則是藉由曾在倫敦工作的經歷，主動與英國外交及國協事務大臣哈利法克斯伯爵聯絡並說明這次行動。

title: 7月20日密谋案

source_text: 外交、聯邦及發展事務大臣（），簡稱外交大臣（）或外相，是英国内阁閣員、以及四個內閣重臣之一，負責主理英國的對外事務，並且是外交、聯邦及發展事務部（簡稱外交部）的首長。出任此職的人，除了是內閣成員外，也是英國政府最重要的大臣之一。外交、聯邦及發展事務大臣的內閣排列僅次于首相及財政大臣。
target_text: The Minister for Foreign Affairs, the Federation, and Development (DFD), who is a Foreign Secretary (or Foreign Minister), is one of the British Cabinet Ministers and one of the four Cabinet Chiefs, who is responsible for the foreign affairs of the United Kingdom and the head of the Foreign Affairs, Federal Affairs and Development Department (DFD). In addition to being a member of the Cabinet, he is one of the most important ministers of the British government. The Minister for Foreign Affairs, Union and Development is ranked second only to the Prime Minister and the Minister of Finance.
title: 外交、聯邦及發展事務大臣

source_text:
歷史
此職在2020年設立，因首相約翰遜宣布合併外交及英聯邦事務部以及，外交及英聯邦事務大臣及國際事務大臣兩職亦隨即合併，成為此職務。1968年，由外交大臣（Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs）及英聯邦事務大臣（Secretary of State for Commonwealth Affairs）兩職合併，兩職所統領的部門也合二為一。卡爾頓府聯排1號是外交大臣的官邸，志奮領府為其鄉村別墅，日常於白廳辦工。
target_text: The post was created in 2020 as Prime Minister Johnson announced the merger of the Foreign and British Departments and the merger of the Foreign and British Ministers and the Ministers for International Affairs. In 1968, the Minister for Foreign Affairs of State for Foreign Affairs and the Minister for Commonwealth Affairs of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland joined forces to combine the two offices of the Minister for Foreign Affairs and the Secretary for International Affairs.
title: 外交、聯邦及發展事務大臣

source_text:
波斯統治時期
1602年，波斯击败葡萄牙占领军，重新占领巴林。18世纪，阿富汗人侵入伊朗导致萨菲王朝几近崩溃。在由此引发的权力真空时期，阿曼于1717年入侵巴林，结束了波斯长达100多年的统治。1783年，谢赫·艾哈迈德击败波斯，1797年在巴林建立哈利法王朝统治。英國統治時期
1820年，阿勒哈利法部落重新执政的巴林并且与英国签订条约。这是一系列条约的开始，之后巴林和英国签订和平友好的永久休战协定。这个协定在1892年和1951年进行进一步修改。此后巴林逐渐成为英国势力范围。1871年，巴林成为英国保护国。
target_text: During the ensuing power vacuum, Oman invaded Bahrain in 1717, ending Persian rule for more than 100 years. In 1783, Sheikh Ahmed defeated Persian rule, and in 1797 established the Khalifa dynasty in Bahrain. During British rule, in 1820, the Al Khalifa tribe returned to power in Bahrain and signed a treaty with the United Kingdom. This was the beginning of a series of treaties, followed by a permanent truce of peace and friendship between Bahrain and the United Kingdom. The agreement was further amended in 1892 and 1951. Bahrain became a British protectorate in 1871.
title: 巴林历史

source_text:
任命
1724年，纽卡斯尔被沃波尔选为南方部大臣，代替卡特雷特勋爵，这一举动主要由汤森德策划。一段时间以来，他一直被认为是政府中第三重要的人，仅次于沃波尔和汤森德，这一点得到了他的新职位的证实。几年来，纽卡斯尔对外交事务的兴趣与日俱增，并且一直在自学外交和欧洲国家体系的微妙细节。然而，他在职的头几年，英国外交政策的控制权被擔任另一位內閣大臣的汤森德控制，而纽卡斯尔实际上担任了他的副手。沃波尔通常很乐意让汤森德控制外交事务，因为他在大多数问题上都同意汤森德的观点。
target_text: In 1724, Newcastle was elected Minister of the South by Warpol to replace Lord Cartrethe, a move largely orchestrated by Townsend. For some time, he has been considered to be the third most important member of the government, after Warpol and Townsend, as confirmed by his new position. Newcastles has been increasingly interested in foreign affairs for several years, and has been studying the subtle details of diplomacy and the European system.
title: 第一代紐卡斯爾公爵托馬斯·佩勒姆-霍利斯

source_text: 1729年，政府内部在英国外交政策的方向上发生了分歧。汤森德确信英国的主要敌人是奥地利。沃波尔和纽卡斯尔则将西班牙视为对英国力量的主要威胁，因为西班牙拥有庞大的海军和殖民地利益。最终，沃波尔取得胜利，迫使汤森德下台，并由哈灵顿勋爵取而代之。从那时起，纽卡斯尔开始担任高级內閣大臣，并在很大程度上控制着英国的外交政策。纽卡斯尔对他的亲戚和前赞助人的离开感到悲伤，尽管他们的合作关系变得越来越紧张，新的政治情况为纽卡斯尔个人前景提供了巨大的可能性。

清末弛禁
道光二十四年（1844年）10月24日，法国特使剌萼尼与两广总督耆英签订中法黄埔条约。条约签订后，剌萼尼要求耆英上奏清宣宗弛禁天主教，清宣宗准奏。1846年2月20日，清宣宗颁布上谕，明确允许中国人可以信仰天主教，并宣布归还康熙年间的天主教教产。是年8月，罗伯济、南格禄抓住这个时机，委派梅德尔（Lemaître）神父承担向上海道台交涉归还教产的任务，经过梅德尔神父的调查，他将要求归还的教产情况编写成一本备忘录，交给英国领事阿礼国（Ruterford Alcock）和丹麦领事代理人亚历山大·卡尔代（Alexandre Calder），同年12月初，卡尔代陪同阿礼国及通事前往上海道署向上海道台宫慕久提出归还教产的要求，除老天主堂由于已改作关帝庙无法归还外，对于其他两处教产是否归还，宫慕久赴省城苏州向江苏署理巡抚程矞采请示，两天后，宫慕久回到上海，向阿礼国表示可以归还圣墓堂墓地，但老天主堂旁边一座原属于神父住院的房屋和一座花园无法归还，不过可以另拨一块合适的土地作为补偿。最后达成协议，由上海道拨出上海县城垣之内的石皮弄（今太阳都市花园处）、黄浦江边的董家渡和洋泾浜三块土地作为补偿。

In the same month, Carldé took over the city of Alemur and the governor of the upper sea lanes to make an agreement on the return of his property to the house of the upper sea.

source_text: 嘉靖四十二年（1563年）十一月十七日，徐阶上疏请求改变吏部旧弊，惟才是用。徐阶为存在的问题提出两个结论，一是尊主权，每次下旨后很多人阳奉阴违，最后功罪难定，还有人贪馈肆行，都是由于皇帝主权不尊的后果；二是定国是，很多人利用文章掩盖自己的能力不足，这样使得有才的人无法被擢升，因此需要改进国家制度让可以体恤人民的官员上任。嘉靖当天就立刻答回觉得徐阶说的很对，同意说现在由于王言不重，很多官员就非常恣放，徐阶顺势又上奏说重中之重是杜绝贪脏。于是在七月时，嘉靖下谕给徐阶，觉得欺谤、贪肆的官员太多，不把祖宗法度放在眼里，并觉得冢宰应该为此负责，于是徐阶告诉了时任吏部尚书的严讷，严讷赶紧上疏，提出让各地抚按官员加紧巡查，上报所有不法事。后来严讷将那些政绩优异的州县官员破格提升，使得朝廷效率高了很多，严讷也将他可以如此成功归功于徐阶，认为在徐阶执掌朝政的这段时间，不为他做事设置阻碍，任命的大臣也很有才贤。在这样的背景下，时任刑科给事中的陈瓒上疏请求恢复那些因为直言而被废斥的官员，平反各种冤狱。尽管徐阶因陈瓒为他出了很多计画，非常重视陈瓒，可惜嘉靖在看到奏疏后大怒，将陈瓒除名。

target_text: In Port-au-Prince, there is an international airport, Doussaint Louvidur International Airport. target_text: The main industries in Ashgabat are cotton knitting and metal processing. It is the main stopover for the Trans-Rerician railway. There are also many foreign citizens serving as diplomats or agents in embassies in their respective countries. Ashgabat is named after the Ashgabat agreement signed by India, Oman, Iran, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan, with the aim of establishing international transport and border corridors to facilitate the movement of goods between the Gulf of Central Asia and the Persian Gulf.

source_text: 后来有人说，她在初見查理國王之前，就已經被法国宮廷收買並选定為迷住英格兰国王的特務，但这說法似乎没有证据支持。不過英王在初見她時展現出的覬覦之色，確實讓敏銳的法王路易十四（同在現場）開始策劃，利用她的美色去影響英王、資助法國。這個策略由法国駐英大使大力推動，同時也藉由英國国务卿阿灵顿伯爵亨利·本内特夫妇提供的管道（兩夫妻專門替查理二世物色美女、上貢為王家情婦），才得以讓路易絲進入王宮當侍女（實際上當國王情婦）。當路易絲於1673年成為查理最得寵的情婦時，法王給她的賄賂與秘密任務，也就水到渠成了。她受命替法國打探查理國王的機密心思，並且運用她的影響力，讓國王實施親法的外交政策並改信天主教。
target_text: Later, it was said that she had been bought by the French court before the first meeting with King Charlie and chosen as an agent for the King of England, but that the law did not seem to be supported by evidence. But the British king’s appearance at the first meeting with her did make it possible for King Louis XIV, who was so keen, to plan to use her beauty to influence the British king and aid France. This strategy was pursued by the Ambassador of France to the United Kingdom, and was achieved by the conduit provided by the British Secretary of State, the Count Henry Bennett and the Lord of England (the two husband and wife for Charlie II and the royal mistress), to allow Louise to enter the palace as a waitress (and, in fact, the king’s mistress). When Louise became Charlie’s most beloved mistress in 1673, the king gave her a noble and secret mission.
title: 樸次茅斯女公爵路易絲·德·克魯阿爾

source_text: 法国大使不斷送來的珍寶與禮物，使她了解她必須要为祖国的主权與利益服务。當法王路易十四給予她禮物和榮耀之後，這項交易就獲得確認，路易絲也忠實並出色地達成其任務。1673年路易十四很滿意她的工作成效，就在當年12月应查理二世要求，授予她欧比尼女公爵的采邑。也因此，英国人很討厭她。路易十四給她的一雙耳環價值一萬八千英鎊，是路易當年送給英國政要的禮物中，最昂貴的珍品，這也比路易送給英國王后的任何物品還貴重。
target_text: The French ambassador's precious treasure and gift, which made her understand that she had to serve the sovereignty and interests of her country. When King Louis XIV gave her gifts and glory, the deal was confirmed, and Louise served her mission with loyalty and distinction. Louis XIV of 1673 was pleased with her work, and gave her the pick-up of the Duchess of Obini at the request of Charles II in December of that year. The British, therefore, hated her. Louis XIV's earring, worth 18,000 pounds, was one of the most valuable gifts that Louis had given to British dignitaries in that year, and was worth more than anything since Louis had given to the King of England.
title: 樸次茅斯女公爵路易絲·德·克魯阿爾

source_text: 1949年，中华人民共和国成立後，苏联成为首个承認中華人民共和國的国家。中華人民共和國奉行“一面倒”的外交政策，即向社会主义国家陣營靠攏，歌曲《莫斯科—北京》還成為建國初期家喻戶曉流行歌。1950年，中苏签订《中苏友好同盟互助条约》。蘇聯開始對中國提供大量技術援助，如援建武漢長江大橋等多項建築計劃，以及著名的156项重点工程，輸出各種技術與人才，「莫斯科—北京軸心」因此形成。毛澤東還於1952年讚揚這個軸心是「持久的、牢不可破的、戰無不勝的」。
target_text: After the establishment of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, the Soviet Union became the first country to recognize the People’s Republic of China. The People’s Republic of China pursued a “one-sided” foreign policy, relying on the socialist State, and the song “Moscow-Beijing” became a famous homecoming song.
title: 中苏交恶

source_text:
分歧
1949年底至1950年初毛泽东访苏，其目的主要是废除1945年条约，重新签订中苏同盟条约。斯大林最初反对“改变原有中苏条约的合法性”，苏联租用旅顺口30年“在形式上不能改变”，但可以发表一个声明表示苏联同意从那里撤军。后来，在毛泽东的强硬态度面前，斯大林不得不同意签订新条约。苏联有关部门反复考虑，数易其稿，在周恩来到达莫斯科之前起草了12份有关条约和协定，其中规定，目前在旅顺口和大连港的苏联军队自本条约生效之日起2－3年期限内全部撤回苏联境内，撤军将于1950年开始。最后，经过双方讨论确认的协定规定，缔结对日和约后，不迟于1952年底，苏联军队撤出旅顺海军基地；1952年8月周恩来率中国代表团到莫斯科与斯大林进行会谈，除了解决中国的经济发展计划和朝鲜战争问题，延长苏联在旅顺基地驻军也是讨论的内容之一。会谈中斯大林指出，延长共同使用旅顺海军基地期限的倡议应由中方提出。我们在那里是客人，而客人是不提这种问题的。于是，周恩来建议以互换照会的方式，由中国政府向苏联提出相应的请求。9月15日，中苏交换了《关于延长共同使用中国旅顺口海军基地期限的换文》。
target_text: The purpose of the visit to the Soviet Union by Mao Zedong between the end of 1949 and the beginning of 1950 was, inter alia, to abolish the 1945 Treaty and to re-establish the Sino-Soviet Treaty. Stalin initially objected to “altering the legitimacy of the original Sino-Soviet Treaty” for 30 years, and the Soviet chartered brigade “cannot change in form” but could issue a statement stating that the Soviet Union had agreed to withdraw from there. Later, in the face of Mao Zedong’s tough attitude, Stalin had to agree to a new treaty. The Soviet authorities had repeatedly considered the possibility of drafting 12 treaties and agreements prior to Zhou Enlai’s arrival in Moscow, stipulating that the current withdrawal of Soviet troops from the Sino-Soviet and Dalian Ports within the Soviet Union within the period of two to three years from the date of entry into force of the Treaty would begin in 1950.
title: 中苏交恶

source_text: 1958年4月和7月，中共要求苏联提供承诺给予的核武器及核潜艇，苏联则提出要在中国领土上建设用于军事的长波电台，和在中国领海和中方组建联合舰队作为交换。在建设长波电台问题上，毛泽东认为这牵涉主权问题，提出中方出一半资金，苏联出另一半资金和全部技术，但长波电台主权属于中国，被苏联拒绝；而组建联合舰队一事，毛泽东则认为苏联企图军事控制中国。中共当时海军十分薄弱，即使组建联合舰队也无能力共享苏联的海岸线。毛泽东后来在回忆这件事时说：「事实上同苏联闹翻是1958年，他们在军事上控制中国，我们不干。」赫则无法理解毛的激烈反应，特别是苏联刚答应提供给中国潜艇技术的前提下，他说“北大西洋公约组织国家间在互相供应、合作上不存在任何困难，而我们竟连这么简单的一件事都不能取得一致意见。”
target_text: In April and July 1958, the Communist Party demanded that the Soviet Union provide the promised nuclear weapons and submarines, while the Soviet Union offered to build a longwave radio station for military use in Chinese territory in exchange for the formation of a joint fleet in China’s territorial waters and China’s territorial waters. On the issue of the construction of the longwave radio station, Mao said that it was a question of sovereignty and proposed half of China’s funds, the Soviet Union’s other half of its capital and all of its technology, but the latter’s sovereignty was rejected by the Soviet Union; and, in the case of the formation of the joint fleet, Mao considered that the Soviet Union sought military control of China. The Navy was weak at that time, and even the formation of the joint fleet was incapable of sharing the Soviet coastline.
title: 中苏交恶

source_text:
领土争端
中国于1858年的《瑷珲条约》与1860年的《北京条约》两条不平等条约中被帝俄夺取大量领土。后来苏联煽动外蒙古脱离中国而独立，外蒙古成为苏联一个卫星国。毛泽东认为中国还未向苏联清算中国向俄国的失土，却惹来苏联谴责毛泽东像希特勒般寻求“生存空间”。中国方面声称，从1964年到1969年3月，苏联共侵犯中国边境4189次。
target_text: Since then, the Soviet Union has instigated foreign Mongolia to secede from China and become an independent country, and it has become a satellite of the Soviet Union. Mao, believing that China has not settled China’s land losses to Russia before the Soviet Union, has provoked the Soviet Union to condemn Mao for seeking “sustain space” like Hitler.
title: 中苏交恶

source_text: 1964年2月23日至8月22日，中国和苏联在北京东交民巷40号进行了边界谈判。中方代表团团长为外交部副部长曾涌泉，副团长为外交部苏联东欧司司长余湛，苏方代表团团长为帕维尔·泽里亚诺夫、副团长为苏联驻华大使馆参赞伊利亚·谢尔盖耶维奇·谢尔巴科夫。5月初，泽里亚诺夫乘飞机回到苏联和赫鲁晓夫会谈，赫鲁晓夫同意全面迎合中国。7月初，谈判取得重大进展，中苏同意在以黑龙江、乌苏里江为界的地段，以两江主航道的中心线为界。中国一侧的400多个争议岛屿，以及约600平方公里的争议水面划归中国。珍宝岛等岛屿均归属中国。但7月10日，毛泽东与日本社会党人佐佐木更三、黑田寿男、会面，一日本代表就要求归还被苏联占领千岛群岛征询毛泽东的看法。毛泽东讲：“苏联占的地方太多了。在雅尔塔会议上就让外蒙古名义上独立，名义上从中国划出去，实际上就是受苏联控制。外蒙古的领土，比你们千岛的面积要大得多。我们曾经提过把外蒙古归还中国是不是可以，他们说不可以……有人说，他们还要把中国的新疆、黑龙江划过去。他们在边境增加了兵力。我的意见就是都不要划。苏联领土已经够大了。有两千多万平方公里，而人口只有两亿。你们日本人口有一亿，可是面积只有三十七万平方公里。一百多年以前，把贝加尔湖以东，包括伯力、海参崴、勘察加半岛都划过去了。
target_text: From 23 February to 22 August 1964, China and the Soviet Union conducted border negotiations at 40 East Junction in Beijing. In early July, the Chinese delegation was headed by the Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs, the deputy head of the Soviet Department for Eastern Europe, Pavel Zelyanov, and the deputy head of the Soviet Embassy in China, Ilya Sergeyevich Cherbakov. You returned to the Soviet Union and Khrushchev by air.
title: 中苏交恶

source_text: 外交照會（）即一國政府向另一國政府通知己方對某一事件的意見。亦稱「通牒」。「照會」，意指「察照知會」。可以是某國外交部對另一國外交部的書信，也可以是某國外交官對另一國的外交官的書信，也可以是外交部對外國使節與領事的電報，亦可以是各地的行政長官與當地外國外交官所遞交的一種外交文書。
target_text: A diplomatic conference (i.e., a government informs another government of its opinion on an incident) is also called an ultimatum. A "opportunity" means a "opportunity meeting." It can be a letter from a foreign ministry to another ministry of foreign affairs, a letter from a foreign minister to a diplomat from another country, a telegram from the foreign ministry to an ambassador and minister from another country, or a diplomatic document from a local administrative officer to a foreign diplomat.
title: 外交照會

source_text: 以后汪日章调任行政院简任秘书，由李惟果任组长。1940年，侍从室第三处成立，以陈果夫为主任，萧赞育为副主任。原来侍五组的人事业务移交给侍三处办理。这个组的职掌，改为主管外交行政。它同外交部发生了直接的联系。侍五组的工作人员也不多，只有一两个秘书。沈昌焕和邵毓麟都曾做过该组秘书。速记人员也是列在侍五组的编制之内。第六组（简称侍六组）主管谍报业务，1938年蒋介石撤退到武汉以后由于情报来源日趋复杂，而且蒋介石都要亲自掌握，所以蒋在其侍从室里成立侍六组，综核一切特工组织的情报业务。唐纵任组长。在建制上虽属侍二处，但同时也受侍一处主任的双重领导。在侍从室内部也是一个保密的单位。侍六组成义之初，从侍二组调去参谋卢集贤一人和缮写人员数人。后来增设秘书，担任研究和对外面特工组织的联系。邵毓麟和王芃生都曾在该组任过秘书，负责关于日本和朝鲜方面的谍报工作。邵毓麟还担任过当时在重庆的韩国流亡组织的联络工作。对日作战的日军行动的情报，仍由侍二组处理。中共和八路军活动的情报，则是侍六组业务的一部份。抗战后期调张国疆（军校九期、陆大十七期）任侍六组参谋，专管中共和八路军工作。
target_text: In 1940, the third division of the waiting room was set up, with Chen Gov as its director, and Xiao Xanyu as its deputy director. After the withdrawal of the service to Wuhan in 1938, the staff of the first group was handed over to the third division. The group became responsible for foreign affairs administration. It was also directly connected with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The staff of the fifth group was not numerous, with only one or two secretaries. Shen Chang-hwan and Xing were also appointed as secretaries of the group. The stenctuaries were also included in the composition of the group. The sixth group (Sentage Six) was set up to report operations within the group, after the withdrawal of Chiang Kai-shek to Wu-han in 1938, and, as a result of the growing complexity of the information sources and his personal mastership, Zhang was assigned six teams in the chamber, and the army secretary of the army was also responsible for research and operations of the Japanese army.
title: 國民政府軍事委員會委員長侍從室

source_text: 亚太太空合作组织（，缩写：）是由亚太地区联合国成员国组成的政府间国际组织，总部设于中国北京，现任秘书长余琦女士。该组织的宗旨是通过推动成员国之间空间科学、技术及其应用多边合作，并通过技术研发、应用、人才培训等事务在成员国之间开展互助，提高成员国空间能力，促进人类和平利用外层空间。“亚太空间合作组织”的前身为“亚太空间技术应用多边合作会议”，2005年10月28日八个成员国签署《亚太空间合作组织公约》标志该组织正式成立，截至2006年6月止共有9个签约国。根据其公约的规定，至少必须有5个国家签署该公约，并向东道国政府交存批准书或接受书后公约即生效。
target_text: The Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Organization (APSCO) is an intergovernmental international organization of Member States of the United Nations in the Asia-Pacific region, based in Beijing, China, and currently the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Ms. Yu Qi. Its purpose is to promote the peaceful uses of outer space by promoting multilateral cooperation in space science, technology and their applications among member States and by enhancing the space capabilities of member States through mutual assistance in technology research and development, applications and training of talent. The Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation was formerly the Asia-Pacific Multilateral Cooperation Conference on Space Technology Applications. On 28 October 2005, eight member States signed the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Organization Convention, which was formally established with nine signatories as of June 2006. In accordance with the provisions of the Convention, at least five States must sign the Convention and enter into force once they have deposited their instruments of ratification or acceptance with the host Government.
title: 亚太空间合作组织

source_text:
发展历程
1992年，中国、泰国和巴基斯坦共同倡议开展亚太地区空间技术与应用多边合作，并致力于推动区域间空间领域技术和具体合作空间项目，自此中国和亚太地区有关国家致力支持这个项目，亚太空间合作组织筹建工作获实质性进展。1994年于泰国曼谷举行亚太空间技术应用多边合作会议（Asia-Pacific Conference on Multilateral Cooperation in Space Technology and Applications）第一次会议。
target_text: Since 1992, when China, Thailand and Pakistan co-sponsored multilateral cooperation in space technology and applications in the Asia-Pacific region and worked to promote interregional space-related technology and specific cooperative space projects, China and interested countries in the Asia-Pacific region have been working to support the project and APSCO has made substantial progress in its establishment. The first meeting of the Asia-Pacific Multilateral Cooperation Conference on Space Technology Applications was held in Bangkok, Thailand, in 1994.
title: 亚太空间合作组织

source_text:
根据第一次会议的建议，成立亚太空间合作机构筹备委员会（Preparatory Committee for the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Mechanism），筹委会由来自10国政府高层官员组成，筹委会秘书处设于北京。筹委会成员国包括澳大利亚、孟加拉、中国、印尼、韩国、蒙古、巴基斯坦、俄罗斯、斯里兰卡和泰国。
2003年8月，组织秘书处先后在吉隆坡、曼谷分别举办了章程讨论预备会议和第一次章程起草组会议，并完成章程大部分条款的审议；会议同意将亚太空间合作组织总部设在中国。
2003年11月10日，章程起草组在北京举行第二次会议，来自中国、韩国、伊朗、马来西亚、菲律宾、俄罗斯、泰国等15个国家的政府官员，以及联合国有关机构的代表和观察员参加了会议。
2005年10月28日，孟加拉、印度尼西亚、伊朗、蒙古、巴基斯坦、秘鲁、泰国和中国8个国家的政府代表正式签署了《亚太空间合作组织公约》。
2006年6月1日，土耳其在北京签署《亚太空间合作组织公约》，成为第9个条约签署国。
target_text: On the basis of the recommendations of the first meeting, the Preparatory Committee for the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Agency (Preparatory Committee for the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Commission) was established in August 2003, consisting of high-level officials from 10 Governments, with its secretariat located in Beijing. The members of the Preparatory Committee included Australia, Bangladesh, China, Indonesia, Korea, Mongolia, Pakistan, Russia, Sri Lanka and Thailand. The secretariat of the Organization organized the preparatory meetings for the discussions on its statute in Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok and the first meeting of its constituent drafting group, which concluded the consideration of most of its provisions; the Conference agreed to the headquarters of the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Organization in China. On 10 November 2003, the second meeting of the drafting group was held in Beijing, with government officials from 15 countries, including China, the Republic of Korea, Iran, Malaysia, the Philippines, Russia and Thailand, as well as representatives of relevant United Nations agencies and observers.
title: 亚太空间合作组织

source_text:
亚太空间技术应用多边合作会议
亚太空间技术应用多边合作会议为亚太空间合作机构（亚太空间合作组织）的重要组成部分，前4年每年举行一次会议，之后每隔1年举行一次。
第1次会议，泰国，1994年1月
第2次会议，巴基斯坦，1995年4月
第3次会议，韩国，1996年5月
第4次会议，巴林，1997年12月
第5次会议，伊朗，1999年12月
第6次会议，中国，2001年9月
target_text: Asia-Pacific Multilateral Cooperation Conference on Space Technology Applications The Asia-Pacific Multilateral Cooperation Conference on Space Technology Applications is an important component of the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Agency (APSCO) and meets annually in the first four years and every other year thereafter: 1st meeting, Thailand, January 1994, 2nd meeting, Pakistan, April 1995, 3rd meeting, Korea, May 1996, 4th meeting, Bahrain, December 1997, 5th meeting, Iran, December 1999, 6th meeting, China, September 2001
title: 亚太空间合作组织

source_text: 1949年中華民國政府遷台後，教廷繼續承認其為代表中國之政府，並且在臺北恢復設置「教廷駐華公使館」（銜牌上為楷書正體字，並有拉丁文“Nuntiatura Apostolica in Sinis”——與當年在北京和南京時一樣），並於1959年升格為大使館。1971年中華民國退出聯合國後，教廷召回駐華大使，改為參贊代辦常駐臺北的教廷駐華大使館。（參贊代辦是當大使暫時離職、尚未指派或因特殊原因而無法向駐在國派駐大使的另一個最高外交代表職銜。） 雖因政治因素，梵蒂岡駐華職稱有所變化。
target_text: Following the departure of the Chinese government from China in 1949, the Holy See continued to recognize it as representing the Chinese government, and to re-establish the "Holy See Embassy in China" in Taipei (the official title of which is “Nuntiatura Apostolica in Sinis” in Latin – as it was in Beijing and Nanjing in 1949 – and to upgrade it to an embassy in 1959. After the withdrawal of China from the United Nations in 1971, the Holy See called back its ambassador to China and replaced him with the Permanent Ambassador of the Holy See in Taipei.
title: 中国天主教

source_text: 王室成員參加的年度活動包括：國會開幕大典、軍旗敬禮分列式、。歷史學家表示，伊莉莎白二世曾說，向有功績者授勳是她認為最重要的活動。查爾斯三世、安妮長公主與威廉王子都曾主持授勳儀式。王室成員會代表君主到其它國家參訪，也會代表君主出席大英聯邦會議，以促進外交關係。王室成員也會在外交、國協及發展事務部建議下到其它國家做國是訪問，活動包括歡迎外國政要、出席正式宴會等。記者認為王室是英國的「軟實力資產」。
target_text: Members of the Royal Council visit other countries on behalf of the monarch, and also represent the monarch at the Union of Great Britain meetings to promote diplomatic relations. Members of the Royal Family will visit other countries on the advice of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, State Affairs, and Development Affairs, for activities such as welcoming foreign dignitaries and attending official dinners.
title: 英國王室

source_text: 佛罗里达州因废票数量最大，民主党要求重新人工計票。美國最高法院判決停止了人工計票，使小布希贏得了選舉。尤里写在轮船上的船名“科诺”（Kono），是-{zh-hans:塞拉利昂共和国;zh-tw:獅子山共和国}-一个盛产血钻石的行政区。一如電影中提到原片名戰爭之王（），英文倒過來即是指軍閥（），成為一個雙關語。剧末的字幕说世界上最大的五个军火供应国是美国、俄罗斯、英国、法国和中国，也就是联合国安理会的五个常任理事国。剧情中利比里亚的独裁者总统曾赴纽约参加联合国的和平大会，亦有讽刺之意。不过这从来不是真的。據斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所统计，影片播出时军火交易量排名前五的是美俄德英以色列。2010年，美国在全球进行军火交易的国家中排名第一，交易额为86.41亿美元；俄罗斯排名第二，为60.39亿美元。2013年中国挤下英国第一次进入全球军火交易量前五，市场占有率5%。
target_text: The Supreme Court of the United States ruled to stop the artificial counting of votes, which enabled Little Bush to win the election. Yuri’s name on board the ship, Kono, was {zh-hans: Republic of Sierra Leone; zh-tw: Lion Hill Republic} – a district with blood diamonds. As in the film’s reference to the original war king, the English word turned out to be a double verse. The top five arms suppliers in the world were the United States, Russia, the United Kingdom, France, and China, the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council.
title: 軍火之王

source_text: 在大使馆，洛根威胁马可夫除非他肯帮助美国政府寻找格列登科，否则会把他的罪证交给俄罗斯的尤里·苏瓦洛夫总统，但是马可夫坚持他对格列登科一无所知。在从洛根口中确认马可夫在说谎之后，杰克决意只身闯入大使馆对马可夫逼供。杰克在大使馆内被俄罗斯人员追捕，这件事酿成了一场国际事件。CTU打算武力攻占大使馆捉拿马可夫，但是尚未获得美俄任何一方的批准。
target_text: At the embassy, Logan threatened Markov to hand over his guilt to Russia’s president, Yuri Suvalov, unless he was willing to help the US government find Grydenko, but Markov insisted that he knew nothing about Grydenko. After confirming that Markov was lying, Jack decided to break into the embassy to extract a confession from Markov. Jack was pursued by Russian agents inside the embassy, and this became an international incident. The CTU attempted to seize the embassy to capture Markov by force, but has not yet obtained the approval of either of the United States or Russia.

国界有人为和天然的两种，人为的例如界碑、界墙、运河等，天然的例如山脉河川等，但事实上即使有了天然国界，也还需要划定人为界线。用条约方式划定国界，要经过“定界”和“划界”两种手续，定界是概念上用条约文字来确定国界的走向和地位，绘制有国界线的地形详图，并作国界通过地点的简单记录等，划界是到现场实地去划定實體的界线，通常由缔约国共同组织进行的。对于根据有关国家的双边条约划定的国界，单方面不得加以改变。

source_text: 国际公约和决议明确规定，计划生育必须以自愿为前提。1968年联合国国际人权会议通过的《德黑蘭宣言》提出，“父母享有自由負責决定子女人數及其出生時距之基本人權”。1969年联合国大会通过的《社會進步及發展宣言》重申，“父母有自由並負責決定其子女人數及生育間距之專有權利”。中国1980年批准的《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》规定，男女“有相同的权利自由负责地决定子女人数和生育间隔”。联合国《国际人口与发展会议行动纲领》指出，计划生育“不应采用任何形式的强迫形式。……不应以指标或配额方式强迫推行计划生育。”
target_text: International conventions and resolutions clearly state that family planning must be voluntary. The German Declaration adopted by the United Nations International Conference on Human Rights in 1968 states that “parents have the basic human right to decide freely and responsibly on the number of their children and the spacing of their births.” The Declaration on Social Progress and Development, adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1969, reaffirms that “parents have the exclusive right to decide freely and responsibly on the number and spacing of their children.” The Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, ratified by China in 1980, stipulates that men and women “shall have the same right to decide freely and responsibly on the number and spacing of their children”. The Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development states that family planning “shall not take any form of coercion.

1840年－1870年歐洲人口販子將廈門、香港等地70多萬中國勞工“賣豬仔”到南美洲當苦力。同一時期約有200多萬華人到美國和加拿大“淘金”。

1901年8月31日，《辛丑条约》签订。清政府与八国联军议和期间，董福祥被八国指控为“首凶”，要求清政府将其处死。李鸿章、袁世凯弹劾董福祥，也请求将其处死。慈禧因董福祥對回軍仍有很大影響力，擔心殺之會引起軍變，最终以革职留任、永不叙用论处。董对此一决定非常不满，一度计划自行招募军队赴山西继续战斗。特別對於榮祿繼續執大政而自己則被貶感到憤恨，特別寫信責備並威脅榮祿“戊戌八月，公有非常之舉。七月二十日電，命祥統所部入京師，實衛公也。拳民之變，屢奉鈞諭，撫囑李來中，命攻使館。祥以茲事體大，猶尚遲疑，以公驅策，敢不承命。疊承面諭，圍攻使館，不妨開炮，祥猶以殺使臣為疑。公謂戮力攘夷，禍福同之。祥一武夫，本無知識，恃公在上，故效犬馬之奔走耳。今公巍然執政，而祥被罪，竊大惑焉。夫祥之於公，力不可謂不盡矣。公行非常之事，祥犯義以從之。公撫拳民，祥因而用之。公欲攻使館，祥彌月血戰，今獨歸罪於祥。麾下士卒解散，咸不甘心，多有議公反覆者。祥惟知報國，已拼一死，而將士憤怨，恐不足以鎮之，不敢不告”慈禧恐其破坏和谈，令光绪帝赐其手书“他日闻鼙鼓思将帅，舍尔其谁属哉”，要求他守时待变，以图再举，董方才回宁夏金积堡隐居。

现代战略轰炸机的定义，根据1990年6月1日签署的苏美《第一阶段削减进攻性武器条约》，满足下述2种条件之一即被视为“战略轰炸机”：
航程大于8000公里。对于空射导弹而言，航程是指标准设计模式下飞行至燃料耗尽条件下可以达到的最大地表弧长。对于弹道导弹而言，航程是发射点与再入器落点之间的飞行轨迹所投射在地表的弧长。对于飞机而言，航程是搭载7500公斤军械不进行空中加油最经济模式可以飞行的最大距离，着陆后内油低于燃料箱最大容量5%。
搭载“长射程空射核战斗部巡航导弹”。其中，射程即上一条的空射导弹的航程，并达到600公里。
据此，8个系列轰炸机被称为战略轰炸机：
美国：B-1B，B-2A，B-52G/H，B-21(研製中)
苏联：Tu-95系列，Tu-160，Tu-22M
中国：轰-6，轰-20(研製中)
对于可搭载600公斤级核战斗部反舰导弹的Tu-16和Tu-22M3系列，停止使用并销毁核武装，不列为战略轰炸机。B-1B也根据条约拆解了AGM-86B导弹发射装置，不再列入战略轰炸机队伍。
target_text: The definition of a modern strategic bomber, according to the Su-American Treaty on the Reduction of Offensive Arms, signed on 1 June 1990, is considered to be a “strategic bomber” if one of the following two conditions is met: the range is greater than 8,000 km. For air-launched missiles, the range is the maximum surface arc length that can be achieved under standard design mode flights to fuel depletion conditions. For ballistic missiles, the range is the arc length that is projected between the launch point and the re-entry point. For aircraft, the range is the maximum distance from the most economical mode of air refuelling without 7,500 kg of ordnance, and after landing the oil is less than 5 per cent of the maximum capacity of the fuel tank.

2000年，获得颁发的。
target_text: The award was awarded in May 1995 by the World Press Association, the “Foundation of the Press Award”, in November 1995 by the International Women's Media Foundation, and in May 1997 by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), the first United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Guillermo Cano World Prize for Freedom of the Press, in 2000.
title: 高瑜

source_text: 1941年6月苏德战争爆发后，納粹德军一度处于优势，逼近莫斯科城下。盛世才认为，现在苏德战争在苏联境内举行，究竟什么时候结束，难以预测；即使苏联获胜，恐怕也不能如过去很有力量地援助新疆，转而投靠国民政府。1942年6月27日，斯大林派苏联副外交人民委员捷卡諾佐夫携带莫洛托夫给盛世才的信来到迪化，试图阻止盛世才。虽然莫洛托夫表示愿意作出让步，但是盛世才不为所动。1942年10月5日，盛世才通过苏联驻新疆总领事普式庚，向苏联政府递交了一份备忘录，要求苏联政府从新疆撤走除外交人员以外的全部人员，其中包括蘇軍紅八團，且须在三个月内撤离。斯大林起初没有考虑撤军，但是1943年4月，鉴于国民政府任命的各部官员已到新疆任职，为了避免发生直接冲突，斯大林答应撤退驻新疆的苏军及顾问。6月，中央军进驻哈密。斯大林知道新疆的局势已不可挽回，于是下令撤军。盛世才与苏联的关系，就此彻底终结。1943年，盛世才加入国民党，并表示“矢志拥护中央，尽忠党国，绝对服从领袖”。
target_text: After the outbreak of the Sudeten war in June 1941, the Nazi German army was once in a state of stifling near the city of Moscow. While the Sudeten war is now taking place within the Soviet Union, it is difficult to predict when it will end; even if the Soviet Union succeeds, it will not be as powerful as it was in the past to assist the Xinjiang and turn to the national government. On 27 June 1942, Stalin’s Deputy Soviet Diplomatic People’s Commissioner, Tecanotsov, arrived with Morotov’s letter to the Seng Shifu and tried to stop the Seng Dynasty. In April 1943, the leader, given the willingness of the various ministries appointed by the National Government to make concessions, did not move.
title: 東突厥斯坦共和國

source_text: 尽管如此，第八战区司令长官朱绍良仍然十分担心迪化将不保，在战事最危急的时候，朱绍良曾经八小时内给蒋介石连发三份急电“……内乏可用之兵，外无一旅之援……迪化危在旦夕，卑职惟有以身殉职，与国土共存亡，上报党国……恳请钧座速筹良策”，在这种情况下，国民政府顺应抗战胜利后全国和谈的潮流，开始通过苏联的斡旋与三区政府进行和谈。1945年7月5日，蒋介石在一次关于中苏会谈的讨论会上提出：“苏联政府如果能保证中国对东北和新疆的领土和行政主权，对中共和新疆变乱不再作任何支援，中国政府才考虑苏联有关外蒙的要求”。会议后，蒋介石向在莫斯科与苏联谈判的宋子文连发两道密电，指示可以“允许外蒙战后独立”，但苏联必须承认“东北领土主权和行政之完整，对中共及新疆变乱不再做任何支援”。宋子文根据蒋介石的电令，向斯大林提出，苏联政府如果能在帮助中国评定“新疆变乱”等问题上作出承诺，中国政府可以在外蒙问题上作出让步。斯大林表示，无论延安、新疆均服从蒋委员长的领导，苏联只支持国民政府，可以根据中国政府的要求发表声明，并答应宋子文关于制止从苏联往新疆“偷运”武器的要求。
target_text: In spite of this, the Commander of the eighth war zone, Chushoyan, remains very concerned about the danger of dedification, and in this case, the national government, in response to the current state of national peace talks following the defeat of the war, began to make peace with the three regional governments through Soviet good offices. source_text: 中華民國駐日代表團，為1947年4月19日成立之中華民國政府派駐日本的外交代表團。屬於盟國管制日本委員會體系的該代表團，負責協助美國與盟軍佔領日本總司令部兩單位之中國駐日軍事與外交事務，最早名為盟國對日委員會中國代表團，後使用中國駐日代表團之名至1948年。該代表團設置團長、副團長、僑務處、第一組至第四組，與專門委員等機關職務。1947年4月19日－1949年3月5日之團長為商震，1949年3月6日之後由朱世明擔任。
target_text: The Chinese People’s Republic of China’s Democratic People’s Republic of China is represented by the Chinese People’s Republic of China’s People’s Republic of China on 19 April 1947, the Chinese Government’s diplomatic delegation to Japan. This group, which is part of the League’s Japan Control Committee, is responsible for assisting the United States and allied forces in the military and foreign affairs of Japan, which occupy two parts of Japan’s General Command, the first being the Chinese delegation to the League’s Japan-to-Japan Committee, and then using the name of China’s General People’s Party until 1948.
title: 中華民國駐日代表團

source_text: 姜瑜（），女，北京人，中华人民共和国职业外交官。曾任中华人民共和国外交部驻香港特別行政区特派员公署副特派员、外交部发言人、中华人民共和国驻阿尔巴尼亚大使和中华人民共和国驻罗马尼亚大使，是中国外交部自1983年建立发言人制度以来的第23位发言人，也是第4位女发言人。
target_text: Jiang Yoo, a woman from Beijing, and a professional diplomat from the People’s Republic of China. He has served as Deputy Commissioner of the Office of the Special Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, as spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, as Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Albania and as Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Romania.
title: 姜瑜

source_text:
生平
姜瑜出生于北京。1982年，姜瑜考入北京外交学院英语专业。1987年，她大学毕业，被分配到北京外交人员服务局，一家专为外国驻华机构提供服务的政府单位。在这里工作近九年之后，姜瑜在1991年进入外交部新闻司工作，而她以后的外交工作几乎都在和新闻、外国记者打交道。
target_text: She graduated from the University in 1987 and was assigned to the Beijing Diplomatic Service, a government unit dedicated to servicing foreign agencies in China. After almost nine years of working here, Jiang Yoon joined the Information Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1991, and her subsequent diplomatic work was almost exclusively with news and foreign journalists.
title: 姜瑜

source_text: 1992年，姜瑜赴常驻联合国代表团任职。1995年，她又回到外交部新闻司，并历任新闻司三等秘书、副处长、处长。2000年，专为驻华记者提供相关服务的外国记者新闻中心成立，姜瑜被任命为这家机构的首任主任。2002年，她又被派到外交部驻港公署，担任参赞。2005年，又调任外交部新闻司参赞。2006年初，升任新闻司副司长。2006年6月13日，姜瑜首次以中华人民共和国外交部发言人的身份，出席例行记者招待会。
target_text: In 1992, Kang Yoon served at the Permanent Mission to the United Nations. In 1995, she returned to the Department of Information of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, where she served as Third Secretary, Deputy Director and Head of the Department of Information. In 2000, the Information Centre for Foreign Journalists, which serves journalists in China, was established and Kang Yo was appointed as its first director. In 2002, she was assigned to the Hong Kong Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as Counsellor. In 2005, she was appointed Counsellor to the Department of Information of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In early 2006, she was promoted to the post of Deputy Director of the Department of Public Information.
title: 姜瑜

source_text: 2012年4月，出任外交部驻香港特别行政区特派员公署副特派员。2015年3月，出任中华人民共和国驻阿尔巴尼亚大使。。2019年3月，出任中华人民共和国驻罗马尼亚大使。2022年3月，自驻罗马尼亚大使离任。2022年9月，出任中华人民共和国外交部中国—中东欧国家合作事务特别代表。
target_text: In April 2012, he served as Deputy Special Representative of the Department of Foreign Affairs to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. In March 2022, he left Romania. In September 2022, he served as Special Representative of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People ' s Republic of China for China-Central and Eastern Europe Cooperation.
title: 姜瑜
