source_text: 库克群岛与许多国家保持着外交关系，同时也是许多国际组织的成员国之一。由于库克群岛是新西兰的联系邦，所以新西兰可以根据库克群岛的“授权[…]而协助库克群岛”在外交事务中行事； 尽管库克群岛依然承担条约义务，但是其并未放弃“作为一个主权独立的国家与国际社会互动”。
target_text: The Cook Islands maintains diplomatic relations with a number of States and is also a member of many international organizations. Since the Cook Islands is an associated state with New Zealand, New Zealand can assist the Cook Islands in its foreign affairs under its “authorization [...]” of the Cook Islands; Despite its treaty obligations, the Cook Islands has not relinquished its “interacting with the international community as a sovereign and independent State”.
title: 庫克群島外交

source_text:
外交历史
早在1980年代，库克群岛就已经成为联合国旗下多个专门机构的成员国。1984年，加入世界卫生组织；1985年，加入粮食及农业组织和教科文组织；1986年，加入国际民用航空组织。《联合国各机关惯例汇编》记录道，新西兰在1988年就已经宣布“其未来对国际协定的参与将不再延伸到库克群岛……”。 1991年，库克群岛成为环境与发展会议筹备委员会以及气候变化框架公约政府间谈判委员会的正式成员。《惯例汇编》将这描述为“进一步证明国际社会已接受库克群岛为国际法下的‘国家’”。 最终，联合国秘书处在1992年“承认库克群岛拥有全部条约的制订能力”； 秘书长以多边条约保存人的身份决定库克群岛可以参加对“所有国家”开放的条约。
target_text: In 1991, the Cook Islands became a full member of the Preparatory Committee for the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development and the Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee for the Framework Convention on Climate Change. This was described in the Repertory of Practice as “a further demonstration of the acceptance by the international community of the Cook Islands as a `State' under international law.” Finally, in 1992, the United Nations Secretariat “recognizes that the Cook Islands has full treaty-making capacity”;
title: 庫克群島外交

source_text:
外交关系
截至2023年9月，库克群岛已经与59个国家建立了外交关系。2000年，库克群岛政府签署了与欧洲联盟和非洲、加勒比和太平洋国家集团之间的《》。签署该协议后，库克群岛政府在布鲁塞尔设立了欧盟代表处。2002年，该代表处升级为欧盟认证的正式外交使团。该使团的成立标志着库克群岛国际关系的重要发展，是库克群岛在太平洋国家以外设立的第一个正式外交使团。
target_text: By September 2023, the Cook Islands had established diplomatic relations with 59 countries. In 2000, the Government of the Cook Islands signed the Agreement with the European Union and the African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States. Following the signing of the Agreement, the Government of the Cook Islands established the European Union Representation Office in Brussels. In 2002, the Office was upgraded to a full European Union accredited diplomatic mission. The establishment of the mission marked an important development in the Cook Islands ' international relations and was the first official diplomatic mission established by the Cook Islands outside the Pacific.
title: 庫克群島外交

source_text:
1937年以后的上海
上海公共租界是在南京条约后形成的，警察、行政和护照管理都由外国自治机构执行。1937年淞沪会战以后，该市被日本占领，而日军和中国维新政府在该区域内没有建立护照制度。上海港是世界上唯一一个既不需要签证也不需要护照就允许进入的地方。根据中国和欧洲国家之间的不平等条约，签证只在订票离开欧洲时才是必需的。
target_text: Shanghai, after 1937, the Shanghai public rental community was formed after the Nanjing Treaty, where police, administration, and passport administration were administered by foreign self-government agencies. After the 1937 war, the city was occupied by Japan, while the Japanese Army and the new Chinese government did not have a passport system in the region.
title: 上海隔都

source_text: 早在第二次世界大戰爆發前，法國科學家亨利·貝克勒、皮埃爾·居禮以及瑪麗·居禮便針對鈾的放射能進行詳細研究。第二次世界大戰爆發後法國加速展開核武器的研究計劃，但德國佔領法國後這批研究人員紛紛流亡海外，直到戰爭結束後重新開始研究相關技術的商業應用。1948年法國已經擁有核反應爐，隔年興建了可以生產鈽元素的反應爐，不過一開始法國政府並沒有計劃研發自己的核武器，而是希望能夠與美國就核武器使用上進行合作，直到1952年才開始大量興建核電工程並開展原子核物理學的研究。1954年法越戰爭戰敗和1956年第二次中東戰爭結束後，法國軍方高層認為發展可獨自運用的核武器才能解決與蘇聯和其他自由世界國家的緊張外交關係，讓法國繼續保持與英國同等的大國地位。原本法蘭西第四共和國計劃與義大利和德國締結戰略軍事同盟以維持自己的勢力，但是夏爾·戴高樂在1950年代到1960年代期間主張法國自行推動核武器發展，希望藉此能讓法國不須捲入北大西洋公約組織所可能必須參與的軍事衝突，在北約組織的核武器政策外擁有獨自的嚇阻能力，進而擴展自身於冷戰時期的外交以及軍事實力。
target_text: As early as 1948, French scientists Henry Beckler, Pierre Cuill, and Mary Gilley began detailed research on radioactivity in the wake of the Second World War. Instead of planning to develop their own nuclear weapons, France accelerated research on nuclear weapons in the wake of the Second World War, but after Germany occupied France, the group of researchers went into exile until the end of the Second World War. After the fall of the 1954 War and the end of the Second Middle East War in 1956, France’s military elite argued that the development of nuclear weapons that could be used on their own would resolve the tension with Soviet and other liberal countries, but instead hoped to cooperate with the United States on the use of nuclear weapons until 1952, when France began research on nuclear power and atomic physics began.
title: 核武器擁有國列表

source_text: 朝鮮民主主義人民共和國於1974年加入國際原子能總署，1985年簽署《不擴散核武器條約》，接受國際原子能總署監督以及多次核武器是否發展之核查。美國從1970年代開始關注朝鮮的核武器發展，1988年下半年美國正式對國際宣稱朝鮮可能正在開發核武器的訊息，隨即引起朝鮮政府的強烈反應和國際社會的廣泛關注。自1989年開始，朝鮮陸續和韓國、日本、美國、俄羅斯和中華人民共和國等進行有關核武器撤除之談判。1993年，朝鮮首次威脅要退出《不擴散核武器條約》。1994年5月30日，聯合國安全理事會提出對朝鮮的核武器發展計劃進行調查並實施制裁。1994年6月美國總統吉米·卡特前往平壤協調後，朝鮮與美國達成限制核武器發展的《朝核問題框架協定》，其中朝鮮必須凍結所有核計劃的進行，並在所有核設施上加裝監控系統且禁止一切相關計劃的重新展開，藉此換取與美國之間的外交互動關係得以正常化，同時美國、日本和韓國應滿足朝鮮將原本石墨慢化核反應爐替換為輕水反應爐，以能夠繼續維持朝鮮自身對於核子動力能源的要求。之後美國指責朝鮮秘密進行濃縮鈾的提煉計劃，並且計劃切斷能源等補助，直到2002年8月有關輕水核反應爐的建設才於平壤奠基準備開工。2002年10月，美國透過偵察機構掌握了朝鮮仍在秘密研製核武器的證據，對朝鮮政府所發布的核計劃提出異議。
target_text: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea joined the International Atomic Energy Agency in 1974, signed the Treaty on the Non-Expansion of Nuclear Weapons in 1985 to be monitored by the International Atomic Energy Agency and verified on many occasions by the development of nuclear weapons. In 1993, the United States began to focus on the development of nuclear weapons in North Korea, and, in the second half of 1988, the United States officially announced that the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea might be developing nuclear weapons, following a strong response from the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea in 1974 and widespread attention from the international community. Since 1989, negotiations on the elimination of nuclear weapons have begun with the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, Japan, the United States, the Russian Federation, and the Republic of China, among others. In 1993, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea threatened to withdraw from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons.
title: 核武器擁有國列表

source_text: 朝鮮嘗試開發能夠於實際戰場上應用的核武器計劃以及不斷試射彈道飛彈，也導致自身與韓國、美國和日本之間的外交關係漸趨緊張；聯合國於2009年6月12日通過執行針對平壤的制裁措施《聯合國安理會1874號決議》，加強對朝鮮的經濟制裁並授權各國可攔檢運往朝鮮的可疑船隻與貨物。2012年4月，朝鮮在憲法修正案中提及自身為擁有核武器的國家。瑞典研究核輻射的科學家拉斯·艾瑞克·德吉（Lars-Erik De Geer）聲稱在2010年4月中旬和5月11日時，朝鮮極有可能進行2次相當於50噸至200噸的核試驗，但韓國和美國政府認為這說法缺乏可以驗證的地震數據。
target_text: On June 12, 2009, the United Nations adopted resolution 1874 of the United Nations Security Council, which imposed sanctions on Pyongyang, reinforcing economic sanctions against the Democratic People ' s Republic of Korea and authorizing countries to intercept suspicious ships and cargo destined for the Democratic People ' s Republic of Korea. In April 2012, the Democratic People ' s Republic of Korea referred to itself as a country with nuclear weapons in the Constitutional amendment. Lars-Erik De Geer, a Swedish scientist working on nuclear radiation, claimed that it was possible to conduct two nuclear tests in the North on mid-April and 11 May 2010 that would amount to between 50 and 200 tons, but the Korean and United States governments argued that the law lacked supporting seismic data.
title: 核武器擁有國列表

source_text: 新思维（）是苏联末任最高领导人，苏共中央总书记戈尔巴乔夫在1987年与经济改革一道提出的在政治、经济、军事、外交领域推行的一系列改革思想及新政策。提倡“尊重人权”、“公开性”和“多元化”，建设“人道的民主的社会主义”，并采取军事上的收缩政策，如签署《中程导弹条约》和从阿富汗撤军等。之後蘇聯進行了一系列政治及經濟改革，最終促成東歐劇變和苏联解体。
target_text: New thinking () was the last-ever leader of the Soviet Union, and the Central Secretary-General of the Soviet Union, Gorbachev, introduced in 1987, together with economic reforms, a series of reform ideas and new policies in the political, economic, military, and diplomatic fields. The promotion of “respect for human rights”, “openness” and “multiversity”, the building of “humanist democracy and socialism” and the adoption of a policy of military contraction, such as the signing of the Intermediate-Range Missile Treaty and the withdrawal of troops from Afghanistan, were followed by a series of political and economic reforms in the Soviet Union, which eventually led to the transformation of the Eastern Europe and the disintegration of the Soviet Union.
title: 新思维 (苏联)

source_text: 国际刑事法院（，常縮寫作：或；）是一个位于荷兰海牙的政府间组织和国际法庭。它是第一个也是唯一一个有管辖权起诉犯有灭绝种族罪、危害人类罪、战争罪和侵略罪的个人的常设国际法院。国际刑事法院不同于国际法院，国际法院是联合国审理国家间争端的机构。
target_text: It is the first and only Permanent International Court of Justice with jurisdiction to prosecute individuals for genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes and crimes of aggression. Unlike the International Court of Justice, which is the United Nations forum for inter-State disputes.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 国际刑事法院根据多边《罗马公约》于2002年成立，许多观察家认为它是走向正义的重要一步，也是国际法和人权的创新。然而，它面临着来自政府和民间社会团体的一些批评，包括对其管辖权的反对，对偏见、欧洲中心主义和种族主义的指控，对其案件选择和审判程序的公平性的质疑，以及对其有效性的怀疑。
target_text: The International Criminal Court, established in 2002 under the multilateral Rome Convention, was considered by many observers to be an important step towards justice and an innovation in international law and human rights. However, it faced criticism from Governments and civil society groups, including opposition to its jurisdiction, accusations of prejudice, European centristism and racism, doubts about the fairness of its case selection and trial procedures, and doubts about its effectiveness.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text:
背景
责任委员会在第一次世界大战后的1919年巴黎和会上首次提议设立一个国际法庭，对被控犯有国际罪行的政治领导人进行审判。 1937年在国际联盟主持下于日内瓦举行的一次会议再次讨论了这一问题，会议达成了第一项公约，规定设立一个常设国际法院审理国际恐怖主义行为。该公约由13个国家签署，但没有一个国家批准，该公约也从未生效。
target_text: The responsibility committee first proposed the establishment of an international tribunal to try political leaders accused of international crimes at the Paris Conference of 1919 after the First World War, and again discussed the issue at a conference held in Geneva in 1937 under the auspices of the League of Nations, which resulted in the first convention providing for the establishment of a permanent International Court of Justice to deal with acts of international terrorism, which was signed by 13 States but not ratified by one, and which has never entered into force.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 第二次世界大战后，盟国成立了两个特设法庭，起诉被指控犯有战争罪的轴心国领导人。位于纽伦堡的国际军事法庭起诉了德国领导人，而位于东京的远东国际军事法庭则起诉了日本领导人。1948年，联合国大会首次认识到需要一个常设国际法院来处理二战后起诉的暴行。应大会的要求，国际法委员会在20世纪50年代初起草了两项规约，但在冷战期间被搁置，这使得建立国际刑事法院在政治上不切实际。
target_text: In 1948, the United Nations General Assembly first recognized the need for a permanent international court to deal with post-Second World War atrocities. At the request of the General Assembly, the International Law Commission drafted two statutes in the early 1950s, but was put on hold during the cold war, making the establishment of an international criminal court politically impractical.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 本杰明· B·佛罗伦斯是二战后纳粹战争罪行的调查员，也是纽伦堡审判中美国陆军的首席检察官，他成为建立国际法治和国际刑事法院的积极倡导者。在1975年出版的《定义国际侵略：寻求世界和平》一书中，他主张建立这样一个法庭。另一位主要支持者是出生于德国的国际法教授Robert Kurt Woetzel，他于1970年与人合著了《走向可行的国际刑事法院》，并于1971年创建了建立国际刑事法院基金会。
target_text: Benjamin B. Florence, an investigator of Nazi war crimes after World War II and chief prosecutor of the United States Army in the Nuremberg trial, was an active advocate for the establishment of the international rule of law and the International Criminal Court. In the book Defining International Aggression: Towards World Peace, published in 1975, he advocated the establishment of such a tribunal. Another major supporter was Robert Kurt Woetzel, a German-born professor of international law, who in 1970 co-authored the “Towards a viable International Criminal Court” and created the Foundation for the Establishment of the International Criminal Court in 1971.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 1994年，国际法委员会向大会提交了国际刑事法院规约的最后草案，并建议召开一次会议，谈判一项作为国际刑事法院的规约的条约。为了审议规约草案中的主要实质性问题，大会设立了设立国际刑事法院特设委员会，该委员会于1995年举行了两次会议。大会在审议了委员会的报告后，设立了国际刑事法院筹备委员会，以编写一份综合案文草案。
target_text: In 1994, the International Law Commission submitted to the General Assembly the final draft of the Statute of the International Criminal Court and recommended the convening of a conference to negotiate a treaty as the Statute of the International Criminal Court. In order to consider the main substantive issues in the draft Statute, the Assembly established the Ad Hoc Committee on the Establishment of an International Criminal Court, which met twice in 1995 and, having considered the report of the Commission, established the Preparatory Commission for the International Criminal Court to prepare a consolidated draft text.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 最后，大会于1998年6月在罗马召开了一次会议，目的是最后确定作为法院规约的条约。1998年7月17日，《国际刑事法院罗马规约》以120票对7票获得通过，21个国家弃权。投票反对该条约的七个国家是中国、伊拉克、以色列、利比亚、卡塔尔、美国和也门。以色列对该条约的反对源于将“将人口转移到被占领土的行动”列入战争罪清单。
target_text: Finally, the General Assembly convened a meeting in Rome in June 1998 to finalize the treaty as the Statute of the Court. On 17 July 1998, the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court was adopted by 120 votes to 7, with 21 abstentions. The seven countries that voted against the Treaty were China, Iraq, Israel, Libya, Qatar, the United States and Yemen. Israel's opposition to the Treaty stems from the inclusion of “actions to transfer populations to occupied territories” in the list of war crimes.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text:
行动
国际刑事法院于2002年7月1日《罗马规约》生效后开始运作，这是一项多边条约，是国际刑事法院的章程和管理文件。成为《罗马规约》缔约国的国家成为国际刑事法院的成员，在管理法院的缔约国大会任职。截至2022年3月，国际刑事法院共有123个成员国；42个国家既没有签署也没有成为《罗马规约》的缔约国。
target_text: The International Criminal Court became operational on 1 July 2002 following the entry into force of the Rome Statute, a multilateral treaty that is the statute and administrative instrument of the International Criminal Court. States that are parties to the Rome Statute become members of the International Criminal Court and serve in the Assembly of States Parties to the Court. As of March 2022, the Court had 123 member States; 42 States had neither signed nor become parties to the Rome Statute.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text:
缔约国
截至2019年11月，123个国家是《法院规约》的缔约国，包括南美洲所有国家、几乎整个欧洲、大洋洲大部分地区和大约一半的非洲。布隆迪和菲律宾是成员国，但后来分别于2017年10月27日和2019年3月17日退出。另有31个国家签署但未批准《罗马规约》。条约法要求这些国家在宣布不打算成为条约缔约国之前，不得采取“违背条约目的和宗旨的行为”。四个签署国——以色列、2008年8月26日的苏丹、2002年5月6日的美国和2016年11月30日的俄罗斯——已通知联合国秘书长，它们不再打算成为缔约国，因此，它们签署《规约》不承担任何法律义务。另有四十一个国家[36]既没有签署也没有加入《罗马规约》。其中一些国家，包括中国和印度，对法院持批评态度。乌克兰是一个未批准的签署国，自2013年起接受了法院的管辖权。
target_text: As of November 2019, 123 States were parties to the Statute of the Court, including all South American States, almost all of Europe, most of Oceania, and about half of Africa. Burundi and the Philippines were member States, but subsequently withdrew on 27 October 2017 and 17 March 2019, respectively. Another 31 States signed but not ratified the Rome Statute. The law of treaties required them not to engage in “acts contrary to the object and purpose of the Treaty” until they declared that they did not intend to become parties to the Treaty. The four signatories — Israel, Sudan on 26 August 2008, the United States on 6 May 2002 and Russia on 30 November 2016 — had informed the Secretary-General of the United Nations that they no longer intended to become parties and therefore had signed the Statute without any legal obligation. Forty-one States [36] had neither signed nor acceded to the Rome Statute. Some of them, including China and India, were critical of the Court.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 经修正的《规约》将侵略罪定义为“能够有效控制或指挥一国政治或军事行动的人策划、准备、发动或执行侵略行为，其性质、严重性和规模明显违反《联合国宪章》。“《规约》将“侵略行为”定义为“一国对另一国的主权、领土完整或政治独立使用武力，或以任何其他不符合《联合国宪章》的方式使用武力。“该条还列出了七项侵略行为，这些行为与联合国大会1974年第3314号决议中的行为相同，包括一国对另一国实施的下列行为：
target_text: The amended Statute defines the crime of aggression as “the planning, preparation, initiation or execution of an act of aggression by a person who has effective control or direction over the political or military action of a State, the nature, gravity and scale of which are clearly contrary to the Charter of the United Nations.” “Aggression” is defined in the Statute as “the use of force by a State against the sovereignty, territorial integrity or political independence of another State, or in any other manner inconsistent with the Charter of the United Nations.” It also lists seven acts of aggression which are identical to those of the United Nations General Assembly in resolution 3314 of 1974, including the following acts committed by one State against another:
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text:
非《罗马公约》缔约国的合作
国际法的原则之一是，未经第三国同意，条约不得为其规定义务或权利，1969年《维也纳条约法公约》也规定了这一点。根据《国际刑事法院罗马规约》的设想，非缔约国与国际刑事法院的合作属于自愿性质。未加入《罗马规约》的国家在某些情况下可能仍有义务与国际刑事法院合作。当联合国安理会将案件提交国际刑事法院时，所有联合国成员国都有义务合作，因为其决定对所有成员国都具有约束力。此外，有义务尊重和确保尊重国际人道主义法，这源于《日内瓦四公约》和《第一附加议定书》，反映了国际人道主义法律的绝对性质。
target_text: One of the principles of international law is that treaties may not impose obligations or rights on third States without their consent, as also provided for in the 1969 Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties. As envisaged in the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, cooperation between non-States parties and the International Criminal Court is voluntary. States that are not parties to the Rome Statute may still be obliged to cooperate with the International Criminal Court in certain circumstances. When the United Nations Security Council refers cases to the International Criminal Court, all States Members of the United Nations have an obligation to cooperate, since their decisions are binding on all States. Moreover, there is an obligation to respect and ensure respect for international humanitarian law, which derives from the Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocol I and reflects the absolute nature of international humanitarian law.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 有时有人认为，为了允许权力从滥用权力的政权和平移交，大赦是必要的。国际刑事法院剥夺了各国特赦侵犯人权者的权利，这可能会使谈判结束冲突和向民主过渡变得更加困难。例如，对上帝抵抗军四名领导人的逮捕令尚未执行，一些人认为这是结束乌干达叛乱的障碍。捷克政治家Marek Benda认为，“在我们看来，国际刑事法院作为一种威慑，只意味着最糟糕的独裁者将不惜一切代价试图保留权力”。联合国和红十字国际委员会坚持认为，赦免被控犯有战争罪和其他严重罪行的人违反了国际法。
target_text: For example, the arrest warrants for four leaders of the Lord's Resistance Army (LRA) have not yet been executed, which some consider to be an obstacle to ending the Ugandan rebellion. According to Czech statesman Marek Benda, “the ICC, in our view, as a deterrent, only means that the worst dictators will try to retain power at any cost.” The United Nations and the International Committee of the Red Cross maintain that amnesties for those accused of war crimes and other serious crimes are contrary to international law.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text:
联合国
与国际法院不同，国际刑事法院在法律上独立于联合国。《罗马规约》赋予联合国安全理事会某些权力，限制了其职能独立性。第13条允许安全理事会将本不属于法院管辖范围的局势提交法院处理（正如它在达尔富尔和利比亚局势中所做的那样，法院本不可能起诉这些局势，因为苏丹和利比亚都不是缔约国）。第16条允许安全理事会要求法院推迟12个月对案件进行调查。安全理事会可以无限期延长这种延期。这种安排给国际刑事法院带来了联合国机构固有的一些优势，例如使用安理会的强制执行权，但也造成了被安理会政治争议玷污的风险。
target_text: Unlike the International Court of Justice, the International Criminal Court is legally independent from the United Nations. The Rome Statute confers certain powers on the United Nations Security Council, limiting its functional independence. Article 13 allows the Security Council to refer to the Court situations that are not otherwise within the jurisdiction of the Court (as it has done in the situations of Darfur and Libya, where the Court could not have prosecuted those situations, since neither the Sudan nor Libya are parties). Article 16 allows the Security Council to request the Court to postpone the investigation of a case for 12 months. The Security Council may extend such an extension indefinitely. Such an arrangement creates certain advantages inherent to the organs of the United Nations, such as the use of the Council ' s enforcement powers, but also creates the risk of being tarnished by the Council ' s political controversy.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text:
法院在许多不同领域与联合国合作，包括信息交流和后勤支持。法院每年向联合国报告其活动，缔约国大会的一些会议在联合国设施举行。国际刑事法院和联合国之间的关系受《国际刑事法院与联合国关系协定》管辖。非政府组织
在20世纪70年代和80年代，国际人权和人道主义非政府组织开始以指数级的速度激增。与此同时，寻找惩罚国际罪行的方法的努力从法律专家的专属责任转向了与国际人权行动主义共同承担。
target_text: The Court cooperates with the United Nations in many different areas, including information exchange and logistical support. The Court reports annually to the United Nations on its activities, and some meetings of the Assembly of States Parties are held at United Nations facilities. The relationship between the International Criminal Court and the United Nations is governed by the Relationship Agreement between the International Criminal Court and the United Nations.
title: 国际刑事法院

source_text: 有许多非政府组织正在处理与国际刑事法院有关的各种问题。非政府组织国际刑事法院联盟是非政府组织在与国际刑事法院有关的类似目标上相互协调的一个保护伞。中金会在150个国家拥有2500个成员组织。最初的指导委员会包括来自世界联邦党人运动、国际法学家委员会、大赦国际、人权律师委员会、人权观察、议员促进全球行动和没有正义就没有和平的代表。如今，与国际刑事法院合作的许多非政府组织都是中金公司的成员。这些组织的背景各不相同，既有人权观察和大赦国际等主要国际非政府组织，也有专注于和平与正义使命的规模较小、更具地方性的组织。许多国家与各国密切合作，如国际刑法网络，该网络由海牙市政府以及荷兰国防部和外交部创建，主要由其资助。CICC还声称，一些组织本身就是联合会，如国际人权联盟联合会（FIDH）。

source_text: 尽管国际刑事法院否认了针对非洲领导人的指控，并声称无论受害者身在何处，都会为他们挺身而出，但肯尼亚并不是唯一一个批评国际刑事法院的国家。苏丹总统奥马尔·巴希尔访问了肯尼亚、南非、中国、尼日利亚、沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、卡塔尔和其他几个国家，尽管国际刑事法院尚未对其发出逮捕令，但他没有被捕；他说，对他的指控“言过其实”，国际刑事法院是针对他的“西方阴谋”的一部分。科特迪瓦政府选择不将前第一夫人西蒙娜·巴博移交法院，而是在国内对她进行审判。卢旺达驻非洲联盟大使Joseph Nsengimana认为，“这不仅仅是肯尼亚的情况。我们已经看到国际正义越来越成为一个政治问题。”乌干达总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼指责国际刑事法院“处理复杂的非洲问题不当”。时任非盟主席的埃塞俄比亚总理Hailemariam Desalegn在联合国大会第六十八届会议的一般性辩论中告诉联合国大会：“国际刑事法院的运作方式给非洲留下了非常糟糕的印象。这是完全不可接受的。”

非洲联盟（非盟）退出提议
南非总统雅各布·祖马表示，人们认为国际刑事法院“不合理”，因此于2015年10月13日召开了非盟特别峰会。博茨瓦纳是国际刑事法院在非洲的著名支持者。在峰会上，非盟没有支持集体退出国际刑事法院的提议，因为这一想法缺乏支持。峰会得出结论，现任国家元首不应接受审判，肯尼亚的案件应推迟审理。埃塞俄比亚前外交部长Tedros Adhanom表示：“我们拒绝了国际刑事法院在伸张国际正义时采用的双重标准。”尽管有这些呼吁，国际刑事法院还是要求William Ruto出庭受审。联合国安理会随后被要求考虑将对肯雅塔和鲁托的审判推迟一年，但遭到拒绝。11月，国际刑事法院缔约国大会响应肯尼亚对在任国家元首豁免的呼吁，同意考虑对《罗马规约》进行修正，以解决这些问题。
target_text: At the summit, the African Union (AU) did not support the proposal to withdraw collectively from the ICC because there was no support for this idea. The summit concluded that the current Head of State should not stand trial and that the case of Kenya should be postponed. The former Foreign Minister of Ethiopia, Tedros Adhanom, said: “We reject the double standards applied by the ICC in the pursuit of international justice.” Despite these calls, the ICC requested William Ruto to appear before the Court. The United Nations Security Council was subsequently asked to consider postponing the trials of Kenyayata and Ruto by one year, but it was rejected. In November, the ICC Assembly of States Parties, responding to Kenya's call for immunity of the incumbent Head of State, agreed to consider amending the Rome Statute to address these issues.

source_text: 随后的唐纳德·特朗普政府对国际刑事法院的敌意要大得多，类似于布什政府威胁要起诉国际刑事法院法官和美国法院工作人员并对其进行金融制裁，以及对美国国民因涉嫌在阿富汗犯下的罪行和暴行而进行的任何调查实施签证禁令。这一威胁包括对120多个批准法院在这一进程中进行合作的国家中的任何一个实施制裁。2017年11月，法图·本苏达建议法院考虑对阿富汗战争期间犯下的侵犯人权行为提出指控，如美国武装部队和中央情报局涉嫌强奸和折磨、塔利班犯下的反人类罪以及阿富汗国家安全部队犯下的战争罪。美国国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿表示，国际刑事法院对美国没有管辖权，美国没有批准《罗马规约》。2020年，国际刑事法院的高级法官推翻了此前不起诉的决定，授权对阿富汗战争罪指控进行调查。

source_text:
对公司的管辖权
关于国际刑事法院是否应该对违反国际法的公司拥有管辖权，目前存在争议。支持者认为，企业可以而且确实侵犯人权，例如与冲突地区原材料有关的战争罪。批评者认为，起诉公司会损害互补性原则，根据国际法，这会赋予公司过大的权力，或者会损害公司的自愿倡议。John Ruggie认为，根据国际法，公司的管辖权应限于国际犯罪，而La Sabana大学的Nicolás Carrillo Santarelli则认为，它应涵盖所有侵犯人权的行为。
target_text: The question of jurisdiction over corporations is currently at issue as to whether the International Criminal Court should have jurisdiction over companies that violate international law. Proponents argue that corporations can and do violate human rights, such as war crimes related to raw materials in conflict zones. Critics argue that prosecuting companies would undermine the principle of complementarity, which would give corporations too much power under international law, or undermine their voluntary initiatives. John Ruggie argues that, under international law, corporate jurisdiction should be limited to international crimes, while Nicolás Carrillo Santaralli of La Sabana University argues that it should cover all human rights violations.

邵玉銘畢業於國立政治大學外交系，後獲美國芝加哥大學歷史學博士，曾任教於美國聖母大學及馬里蘭大學。後返台從政。1987年—1991年任新聞局長，於任內代表中華民國政府宣布解除戒嚴。1991年因個人婚外情問題而辭職。後於1999年—2001年任國民黨副秘書長、2001年—2003年任《中央日報》董事長兼社長。馬英九就任總統後，曾於2009年—2012年任外交部北美事務協調委員會主委。2013年7月29日，成為延宕30個月的公共電視文化事業基金會第五屆董事長。
target_text: She graduated from the Department of Foreign Affairs of the National University of Political Science, and was a professor of history at the University of Chicago and the University of Maryland. She went back to politics. From 1987 to 1991, she was the head of the news agency, representing the Chinese government, and announced the lifting of the state of siege.
title: 邵玉銘

source_text:
經歷
早年曾任行政院新聞局局長，後曾兩度出任外交部長，並擔任過駐教廷與駐泰國大使，後任總統府秘書長，主導掌握中華民國外交系統將近30年，有「外交教父」之稱。由於政治立場與時任總統的李登輝不合，解職後轉任總統府資政，1998年過世，享壽84歲。
target_text: In his early years as head of the Press Department of the Executive Council, he served twice as Minister for Foreign Affairs, as Ambassador to the Holy See and Thailand, and as Secretary-General of the Office of the President of the Republic, who oversaw the Chinese diplomatic system for nearly 30 years, known as the "diplomatic godfather." As a result of the political opposition to the then President, Li Deng Hui was removed from office and was transferred to the Office of the President in 1998, when he passed away and was 84 years old.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text:
家庭
妻：黎佩蘭，即黎民偉長女。
子：沈大川
岳父：黎民偉，人称「中國電影之父」。
外甥女：黎姿，香港影星。
小姨：黎萱，香港甘草演員。政治立場
沈昌煥與蔣家關係良好，被視為是「夫人派」、「官邸派」的外交官員，也因此不論是擔任外交部長或是卸職轉任其他職務，皆能一手主導中華民國的外交系統與外交事務，前後長達將近30年，因此得到「外交教父」之別稱。
target_text: His wife, Leperan, is the great daughter of Le Dynasty. Son: Shen Dae-chun's father-in-law, Le Min-Wi, is known as "the father of Chinese films."
title: 沈昌煥

source_text: 沈昌煥堅持「漢賊不兩立」的態度，強硬反對與所有共產國家及中华人民共和国進行任何交流接觸。堅守中華民國唯代表中國唯一合法政府的立場，並以此為外交國策，也使得1970、80年代的中華民國外交關係呈現低迷狀態。最後由於與時任總統的李登輝及主流意見不合，總統府秘書長職務遭到解除，轉任資政，結束長期在外交部門的服務。
target_text: In the 1970’s and 1980’s, China’s diplomatic relations became depressed. Finally, because of the disagreement with the then President, Li Deng-hee and the mainstream, the President’s post of Secretary was removed, transferred to office, and ended his long-term service in the Foreign Office.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text: 1960年沈昌煥第一次出任外交部長，在當時冷戰的大環境下，美國在東亞持續強而有力的支持中華民國政府，時中華民國的外交情勢尚稱平穩。任內亦曾有多位外國重要友邦元首訪華，包括美國總統艾森豪、泰王拉瑪九世等等，是中華民國政府遷臺後外交最風光的時期。而沈昌煥可靠的堅定立場與蔣家的親近關係，使得中華民國的外交政策逐漸由沈昌煥一手主導，鞏固強化了以反共國策為原則的對外政策。然而任內並非皆為順遂之事，如1964年對法斷交，巴黎與北京關係正常化；美國宣佈停止多年的美援，使當時各項建設發展失去一定的資金支持等。
target_text: In 1960, Shen Changjing was the first foreign minister to assume his post, and in the midst of the cold war, the US maintained strong and strong support for the Chinese government in East Asia, while the diplomatic situation in China was stable. Several prominent foreign friends and heads of state visited China, including US President Eisenhower, T. Rama IX, and so forth, during the best days of diplomacy since the departure of the Chinese government.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text:
駐泰國大使
1969年沈昌煥調任駐泰國大使，在大使任內，泰國对两岸政策立場不定，泰國華僑界形勢不安，沈曾多次召集會議，進行穩定士氣。為鞏固邦交關係，上任即邀蔣經國先生訪問泰國，竭力呈請政府捐贈亞洲理工學院研究基金，以爭取成為該學院董事，台灣每年可選派在職人員及學者前往攻讀碩士或博士。此一方案不僅敦睦了兩國邦誼，也造就了不少台灣經貿科技人才，對日後台灣經濟起飛，也發揮了一些作用。後又與泰國軍方合作協助推行泰王山地計劃，成效卓著。此計劃執行至今仍未停止，對後來中止外交關係情況下，甚多政要訪泰，包括李登輝以總統地位赴泰國，均受到泰王接見禮遇。沈昌煥在任內確實有所穩定了與泰國的邦交關係。
target_text: In order to strengthen relations, the incumbent invited Mr. Chen to visit the country, and made an effort to request the Government to donate the research fund of the Asian Institute of Technology to win membership in the Academy, and each year Taiwan can choose its staff and academics to attend the University’s competition for Masters or Doctors. Not only the two states, but also a number of Taiwan’s technologists, who have been able to fly to Taiwan’s rear economy, but also to play a role.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text: 1971年聯合國大會召開前夕，由於美國預估重要問題無法成案，直言宜取雙重代表權的方法，試圖讓北京入會的同時，可以保住台北的席次。而此一議案本來經過中美多方談判，新起外交人員錢復等正候蔣中正的首肯時，沈昌煥面見蔣介石強力反對雙重代表權一案，並同蔣夫人宋美齡向蔣堅持「漢賊不兩立」的外交原則，使台北在公開場合猶宣達死守不讓步的立場，對於雙重代表權一案表達「最強烈的反對」。儘管親中华民国的沙烏地阿拉伯支持雙重代表權案，但最後在1971年聯合國大會相關投票結束的前一刻，中華民國宣布退出聯合國，中华人民共和国随即取得聯合國的「中国」席位。
target_text: In 1971, on the eve of the UN General Assembly’s convening, and in anticipation of the impotence of important issues in the United States, an attempt was made to preserve Taiwan’s seat at the same time as Beijing joined, in an attempt to retain double representation. After many negotiations in China and the US, the new member of the diplomatic corps was called upon to wait for the correct end of the day, Shen Chang met with the powerful anti-double representation case, and, together with Mrs. Song’s diplomatic principles to insist on “Hanks are equal,” the People’s Republic of China announced its withdrawal from the United Nations, and the People’s Republic of China immediately obtained its “China” seat in the United States, despite Saudi Arabia’s pro-Republic of China’s support for the double representation.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text: 此事使得沈昌煥日後受多方責難，因為對於當時的中華民國來說，在聯合國內比不在聯合國內為佳，但沈昌煥持強硬態度的結果，使得台北代表以「安理會常任理事國」之姿被聯合國大會所逐出，影響日後中華民國外交甚鉅。同為「夫人派」的外交官陸以正為此事辯駁，他表示即使當年真的通過雙重代表權一案，北京必不接受，一定會等到台北不在聯合國內，他們才進去，所以離開聯合國是早晚的問題。然而錢復指出，各國對於1971年投票時所持的態度正是尋求一種和解；若是當年中華民國保有「普通會員國」的資格，日後在台灣的中華民國政府也毋庸尋求重返或加入聯合國，爭議即可告一段落。
target_text: This has caused many to blame after Shen Chang’s death, because it was better for the then Central Chinese People’s Republic than it was for the United Nations than it was for the then Central Chinese People’s Republic, but it was too late for them to leave the United Nations as a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council. However, it was noted that the attitude of Taiwan’s representatives in the 1971 elections had been to seek a settlement; if the “general member” of the Chinese People’s Party had held its position in that year, then the Chinese government in Taiwan would not wish to return to the United States or join the United States.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text: 1988年連戰出任外交部長，一上任即促成「蘇聯貿易訪問團」成行。訪蘇是台灣經貿外交的一大突破，但這項大膽的外交行動由於事先未按過去的常例徵詢沈昌煥的意見，在決策定案之後，又不理會沈的勸阻，引起沈昌煥的恐慌和不滿。於是，沈昌煥便在國民黨中常會中大舉反攻，手拿《蘇俄在中國》一書痛斥「訪蘇團」的成行，結果被李登輝順水推舟地解除其總統府秘書長的職務，轉任總統府資政，結束了外交上近30年的「沈昌煥時代」。
target_text: In 1988, when he became Minister of Foreign Affairs, he led to the “Soviet Trade Visitor Group.” A major breakthrough in Taiwan’s trade diplomacy was visiting the country, but this bold diplomatic move led to Li’s dismissal of the secretary-general of the president’s office from his position, after a decision had been taken, and his resignation caused panic and displeasure. So, Shen Chang’s counterattack in the National Party’s regulars, and his rejection of the Soviets’ visit to the Soviet Union in China, which resulted in Lee’s removal from the post of secretary-general of the president’s office and his transfer to the administration of the president’s office for nearly 30 years.
title: 沈昌煥

source_text: 黃少谷（），中華民國政治人物、中華民國陸軍中將，湖南省南縣人，中國國民黨籍，曾任第二集團軍總部秘書長、立法委員、國民黨總裁辦公室主任、世新專校籌辦人、外交部長、行政院政務委員、駐西班牙大使、行政院副院長、國安會秘書長、司法院長及總統府資政等職務，少時慕諸葛武侯智略忠誠，自名黃亮。
target_text: Hwang Shau Gou, a Chinese politician, a Lieutenant General of the Chinese National Army, a South Chinese citizen of Hunan Province, a member of the Chinese National Democratic Party (NDP), former Secretary-General of the Second Group, a member of the Legislative Council, the Director of the Office of the President of the National Democratic Party (NDP), the Secretary-General of the New World Special School, the Minister for Foreign Affairs, a member of the Executive Council, the Ambassador to Spain, the Vice-President of the Executive Council, the Secretary-General of the State Security Council, the Chief Justice and the President's Office.
title: 黃少谷 (政治人物)

source_text:
1950年3月，蔣介石以黃少谷為行政院秘书长。历任总裁办公室秘书主任、中華民國行政院副院长、外交部长、中華民國驻西班牙大使、总统府国策顾问、资政、国家安全会议秘书长。後來經過蔣經國提名，任司法院长，又與他進行司法改革。1947年以后当选为中国国民党历届中央常委。1967年10月6日，代表總統蔣中正赴加拿大訪問；9日，與加國總理皮爾遜（Lester Bowles Pearson）會商兩國加強合作問題；17日，返回臺灣。
1969年黃少谷由行政院副院長轉任國家安全會議秘書長一職，掌握攸關國家安全政策制定的各種海內外情資。直到1979年轉任司法院院長。黃少谷任職期間情資混亂導致對外政策進退失據，從失去聯合國席次到美國與我斷交。這是中華民國最風雨飄搖的十年，卻是黃少谷獨子黃任中突然獲得大筆境外資金成為許多上市公司金主的開始。
target_text: Following his nomination by the State, he served as President of the National Council of China, followed by judicial reform. After 1947, he was elected to the Central Committee of the Chinese National Party. On 6 October 1967, he was visiting Canada on behalf of the President of the Republic; on 9 October, a coup d’état with the Governor of the People’s Republic of China, the Vice-President of the People’s Republic of China, the Minister for Foreign Affairs, the Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Spain, and the Secretary-General of the National Security Council; on 17 November, he returned to Taiwan.
title: 黃少谷 (政治人物)

source_text: 扎马战役的结果标志着第二次布匿战争的结束。迦太基的大多数领袖意识到，他们的国家已无力再战，遂决定向罗马求和。据说当一名迦太基元老仍然在元老院中主张与罗马作战时，汉尼拔毫不客气地把他从讲台上拽了下来。另一方面，一些强硬的罗马人物，以老加图为代表，主张彻底毁灭迦太基，要求西庇阿把迦太基夷为平地。但是，西庇阿却对迦太基采取了比较温和的态度，只以一个苛刻的条约（按此条约，迦太基几乎完全被解除武装，并支付巨额赔款，未得罗马同意不得向他国宣战）结束了战争。而且，按照西庇阿的意愿，汉尼拔实际成为迦太基的政治首脑。与他对敌人的仁慈相反，西庇阿对意大利人中的叛徒十分残酷：来自拉丁城市的人被斩首，若是罗马人则会在十字架上钉死。
target_text: On the other hand, some hard-line Roman figures, represented by old Gato, called for the complete destruction of Carthage and demanded that the Carthage be razed. But, contrary to his kindness to the enemy, Siddhea was cruel to the Italian traitors: those from the Latin city were beheaded, and if the Romans were crucified, they would be crucified.
title: 大西庇阿

source_text: 1915年2月，英属印度军队中的印度人策划发动的，是更大范围的中一系列密谋里最著名的计划，印德密谋是第一次世界大战中1914年到1917年发动泛印度造反以推翻英属印度统治的密谋。革命者包括印度、美国和德国的印度民族主义者，此外爱尔兰共和主义者及德国外交部也提供帮助。印德密谋在第一次世界大战爆发时便开始酝酿，酝酿者有美国的加达尔党，德国的柏林委员会，英属印度的印度革命家，德国外交部通过驻美国旧金山的领事馆也参与酝酿。英国派情报人员渗透进入加达尔运动，最终挫败了计划中的1915年2月兵变，主要领导人都被逮捕。在驻印度军队中的兵变图谋也被粉碎。
target_text: In February 1915, the Hindus in the British Indian army staged the most famous of a larger series of conspiracies, the Indian plot of the First World War, which was launched between 1914 and 1917 by Pan-Indian rebels to overthrow British Indian rule. The revolutionists included Indian nationalists from India, the United States, and Germany, as well as Irish Republicans and the German Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The Indian plot began when World War I broke out, and was conceived by the Gadal Party of the United States, the Berlin Committee of Germany, the Indian revolutionary in the British, and the German Foreign Office, through its consulate in San Francisco.
title: 阿姆利則慘案

source_text: 1918年10月，签署穆德洛斯停战协定，随即伊斯坦布尔被军事占领；1919年签署凡尔赛条约，由于奥斯曼帝国的去留哈里发的地位与变得更加明晰。1920年，色佛尔条约的签署后在瓜分奥斯曼帝国问题上出现了空前的团结，在有些地区，人们认为基拉法特运动是基于泛伊斯兰思想的正统派伊斯兰教，使得基拉法特运动深受鼓舞。
target_text: In October 1918, the Madrid Armistice Agreement was signed, followed by the military occupation of Istanbul; in 1919, the Versailles Treaty was signed, thanks to the retention of caliphate in the Ottoman Empire and greater clarity. Following the signing of the Scheffer Treaty in 1920, there was unprecedented solidarity on the part of the Ottoman Empire. In some areas, the Kirafat movement was encouraged by Islam, which is believed to be an orthodox religion based on pan-Islamic ideology.
title: 基拉法特运动

source_text:
一、法院对于陈述各项争端，应依国际法裁判之，裁判时应适用：
（一）不论普遍或特别国际协约，确立诉讼当事国明白承认之规条者。
（二）国际习惯，作为通例之证明而经接受为法律者。
（三）一般法律原则为文明各国所承认者。
（四）在第59条规定之下，司法判例及各国权威最高之公法家学说，作为确定法律原则之补助资料者。
二，前项规定不妨碍法院经当事国同意本“公允及善良”原则裁判案件之权。
target_text: 1. The Court shall decide on the presentation of disputes in accordance with international law and shall apply: (i) whether a general or a special international treaty establishes the rules expressly recognized by the parties to the proceedings; (ii) international custom, as evidence of general practice, which is accepted as law; (iii) general principles of law are recognized by civilized nations; (iv) judicial jurisprudence and the doctrine of public law of the highest authority of States, under article 59, as subsidiary means for determining legal principles; and (ii) the former provision is without prejudice to the power of the Court to decide cases with the consent of the parties to the principle of “fairness and good”.
title: 国际法的渊源

source_text: 国际习惯法，更加准确的说法是习惯国际法（），也称国际习惯，是包含某些习惯性原则的国际法的渊源，其构成要素包括国家的一致行为及法律确信。习惯国际法与国际法基本原则、国际条约一起被国际法院、法学家、联合国及其成员国承认为国际法的三大基本渊源。
target_text: Customary international law, to be more precise, is customary international law () or customary international law, which is the source of international law encompassing certain customary principles, and which consists of the unanimous conduct of States and opinio juris. Customary international law, together with the basic principles of international law, international treaties, is recognized by the International Court of Justice, jurists, the United Nations and its member States as the three fundamental sources of international law.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 1950年，联合国国际法委员会罗列了可用于证明某项习惯国际法存在的证据形式：国际条约、国内和国际法院的判决、国内立法、国内法律顾问的观点、外交信函和国际组织的惯例。2018年，该委员会以评注的形式正式通过了关于习惯国际法识别的结论。联合国大会接受了这一决定，并鼓励各國將其尽可能广泛传播。
target_text: In 1950, the United Nations International Law Commission listed the forms of evidence that could be used to prove the existence of a particular customary international law: international treaties, decisions of national and international courts, domestic legislation, the views of domestic legal advisers, diplomatic correspondence and the practice of international organizations. In 2018, the Commission formally adopted conclusions on the identification of customary international law in the form of commentaries. The General Assembly accepted this decision and encouraged States to disseminate it as widely as possible.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 各国政府接受许多种类的习惯国际法。一些习惯国际法在国际社会中逐渐上升成为国际强行法，这些规则被认为是一类不可损抑的权利。而另一些习惯国际法可能只被一小部分国家的政府接受和遵守。不论各国是否将其纳入国内法或是签署有关的条约，各国一般都受到习惯国际法的约束。
target_text: Governments accept many types of customary international law. Some customary international law has evolved into international jus cogens and these rules are considered a category of non-derogable rights in the international community. Other customary international law may be accepted and respected by only a small number of Governments. States are generally bound by customary international law, whether or not they incorporate it into their domestic law or sign the relevant treaty.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 不能将国际强行法和习惯国际法混为一谈。所有国际强行法都为各国采用，都是习惯国际法，但是并非所有习惯国际法都会上升为国际强行法。通过签订条约或颁布相抵的法律，一国可以排除习惯国际法的适用，但是国际强行法是不可损抑的规范，不能通过上述方式而排除。
target_text: International jus cogens cannot be confused with customary international law. All international jus cogens is applied by States and is customary international law, but not all customary international law rises to international jus cogens. By entering into treaties or enacting countervailing laws, a State may exclude the application of customary international law, but international jus cogens is an irrevocable norm and cannot be excluded by the above-mentioned means.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 战争法曾在很长时间内作为一类习惯法规范存在。直到1899和1907年《海牙公约》《日内瓦公约》和其他相关条约签署后，战争法相關法律规范才以成文法的形式确认下来。然而，这一系列公约并不能调整战争期间可能发生的一切法律问题。而根据日内瓦公约的第一附加议定书第一条（2）的规定，武装冲突中发生、未由相关协议或条约规定的法律问题由习惯国际法调整。
target_text: The law of war existed for a long time as a class of customary norms. It was only after the signing of the Hague Conventions of 1899 and 1907, the Geneva Conventions and other relevant treaties, that the legal norms relating to the law of war were confirmed in the form of statutory law. However, the series of conventions did not regulate all legal issues that might arise during the war. According to article 1 (2) of Additional Protocol I to the Geneva Conventions, legal issues arising in armed conflict, which were not regulated by the relevant agreements or treaty provisions, were governed by customary international law.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 一般来说，主权国家必须同意特定的条约或法律规范才能受其约束。但是，习惯国际法对主权国家的约束效力并不需要主权国家同意该规范。因此，只要主权国家不明确反对该习惯国际法，该规则便对该国产生效力。与此相反，如果主权国家明确表达了反对意见，那么除非该习惯国际法被认为是国际强行法，该主权国家可能就不受该规范约束。然而，有反对观点认为，对于任何没有申明“沉默即同意”原则的国家来说，任何对“沉默即同意”原则的适用都表明将该原则归于一项习惯的倾向。如此一国若不赞成一种更宽松的证明习惯国际法存在的前提（该前提一般为“有一般的实践或通例存在，且被各国接受为法律”），这种倾向便会基于循环论证。（之所以习惯国际法具有法律约束力，是因为沉默即同意；同时之所以沉默即同意，是因为该原则是习惯国际法的一个方面。）
target_text: In general, a sovereign State must agree to a particular treaty or legal norm in order to be bound by it. However, the binding effect of customary international law on a sovereign State does not require the consent of the sovereign State to be bound by the norm. Thus, if a sovereign State does not expressly object to customary international law, the rule becomes effective for that State. Conversely, if a sovereign State expressly expresses an objection, it may not be bound by the norm unless it is considered to be international jus cogens. However, the view is against any application of the principle of “silence or consent” to any State that does not affirm the principle of “silence or consent” indicates a tendency to attribute the principle to a custom. If a State does not favour a more liberal premise of proof of the existence of customary international law (the premise is generally that there is “general practice or general practice and that States accept it as law”), this tendency would be based on circular reasoning (the customary international law is legally binding, because silence is consent; the silence is consent, because the principle is one aspect of customary international law).
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 基于这种现实，长期以来国际法形成了一种原则，即若国家没有明确表示同意这项规则（如签订一项条约），该国就不能被该规则约束。习惯国际法则潜移默化地突破了这一观点。国际法院国际法院规约基于《联合国宪章》第九十二条订立，该规约承认了习惯国际法的存在［第三十八条（1）b］。“法院对于陈诉各项争端，应依国际法裁判之，裁判时应适用：……（丑）国际习惯，作为通例之证明而经接受为法律者。”
target_text: On the basis of this reality, international law has long developed the principle that a State cannot be bound by this rule if it has not expressly expressed its consent (e.g., by a treaty). Customary international law is a tacit departure from this view. The Statute of the International Court of Justice, which is based on Article 92 of the Charter of the United Nations, recognizes the existence of customary international law [Article 38 (1) (b)]. “The Court shall decide on disputes on the basis of international law and shall apply it: ... (b) international custom, which is accepted as law as evidence of general practice.”
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 习惯国际法“由源于国家间存在的一般实践或通例的规则组成，出于某种确信，国家遵守这些规则”。由此可见，习惯国际法往往产生于“随着时间的推移，一个在国家间广为流传反复出现的实践或通例（国家实践）；这种实践或通例必须因感到某种义务作出（国际强行法）；这种实践或通例必须被大多数国家所接受同时未遭到大量国家反对”。某项习惯国际法的产生是国家间的共识，同时该规则还应当是一种广为流传的通例，并让国家明显地察觉到自身受到某项义务约束。
target_text: Customary international law “composed of rules of general practice or general practice emanating from the existence of an inter-State State, which, out of some conviction, the State adheres to.” It follows that customary international law often results from “a practice or general practice that has been widely disseminated between States over time (State practice); such practice or general practice must be made out of a feeling of an obligation (international jus cogens); such practice or general practice must be accepted by the majority of States without being opposed by a large number of States at the same time.” A customary international law has emerged from an inter-State consensus and, at the same time, the rule should be a general rule that is widely known and should give States a clear sense of being bound by an obligation.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 关于国际强行法中的心理要素，国际法院在北海大陆架案中作出了如下阐释：“这些行为不仅必须是一种现存的通例，同时还需要作为一种信念的证据，即相信该行为为一项要求它的法律规则的存在所规定……因此，有关国家必须感到其遵守了相当于一项法律义务的义务。”国际法院强调了有必要证明基于“法律责任感”的行为不同于“出于礼貌、便利或传统考虑的行为”。这随后在尼加拉瓜诉美国一案中得到确认。
target_text: With regard to the psychological elements of international jus cogens, the International Court of Justice stated in the North Sea Continental Shelf case that “these acts must not only be an existing general rule, but also serve as evidence of the conviction that the act is required by the existence of a rule of law which requires it ... The State concerned must therefore feel that it has complied with an obligation equivalent to a legal obligation.” The Court stressed the need to prove that acts based on “a sense of legal responsibility” were different from “acts motivated by considerations of courtesy, convenience or tradition”, which was subsequently confirmed in Nicaragua v. the United States.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 对习惯法的承认可以分为对单一的双边习惯法的承认和对世界范围内的多边习惯法的承认。地区性的习惯可以发展为当地的习惯国际法，但是这类习惯不能约束这个地区之外的其他国家。双边国际习惯法的存在被国际法院在印度领土通行权案中承认。该案中，国际法院认为“在两国的长期的实践中，为两国所接受的调整两国之间关系的方法，没有理由不构成它们之间相互的权利和义务的基础”。
target_text: Recognition of customary law can be divided into recognition of a single bilateral customary law and recognition of multilateral customary law worldwide. Regional custom can evolve into local customary international law, but such custom cannot bind other countries outside the region. The existence of bilateral customary international law was recognized by the International Court of Justice in the Right of Passage in Indian Territory case, where the International Court of Justice held that “in the long-standing practice of the two States, there is no reason why the methods accepted by the two States to regulate relations between them do not form the basis of their mutual rights and obligations”.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 其他被接受或宣称为习惯国际法的规范大致包括来访外国元首的豁免权、不推回原则等。1993年，联合国安全理事会承认《日内瓦公约》为习惯国际法。如果任何条约或法律被认定为习惯国际法，那么尚未批准该条约的缔约国将有义务善意遵守其规定。
target_text: Other norms that have been accepted or claimed as customary international law include, to a large extent, the immunity of visiting foreign heads of State, the principle of non-refoulement, etc. In 1993, the United Nations Security Council recognized the Geneva Conventions as customary international law. If any treaty or law is recognized as customary international law, States parties that have not yet ratified them will be obliged to comply with its provisions in good faith.
title: 国际习惯法

source_text: 在2000年代引起關注的一個話題是，在美国协防台湾的前提下，澳大利亚是否与中華民國一同對抗來自中華人民共和國的潛在威脅（协防台湾），然而與美國合作的澳大利亞受到和中華人民共和國的貿易關係持續增長而有所影響。2004年8月16日，澳大利亞外長亞歷山大·唐納与中华人民共和国总理温家宝会晤。19日，澳大利亚媒体披露会晤后回答记者时，唐納的表态。他指澳美军事联盟只是“象征性的”，若台湾海峡发生军事冲突，澳大利亚“不一定要”自动启动《澳新美安全条约》，加入美国“保护”台湾行列。19日，美国国务院发言人表示，美国政府在台海问题上立场明确，即和平解决，反对使用武力，并重申《澳新美安全条约》中澳大利亚义务。次日，中華民國外交部政务次长高英茂接受美国广播公司专访表示，中华民国政府对唐納言论“感到失望”，指责他向中华人民共和国政府传达了“错误訊息”。唐納的說法隨後即被時任澳大利亞總理約翰·霍華德糾正。2005年3月，中華人民共和國正式聲明澳大利亞應該重新評估此條約，此時中華人民共和國通過了針對中華民國的《反分裂國家法》，對此唐納宣佈為防止中華人民共和國侵略中華民國（武统台湾），安保條約應要生效，但該條約只要求與美國進行磋商，而不一定會使澳大利亞發動戰爭。
target_text: On August 16, 2004, Australia’s Foreign Minister, Alexander Downer, met with the Prime Minister of the People’s Republic of China, Wen Jiabao. On 19 August, when the Australian media revealed that they were responding to journalists, Donald spoke about the potential threat from the People’s Republic of China. He called the US-China military alliance “symmetrically” and, if there was a military conflict in the Taiwan Strait, Australia “not necessarily” automatically launched the New America-China Security Treaty and joined the US-China “protecting” Taiwan. On 19 August, the US State Council spokesman stated that the United States Government’s position on Taiwan was clear, peaceful, opposed to the use of force, and reiterated the Australian obligation in the AUS Security Treaty to prevent the invasion of Australia.

source_text: 这一定义的表述方式，显然受到世界知识产权组织于1996年通过的《世界知识产权组织版权条约》第八条的影响。中国全国人民代表大会常务委员会于2006年12月29日通过了加入这一条约的议案。但是，仔细分析上述条约的表述可以发现，中国的信息网络传播权与该条中规定的“公共传播权”有很大的差异。

source_text: 1911年（宣統3年）夏，王正廷归国期間，武昌起義爆发，王正廷遂赴湖北省，出任中华民国军政府鄂军都督府外交副司長（後来升任司長），负责外交事務。同年12月，在南北議和中，王正廷出任南方代表伍廷芳的参赞。1912年（民国元年）1月，王正廷当选南京臨時参議院的浙江省代表，並当选为副議長。
target_text: During the summer of 1911, when Wang was returned to the country, Wuchang took over, Wang was appointed to Hubei Province as Deputy Director of Foreign Affairs (later to the post of Director of Foreign Affairs) of the Governor-General of the Military Government of the Republic of China. In December of the same year, in North and South China, Wang was appointed Counsellor to the Southern Representative, Wu Tingfang. In January of 1912, Wang was elected representative of Zhejiang Province to the Senate at the time of impending Nanjing and was elected Vice-President.
title: 王正廷

source_text:
北京政府的外交活動
袁世凱死後，孫文（孫中山）发动護法運動，获得王正廷支持。民国6年（1917年）8月，王正廷担任广州非常国会副議長。9月，護法軍政府成立，王正廷担任外交次長（暫行署理外交总長）。1919年（民国8年）巴黎和会召开，王正廷作为護法軍政府代表，同北京政府代表陸徵祥、顧維鈞等人一起组成中国代表团参加和会。《凡尔赛条约》使日本继承了德国在中国山東半島的旧有权益，在中国代表团中，王正廷极力反对此条约。結果，随着五四運動爆发等国内情勢变化，中国代表团拒绝签署《凡尔赛条约》。
target_text: In September, the Government of the Defense Forces was formed, and Wang was the Under-Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs (Provisional Head of Foreign Affairs). In 1919, the Paris Peace Conference was held in Paris (8th year of the People’s Republic of China), where Wang, as the representative of the Defence Forces, formed the Chinese delegation, along with the representatives of Beijing’s Government, Wang Jianxing and others, to participate in the Conference. The Versailles Treaty enabled Japan to inherit Germany’s old interests in the half-island of Shandong, China. In the Chinese delegation, Wang Jianxin strongly opposed the Treaty. As a result, the Chinese delegation refused to sign the Versailles Treaty, as a result of domestic developments such as the outbreak of the 5th Movement.
title: 王正廷

source_text: 归国後，護法軍政府内部发生矛盾，王正廷被迫下野。1921年（民国10年），被任命为北京的中国大学校長。同年5月，被任命为荷兰海牙的常设仲裁法院的仲裁员。1922年（民国11年）3月，王正廷被北京政府任命为接收膠澳善後督办，负责就山東半島的懸案同日本进行交涉。同年11月，王正廷在汪大燮内閣中署理外交总長。1922年12月至1923年1月，王正廷曾短期代理国務总理。1923年3月，王正廷被北京政府委以中苏交涉事務，任至1924年（民国13年）3月为止，为解決中苏两国之间的懸案尽力。经过王正廷的努力，在继其後任的顧維鈞任内，1924年5月中苏協定缔結，两国恢复邦交。其後，王正廷历任北京政府的外交总長、財政总長。
target_text: In March 1922 (November) Wang was appointed by the Beijing Government as the follow-up to the Gyeong-ahung case to deal with Japan. In November of the same year, Wang Jung-ting was appointed Director-General of Foreign Affairs in Wang Dae-Ning. In December 1922 to January 1923, Wang Jung-ting acted as Prime Minister of the State on a short-term basis. In March 1923, Wang was appointed by the Beijing Government Council to take over from China to China until March 1924 (13 years) to try to resolve the outstanding case between China and China.
title: 王正廷

source_text: 1928年（民国17年），王正廷转入南京国民政府，任国民政府外交委員会委員。同年6月，王正廷任外交部長兼中国国民党中央政治会議委員。任内，王正廷负责济南事件的事後处理，同日本进行交涉。但交涉极其困难，而且中国普通国民对于向日本妥協也激烈反对。同年12月，南京发生中国民众游行，王正廷在南京的住宅遭到破坏。最終，1929年（民国18年）3月28日，中日两国缔结協定。

source_text: 在担任外交部長期间，王正廷展开了同帝国主義各国的条約改定運動，力图改正关税条件，废除領事裁判权。这些目标未完全实現，後任外交部長继续开展了此项工作。王正廷任内在关税条件的改正方面取得一定成果。1931年（民国20年）9月18日九一八事变爆发後，王正廷同日本进行交涉。但是，由于蒋介石的「安内攘外」路线，中方无法摆出強硬姿态。9月28日，被九一八事变激怒的南京及上海学生游行队伍殴打王正廷，致使其受傷，王正廷遂辞去外交部長职务。同年12月，王正廷当选为中国国民党第4届中央執行委員（后来第5届任候补中央执行委员，第6届任中央执行委员）。此後，1936年（民国25年）8月至1938年（民国27年）9月，王正廷任中国駐美国大使。
target_text: During his tenure as head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Wang was engaged in a campaign to change the contract with the imperialist countries, seeking to correct tariff conditions and abolish the power of the courts. source_text: 常设仲裁法院位于海牙的和平宫，该建筑是1913年依靠卡内基基金会的捐赠建立起来的。起初只由常设仲裁法院使用，现在由该院和国际法院共同使用。与国际法院不同，常设仲裁法院并不是一个国家之间的法庭。争议双方可以请求該院对其进行仲裁、调解或者仅仅是调查事实。該院不仅接受来自国家间的申请，同时也接受国家与私人团体或者个人之间的冲突解决申请。

周書楷（），中華民國外交家，湖北安陆人。早年
周于1931年考入国立中央大学政治系，毕业后初就业于民间机构中国国际联盟同志会，1938年进入中华民国外交部，赴英国伦敦使馆任学习员。在英国期间，周先后毕业于伦敦大学和剑桥大学。1945年12月，周奉调回国，后出任国共美三人谈判小组中美国政府特使马歇尔的翻译。1949年，周随中华民国外交部播迁台湾。1965年，周被任命为中国驻美大使，他是第一个没有博士学位的中华民国驻美大使。1970年，他促成蒋经国访问美国。
target_text: During his stay in the United Kingdom, he graduated from the University of London and Cambridge. In December 1945, Zhou was transferred back to the United States as Special Envoy of the United States Government to the United States three-party negotiating team. In 1949, he was transferred to Taiwan with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China. In 1965, he was appointed Ambassador of China to the United States, the first Ambassador of the Republic of China to the United States without a doctorate. In 1970, he facilitated a visit to the United States.
title: 周书楷

source_text: 美國在會前與台北交涉協商多時，打算以「雙重代表權」保住台北在聯合國的席次代表，但是美國為拉攏中华人民共和国制衡蘇聯，而替中华人民共和国加入联合国宣传，又派遣国务卿基辛格秘密前往北京与周恩来商量入联事宜，导致大批原本支持中华民国的国家倒戈中华人民共和国。中华民国政府於9月率团出席紐約联合国大会，另一方面美國在每年都將中國代表權一案列為「重要問題」在1971年沒有闖關成功，分段表決案也在表決中被否決。10月25日，在聯合國大會通过联合国2758号决议之前数小时，周书楷代表中華民國政府宣布中华民国退出联合国。截至1972年，中華民國一共與29個國家斷交，最重要的當屬日本。
target_text: In September, the government of the Republic of China led the Chinese government to the United Nations General Assembly in New York, while the United States unsuccessfully listed China’s representation every year as an “important issue” in 1971, and voted against it. On October 25, the Chinese government announced the withdrawal of the Republic of China from the United Nations a few hours before the adoption of United Nations resolution 2758 by the United Nations General Assembly.
title: 周书楷

source_text: 清朝初期，清朝政府与俄罗斯沙皇国政府签订了《尼布楚条约》，该条约中国称为平等条约，俄罗斯（含苏联时期）称为不平等条约（俄罗斯人认为《瑷珲条约》中收回了被中国人强占的失地）。俄国在清朝前中期被视为清朝唯一的“与国”而进行平等外交。有人认为，这一条约象征着中国現代化外交的开始。不过直到总理衙门成立前，除俄国以外的国家都是以中國與藩属國交往的概念来处理与外国的事务，并且在交往中竭力要求外臣服貼（如要求英使马戛尔尼向乾隆帝下跪而不是單膝跪地），与现代意义上的外交并不相同。
target_text: At the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Dynasty Government signed the Nibchu Treaty with the Government of the Tsar of Russia, which China called an equality treaty, and Russia, which included Soviet times, called an inequality treaty (which Russians thought had taken back the land that had been taken over by the Chinese). Russia engaged in equal diplomacy in the middle of the Qing Dynasty as the only Qing Dynasty “with the state.” The view was expressed that this treaty symbolized the beginning of China’s modern-day diplomacy.
title: 清朝外交

source_text: 随着清朝政府的管治失效，以及外国勢力的到來，內部的紛爭矛盾。以《南京条约》为开端，清朝开始与外国签署一系列的不平等条约。这些不平等条约，或要求割地，或要求赔款，使得清朝由一个主權强大的帝国逐漸變為了一个割讓、租借出若干小型殖民地的帝國。
target_text: Starting with the Nanjing Treaty, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea began to sign a series of unequal treaties with foreign countries. These unequal treaties, which require either the cutting of land or compensation, have turned the Democratic People’s Republic of China into an empire with a powerful monarchy that cede and leased a number of small colonies.
title: 清朝外交

source_text: 清朝前前后后共和五十多个国家签订了近二百个条约。虽然其中有相当一部分是損失自身經濟、版圖利益的条约（如：《中英天津条约》、《展拓香港界址專條》），但也有国家強盛时與外國签订的条约（如：《中俄尼布楚条约》）。朝廷政策闭关锁国禁海令顺治三年（1646年）编制的《大清律》保留了《大明律》中有关“私出外境及违禁下海”的条文。
target_text: While a significant proportion of these treaties have been concluded at the expense of their own economies and economic interests (e.g., the Treaty of China and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the Hong Kong Boundaries Agreement), there are also treaties with foreign countries (e.g., the Treaty of China and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland) that have been signed in the wake of China’s previous and subsequent accession to the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.
title: 清朝外交

In 1815, the ban on opium was observed in 20 years: the ban on opium. source_text: 《尼布楚条约》签订前，中俄双方对彼此的认识尚非常缺乏，从而导致沟通上的障碍，当时的俄国对清朝国力的认识相当粗浅，视中国为其向西伯利亚扩张所遇的诸多民族之一，在双方开始接触时，俄国竟然要清朝“归顺于我沙皇陛下最高统治之下，向我大君主纳贡”，要求中国承认其宗主国地位。同样，习惯以中国传统的“朝贡”、“藩属”模式处理对外事务的清朝也一度视俄国为北方新“胡”，仅视其为一支野蛮的远方部落，理所当然应该向天朝纳贡。清朝、俄罗斯两国外交礼仪也矛盾重重，以此种彼此之认知作为两国外交的基础，自然不会产生什么实质性的外交。在雅克萨之战后，双方围绕根特木儿的归属及划界展开谈判，最终签订《尼布楚条约》。自条约签订后到雍正五年（1727年）这三十多年里，两国间虽仍纠纷不断，却从未发生大规模的军事直接对抗，反映出双方从单纯依靠军事手段转变为寻求外交途径来解决矛盾的一种趋势。1689年以后，两国以俄国（元老院）与理藩院对等互通信函往来国书、咨文几无间断，面对面的谈判交涉异常频繁，雍正五年（1727年）双方签订的《恰克圖界約》便是其间具有里程碑意义的重大外交成果。雍正帝还于1731年派遣正式使团访问莫斯科，祝贺安娜女皇登基。
target_text: Similarly, the Qing dynasty, which used to deal with foreign affairs in the traditional Chinese “Dynamite” model, was viewed at one time as a new “hu” in the north, but only as a barbarous faraway tribe, and as a legitimate source of tension between the two countries’ diplomatic ceremonials, which served as the basis for diplomacy between the two countries, did not, of course, produce any substantial diplomacy. In the post-Yaksar period, the two sides negotiated on the attribution and demarcation of Gentemu’s children, culminating in the signing of the Nibchu dynasty, which was a non-nebloitation of the two countries’ diplomatic landmarks, after five years after the signing of the treaty and more than five years (1727 years of direct visits to Nagon).
title: 清朝外交

source_text: 1882年，清朝与朝鲜王朝在天津签订《中朝商民水陆贸易章程》。通过该条约，清政府在朝鲜取得领事裁判权、海关监管权等一系列权益。此后清政府又与朝鲜签定了《仁川华商租界章程》等条约，在朝鲜取得了包括仁川、元山等处的租界在内的更多的权益（参见仁川清租界）。直到甲午战争爆发后朝鲜王朝正式结束与清朝的宗藩关系。

波兰立陶宛和瑞典统治期
1558年，沙皇伊凡大帝入侵塔尔图，开始了利沃尼亚战争。彼得·舒伊斯基指挥的部队包围了该镇并开始了猛烈的攻击。有鉴于此，在没有任何外援的情况下，该镇投降了。当地主教被关押在莫斯科，这实际上结束了地方自治时期。（Ivan Mikhailovich Viskovatyi）是伊凡大帝统治时期的著名外交官和外交记录档案管理员，他认为古代俄罗斯“建国”证明了俄罗斯对该地区的领土主张是合理的 。在1582年的影响下，该市与利沃尼亚联邦南部地区一起成为波兰-立陶宛联邦的一部分。
target_text: In 1558, the Tsar Ivan the Great invaded Tartu and began the war in Lvonia. The troops under the command of Peter Schuysky surrounded the town and began a violent attack. In view of this, the town surrendered without any foreign aid.

source_text:
爱沙尼亚独立后
在第一次世界大战后，爱沙尼亚获得了独立，城市正式以爱沙尼亚语的名称"塔尔图"而闻名。在1918年至1920年的爱沙尼亚独立战争结束后，苏俄布尔什维克政府与爱沙尼亚签署了一项和平条约，即1920年2月2日在塔尔图签署的《塔尔图和约》。根据这份条约，苏俄“永久”放弃对爱沙尼亚的领土主张。

source_text: 1920年，一场爱尔兰共和军的志愿者对英国政府军的游击战期间，1920年爱尔兰政府法案将爱尔兰岛分成两个分离的管辖区：「南爱尔兰」与「北爱尔兰」。爱尔兰的分裂被1921年英爱条约确认，该条约终结了南部的游击战，建立了爱尔兰自由邦——一个几乎独立的爱尔兰国家（在1949年成为共和国并完全独立）。这个协议承认了爱尔兰人民中主要集中在古代的阿尔斯特省希望作为一部分留在联合王国，其中新教徒在全体而言占压倒性优势，與要求从英国独立的天主教徒之间有巨大分歧。
target_text: In 1920, during a guerrilla war between the Irish Republican Army and British government forces, the Irish Government Act 1920 divided the island of Ireland into two separate jurisdictions: "South Ireland" and "Northern Ireland." The division of Ireland was confirmed by the 1921 British love treaty, which ended the guerrilla war in the south and established the Irish Free State – a near-independent Irish state (which became a republic in 1949 and was fully independent). The agreement recognized the desire of the Irish people, which was concentrated in the ancient province of Alster, to remain in the United Kingdom as part of it, with Protestants overwhelmingly in the United Kingdom, and there was a huge divergence between the Catholics who called for independence from the United Kingdom.

source_text: 凯文·迈克尔·拉德，AC（；），中文名為陆克文，澳大利亚工党籍政治人物、外交官，其出生于澳大利亚昆士兰州楠伯，毕业于澳大利亚国立大学，主修中国历史及文学。从政期间，曾任澳大利亚工党领袖、澳大利亞外交部长等职，并於2007年至2010年以及2013年两度出任澳大利亞總理，现任澳大利亚驻美国大使。
target_text: Kevin Michael Raad, AC (;) Chinese, Rudd, Australian Labour Party politician, diplomat, born in Nanber, Queensland, Australia, graduated from the Australian National University, majoring in Chinese history and literature. During his political career, he served as leader of the Australian Labour Party, Australian Foreign Minister, etc., and served twice as Prime Minister of Australia from 2007 to 2010 and 2013 and is currently Ambassador of Australia to the United States.
title: 陆克文

source_text: 2010年6月，因工党内部纷争，陆克文被迫下台，时任副总理及工党副党魁的朱莉娅·吉拉德接替了他的党魁及总理的职务，随后其出任澳大利亚外交部长至2012年初。2013年6月，在党内选举中击败吉拉德获胜，再任总理，然而仅3个月后便在当年的联邦大选中被托尼·阿博特领导的自由党-国家党联盟击败，再次下台。2013年11月，陆克文从议会辞职，自此结束了在澳洲的政治生涯。离开政坛后，陆克文主要从事中国及亚洲方面的研究及交流工作，并从2014年10月起担任亚洲协会政策研究所首任所長。2022年底，陆克文获任命为新一任澳大利亚驻美国大使，于2023年3月上任。
target_text: In June 2010, because of internal disputes within the Labour Party, Kevin Rudd was forced to step down, then Deputy Prime Minister and Vice-President of the Labour Party, Julia Gilad, who replaced him as head of his party and prime minister, and subsequently as Minister for Foreign Affairs of Australia until the beginning of 2012. In June 2013, Gilad won the party election and re-elected as prime minister, but only three months later in the federal election that year was defeated by Tony Abbot’s Liberal-National Alliance. In November 2013, Rudd resigned from Parliament, ending his political career in Australia. After leaving the political arena, Kevin Ruddd was mainly engaged in research and communication work in China and Asia, leading the Institute of Policy Studies of Asian Associations from October 2014. In late 2022, Kevin Rudd was appointed as the new Australian Ambassador to the United States, and took office in March 2023.
title: 陆克文

source_text: 1981年澳洲国立大学畢業後，陸克文進入澳大利亚外交部服務，先派駐瑞典首都斯德哥爾摩；1984年轉派駐北京，專責分析中國政治及經濟形勢；1988年陸克文升任為外交部助理次長。不久，陆克文为当时是昆士兰州議會反对党领袖的工作，并協助他在第二年的大选中獲勝。在戈斯出任昆士兰州州长后，即任命陆克文担任自己的幕僚长、兼州政府内阁办事处总监。1995年陸克文离开昆士兰州政府，出任畢馬威（KPMG）會計師事務所中國事務顧問。1997年出任澳大利亚昆士兰大学亚洲语言系副主任。

Shortly thereafter, Kevin worked as then leader of the opposition party in the Queensland Council and helped him to win the second year’s election. After Goss was Governor of Queensland, Kevin Rudd was appointed Chief of Staff and Head of the State Cabinet Office.

source_text: 外交政策上，陆克文政府施行联合国、亚洲和美国兼顾的“三个支柱”政策。陆克文和美国总统奥巴马由于政治理念的近似建立了很好的私人关系：奥巴马曾说陆克文是所有世界领袖中和他的思维最相近的，两人有“神交”（"meeting of the mind"）。陆克文的汉语能力又让他和澳大利亚的另一重要贸易伙伴中国的领导人建立起较好的关系。虽然在第一届陆克文政府任内澳中关系受到一系列事件的影响，例如力拓间谍案中中国政府逮捕澳洲人胡士泰，但双方领导人的默契仍使双方关系得到恢复。例如2010年6月21日，时任中国国家副主席习近平与陆克文在澳洲首都堪培拉举行会谈，双方签署10项总值逾88亿美元的商业协议，其中有7项涵盖资源和能源领域。有分析家认为此举表示澳中关系已从力拓间谍案的纠纷低谷中走出。
target_text: For example, on 21 June 2010, Chinese Vice-President Xi Jinping and Kevin Rudd met in Canberra, the capital of Australia, and signed 10 commercial agreements with a total value of over $8.8 billion, seven of which covered the area of resources and energy.

2010年9月14日，吉拉德公布新一届内阁名单，任命陆克文为外交部长，并在同年9月代吉拉德参加联大会议。2012年2月，时任外交部长的陆克文和多个前座内阁同僚的矛盾开始公开化，原因是忠于吉拉德的议员指控陆克文意图夺回总理席位。2月22日，陆克文在外交訪問美國華盛頓期間，突然宣告因为内阁同事的攻击太过火而吉拉德却不加以制止，自己无法在不被总理支持的情況下繼續擔任外交部長的職務，宣告辭職並將回國考慮下一步動作。回國后他發表講話說，工黨在吉拉德的領導下無法在下屆選舉中戰勝由托尼·阿博特領導的反對黨，因此他將挑戰工黨黨魁一職。2012年2月27日，議會黨團進行投票決定党领袖人选，陸克文以31：71票不敵吉拉德，吉拉德留任黨领袖和總理。之后陆克文声明将遵守承诺退居议会後座并不会再挑战吉拉德的领导地位，并呼吁吉拉德一派不要报复在党内投票中支持他的议员。他空出的外交部长一职则不久后由前新南威尔士州州长鲍勃·卡尔接替。

source_text: 在野生動物保護上，陸克文政府採取積極政策。特別是在日本侵入澳洲鄰海捕鯨問題上，政府對反抗活動基本持支持態度。第一届陆克文政府在多边谈判未能说服日本的情况下于2010年不惜將日本告上海牙国际法庭。《南极捕鲸案（澳大利亞訴日本；新西兰介入）》在2013年6月26日到7月16日進行公開聆訊，第二届陆克文政府派出以律政部长、御用大律师德雷福斯为首的强大律师团队前往海牙参加庭辩。最终国际法庭在2014年4月以12票赞成、4票反对的结果宣判日本在南太平洋的捕鲸活动违反国际法，必须停止，至此澳大利亚反日本捕鲸的活动以胜利告终。

source_text: 黑海艦隊的總部在克里米亞的塞瓦斯托波尔海军基地，其他基地分佈在克拉斯诺达尔边疆区、罗斯托夫州、克里米亚等。1954年蘇聯把克里米亚劃歸烏克蘭蘇維埃社會主義共和國。1992年苏联解体后，俄罗斯被允許继续使用这个港口作为其军事基地，在过去十数年中导致多次外交冲突。按条约俄罗斯将于2017年撤出塞瓦斯托波爾，於2010年簽約再度延長25年。每年俄罗斯向乌克兰繳纳一亿美元作为其基地的租金。2014年克里米亚归属公投后，克里米亚共和国逕自宣布和塞瓦斯托波尔一起从乌克兰独立；塞瓦斯托波尔以联邦直辖市身份加入俄罗斯联邦（不被國際承認），并被编入克里米亚联邦管区，黑海艦隊繼續控制當地。由於俄羅斯控制該區，因此中止向烏克蘭繳付租金。

外交政策
眾議員保羅堅定支持不干預主義的外交政策。他投票反對授權向伊拉克發動戰爭的伊拉克決議案，並且自始至终反對美國對伊拉克的入侵，他也批評布希政府在反恐戰爭中的許多行動已經侵犯了公民自由。他最近以來演講中顧慮的則是美國與伊朗間的緊張關係，擔心兩國間會爆發戰爭。他在2001年投票反對了美國愛國法（USA PATRIOT Act），使得他與共和黨團的關係一度破裂，他也在2005年投票反對了一項徵兵法案。他支持美國退出聯合國。
target_text: He voted against the Iraqi decision authorizing war against Iraq and, from the outset, against the US invasion of Iraq. He also criticized the Bush administration’s actions in the war on terror as a violation of civil liberties. In his recent speech, he was concerned about the tight relationship between the US and Iran, fearing a war between the two countries. In 2001, he voted against the USA PATRIOT Act, which led to a breakdown in his relationship with the Republican Party, and in 2005 he voted against a draft military bill.

source_text:
历史早期案例
1474年，受到神圣罗马帝国特别法庭的审判，这是第一次“国际”战争罪审判，也是第一次对指挥责任的审判。他被定罪并砍头，因为“作为一名骑士，他应有责任防止”惨剧发生，但他認為自己是在“听从命令”。海牙公约《海牙公约》是分别于1899年和1907年在荷兰海牙的第一次和第二次和平会议上达成的国际条约。加上1864年和1909年日内瓦第一和第二公约，这些条约是现世国际法诞生初期的第一批正式阐述战争法和战争罪的条约。
target_text: In 1474, he was tried by the Special Court of the Holy Roman Empire for the first “international” war crimes trial and for the first time for command responsibility. He was convicted and decapitated because “as a knight, he had a duty to prevent” the tragedy, but he thought he was “following orders.” The Hague Conventions were international treaties concluded at the first and second peace conferences in The Hague, the Netherlands, in 1899 and 1907, respectively. Together with the first and second Geneva Conventions of 1864 and 1909, these treaties were the first treaties formally spelled out the laws of war and war crimes in the early days of present-day international law.
title: 战争罪

source_text:
日内瓦公约
《日内瓦公约》是1864年至1949年所通过的4部相关条约的总称，在作战行为方面代表了国际法的法律基础。2006年，《日内瓦公约》获得全球所有国家的通过，但一些签署国常常违反《日内瓦公约》的规定，或利用法律规定的模棱两可之处，或通过政治斡旋来规避法律程序和原则。
target_text: The Geneva Conventions, the sum total of the four relevant treaties adopted between 1864 and 1949, represent the legal basis of international law in the conduct of combat. In 2006, the Geneva Conventions were adopted by all States of the globe, but some of the signatories often violated the provisions of the Geneva Conventions, or used ambiguities provided for by law, or used political good offices to circumvent legal procedures and principles.
title: 战争罪

source_text:
本列表为中国（大清国、中華民國、中華人民共和國）驻荷兰王国历任大使名录。历任中国驻荷兰公使大清国出使荷蘭欽差大臣（1881年－1912年）清廷于光绪七年（1881年）以驻德国钦差大臣李凤苞兼辖荷兰国，是为清朝向荷兰国派驻使节之始。中华民国驻荷兰公使（1913年－1943年）
1912年1月1日，中华民国成立。2月12日，清帝退位，驻荷兰钦差大臣转为中华民国驻荷兰外交代表。1912年，民国政府任命魏宸组为驻荷兰公使，是为中华民国正式向荷兰派驻使节之始。
target_text: This list is the list of successive Chinese ambassadors to the Kingdom of the Netherlands (China, China, China, and the People’s Republic of China). On 12 February, the Chinese Minister of State in the Netherlands withdrew from office and the Minister of State in the Netherlands was transformed into a diplomatic representative of the Republic of China in the Netherlands. In 1912, the Government appointed Wei Gang as Minister of State in the Netherlands.
title: 中国驻荷兰大使列表

source_text:
历任中国驻荷兰大使中华民国驻荷兰大使（1943年－1950年）
1943年2月15日，中荷两国外交关系升格为大使级，驻荷兰公使金问泗升任驻荷兰大使。中华人民共和国驻荷兰代办（1954年－1972年）
1950年，荷兰王国政府承认新成立的中华人民共和国政府，断绝与中华民国政府的外交关系。1954年11月19日，荷兰与中华人民共和国达成建立代办级外交关系的协议，双方于对方首都互设代办处。
target_text: In 1950, the Government of the Kingdom of the Netherlands recognized the newly established Government of the People’s Republic of China and severed diplomatic relations with the Government of the Republic of China. On 19 November 1954, the Netherlands and the People’s Republic of China entered into an agreement to establish diplomatic relations at the acting level, with each party establishing an office in each other’s capital.
title: 中国驻荷兰大使列表

source_text:
中华人民共和国驻荷兰大使（1984年至今）
1984年2月1日，荷兰承诺不再对台军售，中华人民共和国与荷兰恢复大使级外交关系。另外自1997年5月起，駐荷蘭大使兼任常驻禁止化学武器组织代表团代表，就公约相关事务代表中国政府与禁止化学武器组织及其他缔约国代表团进行联系及交涉。
target_text: On 1 February 1984, the Ambassador of the People ' s Republic of China to the Netherlands (1984-present), the Netherlands undertook not to sell any more troops to Taiwan and the People ' s Republic of China resumed diplomatic relations with the Netherlands at the ambassadorial level. Since May 1997, Ambassador Holland has also represented the Permanent Mission of the People ' s Republic of China to the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons and has been in contact with delegations of the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons and other States parties on matters related to the Convention on behalf of the Chinese Government.
title: 中国驻荷兰大使列表

source_text:
C. 压重水式核反应堆（PHWR）
这是由加拿大设计出来的一种反应堆，也叫做CANDU，这种反应堆使用高压重水来进行冷却和减速。这种反应堆的核燃料不是装在单一压力舱中，而是装在几百个压力管道中。这種反应堆使用天然铀为核燃料，是一种热中子式核反应堆。这种反应堆可以在输出功率开到最大时添加核燃料，因此能高效利用核燃料（因为可作精确控制），並節省濃縮鈾的成本；只是重水很貴。大部分压重水式反应堆都位于加拿大，有一些出售到阿根廷、中国、印度（未加入防止核武器扩散条约）、巴基斯坦（未加入防止核武器扩散条约）、罗马尼亚和南韩。印度也在它的第一次核试爆后运行一些压重水式核反应堆（一般被称为“CANDU的变种”）。中国秦山核电站三期工程的反应堆为此型。
target_text: C. PHWR, a reactor designed by Canada and known as CANDU, uses high-pressure heavy water for cooling and deceleration. The reactor 's nuclear fuel is not installed in a single pressure chamber, but in hundreds of pressure pipelines. The reactor uses natural uranium as nuclear fuel, and is a thermal neutron nuclear reactor. This reactor can add nuclear fuel to maximum output power, so that it can efficiently use nuclear fuel (because it can be precisely controlled) and save the cost of entropy; only heavy water is expensive. Most heavy-water reactors are located in Canada, and some are sold to Argentina, China, India (not party to the Treaty on the Prevention of Nuclear Weapons Proliferation), Pakistan (not party to the Treaty on the Prevention of Nuclear Weapons Proliferation), Romania and South Korea.
title: 核動力

source_text: 为了预防核武器的扩散，国际原子能机构在1968年通过并实施了防止核武器扩散条约（NPT），条约规定签约国对于核技术必须采取保护措施。签约国被要求向国际原子能机构报告它们拥有的核材料的种类和位置。签约国还同意，为了能进入国际核市场，它们允许国际原子能机构派出调查员和监督员来确认它们关于核材料的报告，并且对它们的核材料进行检查。
target_text: In order to prevent the proliferation of nuclear weapons, the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) adopted and implemented in 1968 the Treaty on the Prevention of the Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), which provides that States parties must take measures to protect nuclear technology. The States parties are required to report to IAEA on the type and location of nuclear material in their possession. The States parties also agree that, in order to gain access to the international nuclear market, they allow IAEA to send investigators and monitors to confirm their reports on nuclear material and to inspect their nuclear material.
title: 核動力

source_text: 有些国家以前没有签署这项条约，并且有能力使用国际间援助的核技术（经常为民用）来发展核武器（印度、巴基斯坦、以色列和南非）。南非后来也成为了防止核武器扩散条约的签约国，现在它是世界上唯一已知发展了核武器并被证实将其销毁了的国家。在那些签署了这项条约并通过海运收到了一些零星的核材料的国家中，许多国家已经宣称或已被指责尝试着使用应为民用的核电站来发展武器，比如说伊朗和朝鲜。有些种类的核反应堆比其它种类更容易被用来制造核武器，而且国际上的一些关于核武器扩散的争论已经聚焦到了具有发展核武器的野心的国家中某些具体的反应堆型号上。
target_text: Some countries have previously not signed the Treaty and have been able to use internationally assisted nuclear technology (often for civilian use) to develop nuclear weapons (India, Pakistan, Israel, and South Africa). South Africa has since become a signatory to the Treaty on the Prevention of Nuclear Weapons Proliferation, now the only country in the world known to have developed nuclear weapons and proved to have destroyed them. Among the countries that have signed the Treaty and received sporadic nuclear material by sea, many have declared or have been accused of attempting to use nuclear power plants for civilian purposes to develop weapons, such as Iran and North Korea. Some types of nuclear reactors are more likely to be used to manufacture nuclear weapons than others, and some international debates about nuclear weapons proliferation have focused on specific reactor models in countries with ambitions to develop nuclear weapons.
title: 核動力

source_text: 1930年代末，一次彭文应访问朋友，正巧遇到周恩来到这位朋友家借钱，以解救被捕的革命同志，彭文应随即将自己的钱捐出。中国人民解放军占领上海后，在一次会议上，周恩来一眼便认出了彭文应，并将他介绍给时任上海市军管会主任的陈毅，嘱陈毅“要记住这位帮助过我们的朋友，在上海多关照他。”以后，彭文应和陈毅见过几次面。陈毅在调任国务院副总理兼外交部部长赴北京前夕，曾在上海举办告别招待会，又见到了彭文应，并邀彭文应赴北京时去他家作客。1950年代中期，陈毅在北京任国务院副总理兼外交部部长后，一次时任民盟上海市副主委的彭文应来北京开会，寓居东厂胡同民盟中央的客房，其间还曾赴陈毅专设的家宴。
target_text: In the late 1930s, Peng Wen should have visited his friend and come to the house to borrow money from him in order to rescue the arrested revolutionary comrade, and Peng Wen should have donated his own money. After the Chinese People’s Liberation Army occupied Shanghai, he identified him at a meeting and introduced him to Chen Ying, who was then the head of the Shanghai City Military Control Board, saying “Bearing in mind that he helped our friend and took care of him in Shanghai.” After that, Peng Wen and Chen Yi met several times. Chen Yi, on the eve of his appointment to Beijing as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the State Council, had a farewell reception in Shanghai, met with Peng Wen and invited him to visit his family when he was in Beijing. In the mid-1950, after serving as Deputy Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Beijing State Council, Penwen, who was then Vice-Minister of China’s Shanghai Association, was to attend a meeting in Beijing, where he was staying in a guest’s house in the center of the Democratic People’s Federation.
title: 彭文应

source_text:
考古发现
从1906年开始，德意志帝国考古协会开始在这里发掘，发现了许多楔形文字碑片，包括有契约、法律、预言等，最重要的发现是大约在公元前1283年赫梯王国和古埃及第十九王朝法老拉美西斯二世的和平条约，现在有一个复制品作为最早的国际和平条约范例放在纽约联合国总部。
target_text: Since 1906, the German Imperial Archaeology Association began to excavate here, and has discovered a number of crayons, including contracts, laws, prophecys, etc., the most important being the Treaty of Peace between the Kingdom of Hettie in 1283 B.C. and Pharaoh Rams II, the 19th dynasty of ancient Egypt, a replica of which is now available at United Nations Headquarters in New York as an example of the first international peace treaty.
title: 哈图沙

source_text: 1952年8月13日，董出任战后首任中华民国驻日本大使。1956年，董又受命出任中华民国驻美国大使。1958年，董卸职返台，任总统府资政，曾環島進行調研工作，瞭解基督教在台灣的教派發展、傳教、醫療、教育、社會福利等多方面現況分析。1970年，董移居美国，次年病逝于纽约。
target_text: On August 13, 1952, Dong was appointed as the first ambassador of the Republic of China to Japan after the war. In 1956, Dong was appointed Ambassador of the Republic of China to the United States. In 1958, he returned from his post as President of the Republic, and worked as a researcher on the island to understand the various aspects of the development of Christian sects in Taiwan, missionaries, medical treatment, education, social welfare, etc. In 1970, Dong emigrated to the United States and died the following year in New York.
title: 董显光

source_text:
条约结构
《奥地利国家条约》由序言和9部分组成：
政治及领土的规定
军事和关于空中交通的规定
战争赔款
四国占领军撤出奥地利
国家财产、国家权力和国家利益
经济联系
关于发生国际争端的规定
经济方面的规定
最后总结重點条约第4款关于缔约方面的限制：奥地利永远不能像以前那样同德国缔结任何形式的政治和经济同盟。
target_text: The Treaty of the Austrian Nation consists of a preamble and nine parts: political and territorial provisions; military and air traffic provisions; war compensation payments; withdrawal of the occupation forces of the four States from Austrian State property, State authority and national interests; economic provisions concerning the occurrence of international disputes; final summary of the limitations on the parties in paragraph 4 of the Treaty: Austria can never conclude any form of political and economic alliance with Germany, as it has done in the past.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 除了条约一般规定和对于国家承认之条款外，第7款又额外规定了在奥地利居住的克罗地亚和斯洛文尼亚少数民族的权利，但是此条款到如今也没有得到完全贯彻和实施。第9款中规定奥地利解散所有纳粹党组织，并且不允许在法律上重新認同纳粹和法西斯组织。
target_text: In addition to the general provisions of treaties and the provisions on State recognition, paragraph 7 provides additionally for the rights of the Croatian and Slovenian national minorities residing in Austria, but this provision has not been fully implemented and implemented to date. Paragraph 9 provides for the dissolution of all Nazi party organizations in Austria and does not allow for the legal rerecognition of Nazi and fascist organizations.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 1919年的哈布斯堡王朝的法典仍得以继续实施。奥地利签署条约在6个月内向苏联支付大约1亿5千万美元的战争赔款，并冻结由奥地利进行管理的德国人的财产。联军保证从奥地利撤军。因此奥地利郑重声明，在签署国家条约后自愿成为永久中立国。此声明不是国家条约之一部分，但是是紧密相连之談判條件。
target_text: Austria signed a treaty to pay about $150 million in war reparations to the Soviet Union and to freeze the property of Germans under Austrian administration. Coalition forces pledged to withdraw their troops from Austria. Austria therefore solemnly declared that it would voluntarily become a permanently neutral state after signing the national treaty. This declaration is not part of the national treaty, but is a closely linked bargain.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 在四国占领军的监督下，1947年1月战后第一届民选政府在伦敦试图同四国占领军交涉签署一个和平条约。从1947年3月谈判转到了莫斯科。奥地利谈判代表中以和尤利乌斯·拉布领导的奥地利人民党完全同意了苏联提出的要求，但是奥地利社会党的代表却同奥地利共产党人保持一定距离，并不想完全无条件接受苏联的条件。正是由于布鲁诺·克莱斯基（当时外交部的国务秘书）代表社会民主党，最终成功的是党内同僚们相信了正是因为该党的反苏联的态度阻止了谈判的进程。
target_text: Under the supervision of the occupation forces of the four countries, the first democratically elected government after the war in January 1947 tried to negotiate a peace treaty in London with the occupation forces of the four countries. Negotiations were transferred from March 1947 to Moscow.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 在《奥地利国家条约》的谈判中出现的问题是南斯拉夫联邦人民共和国对奥地利克恩滕州提出的领土要求。由于斯大林和铁托在1949年的冲突，使得此领土要求对苏联来讲变得不是很重要了，所以当时的边界并没有得以改变。而一戰後，奧匈帝國割予意大利之南蒂罗尔亦無易手。
target_text: The question that arose in the negotiations for the Austrian State Treaty was the territorial claim of the Federal People’s Republic of Yugoslavia against the Austrian province of Kranten. The territorial claim became irrelevant to the Soviet Union as a result of the 1949 conflict between Stalin and Tito, so that the borders did not change.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 谈判中最重要的议题是德国在奥地利的财产的问题。这包括了在德、奥1938年3月签署条约前德国公民所有的土地拥有权，还包括在德奥条约签署后从德国转移到奥地利的财产和由德国资本在奥地利建立的所有工业设施，以及德国人在1938年至1945年之间在奥地利所获得的所有财产（其中并不包括强迫购买和掠夺）。在苏占区内几乎全部的炼油工业，多瑙河船运公司和一系列的工业企业（大约有300家）全部作为德国的财产加以没收，交给了当时成立的苏联在奥地利财产管理委员会同意进行管理。
target_text: The most important issue in the negotiations was the issue of German property in Austria. This included ownership of land owned by German citizens prior to the signing of the treaty in Germany and O-O-1938, as well as property transferred from Germany to Austria after the signing of the treaty in O-O and all industrial facilities established in Austria by German capital, as well as all property acquired by Germans in Austria between 1938 and 1945 (which did not include forced purchase and looting). Almost all of the refining industries in the Soviet zone, the Danube Shipping Company and a series of industrial enterprises (approximately 300) were confiscated as German property and handed over to the then-established Soviet Property Management Board in Austria for management.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 在政治方面，因为苏联要求連綁同奥地利进行的谈判同德国与盟军进行的缔约谈判，阻止达成一个让各方满意的协议。由于冷战加剧，使得签署国家条约变得越来越渺茫。当艾森豪威尔接替杜鲁门成为美国总统后，再加上1953年斯大林去世，使得谈判气氛得以缓和。在尤利乌斯·拉贝同年成为奥地利联邦总理后，奥地利方面的谈判风格也为之一变。
target_text: At the political level, the climate was eased when Eisenhower succeeded Truman as President of the United States, together with Stalin’s death in 1953. When Julius Labbé became the Federal Chancellor of Austria in the same year, Austria’s negotiating style changed.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 奥地利于1954年1月25日至2月28日参加了在柏林举行的外长会议。苏联人继续坚持必须在满足一个前提条件后才能签署条约。此条件就是苏联军队在同德国签署了和平条约之后再由奥地利撤军。西方不同意此条件，奥地利也反对。作为另一个条件，苏联外长莫洛托夫提出奥地利必须成为一个中立国。西方担心他们在意大利的驻军会因为中立的瑞士和奥地利同他们在欧洲其他地区的驻军完全分割开来。以瑞士为榜样，奥地利同样成为一个中立国早在1945年至1950年由战后奥地利第一位民选总统卡尔·莱纳所提出，并得到了党内支持。
target_text: Austria participated in the meeting of foreign ministers held in Berlin from 25 January to 28 February 1954. Soviets continued to insist that a precondition must be met before a treaty can be signed. That condition was the withdrawal of Soviet troops from Austria after the signing of a peace treaty with Germany.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 当西德1954年加入北约后，关于奥地利完全主权的谈判继续在莫斯科进行。1955年3月奥地利政府代表团应苏联政府马林科夫的邀请下抵达莫斯科。代表团成员包括副总理阿道夫·希弗（Adorf Schärf）-奥地利社会民主党成员，外长列奥波德·菲格尔:奥地利人民党成员，国务秘书布鲁诺·克莱斯基，奥地利社会民主党，谈判代表为联邦总理尤利乌斯·拉贝-奥地利人民党成员。
target_text: Negotiations on Austria’s full sovereignty continued in Moscow when Sid joined NATO in 1954. In March 1955, a delegation of the Austrian government arrived in Moscow at the invitation of the Soviet Government’s administration, Malinkov. The delegation included Deputy Prime Minister Adolf Schärf – a member of the Austrian Social Democratic Party, Foreign Minister Leopold Figel: a member of the Austrian People’s Party, Secretary of State Bruno Klasky, the Austrian Social Democratic Party, and a member of the Federal Prime Minister, Julius Rabe-Austrian People’s Party.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 4月12日的会谈取得了重大突破，这被认为是奥地利永久中立的诞生日。苏联要求中立必须写进国家条约，他们认为永久中立是奥地利重新获得主权的先提条件。但是奥地利代表试图让对方相信只有一个主权国家才能决定一个具有法律效力的中立。最终谈判达成了一个结果：关于中立的法律应该由一个自由的独立的奥地利来颁布。在最终文件中，即莫斯科备忘录中规定奥地利将成为一个中立的国家，四个二战的战胜国将保证奥地利的领土和主权不被侵犯和损害。当1955年4月15日尤利乌斯·拉贝回到奥地利的时宣称：“奥地利将要自由了”。
target_text: The talks of 12 April made a major breakthrough, which was considered the birth date of Austria's permanent neutrality. The Soviet Union called for neutrality to be included in the national treaty, which they considered to be a prerequisite for Austria's re-establishment of sovereignty. But the Austrian representative tried to convince the other that only a sovereign state could determine a legally binding neutrality.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 条约签订正式签署《奥地利国家条约》当日，外长菲格尔仍然在维也纳进行最后的磋商，试图将有关奥地利在二战中的共同责任从条约的序言中删掉。1955年3月15日，关于战后重建一个独立的民主的奥地利的国家条约最终在维也纳的贝维蒂宫的大理石厅签署。签字后菲格尔由衷地说出了：“奥地利自由了”这句在奥地利近代政治史上最著名的一句话。
target_text: On 15 March 1955, the Austrian State Treaty on the post-war re-establishment of an independent democracy was finally signed in the Great Stone Hall of the Bewetti Palace in Vienna. After signing, the word “Austrian Freedom” was the most famous sentence in Austria’s recent political history.
title: 奥地利国家条约
