target_text: The signatories to the Austrian National Treaty are: Molotov (Minister for Foreign Affairs of the USSR), Ilichev (High Commissioner of the USSR Mission and Representative to Austria), Cameron (Minister for Foreign Affairs of the United Kingdom) (High Commissioner of the British Delegation and Ambassador to Austria), Dülles (Secretary of State of the United States), Little Tomson (High Commissioner of the United States Mission and Ambassador to Austria), Antoine Bine (Minister for Foreign Affairs of France), Laroy (High Commissioner of the French Delegation and Representative to Austria) Figel (Minister for Foreign Affairs of Austria)
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 《奥地利国家条约》于同年6月7日由议会批准。四国占领军以为要驻扎很长的时间，所以他们各自的军营里建立了许多家属区，比如在萨尔茨堡的美军罗德军营可容纳一万人。1955年9月最后的一名苏军士兵撤离了奥地利，10月25日西方盟军也撤出了奥地利。
target_text: The Austrian National Pact was ratified by Parliament on 7 June of the same year. The occupation forces of the four countries, believing that they would be stationed for a long time, had set up a number of family areas in their respective barracks, such as the United States Army Rhodes barracks in Salzburg, where 10,000 people could be accommodated.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 在1955年10月26日最后一名占领军士兵撤出奥地利时，奧地利國會通過中立宣言，並寫進聯邦憲法。声明中规定奥地利不会加入任何军事联盟，不允许外国在其领土上建立军事基地，奥地利将使用一切手段来维护本国的独立。从1965年后，每年10月26日成为了奥地利國慶日。1955年12月14日奥地利加入了联合国。
target_text: On 26 October 1955, when the last of the occupying forces withdrew from Austria, the Austrian Parliament adopted a declaration of neutrality, which was written into the Constitution of the Union. The statement stated that Austria would not join any military alliance and would not allow foreign countries to establish military bases on its territory, and that Austria would use all means to preserve its independence.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 签订了国家条约的奥地利成为了欧洲国家中从1945年至1989年第一个通过和平缔结条约的方式从占领军的手中解放出来的国家。在冷战时期，对国家条约中关于缔结条约的条款和此外的永久中立的解释不允许奥地利加入欧洲经济共同体。奧地利至今非北約成員。
target_text: Austria, which has signed national treaties, became the first of the European countries to be liberated from the occupation forces by the peaceful conclusion of treaties between 1945 and 1989. During the cold war, the provisions of national treaties on the conclusion of treaties and, in addition, the interpretation of permanent neutrality did not allow Austria to join the European Economic Community.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text: 1959年奥地利加入了欧洲贸易联合会，但是此组织由挪威、瑞典、丹麦、英国、葡萄牙和瑞士所建立。直到1995年奥地利成为了欧盟成员国。在2005年的周年庆典中，《奥地利国家条约》的证明文书的原件第一次从莫斯科外交部的档案馆运到了下奥地利州的莎拉城堡和维也纳的贝维蒂尔宫向公众公开展览。
target_text: Austria joined the European Trade Union in 1959, but this organization was established by Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Portugal and Switzerland. Until 1995, Austria became a member of the European Union.
title: 奥地利国家条约

source_text:
外交政策
伊利哈姆·阿利耶夫的外交致力於加強與歐盟的合作，加強與俄羅斯的經濟聯繫，加入北大西洋公約組織的獨立合作夥伴行動計劃，以及與伊斯蘭合作組織保持緊密關係。亞塞拜然政府利用國家的石油財富努力遊說外國，透過精密的洗黑錢以及行賄來收買歐洲政要，誘使官員發表有利或支持亞塞拜然政府的言論，大搞「魚子醬外交」。這在「亞塞拜然自助洗衣店」事件中曝光。
target_text: The foreign policy diplomacy of Eliham Aliyev is committed to strengthening cooperation with the European Union, strengthening economic ties with Russia, joining the North Atlantic Treaty Organization’s stand-alone partnership initiative, and maintaining close ties with the Islamic Cooperation Organization. Azerbaijan’s government is using the country’s oil wealth to talk abroad, laundering black money through precision and buying Europe’s political dignitaries through scavenging, enticing officials to speak out in favour of, or in support of, Azerbaijan’s government, and engaging in “fish sauce diplomacy.” This has come to light in the case of Azerbaijan’s self-service laundry.
title: 伊利哈姆·阿利耶夫

source_text: 1919年10月，威尔逊因中风而无法继续行使总统职责，由此引发的继任危机成为马歇尔担任副总统期间面临的最大挑战。威尔逊本人和第一夫人都不喜欢马歇尔，总统的顾问也认为副总统不是继任总统的恰当人选，他们因此和威尔逊夫人一起设法阻止马歇尔通过正式渠道得知总统病情，以此避免他继任。包括内阁成员及国会领导人在内的许多政要敦促马歇尔代理行使总统职责，但由于具体程序有欠明晰，担心确立影响恶劣的先例，马歇尔拒绝从命。行政部门群龙无首的情况导致组建国际联盟的条约无法通过，美国随即回归孤立主义外交政策。此外，马歇尔担任副总统期间还曾遭遇刺杀，他和夫人洛伊丝一直没有子女，只在担任副总统期间收养过一个病重的孩子。
target_text: Wilson himself and the First Lady did not like Marshall, and the President’s advisers agreed that the Vice-President was not the right person to succeed. They therefore joined Mrs. Wilson in trying to prevent Marshall from becoming aware of the President’s illness through official channels, thereby avoiding his succession. Many dignitaries, including cabinet members and congressional leaders, urged Marshall to assume the President’s role, but, given the lack of clarity of the process and the fear of establishing bad precedent.
title: 托马斯·R·马歇尔

source_text: 威尔逊派马歇尔到全美各地发表鼓舞士气的讲话，鼓励美国民众购买自由债卷支援战争。马歇尔非常擅长这份工作，担任副总统期间，他多次通过公开演说赚取外快，所以很乐于接受总统的委派。他在演讲中将这场战争比作旨在维护个人权利和国家尊严的道德十字军东征。马歇尔在回忆中称，一战令整个国家举步维艰，他直到战争结束时才缓过这口气。随着战争接近尾声，马歇尔成为美国历史上首位主持内阁会议的副总统，威尔逊当时正前往欧洲签署凡尔赛条约，并为组建国际联盟寻求支持，所以内阁会议方面职责就由副总统暂且代劳。威尔逊成为首位亲自将同他国缔结的条约送交参议院批准的美国总统，他在当天早上抵达国会参议院楼层，向主持会议的马歇尔递交文书。
target_text: In his speech, Wilson sent Marshall to the United States to make an inspiring speech, encouraging the American people to buy a free debt roll to support the war. Marshall was very good at this job, and during his vice presidentship, he earned a lot of extravagance through public speeches, so he was happy to accept the president’s appointment. He compared the war to a moral Crusade aimed at defending the rights and dignity of the individual. In his memoirs, Marshall said that World War I had made the entire country difficult, and that he did not stop until the end of the war. As the war drew to an end, Marshall became the first vice president in the history of the United States to preside over the Cabinet, and Wilson was on his way to Europe to sign the Versailles Treaty and seek support for the formation of the League of Nations.
title: 托马斯·R·马歇尔

source_text: 经第一夫人和总统私人医生的安排，威尔逊一直在静养，只有他的亲密助手可以前去面见，这些人都不会透露他的病情。马歇尔曾试图面见威尔逊，希望能借此亲自确认总统病情，但这显然也无法做到，以致他只能通过总统医生发布的少量公告获取一些用语模糊的最新进展。部分国会领导人认为总统及其助理不会自愿将权力移交副总统，因此开始起草马歇尔之前所说的联合决议案。但是，反对组建国际联盟的部分联邦参议员认为，如果马歇尔成为总统，他有可能会在部分关键位置做出妥协，促使建立国际联盟的条约通过。而当时的威尔逊既不愿意也没有可能来做妥协，这样针对条约的辩论也就陷入僵局。在这样的情况下，为了防止条约通过，反对组建国际联盟的参议员封杀了联合决议案。
target_text: Some congressional leaders, believing that the President and his assistant would not voluntarily hand over power to the Vice-President, began to draft what Marshall called a joint resolution. But, according to some federal senators opposed to forming an international coalition, he might compromise in some key places, leading to the adoption of a treaty establishing an international alliance. And Wilson was neither willing nor likely to compromise, so that the treaty debate would be stalled.
title: 托马斯·R·马歇尔

source_text: 马歇尔在余下的任期内只主持过一些礼仪性事务，如接待外国政要，首位到访美国的欧洲君主、比利时国王阿尔贝一世便是其中之一。威尔士亲王爱德华来访时和马歇尔共度了两天，马歇尔充当私人导游，带他游览哥伦比亚特区。白宫的大部分日常事务都由第一夫人伊迪丝代劳，她会审查威尔逊的所有通信，对哪些事项可以呈交总统，哪些要委托他人代劳做决定。这种群龙无首的局面导致授权组建国际联盟的条约无法通过，反对派批评其中的第10条会令美国同欧洲国家捆绑在一起，导致美国在未获国会授权的情况下被迫卷入战争。马歇尔本人支持条约通过，但也建议做出多项调整，如要求所有缔结国认可门罗主义和美国的影响范围，并将第十条改为不具备约束效力的条款。
target_text: For the remainder of her term, Marshall has only conducted some ceremonial matters, such as hosting foreign dignitaries, the first European monarch to visit the United States, King Albert I of Belgium. The Prince of Wales, Edward Edward, spent two days with Marshall, serving as a private tour guide to the District of Columbia. Most of the day-to-day business of the White House is examined by First Lady Edith DeLao, who reviews all of Wilson’s correspondence and decides on which matters to refer to the President and which to entrust to others. This conglomerate situation has led to the failure to pass the treaty authorizing the formation of the League of Nations, of which the opposition criticizes that article 10 binds the United States with European countries and has forced the United States into war without a congressional mandate.
title: 托马斯·R·马歇尔

source_text: 井上的德語、法語以及英语水平非常流利，曾擔任駐外武官多年。1919年至1921年，派赴駐瑞士大使館、駐德国大使館、等日本駐外機構，以及在和平条约实施委员会，从事了解德军武装。井上通曉德语，能不須翻译官与德国当局交涉，亦能为英軍军官做翻译。1921年12月1日，晋升海军少佐。1922年3月1日，任轻巡洋舰“球磨”航海长兼分队长，参与出兵西伯利亚干涉俄国内战的警备行动。1922年，入海军大学甲种班第22期，1924年毕业时成绩在21人中排第3名，后入海军省军务局第一课任职。1925年12月1日，晋升海军中佐。1927年（昭和2年）11月至1929年，在日本驻意大利大使馆任海军武官，直到40歲才返回日本。1929年11月30日，晋升海军大佐。因井上照顾結核病的妻子要求在陆上任闲职，1930年转任海军大学教官。
target_text: In 1919-1921, he was sent to the Embassy of Switzerland, to the Embassy of Germany, to the Japanese Foreign Service, and to the Peace Treaty Implementation Committee, where he was involved in understanding the German army. He was able to speak German without having to be consulted by a translator with the German authorities, as well as to translate it for British military officers. On 1 December 1921, he was promoted to the Navy Major General. On 1 March 1922, he served as the captain and sub-manager of the light cruiser, and took part in the preparation of the army's intervention in the Russian civil war. In 1922, he served as a naval attaché at the Embassy of Japan in Italy until his return to Japan at the age of 40.
title: 井上成美

source_text: 西方政府呼吁对这起事件进行国际调查导致了乌兹别克斯坦外交政策的重大转变。在事件之后，乌兹别克斯坦的外交方向转向了亚洲国家，虽然乌兹别克斯坦和美国政府的关系很密切，并且布什政府声称该国对美国的国家安全很重要，因为该国将汗阿巴德军事基地租借给美国军队。在事件之后，乌兹别克斯坦政府下令关闭汗阿巴德军事基地，并且加强了和中国及俄罗斯的关系，这两个国家都支持该国政府在该事件上的应对措施。
target_text: Following the events, Uzbekistan’s diplomatic orientation turned to Asian countries, despite the close ties between Uzbekistan and the United States Government, and the Bush administration’s claim that the country was important to United States national security because it leased the Khan Abad military base to United States troops. Following the events, the Uzbek government ordered the closure of the Khan Abad military base and strengthened relations between China and Russia, both of which supported the government’s response to the events.
title: 安集延事件

source_text: 德国外长弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔在2007年3月会见了乌兹别克斯坦外长弗拉迪米尔·诺罗夫。他告诉诺罗夫在5月5日布鲁塞尔举行的欧盟外长峰会上各国外长呼吁乌兹别克斯坦政府应该允许国际红十字会探视该国境内的囚犯。 在8月6日至9日施泰因迈尔再次访问乌兹别克斯坦以进一步评估经济制裁的效果及如何发挥效果的。3月27日至28日，在哈萨克斯坦首都阿斯塔纳，一名欧盟代表与中亚各国官员举行了会晤。在此期间诺罗夫强调各国必须尊重乌兹别克斯坦的主权。欧盟中亚地区事务特别代表皮埃尔·莫瑞尔声称继续进行会谈将是具有积极意义的。
target_text: The Foreign Minister of Germany, Frank-Walter Steinmeer, met with the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Uzbekistan, Vladimir Norov, in March 2007. He told Norov that, at the European Union Foreign Ministers Summit held in Brussels on 5 May, he had called on the Government of Uzbekistan to allow the International Committee of the Red Cross to visit prisoners in the country.
title: 安集延事件

source_text: 下表为最新世界上所有国家（地区）的人类发展指数列表。最新的人类发展报告为《2020年人类发展报告》，由联合国开发计划署公布于2020年12月15日，实际上是在2019年数据的估计基础上编制的。2020年报告涵盖了189个国家或地区，包括香港和巴勒斯坦国。最新报告中并未统计北韓、摩纳哥、諾魯、圣马力诺、索马里、圖瓦盧、梵蒂冈、波多黎各、美属维尔京群岛等，但这些国家或地区的官方统计单位独立提供的人类发展指数附加于联合国列表之下以供参考。有7个联合国成员由于缺乏数据而未列入此表。世界平均数值和一些国家联合组织的数值也列入了此表，以便对比。
target_text: The most recent Human Development Report 2020, published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) on 15 December 2020, is based on estimates of 2019 data. The 2020 report covers 189 countries or areas, including Hong Kong and the State of Palestine. The most recent report does not include statistics on North Korea, Monaco, Nolu, San Marino, Somalia, Tuvalu, Vatican, Puerto Rico, the United States Virgin Islands, etc., but the human development index provided independently by official statistical offices in those countries or regions is attached to the United Nations list for information purposes. Seven United Nations members are not included in the table because of lack of data. World averages and figures from a number of joint organizations are included in the table for comparison purposes.
title: 各國人類發展指數列表

source_text: 人口根据联合国《世界人口展望(2019)》，2019年撒哈拉以南非洲人口为11亿。目前的增长率为2.3%。联合国预测，到2050年该地区人口将达到20亿至25亿 ，人口密度为每平方千米80人。与之相比，届时西欧、亚洲和美洲的人口密度将分别为每平方公里170人、140人和30人。撒哈拉以南非洲国家在生育率最高的50个国家和地区中占40个，2008年总和生育率均大于4。除南非和塞舌尔外，其他国家均高于世界平均水平。 除南非以外的撒哈拉以南国家（亦包括苏丹），其中40%以上的人口年龄在15岁以下。
target_text: According to the United Nations World Population Prospects (2019), the population of sub-Saharan Africa stood at 1.1 billion in 2019. The current growth rate is 2.3 per cent. The United Nations projects that the population of the region will reach between 2 billion and 2.5 billion by 2050, with a population density of 80 per square kilometre. By comparison, the population density will be 170, 140 and 30 per square kilometre in Western Europe, Asia and the Americas, respectively. Sub-Saharan African countries account for 40 of the top 50 countries and territories, with total fertility rates greater than 4 in 2008.
title: 撒哈拉以南非洲

source_text:
太空目標
强化本国在太空的领先地位，并确保太空能力能够促进美国的国家安全、本土安全及外交政策目标；
使美国在太空中的行动不受干扰地进行，以捍卫本国的利益；
实行并维持创新性人类及机械开发项目，目的是扩展人类在太阳系中的存在范围；
增加民用开发、科学探索和环境行为带来的利益；
建立一个有活力和具有全球竞争力的国内商用太空区段，以促进创新、强化美国的领先地位，以及维护国家、本土和经济安全；
建立一个活力充沛的科学技术基础，支持国家安全、本土安全以及民用太空行为；
鼓励与外国和/或团体进行国际合作，进行互利的太空行为，进一步促进对太空的和平开发利用，同时推进国家安全、本土安全及外交政策目标。
target_text: Space objectives strengthen national space leadership and ensure that space capabilities contribute to the national security, home-grown security and foreign policy objectives of the United States; Make United States action in space work undisturbed to defend national interests; Implement and maintain innovative human and mechanical development projects aimed at expanding the scope of human presence in the solar system; Increase the benefits of civilian development, scientific exploration and environmental behaviour; Create a dynamic and globally competitive domestic commercial space zone to promote innovation, strengthen American leadership and maintain national, indigenous and economic security; Establish a dynamic science and technology base that supports national security, home-grown security and civil space behaviour; Encourage mutually beneficial space practices with foreign countries and/or groups and further the peaceful development and use of space while advancing national security, home-grown security and foreign policy objectives.
title: 美国太空政策

source_text: 膛线下陷中空的地方称作阴线或阴膛（groove，在多边形膛线中则称为valley），凸起部分成为阳线或阳膛（land，在多边形膛线中称为hill），枪支的书面口径通常指的是一条阳线与其正对面的另一条阳线间的距离，因此子弹弹头的直径通常大于枪管阳线的直径而接近阴线的直径。
target_text: The area below the rebar is called the vaginal or pubic (groove, or the valley in the polygon line) and partly the radial or ulcer (land, or the hill in the polygon line), and the written calibre of the firearm usually refers to the distance between an ulcer and the other ulcer opposite it, so that the diameter of the bullet warhead is usually greater than the diameter of the ulcer and close to the ulcer.
title: 膛線

source_text:
多边形膛线
尽管多边形膛线（polygonal rifling）很早就出现了，但是在19世纪末线状无烟火药弹药刚出现时就已经很少使用。多边形膛线的原理最早是在1853年由著名的英国发明家约瑟夫·惠特沃思爵士（Sir Joseph Whitworth，1803～1887）提出的。当时惠特沃思正在试验在火炮上应用六边形炮管，并且在1854年申请了专利，但是英国军方在1856年拒绝采用他的设计，惠特沃思因此转而将设计应用到了步枪上试图取代当时服役的1853式恩菲尔德步枪。南北战争时期，南军的神枪手使用装配了多边形枪管的在战场上取得了很大成功，甚至在的距离外一击狙杀了北军在战争中阵亡的最高将领约翰·塞奇威克将军（John Sedgwick，1813～1864，生前最后一句话是“这么远的距离，他们连大象都打不到”）。惠特沃思步枪远超同时期其他枪型（比如夏普斯步枪）的远程精度使其成了“神枪手”的代名词，并且被后世定义为最早的一款真正意义上的狙击步枪。
target_text: The principle of the polygonal cord was first proposed by Sir Joseph Whitworth, 1803-1887, the famous British inventor in 1853, when Whitworth was experimenting with the use of a six-sided barrel on a cannon and applied for a patent in 1854, but the British military refused to use his design in 1856, and Whitworth turned the design into an attempt to replace the 1853-type Enfield rifle that was serving at that time. During the North-South War, the South Army's sharpshooters used the polygon tubes to achieve a great success on the battlefield, even when they killed the North from a distance, and the top of the army was patented in 1854, General John Sedgwick, 1813-1864.
title: 膛線

source_text: 最后两款大批量使用的多边形膛线步枪是英国的李-梅特福步枪（Lee-Metford rifle）和日本的有坂铳。当线状无烟火药开始取代黑火药时，因为当时用来制作李-梅特福枪管的金属材料太软，膛喉磨损情况太严重无法适应新式火药，因此整个多边形膛线枪管设计被取缔，在西方几乎销声匿迹，李-梅特福步枪也随即被改制成了传统膛线的李-恩菲尔德步枪。而东方的情况则相反，有坂铳设计则通过后续的三八式步枪不断证明了其在战场上的耐用性和精度，从日俄战争和一战开始一直坚持到了二战结束才退出历史舞台。
target_text: The last two large-scale polyclinic rifles were the British Lee-Metford rifle and Japan’s. When line-free powder began to replace black powder, the metal material used to make the Lee-Metford barrel was too soft, its throat was too heavy to adapt to the new gunpowder, and the entire polycrocial barrel was deactivated in the West, and the Lee-Metford rifle was transformed into a conventional rifle.
title: 膛線

source_text: 第二次世界大战期间，因为纳粹德国为了能够快速生产大量可靠耐用的枪管而开始批量使用新发明的冷锻法，多边形膛线又重出江湖出现在MG42机枪上。二战结束后，许多德国的军火商还在继续推出有多边形膛线的枪械，比如莱茵金属的MG3通用机枪，以及黑克勒&科赫的G3A3自动步枪、SL7半自动步枪和著名的PSG-1半自动狙击步枪。许多以手枪设计著名的欧洲公司，比如黑克勒&科赫、格洛克、乌尔斯基·布罗德、瓦尔特等，都推出了多边形手枪管，使得多边形膛线的设计开始变得更加多样化。
target_text: During the Second World War, many German arms dealers continued to launch multiple-barrel guns, such as the MG3 utility machine gun for Rhine Metals and the G3A3 automatic rifle for Hekler and Koch, the SL7 semi-automatic rifle and the famous PSG-1 semi-automatic sniper rifle. Many well-known European companies designed with pistols, such as Hekle & Koch, Ulsky Brodt and Valpri, introduced poly-barrel tubes, which began to diversify their designs.
title: 膛線

source_text:
而更支持传统膛线的人则指出多边形膛线的不足之处有：
制造上依赖冷锻法，因而器材上的初期投资过于昂贵，而且需要做复杂的高温处理，使得中小型规模的制造厂家（绝大多数枪匠）出于成本无法染指
因为多边形膛线对弹头的接触面更大，如果使用无背甲的铅弹头，铅粉更容易“涂抹”囤积在膛壁上，因而增加膛壁的摩擦系数和发射时的膛压，使得理论上的炸膛风险更高。虽然没有任何实际依据证明是否所有的多边形设计的积铅率都高，推广多边形枪管最为积极的格洛克公司出于谨慎已经公开告知用户避免使用裸露的铅弹头
多边形膛线对弹头压划造成的形变大大低于传统膛线，因此会使得法医学上的弹道鉴定更为困难，增加对枪支犯罪侦查的难度并降低执法机构的办案效能。不過在戰場上這並不會造成困擾。
target_text: In contrast, those who are more supportive of traditional Ripwires point to the shortcomings of polycrackers: manufacturing reliance on cold exercise makes initial investment in equipment too expensive and requires complex high-temperature treatment, making small- and medium-sized manufacturers (the vast majority of gunmakers) untraceable for cost reasons because of greater exposure to warheads by polycryptal cords, the “painting” of lead powders on the wall would make it easier to “paint” and thus increase the friction coefficient of the wall and the burst pressure at the time of launch, making the theoretical risk of explosion even more difficult. While there is no practical basis to prove that all polyclinic designs have high lead rates, the promotion of the most active gun tubes would not cause a significant reduction in the shape of the polycracker than the conventional barline, which would make it more difficult for forensic ballistics to identify, make it more difficult to detect firearms and reduce the effectiveness of law enforcement agencies.
title: 膛線

source_text:
家庭
叶礼庭許多祖先都是加拿大和俄羅斯著名歷史人物。其曾祖父及祖父均世襲伯爵爵位。曾祖父尼古拉·伊格那提耶夫是沙皇亞歷山大三世的第一任內政大臣。祖父保羅·伊格納蒂夫是末代沙皇尼古拉二世的最後一任教育大臣，也是唯一未被革命黨在十月革命中槍決的沙俄末朝大臣，並於1925年攜同一家抵達加拿大。父親佐治·伊格納蒂夫在加拿大聯邦政府任職外交官，其後一路遷升，仕途順遂，曾任加拿大駐南斯拉夫、北約以及駐聯合國大使。
target_text: His great-grandfather, Nicola Ignatiev, was the first Home Secretary of the Tsar Alexander III. His great-grandfather, Paul Ignatif, was the last Minister of Education of the late Tsar Nicholas II, the only Minister of Education who had not been shot by the Revolutionary Party during the October Revolution, and joined the same family who arrived in Canada in 1925.
title: 葉禮庭

source_text:
婚後生活
蔣孝武曾經擔任過駐新加坡商務副代表、駐日代表等職，蔡惠媚也成為外交官夫人，由於年紀輕閱歷淺，因此在一些交際宴會上，蔡惠媚多半是文靜地坐在一旁，並不健談，缺少外交官夫人「人來熟」的親和力。不過，由於蔡惠媚的英語十分流利，隨著歷練的增多，也逐漸適應自己的角色與工作。
target_text: After marriage, Xiaoqiao Wu used to serve as Vice-Minister of Business and Resident Representative in Singapore, and as a diplomat ' s wife, Chei Hye-mye also became a diplomat 's wife, as a result of her low age, Tsai Hye-mye sat at some of the parties in a quiet manner, without talking, and lacked the diplomatic wife’s “good-known” affinity. However, the English language of Choi Hue-mye was very fluent, and, as he gained experience, was adapting to his role and work.
title: 蔡惠媚

source_text: 1839年到1842年，英國發動鸦片战争，清廷戰敗。南京条约签订，清朝被迫五口通商並割佔香港島。1853年4月27日英国驻华公使文翰爵士赴南京访问刚刚成立不久的太平天国。1856年到1860年，英國發動第二次鸦片战争（英法聯軍之役）。英國在此役將已割佔的香港島對岸九龍界限街以南同樣割佔。1876年，中国在伦敦设立永久性大使馆，首任公使郭嵩焘。这也是中国在境外的第一个大使馆。
target_text: Between 1839 and 1842, the British war on opium was waged and the Qing Empire was defeated. The Nanjing Treaty was signed, forcing the Qing Dynasty to trade with five people and take over Hong Kong. On April 27, 1853, the British Minister of State in China, Sir Wenhan, visited the recently established Pacific State. From 1856 to 1860, the UK launched the second opium war (the British French-French coalition campaign), where the British took the same position south of the already-deposited Hong Kong island’s Nine Dragon Boulevard Street. In 1876, China established a permanent embassy in London, the first of its kind. This was also China’s first embassy abroad.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 1886年，中英缅甸条约在英國倫敦簽訂。中國承認英國在緬甸的一切權利。。1890年，中英藏印条约在英屬印度簽訂，包括錫金，藏印邊界等問題。中國承認錫金為英國保護國，但藏印邊界問題並未完全解決。在1893年中英藏印续约簽訂後，英屬印度與中國邊界大致確定。1898年，中英展拓香港界址专条簽訂，英國在香港的殖民地由香港島、九龍界限街以南擴展至新九龍和新界。同時，英國租借威海及周圍地區，是稱英屬威海衛。1900年：义和团运动。1901年：辛丑条约。
target_text: In 1886, the Treaty of Central and British Myanmar was signed in London, United Kingdom. China recognized all the rights of the United Kingdom in Myanmar. In 1890, the Treaty of Central and British Tibet was signed in British India, including Sikjin, and the Tibetan border. China recognized Sikkim as a British protector, but the issue of the Tibetan border was not fully resolved. Following the signing of the contract of 1893, the British border between India and China was more or less certain. In 1898, the British colony in Hong Kong was signed in Hong Kong from the island of Hong Kong, south of Kowloon Boulevard Street, to the New Nine Dragons and New Territories.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 中華民國大陸時期1911年，辛亥革命时期，英国公使朱尔典支持袁世凯东山再起。1922年，英、美、中等九國於華盛頓會議签署《关于中国事件应适用各原则及政策之条约》（九國公約），英、美均支持確認尊重中国的主权的独立與领土完整，限制各国在中国的特權。
target_text: In 1911, the Chinese mainland, during the Xinhe Revolution, British Minister Jules – who supported the re-emergence of Yuan Kedong Hill – signed the Treaty on Principles and Policies Applicable to Chinese Events in 1922 in Washington, D.C. In 1922, the British, American, and Middle Nine countries signed the Treaty on Principles and Policies Governing China’s Events (the Nine Nations Treaty). The British and the United States supported the affirmation of respect for China’s sovereign independence and territorial integrity and the restriction of China’s prerogatives.
title: 中英关系

source_text:
中華人民共和國時期
1950年1月6日，英國與中華民國斷交，承認中華人民共和國，為首個承認中華人民共和國的歐洲的非社會主義國家。当日，時任英国驻华领事高来含（W.G.Graham）向中华人民共和国外交部办公厅主任王炳南面交英国外交大臣贝文致中国总理兼外长周恩来的外交照会，内称：大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国政府自本日起承认中华人民共和国中央人民政府“为中国之合法政府”，“已准备与中央人民政府建立外交关系”。同时，高来含还向王炳南口头说明：英政府“声明取消对国民党政府之承认”；“英政府已指派现在南京的胡阶生秘书，作为过渡时期临时代办，来京与中国政府商谈指派大使及其他事项”，并要求“得到外交特权，其中包括外交礼遇、豁免等”。
target_text: On 6 January 1950, the United Kingdom and the Chinese People’s Republic of China broke up their relations and recognized the Central People’s Republic of China as the first non-social state in Europe to recognize the Chinese People’s Republic of China. On that day, W.G. Graham, then British Consul in China, presented to Wang Bing, Director-General of the Foreign Office of the People’s Republic of China, a diplomatic note addressed to the Chinese Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs, Zhou En, stating that the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland had since recognized that the Central People’s Government of the People’s Republic of China was “ready to establish diplomatic relations with the Central People’s Government”. At the same time, the British Government “declared its recognition of the National Party Government”; “The British Government has appointed the current Secretary of Nanjing, as Chargé d’affaires a.i., to negotiate with the Chinese Government on the appointment of ambassadors and other matters”, and requested “diplomatic privileges, including diplomatic courtesy, immunities, etc.”.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 1月9日，中国总理兼外长周恩来复照英国外交大臣贝文表示“愿在平等、互利及相互尊重领土主权的基础上与贵国建立外交关系，并且接受阁下所指定为临时代办的胡阶森先生”为“建交谈判的代表”，中方“当给予胡阶森先生及其随员以及档案自南京迁来北京所需之一切便利。”然而，英国政府对于周恩来外长的复照只接受胡阶森为英国政府代表来京谈判建立外交关系问题不理解，认为两国外长换文本身已构成外交关系的建立。中国政府主张经过谈判，在明确英方对台湾当局的态度后方可建交。对此，英国政府同意与中方先谈判。中国政府给留在北京的英国谈判代表以外交人员的待遇。1950年3月2日，中华人民共和国外交部副部长章汉夫与英国过渡时期的临时代办胡阶森进行了谈判，3月17日，胡阶森答复章汉夫，称英国政府已在1950年1月6日撤销对前中华民国政府之承认，并于同日通知中华人民共和国予以法律上之承认；由该日起，对前国民党政府已无外交关系存在；在伦敦前中国大使馆已行封闭而前大使已不享受外交官之身份。
target_text: On 9 January, the Chinese Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs, Zhou En, echoed the British Foreign Secretary's statement, “willing to establish diplomatic relations with your country on the basis of equality, mutual benefit and mutual respect for the sovereignty of the Territory, and accepting what you refer to as the Chargé d'affaires, Mr. Hodson, as “representatives of the peace negotiations”, and the Chinese side “shall be given all the facilities necessary for Mr. Hudson and his companions, as well as the archives, to move from Nanjing to Beijing.” However, on 2 March 1950, the British Government negotiated the return of the Foreign Minister of the People's Republic of China, only to accept that the exchange of letters between the Foreign Ministers of the two countries would constitute in itself the establishment of diplomatic relations. The Chinese Government argued that the former Government would withdraw its recognition of the former Government of the Republic of China on 6 January 1950, and informed the People's Republic of China of its legal recognition of the fact that the former diplomatic ambassador of the People's Republic of China had no diplomatic relations with the former Chinese Embassy;
title: 中英关系

source_text: 1954年，中国总理兼外交部长周恩来率政府代表团出席第一次日内瓦会议期间，于4月30日，周恩来同英国外交大臣安東尼·艾登会面，就中英关系问题交换了意见。5月3日，中国外交部欧非司司长宦乡与英国驻华临时代办杜维廉会面。双方代表团高层人员随后又多次见面。1954年6月17日，中国与英国发表联合公报，建立代办级外交关系。其任务是继续谈判两国的完全建交以及处理两国的侨务和贸易问题。这是世界上首例“半建交”的国家之间的外交关系。同年8月，英国前首相、工党领袖克莱门特·艾德礼访问中国。同样在1954年，伦敦出口公司（London Export Corporation）董事长杰克·佩里率领的48位英国工商界代表访问北京，推动次年中英双方在莫斯科国际经济会议上签订《中英贸易协定》。
target_text: In 1954, the Chinese Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs, Zhou Enlai, led a delegation of the Government to attend the first Geneva meeting. On 30 April, Zhou Enlai met with British Foreign Secretary Anthony Aiden to exchange views on the issue of Chinese-British relations. On 3 May, the Chief of the Department of Foreign Affairs of China’s Europe-Africa Department met with British Chargé d’affaires Duvelian. The two delegations met several times later. On 17 June 1954, China issued a joint communiqué with the United Kingdom to establish diplomatic relations at the level of Chargé d’affaires. The mission was to continue negotiations on the full establishment of relations between the two countries and on the issue of diasporas and trade between the two countries. This was the world’s first “semi-establishment” country. In August of the same year, the former British Prime Minister and head of the Labour Party, Clemente Edre, visited China. Also in 1954, 48 representatives of the British business community, led by London Export Corporation, visited Beijing to promote the signing of the China-China Trade Agreement at the next year’s International Economic Conference in Moscow.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 1967年，文化大革命期間，發生火燒英國代辦處事件。1971年1月15日，中国驻英临时代办裴坚章向英外交部驻议会次官罗伊尔进行新任到任拜会时，罗伊尔提出中英两国应该建立大使级外交关系。3月2日，中国国务院总理周恩来会见英国驻华代办谭森，提出中英全面建交互换大使的三点要求：
target_text: On January 15, 1971, when the Chinese Chargé d’affaires of the United Kingdom paid a new visit to the British Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ Under-Secretary of State in Parliament, Royer proposed that China and the United Kingdom should establish diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level. On March 2, China’s State Council Premier Zhou Enlai came to meet with the British Chargé d’affaires in China, Tanson, and put forward a three-point request for an interactive exchange of ambassadors between China and the United Kingdom:
title: 中英关系

source_text: 2014年，香港發生佔領中環及其衍生之雨傘革命。英國下議院外交委員會成員準備前往香港調查《中英聯合聲明》落實情況時被中國拒絕入境，中方指英國干涉中國內政。事件造成兩國一定程度上的外交角力。同年6月，中國國務院總理李克強偕同夫人程虹訪英。
target_text: In 2014, there was a revolution in Hong Kong that took over the center ring and its derivative umbrella. Members of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the United Kingdom’s House of Commons were refused entry by China when they were planning to visit Hong Kong to investigate the status of the U.S.C. Statement, referring to British interference in China’s internal affairs.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 2019年6月至7月，英國表示密切關注香港發生一系列的示威活動，並重申《中英聯合聲明》仍然有效。中國外交部發言人指英國無權干預香港的內部事務。英國外交部傳召中國駐英大使劉曉明，指有關言論是「不可接受的」。2018年11月，英国约克公爵安德鲁王子、国际贸易大臣福克斯率团出席首届中国国际进口博览会。
target_text: In June-July 2019, the United Kingdom expressed its close attention to a series of demonstrations in Hong Kong and reiterated that the Chinese-British United Statement remained in force. The Chinese Foreign Ministry stated that the United Kingdom had no authority to intervene in Hong Kong’s internal affairs.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 2021年2月4日，中华人民共和国外交部发表声明，批评英国广播公司同年1月29日播出2019冠状病毒病中国大陆疫情的“假新闻”，翻炒疫情“隐瞒论”、“源头论”、“责任论”，还将一段反恐演习视频作为中国防疫部门“暴力执法、侵犯人权”的证据，“是典型的带有意识形态偏见的假新闻，影响恶劣”，就此向BBC驻北京分社提出严正交涉。随后，英国通讯管理局于2月4日吊销中国环球电视网（CGTN）执照，理由拥有执照的星空华文传媒对CGTN播出频道无实质控制权，只是CGTN在英分销商，非服务提供者。违反相关规定，即“广播执照持有者必须对获得许可的服务有控制权，包括对其播放的节目进行编辑监督”。另外，针对星空华文传媒申请转接中国环球电视网络公司执照一事，英国通讯管理局不予批准，指申请缺乏关键信息，且环球电视公司由中国中央电视台和中国共产党控制。另外，声明认为CGTN在报道香港反修例运动时有失公允，违反通讯管理局的《广播规则》，有鉴于上述违规行为存在严重性，管理局决定实施制裁，具体措施将很快公布。2月5日，CGTN发表声明回应，对通讯管理局的裁定表示遗憾及坚决反对。声明指，2020年初，英国通信管理局在“极右翼组织及反华势力的操作下”，突然对CGTN英语频道在英国落地许可发起调查，CGTN随后向管理局进行详细解释说明，落地许可转持建议。
target_text: On 4 February 2021, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China issued a statement criticizing the BBC for broadcasting “false news” of the epidemic on mainland China of 2019 coronary viral disease on 29 January of the same year, rebuffing the epidemic “hidden theory”, “source theory”, “responsibility theory” and using a video of anti-terrorist exercises as evidence of “violent enforcement of laws and human rights violations” by the Chinese defence sector, “typically ideologically biased news” which affected the BBC branch in Beijing. The British Communications Authority subsequently revoked the licence of China's Global Television Network (CGTN) on 4 February, citing the lack of substantive control of the CGTN broadcasting channel by the licensed Stars and the lack of critical information by CGTN in the United Kingdom and by non-service providers.
title: 中英关系

source_text: 然而，通讯管理局以CGTN存在“政治属性”为由，拒绝许可转持，并吊销执照。同日的中国外交部例行记者会上，外交部发言人汪文斌坚决反对通讯管理局吊销CGTN执照，认为英方一方面标榜新闻自由，另一方面罔顾事实阻挠CGTN在英落地，是赤裸裸的双重标准和政治打压，严重损害中国媒体声誉，严重干扰两国间正常的人文交流。他敦促英方立即停止政治操弄，纠正错误，同时称中方保留作出必要反应的权利，维护中国媒体的正当权益。2月11日，中国国家广播电视总局宣布禁止英國廣播公司世界新聞頻道在中国落地播出，指英国广播公司的涉华报道有关内容严重违反《广播电视管理条例》及《境外卫星电视频道落地管理办法》。
target_text: At a regular press conference in the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the same day, Wang Wenbin, the spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, strongly opposed the suspension of the CGTN licence, arguing that the British side, on the one hand, had displayed freedom of the press and, on the other hand, ignored the fact that it had prevented CGTN from landing in China, constituted a blatant double standard and political pressure, seriously damaged the reputation of the Chinese media and seriously disrupted normal human-language exchanges between the two countries. He urged the British side to immediately stop political manipulation and correct errors, while stating that the Chinese side reserved the right to react as necessary and upheld the legitimate rights and interests of the Chinese media. On 11 February, China’s National Radio and Television Administration announced that the British Broadcasting Corporation’s World News Channel had been banned from broadcasting in China.

source_text: 2023年3月13日，英國政府發布更新版《安全、防務、發展與外交政策綜合評估》報告，報告把中國定位為「劃時代挑戰」。中國駐英國大使館表示英國此舉是對中國進行攻擊抹黑，中方對此強烈不滿、堅決反對。2023年6月下旬，中国解放军防务战略磋商代表团访问英国，并在伦敦与英国国防部进行防务战略对话。双方讨论了关于国防战略、乌克兰局势、印度太平洋安全、战略稳定与扩散、南海和台海冲突等问题。

target_text: On 30 August 2023, British Foreign Secretary James Cliveli visited China and met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, the first visit of British Foreign Secretary Wang Yi since 2018. source_text:
宗主权（）是指一個國家代表其屬國或附庸國處理外交事務的權力，宗主權下，属国對其內政仍具主權（或稱自治）。行使這種權力的國家普遍被稱為「宗主国」。定義
「宗主權」一詞原是用作闡明和解釋封建領主與諸侯關係，當中領主普遍被視作封臣的「宗主」。
target_text: Monarchy () refers to the power of a country to represent its own country or dependent country in the conduct of foreign affairs, which, under its sovereignty, remains sovereign (or self-governing) over its internal affairs. A country exercising such power is generally referred to as the “dominant state.” The term “dominant power” was used to clarify and explain the relationship between the feudal lord and the confederates.
title: 宗主权

source_text: 現代國際法體系成型初期，「宗主權」一詞則用來介定鄂圖曼帝國及屬國的關係。與主權下的領土、屬土不同，宗主權下的屬國對其內政擁有最高權力。個別例子中，屬國甚至具某種程度的國際法人（International personality）地位，能夠與外國進行非外交性（例如商務、交通、郵政）的交流，甚至直接跟外國簽署相關條約。學者普遍認為，用現代國際法去解釋宗主和屬國的關係具一定難度。
target_text: In the early years of the modern international legal system, the term “patriarchy” was used to define relations between the Ottoman Empire and its constituent states. Unlike the dominant lands and territories, the sovereign states have the highest power over their internal affairs. In other cases, the status of an international legal person, even to a certain extent, allows for non-diplomatic exchanges with foreign countries (e.g. business, traffic, postage) and even direct agreements with foreign countries.
title: 宗主权

source_text:
歐洲國家常用宗主關係和有限主權論，形容清朝和其週邊國家的關係。譬如李氏朝鮮、越南阮朝等等。向中国朝廷朝贡的国家，因中国并不能干预其对外交往，被国际法视为独立国家。朝鮮
從李成桂立國之始，就派使節到明朝，擬兩個國號方案「朝鮮」（古朝鮮國名）和「和寧」（李成桂之父李子春就仕之地）奏請明太祖朱元璋裁定，朱元璋圈定朝鮮二字，於是開始以「朝鮮」為國名。朝鮮是明朝和清朝的藩国，直至中日甲午戰爭為止。

印度錫金王國
緊接著印度1947年的獨立，錫金却嘉與印度總理賈瓦哈拉爾·尼赫魯簽訂了一個宗主條約。此條約確定錫金為印度的保護國，以換取錫金王國的自治，直到1975年錫金王國的君王被廢黜。錫金現為印度人口最少的邦。不丹
印度現今雖已不干涉不丹外交、國防、通訊等方面，但印度仍提供不丹皇家軍隊很大的協助，並承諾抵禦外侮。
target_text: Following India’s independence in 1947, Sikinga signed a major pact with India’s Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. The pact identified Sikkim as India’s protectorate in exchange for self-government from the Kingdom of Sikkim until 1975, when the King of Sikkim was deposed.
title: 宗主权

source_text:
南非
1881年第一次布爾戰爭結束後，英國與南非共和國簽署《比勒陀利亞公約》，除確立英國對南非之宗主權外，亦承認南非的「完全自治」地位。根據《比勒陀利亞公約》，英國能於南非境內自由調動軍隊，並控制南非的對外關係，包括締結條約及與外國進行外交往來。
target_text: In South Africa, after the end of the first Bul War in 1881, Britain and the Republic of South Africa signed the Pretoria Pact, which recognized South Africa’s status as “full self-governing” in addition to establishing Britain’s sovereignty over South Africa. According to the Pretoria Pact, the United Kingdom was able to freely mobilize its armed forces within South Africa and control its external relations, including the conclusion of the pact and foreign diplomacy.
title: 宗主权

source_text:
兩國於1884年簽訂《倫敦公約》，取代《比勒陀利亞公約》。《倫敦公約》容許南非在毋須英國批准下直接與奧蘭治自由邦締結條約。至於與其他國家所簽訂之條約則仍須交付英國審批，但英方須於六個月內作出決定並知會南非。其他
在現今的國際关系中，大國控制或者代理小國的外交和國防存在的事实。通常，這和傳統宗主不同處，在於弱國可以通過公民投票取消這關係。
target_text: In 1884, the two countries signed the London Pact, replacing the Treaty of Pretoria. The London Pact allows South Africa to enter directly into a treaty with the free state of Orange without the approval of the United Kingdom. As far as treaties with other countries are concerned, they are still subject to review by the United Kingdom, but within six months the British will decide and inform South Africa.

source_text: 在《联合国海洋法公约》第三次会议针对领海范围等争端议题作出了具体的增补前，中华人民共和国中央政府一向声称中国南海的西、南、中沙群岛包括近350万平方公里的海域（合中国陆地面积的三分之一）均属于中华人民共和国的领海，并在官方的地图上以九段线与南海诸岛的插入图标示，认为这是中国的“蓝色国土”（总面积473万平方公里）。自1994年11月16日《联合国海洋法公约》生效后，虽然中国大陆多数地图仍然使用这种标示法，但1996年5月15日中国中央政府公布了根据联合国海洋法公约中规定的新的领海基线。其中含有西沙群岛的实际领海基线与南沙的拟定领海基线，从而可以类推出新的内水、领海、毗连区、专属经济区等海域的范围和界线。这包括领海基线以内的岛屿、礁屿、暗沙、内水31,000平方公里。办事处就设立在中国南海诸岛中面积最大的岛屿，永兴岛上（西沙群岛宣德群岛组群中的一岛）。
target_text: Before the third meeting of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea made specific additions to the subject of the dispute, including the scope of the territorial sea, the central Government of the People's Republic of China has always claimed that the Western, South and Central Sha Islands of the South China Sea, including nearly 3.5 million square kilometres of sea (one third of the land area of China), are territorial waters of the People's Republic of China and are marked on the official map by an inserted map with the islands of the South China Sea, which is considered China's “blue land” (a total area of 4.73 million square kilometres). Since the entry into force of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on 16 November 1994, and although most maps of mainland China continue to use such marking, on 15 May 1996 the central Government of China published a new territorial sea baseline in accordance with the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

target_text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs' International Broadcasting Department (known briefly as the Department of National Communications) is one of the units within the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China. History, both within and outside the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was the responsibility of the Department of Information and Culture of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. target_text: Bilateral treaties refer to international treaties to which only two parties are parties. Since the subjects of international law include not only States but also international organizations, the parties to bilateral treaties may be either States or international organizations, or States and international organizations. Bilateral treaties are similar in nature to contracts and thus become contractual treaties.

source_text: 2,000马拉地骑兵在麦地那·阿里·汗（Madina Ali Khan）与尤努斯·汗（Yunus Khan）的指挥下，赶到阿喀德支援克莱芙。克莱芙与劳伦斯少校借机反攻敌军，扭转了形势。1754年，英法双方签署卡那提克临时条约，英方代表是托马斯·桑德斯，法方代表是查尔斯·戈达希。双方承认穆罕默德·阿里·汗·瓦拉杰为卡那提克的纳瓦布，并同意两国属地的比例要平衡。1756年，战争再度爆发，在克莱芙离开孟加拉期间，法军在北部取得了胜利，最后却遭穆罕默德·阿里·汗·瓦拉杰击退。1763年，英法双方签署巴黎和约，正式确认穆罕默德·阿里·汗·瓦拉杰的治权。条约的结果是增强了英国的影响力，1765年，皇帝德里下达一个行政命令，承认英国在南印度的属地。

2000年代以来
2000年代，艾滋病在中国快速扩散传播，2000年代初即开始有中國政府官員承認疫情。疫情扩大化可能导致大流行的风险引起了联合国等多方关注。2000年代前期，中国大陆HIV感染人数估计约为43万与150万之间，也有统计给出了比这个区间更高的数据，有指數千萬人，有媒体据此担忧中國成为「愛滋大國」。2001年上半年的报告发病率比2000年上半年激增67%。2002年，中国政府通过哨点检测估算出HIV/AIDS患者数量约为85万人，由于农村数据收集不足可能存在低估，联合国估计患者数已超过100万，联合国和中国政府都预计到2010年这一数据将达到1000万。自2003年中国政府在联合国艾滋病规划署、世界卫生组织和美国疾病控制和预防中心的支持下，开始进行全国范围内的HIV/AIDS监测，并且每年推出年度报告。
target_text: In the early 2000s, the number of HIV infections on China’s mainland was estimated to be between 430,000 and 1.5 million, with statistics showing higher levels than in the region, and tens of thousands of people with media concerns about China becoming an “HIV-positive country.” The reported incidence increased by 67% in the first half of 2001 than in the first half of 2000. In 2002, the Chinese government estimated the number of HIV/AIDS patients through sentinel testing, with the United Nations estimating more than 1 million as a result of underestimation of data collection in rural areas, and both the United Nations and the Chinese government projected that this figure would reach 10 million by 2010. Since 2003, the Chinese government, with the support of UNAIDS, the World Health Organization (WHO) and the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, has begun to monitor HIV/AIDS nationwide and launched annual reports.
title: 中国大陆艾滋病情况

source_text: 《柏林宣言》（官方名称：《罗马条约签署五十年之际宣言》 德语：）是一份由德国领导下的欧洲理事会所起草，于欧盟27个成员国的国家和政府首脑在庆祝《罗马条约》签署50年之际（2007年3月25日），由时任欧盟理事会轮值主席默克尔，欧洲委员会主席巴罗佐，欧洲议会议长珀特林在德国首都柏林联合签署的文件。《柏林宣言》的主要内容和目标：修订一份新的欧盟条约，并使其从2009年6月欧洲议会换届选举之后生效。 这份新的条约将取代由法国和荷兰通过全民公决于2005年所否决的原有《欧盟宪法》。
target_text: The Berlin Declaration (official name: Declaration on the occasion of the fiftieth anniversary of the signing of the Treaty of Rome) was drafted by the European Council, led by Germany, on the occasion of the celebration of the fiftieth anniversary of the signing of the Treaty of Rome by the heads of State and Government of the 27 member States of the European Union (25 March 2007), by Merkel, then Chairman-in-Office of the Council of the European Union, Barroso, President of the Council of Europe, and Perthrin, President of the European Parliament, signed jointly in Berlin, Germany. The main elements and objectives of the Berlin Declaration are: to amend a new European Union treaty and bring it into force after the European Parliament's election in June 2009, which will replace the original Constitution of the European Union, which was rejected by the referendum of France and the Netherlands in 2005.
title: 柏林宣言

source_text:
各方反应
在欧盟内部，各成员国大多对《柏林宣言》表示了谨慎的乐观，但都意识到宣言没有提到“宪法”二字。《欧盟宪法》被法国和荷兰否决之后，《柏林宣言》的主要意义在于打破目前的《欧盟宪法》僵局，使得欧盟的体制能够得以完善而更好的运作。捷克总统瓦茨拉夫·克劳斯内克表示：《柏林宣言》并不是真正意义上的条约，只是对欧盟在立宪方面制定了一个日程表。波兰总统莱赫·卡钦斯基更是认为新条约在2009年生效是“不现实的”。
target_text: Within the EU, the majority of member states expressed cautious optimism about the Berlin Declaration, but were aware that it did not refer to the word “constitution.” After the rejection of the EU Constitution by France and the Netherlands, the main significance of the Berlin Declaration was to break the current impasse in the EU Constitution and to enable the EU’s institutions to function well and better.
title: 柏林宣言

source_text:
背景
在奥地利帝国、普鲁士帝国和俄罗斯帝国割据了一个多世纪之后，波兰在1917－1918年第一次世界大战结束时重新成为一个主权国家。第一次世界大战的胜利同盟国在1919年6月的凡尔赛条约中确认了波兰的重生。这是1919年巴黎和会最伟大的事件之一。1918年至1921年，新组建的波兰军队发动了一系列边境战争，巩固了波兰的独立。在两次世界大战期间，波兰东一半的领土在1922年通过外交途径得到解决，并得到国际联盟的承认。
target_text: More than a century after the empire of Austria, the Prussia and the Russian Empire, Poland re-established itself as a sovereign State at the end of the First World War of 1917-1918. The victorious allies of the First World War confirmed Poland ' s rebirth in the Versailles Treaty of June 1919. This was one of the greatest events of the Paris Peace Conference of 1919. Between 1918 and 1921, the newly formed Polish army launched a series of border wars that consolidated Poland ' s independence. During the two World Wars, half of Poland ' s eastern territory was resolved by diplomatic means and recognized by the League of Nations in 1922.
title: 波兰第二共和国

source_text: 1728年柏林条约是普鲁士国王腓特烈·威廉一世与神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理六世于1728年12月23日签署的一份秘密条约。根据这个条约普鲁士放弃所有针对奥地利的行动并且支持查理六世颁发的1713年国事诏书，作为代价神圣罗马帝国皇帝支持普鲁士对贝尔格公国提出的领土要求。
target_text: The Berlin Treaty of 1728 was a secret treaty signed on 23 December 1728 by King Prussia, Fertile William I, and the Holy Roman Emperor, Charles VI. Prussia forsworn all actions against Austria and supported Charles VI’s 1713 Dahir, at the expense of Prussia’s territorial claims against the Principality of Berger.
title: 1728年柏林条约

source_text: 但是实际上在此条约签署前不久，1728年8月，查理六世就已经与苏尔茨巴赫普伐而茨伯爵签署了条约将贝尔格和于利希划分给苏尔茨巴赫。1738年查理又与英国、法国和荷兰联合威胁腓特烈·威廉一世，逼迫他放弃对贝尔格的要求。1739年查理又与法国达成条约将贝尔格划分给苏尔茨巴赫。
target_text: But, in fact, shortly before the treaty was signed, in August 1728, Charles VI signed a treaty with Count Surzbachpütz that divided Berg and Ulrich into Surzbach. In 1739, Charlie entered into a treaty with France to divide Berg into Sirzbach.
title: 1728年柏林条约

source_text: 联合国军事参谋团（UN Military Staff Committee, MSC），是联合国安理会的附屬機構，由五个安理会常任理事国的总参谋长或其代表组成。根據《聯合國憲章》的規定，其職責是規劃聯合國軍事行動，理论上是联合国的军事参谋咨询机构。不過由於美國、蘇聯和其他國家在20世紀40年代後期的談判破局，加上冷战時代各方的互不信任，令到成立永久性的联合国獨立军事力量成為空話，使军事参谋团的機能事實上已癱瘓，並无法履行其既定任务。
target_text: The United Nations Military Staff Committee (UN Military Staff Committee, MSC), a subsidiary body of the United Nations Security Council, is composed of the Chiefs of General Staff of the five permanent members of the Security Council or their representatives. Under the Charter of the United Nations, its function is to plan United Nations military operations, and, theoretically, to be an advisory body to the United Nations military staff. But the negotiations between the United States, the Soviet Union, and other countries in the late 1940s, coupled with the mistrust between the parties of the cold war, have made the establishment of a permanent independent military force of the United Nations an empty word and rendered the military staff physically ineffective and incapable of carrying out its mandated tasks.
title: 联合国军事参谋团

source_text:
历史地位
根据联合国宪章第26条、第46条和第47条，军参团的任务是：
协助安全理事会决定联合国武力使用之计划；
在安全理事会权力之下，对于受该会所支配之任何军队，负战略上之指挥责任；
协助安理会制定军备及裁军的计划方案。
军参团是根据联合国宪章第7章第47条第一款的规定，由联合国安理会1号决议于1946年1月25日正式设立的。军参团成立之初，安理会对军参团颇为重视。军参团专门拟定了《章程》和议事规则。联合国秘书处在20世纪40年代中、后期，曾为军参团提供了70名秘书和中、法、英、俄语翻译，组成了一个阵容强大的秘书工作班子。
由于不久世界陷入冷战，美国和苏联的根本分歧使得军参团很快陷入内部僵局。1948年7月2日，军参团主席代表全体成员（除抵制会议的苏联代表外）通知安理会说，在安理会没有解决军参团成员之间的分歧意见之前，该团在决定联合国部队兵力规模、成分和使用等方面无法取得进展。此后该团实际上沦为纯礼仪机构。
target_text: The mandate of the Committee, in accordance with Articles 26, 46 and 47 of the Charter of the United Nations, was: to assist the Security Council in determining the plans for the use of force by the United Nations; to assume strategic command responsibility under the authority of the Security Council for any army under its control; to assist the Council in developing its plans for armaments and disarmament, in accordance with Chapter 7, Article 47, paragraph 1, of the Charter of the United Nations, which was formally established on 25 January 1946 by the United Nations Security Council in its resolution 1. On 2 July 1948, the Council, on behalf of all the members of the Council (other than the representatives of the Soviet Union who boycotted the Conference), informed the Council that the United Nations Secretariat had, in the mid- and late 1940s, provided 70 secretaries and Chinese, French, English and Russian interpreters for the Committee and had formed a strong team of secretaries.
title: 联合国军事参谋团

source_text:
实际工作
每隔一周的星期四上午10点都要准时关起门来举行约20分钟的会议。每次会议，联合国秘书处都要提供5种语言的口头翻译。每次会议的主席由各国代表轮流担任，议程简单固定。首先，轮值主席宣布开会。其次，开始讨论议程，即轮值主席询问各代表对今天的议程有没有新建议，代表通常说没有。再次，确定下次会议的时间和地点。（实际上，会议的时间和地点早已按惯例确定下来。）最后，轮值主席宣布散会。每次会议历时约二三十分钟，是纯仪式性的，毫无实质内容。
target_text: At 10 a.m. every Thursday every week, the Secretariat of the United Nations is required to provide oral interpretation in five languages. Each meeting is chaired by representatives of countries on a rotating basis and the agenda is simple and fixed. First, the Chairman-in-Office announces the meeting. Second, the Chairman-in-Office starts the discussion of the agenda by asking delegates whether they have new proposals for today’s agenda, usually not. Once again, determine the time and place of the next meeting. (The time and place of the meeting have already been set in practice.) Finally, the Chairman-in-Office adjourns the meeting.
title: 联合国军事参谋团

source_text:
日本文化，是指在日本列島上形成的在關於思想、行為、生活、教育、信仰及價值觀等等的一系列實體或非實體的事物或象徵。
日本的遣隋使和遣唐使為日本帶來了漢傳佛教文化，如花道、茶道和香道都是伴隨著漢傳佛教傳到日本的，是日本傳統藝術的重要一環。十世紀左右，日本與東亞大陸的交流變少，開始孕育出日本的所谓國風文化。十六世紀中葉，歐陸文化傳到日本，後來因貿易保護政策和基督教禁令，使歐陸文化在日本的傳播停滯。直至十九世紀，日本在美國的外交壓力下签署日美神奈川条约（日美和親条約），开放了下田及箱馆两港口通商，歐陸文化在日本才得以重新復興，後來更成為日本文化的重要一員。
target_text: Japan’s culture refers to a series of physical or non-physical things or symbols of ideas, behaviors, life, education, beliefs, and values that have developed on the Japanese islands. Japan’s emissary and charisma brought Han Buddhist culture to Japan, such as flower, tea, and fragrance, all accompanied by Han Buddhistism, which was an important part of Japan’s traditional art. Around the tenth century, Japan’s exchange with East Asia began to breed Japan’s so-called national culture. In the middle of the sixteenth century, Europe’s culture was transmitted to Japan, followed by trade-friendly conservation policies and Christian bans, which halted the spread of Europe’s culture in Japan.
title: 日本文化

source_text:
历史
日本為一島國，地處東亞大陸的東北面，與朝鮮半島、满洲及西伯利亞相隔着日本海，特殊的地理位置使其文化一直與東亞大陸文化保持着自身獨特性。日本一方面不斷吸收外來文化，同時有自身的特色。自公元4世紀到世紀，就有渡來人帶來東亞文化。往后日本的遣隋使和遣唐使為日本帶來了漢傳佛教文化，如花道、茶道和香道都是伴隨著漢傳佛教傳到日本的，是日本傳統藝術的重要一環，並稱為日本的「雅道」。隨後到十世紀左右，日本與東亞大陸的交流變少，開始發展具有獨自特色的國風文化，而京都則成為日本的文化中心。16世紀中葉，歐陸文化傳到日本，後來因貿易保護政策和基督教禁令，使歐陸文化在日本的傳播停滯。直至十九世紀，日本在美國的外交壓力下签署日美神奈川条约（日美和親条約），开放了下田及箱馆两港口通商，歐陸文化在日本才得以重新復興，後來更成為日本文化的重要一員。
target_text: Japan is an island nation, located in the north-east of the East Asian continent, and separate from the Korean Peninsula, Manchuria and Siberia, and has a special geographical location that keeps its culture separate from the East Asian culture. Japan, on the one hand, has its own identity while absorbing foreign culture. From the fourth century to the fourth century, there are people who bring East Asian culture. Japan’s emissaries and Chai Tang have brought Chinese Buddhist culture to Japan, such as the flower, tea and fragrance to Japan, which has been accompanied by Han Buddhistism to Japan, which is an important part of Japan’s tradition of art and is called Japan’s "Adha" . The culture of Europe has been suspended until the tenth century, the exchanges between Japan and East Asia have been reduced, the country’s unique national culture has begun to develop, and Kyoto has become the cultural centre of Japan.
title: 日本文化

source_text: 1918年一戰結束後，他代表希臘参加了巴黎和会，以圓融的外交才智，締造了許多外交勝利。他在列強的同意下，於1919年5月派希臘軍佔領了士麥拿及周邊領土。這些擴張在1920年的《色佛尔条约》中，列強承认希腊对新领土的主权，包含如：色雷斯（前属保加利亚及土耳其）大部及爱琴海诸岛（包括应布罗斯岛及特内多斯岛）均归希腊，位于伊奥尼亚的士麦拿则成为希腊的国际联盟托管地。亚历山大的王国领土面积增长了近三分之一。韦尼泽洛斯繼續参加冗長的和会，同奥斯曼帝国和保加利亚进行谈判。1920年8月韦尼泽洛斯返回希腊，亚历山大授其桂冠以表彰其对泛希腊主义事业做出的贡献；他在街上受到群眾英雄般的歡迎，推崇他締造了「橫跨兩大洲與五大海的偉大希臘」。但是的問題反而因軍事勝利而惡化，兩方的激進和狂熱分子造成更深刻的尖銳對立，譬如1920年8月，韦尼泽洛斯在巴黎回旅館的路上被兩名希臘保王派士兵企圖暗殺，幸好他命大而躲過一劫，但希臘執政黨（韋尼派）為了報復領袖受刺而進行大逮捕及暗殺反對派元老。

source_text:
历史背景
国际联盟集体安全的失败导致人们认识到，只有各国同意在交战权方面对其国家主权进行一些限制，并且改革在国际联盟时期一直被称为是“封闭商店”的行政院（职能相当于联合国的安全理事会），一个普遍的安全体系才能有效，在这个体系中，这些会员国将在宪法中放弃武装权，以换取集体安全。与战后德國基本法中包含的第24条一样，该条规定为了集体安全而授权或限制主权，而第9条在二战后的被占领期间被添加到日本宪法中。
target_text: The failure of collective security in the League of Nations has led to the realization that a universal security system can be effective only if States agree to impose some restrictions on their national sovereignty with regard to the right to war and if they reform the administrative court that has been called the “closed shop” at the time of the League (a function equivalent to that of the Security Council of the United Nations), in which those Member States will renounce armed power in their constitutions in exchange for collective security. Like article 24 of the basic laws of post-war Germany, which provides for the authorization or limitation of sovereignty for collective security, article 9 was added to the Japanese constitution during the post-war occupation.
title: 日本國憲法第九條

source_text:
沿革
1970年到1974年，国务院总理周恩来对环境保护作了31次讲话，推动中国的环境保护事业。1972年，中华人民共和国政府派出代表团到瑞典参加第一届联合国人类环境会议，团长为燃料化学工业部副部长唐克。1973年8月，国务院召开第一次全国环境保护会议；同年，国务院环境保护领导小组办公室以中华人民共和国政府的名义加入联合国环境规划署，中国成为联合国环境规划理事会58个理事国之一。
target_text: In 1972, the Government of the People's Republic of China sent a delegation to Sweden for the first United Nations Conference on the Human Environment, headed by Donk, Deputy Minister of the Fuel Chemical Industry. In August 1973, the State Council convened the first National Conference on Environmental Protection. In the same year, the Office of the State Council's Lead Environmental Protection Team joined the United Nations Environment Programme on behalf of the Government of the People's Republic of China and China became one of the 58 members of the United Nations Environmental Planning Council.
title: 中华人民共和国环境保护部

source_text: 这意味着还有一个比博格人还强大的种族攻击了博格。外勤队从一艘损坏较轻的博格方块中带回的信息让珍妮薇知道，这个种族来自于某个液态空间，博格人将他们排作8472种族。由于8472种族的DNA数量异常巨大，导致他们对博格人的同化免疫。在对这群不寻常的外星种族进行了解后，珍妮薇与博格人建立一个条约。医生发现可改进博格纳米探针的电化学信号从而同化该免疫的种族。航海家号独自基于纳米探针的技术开发了一种新式生物武器，该生物武器可以从细胞级上消灭8472种族。珍妮薇以此为交换条件，要求博格人允许航海-{}-家号穿越博格星域。博格人同意了这个条约，但在击退8472种族后，博格人的代表九之七企图同化航海家号，不过被珍妮薇挫败。九之七从此留在了航海家号上。

source_text: 北大年的獨立運動經過了多年的沉寂後在2004年再次出現，並且變得越來越暴力。2014年4月6日至7日，該省在兩天內发生爆炸。炸彈爆炸造成1人死亡，28人受傷。英國外交和聯邦事務部在2014年建議其公民只能在該省進行基本旅行，而澳大利亞的外交和貿易部建議旅客完全避開該省。

title: 也拉府

source_text: 到2002年3月中旬，美军中央司令部开始对“持久自由”军事行动中的教训进行先期总结。因为战事没有完全结束，最后的总结还有点为期过早，不过美军中央司令部也确实总结了一些教训：联合国防部，中央情报局和联邦政府各部门的资源和力量所产生的效果超过了任何一个单独的部门所能达到的效果。同样的采用了灵活的联合方式，使得美军能够更好的调节和分配每个国家的军事资源和力量。“是任务决定了联军，而不是联军决定了任务”。军事行动继续由在佛罗里达州坦帕的中央司令部指挥和控制。通过战场上的高科技中央司令部可以进行战场实时联络，协调空中力量，地面部队，海军和特种部队之间的行动。在美国中央司令部辖区内共有267个军事基地，分布在15个国家的30个地区，涵盖了46个国家。安全协作，外交和进行军事合作是美国同其他国家建立的关系在战时就变得非常珍贵。人道主义的空投，对联军和地区武装力量在经济上和安全上的协作，资深政府官员和国会议员及军方高级将领对本地区进行的访问，和美国对战后阿富汗重建工作的承诺使得美国同联军各国建立了重要的联系。这些在安全合作方面上的投资很快就得到了回报，当地的美国盟友在开放基地，发动军事攻击和允许美军战斗机飞越领空等方面提供了方便。
target_text: By mid-March 2002, the U.S. Central Command had begun to make a preliminary summary of the lessons learned from the “Enduring Freedom” military operation. Since the battle was not completely over, it was a bit premature, although the U.S. Central Command did draw some lessons: the combined Department of Defense, the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) and the federal government departments had more resources and capabilities than any single department could achieve. The same flexible joint approach allowed the U.S. military forces to better regulate and distribute the military resources and forces of each country. “It was the mission that determined the coalition forces, not the coalition forces, decided the mission.” The military operation continued to be controlled and controlled by the central command in Tampa, Florida.
title: 持久自由军事行动

source_text: 1992年8月26日，美国总统老布什宣布联合国军队将开始在北纬32度线以南执行禁飞任务。此行动的目的是保证伊拉克执行联合国668号决议。为了协助监督行动，联军禁止伊拉克任何固定翼和旋转翼飞机飞过禁飞区。在总统的声明后，美军中央司令部立刻建立了西南亚联合打击力量指挥部，它的任务是指挥联军对禁飞区监视行动，行动代号“南方守望”，1992年8月27日，在总统声明后不到24小时，军事行动正式展开。
target_text: On August 26, 1992, United States President Bush announced that the United Nations military would begin a no-fly mission south of the 32nd parallel. The purpose of the operation was to ensure that Iraq would implement United Nations resolution 668. To assist in the monitoring of the operation, Coalition forces banned any Iraqi fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft from flying over the no-fly zone. Immediately after the President’s statement, the United States Central Command established the South-West Asia Joint Strike Force Command, whose mission was to direct the coalition’s surveillance operations of the no-fly zone, code-named “Southern Watch”, and on August 27, 1992, military operations were officially launched less than 24 hours after the President’s announcement.
title: 南方守望行动

source_text:
概况
起先，伊拉克遵守禁飞区的限制，但是萨达姆侯赛因在联合国1992年11月24日宣布继续执行对伊拉克的制裁后开始挑战“南方守望”军事行动：1992年12月27日，正当一架美军的F-16在执行任务时，一架伊拉克的米格-25战斗机闯入禁飞区。美军飞行员在被对方的空对空导弹雷达锁定后，迅速發射AIM-120導彈将其击毁，亦是同款導彈首次應用於實戰。在空战结束后不久，萨达姆侯赛因在伊拉克南部北纬32度线以南部署了地对空导弹。因为这些导弹对联军执行“南方守望”任务的飞行员构成了实质性的威胁，联军要求萨达姆侯赛因马上撤走这些导弹，但是萨达姆侯赛因在联合国的警告后仍然对最后通牒不予理睬。
target_text: Initially, Iraq complied with the no-fly zone restrictions, but Saddam Hussein began to challenge the “South Watch” military campaign after the United Nations announced on 24 November 1992 that the sanctions against Iraq would continue to be enforced: on 27 December 1992, while on mission, an American F-16 entered the no-fly zone, an Iraqi MiG-25 fighter entered the no-fly zone. The United States pilots quickly fired anti-AIM-120 missiles after they had been targeted by the other side's air-to-air missile radar, and the same missile was used for the first time. Shortly after the air war, Saddam Hussein deployed ground-to-air missiles south of Iraq's south 32nd parallel.
title: 南方守望行动

source_text: 1993年1月6日，联军三个主要的国家美国，英国和法国决定共同进行军事打击行动来保证联合国668号决议的贯彻执行。一个星期后，联军的战斗机摧毁了部署在伊拉克南部的这些地对空导弹以及它的指挥部。此外在1月17日联军的海军力量为了支持联合国687号决议的实施，用戰斧巡弋飛彈摧毁了伊拉克的一个核设施基地。687号决议要求伊拉克无条件解除其大规模杀伤性武器。1月18号联军通过空袭成功地摧毁了伊拉克部署在北纬32度线的萨姆防空导弹系统。一个月后，在1993年的4月18号，联军的F-4鬼怪式战斗机通过雷达指引用导弹摧毁了此地的一个防空阵地。
target_text: On 6 January 1993, the three main coalition countries, the United States, the United Kingdom and France, decided to carry out a joint military strike to ensure the implementation of United Nations resolution 668. A week later, coalition fighters destroyed these surface-to-air missiles deployed in southern Iraq and its command. On 17 January, coalition naval forces destroyed a nuclear facilities base in Iraq with an ax cruise missile in support of United Nations resolution 687. Resolution 687 demanded that Iraq unconditionally disarm its weapons of mass destruction. Coalition forces successfully destroyed the Sam's anti-aircraft missile system deployed in Iraq on the 32nd parallel in north latitude on 18 January. A month later, on 18 April 1993, coalition F-4 ghost fighters destroyed an air-defence position in the area using radar guidance.
title: 南方守望行动

source_text: “南方守望”军事行动直到1994年10月都进行得很顺利，但是伊拉克在此后进行了大规模的军事调动，目标直指科威特。为了对付这些调动，联军开始了“警惕的勇士”军事行动。1994年10月萨达姆侯赛因出于对联合国继续进行制裁行动的愤怒，开始不断地进行口头的挑衅，他开始向科威特边境进行大规模的军事集结，包括大量的装甲车和陆军。联军被迫加强了巡逻和监视，重新部署了额外的战斗机和其他军事力量，以此来阻止伊拉克的挑衅，如有必要，将对伊拉克军队进行打击来保护阿拉伯半岛。与此同时联军各自的政府纷纷表示，他们将不会因为恐吓而终止对伊拉克的制裁。萨达姆侯赛因坚持表示他有权力在伊拉克境内进行任何的军事调动，同时他决定撤军以此来表示对海湾地区友好国家提出的建议的反应。伊拉克的广播电台报道说美国屈服了。
target_text: In October 1994, in anger at the continuation of United Nations sanctions, Saddam Hussein began an ongoing campaign of verbal provocations, beginning with a massive military build-up on the Kuwaiti border, including a large number of armoured vehicles and army units. Coalition forces were forced to step up patrols and surveillance, redeploy additional fighter jets and other military forces to deter Iraqi provocations and, if necessary, strike Iraqi forces to protect the Arabian Peninsula.
title: 南方守望行动

source_text: “警惕的勇士”军事行动导致联合国安理会通过新的949号决议，决议不仅禁止伊拉克通过其军事手段来威胁其周边国家的安全或者联合国在伊拉克的行动，还禁止其在北纬32度线以南部署军事力量和在伊拉克南部加强其军事实力。“南方守望”军事行动从一开始就得到了海湾国家的合作。
target_text: The United Nations Security Council adopted a new resolution, 949, which prohibits not only Iraq from threatening the security of its neighbours or United Nations operations in Iraq through its military means, but also from deploying its military forces south of the 32nd parallel and strengthening its military capabilities in southern Iraq. From the outset, the “South Watch” operation has enjoyed the cooperation of the Gulf States.
title: 南方守望行动

source_text: 在1996年“沙漠攻击”行动结束后，西南亚联合打击力量指挥部继续执行在禁飞区的监视任务，禁飞区扩大到了北纬33度线以南，任务得到了美国空军，在阿拉伯海和红海的舰载航母战斗机群以及英国皇家空军的支持。其他联军的战斗机也参加了空中巡逻。联军的海军力量也加强了在红海北部和波斯湾的军事行动以支持联合国制裁伊拉克的决议。西南亚联合打击力量指挥部由美国、英国、法国和沙特阿拉伯四国组成，下辖一个指挥部和四个管理中心：J-1负责人事，J-2负责情报，J-3负责军事行动，J-4负责后勤和J-6负责联络通讯和公共及法律事务。
target_text: Following the end of Operation Desert Attack in 1996, the South-West Asia Joint Anti-Flying Forces Command continued its surveillance mission in the no-fly zone, which was extended south of the 33rd parallel north latitude, with the support of the United States Air Force, a fleet of carrier aircraft in the Arabian and Red Seas and the Royal Air Force. Other coalition fighters also took part in air patrols. Coalition naval forces also intensified military operations in the northern Red Sea and the Persian Gulf in support of United Nations resolutions on sanctions against Iraq. The South-West Asia Joint Anti-Flying Forces Command, comprising four countries: the United States, the United Kingdom, France and Saudi Arabia, has a command and four management centres: J-1 for personnel, J-2 for intelligence, J-3 for military operations, and J-4 for logistics and J-6 for communications and public and legal affairs.
title: 南方守望行动

source_text: 国际贸易标准分类（Standard International Trade Classification，简称：SITC）为用于国际贸易商品的统计和对比的标准分类方法。现行“国际贸易标准分类”于1950年7月12日由联合国经济社会理事会正式通过，目前为世界各国政府普遍采纳的商品贸易分类体系。 到2006年为止，该标准分类经历了四次修改，最近的一次修改为第四次修订版，于2006年3月获联合国统计委员会第三十七届会议通过。该分类法将商品分为为10大类、63章、223组、786个分组和1924个项目。
target_text: The Standard International Trade Classification (SITC) is a standard classification for statistics and comparisons of goods used in international trade. The current Standard International Trade Classification (SITC), which was formally adopted by the United Nations Economic and Social Council on 12 July 1950 and is now widely adopted by Governments worldwide, has undergone four revisions up to 2006, the most recent of which was the fourth revision, which was adopted by the Statistical Commission at its thirty-seventh session in March 2006. The classification grouped commodities into 10 major categories, 63 chapters, 223 groups, 786 subgroups and 1924 projects.
title: 国际贸易标准分类

source_text: “獨立關稅區”原为GATT诞生之初，为尚未获得完全独立的殖民地政府当局而设置。GATT成立之初以“獨立關稅區”的非主权政治实体达30余个。1960年代后，随着殖民地独立，作为“獨立關稅區”的非主权政治实体渐渐减少。目前在WTO存在四個獨立關稅區，即歐盟、臺澎金馬、香港及澳門。
target_text: Since the 1960s, with the independence of the colony, the non-sovereign political entity as an independent tax area has been declining. There are now four separate tax zones in the WTO, namely, the European Union, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau.
title: 单独关税区

source_text: 在16世纪的欧洲，康布雷位于法蘭西王國和哈布斯堡君主国的边界，相对中立的地理位置使其成为了重要的国际谈判场所。为了遏制意大利战争中威尼斯在意大利北部的影响力，教宗国的尤利乌斯二世、神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米连一世、法兰西国王路易十二和阿拉贡的斐迪南二世于1508年在此地成立康布雷联盟。1510年，教宗国与威尼斯共和国结盟，开始反对前盟友法兰西，康布雷联盟最终解散。这场冲突也被称为康布雷同盟战争，从1508年一直持续到1516年。1529年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世和法兰西国王弗朗索瓦一世在此签定康布雷条约。此条约暂时地承认了西班牙在意大利的统治地位。
target_text: In Europe in the sixteenth century, Conbure, located at the borders of the French monarchy and the Habsburg monarchy, became a relatively neutral geographical location that made it an important forum for international negotiations. In order to contain the influence of Venice in northern Italy in the Italian war, the Pontifical State, Ulysses II, the Holy Emperor of the Roman Empire, Marc Simillian I, King Louis XII of France, and King Ferdinand II of Aragon, formed the Conbret Union in 1508. In 1510, the Pope, in alliance with the Republic of Venice, began to oppose the former ally, the Conbrebret Union, which was also known as the Conbret Union War, which lasted from 1508 to 1516. In 1529, the Holy Roman Emperor, Charles V, and King Francie I, provisionally recognized Spain’s dominance in Italy.
title: 康布雷

target_text: The Council of the European Union began with the Special Council of Ministers of the European Coal and Steel Community in 1951 and the Council of the European Economic Community and the Council of the European Atomic Energy Community established by the Treaty of Rome in 1957. The three Councils were streamlined from the Treaty of Merger in 1965 into the Council of the European Communities, which was renamed the Council of the European Union with the Treaty of Maastricht in 1992.

Other international organizations supporting environmental policy development are the Committee on Environmental Cooperation (part of the North American Free Trade Agreement), the European Environment Agency and the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.

source_text: 孤立主义（），又可翻譯為獨立主義、獨世主義，是一种封閉本國外交、經濟、文化、交通和國防的外交政策，致力於將本國和外國隔絕開來，不同程度的禁止國內外人士擁有自由溝通的權力。它通常在军事和经济上表現的較為明顯，會直接影響到所在國人民的生活，尤其是精神思想方面。在防务上，孤立主义采取不干涉原则，即除自卫战争外不主动卷入任何外部军事冲突；在经济與文化上，通过立法最大程度限制与国外的贸易和文化交流。
target_text: Isolationism (which can also be translated as independenceism, ecclesiasticalism) is a foreign policy that shuts down the country’s foreign policy of diplomacy, economy, culture, transport and defence, and seeks to separate itself from the outside world and to prohibit, to varying degrees, freedom of communication within and outside the country. It is usually more visible in military and economic terms, and directly affects the lives of its people, especially spirituality. In defence, isolationism adopts the principle of non-intervention, i.e., non-involvement in any external military conflict, except in self-defence wars; and, in economic and cultural terms, it limits trade and cultural exchanges with foreign countries to the greatest extent possible through legislation.
title: 孤立主义

source_text:
（1949年－1978年）
1949年中华人民共和国建国后，对外交流多与社会主义国家交流，极少与非社会主义国家交流，且其交流多出于官方形式而非民间。1960年代中苏交恶及文化大革命以后，锁国政策达到高峰，與周邊國家的外交關係十分惡劣，毛泽东以及中华人民共和国官方，则认为是西方资本主义国家主动孤立和封锁中国。
target_text: After the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, many exchanges took place with the socialist state, few with the non-socialist state, and most of the exchanges took place in official form rather than with the private sector. After the Central Soviet and Cultural Revolution of the 1960s, the lock-up state policy peaked, the diplomatic ties with the surrounding state were so bad that Mao Zedong and the official state of the People’s Republic of China considered it to be the West’s capitalist state’s initiative to isolate and block China.
title: 孤立主义

source_text: 1970年代，随著中華人民共和國政府取代中華民國政府在聯合國的中国席位及代表權，並與美國等一系列的西方國家建立外交關係後，其外交政策逐渐改变。1978年改革开放後，中华人民共和国逐步抛弃锁国政策，从开放外资合作建设工厂，到外國餐饮企業在華开设分店（如-{麥當勞}-、肯德基），以及最终全面开放外國商品進口。時至今日，中国公民可以相对自由地出国旅游，而外国人也可以相对自由的在除西藏自治区以外的中国领土上旅游。
target_text: In the 1970s, with the Chinese People’s Republic replacing the Chinese Government’s Chinese seat and representation in the United Nations and establishing diplomatic relations with a range of Western countries, such as the United States, foreign policy gradually changed. After the reforms opened in 1978, the People’s Republic of China moved away from lock-in policies, from open foreign investment and cooperation in the construction of factories, to foreign catering enterprises opening branches in China (e.g. – McDonald’s) and, eventually, to fully open foreign exports. To date, Chinese citizens have been able to travel relatively freely abroad, while foreigners have been able to travel relatively freely in China’s territory, except in the Tibet Autonomous Region.
title: 孤立主义

source_text: 在外交上，和平共处五项原则是中华人民共和国自朝鲜战争停火后至今一直奉行的外交国策，这些政策在广义上亦属于孤立主义。朝鲜战争后，除小规模边境冲突外，中国仅参与过一次大规模的对外干涉战争，即在越南战争期间秘密派遣志愿军援助北越对抗美军为首的联合国军。
target_text: In diplomacy, the five principles of peaceful coexistence are the diplomatic State policy of the People’s Republic of China since the Korean War’s cease-fire, and these policies are broadly isolationist. After the Korean War, China participated in only one large-scale foreign intervention war, with the exception of the small-scale border conflict, during which the United Nations forces led by North Vietnam were secretly dispatched to assist them during the Vietnam War.
title: 孤立主义

联合国地名标准化会议（英语：United Nations Conferences on the Standardization of Geographical Names，缩写：UNCSGN）是一个由联合国统计委员会组织的定期举办的国际性会议，会议的宗旨是：鼓励各国和国际的地名标准化工作；
促进各国已经标准化的地名信息在国际的传播；
为每种非罗马化的书写系统发展一套单一的罗马化书写系统。
target_text: The United Nations Conference on the Standardization of Geographical Names (in English: United Nations Conventions on the Standardization of Global Names, Abbreviations: UNCSGN) is a regular international conference organized by the United Nations Statistical Commission to encourage national and international standardization of geographical names; to promote the international dissemination of standardized geographical names information in various countries; and to develop a single romanization system for each non-Roman writing system.
title: 联合国地名标准化会议

组织机构
《亚松森条约》和《欧鲁普雷图议定书》为南方共同市场的机构结构奠定了基础，创建了共同市场理事会和共同市场小组，两者都在过渡阶段开始时发挥作用。根据本条约的规定，在建立共同市场之前，成员国必须召开一次特别会议，以确定管理南方共同市场的公共机构的最终制度结构，并确定每个机构的具体职能和决策过程。
共同市场理事会：最高决策机构。由成员国外交部长和经济部长组成。理事会主席由各成员国外长轮流担任，任期半年。现任轮值主席国为巴西。每年至少举行1次成员国首脑会议。
共同市场小组：执行机构。负责实施条约和理事会决议，就规划贸易开放、协调宏观经济政策、与第三国商签经贸协定等提出建议。
秘书处：行政机构，设在乌拉圭首都蒙得维的亚。
议会：立法机构，设在乌拉圭首都蒙得维的亚。实行一院制，设有143个议席。
仲裁法院：司法机构，解决成员国间争端。
贸易委员会：主管贸易事务，下设8个分委会。
target_text: The institutional structure of MERCOSUR was laid down by the Asunción Treaty and the Orupreto Protocol, which created the Common Market Council and the Common Market Group, both of which played a role at the beginning of the transition period. source_text:
經過
在1835年後，政治聚會和遊行在法國被明令禁止。但在1847年，開始在法國各地流行。人們紛紛舉辦“宴會”，並藉此機會討論諸如改革之類的政治問題。1848年2月22日，巴黎民眾本想舉辦宴會慶祝喬治·華盛頓的生日，但是政府卻出面禁止了此次宴會。這次行動終於成為了革命的導火線，22日中午人們紛紛上街游行，要求推翻國王和首相，並進行改革。他們高唱《馬賽曲》，並在街上構築工事，點燃雜物。許多民眾開始與巴黎國民衛隊交火。2月23日，首相基佐被迫辭職，路易·菲利浦一世本想以此安撫群眾。但是在外交部卻發生了流血事件。一群示威群眾與國民衛隊在外交部門前對峙，在混亂中一名士兵的滑膛槍走火，引得其餘士兵也向示威群眾開火，總共導致52人死亡。巴黎局勢已然無法控制。路易·菲利浦一世做出一些無用的挽救措施，但最後他還是放棄了王位，逃亡英國。拉馬丁成立了臨時政府，建立法蘭西第二共和國。12月，路易-拿破侖·波拿巴當選共和國總統。
target_text: On February 22, 1848, Parisians wanted to celebrate George Washington’s birthday, but the government banned it. They sang the Maasai and built the streets to set fire to a variety of political issues, such as reform. Many people started to fire with the Paris National Guard. On February 23, Prime Minister Kizo was forced to resign, and Louis Philip I wanted to save the crowd. But there was bloodshed in the Foreign Ministry.
title: 法國二月革命

source_text: 外交豁免權（，），又稱外交特權，是國際間為方便外交代表執行正常職務，各國依據相互尊重主權及平等互利原則，按照慣例或有關協議，互相授予外交豁免權；其性質為絕對的，故為絕對豁免權。豁免權以廣義區分，分為絕對豁免權和功能性豁免權。1961年，聯合國國際法委員會將習慣法整編成設定的《維也納外交關係公約》，目前世界各國大部分已簽署。
target_text: Diplomatic immunity (i.e., diplomatic privilege) is a normal international duty to facilitate the exercise of diplomatic duties by diplomatic representatives, and each country grants diplomatic immunity to one another, in accordance with the rules of mutual respect for its sovereignty and equality and mutual benefit; it is absolute in nature and therefore absolute in nature. Immunity is broadly defined, with absolute immunity and functional immunity. In 1961, the United Nations International Law Commission (UNICL) codified the custom law into a structured Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, which is now signed by most of the world.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text:
歷史
现代意义上的外交始于17世纪的欧洲。《維也納外交關係公約》規定外交官在從事外交任務的過程中不受迫害和不受法律制裁。假如這些外交官若因犯法被母國取消豁免，則需在該派遣國受法律制裁。一般來說一名外交官在他所駐的國家裡的確犯法的話，因為豁免權的保護不受刑，但是所在國也會予以驅逐。
target_text: History, modern diplomacy, began in Europe in the seventeenth century. The Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations provides that diplomats are not persecuted and exempt from the law in the course of their diplomatic missions.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text: 外交通訊一般視同不可侵犯，外交官一般允許攜帶任何文件通過邊境而不受搜查。外交郵袋也不受海關或邊防的檢查。但是近年裡由於竊聽和偵探系統的日新月異，甚至不用開啟郵袋亦能得知內容物，不過這種行為一旦被發現的話屬於嚴重的冒犯行為。
target_text: Foreign traffic communications are generally considered inviolable, and diplomats generally allow any document to pass through the border without being searched. Diplomatic postbags are not checked by customs or border guards.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text: 各國駐聯合國代表，須前往美國紐約聯合國總部大樓議事及執行公務時，雖非以駐美外交人員身分進入美國國境，但在美國移民部门及海關亦認定駐聯合國代表等同於他國駐美外交人員，可經由美國入境關卡的外交通道特權通過，且其攜帶物品、文件及外交郵袋亦不必接受美國海關檢查。
target_text: Representatives of the United States to the United Nations, while travelling to the United States Headquarters building in New York and carrying out official duties, have entered the United States as a non-United States diplomatic agent, but the United States immigration and customs authorities have determined that United States representatives to the United Nations are equivalent to United States diplomatic personnel, and may pass through the diplomatic channel of the United States entry gate, and that they are not subject to United States customs clearance for goods, documents and diplomatic pouches.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text: 外交豁免權適用於任何外交代表，不論是常駐代表或臨時使節，也包括其有限的眷屬在內，例如，配偶、未成年子女及成年未有婚姻之女兒。然而相關特權，不一定適用於所有驻外文官、領事人員、職員、及其家屬，如美國的相關規定，雖符合維也納外交關係公約，對外交人員的身份別有少许差別待遇。
target_text: Diplomatic immunity applies to any diplomatic agent, whether permanent or temporary, and to his or her limited family members, such as spouses, minor children and adult unmarried daughters. However, the speciality does not necessarily apply to all civil servants, supervisors, employees, and members of his or her family, such as those of the United States, who are in compliance with the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, and who have a slight difference in status.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text:
絕對豁免權例外事項：
為供給特定服務之費用，例如外交官繳交所使用的水、電費等。
民事法的物權行為不在豁免範圍，例如：土地、動產及日用品的買賣交易等。但代表派駐國購置使館用途的不動產，不在此限。
以私人身分非代表派駐國進行繼承事件訴訟，為遺囑執行人、遺產管理人、繼承人或受遺贈人等。
於駐在國非公務範圍內的專業與商務活動，應屬私人經濟活動，受所在國法律之約束。
派駐國外交官主動於駐在國提起訴訟，則不享有豁免權，外交官針對一件案件提起訴訟，被告當事人提出反訴時，駐在國司法機關依然可以審理及判決該外交官員，而不受此外交豁免權限制。
拋棄外交豁免權，拋棄外交豁免權與否為派駐國之權利，並須明示，不受該名外交人員個人自主決定。例如：1997年1月，美國曾發生格魯吉亞共和國駐美大使駕車肇事並撞死當地少女，美國群情譁然，使美國總統比尔·克林顿要求格魯吉亞總統爱德华·谢瓦尔德纳泽捨棄外交豁免權，交由美國司法機關審判該公使，最後格魯吉亞予以答應。即使派駐國不認同，駐在國亦可選擇將該外交代表列為不受歡迎人物，若派駐國不將被列外不受歡迎的外交代表召回或解除職務，駐在國可以不再承認其外交人員的身份並予以驅逐出境。
target_text: Civil law property rights are not covered by immunity, such as the purchase and sale of land, real estate, and daily goods. But representatives are not allowed to buy the real estate of embassies in countries where they are non-representatives.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text:
功能性豁免權
相對於絕對豁免權的是功能性豁免权，其指特定國際組織或非正式邦交國，及非国家政治实体之外交代表機構，與設置地或駐在國簽署協定，其組織人員得享有部分豁免權利，如國際貨幣基金組織、中華民國與美國互設代表機構。
target_text: Functional immunity, in contrast to absolute immunity, refers to the diplomatic representation of a particular international organization or an unofficial state, as well as of a non-state political entity, and the establishment or presence of a State under a signed agreement, whose members are entitled to partial immunity, such as the International Monetary Fund, the Chinese People’s Republic and the United States Mutual Representation.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text: 甚多國際組織總部設在美國，因此這些國際組織和美國簽有協定，國際組織職員享有屬功能性之外交豁免權，即在執行公務時的行為不受駐在國法律管轄，且僅限於職員本人。而豁免權必須當事人在審理中提出主張，且是否執行公務仍由駐在國法官認定，因此駐在國司法及檢調單位依然可以起訴審理。
target_text: Given the fact that many international organizations are based in the United States, these organizations and the United States have signed an agreement that international workers enjoy functional diplomatic immunity, i.e. that their conduct in the exercise of their official duties is not subject to national law and is limited to the staff members themselves. The immunity must be subject to a ruling by the person in question, and whether or not the official functions are to be determined by the judges in the country, so that the judicial and prosecutorial offices in the country are still open to trial.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text:
外交特權
旅行自由權，除國家安全禁限區（例如軍事基地）外。
通訊保密權，可採外交郵袋、外交信使等方式之保密自由通訊。
人身及財產不可侵犯，外交人員的人身及其家屬不受任何方式之逮捕或拘禁；使館馆舍，包括辦公使用及館長寓邸之建物等不得侵犯，且免受搜索、扣押、徵用、或強制执行。從現代國際法的理論角度，使館仍然屬於其所在國的領土，因此使館本身沒有提供庇護的法理依據。然而，由於維也納外交關係公約規定了使館絕對不得侵犯，因此位於其所在國尋求政治庇護的人士常以進入使館、領事館以獲取事實上的庇護，例如陳光誠進入美國駐華大使館、朱利安·阿桑奇進入、脫北者進入韓國駐華大使館。
派駐國可使用國家象徵物於其外交代表機構，可將派駐國之國旗、國徽置於馆舍、大使寓邸及交通工具上使用。
免納繳稅金及免役務，免納關稅、其他國家、區域或地方性稅金及其役務。
target_text: Personal and financial integrity is inviolable, and the person and family of a diplomat are not arrested or detained in any way; embassy premises, including public use and the building of the residence of the director, are inviolable and are protected from search, seizure, use, or coercion. From the point of view of contemporary international law, the embassy is still in the country’s territory and, as a result, the embassy itself has no legal authority to provide security.
title: 外交豁免權

source_text:
歷史
特命全權公使制度在1815年维也纳会议上正式得到確立。根據维也纳会议建立的外交體系，特命全權公使在外交官銜中次於特命全權大使，居全權代表第二位，名義上與大使一樣能全權代表本國政府但卻不代表國家元首本人，不過公使的實質地位、職務以及所享受的外交特權與豁免同大使相同。直到20世紀初，大部分國與國之間的關係依然是公使級的，一般來說當時只向大國、盟友，以及君主之間存在血緣關係的國家派遣大使。
target_text: History, with full powers, was officially established at the Vienna Conference in 1815. According to the diplomatic system established at the Vienna Conference, full powers were subordinated to diplomats, second in rank as full powers ambassadors, and second in rank as full-time ambassadors, but not as head of state himself, but as a minister, as a matter of fact, office, and diplomatic privileges and immunities. Until the beginning of the twentieth century, most of the country’s relations with the country remained at the rank of minister, generally sending ambassadors only to countries with blood ties between the great nation, allies, and sovereigns.
title: 特命全權公使

source_text: 第二次世界大戰後，因聯合國提倡所有國家不分大小一律平等的原則，將與他國的關係分為大使級與公使級成為不被認可的行為，各國紛紛將與他國的公使級外交關係升格為大使級關係。1961年維也納外交關係公約簽定後，公使級關係向大使級關係的全面轉換加速。到1966年，美國將與當時屬於蘇東集團的保加利亞與匈牙利的關係也升格為大使級，至此公使級外交關係走入歷史。
target_text: After the Second World War, the United Nations promoted the principle of equality of all countries, regardless of size, by dividing relations with other countries into the rank of ambassador and the rank of minister into an unacknowledged act, and by upgrading relations with other countries’ diplomatic ministries to the rank of ambassador. Following the signing of the Vienna diplomatic relations pact in 1961, the overall shift in relations between ministers was accelerated. By 1966, the relationship between the United States and Bulgaria and Hungary, which were formerly part of the Soviet bloc, was also elevated to the rank of ambassador.
title: 特命全權公使

source_text:
公使可以指：
特命全權公使（，簡稱），為公使館的，以及外交官體系中僅次於大使、級別第二高的外交官銜。
（），附派於大使館內的外交官，可作為副館長擔任大使館的二把手。
（，亦稱駐辦公使），為1818年亞琛會議後始設的外交官銜，1961年《維也納外交關係公約》後廢止。
target_text: The Minister may refer to: Minister Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary (simplely) for the embassy, and for diplomats second only to the ambassador and second-highest-ranking diplomat in the diplomatic system. (For diplomats attached to the embassy, they may serve as second-in-chief of the embassy as deputy head of the embassy.) (also known as the minister in charge), as a diplomat who started after the 1818 Assam conference, and as a result of the 1961 Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.
title: 公使

source_text: 中华职业教育社（，缩写为）是中国的一个社会团体。1917年5月6日在上海创立，发起人是黄炎培和蔡元培、梁启超、张謇、宋汉章等48人，结社宗旨是“谋个性之发展，为个人谋生之准备，为个人服务社会之准备，为国家及世界增进生产力之准备”；“使无业者有业，使有业者乐业”。 1941年，中华职业教育社参与发起组织中国民主政团同盟。2004年，中华职业教育社成为联合国公共信息部联系的非政府组织成员。2010年，中华职业教育社成为联合国经社理事会联系的具有咨商地位的非政府组织成员。
target_text: China Vocational Education Institute (SCVS) is a social group in China. Founded in Shanghai on 6 May 1917, the founding fathers were 48 people, including Huang Yingpe and Choi Won-bae, Liang Qing-hye, Zhang Xiao and Song Han-Chang. The purpose of the association was to “develop personality, prepare individuals to earn a living, prepare individuals to serve society, prepare the country and the world to increase productivity”; “Promotion of the unemployed to work and make the economically active enjoy their work.” In 1941, the China Vocational Education Association sponsored the Alliance of Chinese Democratic Societies. In 2004, the China Vocational Education Society became a member of the United Nations Department of Public Information. In 2010, the China Vocational Education Society became a member of a non-governmental organization in consultative status with the United Nations Economic and Social Council.
title: 中华职业教育社

清朝
至清朝前期，“中國”一詞已經有著约三千年以上的使用歷史，作為一種地域（指中原地区）或朝代正统的标志，“外國”對等並稱。但從不曾將“中國”兩字作為政权的直接名称。自清军入主中原以来，统治者皆強調以“中国”自称。1689年清朝与俄国签订，被部分學者認為具有现代国际法水准的边界条约《尼布楚条约》中，首次将“中国”作为正式國家名稱使用，与“俄罗斯”相对。晚清时候清廷在与外国交際往來或签定条约时，“中國”一词的使用非常普遍。许多官方正式文书上亦将“大清”与“中国”混合使用。
target_text: In the pre-King Dynasty period, the word “China” has been used for over 3,000 years as a symbol of territorial (meaning the Central and Eastern regions) or imperial orthodoxy, with “foreign” equivalents. But the word “China” has never been used as a direct name for the regime. Since the beginning of the Qing dynasty, the rulers have called themselves “China.” In 1689, the border treaty between China and Russia, which some scholars consider to have modern international law standards, the term “China” was used for the first time as the official name of the country, as opposed to “Russia.
title: 中國的名稱
