source_text:
同一天凌晨，在西貢，19名越共突擊隊員將美國大使館的外牆炸開了一個大口子，衝了進去，正在執勤的5個憲兵（MP）很快魂歸黃泉。雖然擊斃了看守大使館主門的2個憲兵，但當北越突擊小隊試圖用反坦克火箭把門炸毀時，卻被擔任警戒的美國海軍陸戰隊隊員壓制住了，雙方展開了激烈的交火。但很快美軍的增援部隊101空降師也乘坐直升機趕到了大使館。到了上午10點鐘左右，整個形勢就發生了變化。參加此戰的所有19名北越突擊隊員都被美軍打死，他們的屍體散放在大使館院內。另外還有5名美國人和2名越南平民也在戰鬥中被殺。
參加行動的這些北越突擊隊員都是平民打扮，他們是乘坐一輛舊卡車來到大使館的。幾分鐘後，大使館已經不再危險，受到的破壞也很輕微，但北越此次對「美國國土」的攻擊卻引起了美國媒體的普遍關注，此次戰鬥也成為了春節攻勢的一個標誌。另外還有一些北越正規軍/越共小分隊襲擊了西貢的總統府、電台、南越軍隊的參謀部總部。還有700名北越軍隊發動了對新山一空軍基地（Tan Son Nhut Air Base）的襲擊，威廉·魏摩蘭將軍的美國軍事援助越南司令部（MACV）大樓也同時遭到攻擊。
target_text: In the early morning hours of the same day, 19 Viet Nam Marines, who were on alert, took a big blow to the outside wall of the United States embassy. But shortly after the US Army reinforcements arrived in the embassy in a helicopter, the five MPs, who were on duty, were in the spirits of the yellow spring. Although two charterers were shot dead at the main gate of the prison guard, all 19 North Vietnamese assaulters were killed by the Americans with anti-tank rockets, their bodies were scattered inside the embassy compound. Five United States Marines and two Vietnamese civilians were also killed in the battle, and there was an intense exchange of fire between the two sides.
title: 新春攻勢

source_text: 1月31日，午夜0時之後的的凌晨，19名越共工兵營所屬的敢死隊員聚集在潘清簡街59號（）一家修車廠的藏匿處內分配武器，準備趁夜對美國大使館發動攻擊。接著他們乘坐一輛貨車和計程車朝市中心駛去，當進入莫挺之街、因為正值宵禁而熄掉大燈後，仍被西貢市警發現，但警員們沒有加以攔截。兩輛車之後又轉入統一大道，然後開始對大門的美國陸軍憲兵開火。當時值班的兩位憲兵，查爾斯·丹尼爾專業下士（）和威廉·塞巴斯特一等兵（）立刻開槍還擊，迅速鎖上鐵門後以無線電通報大使館遭受攻擊。同時聽到槍聲的是人在後院的海軍陸戰隊中士羅納·哈伯（），他從使館辦公樓後門奔往前門，穿過大廳裡正在撥電話請求支援的陸戰隊下士喬治·扎赫雷尼（），並把一名南越巡夜員拉入館內，再鎖上厚重的柚木大門。
target_text: On 31 January, in the early morning hours after midnight, 19 dead men belonging to the Viet Nam Engineering Battalion gathered in a shelter at 59 Pan Qingjan Street (a repair plant) to distribute weapons in preparation for a night attack on the American Embassy. They then drove in a van and a taxi to the centre of the city, and, as soon as they entered Morjane, as a result of the curfew, the lights went out, were quickly locked into the iron gate, but the police officers did not stop it. The two vehicles were then turned into Main Avenue, and then started firing at the American Army soldiers at the main gate.
title: 新春攻勢

source_text: 在美國大使館5個街區外的海軍陸戰隊宿舍，羅伯特·歐布萊恩上尉（）將使館警衛隊內其他的陸戰隊員組成了快速反應小組並朝大使館進發。當他們到達莫挺之街時，發現車輛入口已被鎖上，且可以看到越共敢死隊在院裡射擊。當他們呼叫憲兵時，越共隊員們立刻開槍逼他們退到遠處，並在館內的花園裡點火。
target_text: At the Marine House, five blocks away from the US embassy, Captain Robert O’Brien made the rest of the Marines in the embassy guard team a quick reaction team and headed towards the embassy. When they arrived on the streets of Mozambique, they found that the entrance to the vehicle was locked and that the Vietcongs were shooting in the courtyard. When they called for the Constitution, the Vietcong immediately fired shots at them to retreat and set fire in the garden inside.
title: 新春攻勢

source_text: 凌晨4時，美國駐越大使透過副官聯絡西貢警察廳長阮文論（），請他提供援助，但第一分局局長拒絕在暗夜中調動警員，反要求美方派人護送他的警隊前往大使館，因此借助西貢警力增援的計畫宣告失敗。4時20分，美軍援越司令官威廉·魏摩蘭上將命令716憲兵營優先執行對使館敵人的掃蕩任務，缺乏武裝車輛及直升機的憲兵們，只得加派部隊封鎖使館周邊街區。當時因為夜間過暗，再加上大使館方面與館外海軍陸戰隊、憲兵隊之間的通訊、或是院區內部的通訊品質均相當不良，而使事態顯得更加混亂模糊。哈伯中士和其他在大樓內的美國人員可透過電話聯絡外界，而頂樓的索托中士只有一支無線電。
target_text: At 4 a.m., the U.S. Ambassador for the Viet Nam called for assistance from the deputy chief of the Saigon police, Nguyen Mangong, but the chief of the 1st Branch refused to send police officers in the dark and asked the U.S. to escort his troops to the embassy, and failed with the help of the Sigon police. At 4.20 a.m., the U.S. Commander for the United States Army, William Wei Morran, ordered the 716th Regiment to carry out a sweep against the enemy of the embassy, and the lack of charterers in armed vehicles and helicopters.
title: 新春攻勢

source_text: 在使館大樓旁的領事館院區內，海軍陸戰隊下士詹姆士·馬歇爾（）爬上一棟領事館所屬的樓房，從屋頂上朝大使館院子裡的越共們開槍，當他被一枚砲彈破片擊傷時仍然守在射擊位置上，直到越共的另一發子彈將他擊斃為止，他可能是當天最後一名在大使館事件中喪生的美國人。早上5時，美國陸軍第101空降師的一群空降兵搭直升機試圖降落在大使館屋頂上，但馬上被院子裡尚未戰死的越共開火逼退，6時15分，一架救難直升機才飛到樓頂，接走受傷的扎赫雷尼下士，並投下三箱M16步槍的子彈。但由於館內人員都沒有配備該款步槍，因此完全沒派上用場。
target_text: In the compound area of the consulate near the embassy building, Marine Corporal James Marshall, who climbed up to the building belonging to a consulate, shot the Vietcongs from the roof and was still standing at the firing position when he was hit by a shell fragment, until another Vietcong bullet shot him to death, possibly the last American to be killed in the incident at the embassy. At 5 a.m., a group of United States Army 101th landing squadroners attempted to land on the roof of the embassy building, but they were immediately fired by the Vietcong, who were still alive in the yard. At 6.15 a.m., a rescue plane landed on the roof to pick up the wounded Zahrani, and dropped three boxes of M16 rifles.
title: 新春攻勢

source_text:
軍政府鎮壓

過萬名僧侶不理會軍政府的宵禁及集會警告，早上在仰光的大金塔聚集；他們手持旗幟並高叫口號，有居民燒雜物。

source_text: 联合国安全理事会1778号决议是联合国安全理事会于2007年9月25日在第5748次会议上通过的一项决议。该决议表示，鉴于苏丹共和国、乍得和中非共和国间边界区域的局势对国际和平与安全构成威胁，且欧盟、乍得和中非政府已经做出相关承诺，决定向乍得和中非派遣为期一年的联合国中非共和国和乍得特派团（MINURCAT），此团包括最多300名警察和50名军事联络官以及适当数量的文职人员。另外，安理会还授权欧盟与联合国秘书长商议，部署一支武装力量到乍得和中非，为期一年。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 1778, adopted by the United Nations Security Council at its 5748th meeting on 25 September 2007, states that, in view of the threat to international peace and security posed by the situation in the border region between the Republic of the Sudan, Chad and the Central African Republic, and in view of the relevant commitments made by the European Union, Chad and the Central African Government, it has decided to dispatch to Chad and Central Africa, for a period of one year, the United Nations Mission in the Central African Republic and Chad (MINURCAT), consisting of up to 300 police officers and 50 military liaison officers, as well as an appropriate number of civilian personnel. In addition, the Council authorized the European Union, in consultation with the Secretary-General of the United Nations, to deploy an armed force to Chad and Central Africa for a period of one year.
title: 联合国安全理事会第1778号决议

source_text: 伊萨克·蒂进（，），又译为德胜、铁俊甫，是一名荷兰外科医生、学者、商人与大使。在东亚的漫长职业生涯中，蒂进是荷兰东印度公司（Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie，简称作VOC，含义为“联合东印度公司”）的一名高级官员。他是欧洲在亚洲贸易公司与江戶幕府日本进行官方接触的全权代表。他曾两次前往江户，以与幕府将军及其他高级幕府官员沟通。他是荷兰与荷兰东印度公司在孟加拉钦苏拉（Chinsura）的总督。蒂进与他的搭档Charles Cornwallis相互合作，后者是英国东印度公司的总督。1795年，就在乾隆庆祝登基60周年之前，蒂进代表荷兰及荷兰东印度公司的利益访问中国，并受到了乾隆帝的接见；与之相反的是，早先一年访问中国的英国大使却遭到了冷遇。在中国，蒂进在担任荷兰东印度公司贸易代表的同时，也有效地为自己的国家行使了驻华大使的职责。
target_text: During his long career in East Asia, Tijing was a senior official of the Netherlands East India Company (Verreenigde Oostindische Compagnie, known as VOC, meaning “the United East India Company”). source_text: 许多其他国家开始在南极立界声称主权，因此到了1950年代，开始谈判设立一项条约将这一地区非军事化并保证南极洲只用于和平科研目的，条约在1961年获得通过，該條約稱為南極條約。因此英国将其军事力量撤离到南纬60°以外的英属南极领地。只有法国、挪威、新西兰和澳大利亚在南极洲有领土要求，承认英属南极领地。
target_text: Since many other countries began to claim sovereignty in the Antarctic boundary, negotiations began in the 1950s to establish a treaty that would demilitarize the area and guarantee that Antarctica would be used only for peaceful scientific research purposes, which was adopted in 1961 and called the Antarctic Treaty. Only France, Norway, New Zealand and Australia had territorial claims in Antarctica to recognize British Antarctic Territory.

From a political point of view, Britain’s relationship with the European Union is more distant, with Catherine Ashton taking up an important position that will bring Britain closer to the European Union and to engage actively in other European regional affairs.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text: （二）改革內容 設立欧洲理事會主席職位，修改目前每半年輪換一次的歐盟主席國輪替機制。主席任期2年半，可以連任。將目前的歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表和歐盟委員會外交委員這兩個職權交叉的職務合併，設立「歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表」一職，全面負責歐盟對外政策。將更多政策領域劃歸到以「有效多數表決制」決策的範圍，以簡化決策過程。司法、內政等敏感領域的一些政策也將以「有效多數制」表決，成員國不可以「一票否決」。但在稅收、社會保障、外交和防務等事關成員國主權的領域，仍採取「一致通過」原則。各成員國在「有效多數表決制」下的加權票數重新調整，2014年至2017年之間逐步實行。以「雙重多數表決制」取代目前的「有效多數表決制」，即有關決議必須至少獲得55%的成員國和65%的歐盟人口的贊同，才算通過。新表決制將在2014年開始實施，到2017年之前的3年為過渡期。從2014年起，歐盟委員會的委員人數將從27名減至18名，委員會主席的作用將加強。歐洲議會的權力將增強。此外，議會的議席數將從目前的785席減至568席，一些國家所佔議席數將根據其人口數量作出調整。「見右表」成員國議會將在歐盟決策過程中發揮更大作用。例如，如果一項歐盟立法草案遭到三分之一成員國議會的反對，將返回歐盟委員會重新考慮。新《條約》將確認《歐盟基本權利憲章》對各成員國的法律約束力。
target_text: The combination of the two current positions of high-level representatives of the European Union's foreign and security policy and the diplomatic commission of the European Union's Council with the post of "high-level representatives of the European Union's foreign and security policy" with overall responsibility for the European Union's foreign policy. More areas of policy have been reduced to the scope of the “effective majority vote” decision, and some of the policies of sensitive areas, such as justice, the internal government, will be replaced by “effective majority vote” and the foreign affairs committee of the European Union's Council, with the position of “high-level representative of the European Union's foreign and security policy” with the overall responsibility for the European Union's external policy.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text: 《條約》之中新設的「欧洲理事会主席」與「歐盟委員會主席」、「歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表」的職責分工並不完全清楚明確，三人之間能否配合則有待觀察。除此之外，「歐盟委員會專員」人數減少之後，各成員國之間怎樣分配委員名額也沒有最後定斷。由於新的「雙重多數表決制」牽涉到每國國家人口數量，故各成員國如何界定各自人口總數也將成為新的問題。
target_text: The new "President of the Council of Europe" and "President of the Council of the European Union" and "High Representative of the European Union for Foreign and Security Policy" functions in the Treaty are not entirely clear, and it is yet to be seen whether cooperation between the three can be achieved. Moreover, when the number of members of the "Council of the European Union" is reduced, there is no final determination as to how to allocate its membership among member states.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text: 根據《里斯本條約》，歐洲理事會將對警察和司法的規劃，外交政策和憲法問題，擁有更大的發言權，其中包括：歐盟委員會及歐洲議會的組成；有關輪值主席的事項，中止成員權利；改變《條約》内的銜接條款表決系統，以及對有關提名歐盟委員會主席以及歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表的事情上。在緊急情況下，一個國家可利用「打破常規程序」，把歐盟部長理事會通過一些有爭議性的法律，直接遞交至歐洲理事會决定。
target_text: According to the Lisbon Treaty, the Council of Europe will have a greater voice in police and justice planning, foreign policy and constitutional issues, including: the formation of the Council of the European Union and the Council of Europe; the suspension of membership rights in relation to rotating presidents; changes in the rules of succession system in the Treaty; and the nomination of the Chairman of the Council of the European Union and of high-level representatives of the European Union's foreign and security policy. In an emergency situation, a country may use the “breaking the normal procedure” to pass controversial laws on the Council of Europe's Council of Ministers to the Council of Europe.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text: 理事會部長會議內，將有3個會員國，擔任34個月的輪值主席。其宗旨是提供更多的連續性。3個逐次形式擔任的主席位置，形成了「三主席」格局，他們之間將會用超過1年半時間共同工作。唯一的例外，就是理事會的外交事務配置上，將會由新設立的職位：歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表所擔任。2009年《里斯本條約》生效之後，理事會主席由每半年一任，改為經由選舉產生的職位，任期二年半，可連任一次。
target_text: Three member states will serve as rotating chairs for 34 months in the Council's meeting. Its purpose is to provide more continuity. Three successive presidents will serve in a “troika” format, and they will work together for more than a year and a half. The only exception is the Council's diplomatic profile, which will be filled by a new high-level representative of the European Union's foreign and security policy. After the Lisbon Treaty came into force in 2009, the President of the Council will be replaced by a semi-annual chair, who will be elected for a two-and-a-half-year term, renewable once.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text: 根據《里斯本條約》規定，從2014年起，歐盟委員會的規模，从原先的一個專員代表一個成員國（例如，假设欧盟有27个成员国，那么欧盟委员会由27个人组成），變成為由三分之二成員國數目的人数组成（例如，假设欧盟有27个成员国，那么欧盟委员会由18个人组成）。這將結束了自1957年以來，任何時候起碼一個專員代表一個成員國的安排。不過，該《條約》是有規定，歐洲理事會可以利用全體會議成員一致決定方式，來改變這種安排。愛爾蘭第一次全民公決之後，歐洲理事會於2008年12月決定，從《條約》生效起，恢復原來的一個專員代表一個會員國的形式。擔任歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表者一般為当时的歐盟委員會的副主席（Vice-President of the Commission）。
target_text: According to the Lisbon Treaty, since 2014, the Council of the European Union has been composed of two thirds of the membership (for example, 27 members of the European Union, the European Commission is made up of 18 members). This will put an end to the arrangement whereby, at any time since 1957, at least one member represents a member State. However, the Treaty is regulated that the Council of Europe could change that arrangement by a unanimous decision of the full membership. After Ireland’s first referendum, the Council of Europe decided in December 2008 that, with the entry into force of the Treaty, one of its members would represent a member State.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text: 雖然歐洲法院將會有權對一些有關制裁措施的外交政策，採取司法复核，但基本上，外交政策問題將會繼續在歐洲法院的管轄範圍之外。不過，歐洲法院還是具有對自由，安全和司法範圍（Area of Freedom, Security and Justice ASFJ）內但又不涉及到治安與刑事合作（Policing and Criminal Co-operation）的一切事項，擁有管轄權。
target_text: Although the European Court of Justice will have the power to take judicial review of a number of foreign policies relating to sanctions, foreign policy issues will essentially remain outside the jurisdiction of the European Court of Justice. However, the European Court of Justice has jurisdiction over all matters within the scope of freedom, security and justice, but not in relation to public security and criminal cooperation.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text:
歐盟外交及安全政策高級代表
為了確保歐盟外交政策具有更大的協調和一致性，《里斯本條約》創立了歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表，以取代共同外交及安全政策高級代表及對外關係和歐洲鄰國政策歐盟委員會專員兩個職位。該高級代表兼任「歐盟委員會副主席」及「歐洲防務機構管理人」，但不會擔任「歐盟理事會總秘書長」。
target_text: In order to ensure greater coherence and consistency in the European Union’s foreign policy, the Lisbon Treaty created the European Union’s High Representative for Foreign and Security Policy to replace the two posts of High Representative for the Common Foreign and Security Policy and Member of the European Commission for Foreign Relations and European Neighbourhood Policy. The Senior Representative is also the “Vice-President of the Council of the European Union” and the “Director of the European Defence Agency.”
title: 里斯本条约

source_text:
歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表有權主導國防和安全任務。《里斯本條約》也稱呼此職為歐盟外交首席官。歐盟外交和安全政策高級代表根據《里斯本條約》13a-III條款規定，負責歐盟對外行動服務（European External Action Service）；實際即歐盟外交部或外交使團（Foreign Office or Diplomatic Corps for the Union）。相互協助
根據《里斯本條約》，如果任何會員國受到恐怖襲擊，或受到自然或者人為等災害，會員國應予以協助。此外，一些《條約》之内的條款已被修訂：包括在歐盟範圍內的能源供應問題和修訂能源政策等事務。
target_text: The European Union’s high-level representatives on foreign and security policy have the power to direct national defence and security missions. The Lisbon Treaty also calls this function the European Union’s chief diplomatic officer. The European Union’s high-level representatives on foreign and security policy are responsible for the European Union’s foreign operations services, in accordance with article 13a-III of the Lisbon Treaty. In addition, some of the provisions of the Treaty have been amended to include energy supply issues within the European Union’s borders and to reform energy policy.
title: 里斯本条约

source_text:
學生組織
學生會：全校學生均為學生會會員，由全校學生共同投票選出，學生會亦會定期舉辦活動，並借用各種球類用品以滿足學生需要。會章規定所有會員都可成為幹事。
評議會：學生會的一個分支，主要職責是檢討學生會的工作，成員由學生會、班會各派代表成立。
四社：四社分別是紅、藍、黃、綠，由初入學後，便隨機分配學生所屬的社，社亦會定期舉辦活動，讓社員參加。至少是中二才能成為幹事。
學會：參見課外活動。
領袖生：學校的一個執法團體，主要負責協助班長維持課室秩序，檢查同學校服儀容，並登記同學遲到紀錄。至少是中二才能加入。
環保大使：致力於學校的環保及環境工作，主要職責是回收各班可供回收的垃圾，並巡查課室在沒有人的時候有否關上電器。
健康大使：致力於學生的健康問題，時常與環保大使合辦各種活動，以灌輸健康的重要性。
愛心服務大使：致力於關懷區內弱勢社群，時常舉辦探訪老人院和庇護工場的活動。
班會：為班內學生舉行活動，並處理一切有關班內的大小事務。
圖書館管理員：主要在圖書館內為同學借還書本和電腦。
target_text: Students' associations: All students are members of the student council; all students are elected by the student council; all students are voted by the student body; the student council regularly organises events and uses all kinds of football supplies to meet the needs of the student; at least two students are allowed to attend; at least two students are allowed to attend. Leaders: one of the school’s executives is responsible for helping the students maintain order in the classroom, checking the school’s uniforms, and recording the students’ books.

source_text: 1973年开始，上海市政府开始从中学毕业生中招收并培养外语人才。1974年夏，做了3年短暂学徒工之后，王沪宁作为“工农兵学员”被推荐到上海师范大学干校外语培训班学习法语。华东师大西语系被誉为“大使培训班”，出过许多大使，王沪宁学习期间的英语很好，法语更胜一筹。本来按正常情况，王沪宁是会走外交官道路的，但他对政治学的兴趣使他最后走上了另一条完全不同的道路。
target_text: Since 1973, the Shanghai municipality began to recruit and train foreign speakers from secondary school graduates. After three years of short apprenticeships in the summer of 1974, Wang Yi Ning was recommended as an “engineer” to study French as a foreign language course at Shanghai Teacher Training University. The Chinese language department was called the “Ambassador Training Course” with many ambassadors, and the English language during Wang Xiaoning’s studies was excellent and French was better.
title: 王沪宁

source_text: 1981年王沪宁获得复旦大学法学硕士学位，毕业后留校任教。王沪宁的硕士学位论文题目是《从布旦到马利旦——论西方资产阶级主权理论的发展》。答辩委员会高度评价其质量，称之为“我国学术界较系统研究资产阶级主权理论的初步尝试。”1984年4月，王沪宁加入中国共产党，由于复旦自由派盛行，为了抵制自由化思潮，复旦大学政治学教研室主任王邦佐将自称“新保守主义”的王沪宁列为了重点培育对象，对他大加扶持。
target_text: Wang Xiaoning received a Master of Laws (LL.M.) degree from the University of Khatami in 1981 and left it to teach after graduation. Wang Xiaoning's Master of Science dissertation entitled “Burdan to Malidan – development of the doctrine of Western bourgeois sovereignty.” The Defence Committee highly valued its quality and described it as “a preliminary attempt to study the theory of bourgeois sovereignty more systematically in our academic community.” Wang Xiaoning joined the Communist Party of China in April 1984. As a result of the prevalence of the Angdan liberalism, and in an effort to resist the trend of liberalization, Wang Bang-soo, the Director of the Faculty of Political Science at the University of Reytan, placed the emphasis on the development of Wang Xuanning, who called himself “neo Conservativeism,” and supported him.
title: 王沪宁

source_text: 第3任妻子肖佳灵（1966年4月－）：湖南人，复旦大学法学博士，现为复旦大学国际关系与公共事务学院副教授，上海市国际关系学会会员，复旦大学日本研究中心特聘研究员。于复旦大学国际政治系国际关系专业完成本科、硕士、博士教育，1997年5月获法学博士学位。王沪宁是肖佳灵的博士生导师。1999年在日本东京大学法学部从事博士后研究。在研究期间被日本情报机构盯上，准备策反。获知此事的中国国安并不知道肖、王关系，将此事报告中央才知道肖是王沪宁的妻子，于是急令肖回国。后肖佳灵继续在美国耶鲁大学、法国巴黎政治学院做访问学者。两人于1998年结婚，婚后肖佳灵仍居上海，而王沪宁居北京，因为异地聚少离多而最终离婚。两人无子女。
target_text: Xiao Jia Ling, third wife (April 1966): Hunan, a doctor of law at the University of Tokyo, is currently an associate professor at the School of International Relations and Public Affairs of the University of rehabilitation, a member of the Shanghai City Institute of International Relations, and a special research fellow at the Japan Research Centre of the University of rehabilitation. Wang Xiao Jianing was a doctoral teacher at the University of Japan University of Tokyo, where he was in post-doctoral studies in 1999. During his research, he was watched by the Japanese intelligence service and was prepared to turn his back.

target_text: United Nations Day was proclaimed by the General Assembly of the United Nations in 1948 to mark the third anniversary of the entry into force of the Charter of the United Nations. The General Assembly of the United Nations in 1971 recommended that Member States designate the day as a public holiday.

王大閎1917年7月6日生於北京，於上海與蘇州長大。父親是法學家王寵惠。蘇州景海小學畢業後，先後就讀南京金陵中學與蘇州東吳初中。1930年，隨父親前往海牙工作，進入瑞士栗子林中學（或稱夏德乃中學、夏德美中學）就讀，1936年就讀於英國劍橋大學，原先主修機械，後來改為建築。1940年因歐洲局勢不穩，在父親安排下赴美。1941年進入美國哈佛大學建築研究所攻讀。1942年哈佛畢業，受駐美大使魏道明邀請，擔任華盛頓中國駐美大使館隨員。1944年10月，美國雜誌《室內》邀約發表作品，1945年1月，作品《城市中庭住宅》(The Atrium Town House)發表。1947年，在上海與陳佔祥、黃作燊、鄭觀萱、陸謙受共同成立五聯建築師事務所。1949年王大閎前去香港，1952年春天遷居臺北。1953年，在父親支持下成立大洪建築師事務所。

source_text:
普魯士西里西亞
奧地利女皇玛丽亚·特蕾莎加冕为波西米亚王国女王后，立即引发了普鲁士国王腓特烈大帝对西里西亚地区的入侵，从而引发了奥地利王位继承战争（1740-1748）。到1742年第一次西里西亚战争结束时，普鲁士军队已经征服了哈布斯堡王室在西里西亚的几乎所有土地，而根据布雷斯劳和柏林的和平条约，只有最东南部的一些小部分地区，如特申以及特罗保公国和尼萨公国的南部地区仍然是哈布斯堡王朝的领地，称为奥地利西里西亚。玛丽亚·特蕾莎在第二次西里西亚战争（1744-1745）中夺回王室土地的尝试以失败告終，她最终不得不根据《德累斯顿条约》放弃对西里西亚的主权要求。
target_text: By the end of the first war in Silesia in 1742, the Prussia army had conquered almost all of the Crown's land in Silesia, while, under the Treaty of Peace between Breslau and Berlin, only a few small parts of the south-east, such as Teschen and the southern parts of the Tropo and Nisa kingdoms, remained the domain of the Habsburg dynasty, known as Silicia, Austria. María Teresa had failed in her attempt to take back the Crown's land during the second war in Silesia (1744-1745), and she had to abandon her claim to sovereignty over Silesia under the Treaty of Dresden.
title: 西里西亚省 (普鲁士)

source_text: 初中还尚未毕业，由于文化大革命的爆发，王光亚到北大荒当知青；1968年，被分配到黑龙江省绥滨县的生产建设兵团劳动。在中华人民共和国成功取代了中华民国在联合国的席位后，主管当时外交事务的国务院总理周恩来，对于未来外交接班人才深感忧虑。外交部奉命把曾在当时上海外院附中和外语学校学习了3年的原初三学生招回来，从中精选了一些人，送到英国，学习外语、政治、经济。这批人中，就包括了王光亚、杨洁篪、沙祖康、周文重、龙永图等，以及后来成为王光亚夫人的陳毅女兒陈珊珊（又名：丛军）。
target_text: After the People’s Republic of China succeeded in replacing the Republic of China in its seat at the United Nations, Premier Zhou Enlai of the State Council, who was in charge of foreign affairs, was deeply concerned about the future of the diplomatic career. 重要活动
2005年，日本谋求成为联合国安理会常任理事国。王光亚曾试图阻止，但日本一度获得大量国家的支持。有人戏称，这场多边外交是“王光亚的保卫战”。随后，王光亚改变策略，利用由日本和其他一同申请入常的三个国家所组成“四国联盟”，在各有地缘上的反对者这一特点，与相关国家组成“同盟”。最终，以“安理会改革方案未达成共识”为由，代表中国政府公开表示将反对现行改革方案。从而，成功地打破了日本谋求进入常任理事会的愿望。
中国常驻联合国代表任內，王光亚多次反擊“台独活动”。特别是在2007年8月，时任中华民国总统陈水扁致函联合国，表示要求台湾加入联合国。作为联合国安全理事会当月的轮值主席，王光亚退回了陈水扁的信函，并称他是“彻头彻尾的国际麻烦制造者”。

历史
在十三年战争（1454-1466年）之中，波美拉尼亚和普鲁士地区的城镇反抗条顿骑士团國，并寻求波兰国王卡齐米日四世的协助。在1466年签订的托伦条约之中，波美拉尼亚和西普鲁士地区成为了波兰的省分皇家普鲁士，获得了数个特权，特别是在但泽市。1569年皇家普鲁士成为了波兰立陶宛联邦的一部分，保留了普鲁士人的自治政府。另一方面，在托伦条约中降为波兰附庸的条顿骑士团仍然拥有东普鲁士。条顿骑士团國1525年升格为普鲁士公国，1660年波兰丧失了对此地的宗主权。
target_text: In the 13-year war (1454-1466), the towns of Pomelania and Prussia resisted the Order of the Order of the Prussia and sought the assistance of the King of Poland, Kazimi Day IV. In the Torun Treaty of 1466, the Pomerania and Siphorus regions became the provincial subdivisions of Poland, with several privileges, particularly in the city of Danzig. In 1569, the Royal Prussia became part of the Union of Lithuania of Poland, reserving the self-government of the Prussia people. On the other hand, the Order of Ptyton, which was descended into the Torun Treaty of Poland, continued to hold East Prussia. In 1525, the Knights of the Serton Order became the Grand Duchy of Prussia, and in 1660, Poland lost its communal sovereignty over the territory.

source_text: 联合国安全理事会否决权，简称一票否决权，是指联合国安全理事会的5個常任理事國（美国、英国、法國、俄羅斯、中國）各自擁有否決權，能对非程序性事項的安理會決議草案進行否決，以达至对具有强制性的安理会决议的“大国一致”。即使非程序性事項的安理會決議草案獲得大部分成員國的支持，但只要有一個常任理事國投下反對票（即行使否決權）便能使該決議草案被否決，若是常任理事國於投票時缺席或投棄權票則不視為否決。即便決議草案被否決，安理會和联合国大会仍能以聯合國大會第377號決議等途徑進行討論；2022年4月26日，联合国大会通过聯合國大會第76/262号决议，要求在常任理事国动用否决权之后将由聯合國大會在10天内自动召开会议。
target_text: The United Nations Security Council veto, or veto, means that each of the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council (the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Russia, China) has the right to veto the draft decision of the Security Council on non-procedural matters to the extent that it is “coherent” to the mandatory resolution of the Council. Even if the draft decision of the Security Council on non-procedural matters is supported by a majority of the members, the United Nations General Assembly, through resolution 76/262 of the United Nations General Assembly, on 26 April 2022, called for the veto to be used by the permanent members to be automatically convened by the United Nations General Assembly within 10 days.
title: 聯合國安全理事會否決權

source_text:
挪威和丹麥的統治下（1262年－1944年）
冰岛保持了300年的独立，随后被挪威和丹麦统治。1814年丹麦-挪威联合王国根据基尔條約分治之前，冰岛是挪威国王的殖民地，此后成为丹麦的附属国。1874年，丹麦政府给予冰岛有限的自治，1918年，冰岛在内政方面进一步获得了类似于保護國的独立和主权，外交和国防方面丹麦仍保留权力。1940年，纳粹德国在二战期间占领了丹麦，同年盟军占领了冰岛。 丹麦国王继续保持法律上的统治直到1944年冰岛共和国建立。
target_text: Under the rule of Norway and Denmark (1262-1944) Iceland remained independent for 300 years and was subsequently ruled by Norway and Denmark. Before the division of the Danish-Norwegian United Kingdom under the Kiel Treaty in 1814, Iceland was a colony of the King of Norway and subsequently became a dependency of Denmark. In 1874, the Danish Government granted Iceland limited autonomy, and in 1918 Iceland further gained independence and sovereignty in internal affairs similar to that of the protectorate, while Denmark retained power in foreign affairs and defence.
title: 冰岛历史

target_text: On the basis of this secret annex, the Soviet Union began negotiations with Estonia on 25 September and signed a treaty with Estonia on 28 September, giving it the right to occupy certain ports and military installations during the war and to establish a military presence in the areas concerned. On 16 June 1940, the Soviet Union submitted to Estonia a so-called request “to guarantee the implementation of mutual assistance treaties and to prevent anti-Soviet provocations”, after which it took over the entire territory of Estonia, arrested its government officials, repealed its Constitution and established a communist government. On 14 June 1941, Estonia was annexed by the Soviet Union to become a Soviet republic, the Soviet Socialist Republic of Estonia. The Soviet occupation and annexation were not recognized by the United States and Western countries, and the United States also frozen the gold reserves stored by the Estonian National Bank in the United States.

The Russian forces on the territory of Estonia were completely withdrawn in 1994, Estonia joined the European Union and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in 2004 and became part of the Schengen Public Date Party on 21 December 2007.
title: 爱沙尼亚

source_text: 为爱沙尼亚的最高司法机构，由17名法官组成，法官主席由总统提名，议会指派，任期为终生。愛沙尼亞的武裝部隊為愛沙尼亞國防軍。外交爱沙尼亚目前尚未与三个联合国成员国建交，分别是朝鲜民主主义人民共和国，不丹和也门。愛沙尼亞是歐盟27国中，除法國以外，另一个在外交上至今未正式承認朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的國家，愛沙尼亞只承認大韓民國政府為朝鮮半島的唯一合法政府，并在2020年末在韓國首爾設立常驻大使館。
target_text: Estonia is the highest judicial institution in Estonia, composed of 17 judges, appointed for life by the President and appointed by the Parliament. Estonia’s armed forces are the defence of the Estonian nation. Estonia has not yet established relations with three United Nations member states, namely, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, Bhutan, and Yemen. Estonia is one of the 27 European Union countries, with the exception of France, where the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea has not been officially recognized diplomatically to date, and it has only recognized the Korean government as the only legitimate government in the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and has established a permanent embassy in Seoul, Korea, by the end of 2020.
title: 爱沙尼亚

source_text: 它为国际调停者提供资源，例如：和解协议、调停的托管授权等。数据库内有1945年以来签署的各种和解协议350多个，以及从书中摘录的突出显著分析、联合国调解和相关主题的文件、条款和摘录500多篇。而且，联合国调解人包括一个广泛的法律图书馆，是引导联合国努力从事和平调解的法律体系。另外，可以方便的从该站点获得调解的相关知识，如：调停者工具箱、学术课堂、案件摘要、操作的指导说明、知识短文以及关于和平协议、和平进程管理的评论。
target_text: It provides resources for international mediators, such as conciliation agreements, fiduciary mandates for mediation, etc.. The database contains more than 350 settlement agreements signed since 1945, as well as more than 500 documents, articles and extracts from books that highlight salient analyses, United Nations mediation and related subjects. Moreover, the United Nations mediator, which includes a broad legal library, is the legal framework that guides United Nations efforts to engage in peaceful mediation. In addition, relevant knowledge of mediation can easily be obtained from the site, such as mediation tool kits, academic classes, case summaries, operational guidance notes, short knowledge notes and comments on peace agreements and the management of peace processes.
title: 联合国调解人

source_text:
调解课程内容来源于联合国广泛的调解经验。指导和评论均来自于与联合国职员和联合国调解人的采访。在联合国政治事务部门提供建议，联合国秘书长及其代表们解决国际争执和内部冲突的整体努力下，该项目于2006年10月3日公开启动。聯合國人物
調解
target_text: Guidance and comments are derived from interviews with United Nations staff and United Nations mediators. The project was launched publicly on 3 October 2006 with the advice of the United Nations political affairs department and the overall efforts of the Secretary-General of the United Nations and his representatives to resolve international disputes and internal conflicts.
title: 联合国调解人

source_text:
欧罗巴岛（）是一个位于莫桑比克海峡内的岛屿，面积约28平方公里，地势平坦，海岸线约长22.2公里；岛上没有港口、沒有常駐人口，但有一个跑道长1,500米的机场。命名及主权争议
该岛取名于1774年到访的英国船只“欧罗巴号”，1897年起成为法国属地，但马达加斯加宣称对其拥有主权。
target_text: Europa is an island located in the Strait of Mozambique with an area of about 28 square kilometres, flat terrain and a coastline of about 22.2 kilometres; there are no ports and no resident population on the island, but there is an airport with a runway of 1,500 metres long. Named after the sovereignty dispute, the British vessel Europa, which visited the island in 1774, became a French dependency since 1897, but Madagascar claims sovereignty over it.
title: 欧罗巴岛

source_text:
人为散布
美国在20世纪60年代曾经执行过西福特计划，将4亿3000万根 铜制偶极天线（全长1.78厘米，直径25.4微米（1961年）/17.8微米（1963年）的针状物）散布在轨道上形成云状环，从而反射无线电信号以便海外的美军能更好地与本国联系。本计划散布的针状物分布于高度在3500公里到3800公里之间，轨道倾角在96度到87度之间的轨道范围，最终成为了太空垃圾
。根据当时美国联合国大使阿德莱·史蒂文森的说法，在太阳辐射压力的作用下，这些针将会在短短3年内离开轨道。但事实上直到现在仍有相当数目的针残留在轨道上， 偶然才会返回大气层。
target_text: In the 1960s, the U.S. carried out the Westford Plan, which spread 430 million copper-coated polar antennas (1.78 centimetres in length and 25.4 micrometres in diameter (1961) and 17.8 micrometres (1963)) into orbit to form cloud rings, reflecting radio signals to enable U.S. troops abroad to better connect with their home countries. The Plan distributed needles at altitudes of 3,500 to 3,800 kilometres, with orbit inclinations ranging from 96 to 87 degrees, which eventually turned into space trash. According to then U.S. Ambassador Adele Stevenson, these needles would leave orbit within a short period of three years as a result of solar radiation pressure.
title: 太空垃圾

source_text: 老同盟或古老同盟（英语：，法语：），是指欧洲中世纪时期苏格兰与法国之间长达两个多世纪的针对英格兰的同盟关系，包括一系列攻击性和防卫性的双边条约。同盟开始的标志是1295年10月23日在巴黎签署的条约，历经周折，直到1560年的爱丁堡条约才中止了两个国家之间的特殊同盟关系，持续时间265年。它普遍被认为是世界历史上存在时间最长的外交同盟关系，也曾被戴高乐将军称为世界上最古老的同盟。
target_text: An old or ancient alliance (English: French): refers to more than two centuries of alliance relations between Scotland and France in Europe during the medieval era, including a series of offensive and defensive bilateral treaties. The alliance began with a treaty signed in Paris on 23 October 1295, which lasted a long time until the Edinburgh Treaty of 1560 suspended the special alliance between the two countries, lasting 265 years. It is generally considered to be the longest-standing diplomatic alliance in world history, and was once described by General de Gaulle as the oldest ally in the world.
title: 老同盟

source_text:
巴黎条约
1292年，约翰·巴里奥继承苏格兰王位，称约翰一世。但是他懦弱无能，苏格兰主权受到野心勃勃的英格兰国王爱德华一世的严重威胁，约翰几乎承认自己是爱德华的属臣，招致苏格兰国内的强烈不满。苏格兰贵族随即指派了一个十二人的议事会，基本架空了约翰的权力，同时向外寻求盟友，以求维护国家的独立。
target_text: But he was weak, and Scotland’s sovereignty was seriously threatened by the ambitious King Edward I of England, who almost admitted to being Edward’s subordinate, causing strong dissatisfaction within Scotland. The Scottish aristocrats appointed a 12-member sitting, largely emptied of John’s power, while seeking allies from outside in order to preserve the country’s independence.
title: 老同盟

source_text: 1295年10月23日，正在与爱德华一世交战的法兰西国王腓力四世与苏格兰的代表在巴黎签署条约，达成同盟意向，并商定让约翰一世的长子爱德华·巴里奥迎娶腓力四世的侄女。腓力四世表示会帮助苏格兰，但是条约也使得苏格兰形同向英格兰宣战。此后英格兰正式出兵进攻苏格兰，引发第一次独立战争。约翰一世很快被迫退位并离开了苏格兰，国家到了灭亡的边缘。1302年，腓力四世在军事失利后却与英格兰议和，彻底断绝了帮助苏格兰复国的可能。在整个苏格兰独立战争期间，腓力四世只是一个旁观者，最多曾经写信鼓励反抗运动的领袖罗伯特·布鲁斯，甚至还邀请他放弃在苏格兰的抗争，加入到十字军东征中，但是被布鲁斯婉转拒绝。
target_text: On October 23, 1295, King Philippe IV, who was at war with King Edward I, and representatives of Scotland, signed a treaty in Paris, reached an alliance of intentions, and agreed that Edward Barrio, the eldest son of John I, would marry Philip IV’s niece. Philip IV offered to help Scotland, but the treaty also made Scotland war with England. Then England formally attacked Scotland, triggering the first war of independence.
title: 老同盟

source_text:
科贝尔条约
1314年，已登基为苏格兰国王的布鲁斯在班诺克本之战大败英军，取得决定性胜利，苏格兰实际上确保了自己的独立地位；而腓力四世则在同年去世。布鲁斯在此后十多年内并未对盟友表现出太大的兴趣，直到他的幼子大卫于1324年诞生，并成为他的继承人。布鲁斯为了确保大卫登基后能得到足够的支持和帮助，于是派出使者前往法国寻求再续前约。1326年，新的法国国王查理四世面临着重新与英格兰开战的可能，与苏格兰签订科贝尔条约（Treaty of Corbeil），答应在和平与战争中向苏格兰提供帮助与建议，苏格兰则答应如果英格兰与法国开战，将派军队进攻英格兰后方。
target_text: In 1314, when Bruce, who was king of Scotland, won a decisive victory in the battle against England in Banokeburn, Scotland actually ensured its independence; and Philip IV died the same year. For more than a decade, Bruce did not show much interest in his allies until his youngest, David, was born in 1324 and became his successor. To ensure sufficient support and assistance to David when he did come to power, Bruce sent an envoy to France to seek a renewal of his previous contract. In 1326, the new French King, Charles IV, faced the possibility of a new war with England, signed the Treaty of Corell with Scotland, promised to help and advise Scotland in peace and war, and Scotland promised to send troops to attack the rear of England if England fought with France.
title: 老同盟

source_text:
文西内条约
1371年，苏格兰斯图亚特王朝的第一代君主罗伯特二世登基，再度寻求与法国的合作，双方签订了文西内条约（Treaty of Vincennes）。1377年，军事成绩显赫的爱德华三世去世，法苏两方都开始策划新的举动。1380年，查理六世继承法国王位，并于1383年以四万金法郎、一千套盔甲、一千名士兵的条件，使得罗伯特同意重新向英格兰开战。不过这些士兵以及他们的随从在苏格兰的日子并不太平，由于当时苏格兰远远比法国贫穷、落后，这些人在苏格兰与当地的人民和军队不断发生矛盾，而且苏格兰军队惯用的运动战游击战也是这些法国正规军完全不能适应的。不过最终英格兰军队没有占得任何便宜，这也是双方在老同盟中第一次真正近距离合作。
target_text: In 1371, Robert II, the first-generation monarch of the Stuart dynasty in Scotland, once again sought cooperation with France. The two parties signed the Treaty of Vincennes. In 1377, after the death of Edward III, who was a great military achievement, both parties began to plan new moves. In 1380, Charlie VI inherited the throne of the law, and in 1383, the conditions of 40,000 gold francs, 1,000 armors, and 1,000 soldiers led Robert to agree to a new war with England.
title: 老同盟

source_text: 1560年，宗教改革下的苏格兰议会在玛丽远在法国时单方面拟定了爱丁堡条约，明确表示要终止与法国的同盟关系。虽然这一条约始终没有得到玛丽女王的正式批准，但是却实际上迫使所有法国在苏格兰的天主教势力撤离。两个国家长达265年的同盟关系也由此终结。
target_text: In 1560, while Mary was far away in France, the reformed Scottish Parliament unilaterally drafted the Edinburgh treaty, which clearly states that it would end its alliance with France. Although this treaty has never been formally ratified by Queen Mary, it effectively forced all French Catholic forces in Scotland to withdraw.
title: 老同盟

source_text: 波美拉尼亚省（）是1815年至1946年间普鲁士和及后的普鲁士自由邦的一个省分。此省是由1648年威斯特伐利亚和约之后分别由勃兰登堡和瑞典统治的中波美拉尼亚及瑞属波美拉尼亚（「西波美拉尼亚」）所组成。瑞典在1814年的基尔条约中曾想波美拉尼亚让给丹麦，但条约从来没有被遵守，次年维也纳会议后波美拉尼亚被转让到普鲁士。
target_text: From 1815 to 1946, the Province of Bomerania was a province of Prussia and, later, the Free State of Prussia. It was made up of Central Pomerania, which was ruled by Brandenburg in 1648, and then by Sweden ( " West Pomerania"). Sweden wanted to give it to Denmark in the 1814 Treaty of Kiel, but the Treaty was never respected, and Pomerania was transferred to Prussia the following year after the Vienna Conference.
title: 波美拉尼亚省 (普鲁士)

source_text: 1950年11月24日，联合国军总司令道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟发起“圣诞节回家”攻势，命令爱德华·阿尔蒙德少将率领美军第10军进军鸭绿江并消灭“所有北朝鲜抵抗力量”。中国人民志愿军则派遣宋时轮率领的第9兵团，在联合国军不知情的情况下悄悄渡过鸭绿江，伏擊第10军，并保护西线的第13兵团侧翼。11月27日，志愿军展開攻勢，联合国军的前進受挫，無法阻擋志願軍的反攻，轉而往興南方向登船撤退。
target_text: On November 24, 1950, the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Army, Douglas MacArthur, launched the “Christmas Home” offensive, ordering Major General Edward Almond to lead the 10th Army of the United States into the ducks and eliminate the “all North Korean resistance.” The Chinese People's Volunteer Army sent the 9th Regiment, led by the Song timer, to sneak over the ducks without the knowledge of the United Nations forces, ambush the 10th Army and protect the 13th Wing of the West Line. On November 27, the voluntary forces began their offensive, and the United Nations troops were frustrated, unable to resist the resistance of the willing forces and retreated southwards.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 1950年9月15日，美国第10军成功登陸仁川。在联合国军南北夹击之下，釜山周围的朝鲜人民军主力遭到歼灭性打击。9月末，联合国军攻佔汉城（今首尔），朝鲜战争的结束已经在望了。10月初，联合国军越过38度线，进入朝鲜，意图在1950年底重新统一南北朝鲜。联合国军以贯穿朝鲜北部的太白山脉为分界线，沿西海岸进攻的是美國第8軍團，东海岸则为和美國第10軍。10月19日，隶属美國第8軍團的韓國陸軍第1步兵师率先攻入平壤。20日，平壤被联合国军佔领。朝鲜人民军至此基本被消灭殆尽。大多数联合国军將领，包括联合国军总司令麦克阿瑟将军，认为朝鲜战争即将结束。
target_text: In early October, the United Nations troops crossed the 38-degree line and entered North Korea with the intention of reunifying North and South Korea by the end of 1950. The United Nations forces, along the north and south coast of North Korea, attacked the 8th United States Regiment, the East Coast, and the 10th United States Army. On 19 October, the 1st Infantry Division of the Korean Army, which belongs to the 8th United States Regiment, took the lead in Pyongyang. On 20 October, Pyongyang was taken over by the United Nations. The Korean People’s Army was largely wiped out. Most United Nations forces, including General MacArthur, the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Army, believed that the Korean war was coming to an end.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 中华人民共和国在对联合国军发出一系列警告之后低調介入冲突。1950年10月19日，中国人民解放军以中国人民志愿军的名义秘密跨过边境，大舉进入北朝鲜。志愿军第42军是最早到达长津湖地区的志愿军之一，目标是阻止东线联军的推进。10月25日，正在推进的韩国第1军与志愿军遭遇，并在长津湖以南的黄草岭山口停下。元山登陆后，第10军的美國海軍陸戰隊第1師于11月2日遭遇志愿军阻击，在后续战斗中给志愿军造成重大伤亡。11月6日，志愿军42军受命向北撤退，意图将联合国军诱至长津湖。到11月24日，第1陆战师分别佔领了湖东面的新兴里和西面的柳潭里。
target_text: The People’s Republic of China engaged in a low profile conflict after issuing a series of warnings to the United Nations forces. On 19 October 1950, the Chinese People’s Liberation Army crossed the border clandestinely under the name of the Chinese People’s Volunteer Army (CPLA) to North Korea. The 42nd Army was one of the first volunteers to arrive in the Yangtze Lake area. The goal was to prevent the advance of the coalition forces on the eastern front. On 25 October, the 1st Korean Army, which was advancing, was met and stopped at the foot of the Yellowgrass Ridge, south of Lake Changjin. After the landing, the 1st Division of the 10th United States Marine Corps was stopped by volunteers on 2 November, causing heavy casualties among the volunteers during the follow-up fighting. On 6 November, the 42nd Army was ordered to withdraw north, with the intention of lured the United Nations forces to Changjin Lake.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 戰鬥於11月27日開始，麦克阿瑟於28日致電參謀長聯席會議，表示這是一個全新的戰爭，中國入朝兵力遠超預期，联合国军現有兵力無法達成原訂目標。他認為中國的目標是全殲联合国军。現在計畫從攻轉守，伺機調整。28日晚間，麥帥與阿爾蒙德、華克司令開會，決定第8軍團撤到不被志願軍包抄為止，第10軍撤到咸興－興南一線。麥帥30日通知參謀長聯席會議，計劃將第10軍收縮到咸興、元山一帶，避免被分割包圍。
target_text: The battle began on November 27, when MacArthur sent a conference to the Joint Chiefs of Staff on 28 November, stating that it was a brand-new war, that China was far ahead of schedule, and that the United Nations forces were now unable to reach their original target. He believed that China was targeting the entire United Nations army. It was now planned to move from the offensive and set the stage. On the evening of 28 November, McDude and Commanders Almond and Walker met and decided to withdraw the 8th Army to the Haming-Singan line, with the 10th.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 在美军第10军向长津湖进发时，中国人民志愿军的战略则基於第二次国共内战所积累的经验。始终认为在长津湖的联合国军的兵力并不强的志愿军总部，给第9兵团的任务是全歼柳潭里与新兴里的联合国军，随后进攻下碣隅里。此时便开始进行志愿军最擅长的“围点打援”战术——吸引第十军主力部队救援下碣隅里后，将联合国军主力围困於兴南与下碣隅里之间的道路。第9兵团刚开始投入了第20、27军的8个师，均集中於柳潭里和新兴里。
target_text: The strategy of the Chinese People’s Volunteer Army was based on the experience gained during the Second National Civil War when the United States Army’s 10th Army marched to Changjin Lake. The United Nations Army’s low-strength volunteer headquarters in Changjin Lake, which was assigned the task to the 9th Regiment, was to carry out an offensive with the new United Nations troops. At that time, it began its best “surround-and-aid” tactic – to encirculate the United Nations forces on the road between Henan and Lower Chili after attracting the 10th Army’s main forces. The 9th Regiment began to invest in eight divisions of the 20th and 27th Army, all of which were concentrated in Yantari and the emerging ones.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 而在兵力方面，战事开始时，美軍第1陆战师全师在长津湖战区部署了25,473人（宪兵、乐队、两栖牵引车营与部分后勤分队约2,000人仍在兴南），此外还有英国皇家海军陆战队的莱斯戴尔特遣队以及来自美軍第3步兵师与第7步兵师的大约兩个团的兵力增援了第1陆战师。这使得长津湖地区的联合国军实际兵力在30,000人左右。除此之外，最重要的一点，长津湖地区的联合国军背后拥有整个朝鲜战争最密集、最庞大、最集中的空中力量之一提供支援，包括在（位于兴南地区）的美國海軍陸戰隊第1航空聯隊，以及5艘航空母舰组成的美国海军第77特遣队，每日可出动230架次的飞机以提供近距离空中支援。此役陸戰隊第1航空聯隊出任務1,053次，合計3,703架次，其中599次任務是近距离空中支援，454次任務是尋敵攻擊。位於日本的美国空军远东作战货运司令部()则有能力為被包围的联合国军平均每日提供250吨的补给。
target_text: At the beginning of the battle, however, the entire United States Army Land Division deployed 25,473 troops (the military police, the band, the Amphibious Trailer battalion and some of the logistics sub-units are still in the south), in addition to the Royal Marines' Lesdale contingent and the 77th United States Marine Corps from the 3rd and 7th Infantry Divisions, which are supported by the actual strength of the United Nations forces in the Lake Changzin area at around 30,000. The most important point is the support of one of the most intensive, largest and concentrated air forces of the entire Korean war, including the 1st United States Marine Corps (in the south), 599 of which are close air support units, and the average of the 250th United States air cargo command, which is directed at the United States Air Force.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 志愿军的总兵力在150,000人左右。在抵达朝鲜之前，第9兵团下属各军也得到了加强，每个军从原来的3个师变成了4个师，每个师约10,000人 。部分前中华民国国军的士兵也被编入了这些部队以确保满员率。某些步兵连甚至有150-200人。然而，由於联合国军的频繁空袭、糟糕的后勤与史无前例的严寒天气，导致最终参战的人数远低於120,000。例如仅在第9兵团进入朝鲜的第一天，全兵团便有700人被冻伤以致不能继续作战，而大部分的运输载具均被联合国军的空袭摧毁。在美国陆军的官方战史中，写到了志愿军的俘虏报告，第9兵团的大部分师在开始作战之前已经是“减员师”，全师仅6,500至7,000人。这些因素使得包括美国陆军战史官方作者罗伊·艾普曼在内的大量战史专家认为实际上参战的志愿军人数远低於120,000人，艾普曼认为实际作战人数为60,000。而堪萨斯大学教授米勒特认为在75,000-83,000之间。
target_text: Some former soldiers of the National Army of the Republic of China were integrated into these units to ensure full strength. Some infantry companies even had 150-200 troops. However, with frequent United Nations air strikes, poor logistics and unprecedented cold weather, the number of final participants in the war was much lower than 120,000. For example, on the first day of the 9th Regiment’s entry into the country, 700 troops were frozen to the point of being unable to continue fighting, while most transport vehicles were destroyed by United Nations air strikes.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 最终，儘管志愿军的12个师都被部署至前线，第78师、第88师与第94师在战役过程中完全没有与联合国军交火，其中第94师对战役的参与度低到甚至联合国军情报一度认为该师为当时已经被裁撤的第90师。志愿军实际投入进攻的主要兵力为第20军与第27军的8个师。而第26军，则在第20与27军已无兵可用的12月7日方才投入战场。
target_text: In the end, although 12 divisions of the volunteer force were deployed to the front line, the 78th, 88th and 94th Divisions did not engage the United Nations forces at all during the campaign, with 94th Division being less involved in the campaign than the 90th Division, which was once considered by the United Nations military intelligence to have been abolished at that time. The main forces actually invested in the attack were the 20th and 27th. The 26th Army, on the other hand, did not enter the battlefield until 7 December, when the 20th and 27th Army were no longer available.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 到12月1日，志愿军第58师实际上已無戰力，其残部在等待第26军的增援。但让宋时轮最感到懊恼的，就是第26军并没有在美軍陆战队从柳潭里成功突围之前到达，其中尤以第26军第88师的师长吴大林擅自决定将出发时间延迟了15个小时最为致命。隨著机场在12月1日開始運作，联合国军得以获得增援以及撤走死者和伤员。當柳潭里的美軍陆战队员于12月4日完成撤离，向下碣隅里收縮的联合国军终于可以开始向兴南港突围了。
target_text: By 1 December, the 58th Division of the voluntary army was virtually indestructible, and the rest of its ranks were waiting for reinforcements from the 26th Army. But the 26th Army was most upset that the 26th Army did not arrive before the US Marine Corps successfully broke out from Liu Qingli, with, inter alia, the Director of the 88th Division of the 26th Army, Wu Da Lin, deciding to delay its departure by 15 hours. As the airport began to operate on 1 December, the United Nations forces were able to secure reinforcements and evacuate the dead and wounded.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 下碣隅里的志願軍第26军失败后，志愿军高层命令第26军和第27军追击撤退的联合国军，第20军堵截撤退路线。但由于第20军大部已经在柳潭里和下碣隅里被消滅，在古土里与兴南之间的部队只有第58師和第60师的残部。在绝望中，宋时轮命令这些部队在黃草岭山口築壕据守，同时炸掉唯一退路上的水門橋，希望这些地形因素和障碍能让第26军和第27军追上撤退的联合国军。佔据1081高地的志愿军第180团连续炸毁了原来的水泥桥和两个临时替代桥，确信其无法修复。美軍反擊，从南面攻击1081高地，并于12月9日在守军战斗到最后一人后成功佔领了该高地。与此同时，美軍第7陆战团和第31团级作戰队餘部从北面进攻水門橋，他們只遭遇到已经冻僵在散兵坑中的志願軍部隊。
target_text: In despair, the 26th and 27th Army were ordered to pursue the retreated United Nations Army by the 26th Army and the 27th Army, and the 20th Army blocked the withdrawal route. As the 20th Army was destroyed in Liugu and the lower part, the 58th and 60th Division of the army between the ancient tutu and Hinnan were destroyed. In a desperate struggle, the Songs ordered the troops to set up trenches at the corner of the Yellowgrass Hills and to blow off the only water bridge on the way back, hoping that the terrain and obstacles would allow the 26th Army and the 27th Army to pursue the retreat. The 180th Regiment, occupying the 1081st Heights, destroyed the original concrete bridge and two temporary replacement bridges, convinced that they could not be repaired.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 在联合国军到达兴南之前，麦克阿瑟已经於12月8日下令撤走美国第10军，以增援那时已筋疲力竭并快速撤向38线的美军第8军团。按照麥克阿瑟的命令，韩国第1军、韩国第1陆战团、美国第3步兵师和美国第7步兵师已经在港口周围佈置了防禦阵地。追击的志愿军第27军與美国、和之间发生了一些小规模的战斗，但已遭受重创的志願軍第九兵团面对来自美国海军的强大海上火力，根本无法靠近兴南防御圈。在被美国历史学家称为「美国军事史上最伟大的海上撤退行动」當中，一支有193艘船艦的舰队在興南港口组成，不仅撤走了联合国军官兵，也包括他们的重装备，还有大约三分之一的朝鲜难民。一艘美國商船隊（United States Merchant Marine）所屬的“”胜利轮撤走了14,000名难民。最后一个联合国军单位在12月24日14时36分离开，为防止中國人民志願軍和朝鮮人民軍使用，興南港口被摧毁。志愿军第27军在12月25日上午进入兴南。
target_text: Prior to the arrival of the United Nations forces in the south, MacArthur had ordered the withdrawal of the United States 10th Army on 8 December to reinforce the 8th United States Army, which was exhausted at that time and quickly withdrew to the 38th Line. As ordered by MacArthur, the 1st South Korean Army, the 1st South Korean Landing Army, the 3rd United States Infantry Division and the 7th United States Infantry Division had set up defensive positions around the port. There had been a small battle between the 27th United States Army and the United States, but the 9th United States Army, which had suffered heavy damage, could not be close to the Henan Defence Circle in the face of the powerful naval fire from the United States Navy. The last of the 193 ships, known by American historians as the "Last Maritime Evacuation in America's Military History", had been assembled in the port of Hinnan, with not only the removal of United Nations officers, including their heavy equipment, but also about one third of North Korean refugees.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text:
其他
2023年4月27日，南韓總統尹錫悅在美國國會演說時提到長津湖戰役，並指美軍在该战役有4500人阵亡，并成功突破12萬志愿军的包圍对朝鲜战争而言堪称「奇迹」。中華人民共和國外交部發言人毛寧于28日反对尹錫悦称该战役对美军而言是「奇迹」，反稱當時志愿军殲滅2.4萬人。中国中央电视台随后紧急播放《跨过鸭绿江》与《长津湖》等朝鲜战争的电视剧作为国内宣传，以此反驳言论。4月29日，韩国国民力量代表金起炫批评中国在总统尹锡悦对美国进行国事访问期间无礼地使用如「头破血流」等粗俗字眼，以及提及朝鲜战争期间的长津湖战役时通过贬低和歪曲韩国历史的荒谬言论。韩国驻華大使馆于5月5日罕见地就中国媒体接连发文批判韩国总统尹锡悦访美的社评表达抗议。
target_text: On April 27, 2023, South Korea’s president, Yoon Xin, in his speech to the United States Congress, referred to the battle at Changjin Lake, and referred to the US military as having killed 4,500 people in the battle, and succeeded in breaking the siege of the 120,000 volunteers as a “miracle” to the Korean war. On April 29, the Korean National Forces, on behalf of the Chinese media, criticised China’s unruly use of crude words, such as the “blown bloodline” during President Yoon Xi’s visit to the US, in opposition to the battle as a “miraculous” for the US army, and referred to the military’s killing of 24,000 people at the time.
title: 长津湖战役

source_text: 弗朗索瓦-勒内·德·夏多布里昂（，；）是法国十八至十九世纪的作家，政治家，外交家，法兰西学术院院士。出生于法国布列塔尼伊勒-维莱讷省的圣马洛市。拿破仑时期曾任驻罗马使馆秘书，波旁王朝复辟后成为贵族院议员，先后担任驻瑞典和德国的外交官，及驻英国大使，并于1823年出任外交大臣。著有小说《阿达拉》、《勒内》、《基督教真谛》，长篇自传《墓畔回忆录》等，是法国早期浪漫主义的代表作家。
target_text: François-Rène de Chardobron (;) is a French writer from the eighteenth to nineteenth centuries, politician, diplomat, and member of the French Academy of Academic Sciences. Born in St. Malo, department of Brittany-Villenné, France. Secretary to the Embassy in Rome during Napoleon, member of the House of Lords after the re-establishment of the Bourbon Dynasty, successive diplomats in Sweden and Germany, and Ambassador to the United Kingdom, and Foreign Secretary in 1823.
title: 弗朗索瓦-勒内·德·夏多布里昂

source_text: 1820年，贝里公爵的谋杀案使夏多布里昂再次站到了朝廷一边。同年，他出任法国驻柏林公使。1822年，他出任法国驻大不列颠大使，接着，又任维罗纳会议的全权代表，并不顾英国的反对，决定镇压西班牙革命。回国后，他就任外交大臣。镇压西班牙革命取得了成功，但由于与内阁部长约瑟夫·德·维莱勒不和，他在1824年被解职。
target_text: In 1820, the murder of the Duke of Berry brought Chado Brion back to the side of the court. In that same year, he was the French Minister in Berlin. In 1822, he was the French Ambassador to Great Britain, followed by the Plenipotentiary of the Verona Conference, who decided to suppress the Spanish Revolution despite British opposition. He returned home and became Minister for Foreign Affairs.
title: 弗朗索瓦-勒内·德·夏多布里昂

source_text: 1975年，红色高棉推翻了朗诺政权，建立了民主柬埔寨政权，乔森潘于次年4月4日短暂出任政府总理，4月11日又就任国家主席团主席，成为名义上的国家元首。1976年1月当选柬埔寨共产党中央委员。1979年，越南入侵柬埔寨，红色高棉政权被推翻，乔森潘逃亡丛林地区，波尔布特同年辞去总理职务后，乔森潘出任抗越的民主柬埔寨联合政府负责外交事务的副总理，并作为红色高棉的“爱国民主民族大团结阵线”主席，与西哈努克和宋先在1982年组成民主柬埔寨联合政府，坚持武装斗争，乔森潘任负责外交事务的副主席。
target_text: In 1975, the Khmer Rouge overthrew the Ranno regime, established the Democratic Kampuchea regime, and, on 4 April the following year, Chosenpan became Prime Minister of the Government and President of the National Presidency on 11 April, nominal Head of State. He was elected Central Commissioner of the Communist Party of Cambodia in January 1976. In 1979, Viet Nam invaded Cambodia, the Khmer Rouge regime was overthrown, Chosenpan fled the jungle area, Polbut resigned as Prime Minister in the same year, and Chosenpan served as Deputy Prime Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Unified Government of Democratic Kampuchea against Viet Nam, and as President of the Khmer Rouge “Grand Democratic National Unity Front” and formed a coalition Government of Democratic Kampuchea with Sihanouk and Song in 1982 to persist in the armed struggle, with Chosenpan as Vice-President for Foreign Affairs.
title: 乔森潘

source_text: 聯合國的制裁行動，使羅德西亞與外間的貿易和金融聯繫陷於中斷狀態，而羅德西亞公民出境到其他地方也備受制限。例如在1979年，史密斯打算到挪威出席兒子的婚禮，可是挪威政府卻拒絕其入境，使之大表不滿。在制裁初期，羅德西亞與某些違反制裁令的私人公司，以及一些對羅德西亞表示同情的國家合作，使制裁的影響得以減低。不過當地的商界始終對經濟市場萎縮及經濟錯配深表關注；而羅德西亞教會議會也提出道德理由，漸對UDI表示反對。在UDI發表後的三年間，史密斯與英國首相韋爾遜曾召開了兩輪談判，討論有關終止UDI的條件，以及羅德西亞在國際社會的地位與正常化問題。
target_text: In 1979, for example, Smith intended to go to Norway to attend his son’s wedding, but the Norwegian government refused to admit him, displeased him. In the early days of the sanctions, Rodezia and some private companies that had violated the sanctions, as well as some countries that had shown sympathy for Rhodesia, reduced the impact of the sanctions. But the local business community had been deeply concerned about economic market contraction and economic misalignment; and the Rhodesian Church had raised moral grounds to express opposition to UDI. In the three years since the UDI campaign, Smith and British Prime Minister Wilson had called for two rounds of talks to discuss the conditions that had led to the end of FDI, as well as Rhodesian’s status and normalization of the international community.
title: 伊恩·史密斯

source_text:
情況改變
1974年，南非總理沃斯特開始迫使史密斯結束白人少數管治，以換取南非在外交上改善與其他非洲國家的關係。因為南非過去一直在經濟、外交和軍事上支持UDI，使之成為與非洲各國修好的一大阻礙。隨後在1976年，美國國務卿亨利·基辛格提出一個包含六大步的「基辛格方案」，有關方案同時得到英國和南非的支持。為了取得羅德西亞支持，基辛格特地到南非的普利托里亞與史密斯及沃斯特召開會談；此外，時任英國首相卡拉漢還表示方案「將可結束羅德西亞內的衝突」。面對各方壓力，史密斯唯有無奈接受方案。
target_text: In 1974, South Africa’s Prime Minister, West, began to force Smith to end white minority governance in exchange for South Africa’s diplomatic improvement of relations with other African countries. South Africa’s economic, diplomatic, and military support for the UDI has been a major impediment to its repair with African countries.
title: 伊恩·史密斯

source_text: 妮諾·布爾賈納澤（格鲁吉亚語：ნინო ბურჯანაძე，）是一位格鲁吉亚政治人物，2001年11月至2008年6月担任格鲁吉亚议會議長，2003年11月23日至2004年1月25日和2007年11月25日至2008年1月20日曾两次任格鲁吉亚代總統。生平布爾賈納澤於1964年7月16日生於同國的庫塔伊西。1986年從第比利斯國立大學的法律系畢業。1986年到1990年之間在莫斯科國立大學研究生院留學。1990年取得國際法副博士畢業。之後1991年開始在第比利斯國立大學国际法和国际关系系擔任副教授主任。
target_text: Nino Burjanazé, a Georgian politician, served as President of the Georgian Parliament from November 2001 to June 2008, served as Acting President of Georgia on two occasions from November 23, 2003 to January 25, 2004 and from November 25, 2007 to January 20, 2008. Niño Burjanazé was born on July 16, 1964 in Kutaisi, the same country. Graduated from the Faculty of Law of the University of Tbilisi in 1986.
title: 妮诺·布尔贾纳泽

source_text: 1945年，中華民國國民政府接管台灣。1949年，中华民国政府於國共內戰失利後播遷台灣，並宣示要夺回中国大陆、恢復中華民國政府在大陸地區的統治。宪法上，中华民国政府和中华人民共和国政府都依然正式宣称擁有对大陆地區和台灣地區的主权。实际上，中华人民共和國政府只實際管辖到中国大陆，在一个中国原則下宣称擁有台湾地區的主权，但未实际管辖。至於只管辖台澎金马地区（由台湾和澎湖、金门、马祖等岛屿组成）的中华民国便通称“台湾”，因中华民国实际统治的主要岛屿而得名。1991年，中华民国增修憲法，但在憲法法理上仍具有中国大陆的領土權。但目前不排除是否透過修憲來更改領土領域。
target_text: In 1945, the Chinese government took over Taiwan. In 1949, the government of the Republic of China moved to Taiwan after the defeat of the Republic of China’s civil war, and announced its intention to take back mainland China and restore China’s government to the mainland.
title: 中国台湾

source_text:
聯合國
联合国要求使用“中国台湾”（）或“中国台湾省”（）一词来指代台灣。1988年12月20日，鉴于台湾在联合国机构中的称谓问题，中华人民共和国政府以中国常驻联合国亚太经社会副代表名义致函亚太经社会秘书处，要求联合国各有关机构应当使用“中国台湾省”称呼。1989年5月3日，中国常驻联合国代表团向联合国秘书处法律部递交了正式外交照会，“谨奉授权确认联合国系统文件包括统计表格中如必须提及中国台湾省时，其正式称谓应为‘中国台湾省’。”同年6月15日，联合国秘书处法律部答复称，其已将中华人民共和国政府的外交照会印发联合国系统各有关部门，并将立即启用新称呼。2016年，联合国秘书长发言人杜加里克在记者会上被问及秘书长一份关于高雄美浓地震的声明中“中国台湾省”的称谓时强调，这是联合国所采用的正式称谓。
target_text: The United Nations requested that the term “Taiwan, China” or “Taiwan Province of China” be used to refer to Taiwan Bay. On 20 December 1988, the Government of the People's Republic of China, on behalf of the Deputy Permanent Representative of China to the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific, sent a letter to the ESCAP secretariat requesting that the relevant United Nations bodies should use the term “Taiwan Province of China”. source_text: 中华民国视国际组织以「中國台灣省」一詞代替「中華民國」为否定中华民国作为独立主权国家的地位。国际组织以及新闻媒体几度使用该词，遭到中华民国政府官员的抗议。在2011年5月10日，繼联合国世界卫生组织在文件中将中華民國称之为“中国台湾”（）後，時任中華民國總統的馬英九抗议世卫组织的举动，並指世衛此舉是“受到中共壓力的結果”。马英九指出北京的举动「傷害台灣人民的感情，對兩岸都是極為不利」。現任總統蔡英文的政府的第一任行政院院長林全則表示Chinese Taipei（中華台北）的意思就是中華民國。
target_text: On May 10, 2011, after the United Nations World Health Organization (WHO) had named China as “Taiwan” (China), the then President of the Chinese People’s Republic, Ma Yingix, protested against the actions of WHO and said that the actions of the World Health Organization (WHO) were “the result of the pressure on the Chinese Communist Party.” According to Ma Yingix, the move in Beijing was “to hurt the feelings of the Taiwanese people, which are extremely detrimental to both sides of the Taiwan Strait.”

2007年12月1日，首次中日经济高层对话在北京举行，中国国务院副总理曾培炎同日本外务大臣高村正彦共同主持对话，对话的主题是“合作共赢和协调发展”。
2009年6月7日，中国和日本高级官员在东京举行第二次经济高层对话。中国代表团由副总理王岐山率领，其他高级官员包括外交部长杨洁篪和商务部长陈德铭；日本代表团团长是外交大臣中曾根弘文，其他高级官员包括经济产业大臣二阶俊博和财务大臣与谢野馨。
2010年8月28日，第三次中日经济高层对话在北京人民大会堂举行。中国副总理王岐山等代表中方出席，日方是包括外相冈田克也、经济产业大臣直岛正行等六名内阁大臣。会议双方签署7项合作文件。
target_text: On 1 December 2007, the first high-level economic dialogue between China and Japan was held in Beijing, where the Deputy Prime Minister of the State Council co-chaired the dialogue with Japan's Minister for Foreign Affairs, Jung-young Takamura. The Chinese delegation was led by Vice-Prime Minister Wang Jieshan and other high-level officials, including Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi and Minister for Commerce Chen Deok-hyung; the Japanese delegation was headed by Minister for Foreign Affairs Hiro Nakamoto, and other high-ranking officials, including Minister for Economy and Industry, Sang-hoon II and Minister for Finance, and Sheno-Hin. source_text: 2018年12月，华为首席财务官孟晚舟应美国的要求在加拿大被捕。美国寻求引渡她，后者则面临涉嫌违反对伊朗制裁的指控。在孟晚舟被捕后不久，萨克斯写了一篇文章，他说孟晚舟事件是美国政府试图遏制中国，并指责美国寻求引渡她是“虚伪的行为”。他写道，因违反制裁而被罚款的几家美国公司的高管都没有被逮捕。在他发表了这篇文章并受到批评后，萨克斯关闭了他的社交媒体推特账户。亞洲協會高级研究员艾萨克·斯通·菲什指出，萨克斯曾为华为写过宣传文章，并质疑萨克斯是否得到了华为的报酬。萨克斯说他没有得到报酬。

target_text: The Government of the People's Republic of China considers it to be “the sole legitimate Government representing China” and has always maintained the one-China principle as a necessary and inadequate condition for the establishment of diplomatic relations with any country, opposing two Chinas, insisting on one China (opposing Taiwan independence) and being listed by the Government of the People's Republic of China as two of the most basic policies towards Taiwan. source_text: 1954年9月3日，中国人民解放军炮击金门，意图威吓台湾。1955年1月28日，新西兰向联合国提案，将中国共产党军队的行动称为“国际冲突”，请求联合国出面“斡旋停火”。中华人民共和国国務院总理周恩来宣称：“如果美国政府以为可以用战争威胁来吓倒中国人民，来使中共承认两个中国，承认美国侵占台湾和侵入台湾海峡的行为合法，那是梦想。”另一方面，中华民国总统蒋介石明确表明反对这一提案。他担心“中共进入联合国，形成两个中国，直至台湾被中共接管”。次年二月八日，蒋介石发表长篇演讲驳斥“两个中国”：“有人说台湾地位还没有确定，妄想在停火后另行寻求所谓解决的办法。这种说法不仅是违反法律，而且是完全抹煞事实的谬论。”二月二十四日，蒋介石再次在中外记者招待会上说：两个中国的说法，真是荒谬绝伦。”

source_text:
历史
重巡洋舰最早的前身同轻巡洋舰一样，都是有舷侧装甲的装甲巡洋舰。但重巡洋舰的发展比轻巡洋舰还要晚。第一艘真正意义上的现代重巡洋舰出现于1915年——英国皇家海军建成了4艘。该级舰是英国在已有的轻巡洋舰上加以改进而来，排水量为9,750吨，装备7门7.5英寸主炮，在当时被称为“加强型轻巡洋舰”。不过由于服役太晚（最后一艘到1925年才服役），该级舰没有参加第一次世界大战，所以也没有经受实战考验。重巡洋舰的明确划分标准源于《华盛顿海军条约》、《伦敦海军条约》。霍金森级巡洋舰后来根据上述海军军备条约制定的标准归类为重巡洋舰。
target_text: The first heavy cruiser, like the light cruiser, was an armored cruiser. But the heavy cruiser grew later than the light cruiser. The first modern cruiser, in its true sense, appeared in 1915, when the Royal Navy built four. The class was modified by the United Kingdom on existing light cruises, with a discharge volume of 9,750 tons, equipped with seven 7.5 inches of cannons, which were then known as “strength-strength cruisers” at the time. However, due to the lateness of the service (the last one did not serve until 1925), the class did not take part in the First World War and thus did not undergo the test of battle. The clear criteria for the classification of heavy cruisers were derived from the Washington Treaty of Naval Affairs, the London Treaty of Naval Affairs.
title: 重巡洋舰

source_text: 1921年签订的华盛顿海军条约对巡洋舰的标准进行了划分。条约规定，所有巡洋舰的排水量不得超过10,000吨，主炮口径不得超过8英寸（203毫米）。而1930年的伦敦海军条约则再华盛顿海军条约的基础上，更加明确地划分了轻、重巡洋舰的标准——重巡洋舰为主炮口径6.1英寸及以上的巡洋舰，反之则为轻巡洋舰。
target_text: The Washington Naval Treaty, signed in 1921, divides the standards for cruise ships. The Treaty provides that all cruise ships shall not have more than 10,000 tons of drainage and the main cannon shall not have more than 8 inches (203 mm), while the 1930 London Naval Treaty, on the basis of the Washington Naval Treaty, more clearly distinguishes the standards for light and heavy cruise ships — heavy cruise ships of 6.1 inches and above the main cannon — on the other hand, light cruise ships.
title: 重巡洋舰

source_text: 在1920至30年代中期，各国都根据条约的规定建造了很多重巡洋舰。但很大程度上由于经验技术不足，各国在早期建造的“条约型重巡洋舰”存在着性能不平衡的问题。比如美国建造的彭萨科拉级和北安普顿级，與英國的肯特級都只有很薄的装甲。此外，在1930年代，有的国家亦开始试图钻条约的空子（漏洞）甚至秘密突破条约的限制，建造10,000吨级以上的重巡洋舰，比如日本的妙高级和高雄级，排水量达到了12,000吨，亦有為迴避條約限制的最上級，在太平洋戰爭前將15.5cm口徑主炮換上20.3cm口徑主炮，從而將「輕巡洋艦」變成「重巡洋艦」。而其它的国家此时在重巡洋舰的建造技术上也达到了很成熟的水平，性能也较早期有很大的提高，如美国的新奥尔良级，法国的和英国皇家海军的诺福克级等。德国因为不是条约的签字国未受条约的限制，所以德国相应建造的重巡洋舰大大超出海军军备条约限定的标准。
target_text: In addition, in the 1930’s, countries began to try to drill the Treaty’s voids (holes) and even covertly through the Treaty’s restrictions, building heavy cruise ships of 10,000 tons or more, such as Japan’s excellent and high-senior rank, with 12,000 tons of discharges, and the highest level of avoidance restrictions, including the replacement of 15.5cms of cannons with 20.3cm of cannons before the Pacific War, and the conversion of light cruisers from "light cruisers" to "heavy cruisers" to "heavy cruisers," while other countries were now technically advanced in the construction of heavy cruise ships, and at an early stage, such as the New Orleans class in the United States, the French and the Royal Navy’s Norfolk, among others, were heavily arms-restricted vessels beyond the limits of the Treaty.
title: 重巡洋舰

source_text: 上海市旅游局当晚也紧急约谈万豪国际集团上海公司相关负责人，要求责成万豪酒店管理层立即查明事实，说明情况，并向公众真诚道歉；立即整改，对相关责任人作出严肃处理，并配合当局依法进行调查处理。万豪相关负责人表示已深刻认识问题严重性，将认真配合相关调查，落实整改要求。2018年1月10日晚10:44，万豪礼赏的官方推特Marriott Rewards发布了一篇英文推文，推文表示“万豪国际集团尊重中国的主权和领土完整。我们绝不支持任何损害中国主权和领土完整的任何分裂组织。我们对任何可能引起对以上立场误解的行为深刻道歉。”但却被发现该官方推特给支持西藏独立运动的账号“西藏之友”的一篇推文点了讚，该推文内容为感谢万豪礼赏在用户调查中把西藏列为“国家”。万豪礼赏的推特道歉推文发送后，仍未“撤销喜欢”该“西藏之友”推文的点赞。1月12日凌晨，万豪表示，点赞藏独是个别员工的过失，总裁已就此事致歉。中国外交部发言人陆慷也就此事表示，在中国大陆经营的外国公司应当尊重中国的主权和领土完整。有上海的大型企業原定在上海一間萬豪酒店舉辦年會，參加人數為百人以上，共預定十多桌酒席，就連年會場景佈置都已經做好，由於「點讚藏獨」一事而臨時決定取消在萬豪辦年會，改在另外一家酒店舉行。

The relevant head of the Shanghai Tourism Authority expressed deep awareness of the seriousness of the problem and would seriously cooperate in the implementation of the request for correction. On the evening of 10 January 2018, Marriott Rewards, the official Twitter-tender, published an English tweet stating that “The Van Hoon International Group respects the sovereignty and territorial integrity of China.” We did not support any separatist organization that would undermine the sovereignty and territorial integrity of China. We apologized for any act that might lead to a misunderstanding of the position.
title: 萬豪國際

source_text:
商標與宣傳
森下博的時代正為日本帝國主義勃興的時代，所以森下博當年在設計商標時便有行銷中國的抱負。於是森下博結合儒家思想核心的「仁」與在台灣得到的靈感「丹」字，想出了「仁丹」一名。同時，森下博基於濟世的設計概念，將仁丹擬人成為宣揚保健的外交官，以當時外交官的形象為原型，經過數百次的修改，最後設計出頭戴雙角帽、身著大禮服、蓄著德皇威廉二世式的翹鬍子的外交官造型。
target_text: At the same time, Sam's design concept of Boki-Jing became a health-promoting diplomat, based on the image of the diplomat at the time, after hundreds of changes, and finally designed a diplomat with a two-horn hat, a tuxedo, and a German-style William II beard.
title: 仁丹

source_text: 外交代表大使館、領事館、聯合國和其他國際組織註冊車輛享有免稅的待遇，車牌顏色設計有紅底白字和黑底白字兩種，紅底白字的是以官方名義註冊的車輛，黑底白字的是以私人名義註冊的車輛。車輛牌號的編排設計有兩組數字和一組羅馬字母，第一組數字是使團所屬國家或組織的代碼，第二組數字是外交官員的外交等級，羅馬字母代表的是組織的性質，數字與字母之間以連結號聯接。
target_text: Diplomatic embassies, consulates, United Nations and other international organizations have a tax-free system for registered vehicles with red and black colours, with red and white in official names, and black and white in private. The car numbers are composed of two sets of numbers and a set of Roman letters, the first of which is the code of the country or organization to which the group belongs, the second of which is the diplomatic rank of the diplomat, and the Roman alphabet represents the character of the organization, which is linked by the number and letter.

source_text:
设计建造
第一次世界大战后，德国海军丧失了大部分军事力量，变成了一支“近岸海军”，《凡尔赛和约》明文禁止德国海军建造大型军舰。1925年，德国人开工建造埃姆登號輕巡洋舰，之后陆续在条约限制内建造了一些轻巡洋舰及德国级装甲舰。但海军司令埃里希·雷德尔上将希望能重建一战时强大的德国海军。1930年代初期，德国海军开始秘密考虑突破条约的限制以建造重巡洋舰。
target_text: After the First World War, the German Navy lost most of its military power and became a “inshore navy” and the Versailles Treaty explicitly prohibited the German Navy from building large warships. In 1925, the Germans began construction of the Emden Light Cruiser, followed by the construction of a number of light cruisers and German-class armoured ships within the limits of the Treaty.
title: 希佩尔海军上将级重巡洋舰

source_text:
命名
海底山的命名由各国向国际水道组织（IHO）下属的国际海底地名委员会(SCUFN)提交申请，需得到其审议批准。包括IHO、SCUFN在内的国际各种海洋机构本来不含政治目的，批准命名申请只意味着发现和学术利用权，并不等同拥有主权。但随着韩国在日本海的独岛（日本称竹岛）主权纠纷，把称呼政治化，令SCUFN增加“不接受含政治性申请”的规定。
target_text: Seamount naming is submitted by countries to the International Seabed Geographical Names Committee (SCUFN) of the International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) for consideration and approval. International maritime agencies, including IHO, SCUFN, would have been free of political objectives, and approval of naming applications would have meant only discovery and academic exploitation, and not equivalent to sovereignty.
title: 海底山

source_text:
相關法律規定
在多數的國家法律中，任何在公共道路上行駛的車輛都必須懸掛號牌，對於號牌的尺寸、字體大小和顏色會有嚴格的規定；同時在一些少數的國家，電單車和擁有豁免權的車輛擁有-{只}-懸掛一面號牌的權利。
一般而言，不同類型和用途的車輛（摩托車、普通轎車或卡車等；自用、商用、軍用或公共運輸等）會采用不同尺寸、字體大小和顏色的號牌。
當车辆意圖入境他國的時候，可能會因為汽車保險、外交或戰爭等理由被要求登記臨時號牌；基於外交等級的不同，審核時間可能會有所差別，同時也被限制在規定的時間內必須離境。在同樣的理由下，部分國家或個別的车辆會被禁止出入境。
一般而言，牌號會隨著車輛的買賣而更換擁有者，直到該車報廢的同時牌號也會停止使用；但某些國家的法律允許車主在賣出或報廢車輛的時候，申請保有原有的牌號使用在新車上。
某些地區實施一人一牌政策（Plate to Owner），新車主必須登記屬於個人的牌號。
target_text: In most countries, cars of different types and uses (cars, common scooters, trucks, etc.); their sizes, sizes, and colours are strictly regulated; in a few countries, electric bicycles and exempted vehicles have the right to - {only} - hang on to a plate. Generally, vehicles of different types and uses (motorships, regular scooters, trucks, etc.); their sizes, sizes, and colours are strictly regulated. When vehicles attempt to enter the country, they may be required to do so for reasons such as car insurance, diplomacy, or war.
title: 車輛號牌

source_text: 战争借口（、act of war）是导致一场战争爆发的直接原因，也就是战争借口不是导致战争爆发的各种各样原因和前因，而是最终直接导致战争爆发的事件。按照国际法，假如一个国家受到攻击的话，那么被攻击的国家可以以防御战作为战争借口並发动战争。但是发动防御战的国家必须证明它被攻击，最后联合国安全理事会有权力决定一个国家是否受到攻击。
target_text: The pretext of war (act of war) is the direct cause of the outbreak of a war, that is, it is not the causes and causes of war, but the events that eventually lead directly to the outbreak of war. Under international law, if a country is attacked, the country that is attacked can use a defence war as a pretext for waging war.
title: 战争借口

source_text: 若提供的战争借口无法被一个中立的第三方验证，但該國仍會堅持此說法以向联合国安理会及国际公众证明战争的合理性。比如在伊拉克战争，前美国外长克林·鲍威尔向联合国安理会提出证明，稱伊拉克拥有进行生物武器试验的移动实验室，以及伊拉克在尼日尔购买铀的证明后来都被确定是假造的，战后在伊拉克也未能找到任何研制这些武器的证明。
target_text: If the pretext of war offered cannot be tested by a neutral third party, the country will insist on it in order to justify it to the UN Security Council and the international public. For example, in the Iraq war, former US Foreign Minister Klim Powell provided the UN Security Council with a certificate that Iraq had mobile laboratories for conducting biological weapons tests, and that Iraq’s purchases of uranium in Niger were later determined to be false, and that no evidence of the development of these weapons could be found in Iraq after the war.
title: 战争借口

source_text:
早年和外交官生涯
雷赛布生于马赛，其母卡特琳娜是西班牙人。他的青少年时期是在意大利度过的。1825年起年轻的雷赛布在里斯本从事副领事，从而进入外交部门。1828年雷赛布又专任突尼斯的副领事。1832年又成为驻亚历山大港的副领事，由此雷赛布与埃及结缘。
target_text: In 1825, young Rezeb entered the diplomatic service as a vice-consul in Lisbon. In 1828 he was also a vice-consul of Tunisia. In 1832 he became a vice-consul in the port of Alexandria, bringing him to Egypt.
title: 斐迪南·德·雷赛布

source_text: 1833年雷赛布来到开罗任职，期间他担任过穆罕默德·阿里之子，后来的埃及总督赛义德·巴夏的家庭教师。赛义德·巴夏深受雷赛布的影响，而雷赛布开凿苏伊士运河的想法也就在这一期间内萌发。1837年雷赛布回法国完婚，此后他又先后在鹿特丹、马拉加、巴塞罗那任职。1846年至1849年任驻马德里大使。1849年他曾参与斡旋教皇庇护九世安全返回梵蒂冈的工作。不久他辞去了外交官职务，而第一段婚姻也宣告结束。
target_text: He came to Cairo in 1833, when he was the son of Mohamed Ali, followed by Egypt’s Governor, Said Bashar. Said Bashar was under the influence of Rezaib, and the idea of the Suez Canal was born within that period. Reseb returned to France in 1837, and then served in Rotterdam, Maraga and Barcelona. He served as Ambassador to Madrid from 1846 to 1849. He was involved in the safe return of Pope IX to the Vatican in 1849. Shortly after he resigned as a diplomat, the first marriage ended.
title: 斐迪南·德·雷赛布

source_text: 1931年（民國二十年）九一八事變發生後，中國政府遂向國際聯盟提出聲訴，要求制裁日本侵略，同時並照會英、美等國，盼其主持正義，對日本之侵略行動予以勸告或干預。詎國際聯盟未能作有效之制裁，英、法等國亦無積極之反應，惟美國國務卿亨利·劉易斯·史汀生力主門戶開放之對華傳統政策，不欲日本獨佔中國東北。然史汀生氏初亦表現猶豫，尚盼日本能採取緩和政策。
target_text: In 1931, after 988, the Chinese government filed a complaint with the League of Nations calling for sanctions against Japan’s aggression, hoping, in the same way as the British and the United States of America, that it would act justly and advise or intervene in Japan’s aggression. 美洲
自1492年哥伦布发现美洲大陆后，美洲一直没有一个真正意义上的主权国家。1783年，美国脱离大英帝国独立，成为美洲大陆上的第一个独立国家，随后在1789年位于海地的黑奴发起革命，并于1809年获得独立，但美国和海地的独立并未带动美洲的去殖民化。美洲的去殖民化时间跨度较长，由于西班牙帝国和葡萄牙帝国的衰落，西葡两国在拉丁美洲和南美洲的殖民地大多在19世纪独立，1898年的美西战争后西班牙更是丧失了全部在美洲的殖民地，英国在北美洲的殖民地加拿大也在1931年成为自治领。1934年，美国总统罗斯福废除了普拉特修正案，古巴也因此得以收回松树岛。但英国、法国和荷兰在美洲的殖民地大多都在二战结束后才独立，并且至今英法荷三国仍在加勒比海地区拥有部分岛屿作为其海外领土，1979年美国将巴拿马运河区主权交还给巴拿马政府。
target_text: The Americas have not had a truly sovereign State since the discovery of the American continent in 1492 in Columbus. In 1783, the United States emerged from independence from the British Empire, became the first independent nation on the American continent, followed by a revolution in 1789 in Haiti, and gained independence in 1809, but the independence of the United States and Haiti did not lead to the decolonization of the Americas. The decolonization of the Americas took a long time, as a result of the fall of the Spanish and Portuguese empires, most of the colonies in Latin America and South America became independent in the 19th century, Spain lost all of its colonies in the United States after the 1898 American War, and the British colony in North America, Canada, became an autonomous leader in 1931. In 1934, President Roosevelt abolished the Plattt Amendment, and Cuba was able to recover the island.
title: 去殖民化

source_text: 12月26日下午，《產經新聞》記者古屋奎二向中央社透露，有名叫「中村輝夫」的台灣原住民被發現，日本駐印尼大使館將派員前往摩祿泰島接他返回雅加達。消息在當晚傳回臺東時，縣長黃鏡峰表示若該人願回來，將設法安頓他的生活。27日，外交部致電駐雅加達中華商會會長蔣貽曾，請設法把這台灣人護送回國。印尼中華商會因知道當地的飛騰海洋開發公司員工徐成耀為花蓮縣人且懂些阿美族話，便連絡徐成耀來協助。當消息傳到東河鄉時，已五十七歲的李蘭英聽到，心情激動。28日，東河鄉戶政事務所證實中村輝夫是李光輝。次日一早，黃金木便不告而別，離開與李蘭英同住的家。

source_text: 2010年11月底科特迪瓦总统选举结束后，时任总统巴博和前总理瓦塔拉均宣布获胜并分别宣誓就任总统，因此科特迪瓦陷入“一国两主”政治僵局。联合国、非盟、欧盟等国际组织表示承认瓦塔拉当选总统，但巴博拒绝下台。西共体、非盟等国际组织多次出面斡旋都无果而终。
target_text: Following the conclusion of the presidential elections in Côte d’Ivoire at the end of November 2010, when then President Gbagbo and former Prime Minister Ouattara declared their victory and were sworn in as Presidents, Côte d’Ivoire fell into a political impasse of “one country, two leaders.” International organizations, such as the United Nations, the African Union, and the European Union, expressed their recognition of Ouattara’s election, but Gbagbo refused to step down.
title: 象牙海岸革命戰爭

source_text: 4月4日，联合国秘书长潘基文发表声明说，他已下令联合国驻科特迪瓦行动团“采取必要措施”，以阻止巴博及其部队对平民使用重型武器的行为。他称联合国行动是“出于自卫和保护平民”的目的。同一天，法国总统府发表公报称，法国部队应联合国要求，参加了联合国驻科特迪瓦行动团的军事行动，以解除巴博部队的重型武器。联合国驻科特迪瓦行动团发言人向媒体透露，联合国驻科维和部队和法国“独角兽”部队当地时间4日下午对总统府、巴博官邸及阿班和阿库埃多两个巴博阵营的重要军营发起进攻。瓦塔拉阵营发言人4日也声称，支持瓦塔拉的“科特迪瓦共和军”当天下午对总统府、巴博官邸和国家电视台总部等巴博阵营核心区域发起“最后的攻击”。
target_text: On 4 April, the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Ban Ki-moon, issued a statement stating that he had ordered UNOCI to “take the necessary measures” to prevent the use of heavy weapons by Gbagbo and its forces against civilians. He called the United Nations operation “for self-defence and the protection of civilians”. On the same day, the French Presidency issued a communiqué stating that French forces had participated, at the request of the United Nations, in the military operations of UNOCI to disarm the Gbagbo forces. The UNOCI spokesperson revealed to the media that the United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Côte d'Ivoire and the French forces Licorne had launched an “last attack” against the presidential palace, the Gbagbo residence and two important military barracks of the Babo camp in Aban and Acuedo on the afternoon of 4 April.
title: 象牙海岸革命戰爭

source_text: 两派武装连日来多次在阿比让的总统府、巴博官邸和国家电视台等多处巴博阵营核心区域周围发生激烈交火，科特迪瓦两派谁胜谁负目前已到关键时刻。10日，为了摧毁巴博武装的重型武器，联合国和法国的部队开火攻击了巴博部队的阵地。4月11日，科特迪瓦前总统巴博及其夫人11日在阿比让被支持前总理瓦塔拉的士兵逮捕。联合国驻科特迪瓦特使表示，“巴博先生已被逮捕，他活着而且状态良好，他将为其犯下的罪行接受审判”。
target_text: On 11 April, former Ivorian President Gbagbo and his wife were arrested in Abidjan by soldiers supporting former Prime Minister Ouattara. According to the United Nations Special Envoy for Côte d'Ivoire, “Mr. Gbagbo has been arrested, alive and in good condition, and will be tried for his crimes.”
title: 象牙海岸革命戰爭

source_text: 1960年7月16日，凱塞林因心臟病死於德國巴德瑙海姆的一家療養院裡，享年74歲。凱塞林的葬禮按鋼盔團的儀式舉行，下葬於巴德维塞的山間公墓（Bergfriedhof）。鋼盔團成員抬棺，並於墓前行鳴槍禮。凱塞林的前部屬齊格菲·魏斯法爾代表北非與義大利的德軍老兵們發言，表示凱塞林是「一位值得敬仰、善待所有官兵的人物」。代表前空軍與聯邦國防軍的卡姆胡伯也致辭：「凱塞林因早期成就、而非晚期的活動為人铭記」。出席葬禮的還有前武裝親衛隊大將約瑟夫·迪特里希、前德國總理弗朗茲·馮·巴本、舍納爾、海軍元帥和前聯邦總統鄧尼茲、前國防軍少將奧托·雷莫、前武裝親衛隊上校約亨·派普和前駐義大利社會共和國外交大使哈恩等人。
target_text: On July 16, 1960, Kesselin died of a heart attack in a nursing home in Badenauheim, Germany, aged 74. Kesselin’s funeral was performed in the form of a steel helmet, buried in the Tomb (Bergfriedhof) in Badwesses. Helmet's crew carried the coffin and fired a rifle in front of the grave. The former Kesselin's brother, Zigfi Weisfar, spoke on behalf of the German veterans of North Africa and Italy, saying that Kesselin was “a man worthy of respect and good treatment for all soldiers.” The former Air Force and the United States Defense Forces, Kam Huber, also spoke: “Kaserin was remembered for his early achievements, not for his late activities.” The former Armed Forces of the Armed Forces were also present at the funeral.

不過當時的德國政府，存在親華與親日的力量，其中親華以最初的國防部長勃洛姆堡和外交部長康斯坦丁‧馮‧紐賴特為代表，主張在中日之間取比較中立的態度，而不放棄與中國的經貿往來和合作。而以里賓特洛甫和戈培爾為首的一派則主張聯合日本，拋棄中國。 希特勒最初也曾經猶豫不決，但反共產國際協定簽署后，德日關係日漸接近，黨內親日力量對希特勒的影響也日益擴大。希特勒最終決定支持日本，於1938年重新調整了政府，確立了親日派在外交領域的主導地位，此后中德關係就日漸下滑。同年德國還召回了駐華軍事顧問。不過雙方和合作關係一直持續到1939年，武器易貨貿易也一直在進行，甚至德國入侵波蘭后，雙方仍然進行了少量貿易，但總的來說，此時德國在華的影響已經大大下降
1941年底中國正式向德、日、意軸心國宣戰，標志著這段中德合作的歷史徹底終結。
target_text: After the initial signing of the anti-communist international agreement, the German-Japanese relationship approached, and the influence of the party’s Japanese forces on Hitler increased. source_text: 九一八事變發生後，國府採取不妥協、不作戰、不直接交涉之方針，僅請求國際聯盟制止日軍侵略。九一八事變中，國府的反應備受國內輿論指責為“不抵抗政策”，但事實上國府仍坚持從外交渠道积极努力，透過「特種外交委員會」，於國聯力争国际力量对日本侵略行径的谴责和抵抗。但國聯只要求中日雙方早日撤兵，不使事態擴大，1931年12月，國聯議決派遣調查團到中國，但不干涉軍事行動。1932年3月，國際聯盟調查團抵華，於同年10月發表調查報書，指出九一八事變是日本之預謀，滿洲國是日本之傀儡政權；1933年，國聯大會接受報告書，不承認滿洲國，並要求日本撤兵，日本置若罔聞，索性退出國聯。但自1933年热河抗战和长城抗战起，國府對日本政策基本上已轉為“一面抵抗，一面交涉”。到华北危机时，國民政府對日本态度日渐强硬。

source_text: 自从1800年的政变以来所有党派都试图通过巴黎来影响海尔维第共和國的发展。现在这里只有两派：统一派和联邦派。统一派多少是革命的极端支持者，他们支持一个统一的国家。联邦派则希望重建州自主，并限制国民主权，恢复城市贵族的地位。法国驻共和国的大使卡尔·腓特烈·莱因哈特是联邦派在巴黎最重要的发言人，而皮埃尔-莫里斯·格莱尔则是统一派的代表人1801年1月阿尔布莱希特·兰格相格莱尔提交了一份秘密宪法草案并请他转交拿破仑批准。这个草案虽然保持了统一的国家，但是其内部的机制要复杂得多。其中包括一名执政总统和有限选举。拿破仑此时正在打仗，因此没有顾及这个草案，他此时也不想加强海尔维第政府。
target_text: All parties have tried to influence the development of the Republic of Helvedi through Paris since the 1800 coup d’état. There are now only two parties: the Unityist and the Federalist. The Unityist are some of the extreme supporters of the Revolution, who support a united nation. The Federalists want to re-establish state autonomy and limit national sovereignty and restore the status of urban aristocracy. The French ambassador to the Republic, Carl Fitttley Reinhardt, is the most important speaker of the Union in Paris, while Pierre-Maurice Glèlère, is the representative of the Unity, who, in January 1801, submitted a secret draft constitution and asked him to transmit it to Napoleon for approval.
title: 海尔维第共和国

source_text:
解散
虽然拿破仑介入后执政会理论上又获得了对整个国家的控制，但是实际上到共和国解散为止它没有任何作用，因为在大多数州里政府机关由联邦派人士掌握。最后政府还能在外交上获得一个成果：按照吕内维尔和约神圣罗马帝国应该把所有莱茵河左岸的地域割让给法国，为了补偿德意志国家在领土上的损失所有原来教会领土全部被世俗化分给世俗领主。在雷根斯堡的永久帝国会议的最后一次会议上这个问题要被执行。这个问题也涉及到海尔维第共和國，因为至此为止神圣罗马帝国领土上的教会和世俗领主、修道院在海尔维第共和國境内还拥有领地和地产，同样瑞士领主在神圣罗马帝国境内也有这样的领地。1802年秋开始讨论这个问题，10月末基本上达成协议海尔维第共和國在神圣罗马帝国境内丧失的领土将通过塔拉斯和庫爾主教领地来补偿。海尔维第共和國向在其境内有领地的领主偿付40倍的年息作为代价来获得对这些领地的主权。由于海尔维第共和國的外交干涉以及法国和俄罗斯帝国的支持海尔维第共和國最后获得的条件比吕内维尔和约中规定的要好。1803年2月25日达成的德意志调停中瑞士无偿获得了过去教会领主在海尔维第共和國境内的领地。
target_text: Dissolution, even though Napoleon’s involvement in the administration has theoretically gained control of the country as a whole, does not actually play any role until the dissolution of the Republic, since the organs of government in most of the cantons are controlled by federalists. Finally, the Government has a diplomatic legacy: according to Luneville and the Holy Roman Empire, all the lands and properties of the River Rhine should be cededed to France, as did the Swiss subjects in the territory of the Holy Roman Empire, in order to compensate the German State for the loss of all the former Church’s territory, all of which was cededed to the secular lords. The issue was essentially resolved at the last session of the Reagans’ Conference of the Permanent Empire.
title: 海尔维第共和国

source_text:
海外领事流程
该流程是针对此时尚身处美国境外的移民申请者，或不符合身份调整资格的美国境内申请者。他们需要向美国境外的大使馆或领事馆递交之前已获得的移民批准和其他相关材料，以获得从外国进入美国的一次性移民签证。大使馆或领事馆的签证官员根据获得的材料以及面谈的内容，决定是否给申请者移民签证。一旦移民签证获得批准，外籍人士可以持移民签证进入美国，并在入境美国时成为永久居民。美国机场的移民官员会在他们的本国护照上加盖I-551戳（作为绿卡邮寄前的临时身份证明供出入境、就业等用途），并安排绿卡的制卡和邮寄流程。正式的永久民卡会在几周后邮寄给该永久居民。之后，永久居民可以使用它在出国旅行后再次进入美国。
target_text: The process is for immigration applicants who are still outside the United States at this time, or those who do not qualify for identity adjustment. They need to submit to embassies or consulates outside the United States previously obtained immigration authorizations and other relevant materials to obtain a one-time immigration visa to enter the United States from abroad. The visa officer at the embassy or consulate decides whether to grant an immigration visa to the applicant on the basis of the material obtained and the content of the interview. Once an immigration visa is granted, the alien can enter the United States with an immigration visa and become a permanent resident when entering the United States.
title: 绿卡

欧洲联盟条约（Treaty on European Union，简称TEU）是欧洲联盟的宪制性文本、欧盟法律的重要组成部分。该条约有多次著名的重大版本更迭，可能指：马斯特里赫特条约，1992年签署，条约的初始版本；
里斯本条约，2007年签署，2009年生效，条约修正案。关于现时版本的欧洲联盟条约，请参见歐洲聯盟基本條約中的欧洲联盟条约章节。
target_text: The European Union Treaty (Treaty on Europe Union) is an important part of the European Union’s constitutional text and European Union law. There are several famous major changes in the Treaty of Maastricht, signed in 1992, the original version of the Treaty; The Lisbon Treaty, signed in 2007, entered into force in 2009, the amendment of the Treaty. For the current version of the European Union Treaty, see the section of the European Union Treaty in the basic articles of the European Union.

source_text:
美国人进入上海
1844年7月3日，中美《望厦条约》签订，内容参照了中英《南京条约》，规定上海口岸向美国人开放。此后，美国的传教士和商人也开始前来上海。与英国侨民以商人为主不同，美国侨民中传教士的比重较高，包括1845年来到上海的美国圣公会、1847年来到上海的美南浸信会、1848年来沪的美南监理会、1850年来沪的美北长老会等。由于传教士的目的是向中国居民传教，所以他们并不聚居在租界，而是分散居住在县城内外的各个角落，如美南浸信会的晏玛太立足于老北门外护城河边，美南监理会立足于不远处的郑家木桥，美北长老会立足于大南门外。美国圣公会在城内立足后，1848年，文惠廉主教又请求上海地方官府允许美国侨民在虹口开辟租界，但并未正式划定界限。上海开埠初期，虹口美国租界由于有苏州河的阻隔，甚为荒凉，只在江边建成少数的船坞、码头，和为水手们服务的娱乐场所。
target_text: Unlike the British diaspora, which is dominated by businessmen, the American diaspora has a high proportion of missionaries, including the American Episcopal Council in Shanghai in 1845, the South American Baptist Church in Shanghai in 1847, the South American Supervisory Council in 1848, the North American Presbyterian Council in North America, and the North American Presbyterian Council in North America since 1850, have been established outside the city. Because the missionaries were designed to teach Chinese residents, they did not gather in the rental area, but rather scattered around the corners of the city, such as the South American Baptist Church, which is based on the Old North Gate River, the South American Supervisory Council is based on the Chujigi Bridge, which is not far away, and the North American Elders will be based outside the South gate.
title: 1840年代上海

source_text:
甲午战争
1894年，中日甲午战争爆发，上海形势也趋于紧张，碍于各国在上海的势力，日本暂对外宣布上海为中立区域，并许诺不将战火蔓延到上海。中国战败后，日本不仅得到了朝鲜的宗主权和台湾，也得以成为在华列强之一，在汉口、天津乃至重庆、苏州、杭州开辟了一批租界，但是其在上海开辟租界的企图归于失败。此外，根据战后的《马关条约》，外国人可以在中国开办工厂，此后，日本、英国等国在黄浦江下游的杨树浦地区陆续开设众多的近代企业。上海也迅速发展成中国最大的工业中心。
target_text: After China’s defeat, Japan not only gained Korea’s sovereignty and Taiwan, but was able to become one of China’s powers, opening up rent lines in Hanguchi, Tianjin, Chongqing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou, but its attempts to open rent lines in Shanghai failed. Moreover, under the post-war Ma’an Treaty, foreigners could open factories in China, and Japan and the United Kingdom have been able to open up a large number of recent businesses in the Yang Jiu region, which is under the Huangpu River.
title: 1890年代上海

source_text: 與Gouraud著色法比較，Phong著色法的效果更逼真，能够提供更好的光滑曲面的近似值。Phong著色法假设一个平滑变化的曲面为一矢量。在对于有较小的高光曲线区的反射模型，例如PHONG模型时，Phong著色法比Gouraud著色法更优。但運算程序也比前者為複雜。Gouraud著色法在遇到在较大的多边形模型中央有高光曲线区时会产生严重的问题。因为这些高光曲线区在多边形的顶点处会产生缺失，而Gouraud著色法是基于顶点的颜色的，这些高光曲线区会从多边形的内部缺失。这个问题在Phong著色法中得到了解决。不同于通过多边形差值的Gouraud著色法，Phong著色法中一个矢量是从多边形顶点的法线到多边形表面进行差值的。为了或得到最后的像素颜色，面的法线被差值，应用于一个反射模型。由于Phong著色法需要逐像素点进行计算，因此运算量远大于Gouraud著色法。
target_text: In contrast to the Gouraud colouring method, the Phong colouring process is more complicated than the former. The Gouraud colouring method creates serious problems when it comes to a high light curve area in the centre of the larger polygon model. These high-light curves cause a loss at the top of the polygon, while the Gouraud colour is based on the colour of the top, and these high-light curves are missing from the polygon. This problem is solved in the Phong colour. Unlike the Gouraud colouring method through the polygon, one aspect of the Phong colouring method is driven from the line at the top of the polygon to the surface of the polygon.
title: Phong著色法
