source_text: 英國外交官職等劃分與美國並無太大差異，英國亦分成主管及委任兩大類，主管類別由資深者出任，分為三等為屬事務官的常務次長、局長、科長或是特別工作組組長，外派至海外時則可擔任大使（高級專員）、總領事、副代表或較大規模的領事館之領事；副代表一職在歷史上多為派駐重要國家之大使館的次要館長，現在則多為公使。
target_text: The ranking of British diplomats does not differ much from that of the United States. The United Kingdom is divided into two main categories of directors and appointees, with three categories of chief executives, chief executives, section chiefs or special task force chiefs, who are appointed overseas as ambassadors (high-ranking officers), chief executives, deputy representatives or general directors; the deputy representative, who is a second-tier director of embassies of important countries in history, is now a minister.
title: 外交官銜

source_text: 委任類別分為一至七職等，另外分成A至D四個群組（一、二職等屬群組A，三職等屬群組B，四、五職等屬群組C，六、七職等屬群組D），派駐國外時的職等相對應外交官銜，如B3職等者為三等秘書，C4職等者為二等秘書，C5和D6職等者為一等秘書，D7職等為規模中等的外交代表機構之副代表或規模較小的外交代表機構之代表。
target_text: The category is divided into one to seven posts and four groups (A, A, B, B, IV, V, C, VI and D) from A to D (A), C, D, D, D, C, D, D, D, D, D, D, D, D, D, D, D, etc.) and the equivalent for diplomats who are posted abroad, e.g. B3 is the Third Secretary, C4 is the Second Secretary, C5 and D6 are the First Secretary, D7 is the Deputy Representative of a medium-sized diplomatic representative body or representative of a smaller diplomatic representative body.
title: 外交官銜

source_text: 資深外交官可出使屬於政務官的大使，其可能為國家元首直接指派的空降人選，亦可能是專業外交體系出身的外交官升任；公使，一般外交人員升遷的最高事務官層級；公使銜參贊和參贊，此等級劃分相當於陸海空各軍軍衔體系中的上将、中将、少将和准将。
target_text: Senior diplomats may appoint ambassadors who belong to the Civil Service, who may be appointed directly by the Head of State, or diplomats of professional and diplomatic origin; ministers, general diplomats, who are promoted to the highest rank of officers; and ministers and senators, who are ranked among the top, middle, lieutenant and brigadier generals in the military ranks of the air, sea and air forces.
title: 外交官銜

source_text: 資歷淺的外交人員的職等劃分在外派前後會有改變，其級別從九職等至一職等，一職等相當於軍中的上校，九職等是美國外交官體系裏的最低職等，大部份將出任高階官銜的外交官職等為六職等或五職等，個人的職等與外派時所用的官銜是不同的且不可混淆。
target_text: The rank of lightly qualified diplomats changes before and after assignments, ranging from nine to one position, one post equals the rank of Colonel in the military, nine posts are the lowest in the United States diplomatic system, most of them six or five positions, for high-ranking diplomats, etc., and individual posts are different and not confused from those used in assignments.
title: 外交官銜

source_text:
1992年4月6日和7日，欧洲共同体和美国先后承认波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那独立。 1992年5月22日，联合国承认波黑。1992年5月13日，在南斯拉夫社会主义联邦解体之后，卡拉季奇在帕莱被选为塞族共和国总统。根据宪法规定，他有指挥塞族共和国军以及任免军官的权力。上任后，卡拉季奇曾三次赴联合国总部就波黑未来展开谈判。
1995年8月4日，克罗地亚军队开始向克罗地亚中部的塞尔维亚克拉依那共和国大举进攻。同时，卡拉季奇宣布解除总指挥拉特科·姆拉迪奇将军的职位并由他本人接任。表面上，卡拉季奇是因为姆拉迪奇丢掉了波斯尼亚西部两个重要的城镇而惩罚姆拉迪奇的。实际上，卡拉季奇是想显示他对指挥体系的调整。不过，姆拉迪奇将军不愿乖乖离开，支持他的波黑塞族平民和士兵也表示不满。对此，卡拉季奇将姆拉迪奇说成疯子，但最后他还是被迫恢复姆拉迪奇的职位。
target_text: On 6 and 7 April 1992, the European Community and the United States recognized the independence of Bosnia and Herzegovina. On 22 May 1992, the United Nations recognized Bosnia and Herzegovina. On 13 May 1992, after the dissolution of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, Karadžić was elected President of Republika Srpska in Pale. According to the Constitution, he had the power to command the Republika Srpska Army and to appoint and dismiss officers. After taking office, Karadžić went to United Nations Headquarters three times to negotiate the future of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
title: 拉多万·卡拉季奇

source_text:
战争罪行
卡拉季奇因就任塞族共和国总统和武装部队总司令期间，针对波黑非塞族平民犯下多个战争罪行而遭到前南斯拉夫问题国际法庭的指控。有鉴于他的指挥官身份，他要为超过7500名穆斯林的死亡负责。前南斯拉夫问题国际法庭因卡拉季奇的以下行为作出指控：
曾指挥塞族共和国军队进攻萨拉热窝
在联合国安全区内制造屠杀
在1995年5月至7月之间，将联合国人员劫持为人质。
target_text: Karadžić was charged by the International Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia for having committed several war crimes against non-Serb civilians in Bosnia and Herzegovina during his tenure as President and Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Republika Srpska. He was responsible for the death of more than 7,500 Muslims in view of his commanding position. The International Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia has charged Karadžić for having directed the Republika Srpska army against Sarajevo to carry out massacres in the United Nations security zone, taking United Nations personnel hostage between May and July 1995.
title: 拉多万·卡拉季奇

source_text:
逃亡经历
1993年，卡拉季奇在访问联合国总部期间就接到了传票。不过美国政府没有在他于1995年访问联合国期间成功抓到他。有传言称，美国政府根据代顿协定对卡拉季奇提供了保护。不过，这并不妨碍卡拉季奇长达接近十年之久的逃亡令他在波黑塞族间的声望越来越高。
target_text: Karadžić received summonses during his visit to United Nations Headquarters in 1993. However, the United States Government did not succeed in capturing him during his visit to the United Nations in 1995. There are rumours that the United States Government has protected Karadžić under Dayton.
title: 拉多万·卡拉季奇

source_text: 《反共產國際協定》（又稱防共協定，，）是德國與日本在1936年11月25日簽訂的反對共產國際及蘇聯的協定，由德国外交部长约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫和日本驻德国大使武者小路公共签署。此協定後來陸續有其他國家加入。在1937年至1940年間簽署國只有義大利、匈牙利、滿洲國和西班牙國。1941年時，這個協定的簽署國包括了保加利亞、汪精衛國民政府、克羅地亞、丹麥保護国、芬蘭、羅馬尼亞、斯洛伐克。
target_text: The Anti-Community International Agreement (also known as the Anti-Community Agreement) was signed by Germany and Japan on 25 November 1936 against the Communist International and the Soviet Union, signed by the German Foreign Minister Joachim von Ribbitrovy and the Japanese Ambassador to Germany, The Way. This agreement was followed by other countries. Only Italy, Hungary, Manchuria and Spain signed the agreement between 1937 and 1940. In 1941, the signatories included Bulgaria, the People’s Government of Wang, Croatia, the Danish Protector, Finland, Romania, Slovakia.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 签署国日本曾希望《反共產國際協定》能有效地成为一个反对苏联的联盟，但这是苏联人的看法。它还有一项秘密附加议定书，其中规定了专门针对苏联的德日联合政策。  然而，在法西斯意大利加入该条约，特别是在《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》签订德苏和解后，它也逐渐获得了反西方和反英国的身份。
target_text: The signatory country, Japan, had hoped that the Anti-Community International Accord would effectively become an anti-Soviet alliance, but that was the view of the Soviets. It also had a secret additional protocol, which provided for a special German-Japanese policy for the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在日本，人们对该条约持怀疑态度。1935年7月4日，武者小路公共在一次大使馆会议上表示，日本匆忙与德国结盟是不明智的，因为他将英德海军协议解释为德国试图与英国结盟。自1931年穆克登事件以来，美国和英国一直对日本怀有敌意，如果德国最终选择与英国合作而不是与日本合作，日本可能会被孤立。
target_text: On 4 July 1935, At an embassy meeting, Wushu Public stated that Japan’s hasty alliance with Germany was unwise, as he interpreted the British-German naval agreement as an attempt by Germany to align with Britain. Since the 1931 events in Mukden, the United States and Britain have been hostile to Japan, which could be isolated if Germany eventually chose to cooperate with the United Kingdom rather than with Japan.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
德国外交政策中相互竞争的权威和意识形态
德国外交政策的执行名义上由康斯坦丁·冯·诺伊拉斯的外交部负责，但实际约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫领导了。在那里，他可以独立于外交部执行希特勒的个人外交政策请求。这造成了两个军种之间的竞争。虽然希特勒青睐里宾特洛甫作为其个人外交政策的拥护者，但他至少在最初保留了诺伊拉特的职业外交官队伍，以最大限度地提高其政府在国外的外交合法性。日本驻柏林武官岛宏是反共产国际条约谈判中日本方面最重要的一个人，他将德国的外交服务结构解释为“只有希特勒和里宾特洛甫决定外交政策，因此与他们的下属交谈毫无用处”。因此，岛宏试图将谈判的任何重要步骤直接送到里宾特洛甫或希特勒的办公桌上。
target_text: Germany’s competitive authority and ideology in foreign policy is enforced nominally by the Foreign Ministry of Constantine von Noirás, but it is actually led by Joachim von Ribbentrop, where he is independent of the Foreign Ministry in carrying out Hitler’s individual foreign policy request. This has created competition between the two armies. While Hitler favors Ribbentrop as his champion of his personal foreign policy, he retains at least the ranks of professional diplomats in Noirat to maximize the diplomatic legitimacy of his government abroad.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 里宾特洛甫是希特勒选择的个人外交官，但他个人对地缘战略外交的看法与希特勒在20世纪30年代末截然不同。希特勒主张对英国采取友好政策以消灭苏联，而里宾特洛甫将西方盟国视为德国的主要敌人，并设计了德国的大部分外交政策，包括《反共产国际公约》，目的是遏制大英帝国。当谈到日本时，里宾特洛甫认为，日本作为苏联的主要对手，但也可以转向苏联，从而使日本成为里宾特洛普反英联盟的合作伙伴。
target_text: Livingstone was a private diplomat of Hitler’s choice, but his personal view of geostrategic diplomacy was very different from that of Hitler at the end of the 1930’s. Hitler advocated a friendly policy towards Britain in order to destroy the Soviet Union, while the Western allies were treated as the main enemy of Germany and designed most of Germany’s foreign policy, including the International Convention against Communism, in order to contain the British Empire.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在1936年11月25日签署《反共产国际公约》当天的一份照会中，里宾特洛甫通知武者小路公共，根据秘密附加议定书，德国政府认为这两项条约的条款无效。武者小路公共在同一天回复说，日本政府对德国的立场表示“真诚的满意”。这是日本政府坚持的结果，尤其是在1936年7月24日的一次请求中，澄清了该条约的任何一方与苏联之间过去双边条约的影响。
target_text: In a note on the day of the signing of the International Convention against Communism on 25 November 1936, Ribendlov informed the public that the German Government considered the provisions of the two treaties to be null and void under the secret additional protocol. On the same day, the public replied that the Japanese Government expressed “good faith” in Germany's position. This was the result of the Japanese Government's insistence, particularly in a request dated 24 July 1936, which clarified the effects of past bilateral treaties between any of the parties to the treaty and the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
1919年种族平等提案，1922年华盛顿海军会议
日本在第一次世界大战中曾站在获胜的协约国一边。然而，作为1922年华盛顿海军会议的一部分，美国和英国成功地通过条约限制了日本的海军力量，并迫使日本交出了在第一次世界大战期间在中国取得的成果。尽管东京在会议期间获得了一些优势——它在太平洋上与美国和英国平分秋色，有权建立一支超过法国和意大利海军的海军，并被公认为世界上唯一的非西方殖民大国——但该条约在日本不受欢迎。日本民族主义者和日本帝国海军谴责了该条约的限制性方面。
target_text: However, as part of the 1922 Washington Naval Conference, the United States and the United Kingdom succeeded in limiting Japan’s naval forces through a treaty and forced Japan to give up what was achieved in China during the First World War. Despite the advantages that Tokyo gained during the Conference – in the Pacific, on equal terms with the United States and the United Kingdom, it had the right to build a naval force that exceeded the French and Italian Navys and was recognized as the only non-Western colonial power in the world — the treaty was not welcome in Japan.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 塘沽停战结束了满洲的敌对状态，但日本在中国的野心尚未得到满足。1933年至1936年间，日本外务大臣广田奉行“广田的友好外交”——广田和友外交。根据1934年的阿毛主义，日本将自己视为整个东亚的保护力量，反映了1823年门罗主义下美国在美洲的作用。这种姿态再次得到了欧洲列强的允许，内维尔·张伯伦甚至试图在1934年谈判一项英日互不侵犯条约，以改善英国与日本的关系。广田的外交政策领导层秘密地为日本外交设定了一系列雄心勃勃的目标。这包括满洲国的工业建设，通过征服从华北获得资源，征服西太平洋和东南亚，以及为对抗苏联的战争做准备。
target_text: The truce ended in Manchuria, but Japan’s ambitions in China have yet to be met. Between 1933 and 1936, Japan’s Foreign Minister, Hirota, pursued “Friendly Diplomacy in Hirota” – Hirota and Amigo diplomacy. According to Amudolism in 1934, Japan viewed itself as a protective force for the whole of East Asia, reflecting the role of the United States in the Americas under Monroeism in 1823. This gesture was once again allowed by European powers, Neville Chamberlain even tried to negotiate an English-Japanese non-aggression treaty in 1934 to improve British-Japanese relations.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 1934年10月，日本军队出版了一本名为《国防的本质和加强国防的建议》的小册子，直接反对东京文官政府同时（至少是半心半意）试图进行的外交和解（以前首相志原的名字命名为“志原外交”）。这本小册子要求外交和国内政策的各个方面完全服从于“国防”和国家为全面战争做准备的包罗万象的问题。它进一步谴责“合作外交”，赞扬日本退出国际联盟的决定，并呼籲日本接受自己的命运，制定未来100年的伟大计划。
target_text: In October 1934, the Japanese army published a booklet entitled “The essence of national defence and proposals for strengthening national defence”, which directly opposes the diplomatic reconciliation that the civilian government in Tokyo has attempted to pursue (at least half-heartedly) (former Prime Minister Shihara’s name was “Diplomatic Shihara”). It demands that all aspects of foreign and domestic policy be fully subject to the all-encompassing problems of “defence” and national preparations for a comprehensive war. It further condemns “cooperative diplomacy”, commends Japan’s decision to withdraw from the League of Nations, and calls on Japan to accept its destiny and formulate a great plan for the next 100 years.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
关于日本外交政策的国内权力斗争
日本历史学家石田健将日本帝国的制度称为“没有顶点的圆锥体”。日本帝国陆军（IJA）、日本帝国海军（IJN）和日本外务省都有自己的议程，关于日本应如何调整其外交政策。日本的制度是高度传统的，以裕仁天皇的精神和社会文化价值为基础，它也涉及到朝廷，作为这三个敌对团体与天皇之间的缓冲，这使裕仁能够逃避对该制度可能产生的任何失败和挫折的直接政治责任。
target_text: Japanese historian Ishida described the system of the Japanese Empire as “a conical without a pinnacle.” The Japanese Imperial Army (IJA), the Japanese Imperial Navy (IJN) and the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs have their own agendas on how Japan should adjust its foreign policy. Japan’s system is highly traditional, based on the spirit and socio-cultural values of the Emperor, and it involves the court as a buffer between these three hostile groups and the Emperor, which allows him to escape direct political responsibility for any failure or setback that might arise from the regime.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
日苏渔业条约谈判与边界争端
在谈判《反共产国际公约》时，日本政府也在与苏联政府就日本海捕鱼权进行谈判。由于《反共产国际公约》在德国和日本之间针对苏联的秘密附加议定书是禁止任何一个国家在未经《反共产主义公约》另一方明确同意的情况下与苏联签订政治条约，日本大使木沙努吉担心该公约是否会对日苏谈判产生影响。他在11月25日条约签署后给里宾特洛甫的一封信中询问了这一问题，还提到了日本控制的满洲国与苏联之间的边界问题。里宾特洛甫证实了德国政府的同意，即日本是自治的，可以自由处理武者小路公共在同一天的答复中提到的问题。
target_text: The Japanese government was also negotiating with the Soviet Government on Japan’s maritime fishing rights in the context of the negotiation of the International Convention against Communism. Since the secret additional protocol to the International Convention against Communism between Germany and Japan against the Soviet Union was a ban on any country from entering into a political treaty with the Soviet Union without the express consent of the other party to the Anti-Communist Convention, Japanese Ambassador Musha Nuji feared that the Convention would have an impact on the negotiations in Japan. In a letter to Ribentrov following the signing of the 25 November Treaty, he asked this question and also referred to the border between Manchuria, a Japanese-controlled State, and the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
纳粹德国与日本帝国的思想异同
《反共产国际公约》与其说是一项实际的政治承诺，不如说是一份声明，该声明是一种相互的意识形态结盟和外交依恋。这两个国家都有非常具有政治意义的种族意识形态的例子，德国的阿尔弗雷德·罗森伯格和日本的川希美成为了主要的种族主义理论家。1933年纳粹掌权后，罗森伯格得到了政府的支持，成为党内的核心人物，而川的听众则更为有限。Ōkawa的主要支持者是年轻的民族主义军官，尤其是1931年煽动日本首次入侵中国东北的关东军军官。1936年末，二宫武夫出版了颇具影响力的外交政策小册子《指导日本外交的独特原则》，进一步推动了川的工作。在这本小册子中，武夫围绕基于传统日本精神价值观而非西方帝国主义的种族正当扩张主义政策，阐述了日本外交的长期方向。Nimiya的小册子在20世纪30年代末和40年代初即将进入日本国家政治的年轻官僚和学生中尤其受欢迎。
target_text: After the Nazis took power in 1933, Rosenberg was supported by the government and became a central figure in the party, while the audience in Kawakawa was more limited. The main supporters of kawa were young nationalist officers, especially those who incited Japan to invade the first time northeast of China in 1931. In late 1936, the martial arts of the Second House published an influential foreign policy booklet, " Unique Principles for the Direction of Japanese Diplomacy " , which gave further impetus to the work of Kawakami. In this booklet, Wufu described the long-term direction of Japanese diplomacy around a policy of legitimate racial expansion based on traditional Japanese spiritual values rather than Western imperialism.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 关于德国在中日之间的外交矛盾，德国外交部门的一个主要问题是承认1931年日本入侵中国东北后在满洲国建立的日伪国家。德国驻东京大使Herbert von Dirksen从1934年初开始建议承认满洲国，这将清楚地表明德国支持日本扩张主义，并会扰乱德国的中国伙伴。由于中国政府可能会感到愤怒，而苏联政府可能会对德日协约试图包围的潜在看法感到担忧，这种对满洲国的承认最初遭到了诺伊拉特和外交部的反对。作为对承认满洲国最初请求的回应，德克森被指示避免“与日本建立任何可能使德国被怀疑希望对俄罗斯提供援助的密切关系”。德国对任何针对苏联的进攻都持谨慎态度，这源于柏林的印象，即1934年日本受到外交和军事包围的严重威胁。具体而言，德克森还被指示密切关注日本和苏联之间潜在战争的任何迹象，德国人认为，如果战争爆发，苏联可能会得到西方民主国家的援助，尽管这场潜在的战争并没有立即到来。无论如何，德国外交部门不惜一切代价避免卷入这样的冲突。
target_text: In response to the initial request to recognize Manchuria, German ambassador to Tokyo, Herbert von Dirksen, who proposed to recognize Manchuria, beginning in early 1934, would clearly demonstrate Germany’s support for Japanese expansionism and could disrupt Germany’s Chinese partners. Given that the Chinese government might be angry, and that the Soviet government might be concerned about the potential idea of the German-Japanese pact’s attempt to encirculate, the recognition of Manchuria was initially opposed by Noirat and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在法国人民阵线的支持下，莱昂·布鲁姆的内阁于1936年6月掌权。法国国内的社会不稳定和政治暴力使得法国政府在运用法国广泛的外交和军事权力时小心翼翼，效率低下。希特勒预计法国的人民阵线会导致类似西班牙内战的局面，他于1936年10月6日向法国大使公开宣布，德国不会将共产主义接管法国视为国内事务。
target_text: Social instability and political violence in France led the French government to exercise caution and inefficiency in the exercise of France’s broad diplomatic and military powers. Hitler expected that the French Popular Front would lead to a situation similar to the Spanish civil war, and on 6 October 1936 he publicly announced to the French Ambassador that Germany would not regard communism as a domestic matter.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
里宾特洛普和大岛浩的早期设计
在英德海军协定和第七次世界大会之后，德国人里宾特洛甫于1935年10月设想了一个可能涉及日本帝国和中华民国的反共外交体系。这一想法得到了日本方面的支持，当时的日本驻柏林武官岛宏，尽管岛更关心的是日本对中国的征服，而不是日中对抗苏联的平等联盟。只要日本继续占领满洲，中国的国民政府就不愿意与日本达成协议，所以岛和里宾特洛甫起草了一份德日双边条约。
target_text: The idea of an anti-communist diplomatic system, possibly involving the Japanese Empire and the Republic of China, was conceived in October 1935 by the German Ribbentrop after the British-German Navy Agreement and the Seventh World Congress. This idea was supported by the Japanese side, when Japan’s military attaché in Berlin, Hiroshi Shimada, was more concerned with Japan’s conquest of China than with Japan’s equality alliance against the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 最初，该条约定于1935年11月签订，并向中国、英国、意大利和波兰发出邀请。然而，德国军方和外交领导层阻碍了该条约的实现，因为他们担心德国与中国的关系会破裂。此外，外交部长康斯坦丁·冯·诺伊拉斯嫉妒里宾特洛甫在外交部控制之外的外交政策中的崇高地位。
target_text: Initially, the treaty was scheduled to be signed in November 1935, with invitations extended to China, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Poland. However, the German military and diplomatic leadership hindered its realization, fearing a breakdown in Germany’s relations with China.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 虽然该协议的最初设计来自Dienststelle Ribbentrop，但大岛宏本人曾于1938年至1939年和1941年至1945年担任日本驻德国大使，在该协定的大纲中对日本方面产生了很大影响。虽然东京政府在制定该协议时并不是特别积极，但岛和日本驻柏林大使馆的工作人员却积极主动。1935年7月4日，当Mushanokōji向大使馆工作人员表明他对德国意图的怀疑时，岛是工作人员内部分歧的主要来源。
target_text: Although the original design of the agreement came from Dienstelle Ribbentrop, Mr. Oshima himself served as Ambassador of Japan to Germany from 1938 to 1939 and from 1941 to 1945, with considerable influence on Japan’s side of the agreement’s outline. While the Tokyo government was not particularly active at the time of the agreement, the staff of the Island and the Japanese Embassy in Berlin were proactive.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
1935
从10月的会议开始，在某个时候希特勒本人也参加了会议，岛提出了他的想法，即在苏联袭击两国之一时提供互助。在这一点上，岛给日本军队的电报对谈判的外交潜力充满热情，包括建立公开的德日军事联盟的可能性，尽管当时双方都对达成一项影响较小的协议感到更为满意，即在苏联对另一方发动战争时不援助苏联。这样的“无援助”协议更容易融入每个国家各自的大战略。岛的广泛参与对反共产国际条约的形成至关重要，但也引起了日本军事和外交领导人的一些不安，因为岛与里宾特洛甫甚至希特勒本人的未经授权的外交合作远远超出了他的军事任务。但是，像岛这样的下级军官可能会因为与外国政府首脑的鲁莽交往而受到严厉惩罚，岛的进步得到了日本超级军国主义者的积极认可，他们同情希特勒的政策，并对岛的成功印象深刻。
target_text: 1935 Beginning with the October meeting, Hitler himself participated at some point in the meeting, when the island put forward his idea of providing mutual assistance in the event of an attack by the Soviet Union against one of the two countries. On this point, the island's telegram to the Japanese army was passionate about the diplomatic potential of the negotiations, including the possibility of establishing an open German-Japanese military alliance, although both sides were more satisfied at the time with a less influential agreement that the Soviet Union would not assist the Soviet Union in waging war against the other.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: Kotohito指派了一名总参谋部情报官员Wakamatsu Tadaichi在柏林执行一项任务，该任务涉及确定德国对德日针对苏联的协议的态度。1935年11月和12月，若松岛、Ō岛和布隆博格之间的会议收效甚微，尽管若松表示日本军队普遍愿意与德国谈判一项条约。他对Dienststelle在德国外交部门的半官方地位表示怀疑。
target_text: Kotohito assigned a General Staff intelligence officer, Wakamatsu Tadaichi, to carry out a mission in Berlin, which involved determining Germany’s attitude towards German-Japanese agreements against the Soviet Union. In November and December 1935, the meeting between José, Hashima and Blomberg had had very little effect, although he expressed the general willingness of the Japanese army to negotiate a treaty with Germany. He questioned Dienstelle’s semi-official position in the German diplomatic service.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 1935年底，苏联红军情报部门截获了岛和日本总参谋部之间的几封秘密电报。这一信息被转发给了苏联驻日本大使馆，美国大使馆也从中听到了德国和日本之间正在进行的秘密谈判的消息。这标志着苏联第一次被证实收到正在进行的反共产国际条约谈判的消息。
target_text: At the end of 1935, Soviet Red Army intelligence intercepted several secret telegrams between the island and the Japanese General Staff. This information was transmitted to the Soviet Embassy in Japan, from which the United States Embassy heard news of the secret negotiations under way between Germany and Japan.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
1936
德国外交部和里宾特洛甫之间的矛盾在谈判过程中再次显现出来。驻东京大使德克森不是从德国外交部获悉正在进行的会谈，而是从日本总参谋部获悉的。德国外交部长康斯坦丁·冯·诺伊拉特在得知希特勒的情况后，反对建立德日条约。首先，他关心中德关系，认为日本对德国的重要性不如中国；其次，他希望避免外交部将外交政策权力从外交部转移到里宾特洛甫身上，在那里他将里宾特洛夫视为自己立场的对手。在日本，由于重要文件在1936年1月至2月间在日本外务省的官僚机构中丢失，这件事陷入了停滞，因为这些文件在到达外务大臣广田Kōki或他的副手茂光彻之前就被低级别官员丢弃了。
target_text: 1936 The contradiction between the German Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ribbentrop resurfaced during the negotiations. Ambassador Dexxon in Tokyo did not learn from the German Ministry of Foreign Affairs about the talks under way, but from the General Staff of Japan. German Foreign Minister Konstantin von Noirat opposed the establishment of a German-Japanese treaty when he learned of Hitler. First, he was concerned about Chinese-German relations and believed that Japan was less important to Germany than China; second, he wished to avoid the transfer of foreign policy authority from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to Ribbentrop, where he regarded Ribbentlov as his opponent. In Japan, the important documents were lost in the bureaucracy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan between January and February 1936.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 直到1936年3月，在2月26日失败的军事政变和德国对莱茵兰的重新军事化引发的日本动乱之后，这件事才传到新任外相八重手中，八重与当时在日本的驻德大使木沙努克吉和几名高级陆军官员讨论过。在那次会议上，军务长官町次里是唯一一个赞成德国和日本之间建立彻底军事联盟的人，而Arita、Shigemitsu、Terauchi和Mushanokōji则赞成以更谨慎的方式达成专门针对共产国际的协议。然而，他们高估了自己在柏林的权威，岛仍然是德国人的主要谈判伙伴，而且他个人不愿意向外交部官员放弃任何新发现的外交重要性。为了防止与日本军队发生冲突，Arita和Mushanokōji不得不精心安排一个新的位置。从技术上讲，岛作为武官是日本军队的下属，而不是外务省的下属。虽然支持反共产国际版本的协议，但他们仍然赋予岛作为军方代表谈判达成全面联盟的能力。Mushanokōji被指示对德国人采取被动立场，让他们发起谈判，以免看起来像日本外务省在向前迈进。
target_text: It was not until March 1936, following the failed military coup and the civil unrest in Japan caused by Germany’s re-militarization of Rhineland on 26 February, that the matter was brought to the attention of the new Foreign Minister. However, they overestimated their authority in Berlin, the island remained the main negotiating partner of the Germans, and his personal unwillingness to give up any newly discovered importance of diplomacy to officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In order to prevent clashes with the Japanese army, Arita and Mushanokji were the only people who favoured a complete military alliance between Germany and Japan. Technically, the island, as a martial arts officer, was subordinate to the Japanese army, not to the foreign ministry.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在德国方面，1936年3月27日的《法苏互助条约》增加了对苏联后方强大伙伴的需求，以防止完全包围。此外，希特勒希望，如果德国对共产主义做出足够强硬的姿态，法国对苏联的忠诚可能会促使反共的英国政府与德国达成协议。因此，谈判于1936年10月23日恢复，协定于同年11月25日敲定并签署。法国和苏联之间的条约，以及共产国际第七次世界大会加强了共产主义者和社会主义者之间的合作，使共产主义PCF在1936年法国选举中的选票增加了一倍。随着欧洲政治左派的内讧减少，德国政府重新评估其立场变得更加紧迫。就在里宾特洛甫和Mushanokōji草签协议草案的同一天（10月23日），Neurath与意大利外长Galeazzo Ciano签署了一项秘密的九点协议。
target_text: On the German side, the Franco-Soviet Mutual Assistance Treaty of 27 March 1936 increased the demand for strong partners of the Soviet rear in order to prevent a complete siege. Moreover, Hitler hoped that France’s loyalty to the Soviet Union would lead to an agreement between the anti-Communist British Government and Germany if Germany made a strong enough stance towards communism.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 然而，德国在日本的意识形态接近性和军事潜力与中国的经济价值之间的外交矛盾仍在继续，诺伊拉特仍然支持德国与中国结盟。1936年4月，德国与中国签订了一项重要的商业条约，给予中国1亿马克的信贷，用于购买德国的工业和其他产品。1936年夏天，希特勒本人在诺伊拉特和外交部不知情的情况下，开始重新评估中日两国在德国外交关系中的重要性。希特勒批准与日本人进行新的谈判。
target_text: In April 1936, Germany signed an important commercial treaty with China, granting 100 million marks of credit to China for the purchase of German industry and other products. In the summer of 1936, Hitler himself, without the knowledge of Noirat and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, began to reassess the importance of China and Japan in Germany’s diplomatic relations.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 寺内在1936年5月通知Ō岛，为了恢复两派之间的和谐，军队将把谈判的控制权交给了外务省，但在非正式场合，Ō;岛仍将是日本的主要谈判代表，而武者小路公共的角色将更具仪式性。7月，Mushanokōji要求Dienststelle Ribbentrop提交一份拟议条约草案，该草案由Dienststele的东亚专家之一Hermann von Raumer博士起草。但是，可能是按照里宾特洛甫的指示行事的Raumer并没有立即将这份草稿交给Mushanokōji，而是首先将其交给了当时正在参加拜罗伊特音乐节的Ōshima。7月22日，岛、里宾特洛甫、劳默和希特勒在拜罗伊特会面，希特勒在那里对劳默的草稿进行了一些个人编辑。直到那时，草案才被出示给大使武者小路公共。
target_text: In May 1936, the Temple informed that, in order to restore harmony between the two factions, the army would hand control over the negotiations to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, but in an informal setting, the island would remain Japan’s main negotiator, and the public role of the martial arts would be more ceremonial. In July, Mushanokji asked Dienstelle Ribbentrop to submit a proposed draft treaty, which had been drafted by Dr. Hermann von Raumer, one of the East Asian experts in Dienstele, who had probably acted on the instructions of Ribentrov, but who had not immediately given the draft to Mushanokji, but had first handed it to the shima, who was attending the Bayroyt festival.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 1936年7月24日，日本政府经过深思熟虑，正式要求《反共产国际公约》仅限于情报和信息交流，以避免与苏联发生不必要的外交复杂关系。日本政府还特别要求避免任何直接联盟，只要求在发生袭击时进行协商，即使是在秘密协议中。此外，日本政府要求澄清，在其中一方对苏联的战争中，任何义务都是专门防御性的（以避免在不合时宜的时候被卷入德国对苏联的进攻性战争），并避免在条约中，甚至在秘密议定书中具体点名苏联。前两个请求进入了《反共产国际公约》的最终版本，但第三个没有。苏联的名字只在条约的公开部分被避免，最终确定的《反共产国际公约》的秘密议定书仍然专门提到苏联。
target_text: On 24 July 1936, the Japanese Government formally requested, after careful consideration, that the International Convention against Communism be limited to intelligence and information exchange in order to avoid unnecessary diplomatic complications with the Soviet Union. The Japanese Government also requested, inter alia, that any direct alliance be avoided and that consultations be held only in the event of an attack, even in a secret agreement. Moreover, the Japanese Government sought clarification that in the war of one of the parties against the Soviet Union, any obligation was exclusively defensive (to avoid involvement in an offensive war between Germany against the Soviet Union at an untimely time) and to avoid specifically naming the Soviet Union in a treaty, even in a secret protocol.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 此外，日本政府还要求澄清未经前苏联同意禁止与苏联签订双边条约的规定，担心条约的措辞会允许德国维持与苏联签订的现有双边条约，包括《拉帕洛条约》（1922年）和《柏林条约》（1926年）。具体而言，后一项条约是德苏中立条约，甚至得到了反共纳粹的支持，在日本被视为与反共产国际条约的拟议条款相矛盾。德国政府认为《反共产国际公约》足以推翻《柏林条约》的条款，而日本政府对这一解释感到满意，只要它作为秘密附录附在该条约之后。
target_text: In addition, the Government of Japan requested clarification of the provisions prohibiting the conclusion of bilateral treaties with the USSR without the consent of the former Soviet Union and expressed its concern that the wording of the treaty would allow Germany to maintain existing bilateral treaties with the USSR, including the Treaty of Laparo (1922) and the Treaty of Berlin (1926). Specifically, the latter was a German-Soviet neutral treaty, even supported by the anti-communist Nazis, which in Japan was considered to be in contradiction with the proposed provisions of the international treaty against Communism. The Government of Germany considers that the International Convention against Communism is sufficient to override the provisions of the Berlin Treaty, and the Government of Japan is satisfied with this interpretation, provided that it is attached as a secret appendix to the treaty.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 岛在不服从外交部的最后一次行动中向希特勒建议，如果条约中的反苏条款被秘密添加到协议中，外交部的反对意见可以得到挽救。最终，外交部屈服于军队的压力，同意对该协议进行秘密军事补充。1936年8月16日，里宾特洛甫通知希特勒，与武者小路公共和岛进行的谈判导致大使宣布日本政府原则上愿意批准该协议。 里宾特洛甫在给希特勒的一封信中评论了日本政府对该条约的厌恶和日本军队对该条约发表的支持。
target_text: In its last action, the island advised Hitler that the opposition of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs could be saved if the anti-Soviet clause of the treaty was secretly added to the agreement. In the end, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs subjugated to the pressure of the army and agreed to a secret military supplement to the agreement.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 然而，在8月至10月该协议正式草签期间，仍进行了一些小的调整。它的长度从最初计划的10年缩短到了5年。而且，与岛和希特勒的希望相反，日本军方领导层坚持认为，即使在秘密附录中达成一致，军事条款也只能是防御性的，而不能是进攻性的。军方领导层担心，如果日本陷入对中国的战争，条约中的攻击性条款将在外交上迫使日本对苏联发动战争，而日本在军事上不愿意与之作战。因此，《秘密附加议定书》的第一条专门谈到了苏联的“无端攻击”，没有任何攻击性条款。
target_text: And, contrary to the hopes of the island and Hitler, the Japanese military leadership insists that military clauses, even if agreed in secret appendices, can only be defensive and not offensive. The military leadership fears that, if Japan is caught in a war against China, the aggressive clauses in the treaty will diplomaticly force Japan to wage war against the Soviet Union, and Japan is militarily reluctant to fight against them.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
日本枢密院和阿道夫·希特勒批准
《反共产国际条约》要求日本枢密院批准日本加入该条约。1936年10月23日，日本首相广田在听到条约草案的结论后表示，他个人松了一口气，并将日本联合会在推进《反共产国际公约》方面取得的成就与日本联合会1902年建立英日同盟的成功进行了比较。年长的日本政治家，最后一代的近藤齐二，不同意日本政府的外交步骤，并谴责《反共产国际公约》只对德国有用，对日本没有好处。相反，金摩奇更喜欢一门更符合日本民意和地理位置的外交课程，这两方面都使他与英国和美国的积极关系变得可取。然而，金莫奇的批评立场在枢密院仍然闻所未闻。
target_text: Japan’s Privy Council and Adolf Hitler have ratified the International Treaty against Communism, which requires the Japanese Privy Council to ratify Japan’s accession to it. On 23 October 1936, Japan’s Prime Minister, Hirota, having heard the draft treaty’s conclusions, expressed his personal relief and compared the achievements of the Japan Federation in advancing the International Convention against Communism with the success of the Japan-Japan alliance in 1902.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在日本国内以IJA为首的条约支持者看来，日本受到苏联干涉中国的军事威胁，就像德国受到苏联支持法国和捷克斯洛伐克的威胁一样。此外，两国都害怕共产主义势力的颠覆。这使得德国和日本成为反对苏联和共产国际的天然盟友。聚集在IJN周围的反对者指出，《反共产国际公约》可能会增加而不是减少苏联构成的威胁，而且国内会对该协议产生相当大的抵制。最终，支持者在11月13日和11月18日的讨论中获胜，1936年11月25日，枢密院一致支持该条约。
target_text: According to the supporters of the IJA-led treaty in Japan, Japan is threatened by Soviet intervention in China, just as Germany was threatened by Soviet support for France and Czechoslovakia. Moreover, both countries fear subversion by communist forces, making Germany and Japan natural allies against the Soviet Union and communists.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
签约
该条约概述了德国和日本对抗共产国际运动的联合政策，最初生效五年，直到1941年11月。另外签署了两项协议，其中一项是公开的。另一个是专门针对苏联的，是秘密的。该条约是在里宾特洛甫的办公室而不是德国外交部签署的。里宾特洛甫在纽伦堡的证词中将此归因于希特勒希望避免使用德国政治的官方渠道，因为里宾特洛普称之为“意识形态问题”，而不是政治问题。
target_text: The treaty outlines the joint policy of Germany and Japan against the international movement against Communism, which initially came into force for five years, until November 1941. Two other agreements were signed, one of which was public. The other was specifically for the Soviet Union, which was secret. The treaty was signed by Ribbentrop’s office, not by the German Foreign Office. In his statement in Nuremberg, Ribbentrop attributed this to Hitler’s desire to avoid using the official channels of German politics, as Ribbentrop called “ideology” rather than political issues.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
主要协议
全文在德语和日语版本中都是以原始形式考虑的，两国版本中都规定日期为1936年11月25日和昭和11年11月5日。该协议上有德国无任所大使里宾特洛甫和日本驻德国大使武者小路公共的签名。条约最初的期限规定为五年。在日本外务省反对该条约最初的拜罗伊特草案后，这种缩短的长度是做出的让步之一，在该草案中，该条约最初被认为有效期为十年。
target_text: The full text of the agreement was considered in its original form in both German and Japanese versions, both of which set the dates of 25 November 1936 and 5 November 1936. The agreement contained the signatures of the German Ambassador-at-large, Ribendrove, and the Japanese Ambassador-at-Large-in-Germany, Le Lu. The initial duration of the treaty was set at five years. After the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan opposed the original Bayroyt draft of the treaty, such a reduction was one of the concessions made, in which the treaty was initially considered to be valid for a period of 10 years.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在条约的第一条中，德国和日本同意分享有关共产国际活动的信息，并共同计划打击这些活动的行动。在第二条中，两党开启了将该协议扩展到其他国家的可能性，“这些国家的国内和平因共产主义国际运动的破坏性活动而受到威胁”。对第三方的此类邀请将在双方明确同意后共同进行。德国官方媒体提到了共产国际破坏的危害条款，其中包括Völkischer Beobachter讲述了匈牙利和满洲国的各种共产主义活动，作为两国于1939年2月加入该条约的原因。
target_text: In article I of the Treaty, Germany and Japan agreed to share information on international communist activities and jointly plan actions to combat them. In article II, the two parties opened up the possibility of extending the agreement to other countries, where “the internal peace of those countries is threatened by the destructive activities of the international communist movement.” Such invitations to third parties would be carried out jointly with the express consent of both parties. The German official media referred to the harmful provisions of the international communist act, including Völkischer Beobachter's description of various communist activities in Hungary and Manchuria as a reason for their accession to the Treaty in February 1939.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
秘密附加协议
除了主要条约和公开的附加议定书（“附加议定书”）外，1936年11月25日还有另一项附加议定书/Shōwa 11，这项议定书对公众严格保密，专门涉及建立德国和日本对抗苏联的军事和外交伙伴关系。虽然公开协议中提到了共产国际的活动，但秘密附加协议是唯一一个真正提到苏联名字的协议。就像主协议和公开附加协议一样，秘密附加协议是由里宾特洛甫和武者小路公共签署的。
target_text: In addition to the main treaties and the open additional protocols (“additional protocols”), there was another protocol on 25 November 1936, which was strictly confidential to the public and specifically concerned the establishment of a military and diplomatic partnership between Germany and Japan against the Soviet Union. While the public agreement referred to communist activities, the secret additional agreement was the only agreement that actually referred to the name of the Soviet Union. Like the main agreement and the open additional agreement, the secret additional protocol was signed by the Ribbentrop and Wu Man Road.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
法国
在法国，《反共产国际公约》，特别是在意大利加入后，被视为德国在东欧的夺权行为，尤其对捷克斯洛伐克和波兰不利。德国
1937年，德意志帝国告知德国公众该条约已成为法律。里宾特洛甫认为《反共产国际公约》是德日共同捍卫西方文明的行为。即使在1941年德苏战争开始后，纳粹德国也否认了秘密附加议定书的存在和该条约的反苏性质。
target_text: In France, the International Convention against Communism, especially after Italy’s accession, is considered a German seizure in Eastern Europe, particularly against Czechoslovakia and Poland. In 1937, Germany’s Reich informed the German public that the treaty had become law.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在东京，政府不愿吸引任何不受欢迎的国际对手，同时仍专注于在中国大陆的目标。因此，政府最初一直很谨慎，不愿与苏联、英国和美国发生外交事件，但最终在1936年4月苏联与蒙古人民共和国签署互助条约时，发现自己被迫加入了该条约。然而，尽管政府持怀疑态度，枢密院还是一致同意。
target_text: In Tokyo, the government was reluctant to attract any unpopular international opponent, while remaining focused on the goals of mainland China. Thus, the government was initially cautious about diplomatic events with the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States, but eventually found itself compelled to accede to the Mutual Assistance Treaty between the Soviet Union and the Mongolian People’s Republic in April 1936.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 由于《反共产国际公约》，政府内部的军事影响力得到了加强。由于欧洲式的国家社会主义意识形态涌入日本社会，日本政府开始在其媒体宣传活动中使用反犹太主义形象，特别是针对西方资本主义的宣传活动。日本首相广田称德国是该条约后日本最重要的外交伙伴，但强调《反共产国际公约》并不意味着对德国国内政策的意识形态支持。
target_text: As a result of the influx of European-style national socialist ideologies into Japanese society, the Japanese government began to use anti-Semitism images in its media campaigns, especially against Western capitalism. Prime Minister Hirota of Japan described Germany as Japan’s most important diplomatic partner after the treaty, but stressed that the International Convention did not imply ideological support for Germany’s domestic policies.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 相比之下，国际联合会是该条约最大的批评者之一。虽然日本海军军官阶级并不一定谴责该协议，人们认为它的作用非常有限。日本海军联合会对海军形势的看法是，日本的海军力量不如联合王国和美国，如果必要的话，这两个国家都倾向于相互合作，以对抗日本的存在。相比之下，德国（以及后来的意大利）对缓解英美海军封锁或帮助日本海军在太平洋的努力几乎没有帮助。如果这意味着与美国和英国的关系会因此得到改善，日本海军会倾向于避免该条约。
target_text: By contrast, Germany (and, later, Italy) has little help in easing the British-American naval blockade or helping the Japanese navy in the Pacific. If this means that relations with the United States and Britain will improve, the Japanese navy will tend to avoid the Treaty.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
苏联
在公开场合，苏联政府试图淡化该协议的重要性。然而，《反共产国际公约》在内部被视为德国和日本企图包围的明显迹象。1939年1月，苏联外交部长马克西姆·利特维诺夫在给匈牙利政府的一份政治照会中称《反共产国际公约》是“主要掌握在对苏联怀有敌对意图的日本人手中的政治工具”。11月26日，利特维诺夫在苏联全国代表大会上发言时，也对向公众提交的条约的完整性表示怀疑，称其“只是同时讨论的另一项协议的伪装”。
target_text: In a political note to the Government of Hungary in January 1939, the Soviet Minister for Foreign Affairs, Maxim Litvinov, called the International Convention against Communism “a political instrument primarily held in the hands of Japanese with hostile intentions against the Soviet Union”. On 26 November, Litvinov, speaking at the National Congress of the Soviet Union, also expressed doubts about the integrity of the treaty submitted to the public, stating that it was “a disguise of another agreement that was being discussed simultaneously”.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 苏联外交官很快得出了利特维诺夫在11月26日暗示的相同意见：《反共产国际公约》是专门针对苏联的。苏联驻东京大使康斯坦丁·尤里涅夫（正确地）认为，该协议在其表面上包含了针对苏联的军事条款。尤列涅夫甚至在该协议于11月16日和11月20日公布之前联系了日本外务大臣有田。虽然Arita在第一次请求时回避了这个问题，指出谈判只涉及共产国际，而不是苏联，但他没有回应Yurenev的后一次接触，大使在接触中指责日本外交部门与德国进行专门针对苏联的秘密谈判。
target_text: Soviet diplomats quickly came to the same conclusion that Litvinov implied on 26 November: the Anti-Community International Convention was specific to the Soviet Union. Soviet ambassador in Tokyo, Konstantin Yurinev (rightfully), argued that the agreement contained military provisions against the Soviet Union on its face. Even before the agreement was published on 16 and 20 November, Yulenev contacted the Japanese Minister for Foreign Affairs with a field. Although Arita avoided the issue at the time of the first request, noting that the negotiations concerned only communists, not the Soviet Union, he did not respond to Yurenev’s second contact, during which the Ambassador accused the Japanese diplomatic service of conducting secret negotiations with Germany specifically aimed at the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 《反共产国际公约》在政治上加速了苏联与日本贸易关系的下滑趋势。由于对《反共产国际公约》感到震惊，苏联减少了对日本的销售和采购：1939年，日本从欧洲俄罗斯的进口是1914年以来的最低水平，对欧洲俄罗斯的出口是1926年以来的最小水平，而日本从亚洲俄罗斯的进口则是1887年以来的最高水平，对亚洲俄罗斯的出口则是1914年来的最低水平。《反共产国际公约》在未经德国同意的情况下对日本和苏联之间的双边条约采取限制性政策，这使得这种螺旋式的下降很难解决。只有在1939年《德苏条约》和随后日本对德国信任的减少之后，双方的政治和经济态度才有所改善。
target_text: The International Convention against Communism has politically accelerated the downward trend in trade relations between the Soviet Union and Japan. As a result of alarm at the International Convention against Communism, the Soviet Union reduced its sales and purchases to Japan: in 1939, Japanese imports from Europe and Russia were the lowest level since 1914, exports to Europe and Russia were the lowest level since 1926, while Japanese imports from Asia and Russia were the highest level since 1887 and exports to Asia and Russia the lowest level since 1914. The restrictive policy adopted by the International Convention against Communism against bilateral treaties between Japan and the Soviet Union without Germany’s consent made it difficult to resolve this downward spiral.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 尽管德国对日中战争的政策是严格中立的，它没有作出任何特别的外交或其他方面的努力来阻止日本对中国的侵略。德国政府和外交部门仍然私下批评日本的行动。当武者小路公共向国务秘书Ernst von Weizsäcker解释说，日本入侵中国是为了战胜中国共产主义而遵循《反共产国际公约》的精神时，Weizsècker驳斥了武者小路公共的解释，因为德国认为日本的行动将促进而不是扼杀共产主义在中国的发展。Weizsäcker在关于与Mushanokōji的对话的笔记中表示，他担心日本的侵略可能直接导致苏联和中国之间的联盟。
target_text: Although Germany’s policy with regard to the Japanese war is strictly neutral, it has not made any particular diplomatic or other effort to prevent Japan’s aggression against China. The German government and diplomatic services have criticized Japan’s actions in private. When Wu Lu Public explained to Secretary of State Ernst von Weizsäcker that Japan’s invasion of China was in keeping with the spirit of the International Convention against Communism, Weizsècker rejected Wu’s public interpretation because Germany believed that Japan’s actions would promote rather than stifle the development of communism in China. Weizsäcker, in his notes on the dialogue with Mushanokhji, expressed his concern that Japan’s aggression could lead directly to an alliance between the Soviet Union and China.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 不信任的关系和贝尼托·墨索里尼自己的扩张主义加深了意大利与两个盟国之间的距离。1935年10月，意大利无端侵略埃塞俄比亚，违反了国际联盟的政策。尽管由英国和法国起草者设计的旨在让意大利保留大部分战争目标并维持斯特雷萨阵线的《霍瓦尔-拉瓦尔条约》未能获得支持，但国际联盟已经名誉扫地。在联盟最终以经济制裁惩罚意大利的扩张主义后，这打破了斯特雷萨阵线，导致意大利有必要寻找新的合作伙伴。因此，意大利在外交上与盟国一起离开了斯特雷萨阵线，转而与德国签订了钢铁条约。意大利加入《反共产国际公约》完成了德国、意大利和日本之间的外交三角关系，后来在《三方公约》中正式确立，通俗地称为轴心国，其灵感来自贝尼托·墨索里尼在1936年11月1日提及德意关系时使用的术语。
target_text: The relationship of mistrust and Benito Mussolini’s own expansionistism deepened the distance between Italy and the two allies. In October 1935, Italy invaded Ethiopia for no reason, in violation of the policy of the League of Nations.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 意大利外交部长加莱亚佐·西亚诺（Galeazzo Ciano）担心，与德国的紧密结盟以及随后德国进入巴尔干半岛可能会导致意大利在东南欧失去影响力。意大利对第三欧洲或横轴的立场，即在东欧建立一个拒绝德国和苏联影响的力量集团，并不一定是负面的。意大利外交政策中的这种矛盾心理最初阻碍了意大利与德国的全面结盟。
target_text: Italian Foreign Minister Galeazzo Ciano fears that a close alliance with Germany and its subsequent entry into the Balkans could lead to Italy losing influence in South-Eastern Europe. Italy’s position on the third European or transverse, namely the creation of a power group in Eastern Europe that rejects the influence of Germany and the Soviet Union, is not necessarily negative.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
试图将该协定发展为军事联盟
在《反共产国际公约》签署后，特别是在意大利加入后，里宾特洛甫继续努力将其组成一个完整的军事联盟。这反映了里宾特洛甫、劳默、岛和希特勒在条约制定期间的想法，因为希特勒在拜罗伊特签署的原始草案可能包括明确既是防御又是进攻的军事条款。这是由于日本外交官围绕志贺的干预而阻止的。
target_text: Attempts to develop the agreement into a military alliance After the signing of the International Convention against Communism, and especially after the accession of Italy, Ribbentrop continued his efforts to form a complete military alliance. This reflects the thinking of Ribbentrop, Raomer, the island, and Hitler during the treaty-making period, because the original draft signed by Hitler in Baeroyt may include military clauses that clearly define both defence and attack.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 条约缔结后，里宾特洛甫将其转变为军事联盟的努力仍在继续，尽管他的议程是出于对西方盟友战争的担忧，而希特勒的主要担忧是消灭苏联。里宾特洛甫在担任德国驻英国大使期间，在1937年12月28日的报告和1938年1月2日的最后结论中向希特勒建议建立一个强大的反英联盟，以迫使英国保持中立或在战争中击败英国的方式威胁英国。
target_text: After the conclusion of the treaty, Ribbentrop’s efforts to transform it into a military alliance continued, although his agenda was motivated by concerns about the war of Western allies, while Hitler’s main concern was the elimination of the Soviet Union. During his service as German Ambassador to the United Kingdom, he proposed to Hitler, in his report of 28 December 1937 and in his final conclusions of 2 January 1938, the establishment of a strong anti-British coalition to threaten Britain by forcing it to remain neutral or defeat it in the war.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 里宾特洛甫于1938年2月4日被任命为外交部长，接替康斯坦丁·冯·诺伊拉斯，在德国外交部门的政治权力大幅增长。这是由维尔纳·冯·布隆伯格和维尔纳·冯·弗里奇的解职引起的陆军、空军和外交部门改组的一部分。 在这场军事政治清洗中，希特勒罢免了12名将军（不包括布隆伯格和弗里奇），并重新分配了51个其他军事职位。Neurath、Fritsch和Blomberg的下台标志着希特勒内阁中“温和派”的大部分被消灭，而“极端分子”仍然存在：戈培尔、赫斯、罗森伯格和里宾特洛甫。
target_text: In this military-political cleansing, Hitler removed 12 generals (excluding Blomberg and Friedrich) and reassigned 51 other military positions. Neurath, Fritsch and Blomberg marked the elimination of most of Hitler’s cabinets as “moderns,” while “extremists” remained: Gopel, Hess, Rosenberg, and Ribbentrop.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 1938年5月的危机，当时人们认为德国军队对捷克斯洛伐克进行了侵略性的调动，随之而来的是法国和英国的强烈外交反应，这与既定的绥靖政策背道而驰。因此，里宾特洛甫再次向希特勒施压，要求他将《反共产国际公约》正式化为一个全面的军事联盟，以应对对英国和法国的战争。他最终也得到了意大利驻德国大使贝尔纳多·阿托利科的支持。
target_text: The crisis of May 1938, when it was thought that the German army had mobilized aggressively towards Czechoslovakia, followed by a strong diplomatic reaction by France and Britain, ran counter to the established policy of appeasement. As a result, Ribbentrop again pressured Hitler to formalize the International Convention against Communism into a comprehensive military alliance to deal with the war against Britain and France. He was finally supported by the Italian Ambassador to Germany, Bernardo Atolico.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 1939年1月初，里宾特洛甫确信自己在将条约转变为联盟方面取得了进展。墨索里尼现在已经放弃了在英国和德国之间对意大利外交矛盾的尝试，并完全致力于意大利与德国的联盟他也表示同意。墨索里尼还主张甚至扩大这个潜在的联盟，将南斯拉夫、匈牙利和罗马尼亚包括在内。
target_text: At the beginning of January 1939, he was convinced that he had made progress in transforming the treaty into a union. Mussolini has now abandoned his attempts at a diplomatic contradiction between the United Kingdom and Germany, and is fully committed to the alliance between Italy and Germany, and he agrees. Mussolini also advocates even the expansion of this potential alliance to include Yugoslavia, Hungary, and Romania.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 最终，日本的谨慎导致里宾特洛甫只接受了一个双边联盟，而不是他所希望的三边联盟，德国和意大利于1939年5月22日签署了《钢铁公约》。《钢铁公约》的能力被Ciano评价为“真正的炸药”。《钢铁公约》使德国能够继续对波兰采取侵略姿态，因为这个问题不一定需要日本的同意或支持，但里宾特洛甫也希望扩大《钢铁条约》并将日本纳入其中。然而，日本的拖延战术仍在继续，德国希望消除苏联作为其对波兰战争的潜在因素。
target_text: In the end, Japan's caution led to the acceptance of only one bilateral alliance, not the trilateral union he had hoped for, and Germany and Italy signed the Iron and Steel Convention on 22 May 1939. The capacity of the Iron and Steel Convention was assessed by Ciano as “real explosives.” The Iron and Steel Convention enabled Germany to continue its aggressive stance against Poland, since the issue did not necessarily require Japan's consent or support, but it also wanted to expand the Iron and Steel Treaty and to include Japan. However, Japan's delaying tactics continued, and Germany hoped to eliminate the Soviet Union as a potential factor in its war against Poland.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 因此，里宾特洛甫开始认真思考与苏联在东欧未来问题上的交换条件。这将标志着完全背叛了《反共产国际公约》的规定，即未经日本同意，不得与苏联签订双边条约，但德国还是继续这样做了。1939年5月，里宾特洛甫指示弗里德里希·维尔纳·格拉夫·冯·德舒伦堡在新缔结的《钢铁条约》标志着德国外交政策从反苏转向反英和反法外交的基础上，启动德苏和解。里宾特洛甫还承诺将日本的反苏外交政策转变为日本和苏联不再需要对抗的状态。
target_text: This would represent a complete betrayal of the provisions of the International Convention against Communism, whereby no bilateral treaty could be concluded with the Soviet Union without Japan’s consent, but Germany continues to do so. In May 1939, Ribintroph instructed Friedrich Werner Grave von der Schulenburg to conclude the new Iron and Steel Treaty, which marks a shift in German foreign policy from anti-Soviet to anti-British and anti-French diplomacy, to start de-Soviet reconciliation.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
匈牙利和满洲国的加入
匈牙利于1939年2月24日加入该协定 49  1月13日，匈牙利外交部长伊斯特万·查基宣布，如果匈牙利收到邀请，它将接受邀请。它是三大国之外第一个拥有一定独立性的成员国，随后也是第一个在该公约成员国中被剥夺一等地位的国家，从而确立了德国、意大利和日本作为该公约的主导国与其余国家作为其附属国之间的分界线。这三个主要国家的优越地位后来在1941年11月25日的条约延期中正式确立。
target_text: Hungary and the Manchuria States acceded to the Agreement on 24 February 1939, 49/ Hungary, 49/ On 13 January, the Hungarian Minister for Foreign Affairs, Esteban Chaki, announced that Hungary would accept the invitation if it received the invitation. It was the first member State to have some independence from the three States, and then the first to be deprived of first-class status among the States members of the Convention, thus establishing the dividing line between Germany, Italy and Japan, as the lead nation of the Convention, and the rest as its subjects. The superiority of the three major States was subsequently formally established in the extension of the Treaty of 25 November 1941.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约
当德国与苏联秘密谈判《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》时，该条约的合法性遭到了破坏。1939年8月，就在第二次世界大战爆发前几周，里宾特洛甫和斯大林在莫斯科进行谈判时，《反共产国际公约》只是一个小障碍。里宾特洛甫向斯大林解释说，事实上，《反共产国际公约》是针对西方民主国家的，而不是苏联。
target_text: In August 1939, just a few weeks before the outbreak of the Second World War, the International Convention against Communism was negotiated in Moscow. Rebintroth explained to Stalin that, in fact, the International Convention against Communism was aimed at Western democracies, not at the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
斯大林接受这一点是为了他的国家的外交目标，德国公众也开玩笑说，苏联最终会加入反共产国际条约。苏联外交部长维亚切斯拉夫·莫洛托夫在与里宾特洛甫和德国驻苏联大使舒伦堡的谈判中没有将《反共产国际公约》作为一个问题。反共产国际公约内部的反应
意大利
target_text: Stalin accepted this for his country’s diplomatic purposes, and the German public joked that the Soviet Union would eventually accede to international anti-communist treaties. The Soviet Foreign Minister, Vyacheslav Molotov, did not consider the Anti-Communist Convention as an issue in negotiations with Ribendlov and the German Ambassador to the Soviet Union in Schulenburg.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》证实了意大利公众对德国的许多怀疑，意大利公众对与德国的任何外交联盟都不感兴趣。这种外交背叛，再加上轴心国在第二次世界大战中的最终失败，在第二次世界大战刚结束时，意大利文学和流行文化中就弥漫着对德国的恐惧。
target_text: The Molotov-Ribbentrop Treaty confirms many of the doubts of the Italian public about Germany, and the Italian public is not interested in any diplomatic alliance with Germany. Such diplomatic betrayal, combined with the ultimate defeat of the Axis in the Second World War, spread fear of Germany in Italian literature and popular culture at the end of the Second World War.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在日本人看来，《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》违反了《反共产国际条约》，因为德国没有向日本透露其与苏联的谈判。随后，日本人寻求解决苏日边境战争，放弃了对苏联的任何领土野心。日本主要打算将《反共产国际公约》针对苏联而不是英国，而《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫公约》则明确表示，至少在1939年，德国愿意援助苏联，损害西方民主国家的利益。为了应对德国外交政策的急剧变化和日本在边境冲突中败给苏联，平沼政府辞职了。
target_text: In the Japanese’s view, the Molotov-Ribbentrop Treaty violates the International Treaty against Communism, because Germany did not disclose to Japan its negotiations with the Soviet Union. Subsequently, the Japanese sought a solution to the Soviet border war and abandoned any territorial ambitions against the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 里宾特洛甫试图赢得日本对他与德国、意大利、日本和苏联四国集团的支持。德国外交部长辩称，如果东京和莫斯科与柏林和罗马组成军事联盟，日本可以自由地将注意力转向收购欧洲在东南亚的殖民地。然而，意识形态上的障碍太大，让日本领导层感到不安，里宾特洛甫未能迫使他们与苏联结盟。他还主动提出担任日本和苏联之间的谈判代表，但在没有德国监督的情况下，双方开始务实地以双边方式结束分歧，这再次遭到了双方的冷遇。外交改组的结果是，日本退出了里宾特洛甫的反英计划。里宾特洛甫的亲日外交，尽管德国外交部自1934年以来最初对中国持好感，但他一直在推行，现在却遭遇了纳粹掌权以来德国和日本之间最大的外交距离。
target_text: The German Foreign Minister argued that if a military alliance between Tokyo and Moscow were formed with Berlin and Rome, Japan would be free to turn its attention to the acquisition of European colonies in South-East Asia. However, the ideological hurdles were too great for the Japanese leadership to force them to join the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在日本改变对苏战争的态度之后，苏日经济关系有所改善。1939年10月，外交部商务局的松米沙石高和苏联外交部长莫洛托夫表示，双方都有兴趣改善日苏贸易关系。两国同意更永久地解决日本在苏联水域捕鱼和在满洲国支付中国东部铁路费用的问题。苏联承诺，作为这些交易的一部分，收到的大量资金将重新投资于购买日本商品。
target_text: In October 1939, the Foreign Ministry’s Department of Commerce, Shomishaka, and Soviet Foreign Minister Molotov expressed a mutual interest in improving Japan’s trade relations. The two countries agreed to resolve more permanently the issue of Japan’s fishing in Soviet waters and the payment of railway fees in the eastern part of China in Manchuria. The Soviet Union promised that, as part of these transactions, substantial sums of money would be reinvested in the purchase of Japanese commodities.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 从德苏战争开始，日本对与苏联的战争失去了兴趣，导致日本不愿意开辟第二条对抗苏联的战线来减轻德国的努力，日本认为德国的侵略行为不足以引发该条约。由于《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》，1939年末至1940年夏天，德日关系显著降温，但在1940年德国获胜后，法国和荷兰殖民大国的消灭导致日本对收购相关殖民地感兴趣，再次接近德国。
target_text: From the beginning of the war in Texas, Japan lost interest in the war with the Soviet Union, resulting in Japan’s unwillingness to open a second front against the Soviet Union in order to ease Germany’s efforts, and Japan believes that Germany’s aggression is not enough to trigger the treaty. The German-Japanese relationship cooled significantly between late 1939 and the summer of 1940, but after Germany won in 1940, the disappearance of the French and Dutch colonial powers led to Japan’s interest in the acquisition of the colony in question, again approaching Germany.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
德国在西方军事胜利的影响
1940年3月，约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫再次开始动员意大利、苏联，尤其是日本，以实现他建立四国联盟对抗大英帝国的愿景。1940年6月，德国在“西部战役”中取得压倒性胜利，击败了法国、比利时和荷兰。由于法国中印和荷属东印度群岛现在实际上毫无防御能力，东京政府现在觉得有必要再次与德国进行外交接触，而在德国与苏联交换条件后，东京政府此前曾与德国保持距离。德国人还赢得了日本驻柏林和罗马大使岛博史和白鸟俊夫的一些支持，他们被德国在波兰战役中的成功所左右，开始支持里宾特洛甫的外交议程。
target_text: In March 1940, Joachim von Ribbentrop again mobilized Italy, the Soviet Union, and Japan in particular, to realize his vision of a four-nation alliance against the British Empire. In June 1940, Germany won an overwhelming victory in the Western War, defeating France, Belgium, and the Netherlands. Since France’s Central India and the Netherlands East Indies are now virtually defenseless, the Tokyo government now feels it necessary to renew diplomatic contacts with Germany, which had previously been distant from Germany after the exchange of terms with the Soviet Union.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
三国同盟
德国和日本之间的差异，包括日本在中国的战争、经济差异和莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约，导致德国和日本的距离越来越远。1940年，德国战胜了欧洲盟国，引发了各方和解的愿望。这是1940年9月27日《三方公约》的一部分。然而，日本对德国伙伴的不信任仍然存在，日本避免卷入德国最终的对苏战争，而是完全专注于自己在中国的斗争。在《三方条约》中，德国和意大利承认日本在东亚的领导地位，而日本反过来承认德国和意大利在欧洲的领导地位。
target_text: The differences between Germany and Japan, including Japan’s war in China, economic differences, and the Molotov-Ribbentrop Treaty, have led to a further distance between Germany and Japan. In 1940, Germany won over European allies, triggering a desire for reconciliation among the parties. This is part of the Tripartite Convention of 27 September 1940. Japan’s distrust of its German partners persists.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
公约的延期
《反共产国际公约》原定于1941年11月25日续签，因为自1936年11月15日起的五年期限即将到期。德国的主要目标之一是与日本保持密切联系，并鼓励日本站在德国一边干预德苏战争，但日本在战争的剩余时间里拒绝这样做。1941年4月签署的《苏日中立条约》将持续到1945年8月，当时苏联违反了该条约并入侵了日本满洲。
target_text: One of Germany's main objectives was to maintain close contact with Japan and to encourage Japan to intervene in the war in Texas on its side, but Japan refused to do so for the remainder of the war. The Soviet neutrality treaty, signed in April 1941, would last until August 1945, when the Soviet Union violated the treaty and invaded Manchuria, Japan.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
罗马尼亚
罗马尼亚是德国在对苏战争中最重要的军事伙伴，但其德国伙伴几乎没有积极赢得这种忠诚。德国在罗马尼亚接连遭受了三次领土损失，第一次在《莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约》中将比萨拉比亚地区授予苏联，然后作为第二次维也纳条约的一部分将特兰西瓦尼亚地区的大部分地区授予匈牙利，最后作为《克雷奥瓦条约》的一部分批准保加利亚在多布鲁亚地区的领土收益。罗马尼亚在法西斯铁卫队的领导下，其主要敌人不仅在苏联，而且在轴心国中，尤其是匈牙利。尽管如此，在领土损失之前曾主张亲德立场的铁卫队现在认为，与德国结盟是避免德国再次干预罗马尼亚并支持匈牙利的唯一途径。因此，罗马尼亚于1941年11月25日加入《反共产国际公约》，是为了取悦德国伙伴，推进罗马尼亚对苏联的战役，希望夺回比萨拉比亚，并在苏联乌克兰获得领土。
target_text: Romania is Germany’s most important military partner in the Soviet Union, but its German partner has barely actively won this loyalty. Germany has suffered three consecutive territorial losses in Romania, awarding the Bisalabia region to the Soviet Union for the first time in the Molotov-Ribendlov Treaty, then, as part of the second Vienna Treaty, to Hungary, and finally ratifying Bulgaria’s territorial gains in the Dobroia region as part of the Creova Treaty. Romania, under the leadership of the Fascist Iron Guard, is primarily an enemy not only in the Soviet Union, but also in the Axis, Hungary.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
斯洛伐克
斯洛伐克于1939年在德国煽动捷克斯洛伐克解体后成立，于1941年11月25日加入了《反共产国际公约》。建议的成员资格
1936年至1945年间，轴心国利用《反共产国际公约》作为外交工具来增加其政治和外交影响力，但往往没有成功。阿根廷、巴西和智利
德国曾努力让由阿根廷、巴西和智利组成的南美ABC Staaten（“ABC国家”）加入该协议。
target_text: Slovakia, founded in 1939 following Germany’s incitement to the dissolution of Czechoslovakia, acceded to the International Convention against Communism on 25 November 1941. From 1936 to 1945, the Axis countries used the International Convention as a diplomatic tool to increase their political and diplomatic influence, often without success. Argentina, Brazil, and Chile Germany tried to bring ABC Staaten (the “ABC countries”) of South America, composed of Argentina, Brazil and Chile, into the agreement.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 1936年10月12日，Yamaguchi就此事联系了荷兰外交部长Andries Cornelis Dirk de Graeff，但荷兰政府认为自己受到公众舆论的约束，拒绝与日本进行任何外交结盟，de Graeff指出，荷属东印度群岛的共产主义活动并不是迫在眉睫的威胁。然而，为了在亚洲开展反共活动，他至少愿意与日本谈判交换情报。1936年10月24日的第二次会议上，德格拉夫提出，只有荷属东印度群岛才应被纳入任何情报交流，而山口则希望将荷兰大陆纳入其中，以挫败共产国际在阿姆斯特丹的行动（并暗中影响荷兰报纸在报道中减少对日本的批评）。第二天，1936年10月25日，托尼·洛维克就荷兰的一项潜在政策联系了山口，在该政策中，荷属东印度群岛的共产主义以及所有政治意识形态都可以与日本人合作进行镇压和监督。这是许多迹象中的第一个，表明荷兰政府并不太关心对抗共产主义，而是更关心镇压荷属东印度群岛的印尼独立运动。
target_text: On 12 October 1936, Yamaguchi contacted the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, Andrés Cornelis Dirk de Graeff, but the Government of the Netherlands considered itself bound by public opinion and refused to associate itself with any diplomacy with Japan. De Graeff stated that communist activities in the Netherlands East Indies were not an imminent threat. However, in order to carry out anti-communist activities in Asia, he was at least willing to negotiate information exchange with Japan. At the second meeting on 24 October 1936, Degraf suggested that only the Netherlands East Indies should be included in any exchange of information, and Yamaguchi wished to include the Dutch mainland in order to thwart the actions of the Communist International in Amsterdam (and secretly to influence Dutch newspapers in their reports to reduce criticism of Japan).
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
葡萄牙
葡萄牙有兴趣成为可能的成员国，特别是在西班牙加入后。作为仅有的三个在1934年9月18日投票反对苏联加入国际联盟的国家之一（除了荷兰和瑞士），它有着良好的反苏记录。然而，在1934年至1945年德国驻葡萄牙大使奥斯瓦尔德·冯·霍宁根·休恩看来，葡萄牙对英国的经济依赖以及与英国的长期外交联盟使其不太可能接受《反共产国际公约》的邀请。
target_text: Portugal is interested in becoming a possible member, especially after Spain joined. As one of only three countries that voted against the Soviet Union’s accession to the League of Nations on 18 September 1934 (except the Netherlands and Switzerland), it has a good anti-Soviet record.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
英国
英国成员资格是里宾特洛甫在1935年10月为《反共产国际公约》最初设计的一部分。1936年，当约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫成为驻英国大使时，希特勒向他明确表示，欢迎英国加入《反共产国际公约》是他的“最大愿望”。里宾特洛甫对希特勒的野心持怀疑态度，但对国王爱德华八世寄予了一些希望，里宾特洛普认为爱德华八世对德国很友好。1937年11月15日，当被问及英国政府是否收到了《反共产国际公约》的邀请时，外交部副部长罗伯特·加斯科因·塞西尔回答说，没有收到这样的邀请。
target_text: Britain’s British membership was part of the original design of the Anti-Community Convention by Rebintrop in October 1935. In 1936, when Joachim von Ribbentrop became British Ambassador to the United Kingdom, Hitler made it clear to him that welcoming Britain’s accession to the Anti-Community Convention was his “best wish.” Rebintrove had doubts about Hitler’s ambitions, but had some hope for King Edward VIII, who he thought was friendly to Germany. On 15 November 1937, when asked whether the British Government had received an invitation to the Anti-Community Convention, the Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs, Robert Gascoin Cecil, replied that he had not received such an invitation.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text:
历史接受与史学
美国历史学家、伊利诺伊大学名誉教授保罗·W·施罗德在1958年出版的《轴心国联盟与1941年日美关系》一书中将《反共产国际公约》解释为德国和日本的外交声明，该声明没有实际军事价值，“本身几乎没有危险”。施罗德还评论了该协议导致的德日关系相当松散，以及德国和日本对该协议缺乏承诺。施罗德的结论最终认为，《反共产国际公约》延续了自19世纪90年代以来日本外交政策的一种模式，在这种模式中，日本机会主义地抓住了扩张的机会，如1894年第一次中日战争、1904年日俄战争和1915年的21项要求。
target_text: Historic acceptance of the International Convention against Communism was interpreted by Paul W. Schroeder, an American historian and Professor Emeritus at Illinois University in 1958, in the book Axis Union-Japan-United States Relations of 1941, as a diplomatic statement by Germany and Japan, which had no real military value and was “never in itself dangerous.” Schroeder also commented on the rather loose German-Japanese relations resulting from the agreement and the lack of commitment to it by Germany and Japan. Schroeder concluded that the International Convention on Anti-Community had continued a model of Japanese foreign policy since the 1990s, in which Japan had seized opportunities for expansion with opportunism, such as the first Chinese-Japanese war of 1894, the Russian war of 1904 and the 21 demands of 1915.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 作为德国联邦国防军军事史研究室系列《德国与第二次世界大战》的一部分，德国军事历史学家曼弗雷德·梅塞施密特在第一卷《德国侵略的建立》（1990年）中指出，《反共产国际公约》和整个轴心国一样，只是“将不同的政治利益拼凑在一起”。梅塞施密特还评论了希特勒在将意大利或英国纳入条约之间的矛盾心理。关于日本的角色，梅塞施密特和施罗德一样，将《反共产国际公约》视为日本既定政策的延续，但也指出，日本的内部政治机构在日本军队的利益之间存在着巨大分歧，几乎从定义上讲，东京领导层的任何行动都不能被视为整个日本体制的任何统一意见。梅塞施密特也不同意意大利加入该条约必然会给它带来反英的推动力，但意大利的加入首先奠定了该条约的基础。德国和日本的利益差异太大，日本在1937年对华战争开始后的立场太弱，无法对任何敌人、苏联或英国构成威胁。因此，梅塞施密特不同意该协议从反苏变成反英的观点，因为它实际上在1937年6月日本入侵中国时就已经停止了反苏，而不是在同年11月意大利加入该协议时。
target_text: As part of the German Federal Defence Force's series of military history study rooms, Germany and the Second World War, the German military historian Manfred Messechmitt noted in the first volume, The Establishment of German Aggression (1990), that the International Convention against Communism, like the whole axiomatic State, was simply “combining different political interests together.” Messechmitt also commented on the contradictions between Hitler's incorporation of Italy or Britain into the Treaty. With regard to the role of Japan, as well as the differences between Germany and Japan, the position of Japan after the beginning of the War on China in 1937 was too weak to pose a threat to any enemy, the Soviet Union or the United Kingdom.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 英国历史学家伊恩·克肖爵士（Sir Ian Kershaw）在2000年为阿道夫·希特勒（Adolf Hitler）撰写的传记中写道，希特勒批准《反共产国际条约》标志着“世界上两个最军国主义、扩张主义的大国”的外交联盟，但“该条约的象征意义比实际条款更重要”。克肖在对纳粹德国内部权力结构的解释中是“致力于元首”理论的支持者，在这一理论中，希特勒是德国国家的指导思想人物，德国政府内部的所有政治行为者（在《反共产国际公约》中：里宾特洛甫）都试图赢得希特勒的支持，事实上，这位独裁者与政府的日常事务毫不相干。
target_text: The British historian Sir Ian Kershaw wrote in a biography written for Adolf Hitler in 2000 that Hitler's ratification of the International Treaty against Communism marked a diplomatic alliance “two of the world's most militaristic, expansionist Powers”, but that “the symbolism of the Treaty is more important than the actual terms.” In its interpretation of the internal power structure of Nazi Germany, Kshaw was a supporter of the doctrine of “commitment to the Head of State”, in which Hitler was the guiding thinker of the German State, and all political actors within the German Government (in the International Convention against Communism: Ribendrov) tried to win Hitler's support. In fact, the dictator had nothing to do with the day-to-day affairs of the Government.
title: 反共產國際協定

source_text: 在外交方面，贝尔福与其外交大臣兰斯多恩勋爵（Lord Lansdowne）戏剧性地决定要与法国修好，最后在1904年和法国签署了挚诚协定。在这个时期内，日本和俄国之间爆发了战争，而英国作为日本的盟友，在战争的尾声和俄国之间发生了多格灘事件。但贝尔福却忙于国内政务，将外交问题交给了兰斯多恩勋爵。
target_text: On the diplomatic front, Belfort and his Foreign Secretary, Lord Lansdowne, dramatically decided to fix it with France, and finally signed a good-faith agreement with France in 1904. During this period, a war broke out between Japan and Russia, while Britain, as an ally of Japan, witnessed a Dogg Beach incident between the end of the war and Russia.
title: 阿瑟·貝爾福

source_text: 贝尔福自此仍是党内重要人物。1915年5月，自由统一党人获邀加入H·H·阿斯奎斯。贝尔福接替第一海军大臣温斯顿·丘吉尔的职务。1916年12月，阿斯奎斯政府倒台，接替他的是大卫·劳合·乔治。但贝尔福却未因此而退出政府。他留任第一海军大臣几日后，调职外交大臣，但正值一战，战时内阁实际上没有外交大臣的位置。贝尔福经常不能参与政府内部运作。外交大臣任内，贝尔福发表著名的1917年贝尔福宣言。这是一封写给羅斯柴爾德勋爵（Lord Rothschild），他在信中表示支持犹太人在巴勒斯坦建立民族家园。
target_text: In May 1915, the Liberal United Party was invited to join H.H. Asquis. Belfort took over the post of First Navy Secretary Winston Churchill. In December 1916, the Asquis government fell and replaced him by David Lloyd George.
title: 阿瑟·貝爾福

source_text: 1925年签订《苏日基本条约》，日本外交承认苏联并建立大使级外交关系，向苏联归还了北萨哈林岛，远东局势缓和。1926年苏联远东海军撤销，驻扎在海参崴的舰只被划给远东海岸边防部队；则自成红海军的一支舰队，并于1926年9月改称“远东区舰队”。1926年苏联工业产值超过1913年，完成战争创伤恢复。
target_text: In 1925, Japan signed the Basic Treaty of the Sun, diplomatic recognition of the Soviet Union and the establishment of diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level. Japan returned North Sakhalin Island to the Soviet Union, and the situation in the Far East eased. In 1926, the Soviet Far East Navy was withdrawn and the vessels stationed in Vladivostok were assigned to the border guard forces on the Far East coast; it became an autonomous Red Navy fleet, which in September 1926 became known as the Far East Fleet. In 1926, Soviet industrial output exceeded 1913 and war trauma recovery was completed.
title: 太平洋舰队 (俄罗斯)

source_text: 《联合国安理会338号决议》是联合国安全理事会於1973年10月22日在第1747次会议上通过的一项决议，是由美国和苏联联合提案的。该决议要求第四次中东战争有关各方在12小时内在现有阵地上立即停火，并在停火後开始执行联合国安理会242号决议，举行和平谈判。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 338, a resolution adopted by the United Nations Security Council at its 1747th meeting on 22 October 1973 and co-sponsored by the United States and the Soviet Union, calls for an immediate ceasefire on existing positions within 12 hours by all parties involved in the fourth Middle East war, and the commencement of United Nations Security Council resolution 242 after the ceasefire and the holding of peace negotiations.
title: 聯合國安全理事會第338號決議

source_text: 《联合国安理会242号决议》是联合国安全理事会于1967年11月22日在第1382次会议上一致通过的一项决议，是由英国提案的。该决议援引联合国宪章第二条，要求以色列撤离其在第三次中东战争中占领的领土，各方立即停战，并保证苏伊士运河等国际航道的畅通。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 242, which was unanimously adopted by the United Nations Security Council at its 1382nd meeting, on 22 November 1967, was sponsored by the United Kingdom, invoking Article 2 of the Charter of the United Nations, which calls for the withdrawal of Israel from the territories it occupied during the third Middle East war, an immediate truce between the parties and the opening of international shipping routes such as the Suez Canal.
title: 聯合國安全理事會第242號決議

source_text: 《联合国安理会5号决议》是1946年5月8日在联合国安全理事会第40次会议通过的。这个决议是关注伊朗问题的，该决议以10票赞成、1票未投票通过。决议暂缓对苏联军队入侵伊朗问题进行讨论，请伊朗政府查清苏联军队是否已经完全撤离伊朗境内后，不迟于5月20日向安理会提交报告。其后又将讨论日期无限期延迟。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 5 was adopted by the United Nations Security Council at its 40th meeting, on 8 May 1946. The resolution was adopted by 10 votes in favour and 1 vote without a vote. The resolution suspended discussion on the invasion of Iran by Soviet forces and requested the Iranian Government to report to the Council no later than 20 May, after ascertaining whether the Soviet forces had completely withdrawn from Iranian territory.
title: 联合国安全理事会第5号决议

source_text: 《蒙藏條約》（）是外蒙古和西藏第十三世達賴喇嘛派遣的人員在中國辛亥革命後，雙方於1913年1月11日在蒙古庫倫簽訂的條約，互相承認獨立主權地位。但西藏方-{面}-条约签署人的身份受到質疑，从而质疑这条约的有效性，因為藏方的簽約人阿旺德爾智同时具有俄羅斯帝國的布里亚特公民身份，一位受西藏政府信任的貴族認為達賴喇嘛並未授予其代表西藏與蒙古訂約的權力。
target_text: However, the identity of the signatories to the Treaty has been questioned, and the validity of the Treaty has been questioned, since the Tibetan signatory, Awandr Ji, also possesses the citizenship of the Russian Empire, Briat, is believed to have been denied to the Tibetan government by a prominent person trusted by the Tibetan government that the Dalai Lama has not been granted the authority to represent Tibet and Mongolia in its contracts.
title: 蒙藏條約

source_text: 在清朝灭亡之后，西藏和大蒙古國都正式以喇嘛的名义宣布独立，但均未得到当时國際社會包括中华民国的承认。在条约中，蒙古和西藏表示将互相认可并拥护。代表蒙古签署条约的是外务大臣达喇嘛拉布敦以及外务部副大臣达木丁苏隆。西藏方面的代表则是第十三世達賴的助理教師和政治顧問俄籍布里亚特蒙古人阿旺德尔智、阿旺秋增和秘书格登坚参（Gendun-Galsan）。
target_text: After the death of the Qing Dynasty, Tibet and Greater Mongolia officially declared their independence in the name of the Lama, but none of them was recognized by the international community at the time, including the Republic of China. In the treaty, Mongolia and Tibet indicated mutual recognition and support.
title: 蒙藏條約

source_text:
条约內容
条约內容共有九條。
（前言）
蒙古和西藏已經從滿族王朝解放，並從中國分裂出去，成為獨立的國家，而且，鑑於有兩個國家自古以來宣稱信仰同一宗教，以期加強歷史上彼此友誼，外交部長大喇嘛然丁，和助理部長、秘書長达布利特，作為統治蒙古人民的政府的全權代表，與阿旺德尔智、阿旺秋增和秘书格登坚参，作為西藏統治者達賴喇嘛的全權代表，簽訂如下協議：
第一條 西藏的統治者達賴喇嘛批准和承認蒙古成為一個獨立的國家，以及信仰黃教的哲布尊丹巴喇嘛在豬年十一月九日宣稱成為該國的統治者。
第二條 蒙古人民的統治者丹巴喇嘛批准和承認西藏成為一個獨立的國家，以及達賴喇嘛宣布為西藏的統治者。
target_text: (Preamble) Mongolia and Tibet have been liberated from the Mandang dynasty and separated from China as independent states, and have signed the following agreements: The first Tibetan ruler, Dalai Lama, has approved and recognized Mongolia as an independent state, and the yellow religion, Jebsundamba Lama, has declared itself the ruler of Tibet on 9 November. Second, the ruler of the people of Mongolia, Danbala, has approved and recognized Tibet as an independent state, and the Dalai Lama has declared itself the ruler of Tibet.
title: 蒙藏條約

source_text:
条约有效性的爭議
當時许多人对这一条约的有效性持怀疑态度。十三世达赖喇嘛尽管謹請其努力為佛教謀利益，但未曾授权阿旺德尔智与蒙古进行磋商谈判。更重要的是，无论当时的西藏政府或者是藏传佛教的神职人员都似乎从未对这一条约表示认可。而俄国政府则表示，身为布里亚特人，阿旺德尔智是俄国的臣民，因此他无法以达赖喇嘛代表的身份参与外交事务。藏學家則主張阿旺德尔智確實獲得达赖喇嘛授權簽約，簽約的其他藏人也是已經在蒙古的西藏官員，否則他在條約本文中不會自稱全權使者。达赖喇嘛不承認的原因，可能是為了平息英國擔憂俄國因此干涉西藏的顧慮。
target_text: More importantly, neither the Tibetan government at the time nor the Tibetan Buddhist clerics seemed to have endorsed the treaty. The Russian government, for its part, said that, as a Briat, Avandel was a Russian subject, he could not participate in foreign affairs as a representative of the Dalai Lama.
title: 蒙藏條約

source_text:
签署之后
关于这一条约的新闻使得参与西姆拉会议的英国谈判者们担心，俄罗斯可能试图借此机会获得在西藏事务上的影响力。同时，虽然中国最终没有签署《西姆拉条约》，蒙古、中华民国政府和俄罗斯还是于1915年5月25日签署了类似的《中俄蒙協約》。这一条约承认了蒙古在国家内政上的完全自治以及俄罗斯在蒙古的特权，同时也正式承认了中国对蒙古的宗主权。
target_text: After the signing of the treaty, the British negotiators at the Simla Conference feared that Russia might try to take this opportunity to gain influence over Tibetan affairs. Meanwhile, Mongolia, the Government of the Republic of China, and Russia signed a similar Treaty between China and Russia on 25 May 1915, although China did not finally sign the Treaty.
title: 蒙藏條約

source_text: 联合国安理会6号决议是1946年5月17日在联合国安全理事会第42次会议一致通过的。该决议援引《联合国宪章》第四条，规定了新成员国欲加入联合国需向联合国秘书长提出申请，经过安理会审查推荐，联合国大会表决通过后方得以加入。该决议规定安理会将从1946年8月开始审查新入会申请。
target_text: Resolution 6 of the United Nations Security Council, adopted unanimously on 17 May 1946 at the 42nd meeting of the United Nations Security Council, which, invoking Article 4 of the Charter of the United Nations, requires new Member States to apply to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for admission to membership in the United Nations and, following a review and recommendation by the Council, the General Assembly of the United Nations may accede to the resolution, which provides that the Council will review the new membership application from August 1946.
title: 联合国安全理事会第6号决议

source_text:
《联合国安理会7号决议》是1946年6月26日在联合国安全理事会第49次会议上通过的。这个决议是关注西班牙问题的，该决议的草案进行了分段表决，未进行全文表决。决议继续谴责西班牙的弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥政权，决定继续关注西班牙局势。相关决议
联合国安理会4号决议
target_text: Resolution 7 of the United Nations Security Council, adopted on 26 June 1946 at the 49th meeting of the United Nations Security Council, concerned with Spain, the draft resolution was voted on separately and without a vote in its entirety. The resolution continues to condemn the Spanish regime of Francisco Franco and decides to remain seized of the situation in Spain.
title: 联合国安全理事会第7号决议

source_text:

The resolution decided to recommend Afghanistan, Iceland and Sweden to the United Nations following a review of applications for admission to the United Nations by Albania, Mongolia, Afghanistan, Jordan, Ireland, Portugal, Iceland, Siam and Sweden.

source_text: 《联合国安理会12号决议》是1946年12月10日在联合国安全理事会第82次会议上通过的。这个决议是关注希腊问题的，该决议以分段表决通过，全文未付诸表决。决议决定邀请希腊和南斯拉夫代表参加安理会就希腊问题进行的讨论，但无表决权，同时邀请保加利亚和阿尔巴尼亚代表向安理会发表声明，如果安理会认为两国的主张属于希腊问题的一部分，则将邀请两国代表参与讨论，但无表决权。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 12, adopted on 10 December 1946 at the 82nd meeting of the United Nations Security Council, concerned with the question of Greece, was adopted without a vote as a whole and decided to invite the representatives of Greece and Yugoslavia to participate in the discussion of the question of Greece in the Council without the right to vote, while inviting the representatives of Bulgaria and Albania to make statements to the Council and to invite the representatives of both countries to participate in the discussion, without the right to vote, if the Council considers that their claims are part of the Greek question.
title: 联合国安全理事会第12号决议

source_text: 《联合国安理会15号决议》是1946年12月19日在联合国安全理事会第87次会议上一致通过的。这个决议是关注希腊问题的。决议援引《联合国宪章》第34条，决定设立一个调查团，就希腊与南斯拉夫、阿尔巴尼亚和保加利亚之间发生的互相越界行为进行调查，由1947年安理会各成员国各派一名代表组成，上述四国各派一名联络员协助调查团工作。
target_text: Resolution 15 of the United Nations Security Council, which was unanimously adopted on 19 December 1946 at the 87th meeting of the United Nations Security Council, concerns Greece. Invoking Article 34 of the Charter of the United Nations, the resolution decided to establish a fact-finding mission to investigate cross-border acts between Greece and Yugoslavia, Albania and Bulgaria, consisting of a representative of each of the States members of the Council in 1947, with the assistance of a liaison officer from each of the above-mentioned four States.
title: 联合国安全理事会第15号决议

target_text: Resolution 16 of the United Nations Security Council was adopted on 10 January 1947 at the 91st meeting of the United Nations Security Council. The resolution was adopted by 10 votes in favour, with 1 abstention, on the Trieste Free Zone. The resolution established the Trieste Free Zone and approved its Charter, Permanent Statute and Charter of the Freeport.

source_text: 联合国安理会17号决议是于1947年2月10日在联合国安全理事会第101次会议上通过的。该决议是关于希腊问题的，以9票赞成，2票弃权通过。决议表示，依照联合国安理会15号决议设立的国际调查团无权干涉希腊、南斯拉夫、阿尔巴尼亚和保加利亚四个当事国的司法，不得制止希腊法院的死刑判决，但是可以根据调查需要，提出提审相关被判死刑人员以协助调查的要求。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 17, which was adopted on 10 February 1947 at the 101st meeting of the United Nations Security Council on the question of Greece, was adopted by 9 votes in favour, with 2 abstentions. The resolution states that the international fact-finding mission established in accordance with Security Council resolution 15 does not have the authority to interfere in the justice of the four States parties to Greece, Yugoslavia, Albania and Bulgaria, nor may it put an end to the death sentences handed down by Greek courts, but may, depending on the need for an investigation, make a request for the trial of persons sentenced to death to assist in the investigation.
title: 联合国安全理事会第17号决议

source_text: 决议决定对各国裁军情况建立国际管制制度，尽速审议国际原子能委员会报告书。另外，该决议决定由安理会各理事国组成常规军备委员会，在三个月内就各国裁军情况和如何有效保障各国裁军，向安理会提交提案。该决议还提请联合国军事参谋团在1947年4月30日前提出关于建立联合国军队的基本原则。
target_text: The resolution decided to establish an international control regime over the disarmament of States and to consider expeditiously the report of the International Atomic Energy Commission. In addition, the resolution decided that the members of the Council would constitute the Committee on Conventional Arms and would submit proposals to the Council within three months on the disarmament of States and on how to effectively ensure their disarmament. The resolution also requested the United Nations Military Staff Committee to submit, by 30 April 1947, basic principles for the establishment of a United Nations military force.
title: 联合国安全理事会第18号决议

source_text: 《联合国安理会19号决议》是于1947年2月27日在联合国安全理事会第114次会议上通过的。该决议是关于科孚海峡问题的，以8票赞成，3票弃权通过。决议决定就科孚海峡问题成立一个三人国际委员会进行调查，在3月10日前提供报告。争端双方英国和阿尔巴尼亚需对此国际委员会提供协助。
target_text: Resolution 19 of the United Nations Security Council, adopted at the 114th meeting of the United Nations Security Council on 27 February 1947, on the Corfu Channel, was adopted by 8 votes in favour, with 3 abstentions. The resolution decided to establish a three-member International Commission on the Corfu Channel to investigate and provide a report by 10 March.
title: 联合国安全理事会第19号决议

《联合国安理会20号决议》是于1947年3月10日在联合国安全理事会第117次会议上一致通过的。决议表示已经审议了国际原子能委员会提交的报告，各国表示初步同意，请原子能委员会尽速草拟关于国际原子能管制方面的国际公约，提交安理会审议。1947年聯合國安全理事會決議

source_text: 决议决定将原在日本受国际联盟委任统治下的赤道以北太平洋上诸岛屿委托美国进行管理，美国对这些岛屿享有行政、立法和司法全权，并可在岛上推行美国法律并建立军事基地。但统治方须按照《联合国宪章》第83条的要求，逐渐促进这些岛屿向自治或独立发展，并保证岛民享有一系列的自由权利。管理当局还应保证联合国各会员国以及其国民在这些岛屿上享有平等权利（管理者本身不在其列）。
target_text: The resolution decided that the islands of the North Pacific Ocean, formerly under Japan’s League of Nations mandate, should be entrusted with the administration of the United States, which has executive, legislative and judicial authority over the islands and may introduce United States laws and establish military bases on the islands, provided that the governing parties progressively promote the autonomous or independent development of the islands and guarantee the islanders a range of rights of freedom, as required by Article 83 of the Charter of the United Nations. The regulatory authorities should also guarantee equal rights to the States Members of the United Nations and their nationals on those islands (the administrators themselves are not among them).
title: 联合国安全理事会第21号决议

source_text: 《联合国安理会22号决议》是于1947年4月9日在联合国安全理事会第127次会议上通过的。该决议是关于科孚海峡问题的，以8票赞成，2票弃权，1票未投票（英国）通过。决议审议了英国指控其军舰在科孚海峡遭到阿尔巴尼亚铺设的水雷炸伤一案，建议争端双方将此案提交国际法院进行判决。
target_text: Resolution 22 of the United Nations Security Council, adopted on 9 April 1947 at the 127th meeting of the United Nations Security Council, on the Corfu Channel, was adopted by 8 votes in favour, with 2 abstentions, without a vote (United Kingdom). The resolution considered the case of the United Kingdom alleging that its warship had been injured by mines laid by Albania in the Corfu Channel and recommended that the parties to the dispute refer the case to the International Court of Justice for a decision.
title: 联合国安全理事会第22号决议

source_text: 联合国安理会23号决议是于1947年4月18日在联合国安全理事会第131次会议上通过的。该决议是关于希腊问题的，以9票赞成，2票弃权通过。决议决定在希腊和北部诸国边境地区留下一个辅助调查团，接替原调查团的职能。辅助调查团的团员由调查团的团员以一对一的方法委托任命。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 23, which was adopted on 18 April 1947 at the 131st meeting of the United Nations Security Council on the question of Greece, was adopted by 9 votes in favour, with 2 abstentions. The resolution decided to leave the border areas of Greece and the northern countries behind a subsidiary mission to take over the functions of the original mission. The members of the auxiliary mission were appointed on a one-to-one basis by the members of the mission.
title: 联合国安全理事会第23号决议

target_text: Resolution 27 of the United Nations Security Council, adopted on 1 August 1947 at the 173rd meeting of the United Nations Security Council, on the question of Indonesia, adopted without a vote in its entirety. The resolution calls upon both the Netherlands and Indonesia to cease hostilities immediately and to settle disputes through international arbitration or other peaceful means.
title: 联合国安全理事会第27号决议

source_text: 联合国安理会28号决议是于1947年8月6日在联合国安全理事会第177次会议上通过的。该决议是关于希腊问题的，以10票赞成，1票弃权通过。决议决定设立一个小组委员会，由曾对希腊问题提出过议案或者修正案的成员国组成，以研究新的提案供安理会讨论通过。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 28, which was adopted on 6 August 1947 at the 177th meeting of the United Nations Security Council on the question of Greece, was adopted by 10 votes in favour, with 1 abstention, and decided to establish a subcommittee composed of Member States that had submitted proposals or amendments to the question of Greece to study new proposals for adoption by the Council.
title: 联合国安全理事会第28号决议

source_text: 联合国安理会30号决议是于1947年8月25日在联合国安全理事会第194次会议上通过的。该决议是关于印度尼西亚问题的，以7票赞成，4票弃权通过。决议赞赏冲突双方荷兰和印度尼西亚尊重联合国安理会27号决议，均声称已经停火的行为。并决定应两国政府要求，请安理会成员国驻巴达维亚的外交人员会同拟就当地局势报告，以供安理会讨论时参考。
target_text: United Nations Security Council resolution 30, which was adopted on 25 August 1947 at the 194th meeting of the United Nations Security Council on the question of Indonesia, was adopted by 7 votes in favour, with 4 abstentions. It commended the two parties to the conflict, the Netherlands and Indonesia, for respecting United Nations Security Council resolution 27, which claimed that a ceasefire had been established, and decided, at the request of both Governments, to request diplomatic personnel of Council members in Badavía to cooperate with the preparation of a report on the situation on the ground for the Council ' s consideration.
title: 联合国安全理事会第30号决议

联合国安理会32号决议是于1947年8月26日在联合国安全理事会第195次会议上通过的。该决议是关于印度尼西亚问题的，以10票赞成，1票弃权通过。决议指出印尼境内的军事冲突实际仍在进行，敦促冲突双方荷兰和印尼尊重联合国安理会27号决议，立即停火。1947年聯合國安全理事會決議
