source_text: 与此同时，2008年8月8日，第29届奥林匹克运动会在北京开幕，东道主中国以51枚金牌位居金牌榜首位。借助北京奥运会，中国展示了经济发展的成绩、自信以及史无前例的开放心态，大规模的基础建设也极大改观了北京这座城市的面貌，政府与公众在奥运会这个舞台上取得了高度的统一，公众也表现出对政府少有的包容和支持。2010年5月1日至10月31日，上海世界博览会举行，是中国首次举办的综合性世界博览会，也是首次由发展中国家主办综合性世博会，共有256个国家和地区及国际组织参展。
target_text: At the same time, on 8 August 2008, the 29th Olympic Games opened in Beijing, hosting China with 51 gold medals. With the Beijing Olympic Games, China demonstrated economic development achievements, self-confidence, and unprecedented openness.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 香港在1997年回歸中國後，由於亞洲金融風暴和一系列的經濟、政治難題的影響，當2003年初港府宣佈將就基本法第23條有關顛覆罪立法時，引起許多人的反對。部分香港人認為，23條立法是行政長官董建華受命於中央政府而做出的決定，他們擔心立法會限制到港人的政治自由。港府做出多項讓步，但是還是無法平息爭議，最終在7月1日回歸紀念日當天，50萬市民走上街頭抗議立法，該事件也引起中央政府的關切，遊行最終導致香港政府宣佈擱置立法計劃。
target_text: After returning to China in 1997, as a result of the Asian financial turmoil and a series of economic and political difficulties, Hong Kong’s announcement in early 2003 that it would enact legislation on article 23 of the Basic Law relating to offences was met with opposition from many people. Some Hong Kongers argued that 23 pieces of legislation were the decision of the Executive Chairman, who had been appointed by the central government to create China, were concerned that legislation would restrict political freedom for Hong Kongers. The Hong Kong government made many concessions, but it was still unable to resolve the controversy, finally on the day of its return to Hong Kong on 1 July, when 500,000 citizens came back to the streets to protest the law.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 在七一大遊行後，香港民主派開始更積極要求政治改革，他們公開提出，要2007年特首直選、2008年立法會全面直選。中國政府始終堅持香港是中國的內政，反對外國政府干預內部事務。中國政府的立場是，「一國兩制」應以「一國」為先，中國是單一制社會主義國家，香港作為中國的一部分，沒有權利自行改變政治體制。2004年4月，全國人大常委會對《香港基本法》做出解釋，否決2007年特首和2008年立法會直選，並重申解釋和修改基本法的權力在全國人大，而不是香港立法會。
target_text: After seven major marches, Hong Kong’s democracy began to press for political reform, and they openly proposed that Hong Kong’s Basic Law be interpreted by the Standing Committee of the People’s Republic of China in April 2004 to reject the 2007 Prime Minister’s and 2008 Legislative Assembly’s direct election, and to reaffirm that the power to interpret and amend the Basic Law is vested in the People’s Republic of China, rather than in the Hong Kong Legislative Council.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2005年全国“兩會”期間，董建華以健康原因辭去香港特別行政區行政長官的職務，由於《香港基本法》的疏漏，特首的補選開始成為一個爭議的焦點，香港特區政府再度要求全國人大常委會釋法，期間曾蔭權代理香港特別行政區行政長官。然後，再由中央指定的選舉委員會補選特首。
target_text: During the 2005 National “Both Council” period, Dong Jianhua resigned from his post as Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for health reasons, due to the omission of the Hong Kong Basic Law, and the Special Chief Executive's election has begun to be the focus of a controversy. The Hong Kong Special District Government has again called for a release law from the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NCC), during which time he had the right to act as Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2009年7月5日，新疆乌鲁木齐市维吾尔族发动游行示威活动，随后演变成维吾尔族、汉族和警方的大规模暴力冲突，持续数日。官方宣称乌鲁木齐七五事件共造成197人死亡，另有1721人受伤。2009年9月2日至4日，针对汉族平民的500余起针扎事件引发汉族民众上街游行，并发生零星暴力事件，导致5人死亡及14人受伤。
target_text: On 5 July 2009, a demonstration by the Uighur community in the city of Xinjiang, Urumqi, later turned into large-scale violent clashes between the Uighurs, Han and the police, which continued for several days. Officially claimed that the Urumqi 75 had killed 197 people and injured 172 others. From 2 to 4 September 2009, more than 500 pinzats targeting the Han civilian population triggered street marches and sporadic violence, resulting in 5 deaths and 14 injuries.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2005年、2010年全国多个地区爆发大规模反日示威活动。2005年3月至4月其间在中国各地举行的一系列大型游行和抗议活动，主要是反对历史教科书和日本争取成为联合国安理会常任理事国的努力。2010年10月，因中日撞船事件，西安、成都、郑州、宁波等地举行反日示威游行活动。 2012年8月中旬开始，为抗议日本于2012年上半年提出的钓鱼岛国有化政策、8月15日扣押香港保钓人士和8月19日日本右翼登陆钓鱼岛。9月10日，日本政府正式“购买”钓鱼岛后，中国大陆民众发起第二轮游行抗议活动，最终演变成暴力民众对日系商家、私家车的烧抢打砸。针对日本政府“购买”钓鱼岛，胡锦涛政府表示坚决反对，认为日方采取任何方式‘购岛’都是非法的、无效的，并采取了一系列反制措施。
target_text: In response to Japan’s policy of nationalization of the fishing islands in the first half of 2012, the detention of Hong Kong bailiffs on 15 August and Japan’s right-wing landing on the islands on 19 August 2005, the Chinese government launched a second round of protests in October 2010 in the wake of the China-Japan ship crash, which culminated in violent looting of Japanese businesses and private cars. The Hu Jintao government, in response to the Japanese government’s “buying” of the fishing islands, expressed its strong opposition to the illegal and ineffective purchase of the islands and adopted a series of counter-measures.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2010年10月25日，挪威诺贝尔委员会将诺贝尔和平奖授予中国持不同政见者刘晓波，以表彰他长期以来以非暴力方式在中国争取基本人权。刘晓波成为第一个获得诺贝尔奖的中华人民共和国公民，他曾发起并参与起草了《零八宪章》。但他在2008年12月8日被以“涉嫌煽动颠覆国家政权罪”刑事拘留，12月9日被监视居住；2009年6月23日因涉嫌煽动颠覆国家政权罪，经中国检察机关批准逮捕；12月25日，北京市第一中级人民法院以煽动颠覆国家政权罪判处有期徒刑11年，剥夺政治权利两年。
target_text: On 25 October 2010, the Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to Liu Xiaobo, a Chinese dissident, in recognition of his long-standing non-violent struggle for fundamental human rights in China. Liu Xiaobo was the first Nobel Prize-winning citizen of the People's Republic of China to initiate and participate in the drafting of the Eighth Charter. He was held in criminal detention on 8 December 2008 on suspicion of “incitement to subversion of State power” and was under surveillance on 9 December; arrested on 23 June 2009 on suspicion of inciting subversion of State power with the approval of the Chinese prosecution authorities; and, on 25 December, the Beijing city's First Intermediate People's Court sentenced him to 11 years' imprisonment and two years' deprivation of political rights for inciting subversion of State power.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 随着中国互联网的快速发展，信息的自由传播对中共维持执政地位构成挑战。为了应对来自网络发展形成的影响，中国建立世界上最为先进的网络审查制度，审查中国大陆的互联网内容，封锁服务器位于境外的政治敏感类网站，以达到其舆论控制的目的。谷歌、雅虎等公司退出中国大陆市场。此外，中国政府开始雇佣大量网络评论员（俗称“五毛党”）来控制舆论导向。2011年，国家的“维稳”经费预算首次超越军费预算。与此同时，中国官场开始涌现大量“裸官”，许多中央高层的子女或亲属移民海外或拥有外国绿卡。
target_text: In response to the impact of Internet development, China has set up the most advanced Internet censorship system in the world, examining Internet content on mainland China, blocking servers in politically sensitive types of sites outside China to achieve its control of public opinion. Google, Yahoo, and other companies have withdrawn from mainland China.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 美国《大观（Parade）》杂志认为以胡锦涛总书记为首的中国共产党领导层控制国内舆论，并强行镇压被中共官方所认定的邪教组织，故该杂志在其2005年的“十大独裁者排名”栏目中将胡锦涛列为第四名，2006年降调第六，其后数年均名列十名内。无国界记者指责胡锦涛以“和谐社会”为借口阻止中国出现自由媒体，把胡锦涛列入“新闻自由掠夺者”名单。2012年，“无国界记者”报道，中共中央总书记胡锦涛下令囚禁68名网民和30名记者，是囚禁新闻自由捍卫者最多的领导人之一。
target_text: Since the US magazine Parade considered the leadership of the Communist Party of China, headed by General Secretary Hu Jintao, to control domestic public opinion and to forcibly suppress cult organizations identified by the Chinese Communist Party, the magazine ranked Hu Jintao fourth in its 2005 “Ten dictators rankings” and sixth in 2006, with 10 rankings in subsequent years. Reporters without Borders accused Hu Jintao of using the pretext of “harmonizing society” as a pretext to prevent free media in China, including Hu Jintao as a “press freedom predator.” In 2012, “Reporters without Borders” reported that the Central Communist Party's General Secretary Hu Jintao had ordered the imprisonment of 68 Internet users and 30 journalists, and that he was one of the top leaders of the press freedom defenders.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 此外，温家宝有相当多争议和批评，有人称其为“中国影帝温家宝”，也有媒体称其为1949年以来中国最具争议的总理。其争议性主要集中于地质学出身且没有丰富的地方主政经验，被称为经济门外汉，譬如其任内提出的“四万亿投资计划”引发争议。虽然其任内中国GDP高速增长，但应归功于中国自1980年代以来的改革开放的惯性推动，特别是在加入世贸组织后使中国处于国际阶梯上有利位置造就的。然而科技创新对中国GDP的贡献率只占40%（2011年），美德日等国则高达80%以上。截止2012年，“财富世界500强”企业中，中国上榜排名靠前企业全是石油、电力和银行等垄断行业，美国则多为科技企业。经济学家茅于轼认为温家宝政府只注重GDP数量，不注重GDP质量。在个人品行方面，温家宝被指曾出卖赵紫阳，且惯于伪装、作秀和煽情，《纽约时报》则曝光其拥有巨额家族财富。
target_text: In addition, Wen Jiabao’s high rate of growth in China’s GDP since the 1980’s has been due to China’s inertia in reforming and opening up, particularly in China’s position on the international ladder following its accession to the WTO. Yet technological innovation has contributed only 40% to China’s GDP (2011) and countries such as Meditation Day have more than 80%.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 胡錦濤、溫家寶等領導人在2012年11月的中共十八大上退出中央領導層，由習近平按现有接班体制接任中国共产党中央委员会总书记和中国共产党中央军事委员会主席，李克強留任中共中央政治局常委。习近平是第一位出生于中华人民共和国建国后的最高领导人。国务院总理李克强被认为重视改革，其谈到改革是最大的红利，提倡进行政府体制改革，调整或裁减国务院的部门。
target_text: Xi was the first leader of the Central Political Bureau of the Chinese Communist Party. Premier Li Keqiang of the State Council was considered to be the highest priority for reform, and he spoke of reform as the biggest dividend, advocating government reform and restructuring or downsizing the State Council.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2012年，中共中央总书记习近平提出《中央八项规定》等一系列反腐败措施。王岐山担任中纪委书记一職後，在處理貪污腐敗方面採取積極的態度，提出“当前要以治标为主，为治本赢得时间”。在接下来的两年时间中，共计有18万官员被查处，其中有五十多位省部級以上的高官，包括前政治局常委周永康、前军委副主席徐才厚、前统战部部长令计划、前全国政协副主席苏荣等国家级高官，表明中央反腐工作有一定的成效。但有学者和分析人士认为，习近平的反腐运动其实是一种“选择性反腐”或“大清洗”或“权力斗争”，目的是清除异己、打击政敌、掌握权力、巩固自身地位。
target_text: In 2012, the Central Secretary of the Communist Party Xi Jinping proposed a series of anti-corruption measures, such as the Central Eight Rules. Wang Xiaoshan, after assuming the post of Secretary of the Central Committee, took a proactive approach to tackling corruption and corruption, suggesting that “the time is now to be spent on tackling it.” Over the next two years, a total of 180,000 officials, including more than 50 senior provincial officials, including the former Political Board Standing Committee, Zhou Yongkang, the former Vice-President of the Military Commission, Xu Jianhong, the former Minister of the Interior, the former Vice-President of the National Political Consultative Council, and senior national officials such as the former Vice-President of the National Political Consultative Council, have shown that the central anti-corruption effort has been effective.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2013年11月，习近平等人开始推动“全面深化改革”、国家治理体系和治理能力现代化，习认为，在全面深化改革进程中，要积极稳妥推进政治体制改革，以保证人民当家作主为根本，以增强党和国家活力、调动人民积极性为目标，不断建设社会主义政治文明。与此同时，中国共产党全力加大了对国有企业和民营企业的控制力度。至少有288家公司修改了公司章程，这使得中国共产党在企业的管理上拥有量更大的影响力，反映了党的路线。中国官方认为，从邓小平等人提倡的政治体制改革，到习近平等人提出的政改，是“政治体制改革在深化”、“走出了新路”、“硕果累累”。而外界和部分体制内人士则认为习的政改路线并没有遵循邓的政治体制改革道路，且改变了改革开放以来进行的政治体制改革方向，推行个人崇拜，是政治倒退，重新回到了毛泽东时代的体制，即中国共产党最高领导人独揽大权的政治寡头统治以及“党领导一切”的模式。
target_text: At the same time, the Communist Party of China has made every effort to increase its control over State-owned and private enterprises. At least 288 companies have amended their statutes, giving the Communist Party greater influence in the management of their businesses and reflecting the party's path.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 经济民生方面，2015年，中国政府结束了自1979年以来实施的一胎政策，改为二胎政策，并在2021年实施更为开放的三胎政策。2017年3月，中国国务院总理李克强在召开的第十二届全国人大五次会议上的《政府工作报告》中，正式提出建设“粤港澳大湾区”的战略；与此同时，2017年4月，雄安新区成立。李克强提出要推动中国内地与香港、澳门特区的深化合作，研究和制定粤港澳大湾区发展规划，以香港和澳门的独特优势，提升中国的经济发展。粤港澳大湾区是由围绕珠江三角洲伶仃洋，包括香港、澳门、广州、深圳、珠海、佛山、中山、东莞、肇庆、惠州和江门的城市群组成，是继美国纽约都会区、美国旧金山湾区和日本东京都市圈之后，世界第四大湾区。2018年9月23日，广深港高铁香港段正式通车，香港纳入国家高铁网络；2018年10月24日，港珠澳大桥正式通车。
target_text: In March 2017, Premier Li Keqiang of the State Council officially proposed a strategy for the construction of the “Hong Kong Territory” in his Government's Report on the Work of the Twelfth National People's Congress; in April 2017, the Yu An Xin District was established. Li Qiang proposed to promote further cooperation between the Mainland and Hong Kong, the Macao SAR, and to study and formulate a development plan for Hong Kong and Macao, with a view to enhancing China's economic development in view of the unique advantages of Hong Kong and Macao. The Hong Kong Territory was incorporated into the National Telecommunications Network in Hong Kong, Macao, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chuhai, Fushan, China Shan, Dongshan, Hoang, Zhaoqing, Hue State and Jiangmen, following the United States Metropolitan Area of New York, San Francisco Bay of the United States, and Tokyo Metropolitan Area of Japan.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 此外，以习近平为首的中国共产党加强了对社会意识形态方面的管控。2017年10月18日，习近平在中共十九大报告中提出《习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想》，24日，中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会通过了关于《中国共产党章程（修正案）》的决议，习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想写入党章。2019年2月，中国官方媒体新华社引述中共中央报刊《求是》报道称，中共中央总书记习近平在中央全面依法治国委员会首次会议上发言，指出必须坚持加强党对依法治国的领导，决不能走宪政、三权分立和司法独立的路。2021年11月11日，中國共產黨第十九屆中央委員會一致通過《关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议》，主要阐述习近平领导的中國共產黨在十八大以来的成就，強調中国特色社会主义新时代，同時注重銜接分別在1945年和1981年通過的兩份關於歷史問題的決議。
target_text: In addition, the Communist Party of China, headed by Xi Jinping, strengthened its control over the ideology of society. On 18 October 2017, Xi Jinping, in the 19th session of the Central Committee for the Rule of Law, introduced the Xi Jinping Socialist Thoughts of the Chinese Character in the Xi Jinping New Age. On 24 October, the nineteenth National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party adopted a resolution on the Constitution of the Chinese Communist Party (Amendment), and Xi Jinping’s Socialist Thoughts of the Chinese Characteristics of the Xi Jinping New Age were written into the Party’s Constitution. In February 2019, the Chinese official media Xinhua reported that Xi Jinping, the Central General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, Xi Jinping, had spoken at the first meeting of the Central Committee for the Rule of Law, noting the need to strengthen the Party’s leadership of a State based on the rule of law, and that it must not follow the path of constitutionalism, the separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary. On 11 November 2021, the 19th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party unanimously adopted the Resolution on
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 在社会维稳方面，2013年12月，全国人大废除了自1957年以来实施的劳动教养政策；2019年12月，全国人大废除了自1991年以来实施的收容教育政策。2013-2014年间，针对新疆地区出现的一些重大恐怖袭击事件，譬如莎车县暴恐袭击案、乌鲁木齐公园北街早市暴力恐怖袭击案等，中国共产党开始试点建设“新疆再教育营”。2016年陈全国调任新疆自治区党委书记，此后营地规模迅速扩大，引起国际关注和争议。
target_text: In terms of social stability, in December 2013, the National People ' s Congress abolished the re-education through labour policy that had been in place since 1957; and in December 2019, the National People ' s Congress abolished the sheltered education policy that had been in place since 1991. During the period 2013-2014, the Communist Party of China began pilot construction of the Xinjiang Re-education Camp in response to major terrorist attacks in the Xinjiang region, such as the sarcophagus attacks in Sa ' ara County and the violent terrorist attacks in the morning city of Urumzi Park North.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text:
修改宪法
2018年2月25日，中国共产党中央委员会向第十三届全国人民代表大会提出对邓小平时代《八二宪法》的《宪法修正案》，建议删除国家主席和副主席“连任不得超过两届”的限制。邓小平时代以来的“废除领导干部终身制”或将结束。3月11日通过《宪法修正案》，同时习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想写入中华人民共和国宪法。
target_text: On February 25, 2018, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China proposed to the Thirteenth National People's Congress an amendment to the Constitution of the Eighty-Second Constitution of the Deng Xiaoping era, which would remove the restriction that the President and Vice-President of the country “cannot be re-elected for more than two consecutive terms.” The amendment to the Constitution was adopted on March 11, and Xi’s socialist idea of the Chinese character of the new Xi Jinping era was enshrined in the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 根据1982年制定的《中华人民共和国宪法》（八二宪法），恢复设立自1968年缺位，1975年被废除的国家主席和副主席职位，不过取消国家主席在五四宪法中主持召开最高国务会议和领导国防委员会的权力，失去了行政权和军权，变成礼仪性的虚位元首。根据邓小平在1980年提倡的“废除干部领导职务终身制”，重新设立的国家主席和副主席任期为五年一届，连任不能超过两届。这次修宪仅删除了连任限制，并没有赋予国家主席拥有更大的权力，但引发了体制内外的广泛争议。
target_text: In accordance with the Constitution of the People's Republic of China of 1982, the post of President and Vice-President of the State was reinstated since 1968 and abolished in 1975, although the President of the State's power to preside over the Supreme Council of State and lead the National Defence Council was abolished in five or four Constitutions, with the loss of executive power and military power, and became a ceremonial nobility. According to Deng Xiaoping's proposal in 1980, the President and Vice-President of the State were re-established for a term of five years, with no more than two consecutive terms. The amendment merely removed the term of re-election and did not confer greater powers on the President of the State, but gave rise to widespread controversy, both within and outside the system.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 从1993年开始，国家主席与中共中央总书记和中央军委主席形成“三位一体”的制度。根据中国共产党的领导原则和“枪杆子里面出政权”的政治理念，党的总书记和军委主席是中国政治体系中拥有最大权力的两个职务，而这两个实权职位在《中国共产党章程》里没有连任次数的限制。由于“三位一体”制度，国家主席的连任限制被取消后，最高领导人的职务将不再受任何任期制限制。如历史上，毛泽东曾终身担任中国共产党中央委员会主席直至去世。
target_text: Since 1993, the President of the State has formed a “triple one” system with the Central Secretary-General of the Communist Party of China and the Chairman of the Central Military Commission. In accordance with the Chinese Communist Party’s leadership principle and the political philosophy of “the regime inside the gun”, the Party’s General Secretary and Chairman of the Military Commission are the two positions with the greatest powers in the Chinese political system, which have no limit on the number of re-elections in the Constitution of the Communist Party of China. As a result of the “triple one” system, the re-election of the President of the State will no longer be subject to any term limit.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2015年10月，屠呦呦成为获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖的首位中国籍科学家。2020年，量子計算原型機九章由中國科學技術大學相關技術團隊研製成功，達成了量子計算研究的第一個里程碑：量子計算優越性。同年11月，奋斗者号潜水器搭载3人成功潜入10909米深海域。此外，中国在航空航天领域以及空间探索上取得一系列突破：
target_text: In October 2015, Yoyo became the first Chinese scientist to win a Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. In 2020, nine chapters of the quantum calculator prototype were successfully developed by a team of technology related to the Chinese University of Science and Technology, which reached the first milestone in quantum computing research: Quantum calculations are excellent. In November of the same year, the Combater submersible successfully launched three people into the sea of 10909 meters. In addition, China made a series of breakthroughs in aerospace and space exploration:
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text:
中国探月工程的「繞、落、回」任務全部完成，包括2013年嫦娥三号搭载的玉兔号月球车成功登月，以及2020年嫦娥五號成功執行首次地外天體採樣返回任務。
2015年，北斗三号项目建设启动。同年，暗物质粒子探测卫星“悟空”发射成功。
2016年，天宫二号发射成功、取代了之前的天宫一号。同年，“500米口径球面射电望远镜”在贵州落成。
2020年，火星探测器“天问一号”成功发射升空，并在2021年5月成功着陆火星表面。同年7月，北斗三号正式开通。
2021-2022年，神舟十二号、神舟十三號、神舟十四號、神舟十五號载人飞船先後与天宫空间站成功对接，執行中國太空站在軌關鍵技術驗證及建造任務。
2023年，隨着神舟十六號载人飞船与天宫空间站成功对接，中國太空站從此進入長年有人駐守的常態化營運模式。
target_text: In the same year, the Beidou III project was launched. In the same year, the dark particle detection satellite Goku was launched. In 2016, the Sky Palace II was successfully launched, replacing the former Sky Palace I. In the same year, the "500-metre-gauge surface transmission telescope" landed in Guizhou. In 2020, the Mars probe, "Store One" was successfully launched and landed on the surface of Mars in May 2021.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 另一方面，2022年2月4日，第24屆冬季奧林匹克運動會在北京開幕；這是中國首次舉辦冬季奧運會，而北京也因而成為首座既舉辦過夏季奧運會，又舉辦過冬季奧運會的城市（即“双奥城市”或“双奥之城”）。2023年7月28日至8月8日，原定于2021年于中国四川省成都市举行后因2019冠状病毒病疫情等原因二次延期的第31届夏季世界大学生运动会举行。
target_text: On the other hand, on 4 February 2022, the 24th Winter Olympic Games opened in Beijing; this was the first winter Olympics in China, and Beijing became the first city to hold both the summer Olympics and the winter Olympics (the “Cities of the Two Olympics” or the “Cities of the Two Olympics”). The 31st Summer Games of the World College of Students, originally scheduled for 28 July to 8 August 2021 in Cheng City, Sichuan Province, China, were postponed for reasons such as the 2019 crown viral epidemic.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 2019年，香港爆发了全球瞩目的“反对逃犯条例修订草案运动”、简称“反送中”，外界广泛忧虑香港的“一国两制”、独立司法、新闻自由和言论自由遭到破坏，而与此同时部分示威者的暴力行动也使得香港社会秩序受损，地区旅游业和经济严重受挫。2020年《香港国安法》的颁布后，包括《苹果日报》高层在内的部分人士因违反国安法被捕，加深外界忧虑，而中国官方则称国安法使得“社会迅速恢复了秩序，香港市民的生命安全和财产安全得到保障”。
target_text: In 2019, Hong Kong launched a global campaign against the “retrogression” of the fugitive regulations, known as “retrogression”, with widespread concern that Hong Kong’s “one country, two systems”, independent justice, freedom of the press and freedom of expression have been undermined, while violent actions by some demonstrators have undermined Hong Kong’s social order and severely disrupted regional tourism and the economy. Following the enactment of the Hong Kong National Security Act in 2020, a number of people, including high-ranking members of the Apple Daily newspaper, were arrested for violating the national security law, which China’s official claims “restored order quickly and the lives and property of Hong Kong’s citizens are guaranteed”.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 习近平治下的中国逐渐扬弃了邓小平制定的“韬光养晦”外交战略思想，继而转向“有所作为/大有作为”的理念。和胡锦涛时期相比，中国外交正变得更为主动，且更具全球性、更积极地参与国际事务，中国新领导人的首年外交足迹遍布全球，中国正在“重新发现”过去被忽略的一些地区的战略价值和潜力。在处理世界热点如伊朗，叙利亚，朝鲜，中东等问题上，中国也开始站到“世界舞台的中央”，不再充当置身事外的旁观者。此外，RCEP和亚信峰会、上合组织、新开发银行、亚洲基础设施投资银行等组织中国都具有实际主导力，潜在的世界性影响力已经不容忽视，而且不论主动或被动，中国经济由于其庞大的规模，全球性经济政策已经不能缺少中国的参与和配合，中国开始显露其全球影响力。
target_text: Compared to Hu Jintao’s period, Chinese diplomacy is becoming more proactive and more global and active in international affairs, China’s first year as a new leader has a global reach, and China is “rediscovering” the strategic values and potential of some of the previously neglected areas. In dealing with such issues as the world’s hotspots as Iran, Syria, North Korea, and the Middle East, China has also begun to take its place in the “central part of the world stage” and to act as an outsider.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text:
2013年9月和10月，中国政府分别提出建设“一带一路”（即“新丝绸之路经济带”）和“21世纪海上丝绸之路”的合作倡议。中国政府指出，“一带一路”倡议坚持共商、共建、共享的原则，努力实现沿线区域基础设施更加完善，更加安全高效，以形成更高水平的陆海空交流网络。
2014年11月10日至11日，第26届亚太经合组织领导人年度会议于在北京市怀柔区雁栖湖举行。该次峰会通过《亚太经合组织第二十二次领导人非正式会议宣言》（《北京纲领（宣言）》），提出并通过致力于旨在打击跨国腐败的《北京反腐败宣言》。
2015年，“习马会”在新加坡举行，是海峡两岸（即中国大陆与台湾）自1949年政治分立以来，双方最高领导人的首次会晤。
target_text: In September and October 2013, the Chinese government proposed, respectively, a cooperative initiative to build a “one-way” (i.e., the “new Silk Road economic belt”) and a “sea Silk Road in the 21st Century.” The Chinese Government noted that the “one-way” initiative adheres to the principles of commerce, common construction, and sharing, and seeks to improve regional infrastructure and make it more secure and efficient in order to form a higher-level network of land, sea, and air exchanges.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 截止至习近平时期，西藏、新疆和内蒙古的独立运动已经基本受到控制，但中华人民共和国在钓鱼岛、南中国海等地依然与许多亚洲国家存在领土争议。台湾问题随着时间的推移，两岸分治已久，台湾有不同于中华人民共和国的价值观与制度，新一代台湾人经过李登辉与陈水扁时期去中国化的教育，对中华人民共和国认同感极低，更不觉得有“内战遗留问题”或与中华人民共和国“统一”的必要，台湾民调显示多数民众不愿“统一”。2022年8月初，美国众议院议长南希·佩洛西率团访问台湾，中国人民解放军而后展开环台军事演练，引发外界对第四次台海危机的担忧。
target_text: The independence movement in Tibet, Xinjiang, and Inner Mongolia was largely under control until Xi’s end, but the People’s Republic of China continues to have territorial disputes with many Asian countries in the fishing islands, the South China Sea, etc. The Taiwan issue has been divided for a long time, Taiwan has different values and institutions from the People’s Republic of China, and a new generation of Taiwanns who have gone to China through the education of Li Tenghui and Chen Shui-bian have a very low sense of identity with the People’s Republic of China, much less the need for “residual problems of civil war” or “unification” with the People’s Republic of China.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 习近平上台后，推翻了自邓小平拨乱反正、改革开放以来的部分政策。2017年，习近平提出“四个伟大”，有学者认为此举是对毛泽东时期的“四个伟大”的效仿。而近年来，从修改宪法到反对“宪政”、“司法独立”，习近平的许多言论和举措招致了国内外的诸多反对声音，部分学者对他的一系列作法感到忧虑、震惊，有人认为这是对毛泽东时代的复辟，推行个人崇拜、煽动民族情绪、背离宪政主义，是体制性倒退，还有人认为这甚至有可能将中国推向第二次文化大革命。此外，中国709维权律师大抓捕事件、陕西千亿矿权案、新疆再教育营、香港反修例運動、战狼外交均引起了巨大争议或批评。
target_text: In 2017, Xi proposed “four greats” as an example of the “four greats” of Mao’s era. In recent years, many statements and initiatives, ranging from constitutional changes to opposition to “constitutionalism” and “independence of the judiciary” Xi’s independence, have attracted many opposition voices at home and abroad.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 极权统治：习近平被普遍认为是中华人民共和国历史上继毛泽东之后最有权势的领导人，并预计会长期执掌政权。2022年10月，中共二十大和中共二十届一中全会先后召开，习近平谋求连任中共中央总书记与中央军委主席的这两个最有权力的职务，打破邓小平時期订下的“废除干部领导职务终身制”原則，再次连任最高领导人。习近平没有给出明确的预期连任的任期期限，有人推测习近平很有可能在2027年的中共二十一大上继续连任，更甚者预计他会仿效毛泽东终身掌权。
target_text: Xi Jinping was widely recognized as the most powerful leader in the history of the People's Republic of China after Mao Zedong, and is expected to hold power for a long period of time. In October 2022, the 20th and 20th sessions of the First Plenary of the Chinese Communist Party were held. Xi Jinping sought re-election to the two most powerful positions of the Central Secretary of the Communist Party and the Chairman of the Central Military Commission.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 大规模监控：习近平当政以来，中国政府开始利用大数据、人脸识别和其它一些人工智能技术建立社会大规模监控体系以及社会信用体系，以“打击犯罪”、“弘扬诚信”，但国内外的反对人士认为此举严重损害了公民的自由和隐私权等基本人权。也有学者警告中国可能步入乔治·奥威尔在《一九八四》一书中所描述的极权、监控社会。中国国家发改委数据显示，截止2019年6月已有3000多万人次因为失信而被限制搭乘飞机和高铁，437万失信被执行人继而主动履行法律义务。此外，中国政府还将监控技术和设备输出到了俄罗斯、非洲、南美洲等地。 2018年以来，中共中央政法委员会进一步提出要建立正规的“政法网评大军”。军费预算连年增加且存在不透明，而国内的“维稳”经费多年超过军费支出。
target_text: Since Xi came to power, the Chinese government has begun to build large-scale social surveillance systems and social credit systems using big data, face-to-face recognition, and other artificial intelligence technologies to “combate crime” and promote good faith, but opponents at home and abroad believe that this has seriously undermined fundamental human rights, such as the freedom and privacy of citizens. There are also scholars who have warned China that George Orwell may enter into the totalitarian and monitoring society described in Book 184.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 香港问题：2019年香港反修例运动期间，Twitter、Facebook禁封或删除了大量“具有中国官方背景、用于煽动舆论的帐号”，其中Twitter声称处理了约20万个相关帐号。期间，中国中央电视台声称1984年签署的《中英联合声明》已经“过时无效”，而随后中国外交部以“香港事务纯属中国内政”应对外界质疑，引发了巨大争议。 2020年6月30日颁布的《香港国安法》引发了较大争议。
target_text: Question of Hong Kong: During the 2019 anti-revision campaign in Hong Kong, Twitter and Facebook blocked or deleted a large number of “accounts with an official Chinese background and used to incite public opinion,” in which Twitter claimed to have processed some 200,000 related accounts. During this period, China’s Central Television claimed that the “Chinese-British Joint Statement” signed in 1984 had been “obsolete” and that the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs then responded to the external challenge with “Hong Kong affairs are purely an internal matter of China.”
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 抗疫抗灾：2019冠状病毒病疫情发生后，习近平一直强调自己“亲自指挥、亲自部署”防疫工作，甚至早在2020年1月7日已经在中央政治局常委会上提出防疫要求。不过有消息指出中央领导人初期对疫情并不重视，甚至要求不要造成民众恐慌，影响即将到来的春节气氛。外界亦有对中国大陆官方公布的死亡人数及染病人数的真实性质疑。2020年5月下旬起，儘管长江中下游地区、淮河流域、西南、华南及东南沿海等地因持续强降水引发严重洪灾，多省发生暴洪、城区内涝、渍灾。除了總理李克強在7月6日現身貴州視察外，習近平不見蹤影，有中國政治學者認為，習近平已陷入「決策疲勞」狀態，面對水災產生了「逃避」心態。然而随着中国政府成功控制疫情，中国经济增长2.3%、优于预期，中国不仅成为全球唯一实现经济正增长的主要经济体，GDP总量也实现了百万亿的历史性突破。但随着2022年上海疫情和北京疫情的爆发，中华人民共和国政府的防疫政策再次引发争论。習近平多次下令要以清零政策應對殺傷力弱的Omicron變異株引發的新冠疫情，因為延續不斷的封鎖措施嚴重影響經濟和民生導致民怨沸騰。
target_text: After the outbreak of the 2019 coronary virus disease, Xi Jinping stressed that he had “directed and deployed” the disease, even as early as 7 January 2020, to the Standing Committee of the Central Political Bureau. However, reports suggest that the central leadership did not attach much importance to the epidemic at an early stage, or even demanded that it not cause panic among the population, affecting the upcoming springtime atmosphere. In late May 2020, despite the severe flooding caused by the continued heavy rains in the lower and lower parts of the Yangtze region, the Huai River basin, south-west China, and the south-east coast, China’s economic growth was 2.3 per cent, and China’s economic growth was expected to be the only positive impact of the current state’s 6 July surveillance, and Chinese political scholars believe that the Chinese government’s recent policy of cutting off the Chinese economy’s power from China’s foreign power to China’s foreign power supply of the US dollar’s power to the US dollar’s power to boost the US dollar’s foreign power to the US dollar’s power of the US$22.
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text:
新疆问题：習近平時期，西方國家開始關注新疆維吾爾族人權和新疆再教育营的問題，并实施了相关制裁，而中华人民共和国政府對西方國家的指責一概否認。2022年8月31日，聯合國人權事務高級專員辦事處發佈《新疆人權報告》，認為中國政府針對維吾爾族和其他穆斯林社群存在嚴重侵犯人權行為。
俄乌战争：2022年中国在俄乌战争中的亲俄立场和态度引起国际争议，并引发了“大翻译运动”，中国官媒则抨击大翻译运动是“辱华”。
target_text: On August 31, 2022, the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights issued the Xinjiang Human Rights Report, which states that the Chinese government has committed serious human rights violations against the Uighurs and other Muslim communities. The war in Russia and the Uighur War: China’s pro-Russian position and attitude during the war in Russia and Ukraine in 2022 caused international controversy and triggered a “big translation movement” and the Chinese media criticized the Great Translator movement as “indulging China.”
title: 中华人民共和国历史

source_text: 中華民國是位於東亞的民主共和國，曾在國際上代表「中國」，現今多通稱為「臺灣」；目前有效管轄範圍為臺灣、澎湖群島及其附屬島嶼，以及中國大陸福建沿岸的金門群島、馬祖列島等島嶼（多合稱為「臺澎金馬」或「臺灣地區」），土地面積共36,197平方公里，其中臺灣及其附屬島嶼占99%以上。目前臺灣本島為主要領土，位居東亞島弧，東臨太平洋、西隔臺灣海峽、南界巴士海峽、北瀕東海，其地形陡峭、景觀多樣，三分之二面積為山地和丘陵地，大部分人口居住於西部平地。截至，全國人口約2,300萬人，人口密度在全世界人口大於1,000萬人以上的國家中位列第二；首都為臺北市，人口最多的城市為新北市。
target_text: China, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which represents China internationally, is now known as Taiwan; it currently has effective jurisdiction over Taiwan, the Great Lakes Islands and their dependencies, as well as the islands of the Golden Gate, the Mazure Islands, on the coast of Fujian, China (more than two thirds of which are hilly and hilly, with a majority of the population living in the western plains). As of today, Taiwan has a population of about 23 million people, with a population density of more than 10 million people around the world.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1911年10月10日，辛亥革命爆發，革命黨人於1912年1月1日在南京宣告建立中華民國，數月後清朝宣統帝下詔退位，中華民國遂從清朝手中正式繼承中國政權。北洋政府時期，政治上陷入長期南北分裂、軍閥混戰，社會上則持續走向自由氛圍。1928年，中國國民黨領導的國民政府統一中國，實施訓政，但此前有合作關係的中國共產黨與國民黨決裂，建立割據政權。1937年，中國抗日戰爭全面爆發，之後成為第二次世界大戰的主要戰場之一，期間國共短暫再次合作。1945年日本投降，中華民國接管臺灣，此後第二次國共內戰爆發。1947年，《中華民國憲法》正式施行，國民政府改組為中華民國政府，同時宣告動員戡亂。1949年，中國共產黨在第二次國共內戰中勝出，並在中國大陸建立中华人民共和国，中國國民黨領導下的中華民國政府則敗退遷往臺灣，在宣告臺灣戒嚴的同時持續主張擁有中國大陸主權。直到1987年，中華民國政府解除臺灣戒嚴狀態，再於1991年終止動員戡亂時期並首次增修憲法，實務上承認治權僅及於臺灣地區，並在不承認中華人民共和國主權的法律框架下與中國大陸往來，之後在1990年代陸續完成國會全面改選、總統直選等民主化措施。2000年，民主進步黨在第二次總統直選中勝出，達成首次政黨輪替及政權和平轉移。
target_text: In 1928, the Communist Party of China (CPC), led by the Chinese National Party (CND), established China in Nanjing on January 1, 1912, and the Communist Party of China (CPD) and the National Democratic Party (NDP) withdrew from China a few months later. In 1937, China fought against the war and became one of the main battle sites of the Second World War, and the People’s Republic of China cooperated once more. Japan surrendered in 1945, the Chinese People took over the Gulf, and the People’s Republic of China began fighting for the second time in 1928, and the People’s Republic of China took over the country’s civil war.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國主權屬於國民全體，在經歷數次憲法增修後成為半總統制國家，以總統為國家元首、行政院院長為政府首腦；中央政府按五權憲法精神分為行政院（內閣）、立法院（國會）、司法院、考試院及監察院，地方上則依行政區劃分為6個直轄市、13個縣及3個市。中華民國提倡民主、自由、人權、法治等基本價值，並持續推動全民健康保險、社會救助方案、多元語言文化發展等政策；其社會屬於多元移民社會，由臺灣原住民族、漢族及新住民等群體組成，兼容南島、中華、日本及西方文化，同時在視覺藝術、文學出版、表演藝術、電影及戲劇等領域均有所發展。
target_text: The central government is divided into the Executive Council (the Cabinet), the Legislative Council (the National Assembly), the Judicial Court, the Trial Court and the Supervisory Board, and the local executives are divided into six direct municipalities, 13 counties, and three municipalities. China promotes the fundamental values of democracy, freedom, human rights, the rule of law, and continues to promote policies such as universal health insurance, social assistance programmes, and the development of a multilingual linguistic culture.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國曾經是聯合國會員國與安全理事會常任理事國，並參與創立聯合國，但在1971年中華人民共和國取得聯合國「中國」席次後逐漸失去國際普遍承認。中華人民共和國長期主張擁有臺灣主權，常被認為是中華民國面臨的最大軍事威脅，但也是後者最大的經濟貿易夥伴。目前中華民國擁有13個邦交國，並與美國、日本等非邦交國發展夥伴關係，同時也是多個政府間國際組織及多邊機制的成員。中華民國行市場經濟，以製造業、服務業及貿易業為主，在全球經濟中占有重要地位，與國際社會有極高經貿依存度，亦是半導體、資通訊技術產業的重要領導者。
target_text: The Chinese People’s Republic of China, which was once a permanent member of the United Nations and a member of the Security Council and was a founding member of the United Nations, lost its universal recognition in 1971 when it won the United Nations “China” seat. The Chinese People’s Republic of China’s long-standing ownership of Taiwan is often considered to be the greatest military threat to the country’s economy, but it is also the largest economic and trade partner of its predecessors. It currently has 13 states, with development partners such as the United States and Japan, and is a member of several international organizations and multilateral institutions.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 「中華民國」一稱最早是由孫中山於1905年在日本東京召開的中國同盟會成立大會上所提出。1912年1月1日，各省都督府代表聯合會宣布建立民主共和制國家，使用「中華民國」作為國號。延續中國改朝換代的慣例，民國紀年以1912年為元年。1949年後，中華民國政府遷往臺灣，主張擁有中國大陸和臺灣的主權，並在聯合國等國際組織代表「中國」；但在1990年代後承認中華人民共和國實際統治中國大陸，而中華民國有效統治範圍是臺灣地區。目前中華民國多通稱為「臺灣」，在不同國際組織則使用「臺澎金馬個別關稅領域」、「中華臺北」等名稱。
target_text: On January 1, 1912, the Union of Governors of the provinces announced the establishment of a democratic republic, using the term “China” as the country’s name. China’s tradition of changing the country was followed by the year 1912. After 1949, the Chinese government moved to Taiwan, claiming the sovereignty of China’s mainland and Taiwan, and represented China in international organizations such as the United Nations; but after the 1990’s, China’s People’s Republic of China and the United States ruled China, and China effectively ruled the mainland.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 北洋政府時期，中華民國以五色旗為國旗，《卿雲歌》為國歌。五色旗的紅色、黃色、藍色、白色、黑色橫條代表五族共和。現行中華民國國旗是孫中山以青天白日旗（陸皓東設計）為藍本，加上紅色底色，形成「青天、白日、滿地紅」的國旗。青色代表光明純潔、民族和自由；白色代表坦白無私、民權和平等；紅色代表不畏犧牲、民生和博愛。白日的12道光芒代表一年12個月、一天12個時辰，並象徵國家命脈與鼓舞國人與時俱進。中華民國國徽同樣以青天白日為基礎，國家代表色為藍色、白色與紅色。
target_text: At the time of the government in the North China, the five-colour flag was the national anthem. The red, yellow, blue, white, and black banners of the five colour flags represent the republic. The Chinese flag is the blue flag of Sun-san with the white flag, and the red colour with the red colour, which forms the flag of the "green sky, white day, full of red" . The white flag represents the light, purity, nationality and freedom; the white representative confesses to selflessness, civil rights and equality; the red representative does not fear sacrifice, civil life, and love. The 12 lights of White Day represent 12 months, 12 hours a year, and are a symbol of national life and inspiration.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 現行中華民國國歌歌詞出自孫中山於1924年在中國國民黨陸軍軍官學校發表的《黃埔軍校訓詞》，由程懋筠譜寫音樂。最初作為中國國民黨黨歌，在國歌尚未制定前代替國歌。直到1937年，中國國民黨正式將其黨歌定為國歌。升降中華民國國旗則演奏《中華民國國旗歌》，該國旗歌還作為國際場合的國歌替代方案。中華民國國花為梅花，在1964年正式核定。梅花的凌冬耐寒表現堅貞剛潔，三蕾五瓣代表三民主義及五權憲法。中華民國國家象徵還有「中華民國之璽」與「榮典之璽」兩枚中華民國國璽。
target_text: The Chinese National Anthem, originally a Chinese National Party (NDP) song, was written in front of the national anthem. Until 1937, the Chinese National Party officially defined its party an anthem. China’s flag was raised, China’s flag was played by the Chinese People’s National Anthem, which is also an international alternative to the national anthem. The Chinese nation’s flower is a mace, which was officially approved in 1964.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1912年，中華民國在中國大陸宣告成立，並經歷北洋政府、國民政府等時期。在這期間，臺灣、澎湖群島接受日本殖民統治（1895年至1945年），與中國大陸分歧發展。更早之前，臺灣先後歷經荷西統治時期（1624年至1662年）、明鄭時期（1661年至1683年）和清治時期（1683年至1895年）。1945年，中華民國政府接管臺灣，概括接受日本時期的政經體制，並與中國大陸體制接軌。1949年，中國共產黨建立「中華人民共和國」，中華民國政府遷往臺灣。而在1970年代後，隨著中華民國在國際上不能繼續代表「中國」、及民主與多元化社會逐漸成形，地方意識、本土文化備受重視，原住民與客家族群積極爭取族群地位，亦出現新的國族觀念與文化認同。
target_text: In 1912, the Chinese People’s Republic of China proclaimed itself on the mainland of China and went through the years between the North and the People’s Republic of China. In 1945, the Chinese government took over Taiwan, outlining its acceptance of Japan’s system of government and its integration with China’s continental system. In 1949, the Chinese Communist Party established the “China People’s Republic of China” and the Chinese Government moved to Taiwan. In the 1970’s, the Chinese People’s Republic was unable to continue representing China, democracy and pluralism at the international level.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1840年第一次鴉片戰爭後，清朝外交及戰役失利，中國淪為次殖民地。隨著清朝改革運動和立憲運動失敗，孫中山等人組成中國同盟會。1911年10月10日，革命軍武昌起義，各省宣告獨立。同年12月，各省都督府代表聯合會在南京府組織中華民國臨時政府，選舉孫中山為臨時大總統。1912年1月1日，孫中山宣誓就職，中華民國正式成立。孫中山組織臨時參議院，制定《中華民國臨時約法》。清朝內閣總理大臣袁世凱和中華民國臨時政府達成協議，逼迫宣統帝溥儀退位；孫中山則主動辭職，由袁世凱繼任臨時大總統，臨時政府遷都京兆地方。
target_text: After the first opium war in 1840, the Qing Dynasty lost its diplomatic and military efforts, and China became a sub-colonial colony. Following the failure of the Qing Dynasty Reform and Constitutional Movement, Sun Chungshan and others formed the China Alliance. On October 10, 1911, the Revolutionary Army took action and the provinces declared their independence. In December of the same year, the provincial governors organized a coalition of representatives of the United Nations in the Nanjing capital to organize the interim government of the Central Chinese People’s Republic, which elected the late President of China’s grandson. On January 1, 1912, Sun was sworn to office and the Chinese People’s Republic was officially established.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 由於北洋軍閥與地方軍閥持續爭權、各地陷入混戰，中國國民黨與中國共產黨展開合作，成立陸軍軍官學校。1925年，國民政府在廣州市成立。1926年起，蔣中正擔任國民革命軍總司令，發動國民革命軍北伐。1927年定都南京市，並展開清黨。1928年，東北易幟，中國分裂政局宣告統一。其後，中國國民黨為首的國民政府實施以黨治國的訓政，國家建設得到發展。同時期內部有地方軍閥與中國共產黨勢力割據，外部有大日本帝國威脅。1927年起，中國共產黨在多地建立革命根據地。1931年，日本發動九一八事變，成立傀儡政權滿洲國。
target_text: Since 1926, China has been serving as the Commander-in-Chief of the National Civil Revolutionary Army, launching the National Revolutionary Army in North Korea. In 1927, the city of Nanjing was established and the Communist Party of China, headed by the Chinese National Democratic Party (NDP), announced that the Chinese separatist government would rule the country in 1928. In the same period, local military forces and the Communist Party of China (CCP), whose power has been cut off, have threatened the entire Japanese Empire. Since 1927, the Communist Party of China (CCP) has established a revolution in many parts of the country.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1937年，中國抗日戰爭全面爆發，日本軍在戰爭初期攻下南京市，國民政府遷往重慶市，雙方陷入僵持；其後中華民國與美國、英國、蘇聯結為同盟國，最終在1945年獲得勝利。在日本投降後，國民政府還都南京市，中國共产黨則進駐日本控制區，雙方展開政治協商會議。1946年，制憲國民大會通過《中華民國憲法》。1947年，《中華民國憲法》施行，召開第一屆國民大會。1948年，國民大會選舉蔣中正為行憲後首任總統，同年頒布《動員戡亂時期臨時條款》。在這期間，中華民國國軍與中國人民解放軍爆發全面內戰。
target_text: In 1937, after Japan’s surrender, the Chinese government in Nanjing and the Chinese Communist Party (CPD) moved into Japan’s controlled area, where they opened political negotiations. In 1946, the National Constituent Assembly passed the Chinese National Charter Act. In 1947, the Chinese National People’s Congress came into force, calling for the First National Congress.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 至少在10,000年前，臺灣原住民族的祖先陸續前來臺灣，成為臺灣最早的居民。南宋乾道七年（西元1171年），被稱為毗舍耶人到澎湖，強行收割島上作物，攻擊澎湖居民。泉州知府汪大猷派兵将其趕走，並戍守澎湖，防止毗舍耶人侵擾。在12世紀後，中國和日本商人、漁民和海盜在臺灣活動，從事非法貿易。1624年，因明朝軍隊驅逐，荷蘭人自澎湖轉往安平建立據點。1626年，與荷蘭敵對的西班牙人佔領臺灣北部，同時期的日本人則離開臺灣。1642年，西班牙人遭到荷蘭人趕走，退出臺灣。荷蘭人在原住民族服從下建立統治制度，開始進行傳教與貿易，並招募中國沿海省份漢人移墾。1662年，南明在中國東南地區抗清未果，鄭成功率領軍隊擊敗在臺灣的荷蘭人。明鄭時期重視中華文化的推廣，鼓勵漢人移民臺灣、從事屯墾經貿，但統治引起反感。
target_text: After the 12th century, Chinese and Japanese businessmen, fishermen and pirates came to Taiwan and became the first residents of Taiwan. Seven years (1171 NW) of the South Song Gang Road, known as the Holants, were transferred from Shirai to Anping to collect crops on the island and attacked the residents. In 1626, the Spanish against the Dutch enemy took over the northern part of the Taiwan Bay, while the Japanese left the Gulf at the same time. In 1642, the Spanish were driven away by the Dutch and withdrew from the Taiwan Straits.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1683年，清朝政府平定臺灣，劃為福建省治理，並頒布渡臺禁令限制移民。不過數十萬名福建省及廣東省的漢人移民臺灣，形成漢人社會；當時主要經濟活動為種植水稻與甘蔗、與中國大陸貿易，並經常發生民變與械鬥。在第二次鴉片戰爭後，臺灣開放港口通商，向歐洲列強出口樟腦與茶葉，但也導致日本、美國有所企圖。在中法戰爭過後，清朝政府更加重視臺灣。1885年，臺灣升格為福建臺灣省，首任巡撫劉銘傳推行鐵道、道路等新政，加速臺灣現代化。1895年，在甲午戰爭戰敗後，清朝根據《馬關條約》將臺灣、澎湖群島主權割讓給日本。
target_text: After the second war on opium, Taiwan opened up its ports to export brains and tea to European powers, but also led to an attempt by Japan and the United States. In the aftermath of the war, the government placed greater emphasis on Taiwan. In 1885, Taiwan was the province of Taiwan, the first cruiser to promote new policies such as railway lanes, roads and so on, accelerating Taiwan’s modernity.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 作為第一個殖民地，日本政府強硬鎮壓臺灣民主國等抗日運動，並計劃提高臺灣農作物產量、將樟腦等產品國有化，大量出口糖與米到日本。同時積極建設基礎設施、銀行體系等，加速臺灣現代經濟成長，成為東亞僅次於日本外最先進的地方。1920年代，在臺灣的軍事統治一度轉為文人政治，並試圖同化臺灣居民。臺灣知識分子發起地方自治運動，並發生霧社事件。在太平洋戰爭期間，日本軍國主義下的臺灣成為侵略東南亞的軍事基地，並因而發展重工業。同時還推動皇民化運動，許多臺灣人加入日本軍，但各地也遭到美國轟炸。至1945年，在日本投降後，中華民國政府接管臺灣。
target_text: The Japanese government, as the first colony, forced the Taiwan’s anti-Japanese movement, including the Taiwan Democratic Republic, and planned to increase the production of Taiwan’s agricultural crops, upgrade the country’s exports of sugar and rice to Japan. At the same time, the construction of infrastructure, banking systems, etc., accelerated the growth of Taiwan’s modern economy, which was only the first place outside Japan. In the 1920’s, military rule in Taiwan was transformed into human politics and attempted to join Taiwanese residents.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1947年，因為臺灣省行政長官公署施政錯誤等因素，臺灣爆發大規模抗爭，爾後國民政府派遣軍隊鎮壓，造成臺灣省籍矛盾擴大。但隨著第二次國共內戰不斷失利、通貨膨脹持續失控，中華民國政府逐漸喪失中國大陸的控制權。1949年初，下野的蔣中正逐步將軍隊調往臺灣，而臺灣地區亦宣告戒嚴。同年10月，中國共產黨成立中華人民共和國。同年12月，中國國民黨掌控的中華民國政府遷往臺北市，另有200萬人遷往臺灣。在韓戰後，中華民國獲得美國軍事支持及援助；日本則與同盟國及中華民國分別簽署《舊金山和約》、《中日和約》，正式放棄臺灣的主權。
target_text: In 1947, as a result of the Taiwan Governor’s administration’s misrule of government, the Taiwan government staged massive protests in Taiwan, and the Chinese Communist Party formed the Chinese People’s Republic of China in October of the same year. In December of that year, the Chinese Communist Party’s Chinese government moved to Taipei, and another 2 million people moved to Taiwan. In the aftermath of the Korean War, the Chinese government was receiving United States military support and assistance; Japan and the Allies and the Chinese People’s Republic signed the Old Golden Mountain Treaty and the Chinese and Chinese Treaty.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 其後，中華民國政府持續主張代表「中國」並計劃反攻大陸，同時在臺灣建立威權主義的黨國體制，控制媒體出版、禁止成立政黨，造成白色恐怖；而其黨國資本主義經濟計畫則促成臺灣經濟快速發展，並創造「臺灣奇蹟」。1971年，聯合國大會決議中華人民共和國為「中國」唯一合法代表，中華民國失去國際社會廣泛承認。1975年，蔣中正逝世，副總統嚴家淦繼任總統。1978年，蔣經國就任總統，並在其任內培植臺灣籍菁英，但也爆發針對黨外運動人士的美麗島事件。1980年代，在民主進步黨成立後，中華民國政府於1987年解除《臺灣地區戒嚴令》，臺灣民主化進程加速。
target_text: In 1971, the U.N. Congress ruled that the People’s Republic of China was the only legitimate representative of China, and that China had lost broad recognition of the international community. In 1975, China was dead, and the Vice President became President of the Republic. In 1978, China became President of the Republic and established Taiwan’s prime minister, but also launched a campaign against foreign activists in the beautiful island of Taiwan.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 1988年蔣經國逝世以後，李登輝繼任總統，並在1991年終止動員戡亂時期，承認中華民國政府僅統治臺灣地區的現實。1991年至2000年，在歷經多次憲法增修後，臺灣從權威主義轉向民主政體，並出現臺灣主體意識等討論。期間「萬年國會」全面改選，並在1996年舉行首次總統公民直接選舉。這時期海峽兩岸關係逐漸發展，但臺灣經濟成長已經放緩。2000年及2004年，民主進步黨籍陳水扁當選總統，組成少數黨政府，結束中國國民黨50年的一黨制統治。陳水扁在其任內強調「臺灣是主權獨立的國家」，並推動公民投票，但在執政末期爆發多起貪污弊案。
target_text: From 1991 to 2000, after many constitutional amendments, Taiwan moved from power to democracy and came to grips with Taiwan’s ideology. During this period, the “Universal House” was re-elected, and the first direct presidential election was held in 1996.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 2008年及2012年，中國國民黨籍馬英九當選總統，在其任內改善海峽兩岸關係，簽訂經濟協議。但在2014年，隨著經濟停滯與主權威脅，臺灣爆發太陽花學運。2015年，馬英九和習近平在新加坡舉行兩岸領導人會面。2016年，民主進步黨籍蔡英文當選首位女性總統，民主進步黨首次取得立法院多數席次。2020年，蔡英文連任總統，民主進步黨持續持有立法院多數席次。
target_text: In 2008 and 2012, the Chinese National Democratic Party (NDP) elected its President, Ma Yingix, to improve cross-Strait relations and sign economic agreements during his term. But in 2014, the Taiwan sunflowers began following economic stagnation and the threat of dominance. In 2015, Ma Yingix and Xi Jinping met with their leaders on both sides of Singapore. In 2016, the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) elected the first female president in English, and the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) won several seats in the Legislative Chamber for the first time.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國轄有臺灣及其附屬島嶼、澎湖群島、金門群島、馬祖列島、東沙群島、中沙群島、南沙群島等地，有效管轄土地面積36,197.067平方公里（世界排行第136名）。臺灣及其附屬島嶼面積35,886.8623平方公里，占中華民國管轄土地面積99%以上。臺灣是位於太平洋西岸東亞島弧間、亞洲大陸東南邊緣的海島，四面環海；其北方和東北方瀕東海，東北方與日本琉球群島接壤，東方與墨西哥相隔太平洋，南方與菲律賓相隔巴士海峽，西方與中國東南地區相隔臺灣海峽。經度約在東經120度至東經121度，緯度約在北緯21度至北緯26度之間。
target_text: China has 36,197.067 square kilometres (136th in the world’s row) of effectively administered land in the Gulf and its dependencies, the Great Lakes Islands, the Golden Islands, the Mazure Islands, the East and the East of Asia Islands, the Central Sha Islands and the South Sha Islands. The Gulf and its dependencies have 35,886.8623 square kilometres, or more than 99% of the land under China’s jurisdiction.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣大致呈現東西狹、南北長的紡錘形，南北長約394公里，東西寬約144公里。臺灣擁有多樣複雜的地形及地理景觀，約有70%面積為山地，平均海拔1,150公尺；主要山脈皆為南北走向，自東向西分別是海岸山脈、中央山脈、雪山山脈、玉山山脈、及阿里山山脈。中央山脈偏於東側，延著南北軸線形成主幹，亦是東西部河川分水嶺。玉山山脈主峰玉山高3,952公尺，為東亞第一高峰。北部則有大屯山脈，構成臺北盆地的周圍。這些山脈多被森林覆蓋，超過3,000公尺的山峰多達268座。
target_text: Taiwan has a wide variety of landscapes and geographical landscapes, with 70% of them mountainous, with an average altitude of 1,150 metres above sea level; the main mountain ranges are north-southward, from east to west, with coastal, central, snow, Yushan, and Ali. The central mountains are eastward, with the north-south axis forming the backbone of the north-south axis and an east-west river.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 阿里山山脈以西為漸趨平緩的丘陵、臺地、平原及盆地，大部分平地、耕地和人口便位在西部和北部沿海。在山麓丘陵周邊是海拔100公尺至500公尺的臺地，包括西北部桃園臺地群（面積最大的臺地）、臺中市后里臺地與大肚臺地、彰化縣八卦臺地、屏東縣恆春臺地等，當中許多是用於種植水稻的梯田。海拔100公尺以下、地勢平坦的沖積平原約占臺灣土地面積23%，橫跨雲林縣到高雄市的嘉南平原便占14%，另有東北部蘭陽平原、南部屏東平原等。在中央山脈與東部海岸山脈之間有花東縱谷平原，另有臺北盆地、臺中盆地、埔里盆地群等盆地。
target_text: Many of the hilly hills, fields, plains, and basins that are slowly levelling westwards lie on the western and northern coasts. The mountains are surrounded by towers of between 100 and 500 metres above sea level, including the Peach Tower in the north-west (the largest), the post-Taiong meadow and belly, the Gospel in the south-east and the spring fields in the east. Many of these are ladders for rice cultivation. Some 23 per cent of the surface of the Taiwan Bay lies in the flat plains below 100 metres above sea level, 14 per cent in the Qana Plain in the north-west forest area to the city of Gao Yu, and others in the Lanyang Plains in the north-east and the south-east coast. There are other valleys between the central and the eastern coasts, as well as other basins such as the north-east basin, the central basin, the central basins, and the valleys in the south-east.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國海岸線全長大約1,566.3公里。臺灣東部海岸山脈急遽沒入太平洋，西部海岸緩慢沒入臺灣海峽（並有沼澤和沙洲等地形），南部和離島海岸則有珊瑚礁群。許多主要港口設在西部海岸線，僅有東北部蘇澳港和北部基隆港例外。在島嶼部分，臺灣擁有21個附屬島嶼，較重要者有龜山島、綠島、蘭嶼、琉球嶼等；澎湖群島位於臺灣海峽，共計64個島嶼；金門群島位於中華人民共和國福建省東南海岸外，共計12個島嶼；馬祖列島位於臺灣海峽西北西方，共計36個島嶼；東沙群島、中沙群島和南沙群島位於南海；釣魚臺列嶼位於東海。
target_text: There are approximately 1,566.3 kilometres of the entire coast of China. The eastern coast of Taiwan has no access to the Pacific Ocean, the western coast has no access to the Gulf canals (with terrain such as marshes and sands), and the southern and off-island coasts have coral reefs. Many of the main ports are located on the western coast, with the exception of the north-eastern port of Suwa and the northern port of Kiron. In the island, there are 21 islands attached to Taiwan, the more important ones being the islands of Turtle Hill, Green Island, Lantern and Lycing, etc.; the lakes are located on the Taiwan Straits, with 64 islands in total; the Golden Islands are located outside the south-east coast of the People’s Republic of China and the Fujian province, with 12 islands in total; the island of Mazure is located in the north-western part of the Taiwan Strait, with 36 islands in total; the islands of East and South and South Asia are located in the South China Sea; the islands of East and East and South China.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣位居歐亞大陸與太平洋海盆的東亞島弧中央位置，是由歐亞大陸板塊與菲律賓海板塊撞擊形成的新生代褶皺山脈。東亞島弧位在東亞至東南亞沿海，北起阿拉斯加阿留申群島，在行經日本、菲律賓後，南至印度尼西亞島嶼；臺灣位於日本和菲律賓之間，但形成時間與琉球群島和菲律賓不同。大約在中生代末期的南澳運動中，臺灣因為造山運動浮出水面成為一個小島，但不久深埋海底。直到大約200萬年前，臺灣東南方向的板塊在花東縱谷一帶撞上歐亞大陸板塊，強大的壓力再度把海底的沈積物抬升到海面，形成北—東北到南—西南走向的地勢。
target_text: Taiwan is located in the middle of the East Asian arc of the European continent and the Pacific basin, and is made out of a collision between the continental plate and the Philippine seaboard. The East Asian arc is located on the coast of East Asia to South East Asia, the Alaskan Islands in the North, and, after travelling through Japan and the Philippines, the island of Nisiia in the South; the Gulf is located between Japan and the Philippines, but time is different from that of the island and the Philippines. At the end of the Middle Ages, in the South Australia movement, Taiwan has surfaced as a small island for the mountain-building campaign, but it is buried deep in the near future. Until about 2 million years ago, south-east of the Taiwan slabs hit the European continent in the middle of the Handong Valley, with a heavy pressure to lift the sea floor again to the surface, creating a landscape that is heading north-east to south-west to south-west.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 其後的褶皺運動、斷層運動使臺灣逐漸上升成為穩固的島嶼，且上升運動不斷進行；自然環境的風化、雨蝕、崩落等作用造成多樣複雜的地形樣貌。其西部臺灣海峽平均深度約300英尺，東部太平洋30英里海床則有13,000英尺。臺灣農耕地大約7,900平方公里，但儘管土地因為火山作用導致土壤肥沃，土壤肥力仍然差異甚大：北部耕地土壤主要是酸性沖積土壤和赤鬆土壤，南部耕地土壤是中性至弱鹼性的沖積土壤。臺灣大部分的土壤缺乏磷和鉀，需要肥料才能有獲得好收成。而隨著社會經濟的變遷與發展，土壤及地下水等生活環境污染日益增加。
target_text: The ensuing tidal, fault-based campaigns have led to a steady rise in the Gulf as well as a steady rise in the islands; the natural environment has been characterized by a number of complex topography effects, such as weather, rain, and landslides. Its western Gulf canals have an average depth of about 300 feet, and its 30-mile ocean floor is 13,000 feet in the eastern Pacific Ocean. Some 7,900 square kilometres of cultivated land is cultivated in Taiwan, but despite the fact that the soil is fertile as a result of volcanic activity, soil fertility is still very low: the soil in the north is mainly acidic and decompressive, while the soil in the south is meso-to-weak.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 由於歐亞大陸板塊和菲律賓海板塊相撞，臺灣擁有火山、溫泉及頻繁地震（平均每年160次地震）。1999年，臺灣發生九二一大地震，造成2,000多人死亡。主要火山分佈在大屯火山群、基隆火山群，另有玄武岩等凝固熔岩、小型泥火山、泥質溫泉等現象。臺灣過去大量開採煤礦、黃金、硫磺、大理石、玉石、天然氣等資源，但2000年後已經耗盡。較小的島嶼因海底火山形成獨特自然風貌，如澎湖群島柱狀玄武岩、綠島和龜山島海底溫泉等。龜山島是臺灣歷史上有紀錄的活火山，但幾個世紀並未噴發。金門群島和馬祖列島在地質上屬於中國大陸。
target_text: As a result of the collision between the continental plates of Europe and the Philippines, the Gulf had volcanic, hot springs and frequent earthquakes (an average of 160 earthquakes per year). In 1999, the Gulf had nine or two earthquakes, causing more than 2,000 deaths. The main volcanoes were scattered over large areas of volcanic formations, the Kiron volcano, and other solid lavas, such as basalts, small mud volcanoes, and mud hot springs. In the past, the Gulf had opened vast amounts of coal, gold, sulphur, marble, limestone, and natural gas, but it had been depleted since 2000.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣氣候帶廣泛，南部為熱帶氣候、北部為亞熱帶氣候、山區為溫帶氣候，北回歸線貫穿嘉義縣、嘉義市及花蓮縣。臺灣四季溫度變化明顯，每月平均溫度約在攝氏15度至30度之間；而東部黑潮暖流調節臺灣溫度，海洋氣流更造就溫潤的天氣。夏季至秋季漫長炎熱，氣溫可達攝氏35度以上。冬季短暫溫暖，偶有寒流南下，最低可達攝氏10度以下，高海拔山區常見飄雪。臺灣溫室氣體排放占全球約0.56%。因應《聯合國氣候變遷綱要公約》和《巴黎協定》，中華民國長期溫室氣體排放減量，並宣示將「2050年淨零轉型」納入目標。
target_text: The temperature of the Gulf is wide-ranging, with heat in the south, heat in the north, heat in the north, temperature in the mountains, and temperature in the north, and temperature in the north. Four seasons of temperature change in the Gulf, with average temperatures ranging from 15°C to 30°C per month, and temperatures in the east, where ocean currents are tempered by heat from summer to fall, which can reach more than 35°C. Short winter temperatures, with occasional chills south of the country, are below 10°C, and high-lying mountains often see snowfalls.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣全年降雨豐沛，年降雨量約2,200毫米（東部和山區降雨量更多），春雨、梅雨及颱風為主要降雨型態。降雨分布取決於季節性季風：夏季因為西南季風滯留鋒面而進入梅雨季，占中南部年降雨量90%、北部年降雨量60%；冬季則吹拂東北季風，東部與北部出現穩定降雨，中南部則普遍乾燥。颱風在夏末到秋初經過臺灣，平均每年襲擊3次至4次，有時引發洪水、土石流或山崩。另外因為氣象條件與空氣污染，秋冬季節空氣品質不良。臺灣附屬島嶼和澎湖群島氣候與臺灣相似，金門群島和馬祖列島氣候與中國大陸沿岸相似，南海諸島氣候與東南亞島嶼相似。
target_text: During the course of the year, the Taiwan rains were abundant, with annual rainfall of about 2,200 mm (more rainfall in the east and mountains), and spring rains, rain rains and typhoons as the main rainfall patterns. Rainfall distribution is determined by seasonal monsoons: summers have entered the rainy season as a result of the south-west monsoons that leave a sharp face, accounting for 90 per cent of annual rainfall in the south-central region and 60 per cent of annual rainfall in the north; winters have hit the north-east, stable rainfall in the east and north, and general drying in the south-central part of the country. By the end of summer and early autumn, typhoons have struck Taiwan on average three to four times a year, causing flooding, mudslides or landslides.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣地區共有119條河流，大多呈現東西向，並發源於中央山脈或丘陵。西部河流多長於東部河流，流域多小於2,000平方公里，但灌溉和排水渠道串聯許多河流。長度100公里河流共有8條，濁水溪是長度最長的河流，高屏溪具有最廣泛流域，而淡水河是唯一具有航運功能的河流。因為降雨季節分配不均，河流流量變化很大：夏季遭遇暴雨高漲、迅速流入大海，冬季枯水期則只剩乾溪。天然湖泊及人工湖泊共55個，最大的天然湖泊是日月潭，而曾文水庫及翡翠水庫是最大的兩個人工湖泊。目前主要河川、水庫均有執行管制與整治措施。
target_text: There are 119 rivers in Taiwan, most of which are in the direction of things, and which originate in the central mountains or hills. The western rivers are larger than the eastern rivers, with watersheds smaller than 2,000 square kilometres, but there are many rivers connected by irrigation and drainage channels. There are eight rivers of 100 km, the longest river, the most extensive river, the most wide river, and the only river with a navigational capacity, the fresh water stream. The river flow has changed considerably because of the uneven distribution of rainy seasons: heavy rains in the summer, rapid flooding into the sea, and dry streams in the winter.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣具有熱帶至溫帶的氣候帶與多種地形樣貌，因而擁有豐富多樣的生物多樣性。其中臺灣物種共有64,906種，包括動物41,017種、10,704種、病毒、細菌、古菌、原生生物及原藻等6,502種、真菌類6,683種。過去臺灣曾完全被森林覆蓋，現在有60.7%以上面積為森林，且其他植被覆蓋大部分土地。自然植被隨海拔高度、氣候土壤不同變化，分成、、常綠闊葉林、針葉林等；針葉林占全部森林約20%，而近75%森林屬於硬木。臺灣持續推動在低海拔平原種植樹林，並在過半地區（主要是山區和丘陵）禁止。
target_text: Taiwan has a hot-to-temperature climate belt and a variety of topographys, resulting in a variety of species diversity. Of these, 64,906 species, including 41,017 animals, 10,704 viruses, germs, germs, germs, protobiotics and algae, 6,683 fungi. Taiwan was completely forested, now 60.7% of which is forested, and most of the land is covered by other vegetation. Natural vegetation varies with altitude, climate soil, split, green forest, pyrotechnic forest, and so on; pyrotechnic forests account for about 20% of the total forest, while nearly 75% of the forest is hardwood.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 目前已知臺灣有119種哺乳動物、690種鳥類、118種爬行動物、43種兩棲動物、401種蝴蝶、2,992種魚類，並有788種蕨類、5,560種被子植物和111種裸子植物。其中約30%為特有種與特有亞種（包括45種哺乳動物、85種鳥類），其他則與中國大陸物種類似。最大的哺乳動物是臺灣黑熊，並有鹿和野豬出沒，各地候鳥群則在淤灘及紅樹林棲息。離島動植物種類則較少，且缺乏樹木。作為世界保育的重地之一，中華民國持續推動自然資源與環境生態維護，並促進生物多樣性、野生動物及濕地保育、教育推廣工作，並公告臺灣黑熊等保育物種。
target_text: There are currently known to be 119 mammals, 690 birds, 118 reptiles, 43 two animals, 401 butterflies, 2,992 fish species, and 788 herbs, 5,560 herbs, and 111 nudity plants. About 30% of these are endemic and endemic Asians (including 45 mammals, 85 birds) and others are similar to those in China. The largest are Taiwan Black Bears, with deer and boars present, and migratory birds live on silts and mangroves everywhere.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 為了維護自然景觀與保育動植物生態，臺灣地區還設置國家公園、國家自然公園、自然保留區、野生動物保護區、野生動物重要棲息環境、自然保護區，各類型自然生態保護區共98處，約占土地面積19.18%。其中9座國家公園包含許多特殊地形景觀，分別是墾丁國家公園（第一座國家公園）、玉山國家公園、陽明山國家公園、太魯閣國家公園、雪霸國家公園、金門國家公園、東沙環礁國家公園（第一座保育海洋環境的國家公園）、臺江國家公園、澎湖南方四島國家公園，另有首座國家自然公園壽山國家自然公園，累計面積750,479.43公頃。
target_text: In order to preserve the natural landscape and conserve plant life, Taiwan also has a national park, a national park, a natural reserve, a wildlife reserve, an important wildlife environment, a nature reserve, a total of 98 protected areas of all types, or 19.18 per cent of the land. Nine of these parks contain a number of special landscapes, in addition to the Tandin National Park (the first national park), the Taming National Park, the Yang Mingshan National Park, the Tetru National Park, the Snowlord National Park, the Golden National Park, the Golden Gate National Park, the East Shalling Cay National Park (the first national park to protect the marine environment), the Taiji National Park, the Four Island National Park in the South of Lake China, and another National Park in the National Park of Natural Parks in the South of China.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國是半總統制國家，主權屬於國民全體。《中華民國憲法》針對行政機關、立法機關、司法機關三權不足，增加考試及監察兩權。總統為國家元首，下設行政院、立法院、司法院、考試院、監察院。總統對外代表國家，依法公布法律、發布命令、任命官員等；其還設置總統府，並遴選資政、國策顧問及戰略顧問。總統、副總統由中華民國自由地區公民直接選舉，任期4年。行政院為國家最高行政機關，下設30個中央行政機關。行政院院長由總統任命，由其提請總統任命副院長、部會首長、政務委員，組成行政院會議。
target_text: The Chinese People’s Republic of China is a semi-presidential country, with the sovereign power vested in the nation. The Constitution of China has three main powers: the executive, the legislature, and the judiciary. The President is the head of the state, with the executive, legislative, and judicial bodies, increasing the number of examinations and monitoring both. The President is the head of state, with the executive, legislative, judicial, administrative, and supervisory chambers. The president is representing the country by publishing laws, issuing orders, appointing officials, etc., in accordance with the law.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 司法院為國家最高司法機關，掌理解釋、民事、刑事與行政訴訟審判及公務員懲戒；其由司法院大法官組成，設置司法院院長、副院長各1人。考試院為國家最高考試機關，設有考選部、銓敘部、公務人員保障暨培訓委員會及公務人員退休撫卹基金監理委員會；其由考試委員組成，設置考試院院長、副院長各1人。監察院為為國家最高監察機關，設有審計部與國家人權委員會；其由監察委員組成，設置監察院院長、副院長各1人。司法院正副院長、司法院大法官、考試院正副院長、考試委員、監察院正副院長、監察委員由總統提名，經立法院同意後任命。
target_text: The Court of Justice is the highest judicial authority in the country, with interpretation, civil, criminal and administrative appeals and public service judges; it is composed of the Chief Justice of the Judiciary, with one head of the court and one deputy head of the court. It is the highest examining authority in the country, with the Ministry of Elections, the Ministry of Syria, the Office of the Commissioner for the Protection and Training of Public Officials and the Board of Supervisors of the Pension Fund; it is composed of the Examiner Board, with one head and one deputy head of the examination chamber. The Supervisory Board is the highest supervisory authority in the country, with the Department and the National Commission for Human Rights; it is composed of the Supervisory Board, with the Director of the Inspection Board and one member each of the Vice-President of the Board of Directors.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國規定公費補助選舉、投（開）票所監察員等制度，並推動提高透明度、防範貪汙、電子政務等政策。公職人員選舉皆為直接選舉，年滿20歲選民便依戶籍取得投票權，並有登記參選權利與女性保障名額。隨著民主選舉成為重要政治活動，傳播媒體、輿論調查、民間團體和抗議活動越趨重要。各級政府主要歲入為稅課收入、營業盈餘及事業收入、規費、罰款及賠償收入，主要支出為社會福利、教育科學文化、經濟發展、一般政務及國防。2022年度各級1年以上公共債務未償餘額為63,994億元，占前3年度名目國內生產毛額平均數37.70%。
target_text: As democratic elections become an important political event, the importance of broadcasting media, opinion polls, civic groups, and protest campaigns has increased. Public election campaigns are aimed at promoting transparency, anti-corruption, e-government, and so on. Public election campaigns are direct elections, with voters at the age of 20 years voting on their own, with the right to register as candidates and women’s security. With democratic elections becoming an important political event, the importance of publicizing the media, opinion polls, civil society groups, and protest campaigns.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 目前人民團體分成職業團體、社會團體與政治團體（政黨），其中民主進步黨和中國國民黨是兩大政黨，主要政治議題有臺灣統獨問題、海峽兩岸關係、經濟發展等。民主進步黨經常被描述為主張獨立的左派政黨，而中國國民黨是反對獨立的中間偏右政黨。由於總統在政府運作中具有極大影響力，「執政黨」指取得該職位的政黨，目前臺灣已經歷經3次政黨輪替。由於選民傾向保守與地方派系影響，中國國民黨比起民主進步黨更具選舉優勢。在2020年立法委員選舉，民主進步黨、中國國民黨、臺灣民眾黨、時代力量、臺灣基進取得席次。
target_text: The Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) is often described as an independent left-wing party, while the Chinese National Democratic Party (CDP) is an anti-independence middle-right party. Given the President’s great influence in the government’s operations, the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) and the Chinese National Democratic Party (CPD) are two major political parties.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 《中華民國憲法》規範中央政府與地方政府權限劃分採均權主義制度，實施地方自治。其地方自治制度具有部分聯邦制特徵，地方政府在部分領域擁有管轄權。依《地方制度法》規定，地方劃分為省、直轄市。省劃分為縣、市；縣劃分為鄉、鎮、縣轄市。直轄市及市均劃分為區。在省政府改為行政院派出機關後，省不再屬於地方自治團體。目前，中華民國第一層級地方自治團體為直轄市及縣（市），共有6個直轄市、13個縣和3個市，146個鄉、38個鎮、14個縣轄市及170個區。中央政府根據人口和經濟等指標，向地方政府分配財政預算，並推動區域聯合治理。直轄市由行政院直接管轄，擁有更多的行政資源，在區域發展扮演重要的都會角色。
target_text: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China provides for a system of central government and local government power-sharing and local self-government. Its system of local self-government is partly federal, and local governments have jurisdiction in some areas. According to the Local System Act, the regions are divided into provinces and municipalities. The provinces are divided into villages, towns, towns and cities. The municipalities are divided into districts. The municipalities are divided into districts. The provinces are no longer members of local self-government since the provincial government was transferred to the Executive Council.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 直轄市及縣（市）設立直轄市及縣（市）政府，鄉（鎮、縣轄市、直轄市山地原住民區）設立鄉（鎮、縣轄市、直轄市山地原住民區）公所，地方行政首長負責處理機關政務、辦理自治事項等。直轄市及縣（市）也組成直轄市及縣（市）議會，鄉（鎮、縣轄市、直轄市山地原住民區）設立鄉（鎮、縣轄市、直轄市山地原住民區）民代表會，地方民意代表行使立法權和質詢權。地方行政首長和地方民意代表由市民普遍選舉產生，任期4年。直轄市、縣和市選舉往往被視為重要的民主選舉，且地方政府之間彼此競合。目前中華民國首都為臺北市。
target_text: The city and county (city) also have direct municipalities and county (city) governments, village (town, town, city) and sub-district (town) and sub-district (town) and town (town) and town (town) and city) and sub-city (town) and sub-district (town) and sub-district (town) and sub-district (town) and sub-district and sub-district) and local government representatives exercise legislative and advisory authority. The local executive and local public representatives are elected by the people for a four-year term. Direct municipal and county elections are often regarded as important democratic elections, and local governments are now competing with each other in China’s capital, Taiwan City.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 早在1947年，《中華民國憲法》基於三民主義和五權憲法的理論基礎，納入孫中山的民族主義、民權主義和民生主義，並規定周延的自由民權保障。不過1948年後，《動員戡亂時期臨時條款》與《臺灣省戒嚴令》凍結部分《中華民國憲法》條文，並形成「萬年國會」。直至1991年，隨著動員戡亂時期終止，《中華民國憲法》才發揮其民主和法治目的。在1991年至2005年，因應政治現實及國家發展，《中華民國憲法》前後歷經7次憲法修正，增修條文體制改變政府結構。目前憲法修正需要四分之三立法委員決議提出，並經公民投票複決過半數支持。
target_text: As early as 1947, the Constitution of the People of China was based on the doctrine of democracy and the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China. Until 1991, when the unrest ended, the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China proclaimed its democratic and rule-of-law objectives.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 司法院設有憲法法庭、普通法院（、高等法院、最高法院）、行政法院（地方法院行政訴訟庭、高等行政法院、最高行政法院）、懲戒法院、專業法院（智慧財產及商業法院、少年及家事法院）等。憲法法庭由15名司法院大法官組成，審理《憲法訴訟法》所定案件。各級法院掌理民事、刑事、行政及智慧財產訴訟審判，懲戒法院掌理公務員、法官及檢察官懲戒。法官為終身職，經由遴選或考試選拔、並在法務部司法官學院受訓產生；法官必須依法獨立審判，不稱職者可以免職。
target_text: The Constitutional Court is composed of 15 Chief Justices of the Constitutional Court to hear cases under the Constitutional Law. The courts deal with civil, criminal, administrative, and intellectual property claims, and discipline judges, judges and prosecutors in the courts.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 目前法律體系採，繼受歐陸法系國家制定《六法全書》。地方法院和高等法院為事實審，最高法院為法律審。刑事訴訟系統從過去法官兼掌的「糾問主義」，改為檢察官、被告及法院組成的「彈劾主義」，並採國家追訴與私人追訴雙軌制。不過司法體系運作仍遭批評，在2023年新增國民法官制度。地方法院行政訴訟庭為事實審，高等行政法院為事實審與法律審，最高行政法院則是法律審。內政部警政署負責、秩序維護、保安警備等警政工作，使臺灣成為。海洋委員會海巡署平時是海域執法機構，戰時具有國防任務。
target_text: The criminal prosecution system has been transformed from a "challenges" formerly held by judges to "impeachment" by prosecutors, defendants, and courts, to a dual system of state prosecution and private prosecution. But the judicial system is still criticized, with a new system of national judges added in 2023. The local courts' executive chamber is a factual trial, the high administrative court is a factual and legal trial, and the highest administrative court is a legal trial.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 在冷戰前期，中華民國在聯合國代表「中國」，也是聯合國創始會員國暨安全理事會常任理事國。到了冷戰後期，中華人民共和國取得聯合國「中國」席次，中華民國失去國際地位。目前中華民國是45個政府間國際組織及多邊機制（亞太經濟合作會議、世界貿易組織、區域漁業管理組織、國際農牧業組織、國際開發銀行等）的成員國、及27個政府間國際組織及多邊機制觀察員，並積極推動參與聯合國體系、世界衛生組織、經濟合作暨發展組織、警政國際組織等機制。同時中華民國還推動亞太地區自由貿易和經濟整合，與多個國家國簽署自由貿易協定。
target_text: In the pre-cold war period, China was represented by China at the United Nations, and was a permanent member of the founding member of the United Nations Security Council. In the post-cold war period, the People’s Republic of China gained the United Nations “China” seat, and China lost its international status. At present, China is a member of 45 inter-governmental organizations and multilateral mechanisms (the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Conference, the World Trade Organization, the Regional Fishery Organization, the International Agricultural Organization, the International Development Bank, etc.), as well as 27 inter-governmental international organizations and multi-rater observers, actively promoting participation in the United Nations system, the World Health Organization, the International Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, and the International Police Organization.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華人民共和國宣稱擁有臺灣的主權，強迫中華民國接受單方面設定的政治統一框架，不斷進行政治打壓及軍事脅迫。不過雙方持續維持經貿、人員、文教與社會交流，開放並執行多項協議措施，中國大陸也是臺灣最大的貿易夥伴、出口市場及對外投資對象。除此之外，臺灣也與香港、澳門發展關係，並推動僑務工作。目前中華民國與汶萊、中華人民共和國、馬來西亞、菲律賓、越南存在南海諸島爭議，並與日本、中華人民共和國存在釣魚臺列嶼主權問題。中華民國政府支持多邊體系解決領土爭端，提出和平協商處理東海、南海分歧。
target_text: China’s People’s Republic of China claims Taiwan’s sovereignty, forcing the Chinese to accept a single-party framework for political domination and military coercion. But the two sides maintain trade, human, cultural, and social exchanges, open and implement various agreements, and China’s largest trading partner, export market, and foreign investment.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣位處東亞島鏈中心，是鄰近臺灣海峽與呂宋海峽的戰略要地。中華人民共和國至今強調不承諾放棄使用武力侵犯臺灣，持續對臺灣展開軍事演習、侵擾西南空域、間諜情報活動，使其成為中華民國唯一的軍事威脅。中華民國國軍包括陸軍、海軍、空軍，並有憲兵、陸軍後勤、後備、防空飛彈、資通電軍等指揮部。在指揮架構部分，總統為三軍統帥，行使統帥權指揮軍隊；其直接責成國防部部長，由部長命令國防部參謀本部參謀總長執行。國防部主管整體國防事務，依法提交相關報告。另設有提供總統諮詢的國家安全會議，下轄國家安全局。
target_text: The People’s Republic of China has so far stressed that it will not renounce the use of force against Taiwan, and that it will continue to conduct military exercises against Taiwan, disrupt south-west airspace, and spy intelligence activities, making it the only military threat in the country. The Chinese National Army, including the Army, the Navy, the Air Force, and the Commanding Department of the Charter, the Navy’s Reactions, the Resides, the Anti-Air Defense Missiles, the Telecommunications and Power Force, among others. In the command structure, the President, acting as chief commander of the three armies, exercises a leading command force; he is directly responsible for the Ministry of Defence, which orders the Ministry of Defence and its Chief of Staff to take over.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 面對中國人民解放軍威脅，國軍提出「防衛固守、重層嚇阻」的守勢防衛構想，戰力整建放在建立不對稱嚇阻戰力，維持周邊制空權和防禦，並在遭遇攻擊時保存戰力、等待其他國家協防。除了防衛作戰需求，國軍還依令支援反恐行動、及協助地區災害防救。同時中華民國持續與美國、日本等理念相近國家交流，共同應對中華人民共和國的威脅。武器裝備以自主研製優先，其他由現貨市場商購及軍購獲得。目前美國根據《臺灣關係法》出售防衛性武器，但大部分國家不願意出售。另外傳出臺灣擁有攻擊中國大陸、及製造核武器能力。
target_text: In the face of threats from the Chinese People’s Liberation Army, the army has proposed a defensive defense structure called “Defence and Stabilization,” in which it is built to build unconscionable resistance, maintain perimeter air control and defense, and preserve its power in the event of an attack, and wait for other countries to negotiate. In addition to defence needs, the army has ordered support for counter-terrorism operations, as well as aiding disaster prevention in the region.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 在2022年，臺灣國防預算近170億美元，占國內生生排行額2.2%。目前國防人力約有170,000名現役軍人，分成軍職人員（徵兵制與募兵制進用）及文職人員（國家考試進用）。所有年滿18歲至36歲、符合標準的男性須服兵役，學生可延緩入營，並設有替代役制度。役男後續會被納入後備軍人管理，並規劃、空襲演習和災難演習。臺灣每年訓練約120,000名預備役軍人，並計劃將增加到260,000人。女性現役軍人多從事非戰鬥職位，在2021年約占15%。臺灣持續改善並保障軍人權益，並提供各階段軍事教育。
target_text: In 2022, the Taiwan National Defence Budget amounted to nearly US$ 17 billion, or 2.2 per cent of the country’s population, and currently there are about 170,000 national defence personnel, divided into military personnel (recruitment and recruitment) and civil servants (national examinations). All men aged 18 to 36 years old and eligible for military service can be placed in the camps, and there is an alternative service system. The men’s successors will be placed in reserve management, planning, air strike drills and disaster drills. Every year, Taiwan trains about 120,000 pre-commissioned soldiers, and plans to increase to 260,000. Women currently serve in non-war positions, amounting to 15 per cent in 2021.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣經濟屬於資本主義市場經濟，主要由製造業、國際貿易和服務業推動，而大量外匯儲備、勞動生產率增加、產業私有化、政府經濟規劃、亦促成經濟成長。在2021年，名目國內生產毛額7,750億美元，人均名目國內生產毛額33,011美元，人均購買力平價59,398美元。而中央銀行藉由貨幣與外匯政策穩定新臺幣和外匯流通，持有世界排行前幾名的外匯儲備。這些讓臺灣在全球經濟中占有重要地位，與國際社會有極高依存度，並在許多調查排行前幾名，如2022年經濟自由指數第6名、《世界競爭力年鑑》第7名、投資環境風險評比第3名。
target_text: In 2021, Taiwan’s economy was dominated by a capitalist market economy, driven mainly by manufacturing, international trade, and services, with large amounts of foreign reserves, increased labor productivity, privatization of industries, government economic planning, and economic growth. In 2021, the mainland produced $775 billion in gross domestic output, with a per capita GDP of $33,011 and a per capita purchasing power parity of $59,398.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國積極在亞太經濟合作會議與世界貿易組織推動區域和全球經濟一體化，與巴拿馬、瓜地馬拉、尼加拉瓜、薩爾瓦多、宏都拉斯、紐西蘭、新加坡、巴拉圭、史瓦帝尼、貝里斯等國簽署自由貿易協定或經濟合作協定。同時強化貿易合作和產業形象、規劃自由經濟示範區、吸引臺灣商人、中國大陸資金及其他外商投資、推動加入《跨太平洋夥伴全面進步協定》和新南向政策。臺灣證券交易所是世界最大的證券交易所之一，上市公司總家數為971家，總資本額約74,999億元。不過臺灣產業主要基於，且大多是集中在北部的家族企業。
target_text: China has been active in promoting free trade agreements or economic cooperation with the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Conference and the World Trade Organization, promoting regional and global economic integration with Panama, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Salvador, Honduras, New Zealand, Singapore, Paraguay, Swahili, and Belize, among others. The Taiwan Stock Exchange is one of the world’s largest securities exchanges, with a total of 971 companies with a capital of approximately $74,999 million.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 同時期，中華民國勞動力人數平均1,185.3萬人、就業人數平均1,141.8萬人，失業率平均3.67%。臺灣持續推動青年就業和創業，女性勞動人數亦持續增加，勞動參與率平均59.18%。臺灣工會組織率相對較高，勞工抗議較少見。中華民國逐步調整基本工資、縮減工作時數、推動性別平等及友善職場措施、辦理勞工與就業保險及勞動檢查、健全退休金及國民年金制度，並落實工會自主、強化勞資爭議處理。目前臺灣綜合所得稅與營業稅相對較低，但已經出現貧富差距擴大、僱傭市場緊縮、非典型就業等現象，低收入及中低收入戶約58.1萬人。
target_text: During the same period, the number of workers in China averaged 11,185.3 million, the number of workers in the country averaged 1,14.18 million, and the unemployment rate averaged 3.67%. The Gulf continued to promote youth employment and start-up, and the number of female workers increased, with 59.18% participation. The Taiwan Workers’ Union is now relatively well organized, with fewer workers protesting. China gradually adjusted basic wages, reduced hours of work, promoted gender equality and friendly workplace measures, insurance and labour inspections, a sound retirement pension and an annual national pension system, and an autonomous, competitive labour market system.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 2022年，中華民國第一產業占名目國內生產毛額（生產面）1.41%。農業就業人口占4.6%。臺灣氣候溫暖、雨水豐沛，適合作物生長。過去臺灣藉由土地改革、技術引進促成農業發展，但近期因加入世界貿易組織受到衝擊。目前農耕地約78.7萬頃（占土地面積22.7%），但農戶平均耕地0.72公頃，屬小農兼業經營，生產成本高且不具競爭力。稻米是最具價值的主食，主要蔬果有竹筍、捲心菜、西瓜、香菇、綠葉蔬菜和蔥。蔬果、茶葉和為重要出口產品，並出現數百個休閒農場。畜牧業奶製品與肉業經濟規模較小，豬肉與家禽比牛肉更歡迎。
target_text: In 2022, China’s first business accounted for 1.41% of the country’s GDP. Agriculture accounted for 4.6% of the population. The Gulf’s population is warm, rain-fed and cooperative. In the past, Taiwan has been driven by land reform and technology, but it has recently been hit by joining the World Trade Organization (WTO).
title: 中華民國

source_text: 過去、和漁業為重要經濟部門，曾大量開採黃金、硫磺、大理石等資源，但現今重要性下降。採礦業與林業由於資源枯竭及管理限制，僅占經濟總產值一小部分，但木材與竹材產量持續增長。由於資源狀況與影響，漁業由沿海漁業轉為遠洋漁業與，主要出口秋刀魚、石斑魚、吳郭魚等；臺灣南部則有觀賞魚養殖場。目前中華民國政府推動建立產品安全、糧食安全、防疫檢疫等機制，並改善農產品運銷、農作物出口、水利建設、農漁民團體、農漁村環境，以及發展農業創新知識和高經濟價值產業。
target_text: The mining and forestry industries, which account for only a small part of the economy, continue to grow in timber and bamboo production. As a result of the resource situation and influence, the fishing industry has been transformed from a coastal fishing industry into a distant fishing industry, with major exports of acrobats, sulfur, marbles, etc., and the south of Taiwan, where fish farms have been observed. The Chinese government is currently promoting mechanisms such as product safety, food security, quarantine, and so on, and improving agricultural marketing, crop exports, water construction, agro-fishing, agro-fishing, agro-village environments, and the development of new knowledge of agriculture and high economic values.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 2022年，中華民國第二產業占名目國內生產毛額（生產面）37.80%，製造業占34.24%。工業勞動人口占35.4%。在產業結構和貿易政策上，臺灣先後經過勞力密集產業進口替代階段（1950年代）、出口導向二次進口替代階段（1960年代）及資本密集技術導向產業等階段（1980年代）。因此早期政策主要投資、輕工業，其後扶植塑膠、石化、鋼鐵、造船、汽車、電子、半導體產業。其中藉由公營事業推動國家政策，並進口石油建立石化工業。目前臺灣還是半導體、資訊及通訊科技產品的重要生產地，也是主要工業產品、高端零件的提供者。
target_text: In 2022, China’s second-generation industry accounted for 37.80 per cent of GDP and 34.24 per cent of the manufacturing industry. Industrial workers accounted for 35.4 per cent of the population. In terms of industrial structure and trade policies, Taiwan followed a labour-intensive industrial replacement period (1950’s), an export-led secondary-import replacement phase (1960’s) and a capital-intensive technology-oriented phase (1980’s.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 目前中華民國主要生產紡織品、食品加工、塑膠、石油精煉、藥品、化學品、鋼鐵、車輛零件、機具機械、半導體、電子設備、資訊及通訊科技設備、消費品等產品，主要出口產品有電子零組件、資通與視聽產品、金屬及其製品；主要進口產品有電子零件、礦產品與機械。數家臺灣公司在全球市場擁有相當重要的地位，臺灣積體電路製造、聯華電子、華碩、宏碁、宏達國際電子便是知名品牌。中華民國政府希望加速產業升級及結構轉型，建立創新驅動經濟形態，並協助企業布局全球。同時藉由國防工業穩定需求及提升技術，自製軍艦、潛艦、戰鬥機、飛彈等武器。
target_text: At present, China’s main export products are textiles, food processing, plastics, oil refining, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, steel, vehicle parts, machinery, semiconductors, electrical equipment, information and communication technology equipment, and consumer goods. The main export products are electronic zeros, information and visual products, metals and their products. The main import products are electronic parts, minerals, and machines.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 2022年，中華民國第三產業占名目國內生產毛額（生產面）60.78%。服務業勞動人口占60%，是成長速度最快的產業類別，並朝向精緻化與專業化發展。主要服務業有批發和零售貿易、政府服務、金融和保險、房地產（包括出租和租賃）、運輸（包括倉儲）、醫療保健和社會服務、高科技服務、住宿（包括飲食）、教育和文化（包括體育和娛樂）。在商業部門方面，中華民國政府推動電子商務業、國際物流服務、餐飲科技、商業服務設計暨廣告服務業、連鎖加盟業、智慧商業服務加速升級與數位轉型，並強化冷鏈物流、國家標準檢驗、智慧財產權等基礎環境。
target_text: In 2022, China’s third-generation industry accounted for 60.78 per cent of the country’s gross domestic product (products). The services sector accounts for 60 per cent of the labour force, the fastest growing product category, and is moving towards sophistication and specialization. The main service industries are wholesale and retail trade, government services, finance and insurance, real estate (including rental and rental), transport (including warehousing), medical and social care, high-tech services, accommodation (including drinking), education and culture (including sports and recreation). In the business sector, the Chinese government promotes electronic commerce, international logistics services, catering technology, business services and advertising services, chain-up industries, intellectual business services acceleration and digital transformation, and enforces the fundamental environment of cold chain logistics, national standards, intellectual property rights, etc.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 中華民國⾦融機構分成、信用合作社、農會、漁會信用部、票券⾦融公司、證券⾦融公司及⾦融控股公司。其中銀行機構持續拓展據點，保險業經歷快速成長有相當高覆蓋率，證券業和票券業機構則趨於穩定。中華民國政府相當看重自己的文化特色，陸續規劃臺灣世界遺產潛力點、國家公園、國家森林遊樂區、林業文化園區、國家綠道、國家級風景特定區等。在2022年，前來臺灣的旅客共895,962人次，主要來自中國大陸、日本、香港、美國和東南亞；出國國民共1,482,821人次，主要前往中國大陸、日本、美國和歐洲。
target_text: China’s financial institutions are divided, credit unions, farmers’ unions, fishermen’s unions, voucher finance companies, voucher finance companies, and financial holding companies. The bank institutions have a constant outreach point, insurance has a fairly high rate of rapid growth, and the securities industry and voucher institutions are stable. The Chinese government values its cultural identity. It has continuously planned Taiwan’s world heritage potentials, national parks, national forest resorts, forestry cultural parks, national green lanes, national landscapes, etc. In 2022, 895,962 previous arrivals from Taiwan, mainly from China, Japan, Hong Kong, the United States and South-East Asia, and 1,482,821 from China, China, Japan, the United States and Europe.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 臺灣科技發展源於政府對於應用科學的、研發創新與產業升級及私營部門相關投入，這也是其經濟成長的重要動力。早期中華民國政府主要推動民生科技產業與臺灣製造（石化業、鋼鐵業、汽車產業），在1980年代轉為資訊科技（個人電腦、積體電路），目前則推動產業創新及升級轉型；同時還支持學術研究發展，引導大學與企業共同開發高科技、學界成果產業化、培育創新人才。目前中華民國政府支持的產業包含數位資訊及通訊、生物醫學、奈米、綠電及再生能源等技術，也積極推動智慧機械、國防戰略、防災、物聯網、雲端運算及人工智慧等項目。
target_text: In the early 1980s, Taiwan’s technology was transformed into information technology (personal computers, bulk circuits) and is currently promoting innovation and upgrading in the industry; in the same time, it also supported research and development in technology, leading universities and businesses to develop high-tech, productive, and creative talent. The Chinese government is currently supporting digital and communications technology, biomedicine, nano, green electricity, and renewable energy.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 除了培育專業技術及跨領域人才，中華民國政府提供產業投資發展環境、推動國際產業創新聚落。目前臺灣共有13個科學園區，分成新竹科學園區、中部科學園區及南部科學園區三大核心園區，集結大量生物技術、個人電腦設備、積體電路、奈米技術、精密機械和電信領域公司。在2021年，臺灣三大科學園區進駐企業的經濟產值達1,239億美元。臺灣還設立工業技術研究院、國家實驗研究院（含國家高速網路與計算中心、國家奈米元件實驗室、國家太空中心、國家地震工程研究中心、臺灣颱風洪水研究中心）和資訊工業策進會等機構展開多項研究。
target_text: In addition to developing specialized technology and cross-national talent, China’s government has provided an investment environment for the development of its industries and promoted the creation of international industries. There are currently 13 scientific parks in Taiwan, divided into the three main parks of the New Bamboo Science Park, the Central Science Park and the Southern Science Park, which bring together a large number of biotechnologies, personal computer equipment, storage circuits, nanotechnics, precision machines, and telecommunications fields. In 2021, the economics of Taiwan’s three major scientific parks were valued at US$ 1,239 million.
title: 中華民國

source_text: 另一方面，中央研究院是國家學術研究最高機構，招攬自然科學與社會科學頂尖研究人員。中華民國在文學研究、經學、歷史學、考古學、人類學、語言學、宗教學、政治學、法學、經濟學、社會學、心理學、教育學、圖檔學、傳播學、體育學、數學、天文學、物理學、化學、地球科學、生物學、基礎醫學、臨床醫學等學術領域均有研究成果，並朝向全球化、在地化、多元化方向發展。目前臺灣在科技競爭排名領先，如在2019年的《全球競爭力報告》創新能力部分排行第4名，在2021年《世界競爭力年鑑》技術基礎設施和科學基礎設施部份分別排行第9名與第6名。
target_text: On the other hand, the Central Institute is the highest institution of State scientific research, with top researchers in natural and social sciences. China has research in literature, literature, literature, history, archaeology, anthropology, linguistics, religion, politics, law, economics, sociology, psychology, education, graphics, broadcasting, gymnastics, mathematics, astronomy, physics, chemistry, geoscience, biology, foundational medicine, and lay medicine, and has developed towards globalization, localization, and pluralism. Taiwan is currently ranked fourth in the technological competition in 2019 in the Global Competition Report’s New Capabilities, and in 2021 in the 9th and 6th posts in the technological and scientific infrastructure of the World Competition Year.
title: 中華民國
