Albania was one of three countries in which the European economy grew in the first quarter of 2010 after the global financial crisis. The International Monetary Fund predicted Albania ' s growth of 2.6% in 2010 and 3.2% in 2011. According to Forbes data as of December 2016, Albania ' s GDP grew by 2.8%, trade vulnerability was 9.7%, unemployment was 14.7%, and in recent years the government, through fiscal and legislative reforms, began implementing an ambitious business improvement plan, with a substantial increase in foreign investment.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text:
改革之初的經濟問題
阿尔巴尼亚曾經是欧洲最贫穷的国家之一，當時全国約一半的人口依然从事农业种植，但近年其經濟比重比例減少，大約只有20%左右，而且著重於旅遊業和其他第三產業發展。全國大約五分之一的人口在国外工作。国家面临的经济问题主要是較高的失业率，而國內整體失業率約10%至15%左右。雖然過去的阿爾巴尼亞一直依賴農業和重工業，但從事農業的人大多是在用過時的設備及方法來耕作，這阻礙了阿爾巴尼亞的經濟發展。
target_text: At the beginning of the reform, Albania was one of the poorest countries in Europe, where about half of the country’s population was still working in agriculture, but in recent years its share of the economy had declined, at around 20 per cent, and focused on tourism and other third-sector development. About one fifth of the country’s population worked abroad. The country’s economic problems were mainly high unemployment rates, while the country’s overall unemployment rate was about 10 to 15 per cent.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 因為共產政權倒台後起初阿爾巴尼亞國內的貧窮、貪腐、內亂問題十分嚴重，所以阿尔巴尼亚政府在上世紀90年代曾接受了不少外国的经济援助，而主要援助国包括中華人民共和國、希腊、意大利及土耳其。隨著國家經濟持續改善、旅遊業發展蓬勃、治安日益穩定，現時阿爾巴尼亞政府基本上已不再需要歐盟以外的外國經濟援助。
target_text: Since poverty, corruption, and civil strife in Albania began after the fall of the communist regime, the Albanian government received a lot of foreign economic assistance in the 1990’s, with the main donors being the Central African Republic, Greece, Italy, and Turkey. As the country’s economy continued to improve, the tourist industry flourished, and the security situation became more stable, the Albanian government was no longer in need of foreign economic assistance from outside the European Union.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞全國出口產品较少，主要出口肉類、工業原材料、天然資源等，而進口主要来自鄰國希臘和意大利。進口货物的资金主要来自于经济援助和在国外工作的阿爾巴尼亞移民所带回来的收入。希臘政府也通过非正式地向阿尔巴尼亚公民贩卖希腊签证。隨着國家在1990年代民主化後，阿尔巴尼亚公民亦開始有自由出入境和出國旅遊或經商的权利，但為阿爾巴尼亞公民提供免簽證的國家仍不多。正因如此，希臘和意大利在阿尔巴尼亚的主要城市都设有签证机构，一度在阿尔巴尼亚公民自由出入欧盟國家的问题上经常发生非正面冲突，現時情況已逐步改善。
target_text: After the country’s democratization in the 1990s, Albanian citizens began to have the right to freely enter and leave the country and to travel or engage in business, but not many countries provided visa-free visas for Albanian citizens. That is why Greece and Italy have visa agencies in major cities in Albania, where there were often non-positive conflicts over the free movement of Albanian citizens to and from the European Union.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞擁有衛生部運行的普遍保健制度。據世界衛生組織的統計，在2000年阿爾巴尼亞已經名列世界前55位最佳醫療服務表現。雖然阿爾巴尼亞共產主義政權的垮台後的數年醫療服務和制度曾一度陷入崩潰狀態，但是自2000年以來至今醫療服務和制度一直在改革和完善化。在2000年阿爾巴尼亞共有51家醫院，其中包括軍醫和專科設施。最常見的死因是循環系統疾病，其次是癌性疾病。人口和健康調查於2009年4月完成了一項調查，詳細介紹了阿爾巴尼亞的各種衛生統計資料，包括男性變性手術、墮胎和其他方面。死亡的主要原因是心血管疾病、創傷、癌症和呼吸道疾病。目前阿爾巴尼亞已經成功地剷除了瘧疾等疾病。
target_text: Albania has a universal health system operated by the Ministry of Health. According to the World Health Organization, Albania was among the world’s 55 best medical service performances in 2000. Although health services and systems have been in a state of collapse for years since the fall of the Albanian communist regime, medical services and systems have been reformed and improved since 2000. In 2000, there were 51 hospitals in Albania, including military and specialized facilities. The most common causes of death were circulatory diseases, followed by cancer.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 現時阿爾巴尼亞預期壽命估計為77.8歲（男性為75.1歲，女性為80.7歲），排名第37名，超過一些歐盟國家，包括斯洛文尼亞、愛沙尼亞、波蘭、匈牙利和斯洛伐克等國家。阿爾巴尼亞的嬰兒死亡率估計在2015年每千活產死亡12人。與其他歐洲國家相比，阿爾巴尼亞的肥胖率屬於歐洲中等水平，與德國差不多，可能由於地中海飲食的習慣有關，不過近年阿爾巴尼亞肥胖率正在加速上升。
target_text: Albania now has an estimated life expectancy of 77.8 years (75.1 years for men and 80.7 years for women) and is ranked 37th out of a number of European Union countries, including Slovenia, Estonia, Poland, Hungary, and Slovakia. Albania’s infant mortality rate is estimated to be 12 deaths per 1,000 live births in 2015. Compared to other European countries, Albania’s obesity rate is intermediate in Europe, similar to that of Germany, probably linked to eating and eating in the Mediterranean, although it has been rising rapidly in recent years.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 军事阿尔巴尼亚军事部门（，簡稱FASH）是阿尔巴尼亚自1912年独立之后组织的的正规军事部门，其最高指挥为阿尔巴尼亚总参谋部，总参谋部之下则是陆军司令部、海军司令部、防空司令部、后勤部以及训练和教学部。而在2009年加入北約後，阿爾巴尼亞的軍事部門會參加北約定期舉辦的軍演和常規訓練。
target_text: The military wing of the military Albania (known briefly as FASH) is the regular military wing organized by Albania since independence in 1912, with the highest command being the General Staff of Albania, which is under the Army Command, the Naval Command, the Air Defence Command, the Logistics Department, and the Training and Teaching Department. After joining the NATO in 2009, the military department of Albania attended regular military performances and regular trainings in the NATO.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞2023年1月的總人口約為2,761,785，該國人口正進入顯著下降階段，最近連續3年（2020至2022年）阿爾巴尼亞總人口更是以超過1%速度下降，主要原因是西化觀念/經濟考慮驅使愈來愈少阿爾巴尼亞父母生育和更多年青一代出國到西歐美國打工生活有關；其中阿爾巴尼亞出生率處於世界極低水平，該國出生率與大部分東歐巴爾幹國家以及韓國和台灣等東亞國家看齊，總和生育率只有1.3，達到人口急速下降的警戒線（為1.5）範圍。上次人口普查是在2011年進行的。
target_text: Albania ' s total population in January 2023 was about 2,761,785, and the country ' s population is entering a significant downward phase. The recent three-year period (2020-2022) has seen the total population of Albania fall at a rate of more than 1%, mainly because Westernization/economic considerations drive fewer and fewer Albanian parents to give birth and younger generations to work in Western Europe in the United States; the country ' s birth rate is at a very low level in the world, and the country ' s birth rate is at the same level as most Eastern European Balgans, as well as East Asian countries such as Korea and Taiwan.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞劳动党政權在1990年代初瓦解，伴隨著大規模的阿爾巴尼亞人移民出境。外來移民在阿爾巴尼亞劳动黨执政时期被徹底禁止，而國內移民相當有限，因此這是一個新現象。從1991年到2004年，約有90萬人從阿爾巴尼亞遷出，其中約60萬人在希臘定居。移民極大地影響了阿爾巴尼亞的國內人口分佈。人口在該國10個州縣減少只有2個州縣增加，即地拉那和都拉斯兩個州縣。根據統計局在2015年1月1日，阿爾巴尼亞人口有2,893,005，到了2023年人口跌至只有2,761,785，僅僅8年間阿爾巴尼亞跌幅達4.54%。
target_text: From 1991 to 2004, about 900,000 people moved out of Albania, some 600,000 of whom settled in Greece. The migration landscape affected Albania’s internal population. Only two less than the country’s 10 counties, namely, the counties of Tirana and Durres, increased. According to the Bureau of Statistics, on 1 January 2015, the population of Albania was 2,893,005, and fell to 2,761,785 in 2023, with only 8 years of Albania falling by 4.54 per cent.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 種族問題是一個棘手的話題，有待討論。官方統計顯示，該國主要民族為阿爾巴尼亞人，佔97％以上，而少數民族（如阿爾巴尼亞的希臘人、阿爾巴尼亞的馬其頓人、阿爾巴尼亞的黑山人、阿爾巴尼亞的羅姆人以及阿爾巴尼亞的阿羅馬人）經常對此官方數字提出異議（當中又以希臘人和馬其頓人為主），認為該國少數民族人口比例應較高。根據有爭議的2011年人口普查，所屬族群：阿爾巴尼亞人為2,312,356人（佔總數的82.6％）、希臘人為 24,243人（0.9％）、馬其頓人為5,512人（0.2％）、黑山人為366人（0.01％）、阿羅馬人為8,266人（0.30％）、羅姆人為8,301人（0.3％）巴爾幹埃及人為3,368人（0.1％）、其他種族為2,644人（0.1％）、沒有透露為390,938人（14.0％）、不相關為44,144人（1.6％）。關於具體人口普查的數據，保護少數民族框架公約諮詢委員會指出，應當極為謹慎地看待人口普查結果，並呼籲當局不要完全依靠普查期間收集的關於確定其保護少數民族政策的國籍數據。
target_text: Ethnicity is a difficult issue to discuss. According to official statistics, the main ethnic group in the country is Albanian, accounting for more than 97 per cent of the population, while minority ethnic groups (e.g. Greeks in Albania, Macedonians in Albania, Montenegrins in Albania, Roma in Albania, and Albanians in Albania) often disagree on the official figure (with Greeks and Macedonians as the majority), considering that the proportion of the minority population in the country should be higher: 2,312,356 (82.6 per cent of the total), 24,243 (0.9 per cent), 5,512 (0.2 per cent), Montenegrins (0.01 per cent), 8,266 (0.30 per cent), Roma (8,30 per cent), 301 (0.3 per cent), Egyptians (3,0.6 per cent) and others (0,0,0,0,1 per cent) of the total population), according to the contested 2011 census, the number of ethnic groups in Albania is low, while the number of ethnic groups is low (44,0,0,0,0 per cent of the population) is low, and the number of national population (44, 0,3 per cent of the national population
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞承認三個國內少數民族，包括希臘人、馬其頓人及黑山人，以及兩個文化少數民族：阿羅馬人和羅姆人。其他阿爾巴尼亞少數民族是保加利亞人、戈蘭人、塞爾維亞人、巴爾幹埃及人、波斯尼亞人及猶太人。對於希臘人團體來說，很難知道阿爾巴尼亞有多少希臘人，希臘政府一般認為，阿爾巴尼亞大約有30萬希臘人居住，但是大多數西方國家估計大約在20萬。阿爾巴尼亞政府推算只有24243人。"CIA世界概況估計希臘少數民族比例佔0.9％，美國國務院對希臘人的推算比例為1.17％，其他少數民族比例則為0.23％。然而，由於衡量受到希臘人抵制的影響，後者質疑希臘少數民族數據的有效性。
target_text: Albania recognizes three minority groups within the country, including Greeks, Macedonians and Montenegrins, and two cultural minorities: the Aroman and Rom. Other Albanian minority groups are Bulgarians, Gorans, Serbs, Balgan Egyptians, Bosniaks, and Jews. For the Greek community, it is hard to know how many Greeks there are in Albania, and the Greek government generally believes that about 300,000 Greeks live in Albania, but most Western countries estimate about 200,000.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞語是阿爾巴尼亞共和國的官方語言。它的標準口語和書面形式是從兩種主要方言-盖格方言（Gheg）和托斯克方言進行修訂和合併，儘管它更多地基於托斯克方言。什昆賓河是兩種方言之間的粗略分界線。希臘語的方言保留現在在標準現代希臘語中丟失的特徵，在希臘少數民族居住的地區使用。阿爾巴尼亞少數民族使用的其他語言包括阿羅馬尼亞語，塞爾維亞語、馬其頓語、波斯尼亞語、保加利亞語、古拉尼語及羅馬尼亞語。馬其頓語是東阿爾巴尼亞Pustec市的官方語言。根據2011年的人口普查，2,765,610人或98.767％的人口宣稱阿爾巴尼亞語為母語（“母語被定義為兒童時期在家中使用的第一語言或主要語言”）。
target_text: Albanian is the official language of the Republic of Albania. Its standard spoken and written form is a revision and integration from two main dialects, Gheg and the Tosk dialect, although it is more based on the Tosk dialect. The Shikunbin River is a rough line between two dialects. The Greek dialect is the official language of the city of Pustec, Eastern Albania. According to the 2011 census, 2,765,610 people or 98.7% of the population of the minority ethnic group in Albania use other languages such as Albanian, Macedonian, Bosniac, Bulgarian, Guaraní and Romani.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 希臘語是該國第二大口語，有0.5％至3％的人口將其稱為第一語言，三分之二的阿爾巴尼亞家庭至少有一名會員講希臘語，其中大多數是在後共產主義時代（1992年至今）因私立學校或移民到希臘而學習的。在南方小的指定“少數民族地區”之外，希臘語的教學在阿爾巴尼亞共產主義時期被禁止。截至2003年，希臘在阿爾巴尼亞和地拉那的一所私立學校提供100多所私人補習中心，這是希臘境外的第一所私立補習中心。近年來，學生人數不斷減少。致力於希臘少數民族的學校給教師帶來了麻煩。由於與鄰國希臘的文化和經濟聯繫，希臘語在該國南部佔很大比例。在阿爾巴尼亞政府統計機構Instat進行的2017年研究中，25-64歲的39.9％的阿爾巴尼亞人能夠使用至少一種外語，其中能說英語的阿爾巴尼亞人為40.0％；其次是意大利語，佔27.8％；希臘語為22.9％。在年齡25歲或以下的阿爾巴尼亞年輕人中，英語，德語和土耳其語在2000年之後的興趣不斷增加。意大利語和法國語的興趣穩定，而希臘語失去了大部分興趣。 趨勢與文化和經濟因素有關。
target_text: The Greek language is the country's second-largest spoken language, with 0.5 to 3 per cent of the population calling it the first-language language and at least one member of an Albanian family speaking Greek, most of them in the post-communist era (1992-present) as a result of private schools or immigration to Greece. Beyond the small “minor ethnic areas” of the South, Greek language teaching was banned in Albania during the period of communism. As of 2003, Greece provided more than 100 private learning centres in a private school in Albania and Tirana, the first private learning centre outside Greece.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 近年來，年輕人對德語的興趣越來越濃厚。他們中的一些人去德國學習或參加各種經歷。阿爾巴尼亞和德國簽署了合作協議，幫助兩國青年更好地了解這兩種文化。由於與土耳其的經濟關係急劇增加，人們對土耳其語學習的興趣，特別是年輕人對土耳其語的學習興趣每年都在增長。受到土耳其投資的經濟重要性和兩國共同價值觀所吸引的年輕人，可以從大學的文化和學術合作中獲益。2011年，土耳其人擁有的Epoka大學授以土耳其語、英語及法語，被選為阿爾巴尼亞最好的外語和外國大學。
target_text: In recent years, young people have become more interested in German. Some of them have gone to Germany to study or participate in various experiences. Albania and Germany have signed cooperation agreements to help young people in both countries better understand these two cultures. As a result of the dramatic increase in economic relations with Turkey, interest in Turkish language learning, especially among young people, is growing every year. Young people attracted by the economic importance of Turkish investment and shared values can benefit from cultural and academic cooperation at universities.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 在1991年阿爾巴尼亞共產主義政權的垮台之後，宣布將義務教育計劃從8年擴展到10年的重組計劃。1992年，阿爾巴尼亞的1997年阿爾巴尼亞危機戰爭以及隨之而來的公共秩序崩潰，使教育和學校管理制度陷入混亂。教科書和用品的廣泛破壞和極度短缺對學校運作造成破壞性的影響，這促使意大利和其他國家提供物質援助。1990年代末，許多學校開始重建，以改善學生學習的條件。大部分改善發生在該國較大的城市，特別是在地拉那，都拉斯和斯庫台。
target_text: In 1992, Albania’s 1997 Albanian crisis and the ensuing breakdown of public order plunged education and school administration into chaos. The widespread destruction and extreme shortage of teaching books and supplies had a devastating effect on school operations, prompting Italy and other countries to provide material assistance. In the late 1990’s, many schools began to rebuild to improve student learning.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 在阿爾巴尼亞推行民主化改革政策之後，新的阿爾巴尼亞政府完全廢除共產主義的教育模式，並逐漸採用歐盟和美國教育模式，使阿爾巴尼亞新一代能夠接受21世紀的西方教育。經過30年的教育改革，阿爾巴尼亞的幼稚園和小學入學率較其他中東歐國家更高，但相比西歐國家來說仍有進步空間。
target_text: Following Albania’s policy of democratization reform, the new Albanian government has completely eliminated the communist model of education, and has gradually adopted the European Union and the United States model of education to make Albania’s 21st century Western education accessible to a new generation. After 30 years of educational reform, Albania’s kindergarten and primary school enrolment rates are higher than in other Central and Eastern European countries, but there is still room for progress than in Western Europe.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞的所有教育計劃由教育部及市政當局負責管理。教育系統資金主要由政府公帑提供，一共分為三個階級，包括小學教育（arsimifillorë）、中學教育（arsimi imesëm）和高等教育（arsimiuniversitarë）。學年年期的長度與美國相似，一般從9月或10月開學，到6月或7月結束，其餘的2至3個月為暑假。阿爾巴尼亞語是所有公立學校的主要教學語言。小學教育一年級至九年級為義務教育，小學九年級學生必須通過畢業考試，合格的學生方能繼續升學。中學提供普通教育，普通教育為學生應付Matura高級程度考試做好準備，讓他們提供取得他們的文憑畢業證書的機會，取得文憑畢業證書的學生可以入讀高等教育和大學課程。雖然阿爾巴尼亞政府實行2007年“高等教育法”的博洛尼亞模式，但這些機構可以是公立或私立的，可以根據高等教育法提供一，二，三級的高等教育。
target_text: All educational programs in Albania are administered by the Ministry of Education and the municipal authorities. The education system is funded mainly by the government, and is divided into three levels, including primary education (arsimihillë), secondary education (arsimi memesëm) and higher education (arsimiuniversitarë). The length of the academic year is similar to that in the United States, usually starting in September or October, and ending in June or July, with the remaining two to three months of summer vacation.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text:
總論
阿爾巴尼亞是一個文化共融的國家，融合了伊斯蘭和西方的文化，包括了古希臘、古羅馬、拜占庭帝國、鄂圖曼帝國文化，同時也包括了阿爾巴尼亞傳統文化。在2000年代之前的阿爾巴尼亞的是一個保守、封閉及文化單一的國家，當時的阿爾巴尼亞是一個盛行霍查主義和男尊女卑的國家。不過至從2000年代中後期起阿爾巴尼亞的社會開始走向性別平等和西化。2017年的全球性別差距報告中阿爾巴尼亞得分為0.728分，全球排名第38名，反映現時阿爾巴尼亞社會已變成男女平等的局面。
target_text: In general, Albania is a country with a common culture that integrates Islamic and Western cultures, including ancient Greece, ancient Rome, Byzantine Empire, Ottoman Empire, and Albanian tradition at the same time. Albania was a conservative, closed, and monocultural country before the 2000’s, when Albania was a country with a prevalence of Hochaism and inferiority. But Albania’s society began to move towards gender equality and westwards from the late 2000’s.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 另外近年阿爾巴尼亞的社會支持同性戀的比率也如支持性別平等般逐年增加，在2018年同性戀平權網站發布的全球報告中，有56%的阿爾巴尼亞人支持同性戀行為，且有33%的阿爾巴尼亞人支持同性婚姻合法化。而現任阿爾巴尼亞總理埃迪·拉馬亦表態支持保障同性戀權利。
target_text: In recent years, Albania’s social support for homosexuality has increased, as has support for gender equality. In 2018, 56% of the Albanian population supported homosexuality, and 33% of the Albanian population supported the legalization of same-sex marriage.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞音樂是阿爾巴尼亞民族特徵的重要組成部分，並繼續在阿爾巴尼亞音樂中發揮重要作用。雖然它可以分為北部Gheg、南部Lab及Tosk進行的兩個文化體系組別。北部和南部的傳統音樂以及北部複雜的音調和南部的鬆弛的旋律形成鮮明對比。許多歌曲是關於阿爾巴尼亞歷史的事件，包括民族英雄斯坎德培和有關榮譽、招待、背叛和復仇的傳統主題。阿爾巴尼亞民間音樂的第一個彙編是由巴黎兩位Himariot音樂家NeçoMuka和KoçoÇakali在他們對這首歌曲Diva Tefta TashkoKoço。這三位藝術家記錄了這幾年來錄製的幾首歌曲，這最終導致了阿爾巴尼亞傳統音樂曲目Himariot Isopoly作為聯合國教科文組織音樂記錄當中的世界文化遺產。
target_text: Albanian music is an important component of Albania’s national identity and continues to play an important role in Albanian music. Though it can be divided into two cultural systems in the north of Gheg, southern Lab, and Tosk. The traditional music of the north and south, as well as the complicated tunes of the north and the loose melody of the south, forms a clear comparison. Many songs are about the history of Albania, including the national hero Skandepe and the traditional themes of honour, hospitality, betrayal and revenge.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 現代阿爾巴尼亞的流行音樂和藝術家如芮塔·歐拉、杜娃·黎波、碧碧·蕾克莎、埃爾莫利拉·亞霍、英瓦·穆拉及艾拉·斯特菲，他們的音樂已經獲得國際認可。斯波拉諾埃爾莫利拉·亞霍被經濟學家描述為世界上最受好評的女高音。阿爾巴尼亞國際歌劇演唱家薩里爾·皮爾古（阿爾巴尼亞語：Saimir Pirgu）是一位得到廣泛認可的音樂家，他來自艾巴申。他被提名為2017年格萊美獎得獎者。
target_text: Modern Albanian pop music and artists like Rita Ola, Duva Lepo, Bebe Reza, Elmollira Yahor, Inva Mula and Ella Steffi have gained international recognition for their music. Spornoel Molila Yahor was described by economists as the most highly regarded soprano in the world. The Albanian international opera singer, Saril Pirgu, was a widely recognized musician from Abashen. He was nominated as the winner of the 2017 Grammy Prize.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞的每個文化和地理區域都有各自不同的風格、材料、顏色、形狀、細節及形式的服裝。目前，民族服飾經常與特殊活動和慶典有關，主要集中在民族節日，宗教節日，婚禮，舞蹈團體等。一些保守的男女長者，主要來自北部和南部一些郊區，在日常生活中會穿著傳統阿爾巴尼亞民族服裝。服裝主要由當地農畜產品如皮革、羊毛、亞麻、大麻纖維、絲綢製成。如今，傳統的紡織品仍然以非常協調的古代圖案繡製而成。
target_text: There are different styles, materials, colours, shapes, details, and forms of dress in every culture and geographical area of Albania. National costumes are now often associated with special events and celebrations, mainly national festivals, religious festivals, weddings, dance groups, etc. Conservative women and men elders, mainly from the northern and southern suburbs, wear traditional Albanian costumes in everyday life.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞語由印歐語系系列組成。該語言被認為是印歐語系中的語言隔離。唯一倖存的印歐語分支的其他語言是亞美尼亞語和希臘語。它在1854年由德國語言學家弗兰茨·博普證明是印歐語。阿爾巴尼亞語經常被認為與伊利里亞語有關，伊利里亞語於古典時期在巴爾幹地區使用的語言。學者們爭辯說阿爾巴尼亞人來自伊利里亞人而另一些人聲稱它來自Daco-色雷斯人。（然而，伊利里亞語和色雷斯語可能是密切相關的語言；參見Thraco-Illyrian。）
target_text: The language is considered to be the language of the Indo-European language community. The other languages of the only surviving branch of the Indo-European language are Armenian and Greek. It was proved in 1854 by the German linguist Franz Bop. The language of Albania is often considered to be related to the Italian language, which was used in the Barcan region during the classical period. Scholars argue that the Albanian language is from the Italians, while others claim that it is from the Daco-Sares. (However, the Italian and Thrace languages may be closely related; see Thraco-Illyrian).
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 文化復興首先表現在教會文本和出版物領域阿爾巴尼亞語的發展，主要是阿爾巴尼亞北部的天主教地區，而且東正教。阿爾巴尼亞在南部，當神職人員Gjon Buzuku將阿爾巴尼亞語天主教禮儀納入阿爾巴尼亞語時，新教改革激發了對當地語言和文學傳統發展的希望，試圖為阿爾巴尼亞語作出改革的馬丁·路德為德語和阿爾巴尼亞語翻譯。由Gjon Buzuku撰寫的Meshari（The Missal）於1555年出版，被認為是中世紀第一部阿爾巴尼亞文學作品之一。語言的精確程度和穩定的拼寫法必須是早期傳統的阿爾巴尼亞語寫作的結果，這一傳統尚未得到很好的理解。然而，在Buzuku之前存在一些支離破碎的證據，這表明阿爾巴尼亞語至少是在14世紀寫成的。
target_text: In the south, when Gjon Buzuku, a cleric, published in 1555 as one of the first Albanian-language works in the Middle Ages, opened up hopes for the development of local linguistic and literary traditions, and Martin Luther, who was trying to reform the Albanian language, translated German and Albanian. However, evidence of the fragmentation of the Meshari (The Missal), written by Gjon Buzuku, was found to be one of the first Albanian-language works in the Middle Ages.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 最早的證據可以追溯到公元1332年，來自Antivari的法國多米尼加Guillelmus Adae，Archbishop的拉丁文報告，他寫道阿爾巴尼亞人在他們的書中使用了拉丁字母，儘管他們的語言與拉丁語完全不同。其他重要的例子包括：洗禮公式（Unte paghesont premenit Atit et Birit et spertit senit）自1462年起，由阿爾巴尼亞人在都拉斯主教的拉丁文中寫成，PalEngjëlli;阿爾巴尼亞語的阿爾巴尼亞語單詞1497由阿爾巴尼亞人經過的阿爾巴尼亞語，以及馬太福音的15世紀聖經片段使用阿爾巴尼亞語，但以希臘字母書寫。
target_text: The earliest evidence goes back to 1332 A.D., the Latin report of the French Dominican Guillermo Adae, Archbishop, Antivari, who wrote that the Albanian people used Latin letters in their books, although their language was different from that of Latin. Other important examples are the baptism formula (Unte paghesont premenit et Birit et spertit senit), written by the Albanian people in the Latin of the Archbishop of Durres, PalEngjëlli; and the Albanian word 1497, which is spoken by the Albanian people, as well as the Romanic 15th-century Bible, which uses the Albanian language, but is written in the Greek alphabet.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 這幾個世紀以來的阿爾巴尼亞著作不應僅僅是宗教文本，而是歷史編年史。人道主義者Marin Barleti提到了他們，他們在1504年的書《Shkodra之圍》（Rrethimi i Shkodrës）證實了他的葉子通過用人們的語言（vernacula lingua）寫的這些編年史以及他著名的斯坎德培的傳記。“斯坎德培歷史”仍然是斯坎德培研究的基礎，被認為是阿爾巴尼亞文化寶藏，對阿爾巴尼亞民族自我意識的形成至關重要。
target_text: These centuries of Albanian writings should not be merely religious texts, but historical history. The humanitarians, Marin Barleti, referred to them, and their book Rrethimi i Shkodrës, of 1504, confirms that his leaves are vital to the formation of self-awareness among the Albanian nation by writing in people's languages (vernacula lingua) and his famous Scenderpe. “Scandpe History” remains the cornerstone of Skandpe’s research and is considered to be the cultural treasure of Albania.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 最初的阿爾巴尼亞電影主要是紀錄片；第一個是關於莫納斯提爾大會在1908年批准阿爾巴尼亞語字母。在共產政權時期，後來被稱為Kinostudio Shqipëria e Re的阿爾巴尼亞電影學院在蘇聯援助下成立，專注於主要是對戰時鬥爭的宣傳。共產黨政府於1952年創立Kinostudio Shqipëria e Re。隨後是第一部阿爾巴尼亞史詩電影《The Great Warrior Skanderbeg》，與蘇聯藝術家合作，記錄了阿爾巴尼亞民族英雄斯坎德培的生活和戰鬥。該片獲得1954年戛納電影節國際獎。
target_text: The original Albanian film was primarily a documentary; the first was about the signing of the Albanian alphabet by the Monastire Congress in 1908. During the Communist regime, the Albanian cinema, known as Kinostudio Shqipëria e Re, was founded with the help of the Soviet Union. The communist government founded Kinostodio Shqipëria e Re in 1952. The first Albanian epic film, The Great Warior Skanderbeg, in collaboration with Soviet artists, recorded the life and battle of the Albanian national hero Skandepe.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 到了1990年，阿爾巴尼亞已經製作了大約200部電影，阿爾巴尼亞有超過450部電影院。隨著20世紀90年代共產主義政權崩潰後的經濟轉型，Kinostudio被打破並私有化。一個新的國家電影攝影中心成立，而城市建立了現代電影院，主要是美國電影。地拉那國際電影節成立於2003年，已成為該國和巴爾幹地區首屈一指的最大電影節。都拉斯舉辦國際電影都拉斯電影節，這是該國第二大國際電影節，每年8月底或9月初在杜勒斯露天競技場舉行。
target_text: By 1990, Albania had produced about 200 films, with more than 450 cinemas in Albania. Kinostudio was broken and privatized as a result of the economic transformation following the collapse of the communist regime in the 1990s. A new National Film and Film Centre was established, and cities established modern cinemas, mainly American films. Tirana International Film Festival was established in 2003 as the largest film festival in the country and in the Balkan region.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text:
習俗
阿爾巴尼亞人以友善、禮貌、好客見稱，一般都會十分主動向別人打招呼、問好和握手，有需要時會協助對方解決問題，即使是面對外國遊客時做法也是一樣。另外阿爾巴尼亞人也講究家庭和友誼觀念，男女地位相對平等。值得一提是阿爾巴尼亞日常人與人之間的非語言溝通中的點頭是代表不是（no）的意思而搖頭是代表是（yes）的意思。
target_text: It is customary for Algerians to say, with kindness, courtesy, hospitality, and handshake, that they are generally very motivated to greet, greet, and shake hands, and help each other when they need it, even in the face of foreign tourists. There is also a sense of family and friendship, with equal status between men and women. It is worth mentioning that the point in the non-linguistic communication between ordinary people and people in Albania is that it is not the meaning of "no" but that it is the meaning of "yes."
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 在霍查统治期间，由于担心苏联、美国、希腊、意大利、南斯拉夫入侵阿尔巴尼亚，在全国各地修建70多万个碉堡。時至今日，阿尔巴尼亚各地都有碉堡分佈，故阿尔巴尼亚被称为“碉堡王国”。由於現今的阿爾巴尼亞政府和人民不喜歡象徵着霍查和勞動黨政權的碉堡，加上拆除碉堡過程十分困難和成本高，因此近年部分阿爾巴尼亞碉堡已改變了用途，例如青年旅舎、博物館、餐廳、咖啡館等。
target_text: During the reign of Hoxha, over 700,000 bunkers were built throughout the country because of concerns about the invasion of Albania by the Soviet Union, the United States, Greece, Italy, Yugoslavia. To date, Albania has been known as “the Kingdom of Fortress” since today's Albanian government and people do not like bunkers that symbolize the political power of Hoxha and the Labour Party, and the difficult and costly process of dismantling the fort has led to the diversion of parts of Albania in recent years, such as youth brigades, museums, restaurants, cafés, etc.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿尔巴尼亚最著名的作家是凡·诺利（）和伊斯梅尔·卡达莱（）。建築由於歷史悠久，阿爾巴尼亞擁有許多重要的文化和歷史地標。從古代古典到現代，國內主要城市已經從城堡內部發展到包括住宅，宗教和商業結構，不斷地重新設計城市廣場，建築技術的進化。
target_text: The most well-known writers in Albania are Van Norley and Ismail Kadale. Constructions have a long history, and Albania has many important cultural and historical landmarks. From ancient classical to modern times, the country’s major cities have evolved from the inner part of the castle to include homes, religious and commercial structures, the constant re-engineering of urban squares, and the evolution of building techniques.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 現時阿爾巴尼亞著名的建築風格包括科爾察中的歷史主義和新藝術，而且現代意大利風格也存在於斯庫台、夫羅勒、薩蘭達及都拉斯。其他城市通過各種文化或經濟影響獲得了當今阿爾巴尼亞獨特的外觀。由於拜占庭帝國的長期統治，阿爾巴尼亞擁有許多拜占庭式建築的教堂、城堡和修道院。阿爾巴尼亞還擁有五百年來鄂圖曼統治的許多倖存的紀念碑。在十九世紀，阿爾巴尼亞的城鎮經歷了由匈牙利和意大利建築師的城市轉型，讓他們看起來像歐洲城市。在阿爾巴尼亞共產主義時期，修建了許多社會主義風格的建築群，寬闊的道路和工廠，重新設計了城市廣場，並拆除了一些歷史悠久的建築物。
target_text: Other cities gained a unique look from today’s Albania through various cultural or economic influences. With the long rule of the Byzantine Empire, Albania had many Byzantine-style churches, castles, and monasteries. Albania also had many of the monuments that had survived the rule of Tuman for 500 years. In the nineteenth century, Albania experienced a transformation of its cities by Hungarian and Italian architects, making them look like European cities.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 自從1990年代阿爾巴尼亞推行民主化及推行資本主義之後，阿爾巴尼亞民主政府開始實行雄心勃勃的去共化運動，大規模地拆除及改建前共產政權大量建築，例如將不少碉堡變為前共產政權政治犯紀念館/咖啡廳和餐廳/流浪動物收容所/酒店旅館等用途，以及拆除對恩維爾霍查所有個人崇拜物件，令阿爾巴尼亞擺脫前共產陰霾；將前共產政權拆除的各種宗教場所重新建立，包括天主教、猶太教及東正教堂和清真寺都能夠為阿爾巴尼亞各派教徒提供各類祈禱/禮拜/宗教活動等服務，這使阿爾巴尼亞贏得全球首20名宗教最包容國家美譽；將日久失修的樓宇翻新使它們成為歐式美式或具有阿爾巴尼亞民族特色的建築物，目的是把阿爾巴尼亞打造成為一個包容新舊以及其他西方文化的國家。
target_text: Since the democratization and capitalism of Albania in the 1990s, the Albanian Democratic Government has embarked on an ambitious de-communization campaign, the massive dismantling and renovation of former communist State buildings, such as the conversion of a number of bunkers to former communist political prisoners' memorials/cafés and restaurants/vagrant animal shelters/tavern hotels, and the dismantling of all personal worships in Enverhocha, which resulted in the removal of former communist sites and the re-establishment of various religious sites, including the Catholic, Jewish and Orthodox churches and mosques, with the aim of creating Albania as a country that embraces modern and other Western cultures.
title: 阿尔巴尼亚

source_text: 阿爾巴尼亞擁有兩個文化聯合國教科文組織世界遺產，包括薩蘭達南部布特林特的古代遺跡，以及中世紀的培拉特和吉羅卡斯特歷史中心。以及喀爾巴阡山脈原始山毛櫸森林和歐洲其他地區古山毛櫸森林和奧赫里德地區的自然和文化遺產。此外，下塞爾塞皇家陵墓、阿波羅尼亞、巴什托維堡壘、杜勒斯露天競技場已列入暫定名單。
target_text: Albania has two United Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) World Heritage Sites, including ancient monuments in Butrint, south of Saranda, as well as the central-century historical centres of the Berat and Gilokaster. source_text:
2011年宗教普查漏洞
2011年的宗教普查引起了有关阿尔巴尼亚宗教成分的争议。其原因是普查人员未能够与南部大量东正教社群取得联系。只有34%的阿尔巴尼亚正教基督徒被普查人员联系过。此外，普查人员有时在没有受调查人见证的情况下径自随意填写了其宗教信仰并在调查问卷上违规地使用铅笔填写。有时，整个社群声称完全没有被联系过。有计70%的被调查者拒绝在列出的宗教列表上选择自己的信仰。阿尔巴尼亚正教会与苏菲派拜克塔什教团对调查结果提出了质疑与抗议。
target_text: The 2011 Religious Census was flawed, and the 2011 Religious Census generated controversy about the religious composition of Albania. This was due to the fact that the censusers were unable to reach out to a large number of Orthodox communities in the south. Only 34 per cent of Albanian Orthodox Christians were contacted by the censusers. Moreover, the censusers sometimes filled out their religious beliefs at random, without being witnessed by the respondents, and used pencils irregularly on questionnaires. In some cases, the entire community claimed that it had not been contacted at all. 70 per cent of the respondents refused to choose their faith on the list of religions.

source_text: 黑龙江省，简称黑，位于中国东北地区北部，是中华人民共和国最靠北和最靠东的省份，省会驻地为哈尔滨。中俄界河黑龙江为境内最大河流，省名由江名而来。省界东、北与俄罗斯接壤，南接吉林省，西邻内蒙古自治区，全省土地面积共47.3万平方公里（含加格达奇、松岭），排名全国第6。2022，全省常住人口约3099万人，其中汉族占95%以上，另有回族、满族、蒙古族、朝鲜族等53个少数民族。黑龙江省是中国重要的装备制造业、能源工业与农业基地，工业门类以机械、能源、食品、医药工业为主；粮食总产量和商品粮调出量均居全国首位。省人民政府駐哈尔滨市南岗区中山路202号。

The province is bordered by the north and the south by the Russian Federation, Jilin Autonomous Region in the west, with a total land area of 473,000 square kilometres (including Gagdachi and Songling) and ranks 6th all over the country. 2022 The province has a permanent resident population of about 3099 million people, 95 per cent of whom are Han, and 53 ethnic minorities, including the Hui, Man, Mongolian and Korean communities. title: 黑龙江省

source_text: 916年，契丹族首领耶律阿保机建立辽朝（大契丹国），与南边的北宋王朝并存。辽代今黑龙江地区归东京道管辖。1115年，生活在今黑龙江阿什河流域的女真完颜部完颜旻建金朝，定都于上京会宁府（今黑龙江省哈尔滨市阿城区）。1125年金灭辽，1127年灭北宋。后迁都中都（今北京一带），再迁都至汴京（今河南开封），黑龙江地区仍归上京路管辖。1234年（金天兴三年），蒙古与南宋联合灭金朝，黑龙江流域分属岭北行省和辽阳行省，元中叶以后，黑龙江流域为开元路和水达达路所辖，并派军队屯田镇守。元朝并在黑龙江下游东岸的奴儿干城设置征东元帅府。明永乐七年（1409年）在元征东元帅府旧址设奴儿干都司，管辖黑龙江与乌苏里江等流域的所有军事建制机构，永乐九年（1411年）正式开始行政管辖权。都司的主要官员初为派驻数年而轮调的流官，后为当地部落领袖所世袭。宣德九年（1434年）正式废弃，共持续25年，但原设于此处的卫所仍然存在，以对当地继续实施羁縻统治。清初将这里作为自己的起源禁地，禁止汉人入内，并作为流放犯人之地。清顺治四年（1647年）在宁古塔地区设置牛录章京，1653年设宁古塔昂邦章京，1662年升驻宁古塔将军。康熙十三年（1674年），将吉林水师营移驻黑龙江。康熙二十一年（1682年），清政府提出在黑龙江、呼玛尔两地建城。

1907年4月（清光绪三十三年三月），清廷裁撤黑龙江、吉林、奉天将军，设立东北三省。黑龙江省的行政区域承袭黑龙江将军管辖范围，东南和南部与吉林省毗连，西南与奉天省为邻，西部与蒙古接壤，北部和东北部以黑龙江与俄国为界。全省总面积约57万余平方公里，省治齐齐哈尔城。
target_text: After the second opium war in the 19th century, the Qing Government was forced to sign a treaty and a Beijing treaty to cede to Russia about 1 million square kilometres of Chinese territory north of the Heilong River and east of the Ursuri River. During the period of Qing Qingqing and Kuo-ho, the Heilongjiang area was gradually de-enclosed, de-cultivated, densely populated, and civilianized, with the addition of capitals, halls, states, and counties. In April 1907 (33-March, clean-up), Qing Dynasty abolished the Heilongjiang, Jilin and General Feng Tian and established the three north-east provinces. The administrative areas of Heilongjiang Province inherited the jurisdiction of General Heilongjiang Province, bordering the south-east and south with Jilin Province, bordering the south-west with the province of China, bordering Mongolia in the west and bordering the north and north-east with Russia.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text: 1912年，清王朝被推翻，黑龙江省开禁，后来发现了金矿，淘金者纷纷涌至。中華民國時期黑龙江省名称和行政区划沿袭旧制不变以松花江为界，南归吉林省，北为黑龙江省所辖。这期间，从山東，直隸（河北），河南以及其他省份的大规模移民纷至沓来。有几百万新移民定居在今日的黑龙江省境内，从而形成了一个独特的边疆社会。
target_text: In 1912, the Qing dynasty was overthrown, the province of Heilongjiang was banned, and gold mines were discovered, and gold-diggers arrived. The name and administrative division of the province of Heilongjiang remained the same as the old system in China, with the province of Songhua and the province of Jilin to the south and the province of Heilongjiang to the north.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text: 1931年9月18日九一八事变后日軍由南向北大規模入侵东北地区，各地民眾及駐軍纷纷奋起抵抗，較著名的有如國民政府黑龍江代省主席馬占山指挥的江桥抗战（1931年11月3日～19日）。但由於其各自為政，遭到日軍一一击败，黑龙江全省也於民國二十一年初全部沦陷。日本扶持建立满洲国，将原黑龙江省所辖范围分别划归兴安北、兴安东、龙江、黑河、滨江、三江六省管辖。这一时期省际边界调整频繁，至1945年日本投降止，今黑龙江省界内划为龙江、滨江、三江、黑河、东满、北安6省。大量木材、粮食、煤炭以及矿产由此运往日本作为重要战备物资。日军还于北满各地建立各种工事、要塞、研究所等秘密军事机构，较著名的有进行细菌战、活体实验的731部队等。1945年日军战败后，黑龙江地区先后建立5个省级地方政权：黑龙江省、嫩江省、合江省、綏寧省和松江省。此外还有哈爾濱特别市建制。1947年2月2日，黑龙江省、嫩江省两省在齐齐哈尔市举行合并会议，决定合并为黑龙江嫩江联合省（简称黑嫩省），省政府驻齐齐哈尔市。1947年9月16日，东北行政委员会决定，将黑嫩联合省重新划分为黑龙江、嫩江2省。除将安达县划归嫩江省管辖外，原管辖区域不变。同时撤销第一、第二、第三、第四专区，第五专区仍恢复为黑河专区，归黑龙江省管辖。
target_text: Japan supported the establishment of the Manchurian State in the north-eastern region from the south to the north, with the population and the army fighting against the river bridge under the command of the President of Heilongjia Province (3-19 November 1931), but was defeated by the Japanese army as a result of their actions, the entire province of Heilongjiang was completely destroyed at the beginning of the twenty-first year of the People’s Republic of China. The former province of Heilongjiang was divided into the provinces of Heilongjiang north, Hing Andong, Longjiang, Heijiang, Bandi and Sanjiang, respectively. The provinces of Heilongjiang Province were divided into the provinces of Heilongjiang Province, which were under the control of the provinces of Heilong Dynasty, the Black and South China Rivers.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text: 1949年将今黑龙江地区的合江、松江、黑龙江、嫩江4省和哈尔滨特别市合并为黑龙江和松江两省，省会分别驻齐齐哈尔市和哈尔滨市。1954年松江省与黑龙江省合并成新的黑龙江省，省会为哈尔滨市，同时将原黑龙江省管辖的白城地区划归吉林省管辖。中苏交恶后，中华人民共和国内务部和国家测绘总局于1963年发布文件《关于请对存在俄语地名的问题进行调查研究提出处理意见的通知》，要求黑龙江省对其辖区内的俄语地名进行清理。随后，黑龙江省民政厅进行了统计，确定了20个过去使用但现在有中文名称的俄语地名（主要是哈尔滨市内的街道，以及黑龙江上的岛屿）和9个没有中文名称的地名后于1963年12月27日向北京发送了一份书面报告，其中包含对俄罗斯地名进行更名的建议，以及一些地名需要进一步研究的说明。1964年12月26日，中华人民共和国国务院应内政部的要求，批准了黑龙江省当局的提议。1969年7月，清代、中华民国时期原黑龙江省曾辖的呼伦贝尔地区由内蒙古自治区重新划归黑龙江省管辖。1979年7月，呼伦贝尔盟重新划归内蒙古自治区管辖，黑龙江省形成现今版图。
target_text: On 27 December 1963, the Ministry of the Interior of the People ' s Republic of China and the General Directorate of National Surveys sent a written report to Beijing, containing a proposal for a new name for the Russian language in the province of Heilongjiang and the town of Harbin. Subsequently, on 26 December 1964, the Ministry of the Interior of the People ' s Republic of China approved the transfer of 20 Russian-language geographical names (mainly the streets of Harbin and the islands of Heilongjiang) and nine non-Chinese-named geographical names from the province of Heilongjiang to the province of Heilongjiang.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text:
黑龙江省位于中国最东北部，是中国位置最北、纬度最高的省份，西起东经121°11′，东至东经135°05′，南起北纬43°26′，北至北纬53°33′，东西跨14个经度，南北跨10个纬度。全省土地总面积共约47.3万平方千米(含加格达奇和松岭)，居全国各省、直辖市、自治区第6位。国境线长2981.26千米。
接邻省区：吉林、内蒙古
接邻国家：俄罗斯（北界黑龙江，东界乌苏里江）
中国疆域的最东点（黑瞎子岛）和最北点（漠河）均位于黑龙江省境内。
target_text: Heilongjiang Province is located in the north-easternmost part of China, with the highest north-east location in China, 121°11 longitude eastward, 135°05 longitude east-east, 43°26 longitude north-south, 53°33 longitude north-south, 14 longitudes east-west and 10 long latitudes north-south. The total land area of the province is approximately 473,000 square kilometres (Higagdachi and Songling) and is 6th in all the provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions of China. The borderline is 2981.26 kilometres long.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text:
黑龙江省境内除西部和中部有一些内流河、东南角属于绥芬河流域以外，其余河流都属于黑龙江流域。省内流域面积在50平方千米以上的河流有1918条，其中流域面积在1万平方千米以上的有18条。主要的河流有：
黑龙江：是一条流经中、俄、蒙三国的国际河流，也是中国第三大河流，以克鲁伦河为源计算长度达5498公里，其中在本省境内长约1887公里；总流域面积达180多万平方公里，在中国境内流域面积约89万平方公里。黑龙江有额尔古纳河、石勒喀河南北二源，在漠河县西北部的洛古河附近汇合，始称黑龙江，省名即由江名而来。
松花江：在本省境内长约939公里，是黑龙江的第一大支流。流贯本省经济发达、人口稠密的中部地区，富航运、灌溉之利。
嫩江：发源于伊勒呼里山，长1370公里，系松花江北源，部分为黑龙江与内蒙古两省区的界河。
牡丹江：发源于吉林，在黑龙江省境内长约700公里，是本省东南部的重要河流，松花江的重要支流。
乌苏里江：发源于俄罗斯境内，为中俄界河。
target_text: The main rivers are: Heilongjiang, an international river that flows through China, Russia and Mon, and the third largest river in China, measuring 5498 km from the Kruron River, covering about 1887 km from the province; the total basin, covering more than 1.8 million km2 from China, covering about 890,000 km from China; and the central part of the central part of the central river of China, with a population of about 890,000 km from China.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text:
兴凯湖：位于黑龙江省东南部密山市境内，总面积4380平方公里，按总面积计算为中国第二大湖泊。该湖为中俄界湖，位于中国的水面面积为1090平方公里。
镜泊湖：位于牡丹江上游，面积92.5平方公里，是中国最大的火山熔岩堰塞湖。湖水出口处有落差达20米的吊水楼瀑布。
五大连池湖：，位于黑龙江省北部五大连池市，指五个首尾相连的火山堰塞湖，系1719年至1721年发生的火山爆发所形成。
此外，松嫩平原上还有许多小湖泊，当地俗称为“泡子”。
target_text: Heung Kai Lake, located in the city of Myosan, south-east of Heilongjiang Province, with a total area of 4380 square kilometres, is China’s second largest lake in terms of total area. The lake is a Chinese-Russian lake with a surface area of 1090 square kilometres.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text:
气候
黑龙江省是中國最北的省份，地处欧亚大陆东岸东北亚区域的中高纬度地区，属于大陆性季风气候，依温度指标从北向南可分为寒温带和中温带；依干燥度指标从东向西可分为湿润区、半湿润区和半干旱区。全省四季分明，冬季漫长、严寒、干燥，夏季短促、湿润、多雨，春、秋两季气候多变，最西北部全年无夏。全年平均气温从北往南在-5~4℃之间，自西北向东南渐低，相差近10℃。最冷月（一月）平均气温-30℃至-18℃，最热月（七月）平均气温18℃至23℃，年温差高达38℃-48℃。最北部的漠河县极端最低气温达-52.3℃，系中国最低气温记录。全省全年晴朗天气较多，无霜期约90-120天。年均降水量400-700毫米，东部多、西部少，以小兴安岭和张广才岭最多，可达700毫米以上；大兴安岭北部最少，不足400毫米。全年降水量的百分之60集中在六、七、八三个月；冬季和春季降水量少。春季松嫩平原和三江平原风能资源丰富。秋季冷空气活动频繁，降温较快。
target_text: The northernmost province of the province of Heilongjiang is the mid-high latitude of the north-east Asian region on the eastern coast of Eurasia. It is part of the continental monsoon climate, which can be divided into cold and medium temperate zones depending on the temperature indicator from north to south; the dryness indicator can be divided into humid zones, semi-humid areas and semi-arid areas from east to west. The provinces are characterized by four seasons, long winters, harsh and dry, short summers, humid, heavy rains, spring and autumn seasons, with the north-west being characterized by high temperatures throughout the year, ranging from north to north to north to 5 to 4°C. The average temperature from north to south to south is about 10°C. The coldest month (January) average is between 30°C and 18°C, the warmer month (July) is 18°C to 23°C, the hot month (July) is characterized by short temperatures of 38° C-48°C, the dry seasons of autumn and the north-west is characterized by low temperatures of 52.3°C.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text:
四至行政区划
黑龙江省现辖12个地级市、1个地区，下设54个市辖区、21个县级市、45个县、1个自治县；1315个乡级行政单位，包括574镇，282乡，52民族乡，407街道。地级市：哈尔滨市（行政级別为副省级）、齐齐哈尔市、鸡西市、鹤岗市、双鸭山市、大庆市、伊春市、佳木斯市、七台河市、牡丹江市、黑河市、绥化市
地区：大兴安岭地区
target_text: In Heilongjiang province, there are now 12 municipalities and 1 district, with 54 municipalities, 21 counties, 45 counties and 1 autonomous district; 1315 communal administrative units, including 574 towns, 282 communes, 52 ethnic communes, 407 streets.

source_text:
人口
2022年末，全省常住总人口3099万人，比上年减少26万人。其中，城镇人口2052万人，乡村人口1047万人。常住人口城镇化率为66.2%，比上年提高0.5个百分点。0—14岁人口占全省总人口的比重为9.3%，65岁及以上人口占全省总人口的比重为17.8%。根据2021年统计公报，全省总常住人口为3125万人，比2020年减少46万人。
target_text: At the end of 2022, the total resident population of the province was 3,099,000, a decrease of 260,000 from the previous year. Of these, the urban population was 2.52 million and the rural population 10.47 million. The rate of urbanization of the resident population was 66.2 per cent, an increase of 0.5 percentage points from the previous year. The population aged 0-14 accounted for 9.3 per cent of the total population of the province and the population aged 65 and over accounted for 17.8 per cent of the total population of the province. According to the 2021 statistical bulletin, the total resident population of the province was 31.25 million, a decrease of 460,000 from 2020.
title: 黑龙江省

source_text:
民族
在黑龙江省，漢族占絕大多數，其中很多人是清朝時山東、河北一帶的移民後裔。官方认定了10个世居少数民族：满族、朝鲜族、蒙古族、回族、达斡尔族、锡伯族、赫哲族、鄂伦春族、鄂温克族、柯尔克孜族。其中，赫哲族是黑龙江省独有的民族。省内有杜尔伯特蒙古族自治县，齐齐哈尔有梅里斯达斡尔族区，此外有若干民族乡等。
target_text: In Heilongjiang province, the Han ethnic group is the majority. Many of them are immigrants of ethnic origin from the north and the east of the river. There are 10 native ethnic minorities officially identified: the Man, the Korean, the Mongol, the Hue, the Dahir, the Cibs, the Hechts, the Horunchun, the Swink, the Kolkzys. The Hechze ethnic group is the exclusive ethnic group from the Heilongjiang province. There is an autonomous municipality of the Durbert Mongol ethnic group in the province, the Merisda ethnic group in Qihar, and a number of ethnic communities.
title: 黑龙江省
